

######## Adamance
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Adamance
| routecost = 0
| image = Adamance moon map.png
}}<translate>

<!--T:1-->
'''Adamance''' is a free moon added in version 50 as one of the three intermediate moons along with [[Offense]] and [[March]]. It has a hazard level of "B" and is arguably the most dangerous free moon.

== Description == <!--T:2-->
</translate>
{{Template:Terminal|text=20-Adamance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>
<translate>

<!--T:3-->
CONDITIONS: Erosion and geographical forces have resulted in a landscape of deep valleys and mountains.

<!--T:4-->
HISTORY: Adamance is the biggest and oldest of what are colloquially referred to as the "Green Witches": Vow, March, and Adamance, which orbit No Service.

<!--T:5-->
FAUNA: Adamance is home to a lively, diverse ecosystem of smaller-sized omnivores.</translate>}}
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
== Environment ==
Adamance has a forest landscape, similar to that of [[Vow]] and [[March]], with many red-leaved trees across its surface. However a key difference between other forest moons being the prominently steep terrain which should be navigated with caution.
</translate><br><translate>
<!--T:13-->
The area in front of the ship door, the main entrance, and the bottom of the valley have large numbers of flowers. There is a small cabin at one end of the valley similar to the one on [[Rend]], which contains one of the [[Sigurd Logs]] and the words "[[Artifice|68 ART]]" painted on a wall. The cabin is always locked at the beginning of the day, requiring a [[Key]] or [[Lockpicker]] to enter.

<!--T:14-->
The interior is most often the [[Factory]], but can also be the [[Mineshaft]], or on rare occasion the [[Mansion]].

<!--T:7-->
== Strategy ==
Getting to Adamance's main entrance is relatively easy, only requiring a brief trek up the cliff opposite the ship. However, due to Adamance's cliff faces near the ship and the main entrance, it can be difficult to reach those places if in a hurry and the narrow paths can be easily blocked by most outdoor entities.

<!--T:26-->
There are 2 bridges on Adamance:
The one spanning from the ship to the main entrance uses the [[Bridge|normal bridge mechanics]].
The shorter one, providing easier access to the fire exit, always breaks the 4th time an employee lands on it, including jumping in place.

<!--T:16-->
The hills can be quickly descended by hugging close to them. It is possible to circumvent the valley and the bridge by scaling the left side of the hill behind the cabin, where the slope is the least steep.

<!--T:17-->
There is a permanent quicksand pit to the right of the main entrance.

=== Weather === <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
Adamance can have any type of weather. When flooded, it has the maximum water level at the beginning of the day (requiring the use of the bridges to reach the building) and slowly drains over time, making trips through the valley possible.

######## Adamance/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Adamance
| routecost = 0
| image = Adamance moon map.png
}}
'''Adamance''' is a free moon added in version 50 as one of the three intermediate moons along with [[Offense]] and [[March]]. It has a hazard level of "B" and is arguably the most dangerous free moon.

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=20-Adamance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Erosion and geographical forces have resulted in a landscape of deep valleys and mountains.

HISTORY: Adamance is the biggest and oldest of what are colloquially referred to as the "Green Witches": Vow, March, and Adamance, which orbit No Service.

FAUNA: Adamance is home to a lively, diverse ecosystem of smaller-sized omnivores.}}
== Environment ==
Adamance has a forest landscape, similar to that of [[Vow]] and [[March]], with many red-leaved trees across its surface. However a key difference between other forest moons being the prominently steep terrain which should be navigated with caution.<br>The area in front of the ship door, the main entrance, and the bottom of the valley have large numbers of flowers. There is a small cabin at one end of the valley similar to the one on [[Rend]], which contains one of the [[Sigurd Logs]] and the words "[[Artifice|68 ART]]" painted on a wall. The cabin is always locked at the beginning of the day, requiring a [[Key]] or [[Lockpicker]] to enter.

The interior is most often the [[Factory]], but can also be the [[Mineshaft]], or on rare occasion the [[Mansion]].

== Strategy ==
Getting to Adamance's main entrance is relatively easy, only requiring a brief trek up the cliff opposite the ship. However, due to Adamance's cliff faces near the ship and the main entrance, it can be difficult to reach those places if in a hurry and the narrow paths can be easily blocked by most outdoor entities.

There are 2 bridges on Adamance:
The one spanning from the ship to the main entrance uses the [[Bridge|normal bridge mechanics]].
The shorter one, providing easier access to the fire exit, always breaks the 4th time an employee lands on it, including jumping in place.

The hills can be quickly descended by hugging close to them. It is possible to circumvent the valley and the bridge by scaling the left side of the hill behind the cabin, where the slope is the least steep.

There is a permanent quicksand pit to the right of the main entrance.

=== Weather ===

Adamance can have any type of weather. When flooded, it has the maximum water level at the beginning of the day (requiring the use of the bridges to reach the building) and slowly drains over time, making trips through the valley possible.

######## Adamance/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Adamance
| routecost = 0
| image = Adamance moon map.png
}}
'''Adamance''' - бесплатная луна, добавленная в версии 50 как одна из трёх лун средней сложности к уже имевшимся на тот момент [[Offense/ru|Offense]] и [[March/ru|March]]. Имеет уровень угрозы "B" и, возможно, является самой сложной средней луной.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=20-Adamance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: Эрозия и геологические силы привели к ландшафту, полному глубоких расщелин и гор.

ИСТОРИЯ: Adamance - крупнейшая и самая старшая из так называемых "Зелёных Ведьм": Vow, March и Adamance на орбите вокруг No Service

ФАУНА: Adamance - дом для живой и разнообразной экосистемы мелких всеядных.}}
== Окружение ==
Adamance обладает лесным ландшафтом, похожим на таковые у [[Vow/ru|Vow]] и [[March/ru|March]], с кучей красно-лиственных деревьев раскиданных по поверхности. Тем не менее ключевым отличием от других лесных лун является крутая местность, передвигаться по которой надо с осторожностью.<br>Пространство перед дверьми корабля, перед главным входом и на дне расщелины покрыто огромным количеством цветов. На одном из концов внизу расщелины имеется хижина, подобная той, что встречается на [[Rend/ru|Rend]], которая содержит одну из [[Sigurd Logs/ru|Записей Сигурда]] и нанесённую на внутреннюю стену надпись "[[Artifice/ru|68 ART]]", которую можно разглядеть, если включить в хижине свет. В начале каждого дня хижина заперта и требует для открытия [[Key|Ключ]] или [[Lockpicker/ru|Отмычку]]

Зданием зачастую является [[Завод]], но иногда может быть [[Особняк|Особняком]] или, в редких случаях, [[Шахты|Шахтами]].

== Стратегия ==
Добраться до главного входа на Adamance относительно легко, нужно лишь взобраться на скалу напротив корабля. Однако, забраться на скалы у главного входа и корабля в спешке может быть трудно и узкие тропки часто блокируются большинством уличных сущностей.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There are 2 bridges on Adamance:
The one spanning from the ship to the main entrance uses the [[Bridge|normal bridge mechanics]].
The shorter one, providing easier access to the fire exit, always breaks the 4th time an employee lands on it, including jumping in place.
</div>

По крутым склонам можно быстро и безболезненно спуститься, прижавшись к ним. Возможно обойти расщелину и мост, прижавшись слева к горе за хижиной, где склон не такой крутой.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Справа от главного входа имеется постоянная грязевая лужа, подобно [[March/ru|March]].
</div>

<span id="Weather"></span>
=== Погода ===

На Adamance возможны все погодные условия. При затоплении в начале дня уровень воды будет максимальным, требуя от сотрудников использования мостов, и будет постепенно опускаться с течением дня, делая возможным переход по низу расщелины.

== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
При перелёте на орбиту Adamance, вместо сообщения "Приятного полёта" терминал выдаст "Удачи". Это сообщение также выводится при перелёте на [[Titan/ru|Titan]] и [[Embrion/ru|Embrion]].

В ранний период разработки Версии 50, название нынешней Adamance было Constancy, а тогдашней Adamance была нынешняя [[Artifice/ru|Artifice]].{{cite Patreon|date=2024-04-07|slug=version-50-post-101884472|title=The Version 50 Post}}

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=20-Adamance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：侵蚀和地理因素导致了深谷和山脉的景观。

历史：Adamance 是俗称“绿色女巫”的 Vow 、 March 与 Adamance 中最大、最古老的一个。这些星球围绕 No Service 旋转。

生态： Adamance 是一个充满活力、多样化的小型杂食动物生态系统的家园。}}
== 环境 ==
Adamance 的环境为一片森林景观，类似于 [[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]] 和 [[March/zh-cn|March]] ，表面有许多红叶树。然而，其他森林星球之间的一个关键区别是明显陡峭的地形，应该谨慎探索。<br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The area in front of the ship door, the main entrance, and the bottom of the valley have large numbers of flowers. There is a small cabin at one end of the valley similar to the one on [[Rend]], which contains one of the [[Sigurd Logs]] and the words "[[Artifice|68 ART]]" painted on a wall. The cabin is always locked at the beginning of the day, requiring a [[Key]] or [[Lockpicker]] to enter.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The interior is most often the [[Factory]], but can also be the [[Mineshaft]], or on rare occasion the [[Mansion]].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 策略 ==
到达 Adamance 的主要入口相对容易，只需要在船对面的悬崖上短暂跋涉。然而，由于 Adamance 靠近船只和主要入口的悬崖面，如果匆忙的话很难到达这些地方，狭窄的道路很容易被大多数外部实体堵塞。从船到主要入口的桥梁可能遵循与 [[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]] 的脆弱桥梁相同的机制，尽管这可能会改变。地图右侧的桥似乎总是在第四次使用时断裂。靠近山丘可以很快下山。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There are 2 bridges on Adamance:
The one spanning from the ship to the main entrance uses the [[Bridge|normal bridge mechanics]].
The shorter one, providing easier access to the fire exit, always breaks the 4th time an employee lands on it, including jumping in place.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The hills can be quickly descended by hugging close to them. It is possible to circumvent the valley and the bridge by scaling the left side of the hill behind the cabin, where the slope is the least steep.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a permanent quicksand pit to the right of the main entrance.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Weather ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Adamance can have any type of weather. When flooded, it has the maximum water level at the beginning of the day (requiring the use of the bridges to reach the building) and slowly drains over time, making trips through the valley possible.
</div>

Using it with {{keybind|Item primary use}} produces a loud sound that can be heard by other employees and entities that can hear. If dropped while producing sound, it creates a mildly amusing “sad airhorn” noise caused by the game's exaggerated [[w:Doppler_effect|Doppler effect]].

<!--T:1-->
'''Ammo''' (short for 'ammunition'), a.k.a. '''Shotgun shell''', is a consumable item in the game, exclusively dropped from [[Nutcracker]]s.
It becomes available for collection after defeating a Nutcracker.

<!--T:2-->
The primary function of Ammo is to facilitate reloading the [[Shotgun]] while held in your inventory when there is space for it in the shotgun, the sole ranged weapon featured in the game, consuming the shell. Notably, Ammo is consistently generated in pairs upon the Nutcracker's defeat.

<!--T:3-->
Players are unable to purchase Ammo through the in-game terminal. Shotgun shells can be sold at the [[Gordion|Company Building]], but sell for nothing.

<!--T:5-->
Despite their minimal size and no sell value, they can't be put in the [[utility slot]].
</translate>

######## Ammo/en

{{Template:Investigation}}
'''Ammo''' (short for 'ammunition'), a.k.a. '''Shotgun shell''', is a consumable item in the game, exclusively dropped from [[Nutcracker]]s.
It becomes available for collection after defeating a Nutcracker.

The primary function of Ammo is to facilitate reloading the [[Shotgun]] while held in your inventory when there is space for it in the shotgun, the sole ranged weapon featured in the game, consuming the shell. Notably, Ammo is consistently generated in pairs upon the Nutcracker's defeat.

Players are unable to purchase Ammo through the in-game terminal. Shotgun shells can be sold at the [[Gordion|Company Building]], but sell for nothing.

Despite their minimal size and no sell value, they can't be put in the [[utility slot]].

######## Apparatus
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The '''Apparatus''' (or, "Apparatice") is a special [[Scrap]] that can only spawn in one of 4 possible locations in the [[Facility]] interior. It resembles a glowing power cell,  provides energy to the interior, and has worn-out text on its underside reading "Model: GJH-851 #458agf-6" (with the "-" symbolizing a character that's too faded to be legible). Despite its value being shown as "???" in-game, it will always be worth {{credits|80}}.

<!--T:16-->
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops. 

<!--T:4-->
Additionally, collecting the Apparatus has a 70% chance of increasing the interior enemy spawn rate (spawning 2 monsters minimum every "spawn wave") until you leave the moon. Unplugging the Apparatus will also instantly activate any dormant [[Old Bird]] outside the facility. This means that pulling the Apparatus early in your run can make things significantly harder.

<!--T:5-->
Once removed, it cannot be reinserted - it is best salvaged last, with an escape route planned out beforehand.

<!--T:6-->
Its properties can be used to open secure doors if opening them via the [[Computer Terminal|Terminal]] is inconvenient.

######## Apparatus/cs
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Aparát''' je cenný svítící napájecí článek který přináší energii do [[Facility|Zařízení]]. Vždycky se objevuje v oddané 'generátorové místnosti' v Zařízení. Sbíráním ho trvale vypne v Zařízení elektriku, což dělá útěk těžší: všechna světla se vypnou, všechny bunkrové dveře budou nuceně otevřená a nemůžou se zavřít. Avšak [[Turret|Turrety]] a [[Landmine|Nášlapné miny]] budou stále fungovat a můžou se vypnout jako obvykle.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops.
</div> 

Navíc, sbírání Aparátu má 70% šanci zvýšení objevovací míry vnitřních příšer (objeví se minimálně 2 příšery každou "objevovací vlnu") dokud neopustíte měsíc. Sbírání Aparátu okamžitě aktivuje všechny nečinné [[Old Bird|Staré Ptáky]] mimo zařízení. Což znamená že sbírání Aparátu brzy ve sví hře udělá ji mnohem těžší.

Jak je vyndaný, nemůže být vyndaný - je nejlepší ho vzít poslední, s předem plánovanou únikovou cestou.

Jeho vlastnosti mohou být využity k otevření bunkrových dveří když otevírání přes [[Computer Terminal|Terminál]] je nevyhovující.

== Drobnosti ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">"Vrták" pod [[Gordion|Gordionem]] má dva sloty který vypadají podobně nebo identický k slotu Aparátu. Prozatím<sup>[kdy?]</sup>, nemůže se do nich Aparát dát.</span>

* Vnitřně, tenhle předmět se jmenuje "Plícový Aparát", pravděpodobně kvůli tomu že vdechuje život do čehokoliv do čeho je připojený.

Zeekerss released it in a Patreon post.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}</span>
* V záběrů hry před vydáním<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vt08pWqO6Og Záběry na YouTubu]</ref>, existoval výtah který by vás bral mezi patry [[Facility|Zařízení]], podobně k vrtačce. Měl slot pro Aparát. Lze předpokládat, že v určité fázi vývoje, hráči měli najít a přinést Aparát aby poháněl zmíněný výtah.

{{navbox items}}

######## Apparatus/de
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der '''Apparatus''', bzw. '''Apparatice''' wie er im Spiel genannt wird, ist eine wertvolle leuchtende Energiezelle, die die [[Interiors#The Factory/de|Fabrik]] mit Strom versorgt. Sie erscheint in der Fabrik immer in einem dazugehörigen "Generatorraum". Sammelt man den Apparatus ein, fällt der Strom in der gesamten Fabrik aus und macht so eine Flucht schwieriger: alle Lichter gehen aus und Sicherheitstüren bleiben permanent geöffnet; [[Interiors#Turrets/de|Geschütze]] und [[Interiors#Landmines/de|Tretminen]] sind dagegen weiterhin aktiv und können wie gewohnt ausgeschalten werden.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Außerdem hat das Einsammeln des Apparatus eine 70% Chance die Anzahl der neu erscheinenden Kreaturen zu erhöhen (sodass bei jeder "Welle" 2 Kreaturen erscheinen bis man den Mond verlässt). Den Apparatus früh am Tag zu entfernen kann das weitere Erkunden also erheblich erschweren.
</div>

Sobald der Apparatus einmal entfernt wurde, kann er nicht wieder eingesetzt werden - daher ist es am sinnvollsten den Apparatus als letztes zu holen und sich vorher zu überlegen, auf welchem Weg man die Fabrik wieder verlässt.

Der Apparatus kann benutzt werden, um Sicherheitstüren in Fällen zu öffnen, wenn dies vom [[Computer Terminal|Computer]] aus nicht möglich oder umständlich ist.

== Trivia ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Der "Bohrer" unter [[Gordion/de]] hat zwei Plätze die aussehen, wie die für den Apparatus. Aktuell kann jedoch kein Apparatus in einen der Plätze eingesteckt werden.</span>
* Obwohl der Apparatus als "Apparatice" vom Scanner anzeigt wird, nennt die Gehaltsabrechnung ihn "Apparatus".
* Intern wird der Gegenstand "Lung Apparatus" betitelt, vermutlich da er Leben in alles einhaucht, in das er eingesteckt wird.
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Cut_Content|cut]] page from the [[Training manual]] would have given Lung Apparatuses some backstory, as well as hinting at the power-out mechanics. Zeekerss released it in a Patreon post.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">In Material von vor der Veröffentlichung existierte ein Aufzug, der benutzt wurde um zwischen Etagen der Fabrik zu wechseln. Dieser hatte ähnlich wie der Bohrer einen Platz für den Apparatus. Es ist anzunehmen, dass an einem Punkt in der Entwicklung des Spiels, Spieler den Apparatus finden und zum Aufzug zurückbringen mussten, um ihn mit Strom zu versorgen.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vt08pWqO6Og</ref></span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The model number located on the Apparatus's underside is the same texture that appears on the back of the [[Company Cruiser]].</span>

{{navbox items}}

######## Apparatus/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
The '''Apparatus''' (or, "Apparatice") is a special [[Scrap]] that can only spawn in one of 4 possible locations in the [[Facility]] interior. It resembles a glowing power cell,  provides energy to the interior, and has worn-out text on its underside reading "Model: GJH-851 #458agf-6" (with the "-" symbolizing a character that's too faded to be legible). Despite its value being shown as "???" in-game, it will always be worth {{credits|80}}.

Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops. 

Additionally, collecting the Apparatus has a 70% chance of increasing the interior enemy spawn rate (spawning 2 monsters minimum every "spawn wave") until you leave the moon. Unplugging the Apparatus will also instantly activate any dormant [[Old Bird]] outside the facility. This means that pulling the Apparatus early in your run can make things significantly harder.

Once removed, it cannot be reinserted - it is best salvaged last, with an escape route planned out beforehand.

Its properties can be used to open secure doors if opening them via the [[Computer Terminal|Terminal]] is inconvenient.

== Spawn chances ==

The Apparatus' Spawn Chances are exactly the same as the Spawn Chances of a [[Factory]] Interior on any Moon, as this Interior always generates one (except in extremely rare cases, which is most likely a bug).

== Trivia ==
* The "drill" under [[Gordion]] has two slots that seem similar and or identical to the Apparatus slot. As of [[Version 73]], they still do not accept the Apparatus.
* The spelling of the word "Apparatus" is different in the item's scan node, instead being called the "Apparatice".
* Internally, this item is dubbed the "Lung Apparatus", presumably because it breathes life to whatever it's plugged into.
** A [[Cut_Content|cut]] page from the [[Training manual]] would have given Lung Apparatuses some backstory, as well as hinting at the power-out mechanics. Zeekerss released it in a Patreon post.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}
* In pre-release footage,{{cite YouTube|video-id=Vt08pWqO6Og|title=Lethal Company - Announcement Teaser|creator=Zeekerss}} there existed an elevator used to travel between floors of the [[Facility]], similarly to the drill. It also had a slot for the Apparatus. It can be assumed that during some point in development, players needed to find and bring the Apparatus back in order to power said elevator.
* The model number located on the Apparatus's underside is the same texture that appears on the back of the [[Company Cruiser]].

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Le '''Cœur d'énergie''', ou l''''Appy''' comme il est appelé communément, est une cellule énergitique de  valeur qui apporte de l'électricité dans l'[[Usine]]. Il spawn toujours dans la 'pièce du générateur'. Le collecter désactive de façon permanente l'électricité de l'Usine, sortir est devenu plus compliqué : toutes les lumières s'éteigne, toutes les portes bunker sont ouvertes et ne peuvent plus être fermé. Cependant, les [[Traps|Tourelles]] et les [[Traps|Mines]] fonctionne toujours et peuvent être désactivé normalement.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. En plus, collecter le Cœur d'énergie a une chance de 70% d'augmenter le taux de spawn à l'intérieur (Spawn 2 monstres minimum toutes les "vagues de spawn") jusqu'a que vous quittez la lune. Collecter le Cœur d'énergie va activez immédiatement tous les dormants [[Old Bird|Garde Robot]] à l'extérieur. Ca veut dire que si vous retirez le Cœur d'énergie tôt dans votre journée, cela peut compliqué votre retour.

Une fois retiré, il ne peut pas être replacé, c'est mieux de le prendre en dernier avec une route d'échappatoire prévue à l'avance.

Ces propriétés font qui peut être utilisé pour ouvrir les portes bunker si les ouvrir via le [[Computer Terminal|Terminal]] est inconvénient.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Bateria''' lub '''Apparatus''', jak się je nazywa w grze, to cenne świecące ogniwo energetyczne dostarczające energię do [[Facility/pl|Bazy]]. Zawsze pojawia się w dedykowanym „pomieszczeniu generatora” w obiekcie. Zebranie go spowoduje trwałe wyłączenie zasilania bazy, co utrudni ucieczkę: wszystkie światła zgasną, wszystkie drzwi bunkrowe zostaną otwarte i nie będzie można ich już zamknąć. Jednakże [[Interiors#Turrets/pl|Wieżyczki]] i [[Interiors#Landmines/pl|Miny lądowe]] nadal działają i można je jak zwykle wyłączyć.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dodatkowo, zebranie Baterii ma 70% szans na zwiększenie częstotliwości pojawiania się wrogów wewnątrz (pojawianie minimum 2 potworów na każdą „falę odradzania”, dopóki nie opuścisz księżyca). Zabranie Baterii od razu aktywuje [[Old Bird/pl|Stare Jastrzębie]] znajdujące się na zewnątrz Bazy. Oznacza to, że ciągnięcie urządzenia na początku dnia może znacznie rundę.
</div>

Raz usuniętej nie można zastąpić nową – najlepiej jest ją zabrać jako ostatnią, z wcześniej zaplanowaną drogą ucieczki.

Jego właściwości można wykorzystać do otwierania drzwi bunkrowych, jeśli otwieranie ich za pomocą [[Computer Terminal/pl|terminalu]] jest niewygodne.

== Dodatkowe informacje ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">„Wiertło” pod [[Gordion/pl|Gordion]] ma dwa miejsca, które wydają się podobne i/lub identyczne do gniazda Baterii. W tej chwili nie mają żadnego zastosowania.</span>
* Mimo iż Bateria jest nazywana w grze "Apparatice" podczas skanowania jej, okienko rachunku sprzedaży nazywa ją "Apparatus".
* Nieformalnie, przedmiot ten nazywany jest „Lung Apparatus” (Aparatem płucnym), prawdopodobnie dlatego, że tchnie życie w wszystko, do czego jest podłączony.
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Cut_Content|cut]] page from the [[Training manual]] would have given Lung Apparatuses some backstory, as well as hinting at the power-out mechanics. Zeekerss released it in a Patreon post.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}</span>
* W materiale przedpremierowym<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vt08pWqO6Og materiał na YouTube]</ref> istniała winda używana do przemieszczania się pomiędzy piętrami [[Facility/pl|Bazy]], podobnie jak wiertło. Miało także miejsce na Baterię. Można założyć, że na pewnym etapie rozwoju gracze musieli znaleźć i przynieść Baterię, aby zasilić wspomnianą windę.
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The model number located on the Apparatus's underside is the same texture that appears on the back of the [[Company Cruiser]].</span>

######## Apparatus/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
O '''Aparelho''' é uma célula de energia provendo energia para a [[Facility|Fábrica]]. Ele sempre gera uma 'sala do gerador' específica na Fábrica. Coletá-lo fará com que a energia da Fábrica seja permanentemente desabilitada, fazendo com que a fuga seja mais difícil: todas as luzes se apagam; todas as portas reforçadas são abertas e não podem ser mais fechadas. Porém [[Turret/pt-br|torretas]] e [[Landmines/pt-br|minas terrestres]] ainda funcionam e podem ser desabilitadas normalmente.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops.
</div> 

Além do mais, coletar o Aparelho tem uma chance de 70% de aumentar a taxa de geração de entidades no interior (gerando 2 monstros no mínimo a cada "onda de geração") até a equipe sai da lua. Coletar o Aparelho também instantaneamente ativará qualquer [[Old Bird/pt-br|Old Birds]] dormentes fora da instalação. Isso quer dizer que pegar o Aparelho cedo ao pousar na lua fará com que a sessão seja mais difícil.

Quando removido, ele não pode ser recolocado - é melhor pegá-lo por último, com uma rota de fuga planejada anteriormente.

Suas propriedades podem ser utilizadas para abrir portas reforçadas, caso seja inconveniente abri-las usando o [[Ship/pt-br#Terminal|Terminal]].

== Trivia ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">A "broca" embaixo de [[Goridon/pt-br|Gordion]] tem dois encaixes que parecem ser semelhantes ou idênticos ao encaixe do Aparelho. Até a versão 64, eles não recebem o Aparelho.</span>
* Em inglês, quando escaneado, o Aparelho é chamado de “Apparatice”, porém quando vendido, a tela mostrando o salário chama-o de “Apparatus”.
* Internamente, esse item é chamado de "Lung Apparatus", traduzindo para "Aparelho de pulmão", provavelmente, pois ele inspira vida onde estiver plugado.
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Cut_Content|cut]] page from the [[Training manual]] would have given Lung Apparatuses some backstory, as well as hinting at the power-out mechanics. Zeekerss released it in a Patreon post.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}</span>
* Em vídeos de pré-lançamento<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vt08pWqO6Og O vídeo noYouTube]</ref>, existia um elevador usado para viajar entre os andares da [[Interiors/pt-br|fábrica]], similar à broca. Ele também tinha um encaixe para o Aparelho. Pode ser assumido que, durante o desenvolvimento, jogadores deveriam buscar e achar o Aparelho de volta para energizar tal elevador
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The model number located on the Apparatus's underside is the same texture that appears on the back of the [[Company Cruiser]].</span>

######## Apparatus/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
'''Аппарат''' - это уникальный [[scrap|лом]], который может появиться только в одной из 4-х возможных локаций на [[Interiors/ru#Завод|Заводе]]. Он напоминает светящуюся энерго-ячейку, которая питает энергией всё здание, а также обладает слегка стёршимся текстом на нижней стороне: "Model: GJH-851 #458agf-6" (Где символ "-" означает символ на модели, стёршийся слишком сильно, чтобы его распознать). Несмотря на то, что его ценность указана как "???", в игре он всегда будет иметь ценность {{credits|80}}.

При отключении Аппарата от машины в здании навсегда отключится свет, делая передвижение по нему затруднительным: все источники света отключатся, все защитные двери откроются и больше не смогут быть закрыты. Тем не менее [[Traps|Турели]], [[Traps|Мины]] и [[Traps|Платформы с шипами]] продолжат функционировать как обычно. Единственный способ хотя бы временно вдохнуть жизнь в электросеть здания - использовать [[Zap gun/ru|Электро-пушку]] на [[Interiors/ru#Электрощиток|Электрощитке]], из-за чего все источники освещения начнут непродолжительно мерцать в момент, когда так начинает и перестаёт течь. 

Также, сбор Аппарата имеет 70% шанс увеличить частоту спавна врагов внутри (спавня минимум 2х монстров каждый "цикл спавна") пока вы не покинете луну. Отключение Аппарата также немедленно активирует всех спящих [[Old Bird/ru|Старых Птиц]] снаружи здания. Это означает что сбор Аппарата в начале игры может сделать ваш забег значительно сложнее.

Взяв Аппарат, вставить назад вы его уже не сможете. Лучше всего его брать в последнюю очередь, заранее запланировав путь побега.

Его свойства могут быть использованы для открытия защитных дверей при невозможности открытия их через [[Ship/ru#Терминал|Терминал]] или щиток.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные Факты ==
* "Дрель" под [[Gordion/ru|Gordion]] имеет 2 слота, схожих или идентичных со слотом от Аппарата. Но на момент [[Version 69|Версии 69]] Аппарат вставить туда нельзя.
* В игре при сканировании называется “Apparatice”, а при выдаче Зарплаты он называется “Apparatus”.
* Внутри кода игры этот предмет называется "Лёгочный Аппарат" ("Lung Apparatus"), предположительно из-за того, что он вдыхает жизнь во всё, во что воткнут.
** [[Cut_Content|Вырезанная]] страница из [[Training manual|инструкции]] могла бы описывать предысторию Лёгочных Аппаратов, а также указывать на механику отключения энергии. Zeekerss выпустил её в посте на Patreon.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}
* В до-релизном видео{{cite YouTube|video-id=Vt08pWqO6Og|title=Lethal Company - Announcement Teaser|creator=Zeekerss}} существовал лифт, использовавшийся для путешествия между этажами [[Interiors/ru#Завод|Завода]]. Подобно дрели у него также был слот для Аппарата. Можно предположить, что в определённый момент разработки игры игрокам нужно было найти и принести обратно Аппарат, чтобы запитать этот лифт.
* Номер модели, указанный на нижней стороне Аппарата является той же текстурой, что и на задней части [[Company Cruiser|Крузера Компании]]

######## Apparatus/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''发电装置'''，游戏内称为“Apparatice”，是为设施供电的高价值发光动力电池，其总在特定的“[[Generator rooms|配电房]]”内生成。将其拔出后会永久切断设施内电源，提高离开设施的难度：所有灯光熄灭、强制打开所有安全门且无法再关闭。不过，[[Traps/zh-cn|炮台]]和[[Traps/zh-cn|地雷]]不会停止工作，且仍可以被正常关闭。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Unplugging the Apparatus from its machine will permanently disable the facility's power, making navigation more difficult: all lights turn off, all secure doors are forced open and can't be closed anymore. However, [[Traps|Turrets]], [[Traps|Landmines]] and [[Spike Trap|Spike Traps]] still function and can be disabled from the [[Terminal]] as usual. The only way to temporarily bring light back to the facility is by using a [[Zap gun]] to shock the Facility's [[Interiors#Breaker panel|Breaker box]], which will cause all lights to flicker for a moment when the electric current starts & stops.
</div> 

拔下发电装置有 70% 的概率会导致室内实体生成率增加（在每一波“生成潮”时至少生成 2 个实体），还会立即激活所有在室外待机的[[Old Bird|“机敏”号机器人]]。这意味着过早地拔下发电装置会显著提升游戏内各方面的难度。

发电装置一旦被拔出就无法再次插回——所以最好在离开星球前再拔出，且应提前计划好撤退路线。

由于发电装置的特性，也可用其打开在[[Computer Terminal|终端]]上不方便打开的安全门。

== 杂项 ==
* [[Gordion]]地下的“钻机”有两个看上去可以插入发电装置的插槽，但截至[[Version 69|版本 69]]还无法使用。
* 虽然在扫描时，发电装置被称为“Apparatice”，但在结算屏幕上其仍显示为“Apparatus”。
* 游戏内部（代码）将发电装置称为“Lung Apparatus（肺部装置）”，可能是因为该装置可为任何插在它上面的东西注入生命力。
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Cut_Content|cut]] page from the [[Training manual]] would have given Lung Apparatuses some backstory, as well as hinting at the power-out mechanics. Zeekerss released it in a Patreon post.{{cite Patreon|date=2022-06-16|slug=i-figured-it-out-67830705|title=I figured it out! (Lore and inspirations)}}</span>
* 在游戏的预发行预览视频<ref>[https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV14C411s7vh 预览视频]（[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vt08pWqO6Og YouTube 原视频]）</ref>中，有一个可在[[Facility|设施]]的楼层间穿梭的电梯。电梯内有一个发电装置插槽，与钻机类似。据此可推测，在游戏开发的某段时间内，玩家需要找到发电装置并将其带回，以为这一电梯供电。
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The model number located on the Apparatus's underside is the same texture that appears on the back of the [[Company Cruiser]].</span>

<!--T:18-->
'''Artifice''' is a secret moon. It has a hazard level of "S++", the highest in the game and the only accessible moon with this level. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Artifice is 1500 credits.

<!--T:19-->
It does not appear in the list from the Terminal's <code>MOONS</code> command. Instead, the only reference to it is on [[Adamance]], painted into the walls inside of the shack.

== Description == <!--T:2-->
</translate>
{{Template:Terminal|text=68-Artifice

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>
<translate>

<!--T:3-->
CONDITIONS: Abandoned facilities are littered across the landscape, which was once teeming with life.

<!--T:4-->
HISTORY: Weapons and classified technology has been found at various sites on the surface, dating back at least two hundred years.

<!--T:5-->
FAUNA: It's rumored that active machinery has been left behind.</translate>}}
<translate>
== Environment == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Artifice is a strangely empty and eerie map. Everything around looks decayed and abandoned with a fallen powerline near the front. Around the moon, there are many convenient hiding areas such as a shack on the right side to be used as a hiding spot. This shack contains a secret entrance in the back that leads to outside the fence. This map contains four warehouses, one of which is inaccessible. All of the warehouses have a switch inside to open or close their garage door.

<!--T:8-->
The closest warehouse appears to be a hospital with an office. Both of these rooms make great hiding spots. The opposite warehouse is a large, empty garage with some catwalks and a single room that leads outside. This room can be used as a great way to evade certain enemies. The furthest warehouse is filled with fog for an unknown reason. To enter it, you either must enter through its back door, the adjacent warehouse's catwalk, or the stairs around the side.

<!--T:22-->
The most common indoor layout is the [[Mineshaft]], followed by the [[Mansion]], with the chance of the [[Factory]] remaining fairly high.

== Strategy == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
Spawning the second most amount of scrap of any moons on average, Artifice can be a high-risk, high-reward moon. Unique to this moon are a set of warehouses with interactable levers. These levers can be used against [[Old Bird]]s and [[Forest Giant|Forest Keepers]] that spawn here to remove the threat they pose to any travels to and from the ship.

<!--T:11-->
The ship spawns on a hill relative to the main outdoor area, making it hard to get back and forth without running uphill to reach the ship, which could be dangerous with any nearby entities. To the right of the main entrance (and straight ahead out of the Fire Exit) is a small hut with a damaged wall that can be used to enter/leave the fenced off area if the main way in is too risky, although this route can be far slower.

<!--T:12-->
Occasionally, Old Birds will spawn inside the warehouse; it may be best to close the warehouse if they do, effectively trapping them. Alternatively, keeping one Old Bird roaming allows it to kill Forest Keepers, [[Baboon Hawk|Baboon Hawks]], and [[Eyeless Dog]]s, which may be harder to deal with than one Old Bird. Aside from Old Birds, you can lure in and trap other entities inside the warehouses.

'''Artifice''' is a secret moon. It has a hazard level of "S++", the highest in the game and the only accessible moon with this level. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Artifice is 1500 credits.

It does not appear in the list from the Terminal's <code>MOONS</code> command. Instead, the only reference to it is on [[Adamance]], painted into the walls inside of the shack.

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=68-Artifice

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Abandoned facilities are littered across the landscape, which was once teeming with life.

HISTORY: Weapons and classified technology has been found at various sites on the surface, dating back at least two hundred years.

FAUNA: It's rumored that active machinery has been left behind.}}
== Environment ==

Artifice is a strangely empty and eerie map. Everything around looks decayed and abandoned with a fallen powerline near the front. Around the moon, there are many convenient hiding areas such as a shack on the right side to be used as a hiding spot. This shack contains a secret entrance in the back that leads to outside the fence. This map contains four warehouses, one of which is inaccessible. All of the warehouses have a switch inside to open or close their garage door.

The closest warehouse appears to be a hospital with an office. Both of these rooms make great hiding spots. The opposite warehouse is a large, empty garage with some catwalks and a single room that leads outside. This room can be used as a great way to evade certain enemies. The furthest warehouse is filled with fog for an unknown reason. To enter it, you either must enter through its back door, the adjacent warehouse's catwalk, or the stairs around the side.

The most common indoor layout is the [[Mineshaft]], followed by the [[Mansion]], with the chance of the [[Factory]] remaining fairly high.

== Strategy ==

Spawning the second most amount of scrap of any moons on average, Artifice can be a high-risk, high-reward moon. Unique to this moon are a set of warehouses with interactable levers. These levers can be used against [[Old Bird]]s and [[Forest Giant|Forest Keepers]] that spawn here to remove the threat they pose to any travels to and from the ship.

The ship spawns on a hill relative to the main outdoor area, making it hard to get back and forth without running uphill to reach the ship, which could be dangerous with any nearby entities. To the right of the main entrance (and straight ahead out of the Fire Exit) is a small hut with a damaged wall that can be used to enter/leave the fenced off area if the main way in is too risky, although this route can be far slower.

Occasionally, Old Birds will spawn inside the warehouse; it may be best to close the warehouse if they do, effectively trapping them. Alternatively, keeping one Old Bird roaming allows it to kill Forest Keepers, [[Baboon Hawk|Baboon Hawks]], and [[Eyeless Dog]]s, which may be harder to deal with than one Old Bird. Aside from Old Birds, you can lure in and trap other entities inside the warehouses.

== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=68-Artifice

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: По ранее полному жизни ландшафту раскинуты заброшенные комплексы.

ИСТОРИЯ: На поверхности были обнаружены оружие и засекреченные технологии, датирующиеся как минимум двумя сотнями лет.

ФАУНА: Идут слухи, что на луне были оставлены включенные роботы.}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

Artifice - по-странному пустая и жуткая карта. Всё вокруг выглядит разложившимся и заброшенным с упавшей ЛЭП у входа на территорию. По луне разбросаны удобные укрытия, например хижина в правой части. В задней части хижины есть тайный лаз, ведущий наружу территории. Эта карта содержит 4 складских помещения, одно из которых недоступно. Все склады имеют рычаг внутри для открытия и закрытия больших гаражных дверей.

Ближайший склад по-видимому является госпиталем с офисом. Обе комнаты - хорошие укрытия. Склад напротив - огромный, пустой гараж с мостиками и единственной комнатой, ведущей наружу. Эта комната может быть использована как прекрасный способ избегания определённых противников. Самый дальний склад по неизвестной причине наполнен туманом. Он изначально закрыт, и чтобы в него пробраться, придётся воспользоваться чёрным ходом, лестницей сбоку или мостком, ведущим из соседнего склада.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The most common indoor layout is the [[Mineshaft]], followed by the [[Mansion]], with the chance of the [[Factory]] remaining fairly high.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Будучи второй самой лучшей луной по луту, Artifice может быть местом с высоким риском и высокой наградой. Также имеются уникальные склады, которые можно открывать и закрывать с помощью рычагов. Это может быть использовано против [[Old Bird/ru|Старых Птиц]] и [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранителей Леса]], появляющихся здесь, чтобы избавиться от угрозы, которую они несут при путешествии к и от корабля.
</div>

Корабль приземляется на возвышенности относительно основной территории, что делает путешествия между кораблём и зданием затруднительным, так как придётся взбираться в гору, что может быть опасным при наличии рядом сущностей. Справа от главного входа (и прямо напротив пожарного выхода) находится маленький пост с пробитым лазом в стене, которым можно воспользоваться в качестве альтернативного пути перемещения в и из территории если основной маршрут слишком рискованный, хотя этот путь может быть куда более медленным.

Иногда Старые птицы могут сразу появиться внутри складов; в таком случае будет лучше сразу запереть их. Также можно позволить одной Старой Птице продолжать блуждать, чтобы она разбиралась с [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранителями Леса]] и [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Безглазыми Псами]], справиться с которыми может быть труднее. чем с одной Старой Птицей. Также в склады можно заманить и запереть другие сущности, включая Хранителя Леса.

######## Artifice/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Artifice
| routecost = 1500
| image = Artifice_map.png
}}
{{spoilers}}
'''Artifice''' 是一颗隐藏星球。它是唯一一颗有着本游戏最高的危险等级"S++",且可抵达的星球。将飞船导航到 Artifice 的轨道上需要 1500 信用点。

此星球并不会在终端的 <code>MOONS</code> 指令中列出。相反，唯一提到过它的地方是位于 [[Adamance]] 上的一座棚屋里墙上的涂鸦。

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=68-Artifice

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：废弃的设施散落在曾经生机勃勃的景观中。

历史：在地表的不同地点发现了武器和机密技术，至少可以追溯到200年前。

生态：有传言说，一些仍在运行的机器被遗弃在此。}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== 环境 ==

Artifice 是一张奇怪的空洞而怪异的地图。周围的一切看起来都腐烂了，前面附近有一条倒下的电线。在星球上有许多方便的藏身之处，比如右边的棚屋可以用作藏身之处。这间小屋后面有一个秘密入口，通往围栏外。这张地图包含四个仓库，其中一个无法进入。所有仓库内部都有一个开关，可以打开或关闭大门。

最近的仓库似乎是一家有办公室的医院。这两个房间都是很好的藏身之处。对面的仓库是一个巨大的空车库，里面有一些T台和一个通往外面的单人间。这个房间可以用来躲避某些敌人。由于未知的原因，最远的仓库里充满了雾。要进入它，您必须通过它的后门、相邻仓库的T台或侧面的楼梯进入。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The most common indoor layout is the [[Mineshaft]], followed by the [[Mansion]], with the chance of the [[Factory]] remaining fairly high.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
平均而言， Artifice 是所有星球中生成废料最多的，它可能是高风险、高回报的星球。这个星球的独特之处在于一组具有可交互杠杆的仓库。这可以用来对付在这里生成的[[Old Bird/zh-cn|老鸟]]，以消除它们对往返飞船的任何旅途构成的威胁。
</div>

飞船在相对于主要室外区域的一座山上降落，如果不上坡到达飞船，就很难来回穿梭，这时附近的任何实体都可能是危险的。主要入口右侧（消防出口正前方）是一座墙壁受损的小屋，如果主要路径太危险，这可以用来进出围栏区域，尽管这条路线可能要慢得多。

老鸟偶尔会在仓库内部生成。此时最好的方法是关闭仓库，从而有效地困住它们。另外，可以让一只老鸟在外部巡逻，让它杀死相对来说更难处理的[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]和[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]。玩家可以将其他实体引诱并困在仓库内，例如森林守护者。

<translate>
== Environment == <!--T:2-->

<!--T:3-->
Assurance is a hilly desert moon with large rocks strewn about the environment. Random large machinery and pipes are laid over different sections of the rocks. The [[Interiors|interior]] is usually the Factory but sometimes the Mineshaft, with a small chance of the Mansion.

== Strategy == <!--T:4-->

<!--T:5-->
The optimal path to the main entrance is to head up the mildly sloped hill to the left of the ship or just jump on the big rock on the left during the ship's landing phase, then continue straight. When leaving, employees need to go around this hill instead, as the other side is too steep to climb. The [[Fire_exit|Fire Exit]] can be reached by climbing up the tall ladder inside the scaffolding in the front of the [[Ship]], then jumping off the big rock onto the large pipe. The Fire Exit is located at the end on the right side of the pipe.

BEDINGUNGEN: Ähnlich wie sein Zwillingsmond 41-Experimentation, jedoch mit noch mehr zerklüftet und verwittertem Gelände.

<span id="Environment"></span>
== Umwelt ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance ist ein hügeliger Wüstenmond. Die großen Felsen auf seiner Oberfläche werden scheinbar zufällig von Rohren und großen Maschinen verbunden.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der optimale Weg zum Haupteingang führt den leicht ansteigenden Felsen auf der linken Seite des Schiffs hinauf, alternativ kann auch schon im Landeanflug links auf einen großen Felsen gesprungen und von hier geradeaus weitergegangen werden. Auf dem Rückweg müssen die Mitarbeiter um diesen Hügel herum gehen, weil die andere Seite zu steil ist. Der [[Fire Exit|Notausgang]] kann durch Erklimmen der hohen Leiter im Gerüst vor dem [[Ship|Schiff]] erreicht werden. Vom Gerüst muss der Mitarbeiter zunächst auf einen großen Stein, dann auf ein langes Rohr springen. Am Ende des Rohres auf der rechten Seite ist der Notausgang.
</div>

=== Verlaufskurve der Erscheinungsrate ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

== Environment ==

Assurance is a hilly desert moon with large rocks strewn about the environment. Random large machinery and pipes are laid over different sections of the rocks. The [[Interiors|interior]] is usually the Factory but sometimes the Mineshaft, with a small chance of the Mansion.

== Strategy ==

The optimal path to the main entrance is to head up the mildly sloped hill to the left of the ship or just jump on the big rock on the left during the ship's landing phase, then continue straight. When leaving, employees need to go around this hill instead, as the other side is too steep to climb. The [[Fire_exit|Fire Exit]] can be reached by climbing up the tall ladder inside the scaffolding in the front of the [[Ship]], then jumping off the big rock onto the large pipe. The Fire Exit is located at the end on the right side of the pipe.

######## Assurance/fr
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Assurance
| image = Assurancemap.png
| routecost = 0
}}'''Assurance''' est la [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Moons/fr Lune] la plus compliqué des trois premières. En dépit de son niveau de danger à "D", elle peut être plus dangereuse que [[Vow]] et [[Experimentation]] mais contient aussi le plus d'objets des trois. La petite taille de la carte et la Sortie de Secours facilement accessible en fait le choix parfait pour des parties efficaces et rapides.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The small map size and easily accessible fire exit make it the perfect choice for quick and efficient rounds.
</div>

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=220-Assurance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Similaire à sa lune jumelle, 41-Experimentation, avec un terrain beaucoup plus irrégulier et altéré.

HISTOIRE: 220-Assurance est beaucoup plus jeune que sa contrepartie. Découverte pas longtemps avant 41-Experimentation.

FAUNE: Inconnu}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Environnement ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance est une lune déserte collineuse avec des gros rochers dispersés dans le paysage. Des grosses machines et de tuyaux sont répandus sur différentes parties des rochers.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Le chemin optimal pour l'entrée principale est de monter la pente légère à gauche du vaisseau ou simplement de sauter sur le rocher à gauche lorsque le vaisseau atterrit, puis continuer tout droit. Quand ils partent, les employés doivent contourner cette colline car de l'autre coté, c'est trop pentu pour être escaladé. La sortie de secours peut être atteinte en montant l'échelle dans les échafaudages à l'avant du vaisseau, puis en sautant sur le tuyau depuis le rocher. La sortie de secours se situe au bout à droite du tuyau.
</div>

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Courbe du taux d'apparition ===

Les entités de nuit commencent à apparaitre à environ <code>3:00pm</code> sur Assurance. De meme que sur [[Experimentation]], après <code>10:00pm</code> le taux d'apparition augmente drastiquement avec un pic à <code>12:00am</code>. Le taux d'apparition des entités de jour diminue graduellement avec le temps avec toutes les entités apparaissant au début de la partie. Voir [[Mécaniques]] pour l'interprétation.

== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
Dans le coin nord-est de la carte, au-delà de la barrière grillagée, il existe une copie de la grande échelle permettant de monter sur le Tuyau. Elle est à peine visible depuis le haut du rocher où mène l'originale. Si d'aventure vous atterissiez en dehors de la carte, elle peut être utilisée pour grimper et retourner au sein de celle-ci.

<span id="Environment"></span>
== Territorio ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance è una luna deserta e collinare con grandi rocce sparpagliate nel paesaggio. Un mucchio di grandi macchinari e tubature sono posizionati sopra varie sezioni delle rocce.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategia ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Il percorso ottimale per raggiungere l'entrata principale è sulla collina leggermente inclinata alla sinistra della nave oppure puoi semplicemente saltare sulla grande roccia a sinistra della nave durante l'atterraggio e continuare dritto. Al ritorno, gli impiegati devono aggirare la collina poichè l'altro lato è troppo ripido per scalare. L'[[Special:MyLanguage/Uscita Anticendio|Uscita Antincendio]] può essere raggiunta salendo sulla lunga scala dentro l'impalcatura di fronte alla [[Special:MyLanguage/Nave|Nave]] e poi saltare dall'enorme roccia verso la tubatura. L'Uscita Antincendio si trova alla fine del lato destro del tubo.
</div>

=== Curve di probabilità generazione ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

{{Template:Terminal|text=220-Assurance

WARUNKI: Podobne do bliźniaczego księżyca 41-Experimentation, charakteryzujące się znacznie bardziej poszarpanym i zwietrzałym terenem.

<span id="Environment"></span>
== Środowisko ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance to górzysty, pustynny księżyc z dużymi głazami porozrzucanymi na całym terenie. Losowo duże maszyny i rury są układane w różnych sekcjach skał.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategia ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Optymalną ścieżką do głównego wejścia jest wejście na lekko nachylone wzgórze na lewo od statku lub po prostu wskoczenie na dużą skałę po lewej stronie podczas fazy lądowania statku, a następnie kontynuowanie podróży prosto. Wychodząc, pracownicy muszą zamiast tego ominąć to wzgórze, ponieważ druga strona jest zbyt stroma, aby się na nią wspiąć. Do [[Fire Exit/pl|wyjścia pożarowego]] można dotrzeć, wspinając się po wysokiej drabinie znajdującej się wewnątrz rusztowania z przodu [[Ship/pl|statku]], a następnie zeskakując z dużej skały na dużą rurę. Wyjście pożarowe znajduje się na końcu, po prawej stronie rury.
</div>

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Funkcje szans pojawienia się ===

Byty nocne zaczynają pojawiać się około 15:00 na Assurance z dość dużym naskokiem pojawiania. Podobnie jak w [[Experimentation/pl|Experimentation]], po godzinie 22:00 liczba wrogów drastycznie wzrasta, osiągając szczyt o godzinie 24:00. Liczba istot pojawiających się w ciągu dnia stopniowo maleje wraz z upływem czasu, przy czym większość istot pojawia się na początku gry. Zobacz [[Mechanics/pl|mechaniki]], aby zapoznać się z interpretacją.

In the North-east corner of the map, beyond the fence, there's a copy of the tall ladder. It's barely visible from on top of the rock or scaffolding.
Should you end up over there somehow, it can be used to climb back in bounds.{{cite YouTube|video-id=0oyRr5P-rsE|title=Climbing the Secret Ladder in Lethal Company.|creator=Thwael|start-timestamp=24}}
</div>

######## Assurance/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Assurance
| image = Assurancemap.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Assurance''' é a [[Moons|lua]] mais difícil entre as "mais fáceis". Apesar de seu nível de periculosidade ser marcada como "D", ela pode ser um pouco mais perigosa que [[Vow]] e [[Experimentation]] mas também é a que oferece os melhores itens das três.
</div>

Pelo tamanho do mapa ser pequeno e pela saída de emergência ser facilmente acessível faz com que seja a melhor escolha para ser rápido e eficiente.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Descrição ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=220-Assurance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDIÇÕES: Similar a sua lua gêmea, 41-Experimentation, com um terreno mais erodido e ríspido.

HISTÓRIA: 220-Assurance é muito mais nova do que sua contraparte. Descoberta não tanto tempo antes de 41-Experimentation.

FAUNA: Desconhecida.}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Ambiente ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance é uma lua deserta montanhosa com grandes rochas espalhadas pelo ambiente. Maquinário grande e canos espalhados por várias secções das rochas.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estratégia ==

O melhor caminho para a entrada principal é subir a colina levemente inclinada à esquerda da nave ou simplesmente saltar para a grande rocha à esquerda durante a fase de pouso da nave e, em seguida, seguir em frente. A [[Fire_exit|Saída de Emergência]] pode ser alcançada ao subir a longa escada dentro dos andaimes na frente da [[Ship|Nave]], e então pular da grande pedra até o longo cano. A Saída de Emergência está no fim do lado direito do cano.

<span id="Loot_table"></span>
== Tabela de Loot ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Assurance}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|hives=y|facility=y|sapsuckers=y|nutcrackers=y}}
<span id="Entities"></span>
== Entidades ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Interior ===

[[Snare Flea]]s e [[Hoarding Bug]]s são as entidades mais comuns em Assurance. Apesar de não serem as entidades mais perigosas, elas podem acabar com o dia rapidamente se não devidamente tratadas. É recomendado levar uma pá para matar Snare Fleas inconvenientes quando estiver no multijogador.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Night_time"></span>
=== Horário noturno ===

[[Earth Leviathan|Minhocas]] são o maior problema em Assurance. Junto do [[Eyeless Dog]]s elas podem criar um combo mortal que podem rapidamente dizimar tripulações se as coisas saírem do controle. Não é recomendado visitar essa lua durante [[Weather|eclipse]]s já que as chances de ambos aparecerem é maior
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== Horário diurno ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
[[Circuit Bees|Abelhas]] são um tanto raras por Assurance, apesar de serem mais comuns do que em [[Experimentation]].
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Gráfico de chance de spawn ===

Entidades noturnas começam a aparecer por volta das 3pm em Assurance com uma grande variação nos pontos de spawn. Similar a [[Experimentation]], depois das 10pm o spawn de entidades aumenta drásticamente com seu pico às 12am. O spawn de entidades diurnas gradualmente diminui com o tempo com boa parte das entidades aparecendo no início do dia. Veja [[Mechanics|Mecânicas]] para melhor interpretação.
[[File:Assurance_spawn_curve.png|950px]]

######## Assurance/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Assurance
| image = Assurancemap.png
| routecost = 0
}}'''Assurance''' - сложнейшая из лёгких [[Moons/ru|лун]]. Она может быть чуть опаснее [[Vow/ru|Vow]] и [[Experimentation/ru|Experimentation]], но также предлагает лучший лут из трёх. Обладает уровнем угрозы "C".

Маленький размер карты и легкодоступный пожарный выход делают её идеальным выбором для быстрых и эффективных раундов.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=220-Assurance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: Подобна своей луне-близнецу, 41-Experimentation, но с более изрезанным и выветренным рельефом.

ИСТОРИЯ: 220-Assurance намного моложе своего партнёра. Обнаружена незадолго до 41-Experimentation.

ФАУНА: Неизвестно}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance - холмистая пустынная луна с огромными валунами разбросанными по округе. Случайные крупногабаритное оборудование и трубы проложены по разным секциям камней.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Оптимальный путь к главному входу лежит через умеренно наклонный холм слева от корабля, либо можно прыгнуть на большой камень слева во время посадки корабля, затем продолжить двигаться вперёд. По возвращении сотрудникам нужно будет вместо этого обойти холм, так как противоположный склон слишком крутой чтобы на него взобраться. До [[Interiors/ru#Пожарные выходы|пожарного выхода]] можно дойти взобравшись по высокой лестнице в строительных лесах перед [[Ship/ru|кораблём]], затем спрыгнув с большого камня на огромную трубу. Пожарный выход расположен справа у конца трубы.

== Таблица лута ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Assurance}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|hives=y|facility=y|sapsuckers=y|nutcrackers=y}}
<span id="Entities"></span>
== Сущности ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Внутри комплекса ===

[[Snare Flea/ru|Потолочные блохи]] и [[Hoarding Bug/ru|Жуки-собиратели]] - самые частые сущности на Assurance. Хоть и не самые опасные, они могут легко испортить забег если неправильно с ними обращаться. Рекомендуется брать лопату чтобы убивать надоедливых потолочных блох при игре в мультиплеере.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Night_time"></span>
=== Ночные ===

[[Earth Leviathan/ru|Черви]] являются наибольшей опасностью на Assurance. Вместе с [[Eyeless Dog/ru|безглазыми псами]] они создают смертельное комбо, которое может быстро стереть целые экипажи если выйдет из под контроля. Не рекомендуется посещать эту луну во время [[Weather/ru|затмения]] так как шансы появления обоих увеличены.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== Дневные ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Хотя и более частые чем на [[Experimentation/ru|Experimentation]], [[Circuit Bees/ru|пчёлы]] тут также редки.
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Кривые шансов спавна ===

Ночные сущности на Assurance начинают появляться около 3 дня с довольно огромной погрешностью спавна. Подобно [[Experimentation/ru|Experimentation]], после 10 вечера спавн противников существенно увеличивается с пиком в полночь. Спавн дневных сущностей постепенно уменьшается со спавном большинства сущностей в начале игры. Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.
[[File:Assurance_spawn_curve.png|950px]]
<span id="Data_chips"></span>

######## Assurance/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Assurance
| image = Assurancemap.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Assurance''' 是简单难度的[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]中最难的那一个。虽然其危险评级为“D”，但它可以比 [[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]] 和 [[Experimentation/zh-cn|Experimentation]] 还要危险，不过它也是这三个星球中物资最丰富的一个。
</div>

此星球有着较小的地图和方便的消防出口位置，因此是进行快速且高效的一轮游戏的首选星球。

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=220-Assurance

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

条件：与其孪生星球 41-Experimentation 类似，这一星球的地形更为崎岖不平，且受风化作用明显。

历史：220-Assurance 的形成时间比其它类似星球晚得多，发现时间比 41-Experimentation 稍早。

生态：未知}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== 环境 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Assurance 是一个多山的沙漠星球，其上散落着大石块。大型机械和管道随意地铺设在岩石的不同区域上。
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

到达主要入口的最优路径是爬上飞船左侧的缓坡，或在飞船的着陆阶段跳到左侧的大石头上，随后直走。回船时，员工需要绕过来时的这座山丘，因为入口这一侧的岩壁太过陡峭，无法攀爬。要前往[[Interiors/zh-cn#消防出口|消防出口]]，可先爬上[[Ship/zh-cn|飞船]]前脚手架里的梯子，然后从大石头跳到管子上，消防出口就在管子右侧的尽头。

<span id="Loot_table"></span>
== 物品表 ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Assurance}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|hives=y|facility=y|sapsuckers=y|nutcrackers=y}}
<span id="Entities"></span>
== 实体 ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== 室内 ===

[[Snare Flea/zh-cn|抱脸虫]]和[[Hoarding Bug/zh-cn|囤积虫]]是 Assurance 上最常见的实体。虽然它们不是最危险的，但若处理不当，它们也能快速搞砸一局游戏。多人联机时，建议带一把铲子处理那些烦人的抱脸虫。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Night_time"></span>
=== 夜间 ===

[[Earth Leviathan/zh-cn|大地利维坦]]是 Assurance 上最麻烦的实体。它可以和[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]组成一套丝滑连招，在局势失控的短时间内消灭整个队伍。不建议在[[Weather/zh-cn|日食]]时降落该星球，因为这些实体的生成概率在日食时都有增加。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== 日间 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
虽然相较于 [[Experimentation/zh-cn|Experimentation]] ，[[Circuit Bees/zh-cn|电路蜜蜂]]在这里更常见一些，但整体仍然相当罕见。
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== 生成概率曲线 ===

夜间实体大约在下午 3 点开始生成，但生成概率偏差很大。跟 [[Experimentation/zh-cn|Experimentation]] 类似，敌对实体的生成概率于晚上 10 点大幅增长，于午夜 12 点达到顶峰。日间实体的生成概率则随时间推进逐渐降低，其中大部分在游戏开始时就已生成。可在[[Mechanics|机制]]页详细了解概率曲线。
[[File:Assurance_spawn_curve.png|950px]]
<span id="Data_chips"></span>

=== Trivia ===

While the [[Forest Keeper]] has code to detect employee voices, it doesn't actually work. It is unknown if this code was meant to work or is just leftover.

######## Baboon Hawk
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}
{{Infobox entity|id=BaboonHawk

| sciname = Papio-volturius
| danger = 75%
| pip = Medium
| power_level = 0.5
| diversity_level = 1
| max_count = 15
| see_through_fog = No
| spawn_delay = 15s
| pip_size = Medium
| attack_damage = 20
| attack_speed = 500ms

| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|BaboonHawk}}
| stun_multiplier = 0.4
| cause_of_death = Unknown

<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The '''Baboon Hawk''' is a hostile outdoor [[Entities|entity]]. It exhibits fiercely territorial behavior and becomes more aggressive if it has the company of others, or when employees are intruding on it or its territory. It also hoards [[scrap]] from its environment and attempts to bite or skewer employees upon feeling threatened. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Adamance]].

<!--T:50-->

== Mechanics == <!--T:28-->

<!--T:29-->
Baboon Hawks have a fear level that determines whether they attack employees within their line of sight. This level is influenced by a number of factors.

<!--T:30-->
Baboon Hawks are '''more''' fearful when:
</translate>
* <translate><!--T:31--> they see dead Baboon Hawks</translate>
* <translate><!--T:32--> there are multiple employees near each other</translate>
* <translate><!--T:33--> the employee is holding a weapon<tvar name="note"><ref group="note" name="weapons" /></tvar></translate>
* <translate><!--T:34--> the employee is looking at the Baboon Hawk</translate>
* <translate><!--T:35--> it is before 10:24 AM</translate>
* <translate><!--T:36--> the employee is in the ship</translate>
* <translate><!--T:37--> the employee's HP is greater or equal to 30</translate>
* <translate><!--T:38--> there are less than 4 Baboon Hawks in their group</translate>
* <translate><!--T:39--> the employee uses certain noise-making items<tvar name="note"><ref group="note" name="noisemakers" /></tvar></translate>
<translate>
<!--T:40-->
Baboon Hawks are '''less''' fearful when:
</translate>
* <translate><!--T:41--> the employee's HP is less than 30</translate>
* <translate><!--T:42--> there are more than 4 Baboon Hawks in their group</translate>
* <translate><!--T:43--> the employee is not looking at the Baboon Hawk</translate>
* <translate><!--T:44--> it is after 9:36 PM</translate>

* <translate><!--T:46--> the Baboon Hawk is close to its nest</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:5-->
Before attacking, Baboon Hawks will yell and flail at players as a warning, while staying a certain distance away. If ignored and the factors in the previous paragraph are met, they will attack.
</translate>
[[File:Baboon Hawk Territory.png|thumb|250px|<translate><!--T:27--> The Baboon Hawk's "predetermined territory".</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Baboon Hawks have a predetermined territory, marked by 3 spikes in a triangular formation. When one either kills a player or steals an item, they will return to it and drop whatever they have.

<!--T:47-->
Each Baboon Hawk has a randomized leadership value that determines which Baboon Hawk leads the group. The higher this value is, the larger the Baboon Hawk is, meaning that the largest Baboon Hawk always leads the group.

<!--T:16-->
When undisturbed, they tend to partake in minor activities such as exploring or sitting. During night while at their base, Baboon Hawks will go inactive and sleep.

<!--T:8-->
== Strategy ==
Try to make trips to/from [[Ship|The Ship]] in groups, whenever possible. Baboon Hawks will usually stay a decent way away from you before attacking, so boarding the ship and closing the doors will get them to back off or buy you some time at least.

<!--T:9-->
Making [[Audible_sounds|noise]] will attract Baboon Hawks in your direction if they are not more interested in something else.

<!--T:17-->
When fighting Baboon Hawks, it is never recommended to engage more than one, and even then only fight if you have to. Strafing them with a shovel by running in, getting a hit, and retreating is the most effective attack strategy due to their low mobility. Do not let them come near you though, as they quickly tear through employees hp.

<!--T:48-->
Baboon Hawks back off when stared at by employees, maintaining a gap between themselves and the employee. However, they will eventually go into an attacking state if watched for too long
</translate>

######## Baboon Hawk/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}
{{Infobox entity|id=BaboonHawk
| name = Baboon Hawk
| sciname = Papio-volturius
| danger = 75%
| pip = Medium
| power_level = 0.5
| diversity_level = 1
| max_count = 15
| see_through_fog = No
| spawn_delay = 15s
| pip_size = Medium
| attack_damage = 20
| attack_speed = 500ms 
| dps = 40
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|BaboonHawk}}
| stun_multiplier = 0.4
| cause_of_death = Unknown
}}
The '''Baboon Hawk''' is a hostile outdoor [[Entities|entity]]. It exhibits fiercely territorial behavior and becomes more aggressive if it has the company of others, or when employees are intruding on it or its territory. It also hoards [[scrap]] from its environment and attempts to bite or skewer employees upon feeling threatened. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Adamance]].

Baboon Hawks are rotund, bipedal entities with pale green fur, short legs, bat-like wings with a thin membrane, and a mane of reddish-brown hair on their backs. They have skeletal, bird-like heads, with bulging red eyes, a beak with a pink tongue and a row of tiny, black fanged teeth, and a pair of sharp horns growing from their cheeks.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary|BaboonHawk}}
== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
Baboon Hawks predominantly spawn on [[Adamance]].

=== Spawn probability ===
Baboon Hawks always have the same spawn chance multiplier throughout the day but their spawning is affected by spawn count falloff. Meaning, they have a modified chance of spawning depending on how many Baboon Hawks are already on the map.

Learn more about spawn probability on [[Mechanics]].

[[File:Baboon_hawk_probability.png]]
== Mechanics ==

Baboon Hawks have a fear level that determines whether they attack employees within their line of sight. This level is influenced by a number of factors.

Baboon Hawks are '''more''' fearful when:
* they see dead Baboon Hawks
* there are multiple employees near each other
* the employee is holding a weapon<ref group="note" name="weapons" />
* the employee is looking at the Baboon Hawk
* it is before 10:24 AM
* the employee is in the ship
* the employee's HP is greater or equal to 30
* there are less than 4 Baboon Hawks in their group
* the employee uses certain noise-making items<ref group="note" name="noisemakers" />
Baboon Hawks are '''less''' fearful when:
* the employee's HP is less than 30
* there are more than 4 Baboon Hawks in their group
* the employee is not looking at the Baboon Hawk
* it is after 9:36 PM
* the employee is far away from the ship
* the Baboon Hawk is close to its nest
Before attacking, Baboon Hawks will yell and flail at players as a warning, while staying a certain distance away. If ignored and the factors in the previous paragraph are met, they will attack.
[[File:Baboon Hawk Territory.png|thumb|250px|The Baboon Hawk's "predetermined territory".]]
Baboon Hawks have a predetermined territory, marked by 3 spikes in a triangular formation. When one either kills a player or steals an item, they will return to it and drop whatever they have.

Each Baboon Hawk has a randomized leadership value that determines which Baboon Hawk leads the group. The higher this value is, the larger the Baboon Hawk is, meaning that the largest Baboon Hawk always leads the group.

When undisturbed, they tend to partake in minor activities such as exploring or sitting. During night while at their base, Baboon Hawks will go inactive and sleep.

== Strategy ==
Try to make trips to/from [[Ship|The Ship]] in groups, whenever possible. Baboon Hawks will usually stay a decent way away from you before attacking, so boarding the ship and closing the doors will get them to back off or buy you some time at least.

Making [[Audible_sounds|noise]] will attract Baboon Hawks in your direction if they are not more interested in something else.

When fighting Baboon Hawks, it is never recommended to engage more than one, and even then only fight if you have to. Strafing them with a shovel by running in, getting a hit, and retreating is the most effective attack strategy due to their low mobility. Do not let them come near you though, as they quickly tear through employees hp.

Baboon Hawks back off when stared at by employees, maintaining a gap between themselves and the employee. However, they will eventually go into an attacking state if watched for too long

Les Babouins-faucons ont un territoire prédéterminé, marqué par 3 pointes en formation triangulaire. Lorsqu'on tue un joueur ou qu'on vole un objet, il y retourne et laisse tomber tout ce qu'il a.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Each Baboon Hawk has a randomized leadership value that determines which Baboon Hawk leads the group. The higher this value is, the larger the Baboon Hawk is, meaning that the largest Baboon Hawk always leads the group.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Pendant la nuit, lorsqu'ils sont à leur base, les Babouins-faucons resteront inactifs et dormiront.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Stratégie ==
Essayez d'effectuer des voyages vers/depuis le [[Vaisseau|Le Vaisseau]] en groupe, autant que possible. Les Babouins-faucons resteront généralement à une distance décente de vous avant d'attaquer, donc monter à bord du navire et fermer les portes les fera reculer ou vous fera au moins gagner du temps.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Faire du [[Sons audibles|bruits]] attirera les faucons babouins dans votre direction s'ils ne sont pas plus intéressés par autre chose.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Lorsque vous combattez un Babouin-faucon, il n’est jamais recommandé d’en engager plus d’un, et même dans ce cas, ne combattez que si cela est nécessaire. Les taper avec une pelle en courant, les touchez un coup et en battre en retraite est la stratégie d'attaque la plus efficace en raison de leur faible mobilité. Ne les laissez pas s'approcher de vous, car ils déchirent rapidement les HP des employés.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Baboon Hawks back off when stared at by employees, maintaining a gap between themselves and the employee. However, they will eventually go into an attacking state if watched for too long
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Przegląd ==
Jastrzębie Pawiany to półagresywne byty w Lethal Company. Na początku mogą wydawać się bardzo nastraszające, ale w rzeczywistości są dość nieśmiałe, gdy spotyka się je samotnie. Mają tendencję do atakowania tylko wtedy, gdy przewyższają liczebnie pracowników, dlatego zaleca się ostrożność podczas eksploracji w pojedynkę, ponieważ samotni pracownicy są łatwym łupem dla grupy Jastrzębich Pawianów.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Baboon Hawks are rotund, bipedal entities with pale green fur, short legs, bat-like wings with a thin membrane, and a mane of reddish-brown hair on their backs. They have skeletal, bird-like heads, with bulging red eyes, a beak with a pink tongue and a row of tiny, black fanged teeth, and a pair of sharp horns growing from their cheeks.
</div>

== Spawn chances ==

Jastrzębie Pawiany pojawiają się głównie na [[March/pl|March]]. Wydaje się, że lubią gęste lasy i ciągły deszcz. Zaleca się szczególną ostrożność, ponieważ lokalizacje błotne mogą prowadzić do nieprzyjemnej i gwarantowanej śmierci w przypadku ucieczki przed grupą jastrzębich pawianów.
