=== Szansa Pojawienia ===
Jastrzębie Pawiany zawsze mają ten sam mnożnik szans na pojawienie się w ciągu dnia, ale na ich pojawianie się wpływa ilość liczby osobników. Oznacza to, że mają zmodyfikowaną szansę na pojawienie się w zależności od tego, ile Jastrzębich Pawianów jest już na mapie.
</div>

[[File:Baboon_hawk_probability.png]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Mechanics ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Baboon Hawks have a fear level that determines whether they attack employees within their line of sight. This level is influenced by a number of factors.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Baboon Hawks are '''more''' fearful when:
</div>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">they see dead Baboon Hawks</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">there are multiple employees near each other</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee is holding a weapon<ref group="note" name="weapons" /></span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee is looking at the Baboon Hawk</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">it is before 10:24 AM</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee is in the ship</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee's HP is greater or equal to 30</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">there are less than 4 Baboon Hawks in their group</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee uses certain noise-making items<ref group="note" name="noisemakers" /></span>
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Baboon Hawks are '''less''' fearful when:
</div>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee's HP is less than 30</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">there are more than 4 Baboon Hawks in their group</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee is not looking at the Baboon Hawk</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">it is after 9:36 PM</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the employee is far away from the ship</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">the Baboon Hawk is close to its nest</span>
Przed atakiem Jastrzębie Pawiany będą krzyczeć i machać w kierunku graczy w ramach ostrzeżenia, zachowując jednocześnie pewną odległość. Jeśli zostaną zignorowane i spełnione zostaną warunki opisane w poprzednim akapicie, zaatakują.
[[File:Baboon Hawk Territory.png|thumb|250px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Baboon Hawk's "predetermined territory".</span>]]
Jastrzębie Pawiany mają z góry określone terytorium, oznaczone trzema widłami w trójkątnej formacji. Kiedy któryś z nich zabije gracza lub podniesie przedmiot, przyniosą go na swoje terytorium i położą w losowym miejscu.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Each Baboon Hawk has a randomized leadership value that determines which Baboon Hawk leads the group. The higher this value is, the larger the Baboon Hawk is, meaning that the largest Baboon Hawk always leads the group.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
W nocy, przebywając w swojej bazie, Jastrzębie Pawiany przestaną być aktywne i pójdą spać.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategia ==
Jeśli to możliwe, staraj się chodzić do/z [[Ship/pl|statku]] w grupach. Jastrzębie Pawiany zazwyczaj będą trzymać się od ciebie w przyzwoitej odległości, zanim zaatakują, więc wejście na pokład statku i zamknięcie drzwi sprawi, że się wycofają lub przynajmniej kupicie sobie trochę czasu.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Wydawanie [[Audible Sounds/pl|hałasu]] przyciągnie jastrzębie pawiany w twoją stronę, jeśli nie są one bardziej zainteresowane czymś innym.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Podczas walki z Jastrzębim Pawianem nigdy nie zaleca się atakowania więcej niż jednego, a nawet wtedy walcz tylko wtedy, gdy musisz. Nawalanie ich łopatą poprzez wbiegnięcie, otrzymanie trafienia i wycofanie się jest najskuteczniejszą strategią ataku ze względu na ich niską mobilność. Nie pozwól im się jednak zbliżyć, gdyż szybko pozbawiają pracowników HP.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

######## Baboon Hawk/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}

'''Бабуиновый Ястреб''' - агрессивная [[Entities/ru|сущность]] снаружи здания. Выказывает агрессивно территориальное поведение и становится более агрессивным в группе или если сотрудники ступили на его территорию. Также ворует [[scrap|лом]] в округе и пытает укусить или проткнуть сотрудников, если чувствует угрозу. [[Moons/ru|Луна]], на которой они встречаются чаще всего - [[Adamance/ru|Adamance]].

Бабуиновые Ястребы - округлые, двуногие сущности с бледно-зелёным мехом, короткими ногами, крыльями наподобие летучих мышей с тонкой мембраной и красновато-коричневой гривой на спине. имеют скелетные, птице-подобные черепа с выпирающими красными глазами, клювом с розовым языком и рядом мелких, чёрных заострённых зубов, а также парой острых рогов на щёках.

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{quote bestiary|BaboonHawk}}
<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== Шансы появления ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
Больше всего Бабуиновые Ястребы появляются на [[Adamace/ru|Adamance]].

=== Шанс появления ===
Бабуиновые Ястребы всегда имеют одинаковый множитель шанса появления в течении дня, но на их появление всё ещё влияет падение счётчика появлений. Значит, их шанс появления изменяется от количества уже имеющихся на карте Бабуиновых Ястребов.

Больше о механике шанса появления можно узнать в [[Mechanics/ru|Механиках]]

[[File:Baboon_hawk_probability.png]]
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

У Бабуиновых Ястребов есть уровень страха, определяющий, будут ли они атаковать сотрудников в их поле зрения. На этот уровень влияет множество факторов.

Бабуиновые Ястребы '''более''' испуганны, когда:
* они видят мёртвого Бабуинового Ястреба
* несколько сотрудников держатся в группе
* сотрудник держит оружие<ref group="note" name="weapons" />
* сотрудник смотрит на Бабуинового Ястреба
* ещё не наступило 10:42 утра
* сотрудник находится в корабле
* Здоровье сотрудника 30 или больше
* в группе меньше 4-х Бабуиновых Ястребов
* сотрудник использует шумный предмет<ref group="note" name="noisemakers" />
Бабуиновые Ястребы '''менее''' испуганны, когда:
* здоровье сотрудника меньше 30
* в группе собралось более 4-х Бабуиновых Ястребов
* сотрудник не смотрит на Бабуинового Ястреба
* время перевалило за 9:36 вечера
* сотрудник далеко от корабля
* Бабуиновый ястреб близок к своему гнезду
Перед атакой Бабуиновые Ястребы вскрикнут и ткнут клювом в сторону игроков в качестве предупреждения, при этом держась на определённой дистанции. Если это предупреждение проигнорировать и стали выполняться факторы, описанные выше, они перейдут в атаку.
[[File:Baboon Hawk Territory.png|thumb|250px|"Предопределённая территория"]]
Бабуиновые Ястребы обладают предопределённой территорией, отмеченной 3-мя деревянными колами в треугольной форме. Убитых игроков они притаскивают на эту территорию и скидывают.

У каждого Бабуинового Ястреба есть рандомизированное значение лидерства, определяющее то, какой Бабуиновый Ястреб будет возглавлять группу. Чем больше значение, тем крупнее Бабуиновый Ястреб, означая, что крупнейший Бабуиновый Ястреб всегда возглавляет группу.

Если их не тревожить, они обычно занимаются мелкими делами вроде исследования и отдыха сидя. Ночью, находясь на своей территории, Бабуиновые Ястребы станут неактивны и уснут.

== Стратегия ==
Кода возможно, старайтесь путешествовать от/к [[Ship/ru|Кораблю]] в группах. Бабуиновые Ястребы обычно будут держаться на приличной дистанции от вас перед нападением, так что быстрая посадка в корабль и закрытие дверей заставит их отступить или хотя бы выиграет вам немного времени.

Издавание [[Audible_sounds|шума]] привлечёт Бабуиновых Ястребов если они более ничем не заинтересованы.

Не рекомендуется вступать в битву с более, чем одним Бабуиновым Ястребом, и даже это следует делать только если совсем необходимо. Из-за их низкой мобильности лучшей тактикой является заход на "обстрел" - нападение на них с лопатой и немедленной отступление. Не стоит подпускать их к себе, так как они быстро прогрызаются через ХП сотрудника.

Бабуиновые Ястребы отступают, если на них смотрят сотрудники, выдерживая пробел между ними и сотрудником. Тем не менее, если смотреть на них слишком долго, они в конце-концов перейдут в атаку.

== 概览 ==
狒狒鹰是具有中等攻击性的实体。其在初次遇见时可能会显得比较吓人，但实际上它单独行动时相当胆小。狒狒鹰往往在成群数量超过玩家数量时才会发起攻击，所以建议单独行动的员工保持警惕，因为他易成为成群狒狒鹰的攻击目标。

They have skeletal, bird-like heads, with bulging red eyes, a beak with a pink tongue and a row of tiny, black fanged teeth, and a pair of sharp horns growing from their cheeks.
</div>

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== 生物图鉴条目 ==
{{quote bestiary|BaboonHawk}}
<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== 生成概率 ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
狒狒鹰主要在 [[Adamance/zh-cn|Adamance]] 上生成。

=== 生成概率 ===
狒狒鹰的生成概率乘数不会改变，但它们的生成会受已生成数量影响。这意味着狒狒鹰的生成概率会随地图中已有的狒狒鹰数量发生改变。

在[[Mechanics|机制]]页中详细了解生成概率。

[[File:Baboon_hawk_probability.png]]
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== 机制 ==

狒狒鹰是否攻击其视线内的员工由它们的恐惧等级决定。这一等级受多个因素影响：

满足以下条件时，狒狒鹰的恐惧等级将'''增加'''（攻击欲望更小）：
* 它们看见了死亡的狒狒鹰
* 员工们互相靠近在一起
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">员工正持有武器</span>
* 员工正看着狒狒鹰
* 时间在上午 10:24 之前
* 员工在飞船内
* 员工生命值大于等于 30
* 群体内的狒狒鹰数量小于 4
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">员工身上有发出噪音的物品</span>
满足以下条件时，狒狒鹰的恐惧等级将'''减少'''（攻击欲望更高）：
* 员工生命值小于 30
* 群体内的狒狒鹰数量大于 4
* 员工没有看着狒狒鹰
* 时间在夜晚 9:36 之后
* 员工离飞船很远
* 狒狒鹰距离其巢穴很近
在发动攻击前，狒狒鹰会对玩家喊叫并挥舞翅膀以示警告，同时保持一定距离。如果玩家忽视这一警告，并且满足上述攻击条件时，狒狒鹰就会发动攻击。
[[File:Baboon Hawk Territory.png|thumb|250px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Baboon Hawk's "predetermined territory".</span>]]
狒狒鹰有一个预先确定的领地，以呈三角形形状摆放的3个尖刺为标志。每当狒狒鹰杀死一个玩家或偷走一件物品时，它们会回到那里，放下它们所有的东西。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Each Baboon Hawk has a randomized leadership value that determines which Baboon Hawk leads the group. The higher this value is, the larger the Baboon Hawk is, meaning that the largest Baboon Hawk always leads the group.
</div>

在未被打扰时，狒狒鹰趋向于一同进行一些小活动，例如探索或坐下。当游戏内时间进入夜晚时，位于领地内的狒狒鹰会变得不活跃，然后睡觉。

== 策略 ==
尽可能地与其他员工组队往返[[Ship/zh-cn|飞船]]。通常情况下，狒狒鹰在发起攻击前会与员工保持一定距离，所以登上飞船并关门可以将它们驱离，至少也能争取一点时间。

当狒狒鹰对其它事物不再感兴趣时，它会被你所发出的[[Audible Sounds|噪音]]吸引过来。

除非必要，否则不应和狒狒鹰战斗，且非常不建议同时和多名狒狒鹰作战。如果一定要战斗，可以手持铲子冲向狒狒鹰，打一下，随后快速撤退。尽管这会受一次狒狒鹰的攻击，但由于其机动性不强，已经是最为有效的攻击方法了。要注意不能让狒狒鹰靠近你，因为它的攻击速度很快，能在短时间内让你严重受伤。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Baboon Hawks back off when stared at by employees, maintaining a gap between themselves and the employee. However, they will eventually go into an attacking state if watched for too long
</div>

<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The '''Backwater Gunkfish''', known internally as the "Stingray", is a docile, nonlethal indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It lies motionless on the ground, but flees while releasing a trail of goo when attacked or disturbed. The goo makes the ground slippery, while also temporarily covering an employee's visor upon aggravating it, distorting their vision. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[March]].

<!--T:14-->
Backwater Gunkfish resemble terrestrial [[w:Stingray|stingrays]], having a flat green disk-shaped body with lighter green spots on their fins. They have two pairs of small, black beady eyes and five bright purple tentacles near their mouth. The area around their eyes and upper back, as well as their stinger and tail, have a deeper purple color. 
</translate>

{{quote bestiary|Stingray}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|Stingray}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:2-->
The Gunkfish has 2 main states.

=== Evading === <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
When threatened by an employee (either by them being within 1.5 units of the Gunkfish, within 5 units and in its 110° line of sight for 10 consecutive seconds, or by attacking it), the Gunkfish enters an aggressive evasion mode during which it attempts to flee, squealing and leaving behind a trail of goo while moving at a speed of up to 11 units per second.
After 10 seconds of continuous evasion, the Gunkfish calms down, resulting in it ceasing to produce goo, switching to a flopping animation, slowing down to a speed of 6 units per second, and ceasing vocalisations. During this calm phase, it will path to a suitable hiding spot.

<!--T:5-->
After entering this state, the Gunkfish will attempt to "spit" at any nearby employees. The check window, starting at ~0.1 seconds after the evading state is triggered, lasts for 0.15 seconds. During this time, any employees that pass these checks are sprayed:
* Positioned in an area spanning from the Gunkfish's head to 5 units in front '''AND'''
** Less than 2.5 units from the body's position '''OR'''
** Gunkfish's head has line of sight with the employee's head.
The spray severely impedes the employee's vision, covering their visor in a thick green-yellow goo, persisting for 10 seconds.

=== Hiding === <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
After it has reached its desired hiding spot and 10 seconds   have elapsed without the Gunkfish detecting any threats, it enters its hiding state where it "cloaks". After 45 seconds, if no employees are detected within 30 units of it, it will transition back to the evasion state. Otherwise, it stays in the hiding state, repeating this check every 15 seconds.

=== Goo === <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
The goo produced lasts indefinitely, drastically reducing employee friction, functioning similar to ice, causing uncontrollable sliding.

=== Hiding Spots === <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
The Gunkfish chooses hiding spots based on employees in its proximity.
* It initially targets locations far away from the main entrance.
* When an employee is detected within 4 units, it selects a hiding spot in a node close to the employee's last known position.
* If the Gunkfish has recently sprayed an employee, it selects a hiding spot far from them (approximately 40 units away)
* If no employees are visible, it hides near scrap items within a 28-unit radius, positioning itself 2-6 units away from the item.
The hiding spots are calculated in the evasion state, after spitting.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} == 
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
If you encounter a Backwater Gunkfish while on a moon, it is best not to disturb it. While they are weak, they are not aggressive and cannot harm employees directly. The Gunkfish can easily be jumped over should one block your path, which may be seen as a better tactic as opposed to forcing it to move.
</translate>

The '''Backwater Gunkfish''', known internally as the "Stingray", is a docile, nonlethal indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It lies motionless on the ground, but flees while releasing a trail of goo when attacked or disturbed. The goo makes the ground slippery, while also temporarily covering an employee's visor upon aggravating it, distorting their vision. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[March]].

Backwater Gunkfish resemble terrestrial [[w:Stingray|stingrays]], having a flat green disk-shaped body with lighter green spots on their fins. They have two pairs of small, black beady eyes and five bright purple tentacles near their mouth. The area around their eyes and upper back, as well as their stinger and tail, have a deeper purple color. 

== {{section heading/Bestiary entry}} ==
{{quote bestiary|Stingray}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|Stingray}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
The Gunkfish has 2 main states.

=== Evading ===

When threatened by an employee (either by them being within 1.5 units of the Gunkfish, within 5 units and in its 110° line of sight for 10 consecutive seconds, or by attacking it), the Gunkfish enters an aggressive evasion mode during which it attempts to flee, squealing and leaving behind a trail of goo while moving at a speed of up to 11 units per second.
After 10 seconds of continuous evasion, the Gunkfish calms down, resulting in it ceasing to produce goo, switching to a flopping animation, slowing down to a speed of 6 units per second, and ceasing vocalisations. During this calm phase, it will path to a suitable hiding spot.

After entering this state, the Gunkfish will attempt to "spit" at any nearby employees. The check window, starting at ~0.1 seconds after the evading state is triggered, lasts for 0.15 seconds. During this time, any employees that pass these checks are sprayed:
* Positioned in an area spanning from the Gunkfish's head to 5 units in front '''AND'''
** Less than 2.5 units from the body's position '''OR'''
** Gunkfish's head has line of sight with the employee's head.
The spray severely impedes the employee's vision, covering their visor in a thick green-yellow goo, persisting for 10 seconds.

=== Hiding ===

After it has reached its desired hiding spot and 10 seconds   have elapsed without the Gunkfish detecting any threats, it enters its hiding state where it "cloaks". After 45 seconds, if no employees are detected within 30 units of it, it will transition back to the evasion state. Otherwise, it stays in the hiding state, repeating this check every 15 seconds.

=== Goo ===

The goo produced lasts indefinitely, drastically reducing employee friction, functioning similar to ice, causing uncontrollable sliding.

=== Hiding Spots ===

The Gunkfish chooses hiding spots based on employees in its proximity.
* It initially targets locations far away from the main entrance.
* When an employee is detected within 4 units, it selects a hiding spot in a node close to the employee's last known position.
* If the Gunkfish has recently sprayed an employee, it selects a hiding spot far from them (approximately 40 units away)
* If no employees are visible, it hides near scrap items within a 28-unit radius, positioning itself 2-6 units away from the item.
The hiding spots are calculated in the evasion state, after spitting.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} == 
If you encounter a Backwater Gunkfish while on a moon, it is best not to disturb it. While they are weak, they are not aggressive and cannot harm employees directly. The Gunkfish can easily be jumped over should one block your path, which may be seen as a better tactic as opposed to forcing it to move.

回水黏鱼，内部代号为“黄貂鱼”，是一种性情温顺、无致命威胁的室内[[entity|实体]]。它平日里静静趴在地上一动不动，一旦遭到攻击或受到惊扰便会慌忙逃窜，沿途留下一道道黏液痕迹。
这些黏液会让地面变得湿滑难行，若激怒该生物，黏液还会暂时糊住队员的防护面罩，造成视野扭曲模糊。该生物最常出没的[[moon|卫星]]为[[March]]。

回水黏鱼外形酷似现实中的黄貂鱼，躯体呈扁平的圆盘状通体青绿，鱼鳍上分布着浅绿斑点。长有两对小巧乌黑的圆眼，嘴部附近生有五条亮紫色触须。眼周、后背上部、尾刺与尾部区域则呈深紫色。 

== {{section heading/Bestiary entry}} ==
{{quote bestiary|Stingray}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|Stingray}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
回水黏鱼主要存在两种状态。

<span id="Evading"></span>
=== 逃窜状态 ===

当玩家对其造成威胁（距离黏鱼1.5单位内、5单位范围内且处于其110°视野内持续10秒，或是直接发起攻击）时，回水黏鱼会进入应激逃窜状态，发出尖鸣并全速逃离，移动速度最高可达11单位/秒，沿途不断滴落黏液。
持续逃窜10秒后它会逐渐平复，不再分泌黏液，动作改为扑腾蠕动，移速降至6单位/秒且停止鸣叫，随后自主前往合适位置躲藏。

进入该状态后，回水黏鱼会尝试向附近玩家进行喷射。判定时段于逃窜状态触发约0.1秒后开启，持续0.15秒，此时间段内满足判定条件的玩家都会被粘液喷中：
* 处于黏鱼头部向前延伸5单位的区域内 **且**
** 与黏鱼本体距离小于2.5单位 **或**
** 黏鱼头部与玩家头部之间存在直接视线

喷射出的浓稠黄绿粘液会糊满玩家面罩，严重阻碍视野，该视觉遮挡效果持续10秒。

<span id="Hiding"></span>
=== 躲藏状态===

抵达选定躲藏点，且连续10秒未侦测到威胁后，回水黏鱼进入躲藏状态并完成隐匿伪装。
若45秒内30单位范围内没有出现玩家，它将重新切换为逃窜状态；反之则持续保持躲藏状态，每15秒进行一次侦测判定。

<span id="Goo"></span>
=== 粘液效果 ===

回水黏鱼留下的粘液永久存在，会大幅降低玩家移动摩擦力，效果如同冰面，使人不受控制地打滑滑行。

<span id="Hiding_Spots"></span>
=== 躲藏点位 ===

回水黏鱼会根据周边玩家情况选择躲藏位置。
* 优先选择远离主入口的点位。
* 侦测到4单位范围内有玩家时，会挑选靠近玩家最后出现位置的节点藏身。
* 若近期对玩家喷射过粘液，会选择距离该玩家约40单位的远处躲藏。
* 视野内无玩家时，会前往28单位范围内的物资附近藏身，停留在物资2至6单位处。
躲藏点位均在逃窜状态、完成喷射后进行判定选取。
== {{section heading/Strategy}} == 
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If you encounter a Backwater Gunkfish while on a moon, it is best not to disturb it. While they are weak, they are not aggressive and cannot harm employees directly. The Gunkfish can easily be jumped over should one block your path, which may be seen as a better tactic as opposed to forcing it to move.
</div>

Friseure zielen und versuchen sich zum spieler hin zubewegen innerhalb ihres Sichtfeldes. Die Bewegung des Friseurs ist unberechenbar, da er sich zu einer zufälligen Position teleportiert um näher zu dem Spieler zu gelangen, jedoch ist es unwahrscheinlich dass er sich zu einer Position teleportiert an der der Spieler als letztes stand.

The '''Barber''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It moves by intermittently hopping short distances, accompanied by a drumroll noise when preparing to move, and a honking sound upon moving. It only renders itself visible to employees within close proximity to it, and if it moves in the way of one, it swiftly chops them in half with its giant scissors. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Embrion]].

Barbers are ghostly purple humanoids with mostly featureless bodies except for a pair of white gloves on their hands, with which they wield a giant pair of scissors with circular red handles.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary|ClaySurgeon}}
== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Mechanics ==
Barbers are invisible to employees outside of a small radius. Their position can be estimated by the sounds they make as they move around: a snare drum roll while charging, and a loud honking sound when they step forward.

Barbers target and attempt to move toward employees within their line of sight. A Barber's movement is unpredictable, as it teleports to a random position to get closer to the employee it is targeting, though it is likely that it teleports to a position the employee was last standing at.

If an employee touches a Barber's scissors at any point, they are instantly cut in half and killed. When an employee has been cut in half, only the top half of their body can be picked up.

The first Barber that spawns becomes the "Master Barber", which leads every other Barber on the map. Other Barbers only make sounds and move around in sync with the Master Barber. This mechanic is no longer present past Version 62, as Barbers were changed so only one can spawn per day.

Barbers' charge time starts out at 2.75 seconds between steps and decreases by 0.1 seconds every hour, causing them to become faster and more dangerous the longer that employees stay on a moon.

== Strategy ==
* Use the Barber's snare and music to indicate when it'll attack.
* The note played when it moves is very loud, so listen to it to know where it is.
* In versions below 62: If you hear a barber, be prepared for another one to be close behind. They spawn in packs of two and stick close to each other due to the master barber system.
== Trivia ==
* The Barber has the second shortest bestiary entry, consisting of only three sentences and being only beaten by the [[Nutcracker]].

'''Барбер''' - враждебная [[Entities/ru|сущность]] внутри здания. Передвигается, периодически скача вперёд на короткие дистанции под аккомпанемент барабанной дроби при приготовлении к скачку и гудка непосредственно при совершении оного. Обычно невидим, являя себя только сотрудникам в непосредственной близости, по достижении которых тут же разрезает их пополам гигантскими ножницами. Среди всех [[Moons/ru|лун]] чаще всего встречается на [[Embrion/ru|Embrion]].

Сами Барберы - призрачные фиолетовые гуманоиды с бесхарактерным телом за исключением пары белых перчаток на их руках, в которых они удерживают гигантские ножницы с округлыми красными рукоятками.

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{quote bestiary|ClaySurgeon}}
<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== Шансы появления ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Механики ==
Барберы невидимы для сотрудников вне малого радиуса от них. Их позицию можно примерно вычислить по звукам, которые они издают при передвижении: барабанная трель при приготовлении к скачку и громкий гудок при совершении оного.

Барберы выбирают целью и стараются двигаться в сторону сотрудников в их поле зрения. Движения Барбера непредсказуемы, так как он скачет в случайную позицию, чтобы приблизиться к сотруднику, являющимся его целью, хотя есть предположение, что он совершает скачок к месту, где сотрудник стоял чуть ранее.

Если сотрудник в любой момент коснётся ножниц Барбера, их моментально перережет надвое и убьёт. Когда сотрудника разрезает надвое, подобрать можно только их верхнюю половину тела.

Первый появившийся Барбер становится Ведущим Барбером, который ведёт любого другого Барбера на карте. Остальные Барберы издают звуки и передвигаются исключительно синхронно с Ведущим Барбером. Эта механика отсутствует в игре с Версии 62, так как начиная с неё за день может появиться только один Барбер.

Время зарядки скачка Барбера составляет 2.75 секунды между скачками и уменьшается на 0.1 секунды каждый час, делая их тем более быстрыми и опасными чем дольше сотрудники задерживаются на Луне.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==
* Ориентируйтесь по трели и музыке Барбера, чтобы определить, когда он будет атаковать.
* Нота, издаваемая им при движении очень громкая, прислушивайтесь к ней, чтобы понять, где он.
* Для версий ранее 62-й: Если вы слышите Барбера - приготовьтесь к тому, что прямо за ним может быть второй. Они появляются парами и держатся вместе из-за системы ведущего Барбера.
<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные факты ==
* У Барбера вторая самая короткая запись в Бестиарии, состоящая только лишь из 3-х предложений и уступающая только [[Nutcracker/ru|Щелкунчику]].

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''理发师'''是一种紫色的人形[[Entities|实体]]，可在室内被发现。它配备了一把巨大的剪刀，可以把员工剪成两半，并立即杀死员工。剪刀手在短距离内缓慢跳跃，准备移动时则会发出鼓声，移动时发出喇叭声。只有在靠近它的时候才能看到它。它只会在靠近玩家的近距离范围内显形，若它移动到员工身前，会迅速用巨型剪刀将其剪成两半。它们最常出现在[[Dine]][[Moons|卫星]]上。
</div>

理发师是一种幽灵般的紫色人形，身体大部分区域没有明显特征，只在手上戴着一副白手套，并用这双手挥舞一把巨型剪刀，剪刀配有圆形红色握柄。

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== 生物图鉴条目 ==
{{quote bestiary|ClaySurgeon}}
<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== 生成概率 ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== 机制 ==
小范围外的员工看不到理发师。可以通过他们移动时发出的声音来估计他们的位置：冲锋时发出小鼓震动声，向前移动时发出巨大的喇叭声。

理发师会瞄准并试图向其视线范围内的员工移动。理发师的移动是不可预测的，它会随机传送到一个位置，以接近它的目标员工，不过它很可能传送到员工最后站立的位置。

如果员工触碰到理发师的剪刀任何一处，都会被立即切成两半并被杀死。员工被剪成两半后，只能捡起尸体的上半身。

第一个出现的理发师会成为 “剪刀大师”，领导地图上的所有其他剪刀手。其他剪刀手只能发出声音，并与剪刀发大师同步移动。

理发师的行动冷却时间从每次之间的 2.75 秒开始，每小时减少 0.1 秒，导致玩家在星球上停留的时间越长，其速度越快，危险性越大。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==
* 用理发师的声音和音乐来预测它什么时候会攻击。
* 当它移动时播放的声音非常响亮，所以听声辨位。
* 如果你发现一个理发师，请准备好面对另一个。由于理发师的机制，它们以两个为一组生成，并一起行动。
<span id="Trivia"></span>
== 杂项 ==
* 理发师的条目是第二短的生物图鉴条目，只有三句话，仅次于[[Nutcracker/zh-cn|胡桃夹子]]。

######## Bee suit
{{Infobox Furniture|image=Bee Suit Equipped.png|name=Bee Suit|defaultprice=110|categories=[[Category:Suits]]}}
{{merge|Suits}}

== Overview ==

The '''Bee suit''' is a [[Suits|suit]] variant that can be purchased from the [[Ship#Terminal|terminal]] in the ship. After purchase, the suit will be on the suit rack. Interacting with it will change the employee's suit.

The '''Bell''' (or "Brass bell") is a [[Scrap]] item in Lethal Company. It is considered common, appearing on more than half of the game's Moons and is mid-to-high tier in terms of value. It does not have any particular use or possible interactions.  

<!--T:2-->
When dropped on the ground, it produces a loud ringing noise (As of [[v50]] beta), which noise-sensitive entities such as Eyeless Dogs can hear. It also emits faint chiming sounds when held in an employee's hand, which does not alert Entities. As it is a conductive item, it can trigger lightning strikes when held by an employee or set on the ground during [[Weather#Stormy|stormy weather]]. 
</translate>

######## Bell/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--none-->
|audible=When dropped
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
The '''Bell''' (or "Brass bell") is a [[Scrap]] item in Lethal Company. It is considered common, appearing on more than half of the game's Moons and is mid-to-high tier in terms of value. It does not have any particular use or possible interactions.  

When dropped on the ground, it produces a loud ringing noise (As of [[v50]] beta), which noise-sensitive entities such as Eyeless Dogs can hear. It also emits faint chiming sounds when held in an employee's hand, which does not alert Entities. As it is a conductive item, it can trigger lightning strikes when held by an employee or set on the ground during [[Weather#Stormy|stormy weather]]. 
== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{#invoke:Scraps/AutoTables|spawnChancesOnAllMoonsTables|Bell}}

== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
The Bell's model is not hollow on the inside. This can be seen by looking at the underside of it as somebody else is holding the item, and it begs the question of how it could even make the sounds that it does due to the clapper seemingly not being able to move.

The Bell's name is different in the item's scan node (instead being called "Brass bell").

######## Belt bag
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|name=(Tactical) Belt bag
|physics=Solid to other items
|audible=Only to players
|primary-use=<q>Check bag</q>
|secondary-use=<q>Store tool</q>
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The '''Belt bag''' is a blue fanny pack that can be purchased from the [[Store|equipment store]] for {{credits|45}},
used for carrying multiple equipment items with only a single hotbar slot taken up.
</translate>
{{terminal|
 The Company's very own tactical belt bags are an
 absolute must-have for those who want to bring
 their all! They can hold 15 utility items at one
 time. You'll never feel useless again!

 Just press [Q] to store an item in the bag, then
 click to check its contents and drag items out.
 Other players can also use the bag while it's
 fastened around your waist.
}}
<translate>
<!--T:2-->
When on the ground, pressing {{keybind|Interact}} while looking at the belt part lets you pick it up as usual,
whereas looking at the bag part and holding {{keybind|Interact|short=y}} opens the inventory HUD without picking it up.
You can't open the HUD with [[full hands]].
</translate><br><translate>
<!--T:3-->
When in your hand, looking at a tool and pressing {{keybind|Item Secondary use}} will store it in the bag,
while {{keybind|Item primary use}} opens the inventory HUD.
Again this won't work with full hands, such as if you're climbing a ladder.
Note that you can still pick up any item like normal with {{keybind|Interact|short=y}},
and that if you open the HUD, you can still use {{keybind|Item Secondary use|short=y}} to store items.
You can't stow an item that another employee is holding, just like you can't pick it up out of their hand.
</translate><br><translate>
<!--T:4-->
When on your person (hotbar) but not selected, it appears on your waist, and you can look down to use it just as if it was on the ground.
Your fellow employees can also use it while you're holding or wearing it.<ref group="note">
If an employee accesses the [[Terminal]] with a Belt bag ''in their hand'', it becomes inaccessible to others.
</ref>

<!--T:5-->
Only one employee can have the HUD open at once.

<!--T:6-->
Any [[Store#Equipment|purchased equipment]] can be stored in the bag,
as well as [[Key]]s, [[Ammo]] (but not [[Shotgun]]s or [[Kitchen knives]]), and the [[Sticky note]] and [[clipboard]]s.
<br>A bag holds up to 15 items, and weighs a constant {{pounds|15.5}} regardless of what's stored in it,
making it more viable to take equipment across unsound bridges.
</translate><br><translate>
<!--T:7-->
Specific item behaviors:
* Items which drain power while active, such as the [[Flashlight]], will continue to do so if not switched off before being stowed.<!--
--> Holding the Belt bag will not show a battery indicator, nor can you charge items while they're in the bag.
* [[Walkie-talkie]]s remain active when stowed, but incoming transmissions are not audible, and you must withdraw it to broadcast.
* Active [[Lockpicker]]s continue running from within the bag.<!--
--> You can withdraw them and re-stow them and they will remain "paired" to the door they're operating on, unless and until you pick them up directly.<!-- seems to happen less reliably than it was in beta though -->
* Thrown [[Stun grenade]]s ''cannot'' be "cooked" by stowing them; they will go off uselessly inside the bag.
* [[Boombox]]es remain active when stowed but are not audible.
* The timers of [[Extension ladder]]s continue counting down while in the bag, but it doesn't matter since an extended ladder will retract upon being withdrawn.
* Active [[Radar-booster]]s continue to function when stored, but they appear to be in a void, presumably out-of-bounds.
* Belt bags can hold other Belt bags. This creates a way to exceed the 15-item limit, if you're okay with the greater risk.<!--
--> The nested bags must be withdrawn to be used.

<!--T:8-->
Neither the pickup jangle sound nor the opening zip sound are [[Audible_sounds|audible to entities]].
However, as with other items, dropping a bag ''is'' audible.

<!--T:9-->
While it appears that you hold it with both hands, that does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.
However, having the HUD open has the same restrictions as <q>HANDS FULL</q>, despite not showing that message.

<!--T:10-->
Dropped Belt bags have a small collision box, meaning other items dropped on the same spot will land on top of it.
It's also there when the bag is being worn.
As of v64, items stop processing gravity once they've landed, so items can be made to hover using this mechanic.

<!--T:11-->
You can sell a Belt bag for zero credits.
Contained items won't show up in the ledger, nor will they count towards the 12-item sell limit.

<!--T:12-->
When loading a save, any items which were stored in a Belt bag instead appear in a pile against the port (left) wall, by the speaker.
This is likely either unintentional or a limitation of the save system.{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}

== Inventory HUD == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
Hover the cursor<ref group="note">The cursor's effective position is the center of the hand icon.</ref>
over an item, hold <code>LMB</code>, move the cursor off the side of the HUD, and release to drop the item where the bag is.
</translate><blockquote>
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
Due to an oversight, when {{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}} is not bound to the default of <code>LMB</code>,
the controls are more complex.
<br>See <ref group="note">
* Press {{nowrap|<code>LMB/RMB/MMB</code>}} (hardcoded) to "grab" an item.
* Press {{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}} to "release" an item.
** If the cursor is over the slots, the item will be left in the bag.
** Otherwise, the item is dropped.
*** If the cursor is over the close button then it will only drop the item, not close the HUD.
* While an item is "in the cursor", closing the HUD with {{keybind|Pause|short=y}} will cancel the withdrawal.
</ref> for details.
</translate>
</blockquote><translate>
<!--T:16-->
You can't move items to or from the hotbar using this HUD.

<!--T:17-->
Press {{keybind|Pause}}, or hover over the close button and press {{nowrap|<code>LMB</code>}} (hardcoded), to close the HUD.

<!--T:18-->
While the HUD is open, you can still perform any action, including moving around.
The only limitations are that if you get too far from the bag, the HUD will close,
plus some edge cases involving unorthodox keybinds like discussed above.

<!--T:19-->
Only one employee can have the HUD open at once.

<!--T:20-->
The HUD is drawn under/behind the [[scanner]]'s overlays, meaning those can possibly block you from clicking on an item or the close button.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:21-->
Pausing during the opening animation results in having both the HUD and the pause menu open.
In this state, pressing {{keybind|Pause}} closes the HUD rather than unpausing.

<!--T:22-->
The "void" that's shown on the monitor when targeting a stored Radar-booster&mdash;the Belt bag's "pocket dimension", if you will&mdash;<!--
-->is actually out-of-bounds far below the map, at the fixed point {{nowrap|(3000, -400, 3000)}},
and items are teleported to and from this spot when stored or withdrawn.
<br>Items inside a sold bag are deleted<!--, as are any in a bag on an employee who gets eaten-->.<!-- TODO confirm that bit -->

<!--T:23-->
The label on the front reads <q>COMPANY-ISSUED</q>.

<!--T:24-->
Its zipper is framed by two button eyes and hides fabric in the shape of jagged teeth,
making the bag resemble a face like that of an [[w:Otomatone|Otomatone]], or more aptly a generic "monster" as might be marketed to children in real life.

<!--T:25-->
Seeing as the bag can hold 15 [[Radar-booster]]s and get no larger or heavier (and they appear to be in a void on the monitor),
it may be a [[w:Bag_of_holding|Bag of Holding]] or similar supernatural artefact.

<!--T:26-->
In the v64 public betas, the HUD was keyboard-enabled, but it didn't work correctly. Crucially, it lacked a way to withdraw the selected item.

<!--T:27-->
The addition of the Belt bag was effectively a rebalance to make equipment more viable, as teased by Zeekerss in the v60 patch notes:
<q>In the next update I'd like to make store-bought items easier and more efficient to bring with you, even while carrying scrap.</q><tvar name="citation"><ref>
Steam announcement [https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/6940696210369307295 ''Version 60 - The Stuffy Update'']
</ref></tvar>
</translate>

== Inventory HUD ==

Hover the cursor<ref group="note">The cursor's effective position is the center of the hand icon.</ref>
over an item, hold <code>LMB</code>, move the cursor off the side of the HUD, and release to drop the item where the bag is.<blockquote>
Due to an oversight, when {{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}} is not bound to the default of <code>LMB</code>,
the controls are more complex.
<br>See <ref group="note">
* Press {{nowrap|<code>LMB/RMB/MMB</code>}} (hardcoded) to "grab" an item.
* Press {{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}} to "release" an item.
** If the cursor is over the slots, the item will be left in the bag.
** Otherwise, the item is dropped.
*** If the cursor is over the close button then it will only drop the item, not close the HUD.
* While an item is "in the cursor", closing the HUD with {{keybind|Pause|short=y}} will cancel the withdrawal.
</ref> for details.
</blockquote>You can't move items to or from the hotbar using this HUD.

Press {{keybind|Pause}}, or hover over the close button and press {{nowrap|<code>LMB</code>}} (hardcoded), to close the HUD.

While the HUD is open, you can still perform any action, including moving around.
The only limitations are that if you get too far from the bag, the HUD will close,
plus some edge cases involving unorthodox keybinds like discussed above.

Only one employee can have the HUD open at once.

The HUD is drawn under/behind the [[scanner]]'s overlays, meaning those can possibly block you from clicking on an item or the close button.
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
Pausing during the opening animation results in having both the HUD and the pause menu open.
In this state, pressing {{keybind|Pause}} closes the HUD rather than unpausing.

The "void" that's shown on the monitor when targeting a stored Radar-booster&mdash;the Belt bag's "pocket dimension", if you will&mdash;<!--
-->is actually out-of-bounds far below the map, at the fixed point {{nowrap|(3000, -400, 3000)}},
and items are teleported to and from this spot when stored or withdrawn.
<br>Items inside a sold bag are deleted<!--, as are any in a bag on an employee who gets eaten-->.<!-- TODO confirm that bit -->

The label on the front reads <q>COMPANY-ISSUED</q>.

Its zipper is framed by two button eyes and hides fabric in the shape of jagged teeth,
making the bag resemble a face like that of an [[w:Otomatone|Otomatone]], or more aptly a generic "monster" as might be marketed to children in real life.

Seeing as the bag can hold 15 [[Radar-booster]]s and get no larger or heavier (and they appear to be in a void on the monitor),
it may be a [[w:Bag_of_holding|Bag of Holding]] or similar supernatural artefact.

In the v64 public betas, the HUD was keyboard-enabled, but it didn't work correctly. Crucially, it lacked a way to withdraw the selected item.

The addition of the Belt bag was effectively a rebalance to make equipment more viable, as teased by Zeekerss in the v60 patch notes:
<q>In the next update I'd like to make store-bought items easier and more efficient to bring with you, even while carrying scrap.</q><ref>
Steam announcement [https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/6940696210369307295 ''Version 60 - The Stuffy Update'']
</ref>

######## Belt bag/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|name=(Tactical) Belt bag
|physics=Solid to other items
|audible=Only to players
|primary-use=<q>Check bag</q>
|secondary-use=<q>Store tool</q>
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
'''Поясная сумка''' - синяя переносная сумка, которую можно купить в [[Store/ru#Снаряжение|магазине снаряжения]] за {{credits|45}},
используется для переноски разного снаряжения, не занимая при этом более одного слота.
{{terminal|
 The Company's very own tactical belt bags are an
 absolute must-have for those who want to bring
 their all! They can hold 15 utility items at one
 time. You'll never feel useless again!

 Just press [Q] to store an item in the bag, then
 click to check its contents and drag items out.
 Other players can also use the bag while it's
 fastened around your waist.
}}
Когда на земле, нажатие {{keybind|Interact}} по поясной сумке позволяет подобрать её, как обычный предмет, а удержание {{keybind|Interact|short=y}} по застёжке открывает окно сумки без её подбора.
Открыть сумку с [[full hands|полными руками]] не получится.<br>При удержании сумки в руках, нажатие {{keybind|Item Secondary use}} по лежащему на земле инструменту поместит его внутрь сумки,
в то время как {{keybind|Item primary use}} откроет окно сумки.
Опять-таки, с занятыми руками совершить данные действия не получится, как например во время карабкания по лестнице.
Стоит отметить, что при нажатии {{keybind|Interact|short=y}} можно подбирать предметы как обычно,
и что при открытом окне сумки нажатие {{keybind|Item Secondary use|short=y}} всё ещё позволит сложить предметы внутрь.
Аналогично тому, как нельзя выхватить инструмент из рук коллег, его нельзя из чужих рук сразу убрать в сумку.<br>При нахождении в инвентаре, но не в выбранной ячейке появляется на поясе персонажа, куда можно опустить взгляд, чтобы воспользоваться ей, как если бы она лежала на полу.
Коллеги также могут воспользоваться сумкой на вашем поясе или в ваших руках.<ref group="note">
Если сотрудник зайдёт в  [[Terminal/ru|Терминал]] с сумкой ''в руках'', та станет недоступной для остальных.
</ref>

Заглядывать в сумку одновременно может только один сотрудник.

Любое [[Store/ru#Снаряжение|покупаемое снаряжение]] может быть убрано в сумку,
вместе с [[Key|Ключами]], [[Ammo|Картечью]] (но не [[Shotgun/ru|Дробовиками]] или [[Kitchen knives|Кухонными ножами]]), а также [[Sticky note|Стикером-заметкой]] с [[clipboard|планшетами]].
<br>Сумка может держать до 15 предметов и всегда весит постоянные 15.5 фунтов вне зависимости от своего содержимого, делая её более надежным вариантом переноса снаряжения по хрупким мостам.<br>Конкретное поведение предметов:
* Предметы, потребляющие энергию, вроде [[Flashlight|фонариков]], продолжат тратить заряд, если перед складыванием в сумку их не выключить.
* Активированные [[Stun grenade/ru|Светошумовые гранаты]] ''нельзя'' "придержать", сложив их в сумку; они просто взведутся в сумке без особой пользы.
* [[Boombox|Бумбоксы]] продолжат работать в сумке, но слышно их не будет.
* Таймер [[Extension ladder/ru|Выдвижных лестниц]] продолжит отсчитывать изнутри сумки, хотя смысла в этом мало, так как они автоматически складываются при доставании из сумки.
* [[Radar-booster/ru|Радарные усилители]] продолжат функционировать изнутри сумки, но по-видимому будут находиться в пустоте, скорее всего вне карты.
* Сумки можно вкладывать друг в друга, прерывая лимит в 15 предметов, но делая обращение с ними более долгим в рискованной ситуации (к тому же для использовании вложенных сумок их надо полностью достать и взять в руки/использовать с пола).

Ни шелест подбора сумки, ни звук её застёжки [[Audible_sounds|не слышны монстрам]].
Тем не менее, как и в случае с остальными предметами, сброс самой сумки на землю ''является'' слышимым.

Хотя удержание сумки выглядит так, бдуто при этом заняты обе руки, на деле игра не считает руки игрока [[hands full|полными]], так что по такой логике сумка не является габаритной.
Тем не менее при открытии сумки на игрока налагаются те же ограничения, что и при <q>HANDS FULL</q>, несмотря на отсутствие соответствующего индикатора.

Сумки обладают коллизией, будь то после сброса на землю или при ношении на поясе. При сбросе предметов на лежащую сумку те не провалятся в неё, а лягут на саму сумку.
На момент Версии 64 предметы перестают просчитывать гравитации по завершении приземления, потому при подборе сумки предметы, ранее приземлившиеся на неё, останутся висеть в воздухе.

Сумку можно продать за {{credits|0}}.
Содержимое не появится в списке выплат и не будет засчитываться в лимит 12 предметов.

При загрузке сохранения всё содержимое сумки появится в куче у левой стены под колонкой.
Это, скорее всего, так не задумано, либо является следствием ограничений системы сохранений.{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}

<span id="Inventory_HUD"></span>
== Окно инвентаря ==

Чтобы достать предмет из сумки, нужно навестись курсором<ref group="note">Позицией курсора считается центр спрайта руки.</ref>
на предмет и, удерживая <code>ЛКМ</code>, перетащить предмет за пределы окна сумки, после чего отпустить кнопку мыши.<blockquote>
Из-за недоработки, если {{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}} не назначено на стандартный <code>ЛКМ</code>,
управление становится замудрёным.<ref group="note">
* Нажмите {{nowrap|<code>ЛКМ/ПКМ/СКМ</code>}} (обязательно из-за кода игры), чтобы "взять" предмет.
* Нажмите {{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}}, чтобы "отпустить" предмет.
** Если курсор находится на ячейке инвентаря сумки, предмет будет возвращён.
** Иначе предмет будет выброшен из сумки.
*** Если курсор находится над кнопкой закрытия сумки, то предмет будет выброшен, но окно не закроется.
* Пока предмет "находится в курсоре", закрытие окна с помощью {{keybind|Pause|short=y}} отменит вытаскивание предмета.
</ref>
</blockquote>Использование окна сумки не позволит помещать в неё предметы из инвентаря игрока или наоборот.

Нажмите {{keybind|Pause}} или наведитесь на кнопку закрытия окна и нажмите {{nowrap|<code>ЛКМ</code>}} (обязательно из-за кода игры), чтобы закрыть окно.

С открытым окном можно выполнять любые действия, включая передвижение.
Единственное ограничение заключается в том, что при отдалении от сумки окно закроется

Одновременно открыть окно сумки может только один сотрудник

Окно рисуется "под/за" виньеткой [[scanner|сканера]], а значит она может заблокировать нажатие на предмет или закрытие окна.
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
При открытии меню во время анимации открытия сумки отрисуются одновременно и меню, и окно сумки.
В таком состояние нажатие {{keybind|Pause}} закроет окно сумки, а не меню.

"Пустота", показываемая на мониторе при выборе убранного в сумку радарного усилителя, это по сути карманное измерение сумки.

Бирка на передней стороне гласит <q>COMPANY-ISSUED</q> (ВЫДАНО КОМПАНИЕЙ).

Застёжку дополняют два глаза-пуговки и лоскуты ткани, напоминающие острые зубы,
отчего сумка напоминает лицо [https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Отаматон отоматона], или скорее обычного "монстра", которыми в реальной жизни пугают детей.

Учитывая тот факт, что сумку можно набить 15 [[Radar-booster/ru|Радарными усилителями]] (без учёта метода вложения сумки в сумку), и что та от такого не станет больше или тяжелее, можно предположить, что сумка является [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magic_item_(Dungeons_%26_Dragons)#Bag_of_Holding сумкой хранения] или похожим сверхъестественным артефактом.

В публичных бетах Версии 64 окно всегда открывалось с помощью клавиатуры, но работало неправильно. Критическим было то, что не существовало метода возвращения предмета наружу из сумки.

Дополнение Поясной Сумки было по сути ребалансом, сделавшим снаряжение более полезным, что соответствует словам Zeekerss в патчноутах Версии 60:
<q>In the next update I'd like to make store-bought items easier and more efficient to bring with you, even while carrying scrap.</q><ref>
Steam announcement [https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/6940696210369307295 ''Version 60 - The Stuffy Update'']
</ref>

######## Bestiary
{{stub}}
{{about|the terminal command|the individual entries (lore)|Template:GameTextExcerpts/Bestiary|info relevant to gameplay|Entities}}

== Usage ==
The bestiary is a list of [[Entities|wildlife]] the employee has encountered and scanned that are found inhabiting the many [[moons]]. After a kind of wildlife has been scanned for the first time, its entry is accessible via the [[Computer Terminal|computer terminal]] using the [[Computer_Terminal#Terminal Commands|command]] "BESTIARY", or by typing the creature's name. 

Only two creatures do not have a bestiary entry - the [[Ghost Girl]] and [[Masked]]. These entities are not scannable and give an error when attempting to access their pages.

Most entries are written as a "scientific record" on the creature scanned. They are written in a formal tone and include a creature's scientific name (excluding [[Old Bird]]s), some information on its structure, its history, and how to deal with one in an encounter. Some entries do not follow this formula, namely the [[Jester]], [[Butler]], [[Nutcracker]], [[Barber]], and [[Mask hornets]]. These entries are more barren and do not include as much information, with the first two being evidently written by [[Sigurd]], and the latter three having unknown authors.

Many entries are retroactively given a danger level by Sigurd. This danger level scales by percentage between 0% and 100%, excluding the [[Maneater]], whose danger level is 1000%.<ref>[[Maneater#Bestiary_entry|Bestiary entry for Maneaters]]</ref> These levels seem to be given on opinion alone and are not always reflective of the actual difficulty with encountering the creature. Many will also include notes written by Sigurd, ranging from advice to personal anecdotes on the creatures or his crew. The [[Eyeless Dog]], [[Bracken]], Old Bird, Nutcracker, Barber, and Mask hornet entries are the few not given a danger level or other notes (excluding the Bracken, who has notes written by Sigurd but no danger level).<ref>[[Bracken#Bestiary_entry|Bestiary entry for Brackens]]</ref>

######## Body
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|name=<translate><!--T:1--> Body of &lt;playername&gt;</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:3-->
A '''Body''' is the corpse of a deceased [[employee]], effectively a ragdoll which has inherited their appearance.

<!--T:4-->
The majority of methods to die result in the deceased employee becoming a Body. However, there are some exceptions in which a body cannot be recovered by any means, including:
* Being consumed by a [[Forest Keeper]].
* Being consumed by an [[Earth Leviathan]].
* Being consumed by [[The Company#The Company Monster|The Company Monster]].
* Being ripped apart by a [[Giant Sapsucker]].
* Being transformed into a [[Masked]].
* Sinking in Quicksand on [[Adamance]] or a rainy moon.
* Falling off the map.

<!--T:5-->
Despite Bodies generally matching the appearance of the deceased employee, certain deaths modify the Body's appearance, including:
* Dying to a [[Coil-Head]] replaces the Body's head with a spring and removes its forearms.
* Being scorched by an [[Old Bird]] gives the body a black, charred appearance.
* Being consumed by a [[Hygrodere]] causes the body to appear as an empty suit.
* Dying to the [[Ghost Girl]], a [[Kidnapper Fox]], or a [[Cadaver Bloom]] results in a headless body.
* Being cut in half by a [[Barber]] separates the body into a top and bottom half. Only the top half can be picked up.
* A body that has been picked up by a [[Bunker Spider]] and suspended from a ceiling will be wrapped in silk. This can happen even if the body was killed by something other than the Bunker Spider.
* A body that has been used as a host for a now-dead [[Cadaver Bloom]] will have flowers growing out of the helmet and upper chest.

<!--T:6-->
Bodies can be carried back to the [[ship]] like [[scrap]] to "recover" them.
They can also be targeted on the ship's monitor and [[Teleporter|teleported]] back. Teleportation is the only way to retrieve a body that has been taken by a Bunker Spider or fallen into an inaccessible area such as the pits in the [[Interiors|Factory]] and [[Mineshaft]].
Upon returning to orbit, a fine is deducted from the current [[Credits|credit balance]] based on how many employees died;
"recovering" a Body reduces the fine as described below.
Any Bodies are deleted when dead employees are respawned in orbit.

<!--T:7-->
A Body can be sold to [[the Company]] for {{credits|5}}.
Since Bodies are not retained when leaving a moon, the employee will have to be killed after landing on [[Gordion]].
Note that this is mutually exclusive with recovering the Body, so it's advisable to only use this strategy in dire situations,
or if equipment is purchased on Gordion to reduce the credit loss prior to leaving.
As mentioned above, dying to [[the Company Monster]] destroys the Body and doesn't count as selling it.

<!--T:8-->
Bodies count towards the total in the [[weekly challenge]].

== Penalty == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
For each dead employee, you can obtain their body before leaving the moon, so called 'bodies recovered' in game. If the body was not obtained, you lose 20% of your current credits for each body. Otherwise, you lose 8% of current credits.<tvar name="citation"><ref><code>ApplyPenalty</code> - https://pastebin.com/NkErBW2m</ref></tvar>

<!--T:11-->
Formula:
 totalPenalty = Math.Floor(currentCredit * 0.2) * unobtainedBodies + Math.Floor(currentCredit * 0.08) * obtainedBodies

######## Body/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|name=Body of &lt;playername&gt;
|physics=Ragdolls jankily
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
A '''Body''' is the corpse of a deceased [[employee]], effectively a ragdoll which has inherited their appearance.

The majority of methods to die result in the deceased employee becoming a Body. However, there are some exceptions in which a body cannot be recovered by any means, including:
* Being consumed by a [[Forest Keeper]].
* Being consumed by an [[Earth Leviathan]].
* Being consumed by [[The Company#The Company Monster|The Company Monster]].
* Being ripped apart by a [[Giant Sapsucker]].
* Being transformed into a [[Masked]].
* Sinking in Quicksand on [[Adamance]] or a rainy moon.
* Falling off the map.

Despite Bodies generally matching the appearance of the deceased employee, certain deaths modify the Body's appearance, including:
* Dying to a [[Coil-Head]] replaces the Body's head with a spring and removes its forearms.
* Being scorched by an [[Old Bird]] gives the body a black, charred appearance.
* Being consumed by a [[Hygrodere]] causes the body to appear as an empty suit.
* Dying to the [[Ghost Girl]], a [[Kidnapper Fox]], or a [[Cadaver Bloom]] results in a headless body.
* Being cut in half by a [[Barber]] separates the body into a top and bottom half. Only the top half can be picked up.
* A body that has been picked up by a [[Bunker Spider]] and suspended from a ceiling will be wrapped in silk. This can happen even if the body was killed by something other than the Bunker Spider.
* A body that has been used as a host for a now-dead [[Cadaver Bloom]] will have flowers growing out of the helmet and upper chest.

Bodies can be carried back to the [[ship]] like [[scrap]] to "recover" them.
They can also be targeted on the ship's monitor and [[Teleporter|teleported]] back. Teleportation is the only way to retrieve a body that has been taken by a Bunker Spider or fallen into an inaccessible area such as the pits in the [[Interiors|Factory]] and [[Mineshaft]].
Upon returning to orbit, a fine is deducted from the current [[Credits|credit balance]] based on how many employees died;
"recovering" a Body reduces the fine as described below.
Any Bodies are deleted when dead employees are respawned in orbit.

A Body can be sold to [[the Company]] for {{credits|5}}.
Since Bodies are not retained when leaving a moon, the employee will have to be killed after landing on [[Gordion]].
Note that this is mutually exclusive with recovering the Body, so it's advisable to only use this strategy in dire situations,
or if equipment is purchased on Gordion to reduce the credit loss prior to leaving.
As mentioned above, dying to [[the Company Monster]] destroys the Body and doesn't count as selling it.

Bodies count towards the total in the [[weekly challenge]].

== Penalty ==

For each dead employee, you can obtain their body before leaving the moon, so called 'bodies recovered' in game. If the body was not obtained, you lose 20% of your current credits for each body. Otherwise, you lose 8% of current credits.<ref><code>ApplyPenalty</code> - https://pastebin.com/NkErBW2m</ref>

Formula:
 totalPenalty = Math.Floor(currentCredit * 0.2) * unobtainedBodies + Math.Floor(currentCredit * 0.08) * obtainedBodies

######## Boombox

The '''Boombox''' is a type of [[scrap]] that can be purchased from the [[store]] for {{credits|60}} [[credits]]. It is a portable music player that can play a selection of five different songs. 

== {{section heading/Company description}} == <!--T:3-->
</translate>
{{terminal|<translate>
<!--T:4-->
"These jamming tunes are great for a morale boost on your crew!"
</translate>
}}
<translate>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} == <!--T:5-->

<!--T:6-->
The noise produced by boomboxes will cause nearby [[Eyeless Dog]]s to charge towards them, distracting them and allowing employees to escape. [[Hygrodere]]s are also attracted to the noise, with employees being able to lure them away or keep them stationary by holding or placing boomboxes.

== {{section heading/Trivia}} == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Boomboxes will start distorting their music once it is about to run out of charge, causing the music played to slow down up to a certain point, before shortly shutting off completely.

<!--T:9-->
Re-charging the boombox while it is in this degenerative state will retain the slowed-down speed, allowing employees to listen to a slowed-down version of a song.

<!--T:17-->
Boombox Song 2 and Song 3 were composed by [[Zeekerss]]{{Citation needed}}, while Boombox Song 5 was composed by [[ZedFox]]. 

<!--T:18-->
Boombox Song 1 and Boombox Song 4 are songs found on Freesound.org, as Hip Hop 100 A on Freesound.org from user BaDoink<ref>https://freesound.org/people/BaDoink/sounds/572396/</ref> and Hip Hop Beat from user TheoTJ<ref>https://freesound.org/people/TheoJT/sounds/510946/</ref> respectively

######## Boombox/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=While active
|battery=Yes<!-- TODO check duration -->
|primary-use=<q>Toggle music</q>

|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}The '''Boombox''' is a type of [[scrap]] that can be purchased from the [[store]] for {{credits|60}} [[credits]]. It is a portable music player that can play a selection of five different songs. 

== {{section heading/Company description}} ==
{{terminal|"These jamming tunes are great for a morale boost on your crew!"
}}
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==

The noise produced by boomboxes will cause nearby [[Eyeless Dog]]s to charge towards them, distracting them and allowing employees to escape. [[Hygrodere]]s are also attracted to the noise, with employees being able to lure them away or keep them stationary by holding or placing boomboxes.

== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==

Boomboxes will start distorting their music once it is about to run out of charge, causing the music played to slow down up to a certain point, before shortly shutting off completely.

Re-charging the boombox while it is in this degenerative state will retain the slowed-down speed, allowing employees to listen to a slowed-down version of a song.

Boombox Song 2 and Song 3 were composed by [[Zeekerss]]{{Citation needed}}, while Boombox Song 5 was composed by [[ZedFox]]. 

Boombox Song 1 and Boombox Song 4 are songs found on Freesound.org, as Hip Hop 100 A on Freesound.org from user BaDoink<ref>https://freesound.org/people/BaDoink/sounds/572396/</ref> and Hip Hop Beat from user TheoTJ<ref>https://freesound.org/people/TheoJT/sounds/510946/</ref> respectively

<span id="{{section_heading/Company_description}}"></span>

<span id="{{section_heading/Strategy}}"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Звук, издаваемый бумбоксами, привлечёт [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепых Псов]] неподалёку и заставит их делать рывки в свою сторону, отвлекая их и позволяя сотрудникам сбежать. [[Hygrodere/ru|Гигродиры]] также привлечены к звуку, позволяя сотрудникам отманивать их или удерживать на месте, держа бумбоксы в руках или положив их на пол.

<span id="{{section_heading/Trivia}}"></span>
== Интересные факты ==

* Бумбоксы начнут искажать свою музыку, когда они почти разрядились, замедляя музыку до определённого момента перед тем, как полностью выключиться.

* Перезарядка бумбокса в таком состоянии сохранит замедленную скорость музыки, позволяя сотрудникам слушать замедленные версии песен.

}}'''音箱''是一种[[scrap|废料]]，可在[[store|商店]]花费60[[credits|信用点]]购买。它是一款便携式音乐播放器，内置五首不同歌曲可供播放。

{{terminal|“这些即兴乐曲是提振士气的好选择！”
}}
<span id="{{section_heading/Strategy}}"></span>
== 策略 ==

音响发出的音乐会持续吸引附近的[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]冲向音响位置，从而给员工逃脱的机会。[[Hygrodere/zh-cn|史莱姆]]也同样会被音乐吸引，员工可将音响放置在固定点位来牵制史莱姆，或是手持音响将其引走。

<span id="{{section_heading/Trivia}}"></span>
== 杂项 ==

* 若音响的电量即将耗尽，其音乐会变调，同时逐渐减慢播放速度至一定数值，直至电量耗尽。

* 在上述的低电量状态下给音响充电，音乐不会再变调，但播放速度不会恢复。这样员工们就能欣赏到慢速版本的音乐了。

<!--T:1-->
The '''Bracken''', colloquially known as the "Flowerman", is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. Quietly stalking an employee from behind at a distance, it will eventually approach and attempt to snap an employee's neck before dragging away their corpse. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Vow]].

Brackens are lanky creatures with dark, beet-colored skin, small glowing white eyes, and rows of large dark green leaves adorning their backs. They also have long arms with five-fingered hands and hooved lower legs bent similar in shape to that of a horse.

== Bestiary entry == <!--T:26-->
</translate>


<!--T:2-->
{{Terminal|text=<translate><!--T:44--> Bracken -- AKA flower man!</translate>

<!--T:39-->
Scientific name: Rapax-folium

<!--T:40-->
There is debate on the genus to which the Bracken belongs. It is a bipedal vertebrate with skin the color and texture of a red beat. The name was coined for what appear to be leaves protruding from its upper spine. The purpose of these is believed to be for intimidation, however not much is known about the specifics of bracken behaviour due to its illusiveness and low population. 

<!--T:41-->
We know a little from accounts by wildlife experts who have encountered it. is a lone hunter with high intelligence. Its behavior can seem aloof; it exhibits high aggression even when unprovoked, yet it quickly backs off when confronted. However, brackens are known to up their hostility when cornered or simply watched for a long time. For this reason it's recommended to keep an eye on it but not to stare it down. No specimens have been collected dead or alive. It's theorized that upon death their bodies undergo a rapid decomposition process which is unique from other large animals.</translate>}}

== Spawn chances == <!--T:46-->
</translate>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<translate>
== Mechanics == <!--T:28-->

<!--T:3-->
=== States ===
The Bracken has three possible states: sneaking, evading, and enraged.

<!--T:4-->
==== Sneaking ====
The Bracken spawns in its sneaking state. While sneaking, the Bracken moves silently towards the nearest employee. If it successfully reaches them without being noticed, it will snap their neck.

<!--T:5-->
==== Evading ====
When spotted by an employee (within the middle 50% of their screen), the Bracken will stand up making rain stick sounds, and then immediately start evading where they will move away from the employee towards a chosen room (the one furthest to the employee) for 24 seconds, or 11 seconds for every third time it is spotted. The Bracken will then return to sneaking and repeat the cycle.

<!--T:6-->
==== Enraged ====
The Bracken has an internal anger meter. It is increased when the following conditions are met:

<!--T:29-->
{| class="wikitable"
! Action !! Extra Conditions !! Anger Meter !! Note
|-
| Staring at or being within 5 meters of Bracken || - || +.2/.2s || -
|-
| Being within 5 meters of Bracken || while evading (backing away) || +.2/.2s || -
|-
| Staring at Bracken || for the first 1.25s of evasion || +1.5/s || -
|-
| [[Stun grenade|Stunning]] Bracken || - || Sets to 6 || Doesn't add anger, so not causing an immediate check
|-
| Hitting Bracken with a weapon || - || Sets to 11, also +.1 || Adds anger, so Bracken would immediately turn into enraged state
|}

<!--T:13-->
Every 1 cumulative anger added (not set) results in a randomized check for its enraged state, with a 0% chance of becoming enraged at 0 anger and a 100% chance of it becoming enraged at 11 anger.

<!--T:14-->
Formula:
</translate>

 <translate><!--T:15--> random(0, .99) < anger * .09</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:16-->
Upon being enraged, the Bracken will immediately chase the nearest employee in an attempt to snap their neck, with its anger meter slowly ticking down at a rate of 1 anger/second. Once it hits 0 or the employee is dead, the Bracken will return to its evading state. 

=== Corpse dragging === <!--T:30-->

<!--T:7-->
Upon killing an employee, the Bracken will drag their corpse towards its chosen room (it being the one that it moved towards during its evading state). The Bracken will drop the employee's body under these conditions:
* It reaches the room
* It cannot reach the room
* It has not chosen a room
* It exits its evading state (including a transition to an enraged state)

== Strategy == <!--T:31-->

<!--T:8-->
Diligently checking surroundings indoors will ensure the Bracken is unable to sneak up on employees. Once spotted, as long as employees neither approach nor stare, it will immediately flee further into the building. While it is evading, a faint descending hum sound will be heard as long as it can still see you; when this sound cuts out, it is safe to turn around. The Bracken will also open doors to get to an employee, and can be identified by doors that are already opened or the sound of opening doors without any footsteps accompanied by it. Doors can be closed behind an employee to provide sound cues for a pursuing Bracken.

<!--T:17-->
[[Shotgun|Shotguns]] are the easiest and most effective way to dispose of a Bracken, as they deal more than enough damage to kill it in one shot if close enough. [[Zap gun]]s are also effective against the Bracken, making it possible to kill if paired with another employee holding a [[shovel]]. However, the Bracken will be angered by this and immediately attempt to snap an employee's neck if not killed before the stun's duration ends. A Bracken can be killed with a shovel alone by sprint-strafing diagonally in circles in a large area, such as the main entrance on Facility or Mansion interiors, but takes practice to ensure a successful attempt. Alternatively, the Bracken can be killed by triggering [[Landmine|landmines]], either by having the Bracken dragging a body on top of one or through other typical means of triggering a landmine. Stun grenades have no effect on the Bracken, and instead simply anger it.

<!--T:51-->
Another strategy for killing the Bracken with a shovel alone involves forcing it away, then attacking while moving backwards. First, spook it by glancing at it to initiate a retreat, then follow it if it isn't stationary; if it stops, look away and let it retreat again. When close enough, perform the initial attack on the Bracken, then let go of sprint, move backwards, and re-enable sprint to maximize acceleration, all while readying the next hit. When the Bracken is in range again, swing again.

[[Kitchen_Knife|Kitchen knives]] can be utilized in a similar fashion to shovels, but due to its much shorter range and the severe punishment for contacting with the Bracken's collider, using it is strongly discouraged.

<!--T:18-->
Employees are also able to lock the Bracken away using security doors by luring it in and closing the door once it is inside, with the employee escaping through [[Teleporter|teleportation]].

<!--T:45-->
Once an employee is grabbed, they will be unable to use any items and will die shortly after. While it is possible to be teleported in the short window after being grabbed but before being killed, this will usually happen accidentally and should not be relied on as a useful strategy.

<!--T:19-->
If an employee is killed by the Bracken, their body will be dragged far from any exit, making retrieval challenging without the use of a teleporter. If necessary, a body can be found manually by following its blood trail in the direction that goes deeper into the facility.

<!--T:36-->
Because the Bracken knows the facility and the Bracken's chosen room is selected at random, a careful employee can chase it down to go deeper into the building as it will continue to flee as much as it can, preferring said room. If sightings of the Bracken become very frequent, the usage of the strategy should be halted. Caution should be addressed if visiting the Bracken's chosen room, as it will often be angered and trying hard to return to it.

<!--T:50-->
A bracken's chosen room will not be a hallway, but rather an ordinary room, such as the facility room with a staircase. In the Mansion, it gets a bit trickier; despite them appearing to be ordinary rooms, the spiral staircase, the tiny door rooms, and the featureless rooms with a rug and a bookshelf are not chosen by the Bracken. 

<!--T:52-->
The easier way to know where the bracken might come back is remember where you first spotted it, remember the facility tiles, and put on a timer to either 11 or 24 seconds depending on the room it chooses from a section where it was first spotted.

'''Bracken''' werden umgangssprachlich auch "Blumenmänner" genannt und sind schemenhafte humanoide Gegner, denen man in [[Interiors/de|Innenräumen]] begegnen kann. Leise verfolgen sie Mitarbeiter aus der Entfernung, bis sie eine Gelegenheit wittern ihre Beute zu töten und wegzuschleifen.

There is debate on the genus to which the Bracken belongs. It is a bipedal vertebrate with skin the color and texture of a red beat. The name was coined for what appear to be leaves protruding from its upper spine. The purpose of these is believed to be for intimidation, however not much is known about the specifics of bracken behaviour due to its illusiveness and low population.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
We know a little from accounts by wildlife experts who have encountered it. is a lone hunter with high intelligence. Its behavior can seem aloof; it exhibits high aggression even when unprovoked, yet it quickly backs off when confronted. However, brackens are known to up their hostility when cornered or simply watched for a long time. For this reason it's recommended to keep an eye on it but not to stare it down. No specimens have been collected dead or alive. It's theorized that upon death their bodies undergo a rapid decomposition process which is unique from other large animals.
</div>}}
