== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|CadaverGrowths}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
<span id="Growth"></span>
=== Рост ===

Наросты Кадавра появляются из вентиляций подобно любой другой сущности внутри здания, но после появления выберут случайный тайл внутри здания, на котором вырасти и не обязательно рядом с вентиляцией, из которой технически появились. Для первого появления подходит любая поверхность, за исключением [[Шахты|Шахт]], где для появления подходит только поверхность в пещерах. 

Разрастание Кадавра замедлится на 34% как только наросты займут 6 разных тайлов.

<span id="Becoming_infected"></span>
=== Заражение ===

Чтобы стать Цветущим Кадавром, сотрудник должен быть в определённой близости к спорам Нароста Кадавра. Этот шанс устанавливается при входе в комнату с Наростом Кадавра и меняется согласно следующим правилам:
* Увеличивается в зависимости от близости к растению
* Увеличивается со временем, проведённым вблизи растения
* Увеличивается, если стоять рядом с заражённым сотрудником
* Увеличивается (20%), если здоровье сотрудника 60% или меньше
* Увеличивается (50%), если сотрудником критически травмирован
* Уменьшается со временем, проведённым вдали от растения
* Уменьшается с ростом числа заражённых сотрудников
* Уменьшается (25%), если сотрудник абсолютно здоров

В мультиплеере сотрудникам даётся 4 секунды абсолютного иммунитета от инфекции каждый день. В одиночной игре даётся 7 секунд, а также высвечивается сообщение о состоянии фильтра:

<blockquote>
РИСК ЗДОРОВЬЮ!
<br>Твёрдые частицы преодолевают воздушный фильтр;
<br>Качество фильтра: '''x'''%<ref group="note" name="filter" />
</blockquote>

Если шанс заражения равен или больше 1,5%, на дисплее появится оповещение, предупреждающее сотрудника о риске здоровью из-за твёрдых частиц, преодолевающих воздушный фильтр костюма. В результате этого сотрудник может стать заражённым даже если оповещение активно не высвечивается, но увидеть его хотя бы раз сотрудник успеет, так как дневной иммунитет к инфекции не начинает тратиться до того, как это оповещение высветится хотя бы раз.{{ref code|CadaverGrowthAI.InfectPlayers}}

<span id="Infection_phase"></span>
=== Стадия после заражения ===

Когда сотрудник становится заражён, его можно излечить, если тот примет [[shower|душ]] при степени заражения 8% и ниже или если обрызгать его средством от сорняков. Средство от сорняков будет наносить урон только заражённым сотрудникам. Если принять душ до преодоления заражением 8%, на дисплее высветится следующее сообщение:

<blockquote>
БОРЬБА С ИНФЕКЦИЕЙ!
<br>Снижение жара
</blockquote>

При изначальном заражении есть шанс в 60% того, что инфекция станет "серьёзной".<!-- В состоянии серьёзной инфекции при достижении прогресса в 60% заражения или выше изо рта сотрудника при разговоре начнёт исходить облако спор. Эти споры имеют шанс заразить других сотрудников по-близости.--> По достижении прогресса заражения в 80% и выше серьёзно зараженный сотрудник имеет шанс услышать, как лианы Кадавра разрастаются в его голове.

<!-- Внутриигровой флаг, отвечающий за испусканием сотрудником спор изо рта также имеет дополнительный шанс быть установленным, составляющий 40%, а также ещё дополнительный шанс 10% каждый раз, когда сотрудник начинает говорить. Это значит, что даже если при первичном заражении сотрудник не стал заражён серьёзно, у него всё ещё есть шанс испускать изо рта споры.
ПРИМЕЧАНИЕ: Функционал игры, описываемый в закомментированных частях выше в данный момент работает некорректно, хотя и присутствует в коде игры.-->

Изначальный темп прогрессии заражения - 0.78% в секунду, означая, что без изменения условий заражение достигнет 100% за 128.2 секунды, что примерно равно 3 внутриигровым часам. Ускорить процесс можно находясь рядом с другими сотрудниками, имея 40% или меньше здоровья или находясь снаружи под солнцем до 4:48 вечера. 

В мультиплеере на спине сотрудника начинают цвести жёлтые лепестки в соответствии с шансом, увеличивающимся от 5% до 50% с течением заражения. Эти лепестки могут быть просканированы другими сотрудниками с помощью {{keybind|Ping scan}} и будут отображаться как Наросты Кадавра. Их также можно будет увидеть на терминале в виде маленьких красных точек, покрывающих сотрудника (сам заражённый при этом увидеть их на терминале не может).

В одиночной игре лепестки не растут, вместо этого при достижении заражения в 80% и выше на дисплее высвечивается следующее предупреждение:

<blockquote>
ЗАФИКСИРОВАН СИЛЬНЫЙ ЖАР!
<br>ТЕМПЕРАТУРА: '''x'''°F<ref group="note" name="fever" />
</blockquote>

Как только сотрудник достигает заражения в 35%, он расцветёт после смерти в большинстве случаев - единственные случаи, в которых этого не просисходит, это смерти от [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепых псов]], [[Barber/ru|Барберов]] и [[Giant Sapsucker|Гигантских Живичников]].

<span id="Burst_phase"></span>
=== Расцветание ===

Как только заражение достигает 100%, начинается фаза "расцветания". С этих пор сотрудника больше нельзя вылечить средством от сорняков, вместо этого он моментально расцветёт при попытке его обрызгать. 

В одиночной игре прогресс расцветания составляет 31.25% в секунду. В мультиплеере он составляет 25% в секунду, увеличиваясь в зависимости от расстояния до ближайшего сотрудника. Множитель варьируется от 0.015 при расстоянии в 30 тайлов и больше до 3 при нахождении в обнимку с другим сотрудником. Для последнего живого сотрудника используется базовая прогрессия в 18.75% в секунду.

Как только фаза расцветания достигает 90%, дальнейшая прогрессия становится привязана к фиксированному таймеру; для одиночных сотрудников и последнего живого сотрудника в мультиплеере таймер составляет 18 секунд, в иных ситуациях в мультиплеере таймер составляет 1.7 секунд. Таймер замораживается в момент, когда корабль начинает покидать поверхность, так что сотрудники не могут обратиться после того, как рычаг корабля был дёрнут на взлёт.

Если прогресс расцветания достигает 90% или выше, зрение заражённого сотрудника немедленно станет размытым и начнёт постепенно краснеть, также начнёт проигрываться постоянный агрессивный грохот. Эффект более заметен в ситуациях с таймером в 18 секунд. В мультиплеере, даже в ситуациях с последним живым сотрудником, передвижение заражённого станет затруднённым наподобие состояния критического ранения.

Для одиночных сотрудников и последнего живого сотрудника в мультиплеере по достижении расцветания в 90% на дисплее высвечивается следующее предупреждение:

<blockquote>
ЗАФИКСИРОВАН СИЛЬНЫЙ ЖАР!!!
<br>ЗАФИКСИРОВАНЫ ЧУЖЕРОДНЫЕ ТЕЛА!!!
<br>ЗАФИКСИРОВАНЫ НЕОБЫЧНЫЕ МОЗГОВЫЕ ВОЛНЫ!!!
</blockquote>

<span id="Blooming"></span>
=== Цветение ===

Как только фаза "расцветания" достигает 100%, сотрудник начинает "цвести" и заменяется [[Cadaver Bloom/ru|Цветущим Кадавром]]. Сотрудники по-близости с заражением в 85% и выше также моментально зацветут.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
Сотрудникам рекомендуется проходить через споры Наростов Кадавра только в случае крайней необходимости. Как в случае с кустами [[Vain shroud/ru|Полого Савана]], Наросты Кадавра можно убрать с помощью средства от сорняков. Тем не менее, из-за небольшой дальности, сотрудники очень часто будут находиться достаточно близко, чтобы заразиться при попытке убрать Наросты Кадавра, так что данный ход действий не рекомендуется.

При риске заражения полезным для избежания трансформации будет регулярно проверять спины друг друга на наличие жёлтых лепестков. Также полезным будет сотрудник, сидящий за терминалом корабля, так как он будет способен увидеть сигнатуры лепестков на радаре. Тем не менее, так как появление лепестков не гарантированно и на их появление уходит время, ограничиваться проверкой лишь этого симптома не стоит. Для безопасности сотрудников важным считается внимательно следить за временем, проведённым в спорах Наростов Кадавра, а также иметь при себе средство от сорняков.

Сотрудникам не стоит беспокоиться о преждевременном цветении при обрызгивании друг дурга -- из-за множителя близости к другим сотрудникам в стадии расцветания заражённый сотрудник и так расцветёт примерно через 3 секунды на дистанции обрызгивании другим сотрудником. Будет намного более полезным рискнуть цветением ради возможности излечить заражённого сотрудника.

######## Cash register/en
{{topicon Fandom|Cash_Register}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=When used
|primary-use=<q>Use cash register</q>
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
The '''Cash Register''' is a [[Scrap]] item in Lethal Company.
It is considered uncommon, appearing mostly with low chances of on most of the Moons where it spawns, despite there being seven.
It is a high tier item in terms of Value, along with [[Gold bar]]s or [[Zed Dog]]s and is the heaviest item in the game.
It has an interaction where an Employee holding it can pull its lever which will make the drawer open briefly
and emit a typical "Ka-ching" sound which can alert Entities such as [[Eyeless Dog]]s.

When dropped on the ground, it emits a loud metal bang similar to [[Large axle]]s or [[V-type engine]]s which can also alert Entities.
Passively, when carried around by an Employee, the Cash Register will emit faint clicketing metal part sounds,
perhaps to remind of the gears and machinery inside it.
As it is a conductive item, it can trigger lightning strikes when held by an Employee or set on the ground during [[Stormy|stormy weather]].

The circuit bee, also known as red bee, is a eusocial flying insect of the genus Apis, a descendent of the honey bee. They also produce friction by rubbing their two pairs of wings against each other and by rubbing against one another while in the hive. What allows them to create such a surplus of electric field compared to the honey bee is still under research, as they generate a stronger electric field when panicked or angered. This ability is especially useful for them around water.

This destructive BEEhavior will last until they have located the hive or completely exhausted themselves, which can take hours to days. They have BEEn known to leave BEEhind fields of bodies of small rodents, insects and even some larger mammals, and in rare cases they can start fires. == Mechanics == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
Circuit Bees will remain within their hive, while emitting a quiet buzzing noise until an employee enters 10 units of its hive. The swarm will then take off and pursue the intruder until they have either killed them or if the trespasser has left the hive's range. They deal [[damage]] quickly and can kill an employee in about 3-4 seconds of uninterrupted attacks.

<!--T:11-->

They can be very dangerous when wandering around a moon, as they have an increased movement speed and aggro range.

== Strategy == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Circuit Bees will not be a major problem for employees not intending to collect their hives, and being vigilant about walking into the radius of a beehive is the most strategy that will be necessary to avoid death. However, taking a Circuit Bees' hive is almost always worth it if you have time, as it is usually very high value. For more details on hive collection, consult the [[Bee_Hive#Strategy|Bee Hive Strategy]] section.

'''Circuit Bees''', also known as '''Red Bees''', are hostile outdoor [[entities]]. In order to protect their [[Bee Hive|hive]], they attack employees that approach them or their hive by conducting electricity, and become enraged if the hive is stolen or they are otherwise unable to return to it. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[March]].

Circuit Bees are red-colored bees with two thin pairs of legs and two pairs of light brown wings.

Sigurd's danger level: 90%


Scientific name: Crabro-coruscus

The circuit bee, also known as red bee, is a eusocial flying insect of the genus Apis, a descendent of the honey bee. Their appearance is quite recognizable from their hairy, red bodies and two sets of wings. Like their ancestors, they are well-known for their intelligent social BEEhavior, large colony size, building wax nests which they use to store honey, and their important role in pollination. What allows them to create such a surplus of electric field compared to the honey bee is still under research, as they generate a stronger electric field when panicked or angered. This ability is especially useful for them around water.




It's BEEst to keep your distance. If a red bee hive is stolen, red bee swarms will enter an onslaught in which they attack any living creature. This destructive BEEhavior will last until they have located the hive or completely exhausted themselves, which can take hours to days. They have BEEn known to leave BEEhind fields of bodies of small rodents, insects and even some larger mammals, and in rare cases they can start fires. == Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Mechanics ==

Circuit Bees will remain within their hive, while emitting a quiet buzzing noise until an employee enters 10 units of its hive. The swarm will then take off and pursue the intruder until they have either killed them or if the trespasser has left the hive's range. They deal [[damage]] quickly and can kill an employee in about 3-4 seconds of uninterrupted attacks.

If Circuit Bees cannot navigate to their hive, either because an employee took it inside, into the closed ship, or they cannot navigate to the hive, then they will wander around attacking any employee in sight. They can be very dangerous when wandering around a moon, as they have an increased movement speed and aggro range.

== Strategy ==

Circuit Bees will not be a major problem for employees not intending to collect their hives, and being vigilant about walking into the radius of a beehive is the most strategy that will be necessary to avoid death. However, taking a Circuit Bees' hive is almost always worth it if you have time, as it is usually very high value. For more details on hive collection, consult the [[Bee_Hive#Strategy|Bee Hive Strategy]] section.

== Запись в Бестиарии ==
</div>
{{Terminal|text=Circuit Bees
<!-- PLEASE DO NOT FIX THE BEE RELATED PUNS HERE, IT IS DIRECTLY COPIED FROM THE GAME'S TEXT -->


Уровень опасности Сигурда: 90%


Научное Название: Crabro-coruscus

Пчелиный рой, также известный, как красные пчёлы - эусоциальные летающие насекомые генома Apis, потомки медовой пчелы. Их вид вполне узнаваем из-за их ворсистых, красных тел и двух пар крыльев. Как и их предки, они хорошо известны своими умным социальным поведением, большим размером колоний, созданием восковых гнёзд, которые они используют для хранения мёда, и их важной роли в опылении. В отличие от медовых пчёл, которые предпочитают высокие места вроде деревьев для постройки ульев, красные пчёлы создают их улью прямо на земле.


Красные пчёлы очень оборонительные. Они покидают своё гнездо, чтобы атаковать любое существо, что приблизится к ним на несколько метров., оставляя за собой только королеву и пчёл-трутней. Это дерзкое поведение они могут себе позволить из-за своей отличительной способности - создание электростатического заряда. Красные пчёлы создают трение в воздухе, а также потираясь своими двумя парами крылышек друг о друга и потираясь между собой своими тельцами. Что позволяет им создавать такой избыток электрического поля по сравнению с медовой пчелой - вопрос открытый, так как они генерируют намного более сильное электрическое поле когда паникуют или разозлены. Эта способность особенно полезна вблизи водоёмов.




Лучше будет не приближаться к ним. Если улей был украден, красные пчёлы войдут в кураж в котором они будут атаковать любое живое существо. Их разрушительное поведение будет продолжаться до тех пор, пока они не найдут гнездо или не истощат себя, что может занять от пары часов до нескольких дней. Известны случаи, когда они оставляли после себя целые поля мёртвых тел грызунов, насекомых и даже некоторых крупных млекопитающих, а в редких случаях они могут начать пожары. Их сильная польза и вред их экосистема горячо обсуждаются.}}
</div>
</blockquote>

После этого рой взлетит и станет преследовать вторженца до тех пор, пока они либо не убили его, либо пока нарушитель не покинет территорию их улья. == 生物图鉴条目 ==
</div>
{{Terminal|text=Circuit Bees
<!-- PLEASE DO NOT FIX THE BEE RELATED PUNS HERE, IT IS DIRECTLY COPIED FROM THE GAME'S TEXT -->


Sigurd 危险程度评级：90%


学名：Crabro-coruscus

电路蜂群，又称红蜂，是蜜蜂（Apis）属下的一个真社会性飞行昆虫物种，祖先为蜜蜂。它们的外表独特，多毛的红色身体与两对翅膀非常显眼。与其祖先蜜蜂一样，红蜂因其聪明的社会性行为、庞大的群落面积、建造用于储存蜂蜜的蜡巢和在授粉过程中的重要作用而为人所知。与蜜蜂不同的是，红蜂会选择将蜂巢建在地上，而不是在树上等高处筑巢。


红蜂的防御性很高。一旦任何生物靠近其蜂巢数米以内，除蜂后和雄蜂外的蜜蜂就会倾巢而出并攻击该生物。这种大胆的防御行为得益于其最显著的特征——静电充能。红蜂在空气中飞行时会产生摩擦，其在巢中也会用两对翅膀互相摩擦，甚至两蜜蜂个体会互相摩擦。不过目前尚不清楚其为何能产生远高于蜜蜂的电场，尤其是在其恐慌或愤怒时，电场强度还会更高。这一能力在水边时对红蜂尤为有利。




最好离它们远点。如果红蜂的蜂巢被偷了，蜂群会进入猛攻模式，它们会攻击任何活着的生物。这种毁灭性的行为直到其重新找到蜂巢，或是体力完全耗尽（通常要数小时甚至数天）前都不会停止。已知它们能猎杀小型啮齿动物、昆虫，甚至包括某些大型哺乳动物，极少数情况下它们还能引发火灾。它们对生态系统的诸多益处和缺点引起了激烈的讨论。非常期待！！—— 不屈不挠的 Sigurd}}
</div>
</blockquote>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== 机制 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''电路蜂群'''会待在蜂巢里，发出较安静的嗡嗡声。若员工离蜂巢太近，蜂群就会飞出蜂巢并追逐闯入者，直至其死亡或远离蜂巢一定距离。蜂群能造成很高的[[Damage|伤害]]，在没有其他干扰的情况下，其 3~4 秒就可蛰死一名员工。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
无法找到蜂巢的蜂群会在周围漫游，并攻击任何出现在其视野内的东西。所以它们在[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]上游荡时会很危险。
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
绝大多数情况下，只要时间足够，搬走电路蜂群的[[Bee Hive/zh-cn|蜂巢]]总是赚的，其价值在 100 上下。不过综合上文的机制描述，建议只在即将离开星球时再搬蜂巢。
</div>

######## Clipboard
{{#ifeq:{{PAGELANGUAGE}}|en|{{DISPLAYTITLE:clipboard{{#translation:}}}}|<!--skip-->}}

{{autoinfobox item

<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The '''clipboard''' (a.k.a. '''Training manual''' a.k.a. '''Service manual''')
is a pedagogical item which generates in the [[ship]] and in the [[Company Cruiser]].
Both contain multiple pages of gameplay information, interspersed with worldbuilding. They have little use beyond that.
<br>The "Training manual" clipboard will always appear to the left of the [[brake lever]] upon creating or loading a save, even if moved, left in a [[Belt bag]], or lost.
This is the same spot as the button to activate the [[Teleporter]], making it advisable to move the clipboard before attempting to teleport someone under pressure.
It contains some pointers for new players (see [[#Trivia]] section below for caveats).
<br>A "Service manual" clipboard will always be on the low, central shelf of the Cruiser upon delivery. It will disappear if the save is reloaded.
It explains the basics of driving and hints at the alternate use for [[Weed killer]]. (Again see the [[#Trivia]] section for caveats.)

<!--T:2-->
While holding a clipboard, {{keybind|Item inspect}} toggles bringing it close to your eyes (camera) so the text is legible,
and {{keybind|Item secondary use}} and {{keybind|Item tertiary use}} flip between the pages.
The current page is "remembered"; the pages don't fall back into place on their own when not held.

<!--T:3-->
The "Training manual" clipboard contains a cover page, with no useful information, and 3 pages of content (numbered 146, 139, and 140):
* The first describes the [[Echo Scanner]].
* The second gives an overview of the [[Terminal]] and [[moon]] difficulty.
* The last explains how to fulfill your job and meet [[quota]], and ends with some miscellaneous tips.

<!--T:4-->
The "Service manual" clipboard contains the same cover page, with no useful information, and 3 pages of content (numbered 146, 391, and 391 again):
* The first warns against trying to accelerate while in park but is mostly satirical safety guidelines.
* The second explains most of the dashboard controls and the gearstick.
* The last explains how to monitor and refill the Cruiser's health and how to use the magnet, and reminds you about the warranty without explaining it.

<!--T:5-->
Both clipboards are worth zero credits when sold to [[the Company]].
While the "Training manual" adds {{credits|5}} to the ledger, this doesn't count towards the total.<ref>As demonstrated in [[:File:Item names in ledger v62 part1.jpg]].</ref>

== Trivia == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
The "Training manual" contains several details about game mechanics which don't align with how the game actually functions,
making it even less useful for new players (though poor documentation is arguably lore-accurate).
As of v81:
* <q>[...] ping the scanner while looking towards objects of interest</q>&mdash;<!--
-->This doesn't always work, sometimes missing things directly in front of you and other times catching things in your periphery, but those are likely just bugs.
* <q>Green: A place or object of interest; Yellow: An object which can be returned to the Company as valuable scrap; Red: Biological matter, such as wildlife.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->Scrap is marked in ''green'', [[entities]] ''and [[traps]]'' in red, and misc. points of interest in ''blue''. (Also, this is a black-and-white photocopy.)
* <q>'''TIP:''' In general, safer and closer moons are cheap or even free, and the risk analysis team recommends sticking to these safer areas for the entire duration of your contract.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->Opinions differ over how exactly the moons compare on difficulty, but it's hard to dispute that going to the later moons such as [[Titan]] and [[Artifice]] is necessary for "high-quota" play.<ref group="note">And assuming the contract duration is about 3 months, as can be inferred from the [[Sigurd Logs]] (though the player is hired [[Lore/Timeline|centuries later]]), the game's current rules preclude any employees from completing it.</ref>
* <q>You can purchase items in bulk (under 30 lb.)</q>&mdash;<!--
-->The [[Dropship]] has no weight limit; rather, it's limited to 12 items per trip.
<!-- TODO does loitering anger the Company, or is that line included to save players from ''talking'' near it? [[The_Company]] doesn't mention loitering/proximity -->
* <q>The Survival Kit is a recommended package of essentials for beginners.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->The {{credits|138}} pricetag of the [[survival kit]] means it can't be purchased with the starting allowance of {{credits|60}}.
* <q>The conversion rate of scrap to Credits will fluctuate over the course of several days [...]</q>&mdash;<!--
-->Technically correct, but the rate is consistently low on the first day and increases linearly to 100% on the final day; there is no random aspect to [[the Company]]'s rates at present.
** The logs "[[Sigurd_Logs#Swing_of_things_-_Aug_27|Swing of things]]" and "[[Sigurd_Logs#Sound_behind_the_wall_-_Sep_4|Sound behind the wall]]"<!--
--> respectively mention rates of 70% and 120%, with the latter specifically saying that it was unusually high and that <q>[Desmond has] been watching it like the stupid stocks.</q>

<!--T:8-->
The "Service manual" contains a couple details about the [[Company Cruiser]] which don't align with how it actually functions.
As of v81:
* <q>Did you know: Studies show that proper sitting posture while driving the Company Cruiser is correlated with higher efficiency [...]</q>&mdash;<!--
-->This is questionably true in-universe, but since you as the player have no control over your employee avatar's posture,<!--
--> it's impossible to know how much it affects efficiency in terms of gameplay. In any case, it seems that employees all diligently follow the manual's guidance.
* <q>Did you know: the Company Cruiser may even be able to hear you speak! Remember to give it kind words of affection at the beginning of each day.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->The Cruiser doesn't seem to have any sound-based mechanic besides the engine being audible. And if it did, it probably wouldn't distinguish words of encouragement from any other noise.
* <q>This page has all the info you'll ever need to operate your Cruiser.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->It does not.
* <q>[...] in order to heal completely, the truck must be taken into orbit with you.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->As the red scrawlings on this page allude to, you can also restore engine "health" with [[Weed killer]].
* <q>If your Cruiser is damaged or lost, we will replace your next Cruiser!</q>&mdash;<!--
-->See [[Company Cruiser#Warranty]].

<!--T:9-->
Flipping between pages is [[Audible_sounds|audible to entities]].
<!-- That article specifically says "left click", but {{keybind|Item primary use}} doesn't turn the page... -->

<!--T:18-->
It is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].

<!--T:10-->
The [[scanner]] nodes for both clipboards read <q>Training manual</q> and have a subtitle of <q>Useful info!</q>

<!--T:11-->
Both clipboards share the same cover page, but the copy in the "Training manual" has the table blurred out.

The '''clipboard''' (a.k.a. '''Training manual''' a.k.a. '''Service manual''')
is a pedagogical item which generates in the [[ship]] and in the [[Company Cruiser]].
Both contain multiple pages of gameplay information, interspersed with worldbuilding. They have little use beyond that.
<br>The "Training manual" clipboard will always appear to the left of the [[brake lever]] upon creating or loading a save, even if moved, left in a [[Belt bag]], or lost.
This is the same spot as the button to activate the [[Teleporter]], making it advisable to move the clipboard before attempting to teleport someone under pressure.
It contains some pointers for new players (see [[#Trivia]] section below for caveats).
<br>A "Service manual" clipboard will always be on the low, central shelf of the Cruiser upon delivery. It will disappear if the save is reloaded.
It explains the basics of driving and hints at the alternate use for [[Weed killer]]. (Again see the [[#Trivia]] section for caveats.)
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While holding a clipboard, {{keybind|Item inspect}} toggles bringing it close to your eyes (camera) so the text is legible,
and {{keybind|Item secondary use}} and {{keybind|Item tertiary use}} flip between the pages.
The current page is "remembered"; the pages don't fall back into place on their own when not held.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The "Training manual" clipboard contains a cover page, with no useful information, and 3 pages of content (numbered 146, 139, and 140):
* The first describes the [[Echo Scanner]].
* The second gives an overview of the [[Terminal]] and [[moon]] difficulty.
* The last explains how to fulfill your job and meet [[quota]], and ends with some miscellaneous tips.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The "Service manual" clipboard contains the same cover page, with no useful information, and 3 pages of content (numbered 146, 391, and 391 again):
* The first warns against trying to accelerate while in park but is mostly satirical safety guidelines.
* The second explains most of the dashboard controls and the gearstick.
* The last explains how to monitor and refill the Cruiser's health and how to use the magnet, and reminds you about the warranty without explaining it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Both clipboards are worth zero credits when sold to [[the Company]].
While the "Training manual" adds {{credits|5}} to the ledger, this doesn't count towards the total.<ref>As demonstrated in [[:File:Item names in ledger v62 part1.jpg]].</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Trivia ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The "Training manual" contains several details about game mechanics which don't align with how the game actually functions,
making it even less useful for new players (though poor documentation is arguably lore-accurate).
As of v81:
* <q>[...] ping the scanner while looking towards objects of interest</q>&mdash;<!--
-->This doesn't always work, sometimes missing things directly in front of you and other times catching things in your periphery, but those are likely just bugs.
* <q>Green: A place or object of interest; Yellow: An object which can be returned to the Company as valuable scrap; Red: Biological matter, such as wildlife.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->Scrap is marked in ''green'', [[entities]] ''and [[traps]]'' in red, and misc. points of interest in ''blue''. (Also, this is a black-and-white photocopy.)
* <q>'''TIP:''' In general, safer and closer moons are cheap or even free, and the risk analysis team recommends sticking to these safer areas for the entire duration of your contract.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->Opinions differ over how exactly the moons compare on difficulty, but it's hard to dispute that going to the later moons such as [[Titan]] and [[Artifice]] is necessary for "high-quota" play.<ref group="note">And assuming the contract duration is about 3 months, as can be inferred from the [[Sigurd Logs]] (though the player is hired [[Lore/Timeline|centuries later]]), the game's current rules preclude any employees from completing it.</ref>
* <q>You can purchase items in bulk (under 30 lb.)</q>&mdash;<!--
-->The [[Dropship]] has no weight limit; rather, it's limited to 12 items per trip.
<!-- TODO does loitering anger the Company, or is that line included to save players from ''talking'' near it? [[The_Company]] doesn't mention loitering/proximity -->
* <q>The Survival Kit is a recommended package of essentials for beginners.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->The {{credits|138}} pricetag of the [[survival kit]] means it can't be purchased with the starting allowance of {{credits|60}}.
* <q>The conversion rate of scrap to Credits will fluctuate over the course of several days [...]</q>&mdash;<!--
-->Technically correct, but the rate is consistently low on the first day and increases linearly to 100% on the final day; there is no random aspect to [[the Company]]'s rates at present.
** The logs "[[Sigurd_Logs#Swing_of_things_-_Aug_27|Swing of things]]" and "[[Sigurd_Logs#Sound_behind_the_wall_-_Sep_4|Sound behind the wall]]"<!--
--> respectively mention rates of 70% and 120%, with the latter specifically saying that it was unusually high and that <q>[Desmond has] been watching it like the stupid stocks.</q>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The "Service manual" contains a couple details about the [[Company Cruiser]] which don't align with how it actually functions.
As of v81:
* <q>Did you know: Studies show that proper sitting posture while driving the Company Cruiser is correlated with higher efficiency [...]</q>&mdash;<!--
-->This is questionably true in-universe, but since you as the player have no control over your employee avatar's posture,<!--
--> it's impossible to know how much it affects efficiency in terms of gameplay. In any case, it seems that employees all diligently follow the manual's guidance.
* <q>Did you know: the Company Cruiser may even be able to hear you speak! Remember to give it kind words of affection at the beginning of each day.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->The Cruiser doesn't seem to have any sound-based mechanic besides the engine being audible. And if it did, it probably wouldn't distinguish words of encouragement from any other noise.
* <q>This page has all the info you'll ever need to operate your Cruiser.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->It does not.
* <q>[...] in order to heal completely, the truck must be taken into orbit with you.</q>&mdash;<!--
-->As the red scrawlings on this page allude to, you can also restore engine "health" with [[Weed killer]].
* <q>If your Cruiser is damaged or lost, we will replace your next Cruiser!</q>&mdash;<!--
-->See [[Company Cruiser#Warranty]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Flipping between pages is [[Audible_sounds|audible to entities]].
<!-- That article specifically says "left click", but {{keybind|Item primary use}} doesn't turn the page... -->
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The [[scanner]] nodes for both clipboards read <q>Training manual</q> and have a subtitle of <q>Useful info!</q>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Both clipboards share the same cover page, but the copy in the "Training manual" has the table blurred out.
<!-- not sure about this next bit; maybe the ship really is petrol-powered and has unseen computers that use VHS tapes as secondary memory?
And it's been that way since v30,{{cite YouTube|video-id=q0bA-vClBFY|title=v30??? Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=3:54}}
possibly implying that a truck was planned for a long time before being implemented
(given that the table mentions <q>gasoline</q> and a <q>VHS Cassette tape</q>, which don't seem to fit the [[ship]]).
-->
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Each of the pages has its texture, reversed, on the back, giving the impression of razor-thin paper where the ink has bled through.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In-universe, the pages must have been photocopied from multiple source manuals,
as the pages numbered 146 and 139 in the "Training manual" have two different sections each numbered 19,
and the "Service manual" has two pages numbered 391, again each with a section 19.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This item's name is uniquely spelled in all-lowercase.
</div>

}}
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
{{about|the scrap item|the time-of-day indicator|HUD#Clock}}

<!--T:2-->
An old-looking clock with knobs on the back.
Makes a ticking sound.

<!--T:3-->
It's set to midnight when generating on a moon, then ticks up each second it's "alive", including in orbit.
Quitting and reloading the save sets all Clocks back to midnight again.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:4-->
The face is missing the numerals II and V.
It otherwise appears normal, with the alternative representation of IIII as is common on clock faces.

<!--T:5-->
Unconventionally, the minute hand<!-- and hour hand presumably --> ticks over rather than moving continuously.
</translate>

######## Clock/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Scraps/AutoInfobox|infobox
| scrap = Clock
}}
{{about|the scrap item|the time-of-day indicator|HUD#Clock}}

An old-looking clock with knobs on the back.
Makes a ticking sound.

It's set to midnight when generating on a moon, then ticks up each second it's "alive", including in orbit.
Quitting and reloading the save sets all Clocks back to midnight again.
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
The face is missing the numerals II and V.
It otherwise appears normal, with the alternative representation of IIII as is common on clock faces.

Unconventionally, the minute hand<!-- and hour hand presumably --> ticks over rather than moving continuously.

######## Coil-Head
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}
{{Infobox entity
| name = <translate><!--T:27--> Coil-Head</translate>
| sciname = Vir colligerus
| danger = 80%
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 2

<translate>
<!--T:8-->
The '''Coil-Head''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It remains stationary when it is within an employee's line of sight, but chases and attacks nearby employees extremely quickly while not being observed. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Offense]].

<!--T:34-->
Coil-Heads are tall, mannequin-like entities, with mostly featureless beige skin, save for the numerous screws embedded around their bodies with several small, dried wounds. They have missing arms and a large spring in place of their neck, topped with a head with featureless, hollow eye sockets and a gaping mouth.

== Bestiary entry == <!--T:18-->
</translate>
{{quote bestiary|CoilHeads}}
<translate>

== Spawn chances == <!--T:30-->
</translate>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<translate>
== Mechanics == <!--T:19-->

=== Patrolling === <!--T:20-->

<!--T:3-->
Once a Coil-head first enters the map, it starts patrolling an area. During this patrol, it moves on a set route back and forth at a slower speed than when chasing an employee. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>

<!--T:10-->
While the Coil-head is patrolling, it constantly scans for employees, only attacking if an employee meets the following conditions: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* Employee and the Coil-head have an unobstructed view of one another
* AND either:
** The employee is looking at the Coil-head, meaning they are less than 60 units away from one another and the Coil-head is visible within a 68° horizontal FOV (default camera FOV is 66°)
** OR Coil-head is less than 30 units away and has a traversable path to the employee's position

<!--T:21-->
Once successfully passed, the Coil-head progresses into its attacking phase.

<!--T:22-->
=== Attacking ===
Once elevated to this phase, its movement speed ramps up significantly, increasing from 6 to 14.5 <ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. In this state, the Coil-head will '''always''' target the closest employee '''that has a reachable path''', regardless of line of sight, distance or its previous target, <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref> and will accelerate towards them unless observed by at least one employee or stunned (see [[#Observation]]).<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>

<!--T:35-->
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units

<!--T:11-->
==== Dealing Damage ====
When a Coil-head is unobserved, in physical contact with an employee, and not stunned, it does 90 [[damage]] every 0.2 seconds to the employee<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Since observation of a Coil-head requires that the employee be at least 0.3 units away, this means two things:
* Once a Coil-head hits an employee once, it is nearly impossible to survive.
* If an employee is within physical contact of an otherwise unobserved Coil-head, it will attack them regardless of that employee's visibility of it.

<!--T:31-->
==== Recharging ====
While in its attacking phase, if a Coil-head has cumulatively spent more than 9 seconds '''actively''' moving toward any employee, it will enter a recharging/cooldown phase for 11 seconds. During this time, its neck will be retracted and the Coil-head will be unable to move or deal damage, regardless of whether it is being observed or not.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>

<!--T:6-->
==== Observation ====
There are two circumstances where the Coil-head will be unable to move in its attacking phase:<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
* Coil-head is stunned
* OR an employee is observing the Coil-head, that is:
** The employee and the Coil-head have an unobstructed view of one another
** The employee is looking at the Coil-head, meaning they are less than 60 units away from one another and the Coil-head is visible within a 68° FOV (default camera FOV is 66°)
** The employee is at least 0.3 units away from the Coil-head

<!--T:23-->
== Strategy ==
A group can have a single employee watch Coil-heads while others loot. This employee would have to be especially cautious of other enemies, as the employee would be severely inhibited by the Coil-heads' presence.

<!--T:13-->
Considering that an attacking Coil-head will always head for the nearest employee, it would be imperative to warn other employees of its presence.

<!--T:14-->
A [[Stun grenade]]/[[Zap gun]]/[[Radar-booster]] can be used to disable Coil-Heads for several seconds, allowing for an escape.

<!--T:15-->
It takes a Coil-head a ludicrous amount of time (almost 17 seconds) to open an unlocked door. Employees can use this to their advantage in order to make an escape. Be wary, as Coil-heads can open doors even while they are being observed.

<!--T:36-->
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.

<!--T:37-->
Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.

<!--T:24-->
Coil-heads are incredibly dangerous when paired with other entities, especially [[Bracken|Brackens]] and [[Snare Flea|Snare Fleas]], due to the Coil-head’s and Bracken’s conflicting requirements of whether to be looked at or not, and the risk of accidentally stepping into a Snare Flea’s trap while staring at the Coil-head. If encountered together, the best strategy is to go around a corner or obstacle to break line of sight with both the Coil-head and Bracken, but remain looking in the Coil-head’s direction so that it immediately enters your line of sight again when it turns the corner, simultaneously freezing it and scaring the Bracken off, or luring the Coil-Head to a location that you know has no Snare Fleas. (Keep in mind that one may have spawned while you were gone and latched to the ceiling.).

<!--T:32-->
== V.50 Beginning cutscene ==
During the cutscene, we see what appears to be an office in a factory that makes Coil-heads. Through the window, we can see one. But when the alarm goes off, we see it fall over, and in the background, we hear other Coil-heads killing and terrorizing employees and others as they chase them in the dark.

== History == <!--T:43-->

<!--T:44-->
=== [[Version 35]] === 
* Introduced.

<!--T:45-->
=== [[Version 47]] ===
* The audible range of Coil-head’s footsteps has been slightly increased.

<!--T:46-->
=== [[Version 60]] ===
* Coil-head now enters a recharge phase after chasing employees for a certain distance.
* Coil-head can now lose track of an employee when they are out of range and line-of-sight for a long enough time.
* Coil-head now cannot complete a jump as easily if they are spotted by an employee while jumping.

<!--T:47-->
=== Version 61 ===
* Coil-head now will not move when looked at under any circumstances, including when they cannot reach the employee looking at them.

<!--T:48-->
=== Version 62 ===
* Slightly decreased the time a Coil-head needs to spend moving before recharging
* Decreased the time a Coil-head spends recharging
* Coil-head’s timer before it needs to recharge now counts down 80% slower when it is pushing a door or otherwise stuck than when it is actually moving, regardless of wether it is being looked at or not.
* Coil-head now eventually enters recharge mode if it is inside the [[Mineshaft]] elevator.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Übersicht ==
Spiralköpfe sind große humanoide Schaufensterpuppen, denen man in den [[Interiors|Innenräumen]] begegnen kann. Sie können sich weder bewegen, noch angreifen, solange ein Mitarbeiter sie ansieht. Spiralköpfe sind extrem gefährlich und können Mitarbeiter in unter einer Sekunde töten.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Coil-Heads are tall, mannequin-like entities, with mostly featureless beige skin, save for the numerous screws embedded around their bodies with several small, dried wounds. They have missing arms and a large spring in place of their neck, topped with a head with featureless, hollow eye sockets and a gaping mouth.
</div>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Spielmechaniken ==

<span id="Patrolling"></span>
=== Patrouillierend ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Sobald ein Spiralkopf die Karte betritt, beginnt er ein Gebiet zu patrouillieren. Während dieser Patrouillie läuft er eine gesetzte Strecke auf und ab. Dabei ist er langsamer als wenn er einen Spieler verfolgt. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Während der Spiralkopf patrouilliert sucht er dauerhaft nach Mitarbeitern. Er greift an sobald die folgenden Bedingungen erfüllt sind: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
 Mitarbeiter ist weniger als 30 Einheiten entfernt
 UND
 Spiralkopf oder Mitarbeiter hat Sichtkontakt
</div>

Sobald sie erfüllt sind, geht der Spiralkopf in einen Angriffsstatus über.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Angreifend ===
Sobald er in dieser Phase ist, wird die Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit des Spiralkopfs stark steigen. Von '''6''' auf '''14.5''' <ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. In diesem Modus wählt der Spiralkopf den nächsten Spieler als Ziel<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref> und bewegt sich dabei auf diesen zu, solange der Spiralkopf nicht beobachtet wird<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ist ein Spiralkopf unbeobachtet, in physischem Kontakt mit einem Mitarbeiter und nicht betäubt, verursacht er 90 Schaden alle 0,2 Sekunden am Mitarbeiter<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Soabld das Ziel tot ist, wechselt der Spiralkopf auf den nächsten Mitarbeiter, egal wo dieser sich auf der Karte befindet. Erst wenn alle Mitarbeiter das Gebäude verlassen oder anderweitig unerreichbar für den Spiralkopf sind, geht dieser wieder in den patrouillierenden Modus über.<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Recharging ====
While in its attacking phase, if a Coil-head has cumulatively spent more than 9 seconds '''actively''' moving toward any employee, it will enter a recharging/cooldown phase for 11 seconds. During this time, its neck will be retracted and the Coil-head will be unable to move or deal damage, regardless of whether it is being observed or not.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Beobachtet ===
Spiralköpfe haben eine interne Liste an Bedingungen, die sie während jedem Frame überprüfen, ob sie sich bewgen können oder nicht. Sie können sich '''nicht''' bewegen, wenn eine der folgenden Bedingnungen eintritt: <ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
 Spiralkopf ist betäubt
 ODER
 Mitarbeiter sieht den Spiralkopf innerhalb 68° der Mitte des Bildschirms
 UND 
 Spiralkopf ist innerhalb 60 Einheiten Distanz
 UND
 Mitarbeiter ist mindestens 0.3 Einheiten von den Augen des Spiralkopfs entfernt
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategie ==
Eine Gruppe kann einen einzigen Mitarbeiter abstellen, um Spiralköpfe anzustarren, während die anderen Schrott bergen. Dieser Mitarbeiter muss sich vor anderen Gegnern in Acht nehmen, da die Präsenz des Spiralkopfs ihn besonders einschränkt.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Da ein Spiralkopf sich immer für den nächsten Mitarbeiter entscheidet, ist es besonders wichtig andere vor Spiralköpfen zu warnen.
</div>

[[Stun Grenade|Betäubungsgranate]]/[[Zap Gun|Betäubungspistole]]/[[Radar Booster]] können benutzt werden, um Spiralköpfe für mehrere Sekunden auszuschalten, was eine Flucht ermöglichen kann.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Spiralköpfe brauchen besonders lange unverschlossene Türen zu öffen, was die Mitarbeiter zu ihrem Vorteil nutzen können. Sie öffnen Türen jedoch in der gleichen Geschwindigkeit, egal ob sie angestarrt werden oder nicht.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. <div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

== Μηχανική ==

<span id="Patrolling"></span>
=== Περιπολία ===

Μόλις ένα Coil-head εισέλθει για πρώτη φορά στον χάρτη, θα αρχίσει να περιπολεί μια περιοχή. Κατά τη διάρκεια αυτής της περιπολίας θα κινείται μια καθορισμένη διαδρομή μπρος-πίσω με μικρότερη ταχύτητα από ό,τι όταν κυνηγά έναν υπάλληλο. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ενώ το Coil-head περιπολεί, θα αναζητά συνεχώς υπαλλήλους, επιτίθεται σε έναν υπάλληλο μόνο εάν πληρούται η ακόλουθη προϋπόθεση: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
 Ο υπάλληλος είναι σε 30 μονάδες
 ΚΑΙ
 Η κεφαλή του πηνίου ή ο υπάλληλος έχει ανεμπόδιστη θέα του άλλου
</div>

Μόλις περάσει επιτυχώς, η κεφαλή του πηνίου θα μετακινηθεί σε στάση επίθεσης.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Επίθεση ===
Μόλις σε αυτή τη φάση, η ταχύτητα κίνησης θα αυξηθεί σημαντικά, αυξάνοντας από '''6''' σε '''14,5'' <ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. Σε αυτήν την κατάσταση, η κεφαλή πηνίου θα στοχεύει τον πλησιέστερο εργαζόμενο<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Όταν μια κεφαλή πηνίου δεν ανιχνεύεται, βρίσκεται σε φυσική επαφή με έναν υπάλληλο και δεν μένει έκπληκτη, θα προκαλεί 90 [[ζημιά]] κάθε 0,2 δευτερόλεπτα στον υπάλληλο<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https: //pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Μετά το θάνατο του στοχευόμενου υπαλλήλου του, το Coil-head θα αλλάξει στόχους στον επόμενο πλησιέστερο υπάλληλο που μπορεί να φτάσει, ανεξάρτητα από το πού μπορεί να βρίσκονται στον χάρτη. Μόνο αφού όλοι οι εργαζόμενοι έχουν εγκαταλείψει το κτίριο ή με άλλον τρόπο δεν είναι προσβάσιμος στο Coil-head, το Coil-head θα επιστρέψει στη λειτουργία περιπολίας.<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Recharging ====
While in its attacking phase, if a Coil-head has cumulatively spent more than 9 seconds '''actively''' moving toward any employee, it will enter a recharging/cooldown phase for 11 seconds. During this time, its neck will be retracted and the Coil-head will be unable to move or deal damage, regardless of whether it is being observed or not.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Παρατήρηση ===
Μια κεφαλή πηνίου θα ελέγξει μια συγκεκριμένη λίστα συνθηκών κάθε πλαίσιο για να καθορίσει εάν μπορεί να κινηθεί ή όχι. Μια κεφαλή πηνίου δεν μπορεί να μετακινηθεί εάν επιλυθεί επιτυχώς η ακόλουθη συνθήκη: <ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
 Η κεφαλή του πηνίου ξαφνιάζεται
 Ο
 Ο εργαζόμενος βλέπει την κεφαλή του πηνίου σε απόσταση 68° από το κέντρο της οθόνης του
 ΚΑΙ
 Η κεφαλή πενίου βρίσκεται σε απόσταση 60 μονάδων
 ΚΑΙ
 Ο υπάλληλος απέχει τουλάχιστον 0,3 μονάδες από τα μάτια της κεφαλής πενίου
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Στρατηγική ==
Μια ομάδα μπορεί να έχει έναν μόνο υπάλληλο να παρακολουθεί τα Κεφαλή-πηνίου ενώ άλλοι να λεηλατούν. Αυτός ο υπάλληλος θα έπρεπε να προσέχει άλλους εχθρούς, καθώς ο υπάλληλος θα παρεμποδιζόταν σοβαρά από την παρουσία των σπειροειδών κεφαλών.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Λαμβάνοντας υπόψη ότι μια επιτιθέμενη κεφαλή πηνίου θα κατευθύνεται πάντα προς τον επόμενο υπάλληλο, θα ήταν επιτακτική ανάγκη να προειδοποιήσετε τους άλλους υπαλλήλους για την παρουσία της.
</div>

Μια [[Stun Grenade|χειροβομβίδα αναισθητοποίησης]]/[[Zap Gun|όπλο ζαπ]]/[[Radar Booster|ενισχυτή ραντάρ]] μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί για να απενεργοποιήσετε τις κεφαλές του πηνίου για αρκετά δευτερόλεπτα, επιτρέποντας τη διαφυγή.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Χρειάζεται γελοίος χρόνος για να ανοίξει μια ξεκλείδωτη πόρτα. Χρησιμοποιήστε αυτό προς όφελός σας για να κάνετε μια απόδραση. Σημειώστε ότι οι κεφαλές του πηνίου θα ανοίγουν τις πόρτες με την ίδια ταχύτητα όταν παρατηρούνται ή δεν παρατηρούνται.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Τα σπειροειδή κεφάλια είναι εξαιρετικά επικίνδυνα όταν βρίσκονται κοντά σε άλλα πλάσματα, ιδίως [[Bracken|'''γλαυκίδες''''']], λόγω των αντικρουόμενων απαιτήσεών τους σχετικά με το αν πρέπει ή όχι να τα κοιτάξουν. Αν τα συναντήσετε μαζί, η καλύτερη στρατηγική είναι να πάτε γύρω από μια γωνία ή ένα εμπόδιο για να διακόψετε την οπτική επαφή με το σπειροειδές κεφάλι και το αγκαθωτό πλάσμα, αλλά να παραμείνετε κοιτάζοντας το σπειροειδές κεφάλι για να διακόψετε την οπτική επαφή και στη συνέχεια να τρέξετε πίσω στο οπτικό πεδίο, παγώνοντας τον εαυτό σας και τρομάζοντας την αγκαθωτή.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== V.50 Beginning cutscene ==
During the cutscene, we see what appears to be an office in a factory that makes Coil-heads. Through the window, we can see one. But when the alarm goes off, we see it fall over, and in the background, we hear other Coil-heads killing and terrorizing employees and others as they chase them in the dark.
</div>

######## Coil-Head/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}
{{Infobox entity
| name = Coil-Head
| sciname = Vir colligerus
| danger = 80%
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 2
| max_count = 5
| door_speed_multiplier = 0.06
| see_through_fog = No
| pip_size = Medium
| attack_damage = 90
| attack_speed = 200ms
| dps = 450
| contact_damage = 90%
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|SpringMan}}
| stun_multiplier = 3.25
| id = <!--springman-->SpringMan
| cause_of_death = Strangulation
}}
The '''Coil-Head''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It remains stationary when it is within an employee's line of sight, but chases and attacks nearby employees extremely quickly while not being observed. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Offense]].

Coil-Heads are tall, mannequin-like entities, with mostly featureless beige skin, save for the numerous screws embedded around their bodies with several small, dried wounds. They have missing arms and a large spring in place of their neck, topped with a head with featureless, hollow eye sockets and a gaping mouth.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary|CoilHeads}}

== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Mechanics ==

=== Patrolling ===

Once a Coil-head first enters the map, it starts patrolling an area. During this patrol, it moves on a set route back and forth at a slower speed than when chasing an employee. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>

While the Coil-head is patrolling, it constantly scans for employees, only attacking if an employee meets the following conditions: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* Employee and the Coil-head have an unobstructed view of one another
* AND either:
** The employee is looking at the Coil-head, meaning they are less than 60 units away from one another and the Coil-head is visible within a 68° horizontal FOV (default camera FOV is 66°)
** OR Coil-head is less than 30 units away and has a traversable path to the employee's position

Once successfully passed, the Coil-head progresses into its attacking phase.

=== Attacking ===
Once elevated to this phase, its movement speed ramps up significantly, increasing from 6 to 14.5 <ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. In this state, the Coil-head will '''always''' target the closest employee '''that has a reachable path''', regardless of line of sight, distance or its previous target, <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref> and will accelerate towards them unless observed by at least one employee or stunned (see [[#Observation]]).<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>

==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units

==== Dealing Damage ====
When a Coil-head is unobserved, in physical contact with an employee, and not stunned, it does 90 [[damage]] every 0.2 seconds to the employee<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Since observation of a Coil-head requires that the employee be at least 0.3 units away, this means two things:
* Once a Coil-head hits an employee once, it is nearly impossible to survive.
* If an employee is within physical contact of an otherwise unobserved Coil-head, it will attack them regardless of that employee's visibility of it.

==== Recharging ====
While in its attacking phase, if a Coil-head has cumulatively spent more than 9 seconds '''actively''' moving toward any employee, it will enter a recharging/cooldown phase for 11 seconds. During this time, its neck will be retracted and the Coil-head will be unable to move or deal damage, regardless of whether it is being observed or not.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>

==== Observation ====
There are two circumstances where the Coil-head will be unable to move in its attacking phase:<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
* Coil-head is stunned
* OR an employee is observing the Coil-head, that is:
** The employee and the Coil-head have an unobstructed view of one another
** The employee is looking at the Coil-head, meaning they are less than 60 units away from one another and the Coil-head is visible within a 68° FOV (default camera FOV is 66°)
** The employee is at least 0.3 units away from the Coil-head

== Strategy ==
A group can have a single employee watch Coil-heads while others loot. This employee would have to be especially cautious of other enemies, as the employee would be severely inhibited by the Coil-heads' presence.

Considering that an attacking Coil-head will always head for the nearest employee, it would be imperative to warn other employees of its presence.

A [[Stun grenade]]/[[Zap gun]]/[[Radar-booster]] can be used to disable Coil-Heads for several seconds, allowing for an escape.

It takes a Coil-head a ludicrous amount of time (almost 17 seconds) to open an unlocked door. Employees can use this to their advantage in order to make an escape. Be wary, as Coil-heads can open doors even while they are being observed.

Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.

Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.

Coil-heads are incredibly dangerous when paired with other entities, especially [[Bracken|Brackens]] and [[Snare Flea|Snare Fleas]], due to the Coil-head’s and Bracken’s conflicting requirements of whether to be looked at or not, and the risk of accidentally stepping into a Snare Flea’s trap while staring at the Coil-head. If encountered together, the best strategy is to go around a corner or obstacle to break line of sight with both the Coil-head and Bracken, but remain looking in the Coil-head’s direction so that it immediately enters your line of sight again when it turns the corner, simultaneously freezing it and scaring the Bracken off, or luring the Coil-Head to a location that you know has no Snare Fleas. (Keep in mind that one may have spawned while you were gone and latched to the ceiling.).

== V.50 Beginning cutscene ==
During the cutscene, we see what appears to be an office in a factory that makes Coil-heads. Through the window, we can see one. But when the alarm goes off, we see it fall over, and in the background, we hear other Coil-heads killing and terrorizing employees and others as they chase them in the dark.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Panoramica ==
I Testa-Molla sono manichini umanoidi alti e ostili trovati negli [[Interni|interni]]. Non sono in grado di muoversi o attaccare quando vengono osservati da un impiegato. I Testa-Molla sono estremamente pericolosi e possono uccidere un giocatore in meno di un secondo.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Coil-Heads are tall, mannequin-like entities, with mostly featureless beige skin, save for the numerous screws embedded around their bodies with several small, dried wounds. They have missing arms and a large spring in place of their neck, topped with a head with featureless, hollow eye sockets and a gaping mouth.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Mechanics ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Patrolling ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Once a Coil-head first enters the map, it starts patrolling an area. During this patrol, it moves on a set route back and forth at a slower speed than when chasing an employee. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While the Coil-head is patrolling, it constantly scans for employees, only attacking if an employee meets the following conditions: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* Employee and the Coil-head have an unobstructed view of one another
* AND either:
** The employee is looking at the Coil-head, meaning they are less than 60 units away from one another and the Coil-head is visible within a 68° horizontal FOV (default camera FOV is 66°)
** OR Coil-head is less than 30 units away and has a traversable path to the employee's position
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Once successfully passed, the Coil-head progresses into its attacking phase.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Attacking ===
Once elevated to this phase, its movement speed ramps up significantly, increasing from 6 to 14.5 <ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. In this state, the Coil-head will '''always''' target the closest employee '''that has a reachable path''', regardless of line of sight, distance or its previous target, <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref> and will accelerate towards them unless observed by at least one employee or stunned (see [[#Observation]]).<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Dealing Damage ====
When a Coil-head is unobserved, in physical contact with an employee, and not stunned, it does 90 [[damage]] every 0.2 seconds to the employee<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Since observation of a Coil-head requires that the employee be at least 0.3 units away, this means two things:
* Once a Coil-head hits an employee once, it is nearly impossible to survive.
* If an employee is within physical contact of an otherwise unobserved Coil-head, it will attack them regardless of that employee's visibility of it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Recharging ====
While in its attacking phase, if a Coil-head has cumulatively spent more than 9 seconds '''actively''' moving toward any employee, it will enter a recharging/cooldown phase for 11 seconds. During this time, its neck will be retracted and the Coil-head will be unable to move or deal damage, regardless of whether it is being observed or not.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Osservazioni ===
Un Testa-molla controllerà una lista di condizioni ogni frame per determinare se è in grado di muoversi oppure no. Un Testa-molla '''non''' è in grado di muoversi se la seguente condizione non è accettata: <ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
 Il Testa-molla è stordito
 OPPURE
 L'Impiegato vede il Testa-molla in almeno 68° dal centro del loro schermo
 E
 Il Testa-molla è entro 60 unità di distanza
 E
 L'Impiegato è almeno a 0.3 unità di distanza dagli occhi del Testa-Molla
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategia ==
Un gruppo può utilizzare un singolo impiegato per tenere d'occhio il Testa-molla mentre gli altri saccheggiano. Questo impiegato deve rimanere attento anche per gli altri nemici, dato che è severamente limitato dalla presenza del testa-molla.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Considerando che un Testa-molla in attacco punterà sempre verso il prossimo impiegato, è imperativo avvisare gli altri della sua presenza.
</div>

Una [[Granata Stordente]]/[[Zapper]]/[[Amplificatore Radar]] possono essere usati per disabilitare i Testa-Molla per vari secondi, permettendovi di fuggire.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Il Testa-Molla richiede molto tempo per aprire una porta non chiusa a chiave. Usa ciò al tuo vantaggio per darti alla fuga. Stai attento però, i Testa-Molla apriranno le porte alla stessa velocità quando osservati e non.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Coil-heads are incredibly dangerous when paired with other entities, especially [[Bracken|Brackens]] and [[Snare Flea|Snare Fleas]], due to the Coil-head’s and Bracken’s conflicting requirements of whether to be looked at or not, and the risk of accidentally stepping into a Snare Flea’s trap while staring at the Coil-head. If encountered together, the best strategy is to go around a corner or obstacle to break line of sight with both the Coil-head and Bracken, but remain looking in the Coil-head’s direction so that it immediately enters your line of sight again when it turns the corner, simultaneously freezing it and scaring the Bracken off, or luring the Coil-Head to a location that you know has no Snare Fleas. (Keep in mind that one may have spawned while you were gone and latched to the ceiling.).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== V.50 Beginning cutscene ==
During the cutscene, we see what appears to be an office in a factory that makes Coil-heads. Through the window, we can see one. But when the alarm goes off, we see it fall over, and in the background, we hear other Coil-heads killing and terrorizing employees and others as they chase them in the dark.
</div>

== History ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== [[Version 35]] === 
* Introduced.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== [[Version 47]] ===
* The audible range of Coil-head’s footsteps has been slightly increased.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== [[Version 60]] ===
* Coil-head now enters a recharge phase after chasing employees for a certain distance.
* Coil-head can now lose track of an employee when they are out of range and line-of-sight for a long enough time.
* Coil-head now cannot complete a jump as easily if they are spotted by an employee while jumping.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Version 61 ===
* Coil-head now will not move when looked at under any circumstances, including when they cannot reach the employee looking at them.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Version 62 ===
* Slightly decreased the time a Coil-head needs to spend moving before recharging
* Decreased the time a Coil-head spends recharging
* Coil-head’s timer before it needs to recharge now counts down 80% slower when it is pushing a door or otherwise stuck than when it is actually moving, regardless of wether it is being looked at or not.
* Coil-head now eventually enters recharge mode if it is inside the [[Mineshaft]] elevator.
</div>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mechaniki ==

<span id="Patrolling"></span>
=== Patrolowanie ===

Kiedy Coil-Head pojawi się na mapie pierwsze co, to zacznie patrolowanie otoczenia. W czasie swojego patrolu będzie poruszał się w tę i we w tę ze zmniejszoną prędkością niż podczas ścigania pracownika. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - Link na angielskiej wersji strony.</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Podczas patrolowania Coil-Head będzie bez przerwy poszukiwał pracowników, do momentu spełnienia poniższego warunku<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>:
 Pracownik jest w zasięgu 30 jednostek
 ORAZ
 Coil-Head lub Pracownik nie zaobserwowali siebie nawzajem
</div>

Jeżeli warunek się spełnił, Coil-Head przechodzi w tryb atakujący

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Atakowanie ===
Po przejściu w ten tryb jego prędkość znacząco wzroście, zwiększając się z '''6''' do '''14,5''' <ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. W tym trybie, Coil-Head obierze sobie za cel najbliższego pracownika<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref> dopóki nie zauważony<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kiedy Coil-Head nie jest zauważony, w fizycznym kontakcie bez ogłuszenia zada 90 [[damage|obrażeń]] co 0,2 sekundy pracownikowi<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. W momencie śmierci ich celu Coil-Head obierze sobie za cel kolejnego dostępnego najbliższego pracownika niezależnie od ich położenia na mapie. Dopiero w momencie, gdy wszyscy opuszczą budynek lub nie są jakoś dostępni dla Sprężynka, wróci on do trybu patrolującego<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Recharging ====
While in its attacking phase, if a Coil-head has cumulatively spent more than 9 seconds '''actively''' moving toward any employee, it will enter a recharging/cooldown phase for 11 seconds. During this time, its neck will be retracted and the Coil-head will be unable to move or deal damage, regardless of whether it is being observed or not.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Obserwacje ===
Coil-Head co klatkę będzie sprawdzać szereg instrukcji, by określić, czy może się poruszyć czy nie. Coil-Head nie może się ruszyć jeśli te warunki zostaną spełnione<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>:
 Coil-Head jest ogłuszony
 LUB
 Pracownik zobaczy Coil-Heada w zakresie 68° od środka ekranu
 ORAZ
 Coil-Head jest w zakresie 60 jednostek
 ORAZ
 Pracownik jest co najmniej 0,3 jednostki od oczu Coil-Heada
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategia ==
W grupie jedna osoba może patrzeć, gdy reszta zbiera rzeczy. Ten pracownik musiałby uważać na innych wrogów, ponieważ jego możliwości byłyby utrudnione przez obecność Coil-Heada.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Biorąc pod uwagę fakt, iż Coil-Head zawsze kieruje się na kolejnego gracza, należałoby ostrzec resztę grupy o jego pojawieniu się.
</div>

[[Stun Grenade|Granat ogłuszający]]/[[Zap Gun|Działko ogłuszające]]/[[Radar Booster|Radar dopełniający]] mogą buć użyte by unieruchomić Coil-Heada na kilka dobrych sekund, dając możliwość ucieczki.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Zajmuje to Coil-Headowi zaskakującą ilość czasu by otworzyć odblokowane drzwi. Poleca się użyć tego dla własnej przewagi by uciec. Uwaga, bo Coil-Heady otwierają drzwi w tym samym tempie kiedy się na nie patrzy bądź też nie.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Sprężynki są niesamowicie niebezpieczne kiedy w okolicy są inne byty, w szczególności [[Bracken/pl|'''Brackeny''']], ze względu na ich kolidujące się warunki czy trzeba na nie spoglądać czy też nie. W przypadku spotkania ich razem, najlepszą strategią jest schowanie się za róg lub przeszkodę, aby przerwać linię widzenia Sprężynka i Brackena, ale cały czas patrząc na Sprężynka , aby przerwać linię widzenia, a następnie wbiec z powrotem w linię widzenia, zamrażając go i odstraszając Brackena.
</div>
