<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mecânicas ==

<span id="Patrolling"></span>
=== Patrulha ===

Quando um Cabeça-de-mola surge no mapa, ele começará a patrulhar uma área. Durante essa patrulha, ele se moverá a uma velocidade inferior de quando persegue ume funcionárie.<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Enquanto o Cabeça-de-mola estiver patrulhando, ele constantemente procurará por funcionáries, só atacando ume se a seguinte condição for encontrada: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
 Funcionárie estiver em alcance de 30 unidades
 E
 Cabeça-de-Mola ou Funcionárie têm visão clara entre si
</div>

Quando encontrada, o Cabeça-de-mola entrará em seu fase de ataque.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Ataque ===
Quando chegar nesse estado, sua velocidade de movimento aumenta significativamente, aumentando de 6 para 14.5<ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. Nesse estado, o Cabeça-de-mola perseguirá ê funcionárie mais próxime<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>, sempre se movendo até elu, exceto quando for visto<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Enquanto um Cabeça-de-mola não for observado, ao chegar em contato físico com ume funcionárie, e não estiver atordoado, ela fará 90 de [[damage/pt-br|dano]] a cada 0,2 segundos ae funcionárie<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Na morte de funcionárie que estava perseguindo, o Cabeça-de-mola troca de alvo ae próxime funcionárie que conseguir alcançar, não importando onde elu esteja no mapa. Quando todes ês funcionáries saírem da instalação, ou ficam inacessíveis ao Cabeça-de-mola, ele voltará ao estado de patrulha.<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Recarga ===
Depois de perseguir ume funcionárie por uma certa distância, um Cabeça-de-mola entra em um estado de recarga por um curto período de tempo, visível pela retração de seu pescoço. Enquanto estiver nessa fase, eles são incapazes de se mover, mesmo se não estiverem sendo observados.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Observação ===
Um Cabeça-de-mola verifica uma certa lista de condições todos os ''frames '' para determinar se é capaz de mover ou não. Um Cabeça-de-mola é incapaz de se mover caso a seguinte condição seja encontrada:<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
 Cabeça-de-mola está atordoado
 OU
 Funcionárie vê o Cabeça-de-mola em 68° do meio de sua tela
 E
 Cabeça-de-mola esteja a 60 unidades de distância 
 E
Funcionárie está a pelo menos 0,3 unidades de distância dos olhos do Cabeça-de-mola
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Estratégia ==
Um grupo pode ter ume únique funcionárie observar os Cabeças-de-mola enquanto outres saqueiam a instalação. Esse funcionárie teria que tomar cuidado com outros inimigos, já que elu seria seriamente debilitade pela presença do Cabeça-de-mola.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Considerando que um Cabeça-de-mola atacante sempre irá atrás de próxime funcionárie, seria importante avisar outres funcionáries de sua presença.
</div>

Uma [[stun grenade/pt-br|granada de atordoamento]]/[[zap gun/pt-br|arma de choque]]/[[radar booster/pt-br|amplificador de radar]] pode ser usado para desabilitar Cabeças-de-mola por vários segundos, permitindo uma fuga.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Um Cabeça-de-mola precisa de uma quantidade ridícula de tempo para abrir uma porta destrancada. Use isso para sua vantagem para poder fugir. Tenha cuidado, Cabeças-de-mola vão abrir portas na mesma velocidade se vistos ou não.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Cabeças-de-mola são incrivelmente perigosos quando próximos de outras criaturas, especialmente [[Bracken/pt-br|Brackens]], por causa de seus comportamentos antagônicos de ser observado ou não. Se encontrados juntos, a melhor estratégia é ficar em um canto ou obstáculo para quebrar a linha de visão com o Cabeça-de-mola e Bracken, mas ficar olhando para o Cabeça-de-mola para que você quebre a linha de visão e ele corre de volta para sua visão, se congelando e assustando o Bracken.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Cutscene da V.50 ==
Durante a cutscene, nós podemos ver o que é um escritório de uma fábrica fazendo Cabeças-de-mola e na janela vemos um. Mas quando o alarme toca, vemos ele cair e no fundo ouvimos outros Cabeças-de-mola matar e aterrorizar outros funcionáries equantos ês persegue na escuridão.
</div>

######## Coil-Head/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}
{{Infobox entity
| name = Пружиноголовый
| sciname = Vir colligerus
| danger = 80%
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 2
| max_count = 5
| door_speed_multiplier = 0.06
| see_through_fog = No
| pip_size = Средний
| attack_damage = 90
| attack_speed = 200ms
| dps = 450
| contact_damage = 90%
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|SpringMan}}
| stun_multiplier = 3.25
| id = <!--springman-->SpringMan
| cause_of_death = Strangulation
}}
'''Пружиноголовый''' - враждебная [[Entities/ru|сущность]] внутри здания. Замирает на месте когда находится в поле зрения сотрудника, преследуя и стремительно атакуя сотрудников по-близости, когда на него не смотрят. [[Moons/ru|Луна]], на которой встречается чаще всего - [[Offense/ru|Offense]].

Пружиноголовые являются высокими, манекено-подобными сущностями с бежевой кожей без особых примет помимо нескольких винтов, торчащих из нескольких маленьких, высохших ран. У них недостаёт рук, а вместо шеи у них огромная пружинка с неприметной головой с парой пустых глазниц и раскрытым ртом.

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

<span id="Patrolling"></span>
=== Патрулирование ===

Как только Пружиноголовый впервые появляется на карте, он начинает патрулировать территорию. Во время патрулирования двигается по фиксированному маршруту вперёд-назад со скоростью меньшей, чем когда он преследует сотрудника. <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>

Пока Пружиноголовый патрулирует, он постоянно сканирует окружение на предмет наличия сотрудников, атакуя только если сотрудником выполняются следующее условия: <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* Пружиноголовый и Сотрудник имеют неблокированную линию видимости друг друга.
* И:
** Сотрудник смотрит на Пружиноголового, то есть они на расстоянии менее 60 юнитов друг от друга и Пружиноголовый находится в горизонтальном поле зрения сотрудника в 68° (стандартное визуальное поле зрения сотрудников составляет 66°)
** ИЛИ
** Пружиноголовый менее чем в 30 юнитах от сотрудника и имеет до него преодолимый маршрут

Как только условие успешно выполнилось, Пружиноголовый переходит в состояние атаки.

=== Атака ===
При переходе в это состояние его скорость значительно возрастает - с '''6''' до '''14.5'''<ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>. В этом состоянии Пружиноголовый '''всегда''' будет преследовать ближайшего сотрудника, '''к которому можно проложить преодолимый маршрут''', вне зависимости от видимости, дистанции или предыдущей цели, <ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>, и будет двигаться всегда, когда не находится под наблюдением и не оглушён (смотри [[#Наблюдение]]) <ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>.

==== Утеря агрессии ====
Есть два способа разагрить Пружиноголового и вернуть его в состояние [[#Патрулирование|#патрулирования]]:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* Если отсутствуют подходящие цели (то есть ни к одному сотруднику нельзя проложить преодолимый маршрут) Пружиноголовый разагрится, если на него не смотрят суммарно 1 секунду.
* ИЛИ
* Если Пружиноголовый последовательно отвечает следующим условиям на протяжении 4.5 секунд:
** Не наносил урон сотрудникам как минимум 7 секунд
** Активно двигается к сотруднику
** Болле чем в 40 юнитах от любого сотрудника
** Не имеет прямой видимости ни к одному из сотрудников в пределах 140 юнитов

==== Нанесение урона ====
Когда за Пружиноголовым не наблюдают и он не оглушён, он начинает наносить сотрудникам 90 [[damage|урона]] каждые 0.2 секунды при физическом контакте<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>. Так как для наблюдения за Пружиноголовым требуется быть как минимум на удалении в 0.3 юнита из этого следует 2 пункта:
* Как только Пружиноголовый наносит урон сотруднику единожды, шансы на выживание фактически нулевые.
* Если сотрудник войдёт в физический контакт с Пружиноголовым в отсутствие наблюдения кем-либо ещё, он будет немедленно атакован Пружиноголовым вне зависимости от нахождения того в поле зрения сотрудника.

=== Перезарядка ===
При нахождении в состоянии атаки, если Пружиноголовый провёл суммарно 9 секунд '''активно''' преследуя любого из сотрудников, он войдёт в фазу перезарядки на 11 секунд. В это время его шея будет втянута и он будет неспособен передвигаться или наносить урон вне зависимости от наблюдения за ним.<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>

=== Наблюдение ===
Есть 2 ситуации в которых Пружиноголовый не будет способен передвигаться в состоянии атаки:<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
* Пружиноголовый оглушён
* ИЛИ
* Сотрудник наблюдает за Пружиноголовым, а то есть:
** Сотрудник и Пружиноголовый имеют ненарушенный обзор друг на друга
** Сотрудник смотрит на Пружиноголового, то есть они на расстоянии менее чем 60 юнитов друг от друга и Пружиноголовый находится в поле зрения 68° (стандартное визуальное поле зрения сотрудников - 66°)
** Сотрудник находится как минимум в 0.3 юнита от Пружиноголового

== Стратегия ==
Группа может выделить одного сотрудника на наблюдение за Пружиноголовыми пока остальные исследуют и собирают лом. Сотруднику стоит в особенности опасаться других сущностей, так как всё его внимание будет сконцентрировано на присутствии Пружиноголового.

Учитывая, что атакующий Пружиноголовый немедленно двинется к ближайшему досягаемому сотруднику, будет важным предупредить остальных сотрудников о его присутствии.

[[Stun grenade/ru|Светошумовая граната]]/[[Zap Gun/ru|Электро-пушка]]/[[Radar-booster/ru|Радарный усилитель]] могут быть использованы для отключения Пружиноголовых на несколько секунд, позволяя сбежать.

Пружиноголовому требуется неимоверное количество времени на открытие дверей (почти 17 секунд). Сотрудники могут использовать эту механику себе на пользу для побега. Учитывайте, что даже во время наблюдения Пружиноголовые продолжают открывать двери.

Так как Пружиноголовые почти не могут взбираться на вертикальные препятствия, когда сотрудник забирается на большинство объектов, Пружиноголовый не может проложить к сотруднику преодолимый маршрут и следовательно не может на него нацелиться. Это можно использовать для [[#Утеря_агрессии|разагра]] Пружиноголового в случаях, когда все сотрудники находятся в подобных недостижимых позициях и избегают наблюдения за Пружиноголовым на протяжении 1 секунды.

При столкновении со множеством Пружиноголовых хорошей стратегией будет попытаться сгруппировать их вместе, что позволит сотруднику держать их всех одновременно в своём поле зрения.

Пружиноголовые очень опасны в присутствии иных сущностей, в особенности [[Bracken/ru|Орляка]] и [[Snare Flea/ru|Потолочной Блохи]] из-за конфликтующих условий наблюдения Пружиноголового и Орляка и риска случайно отступить под Потолочную Блоху. Если эти угрозы встретились вместе, лучшей стратегий будет зайти за угол чтобы прервать видимость к Пружиноголовому и Бракену, но при этом продолжая смотреть на то, откуда они за вами пойдут, тем самым заморозив Пружиноголового и не давая Бракену пройти к вам через ваше поле зрения, при этом убедившись, что выбранное вами место свободно от Потолочных Блох (следует помнить, что пока вы возитесь с Пружиноголовым есть риск того, что в выбранном вами месте могла появиться новая Потолочная Блоха).

== Начальная катсцена версии 50 ==
В катсцене мы видим по-видимому офис завода по производству Пружиноголовых. За окном - помещение с одним из них. Когда срабатывает тревога мы видим, как он опрокидывается, а на заднем плане становится слышно других Пружиноголовых, убивающих и терроризирующих сотрудников, гоняясь за ними в темноте.

== История ==

=== [[Version 35|Версия 35]] ===
* Введён в игру.

=== [[Version 47|Версия 47]] ===
* Слышимый звук походки Пружиноголового был сделан слегка громче

=== [[Version 60|Версия 60]] ===
* Пружиноголовый теперь входит в состояние перезарядки после преследования сотрудников определённую дистанцию.
* Пружиноголовый теперь может потерять цель, если та достаточно далеко не видно Пружиноголовому продолжительное время.
* Пружиноголовому теперь труднее завершить прыжок, если во время такового он был замечен сотрудником.

=== Версия 61 ===
* Пружиноголовый более не станет двигаться ни при каких условиях когда под наблюдением, даже если наблюдающий его сотрудник недосягаем.

=== Версия 62 ===
* Слегка уменьшено время, на протяжении которого Пружиноголовому нужно двигаться перед тем, как войти в состояние перезарядки
* Уменьшено время, проводимое Пружиноголовым в состоянии перезарядки
* Таймер до входа Пружиноголового в состояние перезарядки отсчитывает на 80% медленнее в случае, когда Пружиноголовый пытается открыть дверь или иным образом застрял на месте несмотря на то, что технически двигается, вне зависимости от того, находится ли он под наблюдением.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 概览 ==
弹簧头是在[[Interiors/zh-cn|室内]]的高大、类人的敌对人体模型。若被员工观测到，它将无法移动或攻击。它极度危险，可在一秒内杀死员工。它们的原型是60年代英国科幻电视剧《神秘博士》中的哭泣天使。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Coil-Heads are tall, mannequin-like entities, with mostly featureless beige skin, save for the numerous screws embedded around their bodies with several small, dried wounds. They have missing arms and a large spring in place of their neck, topped with a head with featureless, hollow eye sockets and a gaping mouth.
</div>

== 机制 ==

<span id="Patrolling"></span>
=== 巡逻状态 ===

弹簧头生成后，它会开始巡逻一片区域。巡逻期间，它将以稍慢于追赶员工时的速度沿一固定路线来回移动。<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/9GHsGnYw</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
当弹簧头巡逻时，它会持续寻找员工，并在以下情况成立时发起攻击：<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
 员工在其 30 单位范围内
 并且
 弹簧头或员工可不受阻挡地看见对方
</div>

一旦条件成立，弹簧头将进入攻击状态。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 攻击状态 ===
一旦进入此状态，弹簧头的移动速度将显著增加，从 '''6''' 提升至 '''14.5'''<ref name=coilhead_class_attributes><code>SpringManAi</code> - https://pastebin.com/NueWGKjB</ref>。在此状态下，弹簧头会将距离最近的员工设为目标<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>并持续向他移动，除非弹簧头被观测到<ref name=coilhead_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/j93DwH3B</ref>。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Losing Aggro ====
There are two ways to de-aggro a Coil-head and revert it to the [[#Patrolling]] phase:<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
* While there are no targetable employees (ones without a valid path for the Coil-head to reach), it will de-aggro if nobody is looking at the Coil-head for a cumulative total of 1 second.
* OR if the Coil-head consecutively meets all of the following conditions for 4.5 seconds:
** Hasn't damaged any employees for at least 7 seconds
** Is actively moving toward an employee
** Is more than 40 units away from all employees
** Does not have a direct line of sight to any employees within 140 units
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
若弹簧头未被观测、未被眩晕且与员工有物理接触时，它会每 0.2 秒对员工造成 90 点[[Damage|伤害]]<ref name=coilhead_oncollidewithplayer><code>OnCollideWithPlayer</code> - https://pastebin.com/RCaRyZk5</ref>。目标员工死亡后，弹簧头会将目标切换至下一个最近的、可接近的员工，无论员工在地图何处。只在所有员工离开室内或无法接近时，弹簧头才会返回至巡逻状态。<ref name=coilhead_doaiinterval></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===充电阶段===
在追逐员工一段距离后，线圈头会进入短暂的充电阶段，表现为其颈部向内收缩。在此阶段中，无论是否有人注视它，它都无法移动。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 观测 ===
弹簧头会在每一帧进行判定，若以下条件成立：
 弹簧头被眩晕
 或
 弹簧头在员工屏幕中间的 68°范围内
 且
 弹簧头在 60 单位距离内
 且
 员工距离弹簧头的眼睛至少 0.3 单位
弹簧头将'''不能'''移动。<ref name=coilhead_update></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 策略 ==
多人行动时，可派一名员工专门处理弹簧头，其他员工搜寻废料。这名员工应提高对其它敌人的警惕，因为弹簧头严重限制了他的行动。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
考虑到处于攻击状态下的弹簧头总会将目标切换至下一员工，有必要在发现弹簧头后警告其他员工。
</div>

[[Stun Grenade|眩晕手雷]]、[[Zap Gun|电击枪]]和[[Radar Booster|雷达增幅器]]可以让弹簧头暂时失去行动能力数秒，创造逃生机会。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
弹簧头需要一段奇异搞笑的时间才能将已解锁的门打开，可借此机会逃生。要小心的是，无论是否被观测到，弹簧头开门的速度不变。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Since Coil-heads are mostly unable to traverse onto any vertical obstacles, when an employee stands on top of many such objects, the Coil-head is unable to find a traversable path to the employee and cannot target them. This can be used to easily [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] the Coil-head when all indoor employees are in such non-reachable positions and refrain from observing it for 1 second.
Alternatively, if some of these positions satisfy the in-game path-finding logic, but result in the Coil-head being stuck or unable to reach the employee, then not observing the Coil-head for a total of 9 seconds in this state will result in an 11 second [[#Recharging|cooldown]] that will restrain and subsequently [[#Losing Aggro|de-aggro]] it as well.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Should an employee find themselves in the presence of multiple Coil-heads, a good strategy is to attempt to bunch them close together, as this allows the employee to have every Coil-head within their field of view at the same time.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
线圈头在靠近其他生物时极为危险，尤其是[[Bracken/zh-cn|'''蕨影''']]和缠缚蚤。原因在于它们对“是否被注视”的机制要求相互冲突，同时还存在不慎踏入陷阱跳蚤伏击范围的风险。
如果同时遭遇它们，最佳策略是绕到拐角或障碍物后方，切断自己与线圈头和花怪的视线，但**始终保持盯着线圈头**。这样一来，当你中断视线后它会快速冲回视野，随即定住不动，从而吓走花怪；或者将线圈头引到你确定没有陷阱跳蚤的区域。（请注意，你离开期间可能会刷新出新的陷阱跳蚤并吸附在天花板上。）
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== V.50 开场动画 ==
在这段过场动画中，可以看到一间位于生产线圈头（Coil‑Head）的工厂内的办公室。透过窗户能看到一只线圈头。但当警报响起时，它会倒地，背景中还能听到其他线圈头在黑暗中追逐、杀害并恐吓员工及其他人员的声音。
</div>

######## Company Cruiser
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{infobox
| bodystyle        = padding: 5px; background: #000065; border: 3px double #0000A7; color: white;
| imagestyle       = border: 3px dashed #0000A7;
| above            = {{LOCPAGENAME}}
| image            = [[File:Cruiser_with_driver.png|200px]]
| label1           = Default Price
| data1            = {{credits|370}}
}}
{{Stub}}
The '''Company Cruiser''' is a large red truck that can be used to transport large amounts of items at once, most prominently [[scrap]]. It can be driven by one [[employee]], and controls much like a real car. It is magnetized to the side of the [[Ship]] when in orbit, and must be driven there before taking off or else it will be left behind. The Company Cruiser can be purchased from the [[Store]] for {{credits|370}}, and can be bought once for free if it is lost or destroyed.

== Company description ==
{{Terminal|text=The Company Cruiser is an entire delivery truck capable of carrying as many items as you could ever need, including your fellow coworkers! Your purchase of a Company Cruiser comes with one free, life-time warranty, because we are that confident in its durability and usefulness!


It comes with a manual, so make sure to read up on the best practices.}}

== Overview ==

The sleeper end of the Cruiser acts as a small room with a closable back door that can hold items and even employees. The inner walls have shelves that act similarly to the [[Cupboard]], capable of storing one-handed items and scrap. Any items left inside of the Cruiser will safely remain inside of the Cruiser while in orbit, including scrap. Strangely, the driver will be teleported inside of the ship upon takeoff, but the passenger will not.{{Citation needed}} <!--i remember this being how it works but im not certain. i know for a fact that the driver is in range-->

[[File:Cruiser internal.png|The cab of the Cruiser.|thumb]]

There is one driver's seat and one passenger's seat. The employee in the driver's seat has full control of the Cruiser, while the passenger has access to everything but the steering wheel and keys. These include the windshield wipers, headlights, and car horn, located on the steering wheel, alongside the gear stick between the seats and the eject button, which is located on the dash behind glass.

Upon being pressed, the eject button will eject the employee in the driver's seat out of the Cruiser. The employee will be shot out of the top, where they will then fall rapidly. Normal rules of gravity and fall damage apply. The employee should land on higher ground to avoid taking critical (or even lethal) damage.

The Cruiser can crush trees and kill any [[entity]] it runs over, including employees and excluding the [[Ghost Girl]].

When an employee presses the gas for too long while the Cruiser is in park, or when the Cruiser takes too much damage, it will explode. This will destroy the Cruiser and kill any employees inside. However, items and scrap that were inside of the Cruiser are still recoverable after an explosion.

[[File:CruiserEngine.png|The engine underneath the hood. Note the green health meter on the bottom left.|thumb]]

The Cruiser's health can be restored by opening the hood and squirting [[Weed Killer]] into the engine. <!-- how do you tell what its health is at? also this is the first time the article mentions jumping...--> If it is at full health, this will instead fill an orange bar that represents the super jump meter. The super jump replaces the normal jump and is much more powerful, launching the cruiser into the air. The super jump should be used cautiously as dying from fall damage, impact damage while in the car, or having the cruiser lose too much health and explode are very possible.

== Strategy ==
The Cruiser acts as a physical object, blocking lightning and the vision of entities. 

Entities do not actively target the Cruiser but they can damage it. [[Eyeless Dog]]s will only lunge at it if the engine is running. [[Forest Keeper]]s will deal damage to the cruiser when colliding with it. They will chase after and grab employees sitting in the driver or passenger seats, but they cannot see employees inside of the sleeper end.

=== Driving ===
The Company Cruiser needs to be ignited before it can be driven. The employee in the driver's seat must find the keyhole and hold {{keybind|Interact}}. The ignition may fail, so if it doesn't ignite after a while, try releasing and holding {{keybind|Interact|short=y}} again.

Once the engine is ignited, the gear stick must be placed from 'Parking' to 'Drive'.
It can be accelerated by pressing the pedal using {{keybind|Walk forward}}. Pressing {{keybind|Walk left}} will turn the steering wheel <abbr title="counter-clockwise">CCW</abbr>/left, and {{keybind|Walk right}} will turn the steering wheel <abbr title="clockwise">CW</abbr>/right. 

It is recommended to stop pressing the pedal and steer the wheel as far as possible in order to get a better turning angle. 
Most of the time the pedal will only need to be tapped lightly, instead of pressing it for long periods of time. This is due to the terrain and high power engine, which moves the Company Cruiser with ease. 

It is also important to note that if the employee wants to stop the car, they must make sure to press the brakes by using {{keybind|Walk back}}. This helps particularly with parking, or to stop midway through steering in a certain direction.

To go backwards, the gear stick must be shifted to reverse. When in reverse, pressing the pedal by using {{keybind|Walk forward|short=y}} will accelerate the car backwards. To reverse into a specific direction, it is important to steer the wheel completely before pressing the pedal. The Company Cruiser will still move the corresponding direction as normal while reversed. For example, if an employee steers using {{keybind|Walk right|short=y}}, the Company Cruiser will reverse towards the right. It is recommended for employees to use the brakes while doing this to avoid overshooting.

Additionally, please note that if the employee wants to go straight forward after steering towards another direction, is recommended for them to press the brakes. This will stabilize and center the steering wheel, ensuring that once they press the pedal the Company Cruiser will properly move forward.

The Company Cruiser is also able to briefly launch itself into the air with a jump. To do this, the employee must press {{keybind|Jump}}. This allows the Company Cruiser to go over small obstacles or to unstick itself from most terrain.

The Company Cruiser can be set to park in order to stop it from sliding down slopes. Note that attempting to drive while in park will cause the Cruiser to violently explode.
In order to make parking easier, it is once again recommended to press the brakes by using {{keybind|Walk back|short=y}}.

While outside of the Cruiser, employees can push it by pressing {{keybind|Interact}} while facing its exterior. Note that it is somewhat unreliable as to what parts of the Cruiser can be successfully pushed. Pushing the Cruiser will move it in a direction based on the angle it is pushed from. Pushing the Cruiser is helpful to unstick it or move it up steep hills. When the Cruiser is parked, it cannot be moved around very much by pushing.

== Warranty ==
The Company Cruiser comes with a warranty.
{{Terminal|text=We are so confident in the quality of this product, it comes with a life-time warranty! If your Cruiser is lost or destroyed, you can get one free replacement. Items cannot be purchased while the vehicle is en route.}}
Only one Company Cruiser can be purchased at a time. If another purchase is attempted when a Cruiser is present, it will not go through and the following text will display.
{{Terminal|text=For the safety of your crew, the Company only allows one Cruiser to be in operation at any given time, but a Cruiser has been detected.}}

== Overview ==
The Cozy lights are a string of wall lights characterized by their dim, yellow appearance. They can be purchased from the [[terminal]] in the ship for 140 credits. Flipping the [[Ship#Light_switch|light switch]] with the Cozy lights purchased will toggle between the default ship lights and the Cozy lights.

'''Credits''' are the game's currency.
The crew's balance and all [[store]] prices are denominated in credits.
[[Scrap]] items are randomly assigned a value in credits during generation, which [[The_Company#Selling_Scrap|informs the sell price]].
And crucially, the Company expects crews to meet [[quota]] by selling scrap over the 4-day period which are worth a certain number of credits in total.

On this wiki, you will see prices with the same symbol as in the [[store]], for example: {{credits|123}}.

== Location ==
The '''Storage Locker''' is found ''near'' the door of [[Ship|The Ship]] opposite the [[Door Controls]]. 

== Overview ==
It can store a very large amount of [[:Category:One-Handed Scrap|One-Handed Scrap]] or [[:Category:One-Handed Items|One-Handed Items]]. Storing Scrap in the locker displays its value.


''Note that if all players die, Scrap in the '''Storage Locker''' will still disappear.''

== Announcement trailer ==

About 2 months after ''Lethal Company'' was announced; Zeekerss published [https://youtu.be/Vt08pWqO6Og a trailer] for the game on {{#time:Y-m-d H:i:s (eP)|2022-07-08T17:45:10+00:00}} which had included many unused assets.

[[File:Lethal Company - Announcement Teaser 0-6 screenshot.png|thumb|The "empty room" along with other unused content being shown.]]
[[File:Experimentation_elevator_room_from_alpha.jpg|thumb|What it looks like now]]

Here is a list: 

* New empty room
* 3 inventory slots
* GUI says "activate drone"
* Apparatus core is Red
* New Elevator that allows for connection between floors
* Apparatus can be used to move the elevator
* Crewmates have grey suits
* Checklist is in guys hand; implying maybe this was a tutorial area
* New battery icon

== Scrap item concepts ==

A few scrap items are [[Sigurd_Logs#Trivia|named in Sigurd's journal]] but don't appear in-game. These are frying pans, a big nail, a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps, and a bundle of cords. There's a [[Big bolt]] item, and the [[Barber]] has scissors, but that's all.
<br>Based on some placeholder text left in the game's files (<code>SampleSceneRelay.unity</code>), an engine part and a dog toy may have been considered too, though of course complete [[engine]]s did make it into the game.

######## Damage
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
{{interlangbox}}
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
Damage is one of the main causes of death in Lethal Company. It is generally received from [[Entities]], [[Traps]], other employees, and the environment.

<!--T:2-->
== Effects ==
The exact effects of damage depend on whether it is taken by an employee or entity.

<!--T:3-->
=== Employees ===
Employees start every day with 100 health. Taking damage that reduces it to below 20 shows a critical injury warning,<tvar name="citation-crit-warning">{{ref code|HUDManager.UpdateHealthUI}}</tvar> while taking damage that reduces their health below 10 will put them in a critically injured state, where they limp around and leave a blood trail on the ground, while also being unable to sprint.<tvar name="citation-crit-effect">{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.DamagePlayer}}</tvar> While below 20 health, employees regain 1 health every second, with the critical injury being cleared upon reaching 20.<tvar name="citation-crit-heal">{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.LateUpdate}}</tvar>

<!--T:4-->
While an employee is not critically injured, they are unable to die from taking less than 50 damage and instead get their health set to 5.<tvar name="citation">{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.DamagePlayer}}</tvar> However, as this puts them in critical injury, any further damage is likely to be lethal, unless the threat is immediately neutralized.

<!--T:5-->
When taking at least 10 damage, employees regain between 8% and 100% of their stamina, depending on the amount of damage taken (however, realistically they can only regain up to 79.2% stamina without dying and 72% without being too injured to run).<tvar name="citation">{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.DamagePlayer}}</tvar><tvar name="footnote"><ref group="note" name="damage stamina recovery" /></tvar>

<!--T:6-->
Employees cannot take damage or die while in orbit.

<!--T:7-->
=== Entities ===
Entities can take damage from far fewer sources than employees. Namely, almost all of them cannot damage other entities, and they take no damage from turret shots and falling. However, they are still able to take damage from lightning strikes, shovels, and shotguns, or die from Earth Leviathans.

<!--T:8-->
Most entities can be killed, but many do not take damage from any source.

<!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
== Notes ==
This page was last updated for Version 81; however, it may still lack information or contain outdated information. Things that do not cause damage or death through <code>DamagePlayer()</code>, <code>KillPlayer()</code>, <code>HitEnemy()</code>, or <code>KillEnemy()</code> may have been missed.
<references group="note">
<ref group="note" name="damage stamina recovery">The formula for this is <code>damage / 125</code>%</ref>
<ref group="note" name="damage vs instant kill">The table lists "100" if damage is dealt through <code>DamagePlayer()</code> (the highest damage amount in vanilla is 100) and "Instant Kill" if the player is killed directly through <code>KillPlayer()</Code>. When it comes to gameplay, both are functionally identical.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="cause of death unknown">"Unknown" is the default cause of death for many sources of damage. The Ghost Girl is the only source with a declared "Unknown" cause of death.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="snare flea release">Upon trying to deal damage, if there are no other players connected and the employee has 15 or less health, the snare flea will release the employee instead of damaging them. A snare flea will not do this if it has attached to the employee previously.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="no jetpack qualification calculation">Minimum velocity required to take damage depends on the employee's angle. If they're more than 65 degrees from upright, the velocity required is 10. If more than 47 degrees, it is 12.5. Otherwise, it is 15. When moving faster than this, the game calculates a value <code>(currentVelocity - minimumVelocity) / 6</code>. It is then truncated and, if the jetpack controls are still active or the employee's angle is more than 50 degrees from vertical, 40 is added to it. Finally, this is clamped between 20 and 100 before being applied as damage to the employee.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="explosion range">Explosions in the game only affect objects whose colliders intersect a sphere with a radius of 6 units, centered on the explosion. Thus if the object's colliders are too small, they will be missed by the explosion even if they are within the damage range.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="knife-causeofdeath">Result of a bug where players damaging other players does not differentiate between sources of damage.</ref>
</references>

######## Damage/en
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages />
Damage is one of the main causes of death in Lethal Company. It is generally received from [[Entities]], [[Traps]], other employees, and the environment.

== Effects ==
The exact effects of damage depend on whether it is taken by an employee or entity.

=== Employees ===
Employees start every day with 100 health. Taking damage that reduces it to below 20 shows a critical injury warning,{{ref code|HUDManager.UpdateHealthUI}} while taking damage that reduces their health below 10 will put them in a critically injured state, where they limp around and leave a blood trail on the ground, while also being unable to sprint.{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.DamagePlayer}} While below 20 health, employees regain 1 health every second, with the critical injury being cleared upon reaching 20.{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.LateUpdate}}

While an employee is not critically injured, they are unable to die from taking less than 50 damage and instead get their health set to 5.{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.DamagePlayer}} However, as this puts them in critical injury, any further damage is likely to be lethal, unless the threat is immediately neutralized.

When taking at least 10 damage, employees regain between 8% and 100% of their stamina, depending on the amount of damage taken (however, realistically they can only regain up to 79.2% stamina without dying and 72% without being too injured to run).{{ref code|PlayerControllerB.DamagePlayer}}<ref group="note" name="damage stamina recovery" />

Employees cannot take damage or die while in orbit.

=== Entities ===
Entities can take damage from far fewer sources than employees. Namely, almost all of them cannot damage other entities, and they take no damage from turret shots and falling. However, they are still able to take damage from lightning strikes, shovels, and shotguns, or die from Earth Leviathans.

Most entities can be killed, but many do not take damage from any source.

== Notes ==
This page was last updated for Version 73, however, it may still lack information or contain outdated information. Things that do not cause damage or death through <code>DamagePlayer()</code>, <code>KillPlayer()</code>, <code>HitEnemy()</code>, or <code>KillEnemy()</code> may have been missed.
<references group="note">
<ref group="note" name="damage stamina recovery">The formula for this is <code>damage / 125</code>%</ref>
<ref group="note" name="damage vs instant kill">The table lists "100" if damage is dealt through <code>DamagePlayer()</code> (the highest damage amount in vanilla is 100) and "Instant Kill" if the player is killed directly through <code>KillPlayer()</Code>. When it comes to gameplay, both are functionally identical.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="cause of death unknown">"Unknown" is the default cause of death for many sources of damage. The Ghost Girl is the only source with a declared "Unknown" cause of death.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="hygrodere taming">The game requires the hygrodere to have a tamed timer above 0 and an angered timer ''below'' 0. As the latter starts at 0 and only decreases while ''above'' 0, this required the hygrodere to have been angered (by being hit or stunned) at least once before (and the value to have not decremented to ''exactly'' 0). If the hygrodere kills an employee, the angered timer is reset to 0.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="snare flea release">Upon trying to deal damage, if there are no other players connected and the employee has 15 or less health, the snare flea will release the employee instead of damaging them. A snare flea will not do this if it has attached to the employee previously.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="no jetpack qualification calculation">Minimum velocity required to take damage depends on the employee's angle. If they're more than 65 degrees from upright, the velocity required is 10. If more than 47 degrees, it is 12.5. Otherwise, it is 15. When moving faster than this, the game calculates a value <code>(currentVelocity - minimumVelocity) / 6</code>. It is then truncated and, if the jetpack controls are still active or the employee's angle is more than 50 degrees from vertical, 40 is added to it. Finally, this is clamped between 20 and 100 before being applied as damage to the employee.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="explosion range">Explosions in the game only affect objects whose colliders intersect a sphere with a radius of 6 units, centered on the explosion. Thus if the object's colliders are too small, they will be missed by the explosion even if they are within the damage range.</ref>
</references>

######## Damage/pt-br
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages />
Dano é uma das principais causas de morte em Lethal Company. É geralmente recebida de entidades, queda, torretas e funcionáries.

== Efeitos ==
Os efeitos exatos de dano dependem se for dado a ume funcionárie ou [[entities/pt-br|entidade]].

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Funcionáries ===
Funcionáries começam todo o dia com 100 de vida. Tomar dano que reduz ela para abaixo de 20 mostra um aviso de ferida crítica<ref name="critical injury" />, já que levar dano que reduz a vida delus para abaixo de 10 vai colocá-lus em um estado de criticamente feride, onde elus mancam e deixam uma trilha de sangue no chão e também são incapazes de correr.<ref name="damage player" /> Enquanto estiver abaixo de 20 de vida, funcionáries regenerarão 1 de vida a cada segundo, com o ferimento crítico sumir quando chegar a 20 de vida.<ref name="player healing" />
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Enquanto ume funcionárie não estiver criticamente feride, elus são incapazes de morrer ao sofrerem menos de 50 de dano, ao invés disso ficarão com 5 de vida.<ref name="damage player" /> Porém, já que isso ê põe em vida crítica, qualquer dano futuro será provavelmente letal, a não que a ameaça seja imediatamente neutralizada.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Quando recebem pelo menos 10 de dano, funcionáries regeneram de 8% a 100% de sua estâmina, dependendo da quantidade de dano recebido (porém, realisticamente, elus só conseguem recuperar até 79,2% da estâmina sem morrer e 72% sem estarem machucados demais para correrem).<ref name="damage player" /><ref group="note" name="damage stamina recovery" />
</div>

Funcináries não conseguem levar dano ou morrer enquanto estiverem em órbita.

=== Entidades ===
Entidades recebem dano de menos fontes do que funcionáries. Ou seja, quase todas as entidades não conseguem receber dano de outras entidades e elas não levam dano de tiros de torreta  e queda. Porém elas ainda são capazes de levar dano de raios, pás e escopetas ou morrerem por Leviatãs Terrestres.

A maioria das entidades podem ser mortas, mas muitas não recebem dano de nenhuma fonte.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Notas ==
Essa página foi atualizada pela última vez na versão 50, porém, ela ainda pode faltar informação ou conter informações desatualizadas. Coisas que não causam dano por <code>DamagePlayer()</code>, <code>KillPlayer()</code>, <code>HitEnemy()</code>, ou <code>KillEnemy()</code> podem ter sido esquecidas.
<references group="note">
<ref group="note" name="damage stamina recovery">A fórmula para isso é <code>damage / 125</code>%</ref>
<ref group="note" name="damage vs instant kill">A tabela lista 100 se o dano for dado por <code>DamagePlayer()</code> (a maior quantidade de dano no ''vanilla'' é 100) e "Morte súbita" se ê jogadore for mortê diretamente por <code>KillPlayer()</Code>. No jogo, ambos são idênticos.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="hygrodere taming">O jogo precisa que o Hygrodere tenha um ''timer'' de domado acima de 0 e um ''timer'' de enraivado ''abaixo'' de 0. Já que o segundo começa no 0 e só diminui quando estiver ''acima'' de 0, isso precisa que o Hygrodere tenha sido enraivado (por ser atingido ou atordoado) pelo menos uma vez antes ( e valor para não ter sido diminuído para ''exatamente'' 0). Se um Hygrodere matar ume funcionárie, o ''timer'' de enraivado é resetado para 0.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="snare flea release">Ao tentar dar dano, se não houver nenhum outre jogadore conectade e ê funcionárie tem 15 ou menos de vida, a Pulga 
traiçoeira soltará ê funcionárie ao invés de danificá-le. Uma pulga traiçoeira não fará isso caso ja tenha se prendido ae funcionárie antes.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="no jetpack qualification calculation">Velocidade mínima necessária para levar dano depende do ângulo de funcionárie. Se elu estiver acima de 65° de erete, a velocidade necessária é 10. Se acima de 47°, é 12,5. Acima disso é 15. Quando se move mais ráipo que isso, o jogo calcula um valor <code>(currentVelocity - minimumVelocity) / 6</code>. Se estiver tuncado e, se os controles da mochila à jato ainda estão ativos ou o ângulo de funcionárie está acima de 50 graus da vertical, 40 é adicionado a ele. Por último, isso é limitado enre 20 e 100 antes de ser aplicado como dano ae funcionárie.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="employee shovel damage">Funcionáries geralmente levam entre 20 e 40 de dano no golpe da pá. A causa disso é desconhecida; provavelmente é a ''hitbox'' da pá ultrapassando vários coledores e dando 10 de dano para cada.</ref>
<ref group="note" name="explosion range">Explosões no jogo só afetam objetos cujos coledores se interferem a uma esfera com um raio de 6 unidades, centrada na explosão. Então se os coledores do objeto são pequenos demais, eles não serão afetados pela explosão, mesmo se estiverem no alcance do dano.</ref>
</references>
</div>

######## Dine
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Dine
| image = MapOfDine.png
| routecost = 600
}}<translate>
<!--T:3-->
'''Dine''' is one of the three snowy [[Moons|moons]] together with [[Rend]] and [[Titan]]. It has a hazard level of "S", which makes it the third highest ranked moon in Lethal Company. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Dine is 600 credits. Dine has also had a map update in the version 50 beta.

== Description == <!--T:4-->
</translate>
{{Template:Terminal|text=7-Dine

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

<translate>
<!--T:5-->
CONDITIONS: Its planet orbits white dwarf star, making for inhospitable, cold conditions. Constant blizzards decrease visibility.

<!--T:6-->
HISTORY: Several famous travelers went missing here, giving it some reputation. Their bodies are unlikely to be found due to the planet's conditions.

<!--T:7-->
FAUNA: It's highly unlikely for complex life to exist here.</translate>}}

== Environment == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
Dine is a very snowy and rocky moon, orbiting a white dwarf star. The constant snowstorm is similar to Foggy weather on other moons, except it's less dense. The snowstorm not only makes it harder to see but also muffles voices and entity sounds. The lights unlike on [[Rend]] do not lead directly to or from the main entrance but instead are a dead end. Dine and its snowy counterpart [[Rend]] both have the [[Mansion]] as their default indoor layout, although the [[Mineshaft]] sometimes appears and there is a rare chance to have the [[Factory]] spawn instead.

== Strategy == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
The main entrance is slightly further away and is positioned almost directly ahead and slightly to the right of the ship's exit, albeit behind a lot of very rough and hilly terrain. Because of the large hills, there are multiple paths that can be taken to reach the main entrance but the best passes directly through a fence in the center of the map. The fire exit is located slightly to the left when leaving the ship and is closer than the main entrance. 

=== Weather === <!--T:12-->

==== Flooded ==== <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
Although Dine is in a constant snow-storm, it is possible for it to flood. The flood starts off blocking both entrances, but the water drains throughout the day, similarly to [[Adamance]]. Main entrance is still possible to reach and enter before drowning. The fire exit is easily accessible at any time with a [[Jetpack]].

==== Eclipsed ==== <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
Dine spawns at minimum all nighttime and 4 indoor entities at the start of the game. This makes it extremely dangerous to land on Dine when eclipsed and employees are strongly discouraged to do so.

<!--T:29-->
To deal with the immediate [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] that spawn in, it's advised to hug close to the hilly terrain and to cut corners quickly to lose their chase.

ZUSTÄNDE: Sein Planet umkreist einen weißen Zwerg, Its planet orbits white dwarf star, was für unwirtliche und kalte Bedingungen sorgt. Ständige Schneestürme beeinträchtigen die Sicht.

GESCHICHTE: Hier werden mehrere berühmte Reisende vermisst, was Dine einen gewissen Ruf einbrachte. Aufgrund der harschen Bedingungen auf dem Planeten ist es unwahrscheinlich, dass ihre Körper gefunden werden.

== Umwelt ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dine ist ein sehr verschneiter und felsiger Mond, der einen weißen Zwerg umkreist. Der ständige Schneesturm ähnelt dem nebligen Wetter auf anderen Monden, ist jedoch weniger dicht. Der Schneesturm erschwert nicht nur die Sicht, sondern dämpft auch Stimmen und andere Geräusche. Im Gegensatz zu [[Rend]] führen die Laternen nicht direkt zum oder vom Haupteingang, sondern sind eine Sackgasse. Dine und sein verschneiter Bruder [[Rend]] haben beide die [[Mansion]] als Standard-Innenkarte (obwohl es eine sehr seltene Chance gibt, dass stattdessen die [[Factory]] spawnt).

Dine hat keine Mobs, die zur Tageszeit spawnen.

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Spawn-Wahrscheinlichkeit ===

Auf Dine beginnen Nachtwesen gegen 15 Uhr zu spawnen. Die Spawnrate steigt stetig an, bis sie um 12 Uhr Mitternacht ihren Höhepunkt erreicht. Indoor-Mobs erscheinen auf Dine mit zwei leichten Ausschlägen als Ausnahme am Anfang und am Ende des Tages, sonst recht linear. Wesen der Tageszeit können nicht spawnen. Zur Interpretation siehe [[Mechanik]].

{{navbox moons}}

######## Dine/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Dine
| image = MapOfDine.png
| routecost = 600
}}'''Dine''' is one of the three snowy [[Moons|moons]] together with [[Rend]] and [[Titan]]. It has a hazard level of "S", which makes it the third highest ranked moon in Lethal Company. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Dine is 600 credits. Dine has also had a map update in the version 50 beta.

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=7-Dine

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Its planet orbits white dwarf star, making for inhospitable, cold conditions. Constant blizzards decrease visibility.

HISTORY: Several famous travelers went missing here, giving it some reputation. Their bodies are unlikely to be found due to the planet's conditions.

FAUNA: It's highly unlikely for complex life to exist here.}}
(This description is identical to [[Rend]]'s.)

== Environment ==

Dine is a very snowy and rocky moon, orbiting a white dwarf star. The constant snowstorm is similar to Foggy weather on other moons, except it's less dense. The snowstorm not only makes it harder to see but also muffles voices and entity sounds. The lights unlike on [[Rend]] do not lead directly to or from the main entrance but instead are a dead end. Dine and its snowy counterpart [[Rend]] both have the [[Mansion]] as their default indoor layout, although the [[Mineshaft]] sometimes appears and there is a rare chance to have the [[Factory]] spawn instead.

== Strategy ==

The main entrance is slightly further away and is positioned almost directly ahead and slightly to the right of the ship's exit, albeit behind a lot of very rough and hilly terrain. Because of the large hills, there are multiple paths that can be taken to reach the main entrance but the best passes directly through a fence in the center of the map. The fire exit is located slightly to the left when leaving the ship and is closer than the main entrance. 

=== Weather ===

==== Flooded ====

Although Dine is in a constant snow-storm, it is possible for it to flood. The flood starts off blocking both entrances, but the water drains throughout the day, similarly to [[Adamance]]. Main entrance is still possible to reach and enter before drowning. The fire exit is easily accessible at any time with a [[Jetpack]].

==== Eclipsed ====

Dine spawns at minimum all nighttime and 4 indoor entities at the start of the game. This makes it extremely dangerous to land on Dine when eclipsed and employees are strongly discouraged to do so.

To deal with the immediate [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] that spawn in, it's advised to hug close to the hilly terrain and to cut corners quickly to lose their chase.

== Loot table ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Dine}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|facility=y|nutcrackers=y|butlers=y}}
== Entities ==

=== Indoor ===

The most common threat on Dine is the [[Butler]], you will usually find several spawned in the facility at around the time you manage out your first trip of scrap.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
=== Nighttime ===

[[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]] and [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] are the most common nighttime entities on Dine. In a similar fashion to [[Rend]], if multiple nighttime entities spawned together, they can pose a significant threat to employee safety if not handled correctly.

To best manage, it's advised to sneak around the hilly terrain and to keep the sprint bar high for quick dashes away from forest keepers if they manage to lock onto you.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}

=== Daytime ===

Dine does not support daytime entities.

=== Spawn chance curves ===

On Dine, nighttime entities start spawning at around 3pm. This rate steadily increases until it peaks at 12am. Indoor entities spawn in a linear fashion on Dine with two smooth peaks at the beginning and at the end of the day. Daytime entities are unable to spawn. See [[Mechanics]] for interpretation.
[[File:Dine_spawn_curve.png|950px]]

######## Dine/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Dine
| image = MapOfDine.png
| routecost = 600
}}'''Dine''' - одна из трёх снежных [[Moons/ru|лун]] вместе с [[Rend/ru|Rend]] и [[Titan/ru|Titan]]. Имеет уровень риска "S", делающий её третьей сложнейшей луной в Lethal Company. Стоимость перелёта на орбиту Dine составляет 600 кредитов. Также карта Dine была обновлена в бете версии 50.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=7-Dine

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: Планета на орбите вокруг белого карлика, что создаёт на ней неприветливые, холодные условия. Постоянные снежные бури ухудшают видимость.

ИСТОРИЯ: Несколько популярных путешественников сгинули здесь, создавая этому месту "репутацию". Их тела уже вряд ли можно найти из-за погодных условий.

ФАУНА: Маловероятно наличие сложных форм жизни.}}
(Описание идентично таковому у [[Rend/ru|Rend]].)

<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dine - очень заснеженная и каменистая луна на орбите вокруг белого карлика. Постоянные снежные бури подобны туману на других лунах за исключением того, что они чуть менее густые. Снежные бури не только ухудшают видимость, но и приглушают голоса и звуки сущностей. Фонарные столбы в отличие от [[Rend/ru|Rend]] не ведут к или от главного входа, а заводят в тупик. Dine и её снежный партнёр [[Rend/ru|Rend]] обе обладают [[Особняк|Особняком]] в роли их основного интерьера, хотя часто встречаются и [[Шахты]], а также есть редкий шанс вместо них появиться [[Завод|Заводу]].
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Главный вход находится немного дальше и расположен почти прямо напротив и чуть правее выхода из корабля, хотя и спрятан за неровной и холмистой местностью. Из-за высоких холмов к главному входу можно пройти несколькими путями, но самый удобный пролегает прямо через забор в середине карты. Пожарный выход расположен ближе и находится чуть левее при выходе из корабля. 

<span id="Weather"></span>
=== Погода ===

<span id="Flooded"></span>
==== Потоп ====

Хотя Dine и находится в состоянии постоянной снежной бури, каким-то образом на ней может произойти потоп. Потоп сразу блокирует доступ к обоим входам подобно [[Adamance/ru|Adamance]]. До главного входа всё ещё можно добраться, не утонув. Пожарный выход доступен в любое время при наличии [[Jetpack|ракетного ранца]].

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
==== Затмение ====

На Dine появляются как минимум все ночные сущности и 4 внутри здания в начале игры. Это делает посадку на Dine опасной во время затмения и сотрудникам строго не рекомендуется так поступать.

Чтобы справиться с появляющимися сразу [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранителями Леса]] рекомендуется идти вплотную к холмам и срезать углы, чтобы уйти от преследования.

<span id="Loot_table"></span>
== Таблица лута ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Dine}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|facility=y|nutcrackers=y|butlers=y}}
<span id="Entities"></span>
== Сущности ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Внутри здания ===

Самой частой опасностью на Dine является [[Butler|Дворецкий]], к моменту завершения первой ходки со скрапом в здании уже будет несколько штук.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== Ночные ===

[[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепые Псы]] и [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранители Леса]] являются самыми частыми ночными сущностями на Dine. Как и на [[Rend/ru|Rend]], если множество ночных сущностей появятся вместе, то они станут значительной угрозой безопасности сотрудников если неуметь справляться с ними.

Чтобы справиться с ночными сущностями, рекомендуется постоянно передвигаться вприсяди и сохранять полоску спринта для быстрых рывков от хранителей леса, если тем удастся вас заметить.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}

<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== Дневные ===

Dine не поддерживает условия для жизни дневных сущностей.

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Кривые шансов спавна ===

На Dine ночные сущности начинают появляться около 3 часов дня. Скорость их появления плавно растёт с пиком в полночь. Сущности внутри здания появляются с линейной частотой с двумя гладкими пиками в начале и конце дня. Дневные сущности появиться не могут. Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.
[[File:Dine_spawn_curve.png|950px]]

######## Dine/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Dine
| image = MapOfDine.png
| routecost = 600
}}'''Dine''' 是 3 个终年积雪的[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]之一，另外 2 个是 [[Rend/zh-cn|Rend]] 和 [[Titan/zh-cn|Titan]]。Dine 的危险等级为“S”，是游戏内第三难的星球。将飞船导航到该星球的环绕轨道上需要 600 点数。Dine 的地图在版本 50 重做过一次。

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=7-Dine

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：此星球绕白矮星运行，因此环境寒冷且不宜居住。长期的暴风雪使能见度降低。

历史：多位著名旅行者在此失踪，该星球的知名度因此有所提升。考虑到星球的环境条件，这些旅行者的尸体大概率无法找回。

生态：几乎不可能存在复杂生命体。}}
（此描述与[[Rend]]的描述完全一致。）

<span id="Environment"></span>
== 环境 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dine是一颗终年大雪覆盖、岩石遍布的卫星，围绕一颗白矮星运行。持续的暴风雪效果与其他卫星的大雾天气类似，只是浓度更低。暴风雪不仅会降低能见度，还会模糊人声和实体的声响。
与[[Rend]]不同，这里的路灯并不会直接连通主入口内外，而是通向一处死胡同。
戴因与其同为积雪星球的[[Rend]]，默认室内地图均为[[Mansion|豪宅]] （尽管有极低概率会刷新为[[Factory|工厂]]）。
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

主入口距离稍远，位置大致在飞船出口的正前方偏右一点，只不过隔着大片崎岖不平的丘陵地形。
由于山丘众多，前往主入口有多条路线可选，但最佳路线是直接穿过地图中央的一道围栏。
安全出口位于飞船出口的左侧不远处，比主入口更近。 

<span id="Weather"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 天气 ==
</div>

<span id="Flooded"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 洪水 ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
尽管Dine常年暴风雪肆虐，但仍有可能莫名发生洪水。洪水一开始会完全堵住主入口，没有[[Jetpack|喷气背包]]根本无法进入；不过，水位会像[[Adamance]]那样逐渐下降。消防通道一开始完全可以通行，是最便捷的进入路线。
</div>

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 日食 ===
</div>

Dine在游戏开局时，至少会刷新全部夜间生物以及4种室内实体。这使得在日食期间登陆戴Dine极为危险，因此强烈不建议员工这么做。

要应对即刻刷新出来的[[Forest Keepers|森林守护者]]，建议紧贴丘陵地形行进，并快速切角转弯来摆脱它们的追击。

<span id="Entities"></span>
== 实体 ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== 室内 ===

在Dine最常见的威胁是*[[Butler|管家]]。通常在你第一次外出搜刮废料时，设施内就会刷新出好几只管家。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== 夜间 ===

[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]和[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]是 Dine 上最常见的夜间实体。与 [[Rend/zh-cn|Rend]] 类似，如果同时生成了多个夜间实体且处理不当，它们能对玩家造成极大威胁。

想要更好地应对，建议在丘陵地带潜行移动，并保持冲刺条处于较高水平，以便在被森林守护者锁定时能快速冲刺脱身。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}

<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== 日间 ===

Dine 不会生成日间实体。

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== 生成概率曲线 ===

Dine 的夜间实体会在下午3点左右开始生成。其生成概率稳定增长，直到午夜12点达到峰值。室内实体的生成概率则呈线性增长趋势，在一天的开始及快要结束时存在两个平滑高峰。日间实体无法生成。曲线的绘制方法详见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。

######## Draft:Translation Guidelines
This page serves as a set of guidelines for translating Lethal Company Wiki into another language. These guidelines, alongside the rest of the wiki, are a work in progress and open to discussion and change as the community deems fit. 

All the guidelines are categorized and formatted in the format of [[#Example section]].

== Example section ==

A brief summary of this section. ''Key words'' like '''SHOULD''' may appear.

'''MUST'''

* Rule A.
:Additional information about Rule A.

'''NOT RECOMMENDED'''

* Rule B.

'''MAY'''

* Rule C.
* Rule D.

That is, when dealing with things related with this section, you
* must follow Rule A by all means.
* could follow Rule B, although it is not recommended.
* may or may not follow Rule C and Rule D. They are optional.

For capitalized and bolded ''key words'' such as '''MUST''', '''RECOMMENDED''', '''SHOULD NOT''', '''MAY''', etc., please refer to [https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2119 RFC 2119] for precise definitions.

Below are the actual guidelines.

== General ==

Here are the general rules to follow when translating.

'''MUST'''

* Translate as-is.
:Due to the mechanism of MediaWiki's [[mw:Extension:Translate]], one may notice that the page content differs with the [[Special:Translate|Translate Tool]]. Ignore the differences, only translate what you see in the Translate Tool.

'''SHOULD'''

* Familiarize yourself with [[metawikimedia:Help:Wikitext_examples|Wikitext]].

== Links ==

Take an interwiki link <code><nowiki>[[Weather]]</nowiki></code>, and language Chinese (China) for example.

<blockquote>
The Chinese (China) translation of "weather" is "天气".<!--

The Chinese (China) translation of "eclipsed" is "日食".-->
</blockquote>

'''MUST'''

* Link to the correct target page.
:For example, <code><nowiki>[[天气]]</nowiki></code> links to [[天气]], not the actual [[Weather]] page. Instead, write <code><nowiki>[[Weather|天气]]</nowiki></code>. The result is [[Weather|天气]], with correct target page and translated link text.

'''RECOMMENDED'''

* If the target page is available in your language, update the link accordingly.
:For example, [[Weather/zh-cn]] is available. You could write <code><nowiki>[[Weather/zh-cn|天气]]</nowiki></code> to make it easier for readers, as they don't need to switch languages themselves.
<!-- Anchors like [[Page#Anchor]]? -->

== Machine translation ==

Machine translations, particularly for those generated by [[w:Large language model|LLMs]], can be valuable references in certain situations, and you '''MAY''' use machine translations to assist your translation process. However, before harnessing the capabilities of machine translations, it is important to:

'''MUST NOT'''

* Directly submit machine translations.

== Ending ==

As you've come across this message, we trust that you are familiar with the guidelines outlined above. We sincerely appreciate your willingness to translate this wiki, and we deeply respect and value your efforts!

== Mechanics == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
'''Earth Leviathans''' will spawn during [[Entities#Nighttime_(Outdoor)|nighttime]] on [[moons]] in which they appear, burrowed in the ground. They will roam around underground looking for a target, erupting after a short delay when a player is above them. An attack from an Earth Leviathan is always fatal and leaves no body to recover or [[Teleporter|Teleport]] back. Held items will also be consumed, but dropped items will be unaffected and will remain there.

<!--T:14-->
Earth Leviathans have two possible behavioral states, as described below:

=== Roaming === <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
Earth Leviathans will roam the map, seeking players at a speed of 4 units per second. When a player is not in close proximity (10 units) to the ship, and is within 15 units of an Earth Leviathan, it targets the player and switches to attack mode.</translate><ref name="sc_updating">[https://pastebin.com/HeU1F7wd SandwormAI - Updating]</ref>
<translate>
=== Attacking === <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
Earth Leviathans will keep chasing the targeted employee, and will emerge from the ground under specific conditions.

==== Chase timer ==== <!--T:19-->

<!--T:20-->
During this state, Earth Leviathans maintain an internal chase timer. If the targeted employee meets '''all''' the following conditions:<ref name="sc_updating"/>

<!--T:21-->
* Is reachable to the Earth Leviathan,
* Is outside of the ship,
* Is within 22 units of the Earth Leviathan,

<!--T:22-->
the timer will reset to 0. Otherwise, it will count the time until the Earth Leviathan abandons the chase. Additionally, the timer also resets if the Earth Leviathan changes its behavioral state.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

<!--T:23-->
If the chase timer exceeds 6 seconds, <u>or the target employee is more than 19 units away from the Earth Leviathan</u><sup>[unverified]</sup>, it returns to roaming mode. Otherwise, when '''all''' four of the following conditions are met:

<!--T:24-->
* The chase timer is less than 1.5 seconds,
* The target employee is within 4 units of the Earth Leviathan,
* The Earth Leviathan is not within 9 units of ship,
* Successfully passes a 17% chance,

<!--T:25-->
the Earth Leviathan will emerge from the ground.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

==== Emerging ==== <!--T:26-->

<!--T:27-->
When the Earth Leviathan is about to emerge, an animation of dust particles rising from the ground begins to play around its emerge position. After a random interval between 1s to 3s, the Earth Leviathan emerges <tvar name="ref_sc_emerging"><ref name="sc_emerging">[https://pastebin.com/LhmdCn86 SandwormAI - Emerging]</ref></tvar>, killing any employee or killable entity in its path during its emergence <tvar name="ref_sc_oncollide"><ref name="sc_oncollide">[https://pastebin.com/e7Ccxxze SandwormAI - OnCollide]</ref></tvar>.

<!--T:28-->
10 seconds after it returns to the ground<ref name="sc_emerging"/>, the Earth Leviathan will reset its status, switching back to its roaming state.

== Strategy == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
The presence of an Earth Leviathan can be ascertained by listening for underground groaning sounds, and its attack is telegraphed by a distinct low growl as particles of dirt jump out of the ground. An Earth Leviathan cannot be killed and is present on every moon, so caution should be taken during nighttime when roaming outside. Avoid staying too close to your teammates, as one can kill your whole team at once if it catches you off guard. Keep some distance to minimize casualties, but stay close enough to warn each other if you notice something hostile. If necessary, use a Walkie Talkie, the Signal Translator, and the ship's Radar in order to warn your team of an Earth Leviathan before it gets the chance to strike.

<!--T:12-->
Despite the Earth Leviathan's bestiary entry advising the employee to "retrace your steps", this strategy rarely results in surviving an attack and often places you directly in the middle of its hitbox. Often times, when it begins growling, you are already at risk of being eaten. Instead, it is advised to drop any items you are carrying and run towards any area elevated from the ground. Examples of this include (but are not limited to): The ship, any ladders, large structures, or pipes. Entering the interior of the moon will also work, but the worm may still be at the door that you entered when you exit. If you cannot run towards one of these areas, dropping your items and running straight forwards will also help you survive.

<!--T:35-->
A very easy way to counter the worm is drop all items once you hear the first roar, walk around, then sprint as soon as the clouds of smoke arise.
</translate>

== Bestiary Entry ==
{{quote bestiary|EarthLeviathan}}

== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== Mechanics ==

'''Earth Leviathans''' will spawn during [[Entities#Nighttime_(Outdoor)|nighttime]] on [[moons]] in which they appear, burrowed in the ground. They will roam around underground looking for a target, erupting after a short delay when a player is above them. An attack from an Earth Leviathan is always fatal and leaves no body to recover or [[Teleporter|Teleport]] back. Held items will also be consumed, but dropped items will be unaffected and will remain there.

Earth Leviathans have two possible behavioral states, as described below:

=== Roaming ===

Earth Leviathans will roam the map, seeking players at a speed of 4 units per second. When a player is not in close proximity (10 units) to the ship, and is within 15 units of an Earth Leviathan, it targets the player and switches to attack mode.<ref name="sc_updating">[https://pastebin.com/HeU1F7wd SandwormAI - Updating]</ref>
=== Attacking ===

Earth Leviathans will keep chasing the targeted employee, and will emerge from the ground under specific conditions.

==== Chase timer ====

During this state, Earth Leviathans maintain an internal chase timer. If the targeted employee meets '''all''' the following conditions:<ref name="sc_updating"/>

* Is reachable to the Earth Leviathan,
* Is outside of the ship,
* Is within 22 units of the Earth Leviathan,

the timer will reset to 0. Otherwise, it will count the time until the Earth Leviathan abandons the chase. Additionally, the timer also resets if the Earth Leviathan changes its behavioral state.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

If the chase timer exceeds 6 seconds, <u>or the target employee is more than 19 units away from the Earth Leviathan</u><sup>[unverified]</sup>, it returns to roaming mode. Otherwise, when '''all''' four of the following conditions are met:

* The chase timer is less than 1.5 seconds,
* The target employee is within 4 units of the Earth Leviathan,
* The Earth Leviathan is not within 9 units of ship,
* Successfully passes a 17% chance,

the Earth Leviathan will emerge from the ground.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

==== Emerging ====

When the Earth Leviathan is about to emerge, an animation of dust particles rising from the ground begins to play around its emerge position. After a random interval between 1s to 3s, the Earth Leviathan emerges <ref name="sc_emerging">[https://pastebin.com/LhmdCn86 SandwormAI - Emerging]</ref>, killing any employee or killable entity in its path during its emergence <ref name="sc_oncollide">[https://pastebin.com/e7Ccxxze SandwormAI - OnCollide]</ref>.

10 seconds after it returns to the ground<ref name="sc_emerging"/>, the Earth Leviathan will reset its status, switching back to its roaming state.

== Strategy ==

The presence of an Earth Leviathan can be ascertained by listening for underground groaning sounds, and its attack is telegraphed by a distinct low growl as particles of dirt jump out of the ground. An Earth Leviathan cannot be killed and is present on every moon, so caution should be taken during nighttime when roaming outside. Avoid staying too close to your teammates, as one can kill your whole team at once if it catches you off guard. Keep some distance to minimize casualties, but stay close enough to warn each other if you notice something hostile. If necessary, use a Walkie Talkie, the Signal Translator, and the ship's Radar in order to warn your team of an Earth Leviathan before it gets the chance to strike.

Despite the Earth Leviathan's bestiary entry advising the employee to "retrace your steps", this strategy rarely results in surviving an attack and often places you directly in the middle of its hitbox. Often times, when it begins growling, you are already at risk of being eaten. Instead, it is advised to drop any items you are carrying and run towards any area elevated from the ground. Examples of this include (but are not limited to): The ship, any ladders, large structures, or pipes. Entering the interior of the moon will also work, but the worm may still be at the door that you entered when you exit. If you cannot run towards one of these areas, dropping your items and running straight forwards will also help you survive.

A very easy way to counter the worm is drop all items once you hear the first roar, walk around, then sprint as soon as the clouds of smoke arise.

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mechaniki ==

'''Wielkie Lewiatany''' pojawiają się w czasie [[Entities#Nighttime_(Outdoor)/pl|nocy]] na [[Moons/pl|księżycach]] pod powierzchnią ziemi. Patrolują pod ziemią poszukując swojej zdobyczy, a gdy pracownik znajdzie się nad nimi, wylatują z ziemi po krótkim odstępie czasu. Ataki Wielkich Lewiatanów jest zawsze śmiertelny i nie pozostawia ciała do odzyskania czy [[Teleporter/pl|przeteleportowania]]. Trzymane przedmioty także znikną, ale nie te rzucone na ziemię, które zostaną nienaruszone.

Wielkie Lewiatany mają dwa możliwe stany zachowawcze, jak opisane poniżej:

<span id="Roaming"></span>
=== Patrolowanie ===

Wielkie Lewiatany patrolują mapę, szukając pracowników z prędkością 4 jednostek na sekundę. Jeżeli pracownik nie jest w pobliżu (10 jednostek) statku oraz jest w promieniu 15 jednostek od Wielkiego Lewiatana, to ten namierza na pracownika i zmienia się na stan atakujący.<ref name="sc_updating">[https://pastebin.com/HeU1F7wd SandwormAI - Updating]</ref>
<span id="Attacking"></span>
=== Atakowanie ===

Wielki Lewiatan będzie kontynuować ściganie pracownika i wyłoni się z ziemi w określonych warunkach.

<span id="Chase_timer"></span>
==== Zegar ścigania ====

Podczas tego stanu, Wielkie Lewiatany przetrzymują swój wewnętrzny zegar ścigania. Jeśli ścigany pracownik spełni '''wszystkie''' warunki:<ref name="sc_updating"/>

* Jest dosięgalny przez Wielkiego Lewiatana,
* Jest poza statkiem,
* Jest w zasięgu 22 jednostek od Wielkiego Lewiatana,

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
zegar będzie nadal odliczał. W przeciwnym razie resetuje się do 0. Dodatkowo licznik czasu resetuje się również, jeśli Ziemski Lewiatan zmieni swój stan.<ref name="sc_updating"/>
</div>

Jeśli zegar ścigania przekroczy 6, <u>lub wycelowany pracownik jest 19 jednostek od Wielkiego Lewiatana</u><sup>[niezweryfikowane]</sup>, powraca do stanu patrolowania. W przeciwnym razie, kiedy '''wszystkie''' cztery z poniższych warunków zostanie spełnione:

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* Zegar ścigania jest mniejszy niż 1.5 sekundy,
* Ścigany pracownik jest w promieniu 4 jednostek od Wielkiego Lewiatana,
* Pracownik nie jest w promieniu 9 jednostek od statku,
* Pomyślnie spełni 17% prawdopodobieństwa,
</div>

Wielki Lewiatan wyleci spod ziemi.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

<span id="Emerging"></span>
==== Wylatywanie ====

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kiedy Wielki Lewiatan ma zamiar wylecieć, animacja cząstek rozpocznie się w jego okolicy na powierzchni, przedstawiający pył unoszący się z ziemi. Po losowo wybranym czasie pomiędzy 0.33s a 2s Wielki Lewiatan wyleci <ref name="sc_emerging">[https://pastebin.com/LhmdCn86 SandwormAI - Emerging]</ref>, zabijając każdego pracownika lub zabijalny byt na swojej drodze <ref name="sc_oncollide">[https://pastebin.com/e7Ccxxze SandwormAI - OnCollide]</ref>.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Następnie po 10 sekundach powróci pod ziemię<ref name="sc_emerging"/> i Wielki Lewiatan zresetuje swój status, powracając do stanu patrolowania.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategia ==

Obecność Wielkiego Lewiatana można stwierdzić nasłuchując podziemnych pomruków, a jego atak sygnalizowany jest wyraźnym, niskim warczeniem, gdy cząsteczki ziemi wyskakują z ziemi. Wielkiego Lewiatana nie można zabić i występuje on na każdym księżycu, dlatego należy zachować ostrożność w nocy, podczas chodzenia na zewnątrz. Unikaj przebywania zbyt blisko członków swojej drużyny, ponieważ może zabić on całą drużynę na raz, jeśli cię zaskoczy. Zachowaj pewną odległość, aby zminimalizować straty, ale pozostań wystarczająco blisko, aby ostrzec się nawzajem, jeśli zauważysz coś wrogiego. Jeśli to konieczne, użyj [[Walkie-Talkie/pl|krótkofalówki]], [[Signal Translator/pl|nadajnika sygnału]] lub [[Ship#Main monitor/pl|radaru statku]], aby ostrzec swoją drużynę przed Wielkim Lewiatanem, zanim będzie miał szansę zaskoczyć.

Pomimo wpisu w bestiariuszu Wielkiego Lewiatana, który radzi pracownikowi, aby „od razu zawrócił”, strategia ta rzadko skutkuje przetrwaniem ataku i często umieszcza cię bezpośrednio w środku jego pola rażenia. Często, gdy zaczyna warczeć, istnieje już ryzyko, że zostaniesz pożarty. Zamiast tego zaleca się porzucenie wszelkich przenoszonych przedmiotów i pobiegnięcie w stronę dowolnego obszaru znajdującego się nad ziemią. Przykładami tego (ale nie ograniczają się tylko do tych) są między innymi: statek, wszelkie drabiny, duże konstrukcje lub rury. Wejście do wnętrza na księżycu Księżyca również zadziała, ale robak może nadal znajdować się przy drzwiach, którymi wszedłeś, kiedy będziesz wychodzić. Jeśli nie możesz dobiec do jednego z tych obszarów, upuszczenie przedmiotów i biegnięcie przed siebie również pomoże ci przetrwać.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A very easy way to counter the worm is drop all items once you hear the first roar, walk around, then sprint as soon as the clouds of smoke arise.
</div>
