<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== Шансы появления ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

'''Земные Левиафаны''' появляются ночью. Они будут блуждать под землёй в поисках цели, извергаясь из земли после небольшой задержки, если над ними игрок. Атаки Земного Левиафана всегда летальная и не оставляет после себя тела для возвращения или [[Teleporter|телепорта]]. Предметы в инвентаре также будут съедены, но заранее выброшенные не пострадают и останутся на месте.

У Земных Левиафанов есть два возможных состояния поведения, описанных ниже:

<span id="Roaming"></span>
=== Блуждание ===

Земные Левиафаны блуждают по карте в поисках игроков со скоростью в 4 единицы в секунду. Когда игрок дальше 10 единиц от корабля и в пределах 15 единиц от Земного Левиафана, последний нацеливается на игрока и переходит в атаку.<ref name="sc_updating">[https://pastebin.com/HeU1F7wd SandwormAI - Updating]</ref>
<span id="Attacking"></span>
=== Атака ===

Земные Левиафаны будут преследовать выбранного сотрудника и извергнутся из под земли при особых условиях.

<span id="Chase_timer"></span>
==== Таймер преследования ====

В этом состоянии Земные Левиафаны будут вести внутренний таймер преследования. Если сотрудник соответствует '''всем''' нижеследующим условиям:<ref name="sc_updating"/>

* Достигаем Земным Левиафаном,
* Снаружи корабля,
* В пределах 22 единиц от Земного Левиафана,

таймер сбросится до нуля. В ином случае он продолжить считать, пока Земной Левиафан не бросит погоню. Дополнительно, таймер также сбрасывается, если Земной Левиафан сменил состояние поведения.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

Если таймер преследования превышает 6 секунд, <u>или целевой сотрудник дальше 19 единиц от Земного Левиафана</u><sup>[не подтверждено]</sup>, он возвращается в состояние блуждания. В ином случае, когда '''все''' четыре нижеследующих условия выполняются:

* Таймер преследования меньше 1.5 секунды,
* Целевой сотрудник в пределах 4 единиц от Земного Левиафана,
* Земной Левиафан вне пределов 9 единиц от корабля,
* Успешно прошёл шанс в 17%,

Земной Левиафан извергнется из под земли.<ref name="sc_updating"/>

<span id="Emerging"></span>
==== Извержение ====

Когда Земной Левиафан собирается извергнуться, рядом с его позицией будет проигрывать анимация частиц, изображающих поднимающуюся с земли пыль. После случайного интервала между 1с и 3с, Земной Левиафан извергается <ref name="sc_emerging">[https://pastebin.com/LhmdCn86 SandwormAI - Emerging]</ref>, убивая любого сотрудника или убиваемую сущность на своём пути во время извержения <ref name="sc_oncollide">[https://pastebin.com/e7Ccxxze SandwormAI - OnCollide]</ref>.

Затем, спустя 10 секунд после возвращения под землю<ref name="sc_emerging"/>, Земной Левиафан сбрасывает своё состояние, возвращаясь в состояние блуждания.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Присутствие Земного Левиафана можно определить по подземным гортанным звукам, а его атака телеграфируется отличительным низким рыком и частицам, исходящим от земли. Земного Левиафана нельзя убить и он присутствует на всех лунах, так что при блуждании снаружи ночью нужно быть аккуратным. Следует держаться подальше от команды, так как атаковав одного сотрудника Земной Левиафан за один раз может съесть весь экипаж. Следует держаться достаточно далеко, чтобы не умереть всем сразу, но достаточно близко, чтобы оповещать друг друга о противниках. Если необходимо - используй рацию, радарный усилитель и корабельный радар, чтобы предупредить команду о Земном Левиафана до того, как тому выдастся шанс атаковать.

Несмотря на то, что запись Земного Левиафана в Бестиарии советует сотруднику "возвращаться, как пришёл", эта стратегия редко позволяет игроку выжить и зачастую наоборот, приводит игрока прямо в середину хитбокса атаки. Часто, когда слышен рык, шансы быть съеденным уже очень высоки. Вместо этого рекомендуется сбросить весь лишний груз и бежать к любой приподнятой поверхности. Примеры таковых включают (но не ограничиваются): корабль, лестницы, огромные структуры или трубы. Вход в здание также поможет избежать атаки, но червь может поджидать под той же дверью, через которую зашла жертва. Если ничего из этого достичь невозможно, сброс всех вещей и бег вперёд также поможет выжить.

Лёгкий способ противостоять червю - бросить всё как только был услышан первый рёв, начать ходить кругами и при первом появлении запыления и кусочков земли начать бежать.

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== 机制 ==

'''大地利维坦'''会在[[Entities/zh-cn#夜间（室外）|夜间]]生成，生成时藏匿于[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]地下。它会在地下漫游并寻找目标；若玩家位于它上方，它会在短暂的延迟过后冲出地面。大地利维坦的攻击总是直接致命的且不会生成尸体，因此无法找回死亡的玩家，用[[Teleporter|传送器]]也不行。玩家所持有的物品也会直接消失，不过丢在地上的物品并不会受影响。

大地利维坦有两种行动状态，如下所述：

<span id="Roaming"></span>
=== 漫游 ===

大地利维坦会在地图中漫游，以 4 单位/秒的速度寻找玩家。如果有玩家距离大地利维坦在 15 单位内，且同时玩家未在飞船附近 10 单位距离内，大地利维坦会标记该玩家并进入攻击状态。<ref name="sc_updating">[https://pastebin.com/HeU1F7wd SandwormAI - Updating]</ref>
<span id="Attacking"></span>
=== 攻击 ===

大地利维坦会持续追逐目标员工，并会在特定条件下冲出地面。

<span id="Chase_timer"></span>
==== 追逐计时器 ====

在此状态下，大地利维坦会在追逐期间计时。如果目标员工同时满足以下'''所有'''条件：<ref name="sc_updating"/>

* 大地利维坦能够接近玩家；
* 玩家不在飞船内；
* 玩家距离大地利维坦在 22 单位内，

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
计时器会持续计时。否则，计时器将重置为 0。此外，大地利维坦在切换行动状态时也会重置计时器。<ref name="sc_updating"/>
</div>

如果追逐计时器超过 6 秒，<u>或目标员工距离大地利维坦超过 19 单位远</u><sup>[尚未证实]</sup>，大地利维坦会切换回漫游状态。否则，若以下'''所有'''条件成立：

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* 追逐计时器少于 1.5 秒；
* 目标员工距离大地利维坦在 4 单位内；
* 员工不在飞船 9 单位距离内；
* 通过 17% 的概率判定，
</div>

大地利维坦会冲出地面。<ref name="sc_updating"/>

<span id="Emerging"></span>
==== 冲出地面 ====

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在大地利维坦即将冲出地面之前，冲出位置附近会播放粒子动画，具体表现为地面上的尘土被扬起。在 0.33~2 秒的随机延迟后，大地利维坦会冲出地面<ref name="sc_emerging">[https://pastebin.com/LhmdCn86 SandwormAI - Emerging]</ref>，并在此过程中杀死任何与其发生碰撞的员工或可击杀实体<ref name="sc_oncollide">[https://pastebin.com/e7Ccxxze SandwormAI - OnCollide]</ref>。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在大地利维坦落回地面的 10 秒后<ref name="sc_emerging"/>，它会重置自身状态，开始漫游。
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The presence of an Earth Leviathan can be ascertained by listening for underground groaning sounds, and its attack is telegraphed by a distinct low growl as particles of dirt jump out of the ground. An Earth Leviathan cannot be killed and is present on every moon, so caution should be taken during nighttime when roaming outside. Avoid staying too close to your teammates, as one can kill your whole team at once if it catches you off guard. Keep some distance to minimize casualties, but stay close enough to warn each other if you notice something hostile. If necessary, use a Walkie Talkie, the Signal Translator, and the ship's Radar in order to warn your team of an Earth Leviathan before it gets the chance to strike.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Despite the Earth Leviathan's bestiary entry advising the employee to "retrace your steps", this strategy rarely results in surviving an attack and often places you directly in the middle of its hitbox. Often times, when it begins growling, you are already at risk of being eaten. Instead, it is advised to drop any items you are carrying and run towards any area elevated from the ground. Examples of this include (but are not limited to): The ship, any ladders, large structures, or pipes. Entering the interior of the moon will also work, but the worm may still be at the door that you entered when you exit. If you cannot run towards one of these areas, dropping your items and running straight forwards will also help you survive.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A very easy way to counter the worm is drop all items once you hear the first roar, walk around, then sprint as soon as the clouds of smoke arise.
</div>

######## Easter egg
{{topicon Fandom|Easter_Egg}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item

<translate>
<!--T:4-->
The Easter egg is a small, colorful egg with 5 [[#Variants|variants]]. It can be thrown with {{keybind|Item primary use}}, and has a small chance to explode upon hitting the ground. The chances of an Easter egg exploding are the same regardless of whether it's been dropped, thrown, or placed inside of another object such as the [[Cupboard]]. Upon exploding, it will shoot confetti and deal up to 5 damage to entities (or 100 damage to players) if they're close enough. Easter eggs will also give extremely high knockback to employees when exploded.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The Easter egg works off of a coordinate system where some spots will always lead to explosions and other spots will always lead to no explosion. These spots are randomized each time When an egg is thrown, it may snap to a location on the ground, as it is locking to the closest coordinate to where the egg should have landed. For example, if one egg that is placed at the company counter explodes, it should be expected that other eggs will also explode when placed in the same spot (a different spot in the counter can contain a coordinate leading to no explosion).
</translate>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
A [[landmine]] can be detonated safely by throwing an Easter egg across it, which still risks the egg exploding.

<!--T:9-->
The explosion from an Easter egg can instantly set a [[Forest Giant]] on fire, causing it to die shortly afterwards.

== Variants == <!--T:11-->
</translate>

* Striped red/blue/yellow
* Solid blue
* Green with a yellow pattern
* Rainbow
* Brown-ish with purple spots

The default appearance is the red/blue/yellow striped egg, which will be chosen upon reloading a save file containing the item due to the game not remembering item variants.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:16-->
The audio for dropping an Easter egg can be heard throughout the entire map in-game, although it is quiet.

<!--T:10-->
<u>Before [[v62]]:</u> It's possible to entirely avoid the possibility of Easter eggs exploding. This is done by setting your game's framerate to 30FPS, then performing the following steps (as the ''host of the lobby'') - Hold the Easter egg, crouch on flat terrain without moving, look all the way down, and drop the item. If done right the egg will be placed gently without making a drop sound. It is very important that this is done by the host, because although a client can perform this exploit without it exploding on their end, the egg still may explode for the host anyways which will cause it to be unretrievable.
</translate>

######## Easter egg/en
{{topicon Fandom|Easter_Egg}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=Slides after thrown
|audible=When dropped or exploding
|primary-use=<q>Toss egg</q>
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
The Easter egg is a small, colorful egg with 5 [[#Variants|variants]]. It can be thrown with {{keybind|Item primary use}}, and has a small chance to explode upon hitting the ground. The chances of an Easter egg exploding are the same regardless of whether it's been dropped, thrown, or placed inside of another object such as the [[Cupboard]]. Upon exploding, it will shoot confetti and deal up to 5 damage to entities (or 100 damage to players) if they're close enough. Easter eggs will also give extremely high knockback to employees when exploded.
== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
The Easter egg works off of a coordinate system where some spots will always lead to explosions and other spots will always lead to no explosion. These spots are randomized each time When an egg is thrown, it may snap to a location on the ground, as it is locking to the closest coordinate to where the egg should have landed. For example, if one egg that is placed at the company counter explodes, it should be expected that other eggs will also explode when placed in the same spot (a different spot in the counter can contain a coordinate leading to no explosion).
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
A [[landmine]] can be detonated safely by throwing an Easter egg across it, which still risks the egg exploding.

The explosion from an Easter egg can instantly set a [[Forest Giant]] on fire, causing it to die shortly afterwards.

== Variants ==
[[File:Easter eggs on shelf.png|thumb|Each variant of Easter egg resting on a [[Facility]] shelf]]
There are 5 possible appearances of the Easter egg:
* Striped red/blue/yellow
* Solid blue
* Green with a yellow pattern
* Rainbow
* Brown-ish with purple spots

The default appearance is the red/blue/yellow striped egg, which will be chosen upon reloading a save file containing the item due to the game not remembering item variants.
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
The audio for dropping an Easter egg can be heard throughout the entire map in-game, although it is quiet.

<u>Before [[v62]]:</u> It's possible to entirely avoid the possibility of Easter eggs exploding. This is done by setting your game's framerate to 30FPS, then performing the following steps (as the ''host of the lobby'') - Hold the Easter egg, crouch on flat terrain without moving, look all the way down, and drop the item. If done right the egg will be placed gently without making a drop sound. It is very important that this is done by the host, because although a client can perform this exploit without it exploding on their end, the egg still may explode for the host anyways which will cause it to be unretrievable.

######## Easter egg/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom|Easter_Egg}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=抛出后会滑行
|audible=当被丢弃或爆炸时
|primary-use=<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>Toss egg</q></span>
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
复活节彩蛋是一种小巧的彩色彩蛋，共有5种[[variants|变体]]。可通过{{keybind|物品主要使用键}}投掷，落地时有小概率发生爆炸。
无论彩蛋是被丢弃、投掷，还是放入[[Cupboard|橱柜]]等其他物品内，其爆炸概率均保持不变。
爆炸时会喷射彩屑，对近距离的实体造成最高5点伤害（对玩家则造成100点伤害）。
</div>
== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
复活节彩蛋的运行基于一套坐标系统：某些位置必定会触发爆炸，而另一些位置则永远不会爆炸。这些位置每次都会随机生成，该机制可以通过投掷彩蛋观察到——彩蛋会吸附到一些奇怪的位置，因为它会锁定在本该落地位置最近的坐标点上。
了解这些机制后，如果员工需要出售多个彩蛋，且发现在公司柜台放置的第一个彩蛋发生了爆炸，那么在同一位置放置的其他彩蛋也应会爆炸（在柜台的不同位置则可能对应不会触发爆炸的坐标）。
</div>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
可以通过向[[landmine|地雷]]上方投掷复活节彩蛋来安全引爆地雷，但这样做有彩蛋自身爆炸的风险。

复活节彩蛋的爆炸可以瞬间点燃[[Forest Giant|森林守护者]]，使其在短时间内死亡。

<span id="Variants"></span>
== 变体 ==
[[File:Easter eggs on shelf.png|thumb|摆放在[[Facility|设施]]货架上的各种复活节彩蛋变体]]
复活节彩蛋共有5种外观：
* 红/蓝/黄条纹
* 纯蓝色
* 带黄色花纹的绿色
* 彩虹色
* 带紫色斑点的棕褐色

默认外观为红/蓝/黄条纹彩蛋。由于游戏不会保存物品变体信息，在重新加载包含该物品的存档时，将会默认选用这一款。
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
游戏中丢弃复活节彩蛋的音效虽然很轻，但整张地图都能听到。

在 [[v62]] 版本之前：
可以完全避免复活节彩蛋爆炸。方法是将游戏帧率设为 30FPS，然后（以房间房主身份）执行以下步骤：手持彩蛋，在平坦地面下蹲且不移动，视角完全朝下，然后丢弃物品。操作正确的话，彩蛋会被轻轻放下，不会发出落地音效。
必须由房主完成这一点至关重要，因为虽然非房主玩家也能触发此漏洞并在自己这边不爆炸，但彩蛋在房主端仍可能爆炸，导致彩蛋无法拾取。

== Environment ==
Embrion is a purplish moon with several ridges and shallow craters, devoid of precipitation. The main entrance is located on a ledge requiring employees to jump to access it. 

<!--T:15-->
The [[Interiors|indoor layout]] is usually the Factory with a moderate chance of the Mineshaft and a small chance of the Mansion.

== Strategy == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
As the Old Bird's bestiary entry implies, this moon has a considerably high spawn rate for Old Birds, and the highest entity power of any moon, meaning that Old Birds can swarm the map very quickly over the course of the day. The low amount of scrap means that this moon is hardly viable for looting purposes, resulting in low reward for such a high risk.

######## Embrion/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Embrion
| image = Embrion_Map_Outside.png
| routecost = 150
}}'''Embrion''' is a secret moon in Version 50. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Embrion is 150 credits. It does not appear on the list with the Moons command. Instead, its only reference is located in the Bestiary entry for [[Old Bird]]. It has a hazard level of "S".

== Description ==

{{Template:Terminal|text=5-Embrion

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Desolate and flat with unbreathable air, Embrion's surface layer is almost entirely made of amethyst quartz, which is made possible by Embrion's distance to its nearest star and its resulting geothermal activity. The surface of Embrion is scorchingly hot.

HISTORY: Embrion was discovered in just the last century. It appears to have been used as a testing ground for Old Birds long before it was officially discovered. As a result of this danger, its status has been marked as Condemned. There are theories that a diverse geothermal ecosystem may be thriving within a vast cave network under Embrion's surface.

FAUNA: Embrion is devoid of biological life.}}

== Environment ==
Embrion is a purplish moon with several ridges and shallow craters, devoid of precipitation. The main entrance is located on a ledge requiring employees to jump to access it. 

The [[Interiors|indoor layout]] is usually the Factory with a moderate chance of the Mineshaft and a small chance of the Mansion.

== Strategy ==

As the Old Bird's bestiary entry implies, this moon has a considerably high spawn rate for Old Birds, and the highest entity power of any moon, meaning that Old Birds can swarm the map very quickly over the course of the day. The low amount of scrap means that this moon is hardly viable for looting purposes, resulting in low reward for such a high risk.

== Описание ==

{{Template:Terminal|text=5-Embrion

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: Пустой и плоский с непригодным для дыхания воздухом, поверхностный слой Embrion почти полностью состоит из аметистового кварца, существование которого возможно благодаря дистанции между Embrion и её ближайшей звездой и вытекающей из неё геотермальной активности. Поверхность Embrion выжигающе горячая.

ИСТОРИЯ: Embrion была обнаружена только в прошлом веке. Похоже, что её использовали как испытательный полигон для Старых Птиц задолго до того, как её официально открыли. В результате этого ей присвоили статус Обречённой. Существуют теории о разнообразной геотермальной экосистеме, которая может процветать в обширной пещерной системе под поверхностью Embrion.

######## Employee
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{infobox entity
|image=Lethal-Company-Suit-Rank.jpg
|image2=Waving_Employee.png
|altname=Player
|hits-to-kill={{hits to kill|10
	|extra={{icon knife}}{{#expr:1+ceil((100-20)/10)}}
	|override-shotgun={{#expr:ceil(100/100)}}&ndash;{{#expr:ceil(100/20)}}
}}
|stun_multiplier=1<!-- estimate -->
|attack_damage=N/A (see weapons' articles)
}}
{{about|the player-controlled entities as they appear to others
|the informational display shown to players|HUD
|the employment relationship|Lore#The Company
}}
The hazmat-suit-wearing player characters of ''Lethal Company'', known as '<nowiki/>'''employees'''<nowiki/>', 'great assets', or simply '<nowiki/>'''players'''<nowiki/>',
are naturally the most important and complex entities in the game.
<br>They only spawn when a player joins a lobby,<ref group="note">
Actually, there are always 4 employees in the lobby, with inactive employees stored out of bounds.
</ref>
only despawn when the player dies (see below) or leaves the lobby, and automatically respawn when the [[ship]] returns to orbit.

An employee appears as a humanoid, covered head to toe in an [[w:Hazmat_suit|<abbr title="nuclear, biological, chemical">NBC</abbr>/hazmat suit]],
by default in [[Orange_suit|bright orange]] but other [[suits]] can be unlocked with [[credits]].
No facial features are visible through the visor.
<br>Employees wear oxygen tanks on their backs, but this is purely decorative and has no relation to the game's [[drowning]] mechanic.
Players' [[Employee_rank|ranks]] are displayed in the form of a patch on their lapel.
<br>Others can see the item an employee is holding, but not any "pocketed" items.
The exception to this is the [[Belt bag]], which appears on the waist when not held.

== Mechanics ==

Like other entities, [[damage]] will decrease an employee's [[health]], and with enough damage they will reach 0 health and die (with the player becoming a [[spectator]]).
Damage sources have a different effect on employees than on other entities.
<br>Depending on the cause of death, the employee may or may not be replaced by a [[body]], and may or may not drop all their held items.
Notably, equipping a [[mask]] or dying to a [[Masked]] will cause the employee to become a Masked.

Every employee has a 4-slot "inventory" or "pockets" which can each hold a single item of [[equipment]] or [[scrap]].
There is no maximum carry weight, however [[weight]] does reduce the employee's agility, and certain items will put the employee into the [[hands full]] state.

Employees can hear all [[Audible_sounds|diegetic sounds]], beyond what other entities can hear.
There are also sonic hallucinations tied to paranoia (not to be confused with [[fear]]).

== Notes ==

<references group="note" />

######## Employee rank
{{topicon Fandom|Company_Ranks}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
The employee rank is a badge on every player model displaying a certain employee's status and/or experience. You can increase your level of experience, abbreviated as XP, by collecting [[scrap]], especially scrap that has a high value. As of 2024, there are five potential rankings you can be given.

== Intern ==
[[File:Lethal-Company-Suit-Rank.jpg|thumb|An employee with the "Intern" employee rank.]]
An intern ranking is when an employee has from 0-50 XP.

Typically interns are new employees; those with less than or equal to 50 XP haven't collected much scrap, which could also mean that the mechanic of collecting material and selling it is still a foreign idea.

Intern badges are white with blue text.

== Part-Timer ==
A part-timer ranking is when an employee has from 50-100 XP.

Part-timers could be new employees who have the hang of how the game works, like selling scrap and certain dangers (e.g. falling into holes or weather-related events) but still be unaware of things like other [[entities]] and what they do.

Part-timer badges are blue with lavender or white text. best

== Employee ==
An employee ranking is when an employee has from 100-225 XP.

Employees are the average employees. They're aware of how everything is supposed to play out and how to avoid certain threats, and dabble in [[ship]] controls like closing doors or disabling turrets. There are few things that these employees won't know.

Employee badges are dark gray with light gray text.

== Leader ==
A leader ranking is when an employee has from 225-500 XP.

Those who have a leader ranking are seasoned and well-versed in everything Lethal Company. While it may be hard to see those with this status in random lobbies, oftentimes those who play with friends have this rank.

Leader badges are dull yellow with green text.

== Boss ==
A boss ranking is when an employee has 500 XP or more.

Boss rankings are the experts, the best of the best. There's nothing that these employees don't know, and most bosses have clever and unique strategies to handling common situations that few would've thought of. They know everything they have to and want to about how Lethal Company works, and there's a lot that they're capable of.

Boss badges are crimson with orange text.

== VIP Employee ==
Used to signify beta players. VIP Employee badges are currently broken and show up for every player.

######## Entities
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}

{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:21--> A [[Thumper]], an example of an entity found [[interiors|indoors]]</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:2-->
'''Entities''' are creatures found on [[moons]]. They may be harmless, mildly disruptive, or pose a serious threat to employee safety. There are currently <tvar name="count">{{formatnum:32}}</tvar> entities that can spawn naturally throughout the game.

<!--T:3-->
Entities are grouped into three main categories:
* Indoor
* Nighttime (Outdoor)
* Daytime (Outdoor)
Each type has a unique spawning curve that varies by moon. These curves are detailed on each moon's page. For guidance on reading spawning curves, see the [[mechanics]] page.

=== Important variables === <!--T:43-->

<!--T:4-->
* '''Health:''' The number of health points an entity has. One point equals the damage from a single [[shovel]] hit. A value of <big>∞</big> on a green background means the entity can't be harmed through normal means, but can still be defeated (e.g., via an [[Earth Leviathan]]). <big>∞</big> on a red background means the entity is entirely invulnerable.
* '''Power Level:''' Indicates the entity's power level. See [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|Entity Spawning Mechanics]] for details.
* '''Diversity Level:''' Restrains the different types of entities that can spawn during a day on a moon. Also see [[Mechanics|Entity Spawning Mechanics]] for details.
* '''Max Spawned:''' Maximum number of that entity type that can exist simultaneously (excluding defeated ones).
* '''Stunnable:''' Whether the entity can be stunned using a [[Stun grenade]] / [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or [[Radar-booster]].

{{navbox entities}}

######## Entities/en
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|A [[Thumper]], an example of an entity found [[interiors|indoors]]]]
'''Entities''' are creatures found on [[moons]]. They may be harmless, mildly disruptive, or pose a serious threat to employee safety. There are currently {{formatnum:32}} entities that can spawn naturally throughout the game.

Entities are grouped into three main categories:
* Indoor
* Nighttime (Outdoor)
* Daytime (Outdoor)
Each type has a unique spawning curve that varies by moon. These curves are detailed on each moon's page. For guidance on reading spawning curves, see the [[mechanics]] page.

=== Important variables ===

* '''Health:''' The number of health points an entity has. One point equals the damage from a single [[shovel]] hit. A value of <big>∞</big> on a green background means the entity can't be harmed through normal means, but can still be defeated (e.g., via an [[Earth Leviathan]]). <big>∞</big> on a red background means the entity is entirely invulnerable.
* '''Power Level:''' Indicates the entity's power level. See [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|Entity Spawning Mechanics]] for details.
* '''Diversity Level:''' Restrains the different types of entities that can spawn during a day on a moon. Also see [[Mechanics|Entity Spawning Mechanics]] for details.
* '''Max Spawned:''' Maximum number of that entity type that can exist simultaneously (excluding defeated ones).
* '''Stunnable:''' Whether the entity can be stunned using a [[Stun grenade]] / [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or [[Radar-booster]].

== Entity list ==

=== Indoor ===

Entities that spawn in indoor environments such as the [[Factory]], [[Mansion]], and [[Mineshaft]].
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|indoor}}
<references group="indoor">
<ref name="butler-knife">A [[Kitchen knife]] will always kill a Butler in one swing.</ref>
<ref name="cadaver-shotgun">The Cadaver Bloom has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from [[Shotgun]]s.</ref>
<ref name="exit">[[Masked]] and the [[Ghost Girl]] are the only entities that can independently leave indoor areas. The [[Maneater]] can be carried outdoors, but doing so triggers a transformation shortly after. [[Cadaver Bloom|Cadaver Blooms]], although marked as an Indoor entity, spawn depending on the infected employee's location upon reaching blooming state.</ref>
<ref name="maneater-shotgun">The Maneater has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from shotguns in its adult form.</ref>
<ref name="snare-flea-health">A Snare Flea will die instantly if attached to an employee who exits the building.</ref>
<ref name="spore-lizard-health">Spore Lizards appear to have 3 health but cannot be damaged by normal means.</ref>
</references>
=== Nighttime (Outdoor) ===

Entities that spawn outdoors primarily at night. Spawn rates generally increase as the night progresses. On [[Weather#Eclipsed|eclipsed]] moons, they may spawn during the day as well.
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}
<references group="nighttime">
<ref name="eyeless-dog-shotgun">Due to [[Known_bugs#Shotguns_can_deal_double_or_possibly_triple_damage_to_some_entities|a bug]],
Eyeless Dogs can take double damage (10) at close range, allowing them to be killed in as few as 2 shots.</ref>
</references>
=== Daytime (Outdoor) ===

Entities that spawn outdoors during the day. Their spawn frequency typically decreases over time, though this can vary by moon. Daytime entities do not factor diversity level into spawning.
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|daytime}}
<references group="daytime">
<ref name="tulip-snake-health">Despite having 3 health, Tulip Snakes always die in a single hit from any weapon.</ref>
<ref name="tulip-snake-outdoor">Tulip Snakes only spawn outdoors, but can be carried indoors if latched onto an employee's head.</ref>
</references>
=== Unused/Removed ===

Entities found in the game files that are either unimplemented, unused, or removed in official versions.
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|unused}}
<references group="unused">
<ref name="red-pill-health">Red Pills lack a proper hitbox and cannot be destroyed, even by traps like the [[Spike Trap]].</ref>
</references>

{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|entitiesSpawnChancesTables_AutoNighttime|all-moons=1}}

{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|entitiesSpawnChancesTables_AutoDaytime|all-moons=1}}
<references group="odds">
<ref name="maneater">The Maneater's chance to spawn is increased 1.5x ''if the moon's interior is a [[mineshaft]]''. If it is a [[facility]] or [[mansion]], the values listed here are used.</ref>
</references>
== Trivia ==
{{modded|section=y}}
Lasso Man is impossible to encounter without the use of mods. In V47, an issue likely caused by [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/2018/Brutal_Company/ Brutal Company] existed where the [[Weekly challenge|challenge moon]] during that time ('''Voiumya-10''' on Rend) was able to spawn Lasso Man due to its flag <code>spawningDisabled</code> being set to false.

The Kidnapper Fox was the first entity to be removed from a public version of the game - added in V55, removed in V60, and re-added in V80.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Las '''entidades''' son criaturas que habitan las [[moon|luna]]s, pueden ser agresivos, no ser ningún peligro, o pueden reducir la seguridad de los empleados.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Están divididos en tres tipos de entidades:

* De interior
* Nocturnas (De exterior)
* Diurnas (De exterior)

Cada una tiene su propia curva de aparición que es diferente en cada luna.
La curva de aparición puede ser encontrada respectivamente en la página individual de cada luna.
La información de como interpretar estas curvas se encuentra en la página de [[mechanics]]
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Important variables ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Vida:''' Cuantos puntos de vida tiene cada entidad, 1 punto de vida es el daño que hace un golpe con la [[shovel|pala]]. El valor de <big>∞</big> en un fondo verde indica que no puede ser dañado de manera normal, pero existen otras maneras de eliminarlo como por ejemplo, con un [[Earth Leviathan]]. <big>∞</big> en un fondo rojo indica que no existe manera de eliminarlo.
* '''Nivel de Poder:''' El nivel de poder de una entidad, más información en: [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|power levels explanation]].
* '''Máximo número de apariciones:''' El número de un tipo de entidad que pueden existir simultáneamente (No incluye a las que hayan sido eliminadas).
* '''Aturdible:''' Si una entidad puede ser aturdida con una [[stun grenade]], [[zap gun]] o con el [[radar booster]].
* '''Luna favorita:''' La luna en la que una entidad tiene su mayor ratio de aparición.
</div>

######## Entities/fi
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Thumper]], an example of an entity found [[interiors|indoors]]</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Olennot''' ovat otuksia, joita tavataan [[Kuut|kuissa]]ssa ja jotka ovat joko harmittomia, häiritseviä tai erittäin vaarallisia. Ne jaetaan kahteen luokkaan, sisä- ja ulkotiloihin.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Olentoja''' tavataan [[moons|kuissa]] ja ne ovat joko vaarattomia, häiritseviä tai erittäin vaarallisia. Ne jaetaan kolmeen luokkaan:
* Sisätilat
* Yöaikaan (ulkona)
* Päiväsaikaan (ulkona)
Jokaisella luokalla on oma syntymiskäyränsä, joka on erilainen jokaisella kuulla. syntymiskäyrät löytyvät kunkin kuun omalta sivulta.
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Olennon ominaisuudet ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Terveys:''' Kuinka paljon vihollisella on terveyttä. ''Kuolematon'' tarkoittaa, että sitä ei voi tappaa eikä se voi kuolla. Osuma [[shovel|lapiolla]] vastaa yhtä olennon terveyspistettä.
* '''Voimataso:''' Olennon voimataso. Lue lisää voimatasoista kohdasta [[moons#Maximum_Power|kuut]].
* '''Maksimimäärä:''' Kuinka monta samaa oliota voi olla yhtä aikaa kuussa.
* '''Tainnutus/tainnutuskerroin:''' Jos olio voidaan tainnuttaa [[Stun Grenade|tainnutuskranaatilla]], [[Zap Gun|zap-aseella]] tai [[Radar Booster]]n avulla. Jos se on tainnutettavissa, tainnutuksen kesto kerrotaan tainnutuskertoimella.
* '''Oven avausnopeus:''' Kuinka nopeasti olento pystyy avaamaan ovia tai kulkemaan ovien läpi verrattuna pelaajaan. Esimerkiksi: 2.0 tarkoittaa, että vihollinen voi avata ovia kaksi kertaa pelaajaa nopeammin.
* '''Suosikkikuu:''' Kuu, josta olio todennäköisimmin löytyy.
</div>

######## Entities/fr
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|Un [[Thumper/fr|Cogneur]], un exemple d'entité trouvée à l'[[interiors/fr|intérieur]]]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La '''Faune''' est composée de créatures qui apparaissent sur les [[Moons|Lunes]], pouvant être inoffensives, nuisibles ou extrêmement dangereuses.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Elle est divisé en 3 catégories:
* intérieures
* Nocturnes (Extérieurs)
* Diurnes (Intérieurs)
Chaque groupe utilise son propre horaire d'apparition, différent sur chaque lune. Ces données peuvent être trouvées sur les pages individuelles des lunes.
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Propriétés ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Vie:''' La vie qu'a un monstre. "Invincible" veut dire qu'ils ne peuvent pas être tués et ne peuvent pas mourir. Un coup de [[shovel|pelle]] est égal à un point de vie.
* '''Niveau de puissance:''' Le niveau de puissance d'une créature. Lisez plus à propos des niveaux du puissances dans l'article [[moons#Maximum Power|Lunes]]
* '''Apparitions maximum:''' La quantité possible d'une même créature qu'il peut y avoir au même moment sur une lune.
* '''Multiplicateur d'étourdissement:''' Si une créature peut être étourdie par une [[Stun Grenade|grenade assourdissante]], un [[Zap Gun|Zap gun]] ou un [[Radar Booster|amplificateur de radar]]. Si elle peut être étourdi, le temps d'étourdissement va être multiplié par le multiplicateur d'étourdissement.
* '''Temps d'ouverture des portes:''' La vitesse d'une créature pour ouvrir ou passer à travers une porte comparativement au joueur. N'a aucun rapport avec l'animation d'ouverture. Une vitesse de 1 correspond à 1 seconde.
* '''Lune préférée:''' La lune sur laquelle une créature a le plus de chance d'apparaître.
</div>

=== Nuit (Extérieur) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Des créatures qui apparaissent à l'extérieur, ''habituellement'' pendant la nuit. Selon les statistiques d'apparition de la lune, ces créatures peuvent apparaître plus tôt ou plus tard, leur taux d'apparition augmentant à mesure que la journée s'écoule. Pendant les [[Weather#Eclipsed|éclipses]], elles apparaissent durant toute la journée.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}
<references group="nighttime">
<ref name="eyeless-dog-shotgun"><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to [[Known_bugs#Shotguns_can_deal_double_or_possibly_triple_damage_to_some_entities|a bug]],
Eyeless Dogs can take double damage (10) at close range, allowing them to be killed in as few as 2 shots.
</div></ref>
</references>
<span id="Daytime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Journée (Extérieur) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Des créatures qui apparaissent à l'extérieur, ''Habituellement'' pendant la journée, ayant taux d'apparition diminuant à mesure que la journée s'écoule.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|daytime}}
<references group="daytime">
<ref name="tulip-snake-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Despite having 3 health, Tulip Snakes always die in a single hit from any weapon.</span></ref>
<ref name="tulip-snake-outdoor"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Tulip Snakes only spawn outdoors, but can be carried indoors if latched onto an employee's head.</span></ref>
</references>
<span id="Unused/Removed"></span>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Entités trouvées dans les dossiers du jeux mais inutilisé dans le jeux d'une quelconque manière.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|unused}}

{{navbox entities}}

######## Entities/id
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|[[Thumper]], salah satu entitas yang dapat ditemukan di [[interiors/id|dalam ruangan]]]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Entitas''' merupakan makhluk yang dapat ditemukan di [[bulan]], baik itu jinak, menyebalkan, maupun sangat berbahaya.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Entitas tersebut dapat dibagi menjadi tiga kategori:
* Dalam ruangan
* Malam hari (Luar ruangan)
* Siang hari (Luar ruangan)
Setiap kategori memiliki kurva pemijahannya sendiri yang berbeda pada setiap bulan. Kurva pemijahan dapat ditemukan pada halaman bulan masing-masing.
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Properti ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Nyawa:''' Jumlah nyawa yang dimiliki musuh. "''Invincible''" berarti mereka tidak dapat mati maupun dibunuh. Satu pukulan dari [[shovel|sekop]] sama dengan satu poin nyawa musuh.
* '''Level kekuatan:''' Level kekuatan sebuah entitas. Baca lebih lanjut tentang ''power level'' pada [[moons#Maximum Power|bulan]].
* '''Pemijahan maks:''' Jumlah maksimum pemijahan entitas dalam waktu yang bersamaan dalam satu bulan.
* '''Setrum/Pengali setrum:''' Menyatakan apabila entitas dapat tertegun dengan [[Stun Grenade|granat setrum]], [[Zap Gun|senjata kejut listrik]], atau [[Radar Booster|pemacu radar]]. Apabila iya, durasi tertegunnya ditentukan dengan ''stun multiplier''.
* '''Kecepatan membuka pintu:''' Seberapa lama entitas perlu untuk menunggu sebelum bisa membuka pintu. Properti ini tidak memiliki pengaruh terhadap animasi dan hanya mempengaruhi jeda. Kecepatan membuka pintu 1 berarti jeda membuka pintu 1 detik.
* '''Bulan favorit:''' Bulan di mana entitas tersebut akan paling sering ditemukan.
</div>

<span id="Entity_list"></span>
== Daftar entitas ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Dalam ruangan ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Entitas yang muncul di dalam ruangan seperti [[Interiors#The_Factory|Pabrik]] dan [[Interiors#The_Mansion|Rumah Besar]].
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|indoor}}

<ref name="exit"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">'''''Catatan:''' [[Masks (Enemy)|Masked]] dan [[Ghost Girl]] merupakan entitas yang dapat keluar ruangan dan berkeliaran di luar ruangan.''</span></ref>
<ref name="maneater-shotgun"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Maneater has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from shotguns in its adult form.</span></ref>
<ref name="snare-flea-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A Snare Flea will die instantly if attached to an employee who exits the building.</span></ref>

</references>
<span id="Nighttime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Malam hari (Luar ruangan) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Entitas yang muncul di luar ruangan, ''biasanya'' hanya saat malam hari. Entitas-entitas ini bisa muncul lebih awal atau lebih telat, tergantung dengan kurva pemijahan bulan masing-masing, dengan tingkat pemijahan yang semakin meningkat seiring berjalannya waktu. Namun ketika [[Weather#Eclipsed|gerhana]], entitas ini kebanyakan muncul seharian.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}
<references group="nighttime">

Eyeless Dogs can take double damage (10) at close range, allowing them to be killed in as few as 2 shots.
</div></ref>
</references>
<span id="Daytime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Siang hari (Luar ruangan) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Entitas yang dapat ditemukan di luar ruangan dan keseluruhan hari ''biasanya'' dengan penurunan tingkat pemijahan seiring berjalannya waktu.
</div>

######## Entities/it
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Thumper]], an example of an entity found [[interiors|indoors]]</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Entities''' are creatures found on [[moons]]. They may be harmless, mildly disruptive, or pose a serious threat to employee safety. There are currently {{formatnum:32}} entities that can spawn naturally throughout the game.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Le '''Entità''' sono esseri trovati sulle [[lune]] e possono essere innocui, un disturbo o estremamente pericolosi. Sono divise in tre categorie:
* Interne
* Notturne (Esterne)
* Diurne (Esterne)
Ogni categoria ha la sua curva di generazione che è diversa su ogni luna. Le curve di generazione si possono osservare nella pagina individuale di ogni luna.
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Proprietà dell'entità ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Salute:''' Quanta vita possiede il nemico. "Invincibile" significa che non può essere ucciso. Un colpo con la [[pala]] equivale a un punto salute dell'entità.
* '''Livello di Potenza:''' Il Livello di Potenza di un'entità. Impara di più sui livelli di potenza su [[lune#Potenza Massima|lune]].
* '''Quantità massima:''' Quanti esemplari della stessa entità possono esistere contemporaneamente su una luna.
* '''Moltiplicatore dello Stordimento''' Se un entità può essere stordita da una [[Granata Stordente|granata stordente]], [[Zapper|zapper]] o dall'[[Amplificatore Radar|amplificatore radar]]. Se può essere stordita, la durata dello stordimento viene influenzata dal moltiplicatore dello stordimento.
* '''Velocità di apertura porte:''' La velocità di un'entità per aprire e viaggiare attraverso le porte in confronto al giocatore. Per esempio: 2.0 significa che un nemico può aprire le porte il doppio più velocemente.
* '''Luna preferita:''' La luna in cui l'entità è più solitamente trovata.
</div>

######## Entities/ko
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Thumper]], an example of an entity found [[interiors|indoors]]</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Entities''' are creatures found on [[moons]]. They may be harmless, mildly disruptive, or pose a serious threat to employee safety. There are currently {{formatnum:32}} entities that can spawn naturally throughout the game.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Entities are grouped into three main categories:
* Indoor
* Nighttime (Outdoor)
* Daytime (Outdoor)
Each type has a unique spawning curve that varies by moon. These curves are detailed on each moon's page. For guidance on reading spawning curves, see the [[mechanics]] page.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Important variables ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Health:''' The number of health points an entity has. One point equals the damage from a single [[shovel]] hit. A value of <big>∞</big> on a green background means the entity can't be harmed through normal means, but can still be defeated (e.g., via an [[Earth Leviathan]]). <big>∞</big> on a red background means the entity is entirely invulnerable.
* '''Power Level:''' Indicates the entity's power level. See [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|Entity Spawning Mechanics]] for details.
* '''Diversity Level:''' Restrains the different types of entities that can spawn during a day on a moon. Also see [[Mechanics|Entity Spawning Mechanics]] for details.
* '''Max Spawned:''' Maximum number of that entity type that can exist simultaneously (excluding defeated ones).
* '''Stunnable:''' Whether the entity can be stunned using a [[Stun grenade]] / [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or [[Radar-booster]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Entity list ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Entities that spawn in indoor environments such as the [[Factory]], [[Mansion]], and [[Mineshaft]].
</div>

<ref name="exit"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">[[Masked]] and the [[Ghost Girl]] are the only entities that can independently leave indoor areas. The [[Maneater]] can be carried outdoors, but doing so triggers a transformation shortly after. [[Cadaver Bloom|Cadaver Blooms]], although marked as an Indoor entity, spawn depending on the infected employee's location upon reaching blooming state.</span></ref>
<ref name="maneater-shotgun"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Maneater has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from shotguns in its adult form.</span></ref>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Entities that spawn outdoors primarily at night. Spawn rates generally increase as the night progresses. On [[Weather#Eclipsed|eclipsed]] moons, they may spawn during the day as well.

</div></ref>
</references>
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Daytime (Outdoor) ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Entities that spawn outdoors during the day. Their spawn frequency typically decreases over time, though this can vary by moon. Daytime entities do not factor diversity level into spawning.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|daytime}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lasso Man is impossible to encounter without the use of mods. In V47, an issue likely caused by [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/2018/Brutal_Company/ Brutal Company] existed where the [[Weekly challenge|challenge moon]] during that time ('''Voiumya-10''' on Rend) was able to spawn Lasso Man due to its flag <code>spawningDisabled</code> being set to false.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Kidnapper Fox was the first entity to be removed from a public version of the game - added in V55, removed in V60, and re-added in V80.
</div>

######## Entities/pl
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|[[Thumper|Dudniarz]], przykład bytu znajdowanego w [[interiors|wnętrzach]]]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Byty''' można znaleźć na [[moon|księżycach]], które mogą być nieszkodliwe, uciążliwe, albo wyjątkowo niebezpieczne.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Można je podzielić na trzy kategorie:
* Żyjące wewnątrz
* Nocne (na zewnątrz)
* Dzienne (na zewnątrz)
Każda kategoria ma swoje własne warunki pojawiania się, które różnią się w zależności od księżyca. Warunki występowania bytów można szukać na indywidualnych stronach księżyców. Informacje o tym jak interpretować te warunki, znajdują się na stronie [[Mechanics/pl|mechaniki (brak jeszcze polskiego tłumaczenia)]]
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Właściwości bytów ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Zdrowie:''' Ile punktów życia ma byt. "Nieśmiertelny" znaczy, że nie da się ich zabić. Uderzenie [[Shovel/pl|łopatą]]  jest równe jednemu punktowi życia.
* '''Poziom Mocy:''' Poziom mocy bytu. Czytaj więcej o poziomie wartości na [[moons#Maximum Power/pl|księżycach]].
* '''Maksymalna liczba:''' Ile takich samych bytów może istnieć jednocześnie na Księżycu.
* '''Ogłuszalny/mnożnik ogłuszalności:''' Czy byt może zostać ogłuszony [[Stun Grenade/pl|granatem paraliżującym]], [[Zap Gun/pl|działkiem ogłuszającym]] lub [[Radar Booster/pl|nadajnikiem sygnału]]. Jeżeli ogłuszalne, to czas ogłuszenia jest mnożony przez mnożnik ogłuszenia
* '''Szybkość otwierania drzwi:''' Jak długo byt musi czekać przed drzwiami, zanim zacznie je otwierać. Nie ma wpływu na szybkość animacji, tylko samo opóźnienie. Prędkość równa 1 znaczy 1 sekundę.
* '''Ulubiony księżyc:''' Księżyc, na którym najczęściej występuje dany byt.
</div>

=== Wewnątrz ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Byty pojawiające się we wnętrzach takich jak [[Interiors#The_Factory/pl|Baza]] i [[Interiors#The_Mansion/pl|Rezydencja]].
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|indoor}}

<ref name="cadaver-shotgun"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Cadaver Bloom has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from [[Shotgun]]s.</span></ref>
<ref name="exit"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">'''''Note:''' [[Masks (Enemy)/pl|Omaskowany]] i [[Ghost Girl/pl|Dziewczynka Duch]] to jedyne byty mogące wyjść z wnętrz i poruszać się na zewnątrz.''</span></ref>
<ref name="maneater-shotgun"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Maneater has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from shotguns in its adult form.</span></ref>
<ref name="snare-flea-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A Snare Flea will die instantly if attached to an employee who exits the building.</span></ref>
<ref name="spore-lizard-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Spore Lizards appear to have 3 health but cannot be damaged by normal means.</span></ref>
</references>
<span id="Nighttime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Nocne (na zewnątrz) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Byty które pojawiają się na zewnątrz, ''zazwyczaj'' po zmierzchu. Zależnie od księżyca, zaczną się pojawiać wcześniej bądź później podczas dnia zwiększając tylko swoją częstość pojawiania się wraz z czasem. Podczas [[Weather#Eclipsed/pl|zaćmienia]] pojawiają się głównie przez cały dzień.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}
<references group="nighttime">
<ref name="eyeless-dog-shotgun"><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to [[Known_bugs#Shotguns_can_deal_double_or_possibly_triple_damage_to_some_entities|a bug]],
Eyeless Dogs can take double damage (10) at close range, allowing them to be killed in as few as 2 shots.
</div></ref>
</references>
<span id="Daytime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Dzienne (na zewnątrz) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Byty pojawiające się na zewnątrz, ''zazwyczaj'' widziane cały dzień ze średnią pojawiania się malejącą wraz z czasem.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|daytime}}
<references group="daytime">
<ref name="tulip-snake-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Despite having 3 health, Tulip Snakes always die in a single hit from any weapon.</span></ref>
<ref name="tulip-snake-outdoor"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Tulip Snakes only spawn outdoors, but can be carried indoors if latched onto an employee's head.</span></ref>
</references>
<span id="Unused/Removed"></span>
=== Nieużyte ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Byty znalezione w dokumentacji gry, ale nie występują nigdzie w grze ani nigdzie oficjalnie.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|unused}}
<references group="unused">
<ref name="red-pill-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Red Pills lack a proper hitbox and cannot be destroyed, even by traps like the [[Spike Trap]].</span></ref>
</references>

######## Entities/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Um [[Thumper]], um exemplo de entidade encontrado no [[Interiors]]</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Entidades''' são seres encontrados nas [[moons/pt-br|luas]] que são ou inofensivos, ou irritantes ou perigosos à saúde de funcionáries.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Elas são divididas em três tipos principais:
* Internas
* Noturnas (Externas)
* Diurnas (Externas)
Cada categoria tem suas próprias curvas de geração que são diferentes em cada lua. As curvas podem ser encontradas no artigo individual de cada lua. Informação em como interpretar essa curva está na página das [[mechanics/pt-br|mecânicas]].
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Propriedades ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Vida:''' Quantos pontos de vida a entidade tem, onde um ponto de vida é o dano causado por um golpe com uma [[Shovel/pt-br|pá]]. Um valor de "<big>∞</big>" em um fundo verde indica que ela não pode ser danificada por meios normais, mas pode ser derrotada, por exemplo, um [[Earth Leviathan/pt-br|Leviatã Terrestre]]. Um valor de "<big>∞</big>" em um fundo vermelho indica que não pode ser derrotada.
* '''Nível de poder:''' Nível de poder de uma entidade. Veja a [[Mechanics/pt-br#Geração_de_entidades|explicação em níveis de poder]].
* '''Geração máxima:''' O número de um tipo de entidade que pode estar presente ao mesmo tempo (não inclui entidades mortas).
* '''Atordoável:''' Indica se uma entidade pode ser atordoada por uma [[stun grenade/pt-br|granada de atordoamento]], [[zap gun/pt-br|arma de choque]], ou [[radar booster/pt-br|amplificador de radar]].
* '''Lua favorita:''' Indica a lua mais provável onde essa entidade ser encontrada.
</div>

O [[Maneater/pt-br|Devorador de Homens]] pode ser pego e levado para formas; porém isso fará com que ele se transforme.</ref>
<ref name="maneater-shotgun">O Devorador de Homens tem o comportamento especial de sempre receber 1 de dano da [[Shotgun/pt-br|Escopeta]] em sua forma adulta.
(Em sua forma bebê, qualquer ataque causará ele se transformar ao invés de tomar dano.)</ref>
<ref name="snare-flea-health">Uma Pulga Traiçoeira morre instantaneamente se estiver na cabeça de um funcionário quando ele sair por qualquer saída.</ref>
<ref name="spore-lizard-health">Acertar um golpe em um Lagarto de Esporos não o causará dano, mesmo eles tendo 3 de vida.</ref>
</references>

<span id="Nighttime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Noite (Exterior) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Noturnas (externo) ===
Entidades que geram em ambientes externos, ''geralmente'' apenas à noite. Dependendo da curva de geração da lua, essas entidades podem gerar mais cedo ou mais tarde no dia, com as chances de geração aumentando com o passar do dia. Durante [[Weather#Eclipsed|eclipses]], elas podem gerar em qualquer horário do dia.
$table
<references group="nighttime">
<ref name="eyeless-dog-shotgun">Graças a [[Known_bugs/pt-br#Escopetas_causam_o_dobro_ou_possivelmente_triplo__de_dano_a_algumas_entidades|um bug]],
Cães Cegos recebem dano em dobro (10) em alcances muito próximos e podem ser mortos em apenas 2 tiros.</ref>
</references>
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}

Eyeless Dogs can take double damage (10) at close range, allowing them to be killed in as few as 2 shots.
</div></ref>
</references>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Diurnas (externo) ===
Entidades que geram em ambientes externos, ''geralmente'' vistas o dia todo, com suas chances de geração diminuindo com o passar do dia. 
$table
<references group="diurna">
<ref name="vida-cobra-tulipa">Cobras Tulipas têm o comportamento especial de morrerem em um único golpe, mesmo elas tendo 3 de vida.</ref>
</div>

</references>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

== Trivia ==
{{modded|section=y}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Um modelo da entidade [[Lasso Man]] encontrado nos arquivos do jogo. Potencialmente sendo conteúdo descartado/descontinuado, é impossível de encontrá-lo sem o use de mods; especificamente o mod Brutal Company.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* O Homem do Laço é uma entidade encontrada apenas nos arquivos do jogo. Potencialmente sendo conteúdo inacabado/cancelado, é impossível de encontrá-lo sem o uso de mods; como o mod [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/2018/Brutal_Company/ Brutal Company].
* A Raposa Sequestradora foi a primeira entidade a ser removida de uma versão pública do jogo, sendo adicionada na V55 e removida na V60. Sua remoção é provavelmente temporária, já que removida para que seus problemas possam ser consertados.
</div>

######## Entities/ru
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">[[Thumper/ru|Топотун]] - пример существа находящегося внутри [[interiors/ru|здания]]</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Сущности''' - существа, которых можно найти на [[Moons/ru|лунах]] и которые могут быть как безвредными, так и мешать или нести серьёзную угрозу безопасности сотрудников.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Они разделены на 3 типа:
* Внутри здания
* Ночные (снаружи)
* Дневные (снаружи)
У каждой категории есть своя кривая шанса спавна, различная для каждой из лун. Их можно найти на странице каждой из лун. Информация о том, как понимать эти кривые, есть на странице [[Mechanics|механик]].
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Характеристики ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Здоровье:''' Сколько очков здоровья у сущности, где каждое очко здоровья равноценно урону, наносимому одним ударом [[Shovel/ru|лопатой]]. Значение <big>∞</big> на зелёном фоне означает, что сущности нельзя навредить обычном способом, но существуют иные способы её уничтожить, например с помощью [[Earth Leviathan/ru|Земного Левиафана]]. <big>∞</big> на красном фоне означает, что сущность нельзя уничтожить вовсе.
* '''Уровень силы:''' Уровень силы сущности. Смотри [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|объяснение уровней силы]].
* '''Максимальное количество:''' Количество данного типа сущности, которое может существовать одновременно (не учитывает тех, что были убиты).
* '''Оглушаемое:''' Может ли сущность быть оглушена с помощью [[Stun grenade/ru|оглушающей гранаты]], [[Zap gun/ru|электро-пушки]] или [[Radar-booster/ru|радарного усилителя]].
* '''Любимая луна:''' Луна, на которой сущность появляется чаще всего.
</div>

<span id="Entity_list"></span>
== Список сущностей ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Внутри здания ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Сущности, которые могут появиться внутри [[Завод|Завода]], [[Особняк|Особняка]] и [[Шахты (ожидается больше информации)|Шахт]].
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|indoor}}
<references group="indoor">
<ref name="butler-knife"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">[[Kitchen knife|Кухонный нож]] всегда убивает Дворецкого за один удар.</span></ref>
<ref name="cadaver-shotgun"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The Cadaver Bloom has the special behavior of always taking only 1 damage from [[Shotgun]]s.</span></ref>
<ref name="exit"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">[[Masked/ru|Одержимые]] и [[Ghost Girl/ru|Девочка-призрак]] единственные сущности, способные по своей воле покидать здание и возвращаться в него. [[Maneater/ru|Людоед]] может быть подобран и вынесен наружу; но это вызовет скорую трансформацию и вернуть в здание его больше будет нельзя.</span></ref>
<ref name="maneater-shotgun"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Во взрослой форме Людоед всегда получает максимум 1 урон от [[Shotgun/ru|Дробовиков]].
(В форме личинки любой урон будет проигнорирован и лишь вызовет немедленную трансформацию)</span></ref>
<ref name="snare-flea-health"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Если сотрудник с Потолочной Блохой на голове покинет здание - та немедленно умрёт.</span></ref>
<ref name="spore-lizard-health"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Несмотря на наличие 3-х ХП, Споро-ящеры игнорируют любой урон.</span></ref>
</references>
<span id="Nighttime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Ночные (снаружи здания) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Сущности, появляющиеся снаружи, ''обычно'' только ночью. В зависимости от кривой спавна луны, эти сущности могут появляться раньше или позже с увеличивающимся с течением времени шансом появления. Во время [[Weather/ru#Затмение|Затмений]] они могут появляться в любое время суток.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}
<references group="nighttime">
<ref name="eyeless-dog-shotgun"><div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Из-за [[Known_bugs#Shotguns_can_deal_double_or_possibly_triple_damage_to_some_entities|бага]]
Слепые Псы получают двойной урон (10) при стрельбе в упор и, следовательно, могут быть убиты как минимум двумя выстрелами
</div></ref>
</references>
<span id="Daytime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Дневной (снаружи здания) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Сущности, появляющиеся снаружи, ''обычно'' встречаются в течение всего дня с уменьшением шанса их появления с течением времени.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|daytime}}
<references group="daytime">
<ref name="tulip-snake-health"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Несмотря на наличие 3-х ХП, Тюльпановые Змеи умирают с одного удара.</span></ref>
<ref name="tulip-snake-outdoor"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Tulip Snakes only spawn outdoors, but can be carried indoors if latched onto an employee's head.</span></ref>
</references>
<span id="Unused/Removed"></span>
=== Неиспользуемые/Вырезанные ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Сущности в файлах игры, которых больше нельзя или никогда нельзя было встретить в игре.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|unused}}
<references group="unused">
<ref name="red-pill-health"><span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">У "Красной Пилюли" по-видимому отсутствует хитбокс, что делает её неубиваемой, даже [[Spike Trap|Платформой с шипами]].</span></ref>
</references>

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные факты ==
{{modded|section=y}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* В файлах игры есть [[Lasso Man/ru|Человек Лассо]]. На данный момент является секретной сущностью. Во время игры не встречается без использования модификаций; например - Brutal Company.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* Человек-лассо - сущность, которая есть только в файлах игры. Потенциально являясь незаконченным/отменённым контентом, его нельзя встретить без использования модов; таких как [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/2018/Brutal_Company/ Brutal Company].
* Лис-похититель был первой сущностью, удалённой из публичной версии игры, будучи добавленным в версии 55 и убранным в версии 60. Это удаление скорее всего временное, так как убран он был для того, чтобы эффективнее разобраться с его проблемами.
</div>

{{navbox entities}}

######## Entities/tr
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|Bir [[Thumper]], [[iç mekanlarda|iç mekanlarda]] bulunan bir varlık örneği]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Varlıklar''' [[Moons/tr|ay]]larda bulunan zararsız, baş belası ya da son derece tehlikeli varlıklardır.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Üç tipe ayrılırlar:
* İç mekan
* Gece (Dış Mekan)
* Gündüz (Dış Mekan)
Her kategorinin, her ayda farklı olan kendi doğma eğrisi vardır. Doğma eğrileri her ayın kendi sayfasında bulunabilir. Bu eğrilerin nasıl yorumlanacağı hakkında bilgi [[Mekanikler]] sayfasında bulunmaktadır.
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Varlık özellikleri ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Can:''' Düşmanın kaç canı olduğunu gösterir. “Yenilmez”, varlığın öldürülemediği ve ölemediği anlamına gelir. Kürek ile bir vuruş varlığın bir canına eşdeğerdir.
* '''Güç seviyesi:''' Bir varlığın güç seviyesini gösterir. [[moons#Maximum Power|Aylar]]’da güç seviyeleri hakkında daha çok okuyabilirsiniz.
* '''Maks spawn:''' Bir ayda bir varlıktan aynı anda en fazla kaç tane oluşabileceğini gösterir.
* '''Sersemletilebilir/Sersemletme çarpanı:''' Bir varlığın [[Stun Grenade|sersemletme bombası]], [[Zap Gun|zap silahı]] ya da [[Radar Booster|radar çoğaltıcı]] tarafından sersemletilebilir olup olmadığını gösterir. Eğer sersemletilebilirse, sersemletme süresi sersemletme çarpanı ile çarpılır.
* '''Kapı açma hızı:''' Varlığın oyuncuya göre ne kadar hızlı bir şekilde kapıyı açabildiğini ya da içinden geçebildiğini gösterir. Örneğin: 2.0, varlığın kapıyı oyuncuya göre iki kat hızlı bir şekilde açabildiğini gösterir.
* '''Favori ay:''' Varlığın en çok bulunma ihtimali olduğu ay.
</div>

<span id="Nighttime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Gece (Dış Mekan) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Açık havada, ''genellikle'' sadece geceleri ortaya çıkan varlıklar. Ayın doğma eğrisine bağlı olarak, bu varlıklar zaman geçtikçe artan doğma oranlarıyla günün erken veya geç saatlerinde doğmaya başlar. [[Hava#Tutulma|Tutulma]] sırasında çoğunlukla tüm gün ortaya çıkarlar.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|nighttime}}
<references group="nighttime">
<ref name="eyeless-dog-shotgun"><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to [[Known_bugs#Shotguns_can_deal_double_or_possibly_triple_damage_to_some_entities|a bug]],
Eyeless Dogs can take double damage (10) at close range, allowing them to be killed in as few as 2 shots.
</div></ref>
</references>
<span id="Daytime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== Gündüz (Dış Mekan) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Açık havada ortaya çıkan varlıklar, "genellikle" tüm gün görülür ve zaman geçtikçe ortaya çıkma oranı azalır.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AllEntitiesTable|daytime}}
<references group="daytime">
<ref name="tulip-snake-health"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Despite having 3 health, Tulip Snakes always die in a single hit from any weapon.</span></ref>
<ref name="tulip-snake-outdoor"><span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Tulip Snakes only spawn outdoors, but can be carried indoors if latched onto an employee's head.</span></ref>
</references>
<span id="Unused/Removed"></span>
=== Kullanılmayanlar ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Oyun dosyalarında bulunan ancak oyun içinde herhangi bir resmi sıfatla görülemeyen varlıklar.
</div>

{{navbox entities}}

######## Entities/uk
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A [[Thumper]], an example of an entity found [[interiors|indoors]]</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Entities''' are creatures found on [[moons]]. They may be harmless, mildly disruptive, or pose a serious threat to employee safety. There are currently {{formatnum:32}} entities that can spawn naturally throughout the game.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Сутності''' є істотами, що можна знайти на [[місяці]]. Вони можуть бути так і нешкідливими, так і надзвичайно небезпечними. Поділяються на три категорії:
* В середині приміщення
* Уночі (зовні приміщення)
* Удень (зовні приміщення)
Кожна категорія має власний шанс спавну істоти, яка відрізняється на кожному місяці. Шанси спавну, що описані формулами кривої, можна знайти на окремій сторінці кожного місяця.
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Властивості сутностей ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Здоров'я:''' Скільки здоров'я має істота. «Невразливий» означає, що їх неможливо вбити і вони не можуть померти. Удар від [[Shovel|лопати]] дорівнює одному очку здоров’я сутності.
* '''Сила:''' Рівень сили сутності. Дізнайтеся більше про рівні сили на сторінці про [[moons#Maximum Power|місяці]].
* '''Максимальна кількість:''' Скільки одночасно може існувати один тип сутності на місяці.
* '''Коефіцієнт приголомшення:''' Якщо сутність можна приголомшити [[Stun Grenade|шоковою гранатою]], [[Zap Gun|зап-пістолетом]] або [[Radar Booster|радарним підсилювачем]]. Якщо можна приголомшити, тривалість приголомшення множиться на коефіцієнт приголомшення.
* '''Швидкість відкриття дверей:''' Наскільки швидко сутність може відкривати двері або проходити через них у порівнянні з гравцем. Наприклад: 2.0 означає, що ворог може відкривати двері вдвічі швидше.
* '''Улюблений місяць:''' Місяць, де істоту найімовірніше буде знайдено.
</div>

</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Entities that spawn outdoors during the day. Their spawn frequency typically decreases over time, though this can vary by moon. Daytime entities do not factor diversity level into spawning.

{{navbox entities}}

######## Entities/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom|Bestiary}}
{{topicon Fandom|Entity|1}}
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:ThumperFunny.png|thumb|一个位于[[Interiors/zh-cn|室内]]的[[Thumper/zh-cn|打击者]]实体]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''实体'''是指在[[moons/zh-cn|星球]]上发现的生物，它们或者无害，或者造成滋扰，或者对玩家的安全造成极大的危害。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
它们主要分为三种类型：
* 室内
* 夜间（室外）
* 白天（室外）
每种类型都有自己的生成曲线，每个星球的产卵曲线都不同。生成曲线可在每个星球的页面上找到。有关如何解释这些曲线的信息，请参阅[[mechanics|机制]]页。
</div>

<span id="Important_variables"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 属性 ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''生命值：'''实体有多少点生命值。“无敌”意为该实体既不能被杀死也不会死亡。上下文中，一[[Shovel/zh-cn|铲子]]能对实体造成一点生命值的伤害。
* '''能量等级：'''实体的能量等级。在[[Moons/zh-cn#最大能量等级|星球]]页面详细了解。
* '''最大生成数：'''在一个星球上最多可以同时存在几个相同的实体。
* '''可眩晕/眩晕乘数：'''实体是否能被[[Stun Grenade|眩晕手雷]]、[[Zap Gun|电击枪]]和[[Radar Booster|雷达增幅器]]眩晕。如果可以，那么眩晕效果的持续时间受眩晕乘数影响。
* '''开门速度：'''实体在开门时需要在门前等待多久。此属性不影响动画速度，只影响具体开门时间。速度值为 1 则代表需要 1 秒。
* '''最喜欢的星球：'''在这个星球上最容易遇见这个实体。
</div>

</div>

<span id="Nighttime_(Outdoor)"></span>
=== 夜间（室外） ===

######## Entity Guide
{{delete|redundant with [[Eyeless Dog#Strategy]] and [[Forest Keeper#Strategy]]}}

A lot of the entities in this game are dangerous and sometimes making the wrong move will kill you.  I'll give you strategies to avoid the entities down below.  I'll also give them a danger rating from 1-10, 1 being the least and 10 being the most dangerous and I'll explain why I think that.

==== [[Eyeless Dog]] ====

<br>
Danger Rating: 5

<br>
The Eyeless Dog, from now on referred to as dog(s), is a middle of the pack threat.  Dogs can slow you down so other entities have time to catch you slacking or the dog hears you running for your life from something and kills you.  They can be deathly dangerous to Ship Operators if caution isn't taken.  Contrary to popular belief, it is not necessary to turn off your walkie-talkie while near them, as only you can hear it, not them. That said, don't talk into it near them.



Giant, 9.5/10. 
These are giant monsters that have eyes on their chest like a Pokémon. They will typically spawn on forested maps like march or vow. They have 3 states, roaming, inspecting, and chasing. In roaming mode, the giant will walk aimlessly through the moon’s exterior. In inspecting mode, if the giant sees something, it will start checking the area and pausing other movement. In chasing mode, the giant will walk after you. This enemy used to be 10/10, but because they can be killed now, you can at least counter them.

######## Experimentation

<!--T:8-->
'''41-Experimentation''' is the starting moon in Lethal Company. It is one of the easier moons to explore, reflected by its hazard level of "D".

<!--T:9-->
When the game starts, the ship starts in the orbit of Experimentation and employees can land there immediately.

== Description == <!--T:19-->
</translate>
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<translate>
== Environment == <!--T:28-->

<!--T:10-->
Experimentation is a desert moon with various buildings scattered around the map. Near the entrance to the [[The Facility]] is a train track on an elevated platform that runs across the map. The Fire Exit is located to the left of the Main Entrance up a set of stairs. From the Fire Exit there runs a pipe all the way back to the ship that can be used for transporting items back. The [[Interiors|indoor layout]] is almost always the Factory, with a small chance of the Mineshaft and an even smaller chance of the Mansion.

<!--T:2-->
When employees enter the large hall where the main entrance is there is a chance that a large shutter door will close partially, with a loud jolt. If this happens enough times, the door will fully shut, forcing employees to instead use the Fire Exit.

<!--T:3-->
== Strategy ==
The optimal path to get to the entrance is to go in a straight line straight towards the ladder up to the rail, then straight toward the main entrance. You will not take fall [[damage]] jumping off the rail on either side, so you can ignore ladders when returning to the ship. 

<!--T:11-->
It is possible for this ladder to be blocked by a large rock that can randomly spawn. If this happens, it is advised to walk to the right and find one of the alternative ladders. 

<!--T:12-->
== Loot table ==
Rarity is the base values the scrap has for spawning. The equation <code>scrap rarity / total rarities = X</code> then <code>X * 100 = %</code> gives you the spawn chance for a scrap.  For example if you take the rarity for the [[V-Type Engine]], which equals 90, and divide it by the total rarity value (the sum of all scrap rarities), which equals 613.  <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> and <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> making our spawn chance for [[V-Type Engine]]s on Experimentation 14.68% for v45.
</translate>

</translate>

'''41-Experimentation''' ist der Einsteiger-Mond in Lethal Company. Er ist einer der am einfachsten zu bereisenden Monde, trotz der Gefahrenstufe von "B".
</div>

Zum Start des Spiels umkreist das Raumschiff immer Experimentation und die Mitarbeiter können hier sofort landen.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Beschreibung ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Umwelt ==
Experimentation ist ein Wüstenmond, auf dem verschiedene verlassene Gebäude auf der Oberfläche verstreut sind. Vor dem Eingang der [[Interiors|Innenräume]] liegt eine Eisenbahnschiene auf einer angehobenen Plattform, welche quer über die Karte verläuft. Der Notausgang liegt links vom Haupteingang an der Seite des Gebäudes, am Ende eines Treppengeländers. Von der Tür des Notausgangs verläuft ein großes Rohr bis zum Schiff zurück, auf welchem Angestellte Gegenstände zurückbringen können.
</div>

Vor dem Haupteingang gibt es ein großes Garagentor, das eine Chance hat mit einem lauten Geräusch halb zuzufallen, wenn Mitarbeiter darunter durch laufen. Geschieht dies oft genug, schließt das Tor völlig und Mitarbeiter müssen den Notausgang nutzen um das Gebäude betreten oder verlassen zu können.

== Strategie ==
Der optimale Weg zum Haupteingang ist gerade auf eine der Leitern zuzusteuern, die auf die Schienen führen und von dort direkt zum Haupteingang zu gehen. Bei der Rückkehr kann man die Leitern ignorieren, da man keinen Fallschaden beim herunterspringen erleidet. 

Es ist möglich dass diese Leitern von den zufällig angeordneten Felsen blockiert werden. In diesem Fall muss eine der alternativen Leitern weiter außen genutzt werden. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Loottabelle ==
Seltenheit beschreibt die Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass ein Gegenstand erscheint. Die Gleichung <code>Schrottseltenheit / Gesamtseltenheit = X</code> dann <code>X * 100 = %</code> ergibt die Erscheinungsrate für einen Gegenstand. Nimmt man beispielsweise die Seltenheit des [[V-Type Engine|V-Typ Motors]], die 90 ist, und teilt sie durch die gesamte Seltenheit aller Gegenstände 613: <code>90/613 = 0,1468</code> und <code>0,1468 * 100 = 14,68</code> ergibt eine Erscheinungsrate des [[V-Type Engine|V-Typ Motors]] von 14,68%.
</div>

}}'''41-Experimentation''' is the starting moon in Lethal Company. It is one of the easier moons to explore, reflected by its hazard level of "D".

When the game starts, the ship starts in the orbit of Experimentation and employees can land there immediately.

== Description ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
== Environment ==

Experimentation is a desert moon with various buildings scattered around the map. Near the entrance to the [[The Facility]] is a train track on an elevated platform that runs across the map. The Fire Exit is located to the left of the Main Entrance up a set of stairs. From the Fire Exit there runs a pipe all the way back to the ship that can be used for transporting items back.

When employees enter the large hall where the main entrance is there is a chance that a large shutter door will close partially, with a loud jolt. If this happens enough times, the door will fully shut, forcing employees to instead use the Fire Exit.

== Strategy ==
The optimal path to get to the entrance is to go in a straight line straight towards the ladder up to the rail, then straight toward the main entrance. You will not take fall [[damage]] jumping off the rail on either side, so you can ignore ladders when returning to the ship. 

It is possible for this ladder to be blocked by a large rock that can randomly spawn. If this happens, it is advised to walk to the right and find one of the alternative ladders. 

== Loot table ==
Rarity is the base values the scrap has for spawning. The equation <code>scrap rarity / total rarities = X</code> then <code>X * 100 = %</code> gives you the spawn chance for a scrap.  For example if you take the rarity for the [[V-Type Engine]], which equals 90, and divide it by the total rarity value (the sum of all scrap rarities), which equals 613.  <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> and <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> making our spawn chance for [[V-Type Engine]]s on Experimentation 14.68% for v45.
