######## Experimentation/es
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Experimentation
| image = Experimentation_map_outside.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''41-Experimentation''' es la luna inicial en Lethal Company. Es una de las lunas más fáciles de explorar, a pesar de tener una clasificación de peligro "B".
</div>

Cuando se empieza una nueva partida, la nave empieza en la orbita de Experimentation y los empleados tienen la opción de aterrizar ahí inmediatamente.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Descripción ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Ecosistema ==

Experimentation es un planeta desértico con varios edificios repartidos alrededor del mapa. Junto a la entrada de [[es#The_Facility|La Fábrica]] hay unas vías de tren sobre una plataforma elevada que se extiende por todo el mapa. La Salida de Emergencia se encuentra subiendo unas escalenas situadas a la izquierda de la Entrada Principal. Junto a la Salida de Emergencia hay una tubería que se extiende hasta la nave, siendo una viable para transportar objetos.

Cada vez que un empleado entra a la sala en la que se encuentra la Entrada Principal hay una pequeña probabilidad de que la puerta cochera caiga y se cierre parcialmente. Si esto se repite lo suficiente, la puerta acabará por cerrarse completamente, dejando solo accesible la Salida de Emergencia.

== Estrategia ==
El camino más óptimo hacia la entrada es ir en línea recta desde la nave hasta la escalera que sube hasta las vías del tren y después ir directamente hacia la entrada. No recibirás [[es/damage|daño]] por caída si saltas desde cualquier lado de las vías, por lo que puedes volver de vuelta a la nave sin usar las escaleras. 

Es posible que la escalera esté bloqueada por una roca enorme que se puede generar de forma aleatoria. En caso de que pase esto, lo mejor es tomar la otra escalera situada a la derecha. 

== Loot table ==
La rareza es el valor por defecto que tiene la chatarra de aparecer. La ecuación <code>scrap rarity / total rarities = X</code> then <code>X * 100 = %</code> determina la probabilidad de aparición de cualquier pieza de chatarra. Por ejemplo si obtenemos la rareza del [[V-Type_Engine/es|Motor Tipo V]], la cual es 90, y la dividimos por el valor total de rareza (la suma de la rareza de todas las piezas de chatarra), que es igual a 613.  <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> y <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> haciendo así que el [[V-Type_Engine/es|Motor Tipo V]] tenga un 14.68% respecto a la versión v45.

<span id="Entities"></span>
== Entidades ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Interior ===

Las [[Bunker Spider|Arañas de Bunker]] y las [[Snare Flea|Pulgas Trampa]] son bastante comunes en Experimentation. Mientras que las arañas se pueden evitar fácilmente, puede resultar molesto lidiar con pulgas trampa en multijugador si nadie trae palas consigo para deshacerse de ellas.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== Nocturnos ===

Los [[Eyeless Dog|Perros Ciegos]] son bastante comunes en Experimentation. Pero debido a que solo son activos hasta tarde, se pueden evitar sin mayor problema.
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Entity !! Spawn Chance !! Rarity !! Power Level !! Max Spawn Count !! Is Killable
|-
| [[Eyeless Dog/es|Perro Ciego]] || 57.25% || 75 || 2 || 8 || {{yes_T}}
|-
| [[Earth Leviathan/es|Leviatán Terrestre]] || 42.75% || 56 || 2 || 3 || {{no_T}}
|}
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== Diurnos ===

Las [[Circuit Bees|Abejas]] son poco comunes en Esperimentation al ser una de las lunas más fáciles.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}
=== Curvas de generación ===
Las entidades nocturnas empiezan a aparecer alrededor de las 5pm en Experimentation. Tras las 10pm la generación de enemigos sube drásticamente, llegando a su tope a las 12am. La generación de las entidades diurnas disminuye gradualmente con el tiempo, siendo más abundantes al inicio del día. Vease [[Mechanics/es|Mecánicas]] para más información.
[[File:Experimentation_spawn_curve.png|950px]]
== Trivia ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Experimentation tiene muchas habitaciones y pasillos de la versión [[alpha/alfa]]. Estas versiones solo son accesibles (en vanilla) usando dos escaleras extensibles para llegar hasta una obertura en la pared más allá de la salida de emergencia.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">There is a easter egg where the garage door near the main entrance closes half way, This is a reference to the early experimentation map found in v4.</span>

######## Experimentation/fr
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Experimentation
| image = Experimentation_map_outside.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''41-Experimentation''' est la lune de départ dans Lethal Company. Il s'agit de l'une des lunes les plus simples à explorer malgré son niveau de danger à "B".
</div>

Lorsque la partie démarre, le vaisseau est en orbite d'Experimentation et les joueurs peuvent y atterrir immédiatement.

== Description ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Environnement ==
Experimentation est une lune déserte avec différents bâtiments dispersés à travers la carte. Proche de l'entrée du [[The Facility|Complexe]] se trouve des rails sur une plateforme surélevée qui longe la carte. La sortie de secours se trouve à gauche de l'entrée principale en haut d'escaliers. Depuis la sortie de secours on peut y voir des tuyaux qui vont jusqu'au vaisseau pour pouvoir transporter des objets jusque là.
</div>

Lorsque les employés rentrent dans le grand hall où se trouve l'entrée principale, il y a une chance que la grande porte se ferme partiellement avec un gros bruit. Si cela ce produit assez de fois, la porte se fermera complètement ,forçant les employés à utiliser la sortie de secours.

== Stratégie ==
Le chemin optimal pour aller à l'entrée est d'aller dans une ligne droite en direction de l'échelle jusqu'aux rails, puis aller à l'entrée principale. Vous ne prendrez pas de dégâts de chute en sautant des rails, donc vous pouvez ignorer les échelles en retournant au vaisseau. 

Il est possible que cette échelle soit bloquée par un gros rocher qui apparaît aléatoirement. Si cela se produit, il est conseillée de marcher à droite et de trouver une des échelles alternatives. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La rareté correspond aux chances de bases d'un objet d’apparaître. L'équation <code>Rareté de la ferraille / Rareté totale = X</code> puis </code>X * 100 = %<code> donne le taux d'apparition de ferraille. Par exemple, si vous prenez le taux de rareté du [[V-Type Engine]], égal à 90, Et le divisez par le taux de rareté total de ferraille, égal à 613. <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> et <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> Donnant le taux d'apparition du V-Type Engine sur Experimentation à 14.68%
</div>

[[Old Bird|Old Birds]] and [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] are very unlikely, but may be a challenge due to the minimal cover of the terrain. Consider traversing the pipeline by the fire exit if these become a problem.

=== Spawn chance curves ===
Nighttime entities only start spawning at around 5pm on Experimentation. After 10pm enemy spawning drastically increases with its peak at 12am. Daytime entity spawning gradually decreases with time with most of the entities spawning at the beginning of the game. See [[Mechanics]] for interpretation.

######## Experimentation/got
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Experimentation
| image = Experimentation_map_outside.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''41-Experimentation''' is the starting moon in Lethal Company. It is one of the easier moons to explore, reflected by its hazard level of "D".
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
When the game starts, the ship starts in the orbit of Experimentation and employees can land there immediately.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Description ==
</div>
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Experimentation is a desert moon with various buildings scattered around the map. Near the entrance to the [[The Facility]] is a train track on an elevated platform that runs across the map. The Fire Exit is located to the left of the Main Entrance up a set of stairs. From the Fire Exit there runs a pipe all the way back to the ship that can be used for transporting items back.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
When employees enter the large hall where the main entrance is there is a chance that a large shutter door will close partially, with a loud jolt. If this happens enough times, the door will fully shut, forcing employees to instead use the Fire Exit.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
The optimal path to get to the entrance is to go in a straight line straight towards the ladder up to the rail, then straight toward the main entrance. You will not take fall [[damage]] jumping off the rail on either side, so you can ignore ladders when returning to the ship.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is possible for this ladder to be blocked by a large rock that can randomly spawn. If this happens, it is advised to walk to the right and find one of the alternative ladders.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Loot table ==
Rarity is the base values the scrap has for spawning. The equation <code>scrap rarity / total rarities = X</code> then <code>X * 100 = %</code> gives you the spawn chance for a scrap.  For example if you take the rarity for the [[V-Type Engine]], which equals 90, and divide it by the total rarity value (the sum of all scrap rarities), which equals 613.  <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> and <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> making our spawn chance for [[V-Type Engine]]s on Experimentation 14.68% for v45.
</div>

######## Experimentation/it
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Experimentation
| image = Experimentation_map_outside.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''41-Experimentation''' è la luna iniziale di Lethal Company. È una delle lune più facili da esplorare, nonostante abbiamo un livello di pericolo "B".
</div>

Quanfo il gioco inizia, la nave compare nell'orbita di Experimentation e gli impiegati possono atterrare immediatamente.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Description ==
</div>
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Paesaggio ==
Experimentation è un pianeta deserto con vari edifici sparpagliati nella mappa. Vicino all'entrata della [[Struttura]] ci sono delle rotaie su una piattaforma elevata che attraversa la mappa. L'Uscita Antincendio si trova a sinistra dell'Entrata Principale sopra una rampa di scale. Dall'Uscita Antincendio c'è una tubatura che raggiunge la nave che può essere usata per trasportare indietro gli oggetti.
</div>

Quando gli impiegati entrano la larga sala dove si trova l'entrata principale c'è la possibilità che la saracinesca si chiuda parzialmente, provocando uno stridulo rumoroso. Se accade molte volte, la porta si chiuderà completamente, costringendo gli impiegati ad utilizzare l'Uscita Antincendio.

== Strategia ==
Il percorso ottimale per raggiungere l'entrata consiste nel correre in una linea retta verso la scala per salire sulle rotaie, poi dritto verso l'entrata principale. Non subirai danno da caduta quando salterai dalla rotaia verso il terreno, perciò puoi ignorare le scale quando ritorni alla nave. 

È possibile che questa scala venga bloccata da una grande roccia che può venire generata casualmente. Se succede, bisognerà camminare a destra per trovare una delle scale alternative. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Tabella del Bottino =
La rarità è il valore base che gli scarti possiedono per venire generati. L'equazione <code>rarità scarto / rarità totali = X</code> e poi <code>X * 100 = %</code> conferisce la probabilità di generazione di uno scarto.
Per esempio se prendi la rarità del [[Motore Tipo-V]], che equivale a 90 e lo dividi per il totale delle rarità o le rarità di tutti gli scarti, che equivale a 613. <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> e <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> quindi la possibilità di generazione del [[Motore Tipo-V]] su Experimentation è del 14.68%
</div>

=== Curve di probabilità generazione ===
Le entità notturne vengono generate a partire dalle 17 su Experimentation. Dopo le 22 la generazione dei nemici aumenta drasticamente con il suo picco a Mezzanotte. Le entità diurne vengono generate gradualmente in calo al passare del tempo e la maggior parte di esse vengono generate all'inizio del gioco.

'''41-Experimentation''' é a lua inicial de Lethal Company. É uma das luas mais fáceis de explorar, mesmo tendo uma nota de perigo "B".
</div>

Quando o jogo inicia, a nave começa na orbita de Experimentation e funcionáries podem pousar lá imediatamente.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Descrição ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Experimentation is a desert moon with various buildings scattered around the map. Near the entrance to the [[The Facility]] is a train track on an elevated platform that runs across the map. The Fire Exit is located to the left of the Main Entrance up a set of stairs. From the Fire Exit there runs a pipe all the way back to the ship that can be used for transporting items back.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Quando os funcionários passam pela entrada do estabelecimento, há uma chance de que uma grande porta de veneziana em frente à entrada principal feche parcialmente, com um forte solavanco. Se isso acontecer várias vezes, a porta será totalmente fechada, forçando os funcionários a usarem a saída de incêndio.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Estratégia ==
O caminho ideal para entrar e sair das instalações é seguir em linha reta em direção a uma escada até o corrimão e depois direto em direção à entrada principal. Você não sofrerá danos de queda ao pular do trilho em nenhum dos lados, então poderá ignorar as escadas ao retornar ao navio.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is possible for this ladder to be blocked by a large rock that can randomly spawn. If this happens, it is advised to walk to the right and find one of the alternative ladders.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

[[Old Bird|Old Birds]] and [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] are very unlikely, but may be a challenge due to the minimal cover of the terrain. Consider traversing the pipeline by the fire exit if these become a problem.

######## Experimentation/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Experimentation
| image = Experimentation_map_outside.png
| routecost = 0
}}'''41-Experimentation''' - начальная луна в Lethal Company. Является одной из легчайших лун для исследования, что отражено через уровень угрозы "D".

В начале игры корабль стартует на орбите Experimentation и сотрудники могут приземлиться туда сразу же.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

Experimentation - пустынная луна с различными постройками разбросанными по карте. Рядом со входом в [[Interiors/ru|Здание]] на приподнятой платформе находятся ЖД пути. Пожарный Выход расположен левее Главного Входа наверху лестницы. От пожарного выхода обратно к кораблю проходит труба по которой можно переносить предметы обратно.

Когда сотрудник зайдёт в большой холл перед главным входом, есть шанс, что жалюзийная дверь над ним частично опустится. Если это случится несколько раз, то дверь полностью опустится, заставив сотрудников использовать пожарный выход.

== Стратегия ==
Самый оптимальный способ попасть в здание - идти прямо до ближайшей лестницы и после до основного входа. При прыжке с платформы Вы не получите урон, так что можете спокойно игнорировать лестницу при возвращении в корабль. 

Лестница может быть загорожена случайно появившимся камнем. В таком случае стоит пройти направо и воспользоваться другой лестницей. 

== Таблица лута ==
Редкость - базовые значения спавна лута. Формула <code>Редкость лута / общая редкость = X</code> затем <code>X * 100 = %</code> даёт шанс спавна лута. Например если взять редкость [[V-Type Engine|V-образного двигателя]], равную 90, и разделить на общее значение редкости (сумму редкости всего лута), равную 613. <code>90/613 = 0.1468</code> и <code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code> даёт нам шанс спавна [[V-Type Engine|V-образных двигателей]] на Experimentation 14.68%
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Experimentation}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|hives=y|facility=y|nutcrackers=y}}

Спавн дневных сущностей постепенно уменьшается с появлением большинства сущностей в начале игры. Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.

{{topicon Fandom}}

}}'''41-Experimentation''' 是游戏的初始星球。是较容易探索的星球之一，其难度等级为“D”

当游戏启动时，飞船就在 Experimentation 的轨道上，员工可立即降落。

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{quote INFO moon|ExpInfo}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
</div>

== 环境 ==
Experimentation 是一个沙漠星球，其地图上散落着各种建筑。在[[The Facility|设施]]入口附近有一条铁轨，它位于高架平台上，横穿整张地图。消防出口位于主入口左侧的楼梯上，旁边有一条管道一直通到船边，可用于运输物品回船。

当员工进入主入口前的大厅时，顶部的卷帘门有可能部分降下，同时伴有声响。如果这种情况发生足够多次，卷帘门将完全关闭，迫使员工改用消防出口。

== 策略 ==
到达主入口的最佳路径是直走到梯子下，爬到铁轨上，然后继续直走到主入口。从铁轨的任一侧跳下都不会受到摔落伤害，因此回船的时候你可以忽略那个梯子直接跳下去，返回船上。 

梯子有可能被随机生成的大石头挡住。在此情况下，可以往右走，寻找其他可用的梯子。 

== 物品表 ==
稀有度是该废料生成的基础值。公式 <code>废料稀有度 / 总稀有度 = X</code>、<code>X * 100 = %</code> 用于计算废料的实际生成概率。以 [[V-Type Engine|V 型引擎]]为例，其稀有度为 90。总稀有度，也就是所有废料稀有度的总和，为 613。代入以上公式，<code>90/613 = 0.1468</code>，<code>0.1468 * 100 = 14.68</code>。据此得出 版本45 中 Experimentation 里 [[V-Type Engine|V 型引擎]]的生成概率为 14.68%。
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Experimentation}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|hives=y|facility=y|nutcrackers=y}}

=== 日间 ===

[[Old birds|老式鸟型作战机甲]]有极小的概率刷新，如果刷新，其位置一般在船舱旁边。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}
=== 生成概率曲线 ===
在 Experimentation 上，夜间实体只会在下午 5 点左右开始生成，但在晚上 10 点生成概率显著升高，在凌晨 12 点达到最高值。而日间实体的生成概率随时间推进逐渐降低，其中大多数都在游戏开始时生成。曲线绘制方式详见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。

== 趣闻 ==
* Experimentation 自 [[Version 4|v4]] 起存在一片未正式使用的隐藏室内区域，其中包含多个房间和走廊。在原版游戏中，该区域通常无法正常进入；玩家只能借助[[Extension Ladder|伸缩梯]]，爬到消防出口后方的一处悬空门洞进入。
* 主入口附近的大型金属卷帘门有时会下落至半闭状态，这是一个彩蛋，致敬了 [[Version 4|v4]] 中出现的早期 Experimentation 地图。

== Company description ==
{{terminal|"The extension ladder can reach as high as nine meters! Use it to scale any cliff and reach for the stars! To save batteries the extension ladder automatically stores itself after 18 seconds."

== Overview ==

The '''Extension Ladder''' can be used to reach otherwise difficult-to-reach or inaccessible locations. It weighs nothing, making it easy for employees to carry.

The ladder remains extended for {{nowrap|18 seconds}}, as listed in its <code>INFO</code>. Note however that it does ''not'' have a battery in-game.

If the ladder falls on an employee, it kills them.

== Strategy ==

An obvious strategy for this item is to quickly get up to areas or escape danger by climbing up something.

Some noteworthy uses include reaching the fire escape on [[Offense]] without needing to jump onto the pipe at the start. It also is useful for maneuvering over the small bridge on [[Adamance]] when it has broken. And even can be used to move up and down the nearby cliffs to the fire escape allowing for safe movement of scrap.

An interesting property of the Extension Ladder is that it blocks both the line-of-sight and the stream of bullets coming from  [[Traps|Turrets]]. You could use this to temporarily clear a passage way if it is under overwatch of a Turret.

== Trivia ==

It is possible to stop employees from being ejected using the ladder, but this serves next to no practical purpose since the game will still be reset after a short time.

== History ==

=== [[Version 40]] ===

Fixed an issue that would occur if the ladder were placed with 0 rotation

Fixed an issue that could cause the player to die on the ladder before its animation played.

=== [[Version 39]] ===

Introduced

== Описание Компании ==
{{terminal|"Выдвижная лестница может достигать в высоту девяти метров! Используйте её, чтобы взбираться на горы и достигать звёзд! Для экономии заряда выдвижная лестница автоматически складывается через 18 секунд."
}}
<span id="Overview"></span>
== Общая информация ==

'''Выдвижная лестница''' может быть использована для достижения в иной ситуации труднодоступных или полностью недоступных мест. Ничего не весит, что делаёт её лёгкой для переноски сотрудниками.

Лестница остаётся разложенной {{nowrap|18 секунд}}, как и указано в её <code>INFO</code>. Примечательно, что в игре у неё ''отсутствует'' ограничение по заряду.

Если лестница падает на сотрудника, тот погибает.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Очевидная стратегия для этого предмета - быстрый подъём до требуемых мест или к укрытиям.

Примечательные способы использования включают в себя достижение труднодоступного пожарного выхода на [[Offense/ru|Offense]] без нужды запрыгивать на трубу при приземлении корабля в начале дня. Также может быть полезна при переправе через маленький мост на [[Adamance/ru|Adamance]], если тот уже сломался. Может также использоваться для подъёма по склонам у пожарного выхода рядом с маленьким мостом, делая переправу лома безопасной.

Интересной особенностью выдвижной лестницы является её способность перекрывать поле зрения и пули [[Traps/ru|турели]]. Это можно использовать для временного обезопашивания проходов под наблюдением турели.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные факты ==

С помощью лестниц можно предотвратить выпадение сотрудников в космос при увольнении. Это не несёт практической пользы, так как перезапуск происходит спустя фиксированное время.

<span id="History"></span>
== История ==

<span id="Company_description"></span>
== 公司描述 ==
{{terminal|伸缩梯最高可伸展至**9米**！用它翻越任何悬崖、触手可及星辰！为节省电量，伸缩梯会在**18秒后**自动收回。
}}
<span id="Overview"></span>
== 概述 ==

'''伸缩梯'''用于抵达平时难以触及或无法到达的位置。它没有重量，便于玩家携带。

如装备信息（INFO）所示，梯子会保持伸展状态18秒。但请注意，游戏内该物品**并不配备电池。

如果梯子砸到员工身上，会直接将其砸死。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

这件物品的一个实用技巧是：快速攀爬到高处区域，或是通过攀爬物体来逃离危险。

一些值得注意的用法包括：在[[Offense]]地图中，无需一开始跳上管道就能直接抵达消防通道。在[[Adamance]]地图里，当小桥断裂时，伸缩梯也能帮助玩家跨越。它甚至可以用来在消防通道附近的悬崖间上下攀爬，让搬运废料的过程更加安全。

伸缩梯有一个有趣的特性：它既能阻挡[[陷阱|炮塔]]的视线，也能阻挡其射出的子弹。如果通道处于炮塔的监视之下，你可以利用这一点临时开辟出一条通路。

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== 趣闻 ==

可以用梯子阻止员工被弹飞，但这几乎没有实际用处，因为游戏仍会在短时间后重置。

== 历史 ==

<translate>
<!--T:17-->
{{redirect|Dog|the smaller canine entity|Kidnapper fox}}

<!--T:1-->
The '''Eyeless Dog''' is a hostile outdoor [[Entities|entity]]. Commonly found roaming in packs, it is completely blind, and instead uses its exceptional hearing to hunt down and ruthlessly maul employees who alert it to their presence. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Titan]].

<!--T:18-->
Eyeless Dogs are large, quadrupedal feline creatures with maroon fur, with a thin mane of darker crimson hair running down their back, along with a long tail. Their heads are almost entirely featureless, save for a large, gaping mouth with a pair of sharp jaws containing off-white needle-like teeth.

<!--T:2-->
== Bestiary entry ==
{{Terminal|text=EYELESS DOG<br /><br />
Scientific name: Leo caecus<br />
A large mammal of the family Saeptivus. They are social, hunting in very large packs. They have also been called "breathing lions" for their recognizable sound and large mouths. They are endurance hunters and attempt to make up for their lack of sight with their sense of hearing. It's a popular myth that they often mistake the sounds of their own kind for prey, entering fights within their own packs.<br /><br />

<!--T:10-->
Their behaviour is unique from other pack animals in their tendency to spread out far to cover distance. When an eyeless dog has found prey, it roars to alert others in the near vicinity, who will also sound the alarm, sometimes resulting in a kind of chain reaction. Eyeless dogs can be dangerous in swarms. However, they are characteristically clumsy, taking guesses at their prey's exact location which are often incorrect.}}
</translate>
== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<translate>

<!--T:3-->
== Mechanics ==
=== Noise loudness meter ===
Each [[Audible_sounds|sound in the game]] has its own specified "noise loudness" meter, being increased and decreased depending on the distance from an entity (such as an Eyeless dog).

<!--T:11-->
Formula:

<!--T:12-->
 Distance < 18 * Noise Loudness

<!--T:13-->
'''''Note:''' Noise Loudness is halved if there is no line of sight between the player and an entity.''

<!--T:4-->
=== States ===
Eyeless dogs have three possible states: roaming, suspicious, and enraged.

<!--T:5-->
==== Roaming ====
While roaming, Eyeless dogs will wander aimlessly, and not specifically stay by the player. Their behavior is based entirely on sound detection, not proximity to a silent player. 

<!--T:6-->
==== Suspicious ====
If a sound with a noise loudness of 0.25 or more is heard by Eyeless dogs, it will add one counter to their "suspicion level". They will then investigate the sound, with their suspicion level decreasing by 1 every 4 seconds. When in the suspicious state, Eyeless Dogs will boost their heads up, and rumble their head while walking confidently. Once their suspicion level is less than  1, they will begin to roam again. 

<!--T:7-->
==== Enraged ====
If their suspicion level reaches 9 or more, or the noise loudness formula above is true, Eyeless dogs will go into a frenzy, quickly lunging towards the approximate location of the noise once close enough. While not lunging, their suspicion level will decrease by 1 every 3 seconds. Once the suspicion level is less than 9, they will stay still until their suspicion level drops to less than 1 (where they will begin roaming again) or another sound is heard. If an employee is caught by an Eyeless Dog in this phase, they are torn to shreds.

<!--T:19-->
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.

<!--T:8-->
== Strategy ==
Spotting Eyeless dogs from afar, players can maneuver around them without alerting them through noise. Alternatively, crouch walking (which eliminates sound made through moving), remaining silent and out of Eyeless dogs' path to avoid a head-on collision allows players to pass by without detection. However, those carrying noisy [[scrap]] (even if unequipped in their inventory) such as [[Teeth]], [[Old Phone]]s, and [[Robot Toy]]s will alert nearby Eyeless dogs.

<!--T:20-->
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.

<!--T:14-->
Eyeless dogs are especially challenging for those staying inside the [[ship]]. Hearing or seeing them nearby, players are able to warn others that there are Eyeless dogs outside before avoiding making sound altogether. Rushing to close the [[Door Controls|door]] can attract Eyeless dogs through the noise made, which may enter the ship once the door reopens. If inside the ship, players can either stay silent in the corner to avoid its path while it walks through, or use the [[Loud Horn|loud horn]] to draw them to the front. Additionally, Eyeless dogs can be drawn away by purchasing an item from the [[store]], as the jingle of the pod will attract them until it departs.

<!--T:21-->
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed. 

<!--T:22-->
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.

<!--T:15-->
Hitting Eyeless dogs with a [[shovel]] will cause them to instantly charge in the direction that they're facing. Players can take advantage of this by forcing them to charge into a wall, followed by a series of repeated shovel hits to stun lock and eventually kill with 12 hits.
</translate>

Augenlose Hunde können in großen Zahlen gefährlich sein, allerdings sind sie tollpatschig und liegen beim Erraten der genauen Position ihrer Beute häufig daneben.

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Spielmechaniken ==
=== Lautstärke von Lärm ===
Jedes Geräusch im Spiel hat einen eigenen festgelegten "Lautstärkepegel". Dieser erhöht oder reduziert sich je nach Distanz zu einer Kreatur.
</div>

Formel:

Distanz < 18 * Lautstärkepegel

'''''Wichtig:''' Der Lautstärkepegel wird halbiert, falls keine direkte Sichtlinie zwischen Spieler und Kreatur besteht.''

=== Modi ===
Augenlose Hunde haben drei Modi: Wandelnd, Verdacht und Wütend.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Wandelnd ===
In diesem Zustand laufen augenlose Hunde ziellos umher.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Verdacht ====
Falls ein Geräusch mit einem Lautstärkepegel von 0,25 oder mehr von einem augenlosen Hund gehört wird, wird die "Verdachtsstufe" des Hundes um 1 erhöht. Daraufhin untersuchen sie das Geräusch, während sich ihre Verdachtsstufe alle 4 Sekunden um 1 reduziert. Sobald ihre Verdachtsstufe unter 1 fällt gehen sie zurück in den Wandelnd-Zustand.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Wütend ====
Erreicht ihre Verdachtsstufe einen Wert von 9 oder höher, werden augenlose Hunde wütend und stürzen sich auf die ungefähre Position des Geräuschs sobald sie in Reichweite sind. Bevor sie sich auf das Ziel stürzen, reduziert sich ihre Verdachtsstufe alle 3 Sekunden um 1. Fällt der Wert unter 9 zurück, bleibt der Hund stehen bis entweder ein Wert von weniger als 1 erreicht ist und der Hund wieder in den Wandelnd-Zustand übergehen kann oder ein weiteres Geräusch gehört wird.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

== Strategie ==
Wird ein augenloser Hund aus der Ferne gesehen, können Spieler ihn vermeiden indem sie leise einen Bogen um ihn machen. Bleibt man geduckt, komplett still und aus dem direkten Pfad des Hundes um Kollisionen zu vermeiden, können Spieler an ihm vorbei ohne entdeckt zu werden. Allerdings sollte man daran denken, dass [[Scrap/de|Schrott]] der Geräusche verursacht (wie z.B. [[Teeth|Gebiss]] und [[Robot Toy|Spielzeugroboter]]) von den augenlosen Hunden gehört werden kann.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

Augenlose Hunde sind für Spieler vor allem im [[Ship|Schiff]] gefährlich. Hört oder sieht man einen in der Nähe, können andere Spieler noch gewarnt werden bevor man verstummt. Die [[Door Controls|Tür]] des Schiffs zu schließen verursacht Geräusche und lockt augenlose Hunde an, die dann in das Schiff gelangen können wenn die Tür sich wieder öffnet. Falls es dazu kommt können Spieler Kollisionen vermeiden, indem sie in den Ecken bleiben oder das [[Loud Horn|laute Signalhorn]] nutzen, um den Hund an die Spitze des Schiffs zu locken. Auch können augenlose Hunde durch das Kaufen eines Gegenstandes abgelenkt werden, da die Abwurfkapsel bei der Lieferung die Hunde mit ihrer Melodie anzieht.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

Schlägt man einen augenlosen Hund mit einer [[Shovel|Schaufel]], stürzt dieser sich sofort in die Richtung in die er gerade sieht. Spieler können das zu ihrem Vorteil nutzen und sie in eine Wand rennen lassen. So können Hunde mit 12 Treffern langsam aber sicher erledigt werden.

== Mechanics ==
=== Noise loudness meter ===
Each [[Audible_sounds|sound in the game]] has its own specified "noise loudness" meter, being increased and decreased depending on the distance from an entity (such as an Eyeless dog).

Formula:

 Distance < 18 * Noise Loudness

'''''Note:''' Noise Loudness is halved if there is no line of sight between the player and an entity.''

=== States ===
Eyeless dogs have three possible states: roaming, suspicious, and enraged.

==== Roaming ====
While roaming, Eyeless dogs will wander aimlessly, and not specifically stay by the player. Their behavior is based entirely on sound detection, not proximity to a silent player. 

==== Suspicious ====
If a sound with a noise loudness of 0.25 or more is heard by Eyeless dogs, it will add one counter to their "suspicion level". They will then investigate the sound, with their suspicion level decreasing by 1 every 4 seconds. When in the suspicious state, Eyeless Dogs will boost their heads up, and rumble their head while walking confidently. Once their suspicion level is less than  1, they will begin to roam again. 

==== Enraged ====
If their suspicion level reaches 9 or more, or the noise loudness formula above is true, Eyeless dogs will go into a frenzy, quickly lunging towards the approximate location of the noise once close enough. While not lunging, their suspicion level will decrease by 1 every 3 seconds. Once the suspicion level is less than 9, they will stay still until their suspicion level drops to less than 1 (where they will begin roaming again) or another sound is heard. If an employee is caught by an Eyeless Dog in this phase, they are torn to shreds.

The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.

== Strategy ==
Spotting Eyeless dogs from afar, players can maneuver around them without alerting them through noise. Alternatively, crouch walking (which eliminates sound made through moving), remaining silent and out of Eyeless dogs' path to avoid a head-on collision allows players to pass by without detection. However, those carrying noisy [[scrap]] (even if unequipped in their inventory) such as [[Teeth]], [[Old Phone]]s, and [[Robot Toy]]s will alert nearby Eyeless dogs.

Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.

Eyeless dogs are especially challenging for those staying inside the [[ship]]. Hearing or seeing them nearby, players are able to warn others that there are Eyeless dogs outside before avoiding making sound altogether. Rushing to close the [[Door Controls|door]] can attract Eyeless dogs through the noise made, which may enter the ship once the door reopens. If inside the ship, players can either stay silent in the corner to avoid its path while it walks through, or use the [[Loud Horn|loud horn]] to draw them to the front. Additionally, Eyeless dogs can be drawn away by purchasing an item from the [[store]], as the jingle of the pod will attract them until it departs.

Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed. 

If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.

Hitting Eyeless dogs with a [[shovel]] will cause them to instantly charge in the direction that they're facing. Players can take advantage of this by forcing them to charge into a wall, followed by a series of repeated shovel hits to stun lock and eventually kill with 12 hits.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Perros Ciegos''', coloquialmente conocidos solo como "perros", son criaturas que se juntan en manadas y deambulan por el exterior. Son ciegos, dependen de su audición y matarán a los jugadores que los alerten.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Eyeless Dogs are large, quadrupedal feline creatures with maroon fur, with a thin mane of darker crimson hair running down their back, along with a long tail. Their heads are almost entirely featureless, save for a large, gaping mouth with a pair of sharp jaws containing off-white needle-like teeth.
</div>

== Entrada al Bestiario ==
{{Terminal|text=Perro Ciego<br /><br />
Nombre científico: Leo caecus<br />
Un gran mamífero perteneciente a la clase Saeptivus. Son sociales y cazan en grandes manadas. También se les ha llamado "leones jadeantes" por su sonido reconocible y sus bocas. Son cazadores robustos y tratan de compensar su falta de vista con su sentido del oído. Hay un rumor que dice que a veces confunden el sonido de los de su propia especie por presas, resultando en peleas en la manada.

Su comportamiento se distingue mucho de otros animales que se juntan en manadas debido a su tendencia a dispersarse para cubrir más terreno. Cuando un perro ciego ha encontrado una presa, ruge para alertar al resto, los cuales harán lo mismo, a veces provocando una reacción en cadena. Los perros ciegos pueden ser muy peligrosos en grupo. Sin embargo, son bastante torpes, ya que tratarán de averiguar donde esta su presa y a veces de forma incorrecta.}}
== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Mecánicas ==
== Medidor de ruido ==
Cada sonido en el juego tiene su propio medidor de "nivel de ruido", subiendo y bajando dependiendo de la distancia de una entidad (como un Perro Ciego).
</div>

Formula:

Distance < 18 * Noise Loudness

'''''Nota:''' El Nivel de Ruido se divide si no hay contacto visual entre el jugador y la entidad.''

=== Estados ===
Los perros ciegos tienen tres posibles estados: deambulando, sospechando y enfadado.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Deambulando ===
Al deambular, los Perros ciegos caminarán sin rumbo fijo.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Sospechoso ====
Si un Perro ciego oye un sonido con un nivel de ruido de 0.25 o mayor, se agregará un contador a su "nivel de sospecha". Irán a investigar el sonido, con su nivel de sospecha bajando en 1 cada 4 segundos. Una vez que su nivel de sospecha vuelva a ser inferior a 1, volverán a deambular sin rumbo.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Enfadado ====
Si su nivel de sospecha es igual o mayor a 9, o si la fórmula del nivel de ruido de arriba se cumple, los Perros ciegos se enfadarán, corriendo y cargando contra el origen aproximado del sonido una vez están cerca. Mientras no están cargando contra nada, su nivel de sospecha bajará 1 cada 3 segundos. Una vez el nivel de sospecha esté por debajo de 9, se quedarán quietos hasta que el nivel de sospecha vuelva a estar por debajo de 1 (donde volverán a deambular) o vuelvan a escuchar otro sonido.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

== Estrategia ==
Si uno logra divisar Perros ciegos desde la distancia, es posible evitarlos sin llamar su atención. Alternativamente, uno puede gatear (lo cual no producirá ningún sonido al moverse), mantenerse callado e intentar no chocarse con los Perros ciegos para evitar colisiones y no ser detectados. Sin embargo, cualquiera que lleve [[scrap/es|chatarra]] ruidosa (incluso sin tenerla directamente en la mano), como [[Teeth/es|Dientes]], [[Old Phone/es|Teléfonos Viejos]] y [[Robot Toy/es|Juguetes de Robot]] alertarán a Perros ciegos en la cercanía.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

Los Perros ciegos pueden resultar ser un desafío para quienes están dentro de la [[ship/es|nave]]. Al poder escucharlos o verlos desde la lejanía, uno podría avisar al resto del equipo de la presencia de Perros ciegos en el exterior para evitar hacer ruido innecesario. Correr para cerrar la [[Door Controls/es|puerta]] puede atraer a Perros ciegos por el ruido que hace, haciendo que puedan entrar a la nave una vez esta vuelva a abrirse. Estando dentro de la nave, los jugadores pueden optar tanto por quedarse quietos en una esquina sin hacer ruido o usar la [[Loud horn/es|bocina]] para atraerlos al frente de la nave. Cabe mencionar que los Perros ciegos pueden ser atraídos lejos de la nave comprando un objeto en la [[Store/es|tienda]], ya que la melodía de la nave de entrega los atraerá hasta que se vaya.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

Golpear un Perro ciego con una [[Shovel/es|pala]] provocará que este cargue en su dirección actual. Los jugadores pueden usar esto para su beneficio, haciendo que arremetan contra una pared y así poder atacarlos hasta matarlos de 12 golpes.

== Wpis w bestiariuszu ==
<blockquote>
<div class="terminal">
Duży ssak z klasy Saeptivus. Są socjalne, polują w bardzo dużych stadach. Nazywano je również "oddychającymi lwami” ze względu na ich rozpoznawalny dźwięk i duże usta. Są łowcami wytrzymałościowymi i próbują nadrobić brak wzroku zmysłem słuchu. Popularnym mitem jest to, że często mylą dźwięki własnego gatunku z ofiarą i wdają się w walki w obrębie własnego stada.
</div>

Bezokie Psy mogą być niebezpieczne w rojach. Są jednak charakterystycznie niezdarne i domyślają się dokładnej lokalizacji swojej ofiary, co często jest niepoprawne.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Mechaniki ==
=== Miernik głośności dźwięków ===
Każdy dźwięk w grze ma swój własny, określony miernik „głośności”, który jest zwiększany i zmniejszany w zależności od odległości od bytu (takiego jak Bezoki Pies).
</div>

Formuła:

Dystans < 18 * Głośność dźwięku

'''''Notka:''' Głośność dźwięku jest zmniejszona o połowę, jeśli nie ma linii widzenia pomiędzy graczem a bytem.''

=== Stany ===
Bezokie psy mają trzy możliwe stany: patrolowanie, podejrzliwy i rozwścieczony.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Patrolowanie ====
Podczas patrolowania Bezoki Pies będzie wędrować bez celu.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Podejrzliwy ====
Jeśli dźwięk o głośności większej bądź równej 0.25 jest słyszalny dla Bezokiego Psa, zwiększy to o jeden ich "licznik podejrzliwości". Spróbują one wtedy zbadać dźwięk i jego pochodzenie, a ich licznik podejrzliwości będzie się zmniejszał o 1 co 4 sekundy. Kiedy ów licznik osiągnie mniej niż 1, powrócą one do stanu patrolowania.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Wściekły ====
Jeśli ich licznik podejrzliwości osiągnie 9 lub więcej lub powyższa formuła głośności dźwięku się sprawdzi, Bezokie Psy wchodzą w stan wściekłości, biegnąc i rzucając się w stronę przybliżonej lokalizacji, skąd pochodzi dźwięk, kiedy są już blisko. Kiedy się nie rzucają, ich licznik podejrzliwości zmniejsza się o 1 co 3 sekundy. Jeśli licznik osiągnie mniej niż 9, staną w miejscu i nie ruszą się do momentu, aż nie osiągnie on mniej niż 1 (gdzie powrócą one do stanu patrolowania) lub nie usłyszą kolejnego dźwięku.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

== Strategia ==
Zauważenie Bezokich Psów z daleka, pozwoli pracownikom wymanewrować dookoła nich bez alarmowania ich. Alternatywnie, skradanie się (które eliminuje dźwięk podczas chodzenia), pozostanie w ciszy i nie wchodzenie w drogę Bezokiego Psa, by uniknąć zetknięcia się z ich głową, umożliwi pracownikom by przejść obok nich niezauważonym (hehe). Jednakże, ci którzy niosą ze sobą hałaśliwy [[Scrap/pl|złom]] (nawet jeśli jest on schowany w ekwipunku) taki jak [[Teeth/pl|zęby]], [[Old Phone/pl|stary telefon]], czy [[Robot Toy/pl|robot-zabawka]] zaalarmuje pobliskie Bezokie Psy.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

Bezokie Psy są szczególnie trudne dla osób przebywających na [[Ship/pl|statku]]. Słysząc lub widząc je w pobliżu, gracze mogą ostrzec innych, że na zewnątrz znajdują się psy Bezokie, zanim całkowicie unikną wydawania dźwięków. Pośpieszenie się, aby zamknąć [[Door Controls/pl|drzwi]] może przyciągnąć Bezokie Psy poprzez wytwarzany hałas, który może przedostać się na statek po ponownym otwarciu drzwi. Będąc na statku, gracze mogą albo pozostać cicho w kącie, aby uniknąć zetknięcia podczas jego przechodzenia, albo użyć [[Loud Horn/pl|głośnej syreny]], aby przyciągnąć je do przodu. Dodatkowo, Bezokie Psy można odciągnąć, kupując przedmiot w [[store/pl|sklepu]], ponieważ dźwięk kapsuły je przyciągnie, dopóki nie odleci.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

Uderzenie Bezokiego Psa [[Shovel/pl|łopatą]] spowoduje, że natychmiast rzuci się on w stronę, w którą jest już skierowany. Pracownicy mogą wykorzystać to na swoją korzyść, zmuszając je by walnęły w ścianę, po którym następuje seria powtórzeń uderzeń łopatą by zablokować je w tej pozycji i ostatecznie zabić je po 12 uderzeniach.

== Entrada do Bestiário ==
{{Terminal|text=EYELESS DOG<br /><br />
Nome científico: Leo caecus<br />
Um mamífero grande da classe Saeptivus. Eles são sociais, caçando em grupos muito grandes. Eles também já foram chamados de "leões que respiram" pelo seu som reconhecível e bocas grandes. Eles são caçadores de resistência e tentam compensar a falta de visão com seu sentido de audição. É um mito popular que eles confundem frequentemente os sons de presas com os sons de sua propria espécie, entrando em lutas em seus próprios grupos.<br /><br />

Cachorros podem perigosos em grupos. No entanto, eles são caracteristicamentes desajeitados, adivinhando a localização exata de suas presas, que provavelmente estão incorretas.
</div>

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Mecânicas ==
=== Medidor de intensidade de ruído ===
Cada som no jogo tem seu próprio medidor de "intensidade de ruído", sendo aumentado e diminuído dependendo da distância da [[entities|entidade]] (tal como o Cachorro Cego).
</div>

Fórmula:

Distância < 18 * Intensidade do Ruído

'''''Nota:''' A Intensidade do Barulho é dividida pela metade se não tiver nenhuma linha de visão entre o jogador e a entidade.''

=== Estágios ===
Cachorros cegos tem 3 possíveis estágios:
localizando, suspeitando e enfurecido.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Localizando ====
Enquanto procura, Cachorros cegos vagarão sem rumo.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Suspeitando ====
Se um som com uma intensidade de ruído de 0.25 ou mais for ouvida por um Cachorro, eles adicionarão um ponto no contador de "suspeitação". Eles irão investigar o som, com o contador diminuindo 1 ponto a cada 4 segundos. Quando o contador de suspeitação é menor de 1 ponto, eles voltarão a procurar de novo.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Enfurecido ====
Se o nível de suspeitação chegar a 9 pontos ou mais, ou a fórmula de intensidade de ruído é acima igual a "true", Cachorros vão ficar enfurecidos, eles vão correr e atacar atrás da localização aproximada do barulho próximo. Quando não estão atacando, o nível de suspeitação deles irão descer por 1 a cada 3 segundos. Se o nível de suspeitação ficar abaixo de 9 pontos, eles ficarão suspeitando até o nível ficar abaixo de 1 ponto, onde eles voltarão a procurar de novo até outro som ser ouvido.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

== Estratégia ==
Por serem grandes, eles podem ser vistos a uma distância considerável, sempre é bom você começar a andar agachado quando notar um, pois nunca se sabe se ele vai te ouvir ou não, e faça silêncio, desligue o seu [[Walkie-Talkie]] e quando você achar que você está longe o suficiente de um, você pode voltar a andar normalmente. Eles podem ouvir objetos barulhentos, então é sempre bom tentar silenciar-los (soltando e pegando um até ele parar de fazer barulho) quando for em direção a nave.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

Os cachorros são um dos poucos seres que podem entrar na [[ship|nave]]. É sempre bom fechar a porta da nave quando for falar no Walkie-Talkie com um outro jogador, pois como visto anteriormente, eles podem ouvir você falando e também podem ouvir o seu coleguinha no Walkie-Talkie. Eles também podem ouvir a porta da nave, e eles entraram quando acabar a energia da porta. Uma forma de tira-lo da porta, é comprar um item baratinho na loja, a música da nave de entregas vai distrai-los, dando tempo de esperar a porta recarregar ou esperar seu amigo chegar. A [[Boombox|caixa de som]] pode parecer um item inútil, mas é extremamente útil para distrair um Cachorro Cego. A forma mais útil para se proteger de um cachorro quando a porta se abrir é se esconder no canto entre o [[terminal]] e o painel da nave, ou ainda melhor, você pode colocar dois móveis altos na entrada, impedindo que o cachorro chegue a você.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

Acertar um Cachorro com uma [[shovel|pá]] pode parecer uma boa ideia, mas ai quando você descobre que o cachorro também tem células nervosas, você não vai achar tão boa essa ideia. Ele vai pular em você e te engolir imediatamente. Mas, você e seus amigos podem pegar vantagem forçando ele em uma parede, seguido de uma série de pancadas continuas até eventualmente matar-lo com 12 pauladas. Se você entendeu alguma coisa que eu falei chame um médico.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Безглазые Псы''', в простонародье именуемые просто "собаки" - огромные агрессивные стайные охотники, блуждающие на улице. Будучи слепыми, они полагаются на свой выдающийся слух и убивают игроков, которых учуют.

== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{Terminal|text=БЕЗГЛАЗЫЙ ПЁС<br /><br />
Научное название: Leo caecus<br />
Огромное млекопитающее класса Цейтлеровых. Социальны, охотятся в огромных стаях. Их также называют "дышащими львами" за издаваемый ими узнаваемый звук и огромные рты. Они являются выносливыми охотниками и пытаются компенсировать отсутствие зрения своим хорошим слухом. Популярен миф о том, что они часто путают звук себе подобных со звуком добычи, начиная драку внутри своей же стаи.

Их поведение уникально по сравнению с другими стайными животными из-за их тенденции распределяться по территории для увеличенного покрытия дистанции. Когда слепой пёс обнаруживает добычу, он громко рычит, чтобы оповестить остальных по-близости, а те в свою очередь сделают то же самое, иногда приводя к цепной реакции. Безглазые псы могут быть очень опасными в стае. Тем не менее, они характерны своей неуклюжестью, делая догадки о конкретном местоположении жертвы, часто неверные.}}
== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== Механики ==
=== Счётчик громкости шума ===
Каждый [[Audible_sounds|звук в игре]] обладает своей "громкостью", уменьшая и увеличивая счётчик в зависимости от дистанции до сущности (таких как, например, Слепые псы).

Формула:

Дистанция < 18 * Громкость шума

'''''Заметка:''' Громкость шума сокращается вдвое, если между источником и сущностью есть преграда.''

=== Состояния ===
Слепые псы имеют три возможных состояния: блуждание, подозрение и ярость.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Блуждание ====
Во время блуждания Слепые псы просто бесцельно бродят.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Подозрение ====
Если Слепой пёс слышит звук с громкостью 0.25 или более, он добавит очко к "уровню подозрения". Они начнут изучать источник шума, с уменьшением их уровня подозрения на 1 значение каждые 4 секунды. Как только их уровень подозрения становится меньше 1, они возвращаются к блужданию.
</div> 

==== Ярость ====
Если их уровень подозрения достигает значения 9 или больше, или если формула громкости выше истинна, Слепые входят в состояние ярости, стремительно двигаясь и бросаясь в сторону предполагаемого источника шума как только подбираются достаточно близко. Пока они не бросаются, их уровень подозрения будет падать на 1 каждые 3 секунды. Как только уровень подозрения снова меньше 9, они замрут на месте до тех пор, пока их уровень подозрения снова не упадёт ниже 1 (после чего они снова вернутся к блужданию) или пока они не услышат другой звук. Если в сотрудник был пойман Слепым Псом в данном состоянии, он будет порван в клочки немедленно.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

== Стратегия ==
Заметив Слепых псов издалека, игроки могут маневрировать вокруг них не беспокоя их никакими звуками. Альтернативно, пригнувшись (избавляя свои движения от звуков), оставаясь тихим и избегая траектории движения Слепых псов и столкновения с ними, игроки могут пройти мимо незамеченными. Тем не менее, игроки, таскающие [[scrap|лут]] (не обязательно в активном слоте), такой как [[Teeth|челюсти]], [[Old Phone|старые телефоны]] и [[Robot Toy|игрушечные роботы]] обратят на себя внимание Слепых псов поблизости.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

Слепые псы особенно трудные для тех, кто остался внутри [[ship/ru|корабля]]. Заметив или услышав собак снаружи, игроки могут успеть предупредить остальных о присутствии Слепых псов снаружи перед тем, как замолкнуть и избегать издавания громких звуков. Подбегание к [[ship/ru#Панель управления дверьми и выключатель света|панели управления дверьми]] может привлечь Слепых псов издаваемыми звуками, из-за чего они могут войти в корабль, когда двери неизбежно откроются. Игроки внутри корабля могут тихо забиться в угол, чтобы не попасться на пути Псов, либо использовать [[Loud Horn|громкий гудок]], чтобы выманить их наружу к переду корабля. Дополнительно, Слепых псов можно увести от корабля покупкой корабля в [[store/ru|магазине]], так как мелодия, издаваемая десантным модулем, будет отвлекать Псов на себя, пока не улетит.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

Удары по Слепым псам [[shovel|лопатой]] заставят их немедленно бросится в направлении, в которое смотря. Игроки могут использовать это, заставляя собак вечно бросаться в стену, сопровождая это повторяющимися ударами лопаты, в конце-концов убивая их за 12 ударов.

== Запис в Бестіарії ==
<blockquote>
<div class="terminal">
Великий ссавець класу «Saeptivus» (Охоронних). Вони соціальні, полюють дуже великими зграями. Їх також називають «дихаючими левами» за їхній впізнаваний звук і велику пащу. </div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Їхня поведінка відрізняється від інших в’ючних тварин своєю схильністю далеко поширюватися, щоб долати відстань. Коли Безокий пес знайшов здобич, він реве, щоб попередити інших поблизу, які також б’ють тривогу, що іноді призводить до ланцюгової реакції. Безокий Собака може бути небезпечним у зграях. Однак вони відрізняються незграбністю, здогадуючись про, зазвичай, хибне місцезнаходження жертви.
</div>
== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Механіка ==
=== Рівень гучності шуму ===
Кожен звук у грі має власний визначений «Рівень гучності», який збільшується та зменшується залежно від відстані від сутності (напр. Безокого пса).
</div>

Формула:

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Відстань < 18 * Гучність
</div>

'''''Замітка''' Рівень гучності ділиться на 2, якщо між гравцем та істотою немає прямого контакту''

=== Стани поведінки ===
Безокі пси мають три можливих стани: никання, підозрілість та розлюченість.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Никання ===
Під час никання безокі пси безцільно блукатимуть.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Підозрілість ==== Якщо безокі пси почують звук із гучністю 0,25 або більше, це додасть один лічильник до їхнього «рівня підозри» і вони досліджуватимуть звук, причому їхній рівень підозри зменшуватиметься на 1 кожні 4 секунди. Коли рівень підозри стане меншим за 1, вони знову почнуть блукати.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Розлюченість ====
Якщо їхній рівень підозрілості сягає 9 або більше, Безокі пси розлючуються, рухаються та кидаються до приблизного місця шуму, коли вони досить близько. Поки вони не роблять випад, їх рівень підозрілості буде знижуватися на 1 кожні 3 секунди. Якщо рівень підозри стане меншим за 9, вони залишатимуться нерухомими, доки їхній рівень підозри не впаде нижче 1 (після чого вони знову почнуть блукати) або не почують інший звук.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
Spotting Eyeless dogs from afar, players can maneuver around them without alerting them through noise. Alternatively, crouch walking (which eliminates sound made through moving), remaining silent and out of Eyeless dogs' path to avoid a head-on collision allows players to pass by without detection. However, those carrying noisy [[scrap]] (even if unequipped in their inventory) such as [[Teeth]], [[Old Phone]]s, and [[Robot Toy]]s will alert nearby Eyeless dogs.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Eyeless dogs are especially challenging for those staying inside the [[ship]]. Hearing or seeing them nearby, players are able to warn others that there are Eyeless dogs outside before avoiding making sound altogether. Rushing to close the [[Door Controls|door]] can attract Eyeless dogs through the noise made, which may enter the ship once the door reopens. If inside the ship, players can either stay silent in the corner to avoid its path while it walks through, or use the [[Loud Horn|loud horn]] to draw them to the front. Additionally, Eyeless dogs can be drawn away by purchasing an item from the [[store]], as the jingle of the pod will attract them until it departs.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Hitting Eyeless dogs with a [[shovel]] will cause them to instantly charge in the direction that they're facing. Players can take advantage of this by forcing them to charge into a wall, followed by a series of repeated shovel hits to stun lock and eventually kill with 12 hits.
</div>

######## Eyeless Dog/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Dog|the smaller canine entity|Kidnapper fox}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''无眼狗'''，俗称“狗”，是在室外漫游的一群富有攻击性的大型捕猎者。由于缺乏视力，它们依靠灵敏的听力定位并杀死引起它们注意的玩家。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Eyeless Dogs are large, quadrupedal feline creatures with maroon fur, with a thin mane of darker crimson hair running down their back, along with a long tail. Their heads are almost entirely featureless, save for a large, gaping mouth with a pair of sharp jaws containing off-white needle-like teeth.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 生物图鉴条目 ==
<blockquote>
<div class="terminal">
无眼狗，Saeptivus 属，是一种大型哺乳群居动物，会以规模庞大的群体进行捕猎，也因其标志性的声音和大嘴巴而被称为“喘气狮”。它们是耐力型捕猎者，虽然没有视力，但其靠灵敏的听力补足了这一缺点。流言称无眼狗会将同类的声音误认为是猎物发出的，并因此引发种群内部争斗。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
它们的行为与其他群居动物有所不同，表现为其倾向于分散开来以狩猎更为广阔的区域。当一只无眼狗发现猎物时，它会吼叫以通知附近的同类，而附近的同类亦会吼叫以通知其他同类，有时甚至能形成类似链式反应的结果。因此，大量无眼狗聚集在一起时将极具威胁性。不过，它们通常也较为笨拙，因其特性决定其只能推测猎物的大致位置，且此结果常常不准确。
</div>
</blockquote>
</div>
== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 机制 ==
=== 噪音响度计 ===
游戏中的每个声音都有独自的“噪音响度”值，并会基于发声位置与实体（如无眼狗）的距离增加或减少。
</div>

公式：

 距离 < 18 * 噪音响度

'''''注：'''若玩家与实体间没有视线（互相不可见），<code>噪音响度</code>将减半。''

=== 状态 ===
无眼狗有三种状态：漫游、怀疑和发怒。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== 漫游 ====
在漫游状态时，无眼狗会无目的地闲逛。
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== 怀疑 ====
如果无眼狗听到了一个噪音响度大于等于 0.25 的声音，它会将自身的“怀疑度”加 1。随后无眼狗将调查该声音，在此期间怀疑度每 4 秒减 1。一旦怀疑度降至 1 以下，无眼狗将回到漫游状态。
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== 发怒 ====
若无眼狗的怀疑度达到 9 或更高，或上述表达式成立时，它会进入发怒状态，向音源的大致位置移动，并在足够靠近时猛扑上去。若其未在猛扑，无眼狗的怀疑度每 3 秒减 1。一旦怀疑度低于 9，无眼狗会保持不动，除非它听到了另外一个声音，或怀疑度降至 1 以下（回到漫游状态）。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Eyeless Dog will violently shake its head side to side with the player in its jaws. In this temporary moment, the eyeless dog will be stunned for a couple seconds, as it is busy with its meal.
</div>

== 策略 ==
若在远处看见无眼狗，玩家可调整行动路径，从而避免发出的声音引起无眼狗的注意。此外，蹲下行走（以消除移动时发出的声音）、保持安静、避开无眼狗的行动路径（以免与其发生碰撞）也可让玩家从无眼狗附近经过而不被发现。不过，若玩家持有（即使未手持，物品位于物品栏中也算）[[Teeth|假牙]]、[[Old Phone|旧电话]]、[[Robot Toy|玩具机器人]]等会产生噪音的[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]，也会引起附近无眼狗的注意。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Dropping any item, regardless of its weight, creates a sound that the dogs can hear and will cause them to investigate the area.
Their alert system is triggered by specific noises (sounds with a loudness pitch of 0.25 or more), not the item's mass.
For example, dropping a [[bell]] will alert the dogs system more than it would dropping a [[Whoopie cushion]], because the [[bell]] has a higher loudness pitch.
</div>

无眼狗对位于[[Ship/zh-cn|飞船]]内的玩家来说尤其难以处理。若在飞船附近发现或听到无眼狗时，玩家可以先互相警告，然后一同避免发出声音。匆忙前去关[[Door Controls|门]]所发出的声音可能会将无眼狗吸引过来，一旦门再次开启，无眼狗就有可能进入飞船内。如果无眼狗进入飞船，玩家可以保持安静并躲在角落中，以此避开无眼狗的行动路径；也可以使用[[Loud Horn|响亮喇叭]]将无眼狗引至船头。此外，亦可以在[[Store/zh-cn|商店]]里购买物品，因为在空投舱离开前，它发出的音乐可以一直吸引无眼狗的注意。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Even if being silent and crouching, an Eyeless Dog can still go into its enraged state if it is aggroed, and will proceed to lunge into the [[ship]]. All players in the proximity of the eyeless dog, which is usually any corner of the [[ship]], will get killed.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an eyeless dog is not aggroed, and comes into the ship, the eyeless dog will not detect the player hitbox even if it is touching you. This only applies if a player crouching (Preferably at a corner of the [[ship]]) and staying silent.
</div>

使用[[Shovel/zh-cn|铲子]]击打无眼狗会使其立即朝自己面对的方向猛冲。可利用这一点使无眼狗冲向墙壁，随后再连续使用铲子击打造成类似眩晕的效果。最终需要 12 次铲子击打才能杀死一只无眼狗。

######## Fear
[[Category:Game_mechanics]]
{{stub|this page is copy and pasted uhh idk if im gonna make it more original xd}}
Fear/Adrenaline is a status existing in-game, but has no official name.

When employees are scared, their screen will become distorted and blurry for a few seconds, which affects most of the ui. (the Item Bar, HP Bar, the remaining battery of items, etc.). Scared employees will hear a strange, jarring, synth-like sound for few seconds after the affect is applied. This sound has no source and is only heard by the employees themselves.

== Causes ==

=== Critical Health ===
No matter how much damage is inflicted, when an employee's HP drops below 20, the employee automatically enters the critical health state and become feared. Both of these effects will remain until the employee's health regenerates back to 20.

=== Employee Death ===
When an employee directly views the body of another employee will cause fear. Using the teleporter to teleport an employee corpse back to the ship will automatically trigger the fear condition for anyone inside the ship or otherwise within vision of the body.

Seeing an employee drowning does not trigger the shocked condition, as they only see the process of the employee falling into water/quicksand without actually witnessing the moment of death. Seeing employees die to the Company Monster, transform into a Masked, or be eaten by Earth Leviathan also don't trigger the shock condition.

=== Entity Interactions ===
Some entities have special mechanics to trigger the shock condition. If the entity that caused condition dies, then the effect will dissipate. Most of these mechanics are when an employee is targeted by the entity, but there are some exceptions.

* When a Hoarding Bug flies near an employee
* When a Snare Flea drops and attempts to ensnare an employee
** If successful, employees remain shocked until they're freed and far enough away from the Snare Flea.
** If failed, employees will remain shocked until the Snare Flea stops pursuing them.
* When a Thumper or Eyeless Dog targets an employee
* When a Coil-Head freezes close enough to an employee
* When a Bracken is spotted during its hunt
** The intensity of the effect is reliant on how far the Bracken is from the spotter.
* When a Forest Keeper begins chasing an employee
** When a Forest Keeper is looking in the direction of an employee, they will hear ambience similar to that of the shocked condition. If spotted, the full shock effect will take place.
* When a Masked is interrupted from attacking an employee
* When a Jester pops
** Affects all nearby employees

Entities that have no unique shock interaction include:

* Bunker Spider
* Mask Hornets
* Hygrodere
* Ghost Girl
* Spore Lizard
* Nutcracker
* Earth Leviathan
* Baboon Hawk
* All daytime entities (Manticoils, Roaming Locusts, and Circuit Bees)

== Effects ==

=== Negative Effect ===
Being feared can, in a way, shock the ''player''. The eerie ambience and visual distortion can startle and disgruntle a player who doesn't understand the effect. They may avoid entity encounters to prevent becoming shocked, thinking that the effect has a greater impact on gameplay than it does.

=== Positive Effect ===
From a positive perspective, the fear condition can make employees aware of nearby monsters. For example, employees can become aware of a Forest Keeper's presence due to the ambience that plays when the Keeper looks in the employee's direction. This can come in handy if the employee is on a moon with poor line-line-of-sight (such as Rend or someplace in Foggy conditions) or if the employee is in the ship.

== Notes ==

* Some people think the attacks of certain entities causes employees to become shocked, but this is a misconception. Some entities themselves don't cause the shock condition, but rather put them into critical health as mentioned above. Bunker Spiders and Coil-Heads are examples of this.

<!--T:1-->
The '''Feiopar''', internally known as the "Puma", is a hostile outdoor [[Entities|entity]]. Often seen hunting in packs, it slowly stalks and approaches its prey from behind, before tearing them to pieces with its claws once it gets close. Upon being spotted, it hides behind trees, and can either retreat or approach from great distances by climbing and leaping between treetops. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Vow]].

<!--T:2-->
Feiopars are large, slender big cats with glowing yellow eyes and a gaping mouth with sharp teeth, similar in appearance to [[w:Black panther|black panthers]]. They have deep black fur speckled with rosettes, and have a long, prehensile tail. They emit a low growling sound while stalking prey.
</translate>

{{quote bestiary}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
Feiopars roam the outdoors in search of prey, climbing between trees. Once they spot prey, they emit a growl and begin to stalk the prey on the ground. If they are spotted, they will freeze or take cover behind a nearby tree until the prey looks away. However, if the Feiopar gets within 3.5 meters of its prey, it will instead attack when spotted.{{ref code|PumaAI.Update}} Looking at a stalking Feiopar while it is not within attack range makes it more scared; past a certain point, it will give up pursuit.

<!--T:9-->
The Feiopar has 3 states.

=== Tree Hiding === <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
This is the default/idle state of the Feiopar. While in this state, it will run to a nearby tree, climbing it at a speed of 14 units per second after a 0.24 second delay. If no employee has been spotted recently, it will attempt to leap to a nearby tree after 0.75&ndash;4 seconds. If there are no nearby trees to leap to, it will drop to the ground after 6 seconds and attempt to find another tree to climb.
If an employee has been spotted, it will stay in the tree. It will then drop if either of the below checks pass:

<!--T:12-->
'''Check 1'''
* An employee is within 4.5 units of the Feiopar's tree
* The employee is looking almost directly at the Feiopar (view angle &lt; 36&deg;)

<!--T:13-->
'''Check 2'''
* The Feiopar has been on its target tree for 6 seconds or more
* The targeted played is within 60 units of the Feiopar
* The employee is not looking at the tree (view angle &gt; 70&deg;)

=== Stalking === <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In this state, the Feiopar has dropped to the ground with a definite target in mind. It will try to approach the employee at a speed determined by its distance from the employee:
* &lt; 4.5 units away: 9 units per second
* 4.5&ndash;7 units away: 5 units per second
* 7&ndash;10 units away: 6 units per second
* &gt; 10 units away: 8 units per second

<!--T:16-->
If at any point an employee looks at the Feiopar (view angle &lt; 67&deg;) for 5 consecutive frames, it will freeze. If after 1.5 seconds of being frozen the employee is less than 15.5 units away from the Feiopar, as well as not directly looking at it (view angle &geq; 25&deg;), it will unfreeze and charge towards the employee at speeds from 3.5&ndash;7 units per second, inevitably triggering the attack phase.

=== Attacking === <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
The Feiopar will switch to this state if either of the following checks pass:

<!--T:19-->
'''Check 1'''
* The employee has direct eye contact with the Feiopar (view angle &lt; 25&deg;)
* The employee is less than 3.5 units away from the Feiopar

<!--T:20-->
'''Check 2'''
* The employee is less than 2.5 units away from the Feiopar

<!--T:21-->
'''Check 3'''
* The Feiopar is frozen
* The employee is less than 15.5 units away from the Feiopar
* The employee is not looking directly at the Feiopar (view angle &geq; 25&deg;)
* The Feiopar has been frozen for more than 1.5 seconds

<!--T:22-->
While attacking, it will "scratch" the employee every 0.2 seconds on average if it is within 6 units of the Feiopar, dealing 7 hitpoints of damage with each scratch.

</translate>

== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:4-->
Hitting a Feiopar with a [[shovel]] or other weapon can frighten it away, even without doing enough damage to kill it.

<!--T:5-->
Despite the bestiary entry making mention of the Feiopar being <q>agitated by the color orange and high-visibility markings,</q>
changing into a different [[Suits|suit]] has no effect on its behaviour at all.
</translate>

The '''Feiopar''', internally known as the "Puma", is a hostile outdoor [[Entities|entity]]. Often seen hunting in packs, it slowly stalks and approaches its prey from behind, before tearing them to pieces with its claws once it gets close. Upon being spotted, it hides behind trees, and can either retreat or approach from great distances by climbing and leaping between treetops. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Vow]].

Feiopars are large, slender big cats with glowing yellow eyes and a gaping mouth with sharp teeth, similar in appearance to [[w:Black panther|black panthers]]. They have deep black fur speckled with rosettes, and have a long, prehensile tail. They emit a low growling sound while stalking prey.
