== 生成概率 ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 机制 ==
巨型啄木鸟共有六个阶段：休憩、漫游、觅食、警戒、暴怒以及狂乱。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
它会一整天在**休憩→漫游→觅食**之间循环切换，除非受到惊扰。
</div>

在休憩阶段，它会回到巢穴、蹲下并睡眠约15秒。噪音会将其惊醒，请注意：它无法听到你通过麦克风发出的说话声。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
醒来后它会进入**漫游阶段**，开始在巢穴周围游荡；短暂漫游后便会进入**觅食阶段**，在此阶段它只会啄食树木。
它通常会在一棵树上啄食数秒，停顿片刻后再次啄击，之后回到休憩阶段。
如果附近没有树木，它就会延长漫游时间。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
巨型啄木鸟在漫游阶段还有一定概率会随机“跳舞”。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
如果任何生物靠近其巢穴一定范围内，巨型啄木鸟会进入警戒阶段。当它发现有东西进入该区域时，会朝对方大声尖叫，并迅速挡在对方与巢穴之间。
如果对方继续靠近，啄木鸟会进入暴怒阶段，开始用猛烈啄击进行攻击：每次啄击对玩家造成*0点伤害，对其他实体造成4点伤害。它攻击的时间越长，攻速就越快。
如果你能成功逃到足够远的地方，它最终会停止攻击，不过想要逃脱相当困难。

狒狒鹰会试图偷取啄木鸟的蛋，但结局通常对狒狒鹰十分不利；无眼狗也可能在啄木鸟巢穴附近游荡并被杀死。

巨型啄木鸟似乎会无视，或至少不会攻击以下生物：
四翼鸟、郁金香蛇以及森林守护者。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
如果啄木鸟受到伤害，它会进入狂乱阶段，并不分对象地持续攻击伤害来源，即便该目标无法被杀死，或是已经被它杀死，例如旧鸟、实体尸体、爆炸后的复活节彩蛋等。如果它因传导雷击受伤，还会攻击导电的物品。
在狂乱阶段，你可以偷走它的一枚蛋，但当蛋孵化并开始鸣叫时，啄木鸟会将目标转向你。
</div>  

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
与蜂巢类似，鸟蛋的价值由其与飞船的距离决定，分为“近”（距离飞船100米以内，价值40–69）和“远”（距离飞船100米以外，价值70–119）两类。
“远”距离的蛋还有30%概率价值超过119，最高可达199。
这些蛋重19磅，属于需双手持有的物品。
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
当蛋被拿走后，很快就会孵化并开始鸣叫。幼鸟会先盯着玩家一秒，随后再次鸣叫。
当第二次鸣叫响起时，啄木鸟就会得知玩家的位置，并开始追击持有蛋的玩家，迅速将其杀死——除非玩家在被它看见前扔掉蛋，或是离开这颗卫星。

如果你带着蛋进入设施，幼鸟会不停地尖叫，巨型啄木鸟会在你进入的门口守着你。
如果你试图关上飞船门躲在里面，它会用喙把门撬开。

当啄木鸟到达蛋的位置时，会用喙将其叼起并送回巢穴。
在此之后，只要吸髓者看见任何玩家，都会立刻发动攻击。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 应对策略 ==
盗取啄木鸟的蛋风险极高，通常得不偿失，尤其是在偷蛋后，啄木鸟会逼得你不得不离开这颗卫星。如果你仍想尝试，有多种不同的方法可以获取鸟蛋。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
最简单的策略是牺牲一名队友。
在一天快结束、搜刮完设施后，四名队员一同靠近巢穴，等巨型啄木鸟入睡。
三人冲刺跳进去，随即蹲下，捡起一枚蛋后蹲着挪到足够远的地方再起身行走，走到更远后再开始奔跑。
留下一人负责牵制啄木鸟，撑到其余三人成功逃脱即可。
等三人回到飞船后，必须立刻撤离。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
如果你打算**单人行动**，或是不想让任何人阵亡，可以使用**TZP吸入剂**。它能让你以足够快的速度赶回飞船，从而不必牺牲任何队友。
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
公司巡洋舰是目前对抗巨型啄木鸟最有效的工具之一。
将巡洋舰停在巢穴附近，安排一名玩家负责驾车接应，其他玩家趁巨型啄木鸟熟睡时潜入，取走鸟蛋后迅速登上巡洋舰后座并驶离。即便巨型吸髓者开始追击，也很难逼停巡洋舰。

此外，当巡洋舰被飞船的磁吸装置吸附时，巨型吸髓者无法伤害车内的任何人。
但请注意：巨型啄木鸟仍有可能将驾驶员从座位上甩出去。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
虽然视情况而定，但巡洋舰可以用来撞倒并杀死巨型啄木鸟。在V70版本中，高速行驶的巡洋舰最多可造成12点伤害，这意味着需要两次高速撞击，再加上一次额外高速撞击或至少两次低速撞击才能将其击杀。

最稳妥的方法是全速前进，高速撞倒啄木鸟一次，然后将巡洋舰开到与地面垂直、紧贴墙壁的位置，这样啄木鸟就无法碰到你。之后不断让巡洋舰在吸髓者上方弹跳，直到它死亡。尽管这种方法比较可靠，但耗时相当长，而且只有当啄木鸟生成在Vow的消防出口山谷时，才算是真正可行的策略。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在Adamance，如果啄木鸟刷新在消防出口桥梁附近，趁它睡觉时偷走一枚蛋，然后跳过桥梁跑回飞船会非常容易，因为啄木鸟需要跑遍整张地图才能追上你。
请注意，这种情况下啄木鸟只会比你晚几秒抵达飞船。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在啄木鸟生成的每颗卫星上，都有几个它无法触及你的点位。你可以站在这些点位里，用铲子不断攻击直至击杀啄木鸟，这些点位包括：
Adamance主入口的岩石后方、坚毅星消防出口桥梁上稳固平坦的区域、坚毅星消防出口山谷中紧贴山坡的一块岩石；
Assurance西格德原木附近紧贴山坡的一块岩石、保障星消防出口附近一块形状奇特的岩石、保障星通往消防出口的梯子旁脚手架的部分区域；
Vow主建筑结构上突出的装饰顶部、誓言星桥梁坍塌后的部分残骸、誓言星水坝的突出部位（不过啄木鸟很容易把你从这里推下去）。

通常你需要把其中一枚蛋带到这些点位，放在啄木鸟够不到的地方来吸引它仇恨；但如果它刚好游荡到这些点位附近，你也可以用铲子打一下再跑回安全区域。
你也可以站在公司巡洋舰的座位和飞船磁吸装置上使用这个方法。
</div>

{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item

{{Stub}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The Gift is a [[Scrap]] item that can be opened to reveal a different, random scrap item inside. The dropped scrap item can be anything that's normally able to spawn on whichever moon the Gift was originally found. The item may be two-handed, despite the Gift being a one-handed scrap item.

<!--T:4-->
The dropped item is usually worth more than standard scrap, with a min value increased by {{credits|10}} and a max value increased by {{credits|14}}. The item that spawns from the present is chosen from the scrap pool of the moon it was found on.

<!--T:5-->
The Gift will be worth {{credits|50}} on [[single scrap day]]. Note that the Gift may be worth more than what is inside.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Due to Gift boxes having a chance to give you a two-handed item, it can be a good idea to not open the Gift until it's been taken to the ship. Conversely, it could also be a good idea to open the Gift as soon as you find it, due to the possibility of receiving a small item that weighs less than {{pounds|19}}.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
The Gift box has the smallest inventory icon out of any others in the game, at 177x177 pixels in size. Most other icons for equipment are 256x256 pixels in size.
</translate>

######## Gift/en
{{topicon Fandom|Gift_Box}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=When opened
|primary-use=<q>Open gift</q>
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}

{{Stub}}
The Gift is a [[Scrap]] item that can be opened to reveal a different, random scrap item inside. The dropped scrap item can be anything that's normally able to spawn on whichever moon the Gift was originally found. The item may be two-handed, despite the Gift being a one-handed scrap item.

The dropped item is usually worth more than standard scrap, with a min value increased by {{credits|10}} and a max value increased by {{credits|14}}. The item that spawns from the present is chosen from the scrap pool of the moon it was found on.

The Gift will be worth {{credits|50}} on [[single scrap day]]. Note that the Gift may be worth more than what is inside.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
Due to Gift boxes having a chance to give you a two-handed item, it can be a good idea to not open the Gift until it's been taken to the ship. Conversely, it could also be a good idea to open the Gift as soon as you find it, due to the possibility of receiving a small item that weighs less than {{pounds|19}}.
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
The Gift box has the smallest inventory icon out of any others in the game, at 177x177 pixels in size. Most other icons for equipment are 256x256 pixels in size.

######## Gordion
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox moon
| name = Gordion
| image = Gordion.png
| dangerrate = Safe
| routecost = 0
}}
{{Template:Spoilers}}<translate>
<!--T:1-->
Gordion is the [[Moons|Moon]] where [[The Company|The Company's]] Headquarters resides. Unlike any other moon, there is no night and day cycle (although, if you sell any items, a trip to and back does take a day), giving you ample time to sell your [[scrap]] items, or buy from the [[Store]] and retrieve your orders. 

<!--T:2-->
Equally unique is its lack of [[Entities|creatures]], aside from the enigmatic entity that handles [[The Company|The Company's]] paycheck in exchange for credits.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Company description}} == 
{{quote INFO moon|CompanyBuildingInfo}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
== Environment ==
The company building has a relatively small map, basically only consisting of a main platform, some containers and a wall. There is also a second layer, containing the drill, underneath the main platform.

<!--T:4-->
==== The Drill ====
Located underneath the moon there is a drill with slots for two [[apparatus]]. The drill is accessible by opening the hatch near the delivery landing sites. Next to the drill there is a slot for a data chip, a broken wire, a slot labelled "BATTERY" and a track leading towards the wall of [[The Company|The Company's]] desk, marked with a spray painted yellow circular marker. As of [[v81]], the drill has no functionality coded in, and the [[apparatus]] cannot be slotted into its slot, although a small hatch on the back of the drill labeled in-game as "trunk" is now able to be opened, with a rectangular slot inside of it. 

<!--T:5-->
=== The Company Monster ===
{{main|The Company#The Company Monster}}
'''The Company Monster''', also known by a large number of other names (The most common pick being '''Jeb'''), is the only entity present on Gordion. It is the company representative and handles the items sold by the employees.

<!--T:13-->
== Data chips ==
A chip containing the log "[[Sigurd_Logs#11._Hiding_-_Sep_30|Hiding]]" can be found at the end of the catwalk below the landing platform.

== Trivia == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
The Walkie-talkie has [[Walkie-talkie#Trivia|an easter egg]], which activates only on this moon.

<!--T:16-->
In a patreon post by Zeekerss,<tvar name="citation">{{cite Patreon|date=2023-09-26|slug=beta-test-bug-89844466|title=The beta test + bug fixing!}}</tvar> concept art of the drill is titled "[[Lore#Desmond|Desmond]]'s drill".

Gordion is possibly named after {{native Wikipedia link|en=Gordion|label=the capital city}} of the former kingdom of Phrygia
(9th&ndash;4th centuries BCE, located in what is now Türkiye). If this is the case, it could be invoking one of a few different pieces of history and legend:
* Most simply, Phrygia had grown into an expansive empire around the turn of the 7th century BCE. It would be fitting for a Company that<!--
--> sees itself as "the next Rome" (or "the next East India Company") to have its hub/market world share a name with the seat of an ancient empire.
* {{native Wikipedia link|en=Gordian Knot|label=According to legend}}, the city was founded by a "King Gordias", a peasant who was<!--
--> gifted the crown for prophecy reasons after arriving at a temple with a wagon. The wagon was later tied up in the temple for display,<!--
--> and another prophecy said the knot was so good that if someone were able to untie it, they would be the one to conquer Asia.<!--
--> This story of a "Gordian" knot was probably Macedonian propaganda, but the term 'Gordian knot' persists as a metaphor for complex problems with<!--
--> simple solutions (akin to '{{native Wikipedia link|en=Columbus' egg}}')&mdash;or to stretch the metaphor, a seal which appears secure but is not.
* The legendary {{native Wikipedia link|en=King Midas}} was said to rule Phrygia (and by some accounts was Gordias' adopted son).<!--
--> His story sees him granted the supernatural power to transmute any object into valuable gold, which immediately backfires.<!--
--> This link is more tenuous, but the theme of greed and the existence of a "[[Sigurd_Logs#8._Golden_planet_-_Sep_??|Golden Planet]]"<!--
--> (real or legendary) in the game's lore somewhat tie it to the legend of Midas.

</translate>

{{Template:Spoilers}}Gordion ist der [[Moons|Mond]] auf dem sich das Hauptquartier der [[The Company|Firma]] befindet. Anders als auf anderen Monden, gibt es hier keinen Tag-Nacht-Zyklus (dennoch kostet es einen Tag dort zu landen, wenn man Gegenstände verkauft). Man hat hier also so viel Zeit [[Scrap/de|Schrott]] zu verkaufen und [[Store/de#Store Items|Gegenstände]] im [[Store/de|Shop]] zu bestellen, wie man möchte. 

Genauso einzigartig ist das Fehlen jeglicher Flora und Fauna auf Gordion, abgesehen von der mysteriösen Kreatur hinter dem Tresen der Firma.
== {{section heading/Company description}} == 
{{quote INFO moon|CompanyBuildingInfo}}
=== Umgebung === 
Das Firmengebäude ist eine kleine Karte. Sie besteht praktisch nur aus einer Hauptplattform, einigen Containern und einer Wand. Es gibt eine zweites Stockwerk unter der Hauptplattform, wo sich der Bohrer befindet.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== Der Bohrer ====
Unter dem Mond befindet sich ein Bohrer mit zwei Plätzen für [[apparatus|Apparate]]. Der Bohrer ist über die Luke nahe dem Ort, an dem die Abwurfkapsel mit gekauften Gegenständen landet, erreichbar. Neben dem Bohrer gibt es einen Eingang für einen Datenchip, ein kaputtes Kabel, einen Eingang auf dem „BATTERY“ steht und ein Weg zur Wand der [[The Company|Firma]], der mit einem runden gelben Graffito markiert ist. Bisher hat der Bohrer keine Funktionalität im Programmcode des Spiels und es kann kein [[Apparatus]] in die vorgesehenen Plätze angebracht werden.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Das Firmenmonster  ===
'''Das Firmenmonster''' ist unter vielen verschiedenen Namen bekannt und der einzige Bewohner von Gordion. Es ist Repräsentant der Firma und übernimmt das Entgegennehmen des Schrotts, den die Mitarbeiter sammeln.
</div>

'''The Company Monster''', also known by a large number of other names (The most common pick being '''Jeb'''), is the only entity present on Gordion. It is the company representative and handles the items sold by the employees.

== Data chips ==
A chip containing the log "[[Sigurd_Logs#11._Hiding_-_Sep_30|Hiding]]" can be found at the end of the catwalk below the landing platform.

== Trivia ==

The Walkie-talkie has [[Walkie-talkie#Trivia|an easter egg]], which activates only on this moon.

In a patreon post by Zeekerss,{{cite Patreon|date=2023-09-26|slug=beta-test-bug-89844466|title=The beta test + bug fixing!}} concept art of the drill is titled "[[Lore#Desmond|Desmond]]'s drill".

######## Gordion/es
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox moon
| name = Gordion
| image = Gordion.png
| dangerrate = Safe
| routecost = 0
}}
{{Template:Spoilers}}Gordion es la [[moons/es|luna]] en la que reside la Sede de [[The Company/es|La Compañia]]. A diferencia del resto de lunas, no hay ningún ciclo de día y noche (aunque a la hora de vender objetos, aterrizar y despegar en Gordion tomará un día.), dándote todo el tiempo del mundo para vender [[scrap/es|chatarra]] o comprar algo de la [[Store/es|Tienda]] y esperar a que llegue el pedido. 

Otra cosa que la diferencia del resto de lunas es la falta de [[Wildlife/es|criaturas]], a excepción de la misteriosa entidad que se esconde tras el mostrador del edificio de [[The Company/es|La Compañia]].
== {{section heading/Company description}} == 
{{quote INFO moon|CompanyBuildingInfo}}
=== Ecosistema ===
El mapa del edificio de la compañía es relativamente pequeño, consistiendo básicamente de una plataforma principal, algunos contenedores de carga y una pared. Hay, además, una zona a parte por debajo de la plataforma principal en la que se encuentra el taladro.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== El Taladro ====
En la parte inferior de la luna hay un taladro con conectores para dos [[apparatus/es|aparatos]]. Es posible acceder al taladro abriendo la escotilla que hay cerca de la zona de recogida de pedidos. Junto al taladro hay un conector para un chip de datos, un cable roto, una ranura con la palabra "BATERIA" y un camino que lleva hasta la pared de [[The Company/es|La Compañía]]. En cuanto a la [[Version 47/es|Versión 47]], el taladro sigue sin tener función alguna en el código, y los [[apparatus/es|aparatos]] no se pueden conectar a este.
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== El Monstruo de la Compañía ===
'''El Monstruo de la Compañía''', conocido también de muchas otras formas, es la única entidad que reside en Gordion. Es representante de la compañía y es el encargado de comprar los objetos que le traigan los empleados.
</div>

######## Gordion/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox moon
| name = Gordion
| image = Gordion.png
| dangerrate = Safe
| routecost = 0
}}
{{Template:Spoilers}}Gordion é uma [[Moons|Lua]] onde a sede da [[The Company|Companhia]] reside. Diferente de outras luas, não existe um ciclo de dia e noite (embora, se você vender algum item, quando você sair da lua um dia vai passar), dando um amplo tempo para vender [[scrap|sucata]], ou comprar algo da [[Store|Loja]] e outros. 

Igualmente único é a falta de [[Wildlife/pt-br|criaturas]], com excessão da entidade enigmatica que cuida dos pagamentos da [[The Company/pt-br|Companhia]] em créditos.
== {{section heading/Company description}} == 
{{quote INFO moon|CompanyBuildingInfo}}
=== Ambientação ===
O edifício da companhia tem um mapa relativamente pequeno, basicamente consistindo apenas da plataforma principal, alguns containers e um muro. No segundo andar, que tem a furadeira, abaixo da plataforma principal.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== The Drill ====
Located underneath the moon there is a drill with slots for two [[apparatus]]. The drill is accessible by opening the hatch near the delivery landing sites. Next to the drill there is a slot for a data chip, a broken wire, a slot labelled "BATTERY" and a track leading towards the wall of [[The Company|The Company's]] desk, marked with a spray painted yellow circular marker. As of [[v81]], the drill has no functionality coded in, and the [[apparatus]] cannot be slotted into its slot, although a small hatch on the back of the drill labeled in-game as "trunk" is now able to be opened, with a rectangular slot inside of it.
</div>

######## Gordion/ru
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox moon
| name = Gordion
| image = Gordion.png
| dangerrate = Safe
| routecost = 0
}}
{{Template:Spoilers}}Gordion - [[Moons/ru|луна]], на которой располагается штаб-квартира [[The Company|Компании]]. В отличие от других лун, не имеет цикла дня и ночи (хотя приземление и отлёт технически занимает 1 день), давая достаточно времени для продажи [[scrap|лута]] или покупки из [[Store/ru|магазина]] и получения заказов. 

Также уникально отсутствие [[Entities/ru|сущностей]], за исключением одного загадочного существа, которое управляет выдаваемой [[The Company|компанией]] зарплатой в кредитах.
== {{section heading/Company description}} == 
{{quote INFO moon|CompanyBuildingInfo}}
=== Окружение ===
Здание компании - довольно маленькая карта, по сути состоящей только из главной платформы, пары контейнеров и стены. Есть также второй слой с дрелью, находящийся под главным.

==== Дрель ====
Под главной платформой расположена дрель со слотами для двух [[apparatus|аппаратов]]. К дрели можно добраться через люк рядом с зоной посадки модуля снабжения. Рядом с дрелью есть слот для чипа данных, переломанный провод, слот с подписью "БАТАРЕЯ" и рельсы, ведущие к стене [[The Company|Компании]], отмеченной нанесённой жёлтой спрей-краской круглой меткой. на момент [[Version 69|Версии 69]] у дрели нет функционала, а в слот нельзя вставить [[apparatus|аппарат]]. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Монстр компании ===
'''Монстр компании''', известный также под кучей других имён (например Джеб) - единственная сущность, присутствующая на Gordion. Он - представитель компании и заведует предметами, продаваемыми сотрудниками.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Чипы данных ===
Чип, содержащий запись "[[Sigurd_Logs/ru#Звуки из-за стены - 4 Сен|Звуки из-за стены]]" можно найти на краю мостиков под посадочной платформой.
</div>

<span id="Trivia"></span>
=== Интересные факты ===

У рации есть [[Walkie-talkie#Trivia|пасхалка]], которая активируется только на этой луне.

В посте Zeekerss на патреоне,{{cite Patreon|date=2023-09-26|slug=beta-test-bug-89844466|title=The beta test + bug fixing!}} концепт-арт дрели назван "Дрель [[Lore#Desmond|Дезмонда]]".

{{Template:Spoilers}}'''Gordion''' 是[[The Company|公司]]总部所在的[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]。与其它星球不同的是，Gordion 上没有日夜循环（不过若在降落后售卖任何物品，起飞后会消耗一天时间），所以你有充足的时间卖掉[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]，或者从[[Store/zh-cn|商店]]购买并取得物品。 

同样独特的是，除了一个负责处理[[The Company|公司]]薪水以换取信用点数的神秘实体之外，Gordion 上没有其它[[Wildlife|生物]]。

公司大楼的地图相对较小，基本上只包含一个主平台，一些集装箱和一堵墙。此外主平台下方还有一层，其中包含一台钻机。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== 钻机 ====
在 Gordion 地下有一台钻机，其上有两个[[Apparatus|发电装置]]的插槽，可通过打开空投点附近的活板门抵达。钻机旁有一个数据芯片的插槽，一截断掉的电线，写有“BATTERY”（电池）的插槽，还有一条导向[[The Company|公司]]前台所在墙面的轨道，其末端有一个用黄色喷漆喷涂的圆形记号。截至[[Version 47|版本 47]]，钻机还没有实际功能，[[Apparatus|发电装置]]也无法插入其插槽中。

######## HUD
{{topicon Fandom|Item_Bar}}
{{topicon Fandom|Scanner|1}}
[[Category:Gameplay mechanics]]
{{interlangbox}}
<translate>
== Employee vitals == <!--T:1-->

</translate>[[File:Player_stats_ui.png|thumb|right]]<translate>

=== Stamina meter === <!--T:2-->

<!--T:3-->
The orange arc in the top-left is the stamina meter.
It shows roughly how much of the player's stamina is left: shrinking during sprinting and jumping, and reverting slowly over time.
<br>Both the upper and lower ends are deceptive, in that a full meter doesn't appear to move with a single jump or burst of sprinting,
and it can drain past the point where the arc disappears.{{cite bug|Stamina meter extents don't match texture}}

=== Damage indicator === <!--T:4-->

</translate>[[File:CracksForming.gif|<translate><!--T:5--> Visor cracks growing with injury.<tvar name="citation">{{cite Patreon|date=2026-02-04|slug=numerous-changes-149902986|title=Numerous Changes}}</tvar></translate>|thumb]]<translate>

<!--T:6-->
Employee health, or rather the amount of damage they've taken, is visualized as the opacity of the figure inside the arc.
An empty outline indicates full health, while a figure that's almost solid red indicates [[Damage#Employees|critical injury]].

<!--T:7-->
As of [[Version 80]], the cracks on an employee's visor grow in severity depending on how injured they are.

=== Weight readout === <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
The readout beside the arc is the total weight of carried items. This value is accurate to within {{pounds|1}}.<ref group="note">The rounding algorithm is in [[Module:Scraps]] as <code>scrapWeight</code>, see comments there.</ref>

=== Battery indicator === <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Above the damage indicator there is a battery icon and charge meter, which indicates the battery power of a chargeable item when held. The charge meter is accurate, though the percentage labels are for the ends of the meter and obviously not the points directly under them. When the battery level is between 0% and ~25%, the battery icon will blink slowly.

<!--T:12-->
There is no indication of whether the item is currently consuming power beyond seeing the meter drain.

=== Utility slot === <!--T:49-->
</translate>
[[File:Utility Slot.png|<translate><!--T:50--> The health indicator, alongside the Utility Slot and battery indicator.</translate>|thumb]]
<translate>
<!--T:53-->
{{redirect|Belt|the purchasable item|Belt bag}}

<!--T:51-->
Above the battery charge meter is the Utility Slot, which can hold one piece of [[equipment]]. It is not accessible by scrolling through the inventory as normal, instead being accessed by pressing {{keybind|Utility slot}}. The Utility Slot was added in [[Version 80]].

<!--T:54-->
If you don't already have an item in your Utility Slot, looking at an equipment item will show <q>Equip to belt</q> instead of <q>Grab</q>, and picking it up will send it to the Utility Slot.
<br>Pressing {{keybind|Utility slot}} will '''not''' send a held item to the Utility Slot; you must drop it and pick it back up.

<!--T:52-->
The Utility Slot cannot hold any [[Scrap]] item (sell value &ge; {{credits|1}}), [[Shovel]]s, [[Ammo]], [[clipboard]]s, the [[Sticky note]], or a [[Maneater]].

=== Critical injury warning === <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
When taking damage which puts the player in the critical range, the message <q>CRITICAL INJURY</q> flashes in the center of the screen.

== Clock == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
A readout showing the time of day appears at the top of the screen when leaving the ship or the moon's interior, and disappears when re-entering the ship or interior.
This applies to every moon except [[Gordion]], where the clock is never shown.

=== Ship departure warning === <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
At 10:12 PM in-game, the message <q>WARNING!!! The autopilot ship will leave at midnight. Please return quickly.</q> is displayed above the hotbar.

<!--T:19-->
A similar message appears if [[spectator]]s all vote to leave early.

=== Emergency weather alert === <!--T:20-->
</translate>
{{spoilers}}
<translate>
<!--T:21-->
As soon as a Meteor Shower starts, all player's screens will show text saying, "EMERGENCY WEATHER ALERT. Meteor Showers detected. Up to 20-30 per hour. Take shelter immediately. YOUR AUTOPILOT SATELLITE ISSUED A WEATHER WARNING." Then a meteor shower will start. There will also be a beeping sound effect for the duration of the message.

<!--T:22-->
See [[Meteor shower]].

== Key hints == <!--T:23-->

<!--T:24-->
Some actions available with the held item and their corresponding keys are listed in the top-right.
Unfortunately, they don't reflect the actual keybinds set by the player.{{cite bug|Key hints in HUD don't reflect keybinds}} Accessing the [[Terminal]] or sitting at the wheel of the [[Cruiser]] also updates the hints. When loading a save or joining a lobby, the hints will show basic movement controls, until the player updates it by interacting with something.

<!--T:25-->
Most keys which need to be held aren't indicated as such.{{cite bug|(a11y) Sprint is hold and crouch is toggle, and you can't change either}}

<!--T:26-->
The option to inspect is missing for a couple of items which support it.

== Chat == <!--T:27-->

<!--T:28-->
The chat allows those with or without a mic to communicate with those nearby. It still has a limited range though, so keep that in mind when using it.

<!--T:29-->
== Hotbar ==
{{see also|Hands full}}

<!--T:30-->
The hotbar aka inventory is a feature in lethal company that allows you to hold and switch items by scrolling.

<!--T:31-->
The hot bar looks like four blue squares on the bottom of your screen, representing available slots that can be taken by items and scrap.

== Echo Scanner == <!--T:32-->

<!--T:33-->
The Echo Scanner highlights items with colors and can be used as a weak light. The color code is as follows:

<!--T:34-->
Green: An object that can be sold to the company.

<!--T:35-->
Red: Enemies, turrets, and landmines.

<!--T:36-->
Blue: Main entrance, ship, and furniture in the ship.

== Advertisements == <!--T:37-->

<!--T:38-->
An advertisement will occasionally appear on the HUD during the course of the day, showing an item that is available from the [[Store]]. The advertisement will obstruct part of the player's view for 15 seconds while playing a musical jingle before disappearing.

<!--T:39-->
The following rules govern if an ad will be played and the item advertised:

<!--T:40-->
* A maximum of one ad will show per quota.
* No ad will appear in the first quota.
* The first two days of a quota each have a 33% chance of an ad appearing. If no ad has been shown in the first two days, there is a 60% chance of an ad appearing on the third day.
* The advertisement will not feature the [[Walkie-talkie]], [[Flashlight]], [[Pro-Flashlight]], or [[Weed killer]].
* The game will first check the list of available items from the store and find the item with the highest-percentage discount. If that discount is at least 30%, then that item will be advertised. Otherwise, the ad will feature a random ship decoration item that the crew does not own.

<!--T:41-->
All members of the crew will see the same advertisement at the same time.

== Performance Report == <!--T:42-->

</translate>[[File:Performance_report.png|thumb|right]]<translate>

<!--T:43-->
The Performance Report hud determines how well you did at your job.

<!--T:44-->
If a player is the most paranoid, that means that they moved their camera the most out of all the players. 

<!--T:45-->
If a player is the laziest, that means they stayed in the ship the most.

<!--T:46-->
If a player is the most profitable, that means they brought the most worthful scraps to the ship.

<!--T:47-->
If a player sustained the most injuries, that means they took the most damage.
</translate><br clear="all" /><translate>

The hot bar looks like four blue squares on the bottom of your screen, representing available slots that can be taken by items and scrap.

== Echo Scanner ==

The Echo Scanner highlights items with colors and can be used as a weak light. The color code is as follows:

Green: An object that can be sold to the company.

Red: Enemies, turrets, and landmines.

Blue: Main entrance, ship, and furniture in the ship.

== Advertisements ==

An advertisement will occasionally appear on the HUD during the course of the day, showing an item that is available from the [[Store]]. The advertisement will obstruct part of the player's view for 15 seconds while playing a musical jingle before disappearing.

The following rules govern if an ad will be played and the item advertised:

* A maximum of one ad will show per quota.
* No ad will appear in the first quota.
* The first two days of a quota each have a 33% chance of an ad appearing. If no ad has been shown in the first two days, there is a 60% chance of an ad appearing on the third day.
* The advertisement will not feature the [[Walkie-talkie]], [[Flashlight]], [[Pro-Flashlight]], or [[Weed killer]].
* The game will first check the list of available items from the store and find the item with the highest-percentage discount. If that discount is at least 30%, then that item will be advertised. Otherwise, the ad will feature a random ship decoration item that the crew does not own.

All members of the crew will see the same advertisement at the same time.

== Performance Report ==
[[File:Performance_report.png|thumb|right]]
The Performance Report hud determines how well you did at your job.

If a player is the most paranoid, that means that they moved their camera the most out of all the players. 

If a player is the laziest, that means they stayed in the ship the most.

If a player is the most profitable, that means they brought the most worthful scraps to the ship.

If a player sustained the most injuries, that means they took the most damage.<br clear="all" />

######## HUD/zh-cn

[[Category:Gameplay mechanics]]
{{interlangbox}}
<span id="Employee_vitals"></span>
== 员工生命体征 ==
[[File:Player_stats_ui.png|thumb|right]]
<span id="Stamina_meter"></span>
=== 体力值计量条 ===

界面左上方的橙色弧形条是体力条，大致显示玩家剩余的体力。体力在冲刺和跳跃时会减少，并随时间缓慢恢复。
<br>体力条的上限和下限都具有误导性：体力全满时，单次跳跃或短暂冲刺不会让体力条产生明显变化；而消耗至体力条为空时，体力仍能继续消耗一小段时间。{{cite bug|Stamina meter extents don't match texture}}

<span id="Damage_indicator"></span>
=== 伤害指示器 ===
[[File:CracksForming.gif|面罩裂纹会随受伤程度加重而扩大{{cite Patreon|date=2026-02-04|slug=numerous-changes-149902986|title=Numerous Changes}}|thumb]]
员工生命值，或者说是员工承受的伤害值，由体力条内人形图标的透明度显示。
空心轮廓代表满生命值，而非常接近红色则代表[[Damage#Employees|重伤]]。

截至[[Version 80|版本 80]]，员工受伤程度越重，面罩上的裂纹就越深。

<span id="Weight_readout"></span>
=== 重量显示 ===

体力条旁边的读数显示了当前携带物品的总重量，精度在 {{pounds|1}} 以内。<ref group="note">要了解舍入算法详情，请见 [[Module:Scraps]] 中 <code>scrapWeight</code> 的实现及相关注释。</ref>

<span id="Battery_indicator"></span>
=== 电量指示器 ===

伤害指示器上方有电池图标和电量条，用于显示当前手持的可充电物品的剩余电量。电量条的显示是准确的，不过百分比标签标示的显然是电量条两端的值，而不是它们所处的刻度位置。若物品电量在 0% 到约 25% 的区间内，电池图标会缓慢闪烁。

除了观察电量条下降之外，没有其他提示能表明物品当前是否正在耗电。

<span id="Utility_slot"></span>
=== 工具槽 ===
[[File:Utility Slot.png|生命值指示器、工具槽和电量指示器|thumb]]
{{redirect|Belt|可购买物品|Belt bag}}

电量指示器上方是工具槽，可放入一个[[equipment|装备]]。工具槽不能通过滚动滚轮切换，而是使用快捷键 {{keybind|Utility slot}} 触发。此功能于[[Version 80|版本 80]]加入。

若工具槽中没有物品，看向可装备的物品时会显示<q>Equip to belt</q>（装备到工具槽），而不是<q>Grab</q>（拿取）。此时捡起物品，也会将其放入工具槽中。

按下快捷键 {{keybind|Utility slot}} '''不会'''将当前持有的物品移动到工具槽中，你必须将物品丢下再捡起才可触发此功能。

工具槽不能放入以下物品：任何价值 &ge; {{credits|1}} 的[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]、[[Shovel|铲子]]、[[Ammo|弹药]]、[[Clipboard|写字板]]、[[Sticky note|便利贴]]和[[Maneater|食人魔]]。

<span id="Critical_injury_warning"></span>
=== 重伤警告 ===

当玩家受到的伤害达到重伤标准时，屏幕中央将闪烁<q>CRITICAL INJURY</q>（重伤）的提示消息。

<span id="Clock"></span>
== 时钟 ==

离开飞船或星球内部结构时，屏幕顶部会显示当天时间。回到飞船内或星球内部结构后，时钟便会消失。
除 [[Gordion/zh-cn|Gordion]] 永远不会显示时间外，此规则适用于所有星球。

<span id="Ship_departure_warning"></span>
=== 飞船起飞警告 ===

游戏内时间到达 10:12 PM 时，快捷栏上方将显示警示消息：

WARNING!!! The autopilot ship will leave at midnight. Please return quickly.

（警告！！！自动驾驶飞船将在午夜离开，请迅速返回。）

当[[spectator|旁观玩家]]全部投票提前离开时，也会显示类似消息。

<span id="Emergency_weather_alert"></span>
=== 紧急天气警报 ===
{{spoilers}}
流星雨一开始，所有玩家的屏幕都会显示提示：

EMERGENCY WEATHER ALERT. Meteor Showers detected. Up to 20-30 per hour. Take shelter immediately. YOUR AUTOPILOT SATELLITE ISSUED A WEATHER WARNING.

（紧急天气警报。检测到流星雨活动，每小时最多20~30颗。立刻寻找掩体。你的自动驾驶卫星已发布天气警报。）

随后流星雨便会开始，消息显示期间还伴有蜂鸣音效。

详见[[Meteor shower|流星雨]]。

<span id="Key_hints"></span>
== 按键提示 ==

若当前手持物品有可用操作，其按键提示会显示在屏幕右上角。可惜的是该提示不会与自定义按键绑定同步{{cite bug|Key hints in HUD don't reflect keybinds}}。使用[[Terminal|终端]]或坐在[[Cruiser|巡航车]]的驾驶位上时也会更新按键提示。在加载存档或加入房间后，会先显示基础的移动操作提示，直到玩家与其他物体交互后，提示才会刷新。

大部分需要长按才会触发的操作则不会在右上角显示提示。{{cite bug|(a11y) Sprint is hold and crouch is toggle, and you can't change either}}

有几件物品本支持检视功能，但并没有显示相应的按键提示。

<span id="Chat"></span>
== 聊天 ==

无论有没有麦克风，聊天功能都允许玩家与附近的人进行交流。但它仍有距离限制，使用时请留意。

== 快捷栏 ==
{{see also|Hands full}}

快捷栏（也称物品栏）是《致命公司》中的一项功能，允许玩家手持物品，并通过滚动滚轮切换物品。

快捷栏在屏幕底部显示为四个蓝色方格，代表可放置物品和废料的可用槽位。

<span id="Echo_Scanner"></span>
== 回声扫描仪 ==

回声扫描仪会用不同颜色高亮显示物品，同时也可当作弱光灯使用。不同颜色意义如下：

绿色：可出售给公司的物品。

红色：敌对实体、炮塔和地雷。

蓝色：主入口、飞船和飞船内的家具。

<span id="Advertisements"></span>
== 广告 ==

游戏内时间为白天时，HUD 界面偶尔会弹出一则广告，展示[[Store/zh-cn|商店]]中可购买的某件物品。广告会播放一段音乐铃声，同时遮挡玩家部分视野，持续 15 秒后消失。

以下规则决定是否播放广告以及广告展示的物品：

* 每个配额轮次最多显示一次广告。
* 第一个配额轮次不会出现任何广告。
* 在配额轮次的前两天，广告显示概率为 33%；若前两天均未出现广告，则第三天广告显示概率为 60%。
* 广告不会展示[[Walkie-talkie|对讲机]]、[[Flashlight|手电筒]]、[[Pro-Flashlight|高级手电筒]]或[[Weed killer|除草剂]]。
* 游戏会先查看商店在售物品列表，找出折扣力度最高的物品。若该物品折扣至少为 30%，则会为其投放广告；否则，广告将随机展示一件尚未拥有的飞船装饰物品。

所有员工将在同一时间看到同一则广告。

<span id="Performance_Report"></span>
== 表现报告 ==
[[File:Performance_report.png|thumb|right]]
表现报告 HUD 会依据工作数据给出你的表现评定。

“最偏执的员工”说明该玩家转动视角的次数相较其他玩家最多。 

“最懒惰的员工”说明该玩家待在飞船里的时间最长。

“最会赚钱的员工”说明该玩家带回飞船的废料价值最高。

“受伤严重的员工”说明该玩家承受的伤害值最高。<br clear="all" />

######## Hive
{{topicon Fandom|Bee_Hive}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item

The '''Bee Hive''' is home to [[Circuit Bees]].

== Strategy == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:5-->
The best time to scout for beehives is early in the morning, to avoid encounters with dangerous outdoor entities. Employees should also be as lightweight as possible (ideally 0lbs). 

<!--T:12-->
Approach the hive at a large distance from your planned escape route. Attract the Circuit Bees and start circling away from your escape route - the Circuit Bees will follow. Once there is a clear enough path, dive back to the hive. Grab it and run toward the Ship. The Circuit Bees will be angered and will chase you at full speed. After exhausting about 3/4 of your stamina, drop the hive and keep running. The Circuit Bees will calm down and return to their hive. Rinse and repeat these steps until you are near enough to the ship. Drop the hive on the side or back railing of the ship and, depending on the situation, either run away from or into the ship.

<!--T:13-->
Once ready, activate the [[Ship#Main_monitor|Control Lever]] to leave the Moon. The Circuit Bees will be left behind as the Ship leaves the atmosphere. Keep note of where the hive is placed, as the bees will travel backwards from their placement as the ship leaves the moon, which can still injure and kill employees. Make sure to quickly grab your amassed hives, as you have about 10 seconds before the Ship door permanently closes and all the hives outside are lost.

<!--T:7-->
[[TZP-Inhalant]] is a good item to have on hand for hive carrying. The increased run speed will help the process, but the limited visibility can cause trouble if the employee is not careful enough.

<!--T:14-->
It is not recommended to take hives indoors or hide from a swarm using the ship door. This will cause the bees to roam and become incredibly dangerous to employees outdoors. Other employees should also give the hive collector a large amount of space to avoid drawing unintended aggression.

######## Hive/en
{{topicon Fandom|Bee_Hive}}

{{autoinfobox item

The '''Bee Hive''' is home to [[Circuit Bees]].

== Strategy ==

The best time to scout for beehives is early in the morning, to avoid encounters with dangerous outdoor entities. Employees should also be as lightweight as possible (ideally 0lbs). 

Approach the hive at a large distance from your planned escape route. Attract the Circuit Bees and start circling away from your escape route - the Circuit Bees will follow. Once there is a clear enough path, dive back to the hive. Grab it and run toward the Ship. The Circuit Bees will be angered and will chase you at full speed. After exhausting about 3/4 of your stamina, drop the hive and keep running. The Circuit Bees will calm down and return to their hive. Rinse and repeat these steps until you are near enough to the ship. Drop the hive on the side or back railing of the ship and, depending on the situation, either run away from or into the ship.

Once ready, activate the [[Ship#Main_monitor|Control Lever]] to leave the Moon. The Circuit Bees will be left behind as the Ship leaves the atmosphere. Keep note of where the hive is placed, as the bees will travel backwards from their placement as the ship leaves the moon, which can still injure and kill employees. Make sure to quickly grab your amassed hives, as you have about 10 seconds before the Ship door permanently closes and all the hives outside are lost.

[[TZP-Inhalant]] is a good item to have on hand for hive carrying. The increased run speed will help the process, but the limited visibility can cause trouble if the employee is not careful enough.

It is not recommended to take hives indoors or hide from a swarm using the ship door. This will cause the bees to roam and become incredibly dangerous to employees outdoors. Other employees should also give the hive collector a large amount of space to avoid drawing unintended aggression.

Los '''Bee Hive''' Son casa de los [[Circuit Bees]]

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estrategia ==

El mejor momento para buscar colmenas es a primera hora de la mañana, para evitar encuentros con entidades peligrosas del exterior. Además, los empleados deben ser lo más ligeros posible (idealmente, con un peso de 0 libras). 

Acércate a la colmena desde un punto alejado de tu ruta de escape prevista. Atrae a las abejas de circuito y empieza a moverte en círculos alejándote de dicha ruta; ellas te seguirán. En cuanto haya un camino lo suficientemente despejado, regresa rápidamente hacia la colmena. Cógela y corre hacia la nave. Las abejas de circuito se enfurecerán y te perseguirán a toda velocidad. Tras haber agotado aproximadamente tres cuartas partes de tu resistencia, suelta la colmena y sigue corriendo. Las abejas se calmarán y regresarán a su colmena. Repite este proceso hasta estar lo bastante cerca de la nave. Deja la colmena sobre la barandilla lateral o trasera de la nave y, según la situación, aléjate corriendo de ella o entra en la nave.

Una vez que estés listo, activa la [[Ship#Main_monitor|palanca de control]] para abandonar la luna. Las abejas de circuito se quedarán atrás a medida que la nave salga de la atmósfera. Ten en cuenta la ubicación de la colmena, ya que las abejas se desplazarán en sentido inverso desde su posición original al salir la nave, lo cual puede herir o incluso matar a los empleados. Asegúrate de recoger rápidamente las colmenas que hayas acumulado, pues dispones de unos 10 segundos antes de que la puerta de la nave se cierre definitivamente y se pierdan todas las colmenas que hayan quedado fuera.

[[TZP-Inhalant]] es un buen artículo para tener a mano al transportar colmenas. El aumento en la velocidad de desplazamiento facilitará el proceso, pero la visibilidad reducida puede causar problemas si el empleado no tiene el cuidado suficiente.

No se recomienda llevar las colmenas al interior ni refugiarse de un enjambre utilizando la puerta de la nave. Esto hará que las abejas se dispersen y se vuelvan extremadamente peligrosas para los empleados que se encuentren en el exterior. Asimismo, los demás empleados deben mantener una distancia considerable respecto a la persona que recoge la colmena para evitar provocar una agresión involuntaria.

######## Hive/zh-cn

{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item

'''蜂巢'''是[[Circuit Bees|电路蜜蜂]]的巢穴。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 应对策略 ==

侦查蜂巢的最佳时间是清晨，以避免遭遇危险的室外生物。员工也应尽可能轻装（理想状态为负重0磅）。 

在远离预定逃生路线的位置靠近蜂巢。吸引电路蜜蜂后，开始绕圈并远离你的逃生路线——电路蜜蜂会跟着你。
等路线足够安全时，迅速冲回蜂巢处，拿起蜂巢就朝飞船跑去。电路蜜蜂会被激怒，全速追击你。

当体力消耗约四分之三后，扔下蜂巢继续奔跑。电路蜜蜂会平静下来并返回蜂巢。
重复以上步骤，直到你离飞船足够近。
把蜂巢放在飞船侧面或后方的栏杆上，再根据情况选择跑向飞船外侧或直接跑进飞船。

准备就绪后，启动**操纵杆**以离开该卫星。飞船飞出大气层时，电路蜜蜂会被留在身后。
注意蜂巢放置的位置，因为在飞船驶离卫星时，蜜蜂会从放置点往回飞，仍可能造成员工受伤甚至死亡。
务必迅速拿走你收集好的蜂巢，因为大约只有10秒时间，之后飞船舱门将永久关闭，舱外所有蜂巢都会丢失。

携带蜂巢时，随身携带[[TZP-Inhalant|TZP吸入剂]]是个不错的选择。提升的奔跑速度会对搬运过程有所帮助，但如果员工不够谨慎，受限的视野可能会带来麻烦。

不建议将蜂巢带入室内，也不要利用飞船门躲避蜂群。这会导致蜜蜂四处游荡，对室外的玩家造成极大威胁。
其他玩家也应与收集蜂巢的人员保持较远的距离，避免被意外激怒的蜜蜂攻击。

The '''Hoarding Bug''', colloquially known as the "Lootbug", is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. Often seen roaming the facility in large colonies, it collects and carries [[scrap]] to a specific location it considers as a nest. It becomes aggressive towards employees if their territory is intruded or their scrap is taken from them. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Embrion]].

<!--T:34-->
Hoarding Bugs have olive-green exoskeletons, brown inner bodies, and two pairs of legs. Their heads have a pair of large, round red compound eyes, long dark brown antennae, and small mouths with two sharp, tiny teeth. Their backs have three pairs of shorter antennae and two pairs of wings.

== Bestiary Entry == <!--T:1-->
</translate>
{{quote bestiary|HoardingBug}}
<translate>

<!--T:23-->
== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<!--T:24-->
There is a 2.63% chance for a 'Hoarding Bug [[infestation]]' as of [[v65]]. This lowers to a 1.2% chance during the Anniversary period (October 23rd).

== Mechanics == <!--T:4-->

<!--T:5-->
Hoarding Bugs do not attack employees unless an employee gets too close to its nest or if an employee takes any "claimed" scrap. They search the map alongside employees for items, including scrap, tools, and player corpses, to collect at their nest. All Hoarding Bugs on a moon share one nesting site, unless there is a locked door preventing the Hoarding Bugs from sharing. 

<!--T:25-->
=== States ===
Hoarding Bugs have 3 possible states: roaming, guarding, and attacking.

<!--T:26-->
==== Roaming ====
The Hoarding Bug wanders around the map, searching areas for scrap. If it sees an item, it will beeline to pick it up and carry it back to a predetermined nesting site, then enter their guarding state for 15 seconds before returning to roaming.

<!--T:27-->
==== Guarding ====
The Hoarding Bug sits motionless on top of its nesting site to guard its items. It also enters this phase if it sees or hears an employee too close to its nest, and will not return to roaming until all employees are far enough away.

<!--T:28-->
==== Attacking ====
The Hoarding Bug makes a loud, angry chirp and lifts off of the ground to chase an employee. There are 3 subphases of the attacking state:

<!--T:29-->
===== "Soft" =====
Triggered when an employee gets too close to a nest without stealing anything, or stays too close to a roaming bug for too long. This can also be triggered if the Hoarding Bug sees you with an item. The bug will give chase for a short period, and return to being docile once enough distance is made.

<!--T:30-->
===== "Hard" =====
Triggered by hitting a Hoarding Bug. The bug will chase the employee as long as it can see them, and will only let up after killing them or after about 15 seconds of not being able to find them. Once this phase is over, it will return to its guarding state for 15 seconds, and will make a low, angry buzzing sound for that time; if it notices the employee while buzzing, it will return to hard attacking. If not, it will return to regular roaming.

<!--T:31-->
===== "Super" =====
Triggered by taking an item from a Hoarding Bug's nest. The same as hard attacking, except the Hoarding bug will never calm down. If an item is voided (such as a key being used to unlock a door, an egg exploding, or a [[Maneater]] eating an item), then the Hoarding Bug will never calm down.

== Strategy == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
In most cases, Hoarding Bugs should be killed as soon as possible, to avoid scrap being taken far away or having to face several at once later. One bug can be killed relatively easily by hitting it once, then strafing to avoid its attack and hitting it two more times as it flies by; they are quite slow to turn. One or multiple can be taken out at once with one shotgun shot, if available. 

<!--T:13-->
Employees should drop all [[scrap]] outside to prevent it being stolen by bugs, though this may result in [[Baboon Hawk|Baboon Hawks]] taking it instead on some moons. Keep in mind, however, that Hoarding Bugs can sometimes help; if the bugs' nest is close to an exit, employees may want to leave them to their devices, then kill the bugs and take the scrap later in the day.

== Trivia == <!--T:32-->

<!--T:33-->
[[File:GhostLootbug.png|thumb|A costumed Hoarding Bug.]]
Hoarding Bugs have always had 3 HP. In previous versions, it seemed to be 2 HP due to a glitch where shovels and signs hit the bug multiple times in one swing.

On October 31st of every year, Hoarding Bugs will wear sheet ghost costumes.

The '''Hoarding Bug''', colloquially known as the "Lootbug", is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. Often seen roaming the facility in large colonies, it collects and carries [[scrap]] to a specific location it considers as a nest. == Bestiary Entry ==
{{quote bestiary|HoardingBug}}

== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

There is a 2.63% chance for a 'Hoarding Bug [[infestation]]' as of [[v65]]. This lowers to a 1.2% chance during the Anniversary period (October 23rd).

== Mechanics ==

Hoarding Bugs do not attack employees unless an employee gets too close to its nest or if an employee takes any "claimed" scrap. They search the map alongside employees for items, including scrap, tools, and player corpses, to collect at their nest. All Hoarding Bugs on a moon share one nesting site, unless there is a locked door preventing the Hoarding Bugs from sharing. 

=== States ===
Hoarding Bugs have 3 possible states: roaming, guarding, and attacking.

==== Roaming ====
The Hoarding Bug wanders around the map, searching areas for scrap. If it sees an item, it will beeline to pick it up and carry it back to a predetermined nesting site, then enter their guarding state for 15 seconds before returning to roaming.

==== Guarding ====
The Hoarding Bug sits motionless on top of its nesting site to guard its items. It also enters this phase if it sees or hears an employee too close to its nest, and will not return to roaming until all employees are far enough away.

==== Attacking ====
The Hoarding Bug makes a loud, angry chirp and lifts off of the ground to chase an employee. There are 3 subphases of the attacking state:

===== "Soft" =====
Triggered when an employee gets too close to a nest without stealing anything, or stays too close to a roaming bug for too long. This can also be triggered if the Hoarding Bug sees you with an item. The bug will give chase for a short period, and return to being docile once enough distance is made.

===== "Hard" =====
Triggered by hitting a Hoarding Bug. The bug will chase the employee as long as it can see them, and will only let up after killing them or after about 15 seconds of not being able to find them. Once this phase is over, it will return to its guarding state for 15 seconds, and will make a low, angry buzzing sound for that time; if it notices the employee while buzzing, it will return to hard attacking. If not, it will return to regular roaming.

===== "Super" =====
Triggered by taking an item from a Hoarding Bug's nest. The same as hard attacking, except the Hoarding bug will never calm down. If an item is voided (such as a key being used to unlock a door, an egg exploding, or a [[Maneater]] eating an item), then the Hoarding Bug will never calm down.

== Strategy ==

In most cases, Hoarding Bugs should be killed as soon as possible, to avoid scrap being taken far away or having to face several at once later. One bug can be killed relatively easily by hitting it once, then strafing to avoid its attack and hitting it two more times as it flies by; they are quite slow to turn. One or multiple can be taken out at once with one shotgun shot, if available. 

Employees should drop all [[scrap]] outside to prevent it being stolen by bugs, though this may result in [[Baboon Hawk|Baboon Hawks]] taking it instead on some moons. Keep in mind, however, that Hoarding Bugs can sometimes help; if the bugs' nest is close to an exit, employees may want to leave them to their devices, then kill the bugs and take the scrap later in the day.

== Trivia ==

* Hoarding Bugs have always had 3 HP. In previous versions, it seemed to be 2 HP due to a glitch where shovels and signs hit the bug multiple times in one swing.

== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{quote bestiary|HoardingBug}}

== Шансы появления ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

На момент [[v65|версии 65]] существует шанс в 2.63% '[[infestation|нашествия]] Жуков-Собирателей'. Он снижается до 1.2% в период Годовщины (23-е Октября).

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Жуки-Собиратели изначально пугливые и не будут атаковать сотрудников, если их не спровоцировать. Они будут исследовать карту вместе с сотрудниками в поисках предметов, включая лут, инструменты и трупы игроков, и таскать их обратно в гнездо. Все Жуки-Собиратели на луне делят между собой одно гнездо.
</div> 

=== Состояния ===
У Жуков-Собирателей есть 3 возможных состояния: блуждание, охрана и атака.

==== Блуждание ====
Жук-Собиратель бродит по карте, исследую территорию в поисках лута. Если он видит предмет, он тут же по прямой двинется к нему, подберёт и утащит в гнездо, затем перейдёт в состояние охраны на 15 секунд перед возвращение к блужданию.

==== Охрана ====
Жук-Собиратель сидит неподвижно в своём гнезде, охраняя предметы. Он также переходит в эту фазу, если слышит или видит рядом со своим гнездом сотрудника, и не возвращается к блужданию, пока все сотрудники не ушли достаточно далеко от гнезда.

==== Атака ====
Жук-Собиратель издаёт громкое, злобное чириканье и взмывает над землёй, начиная гнаться за сотрудником. У состояния атаки есть 3 под-фазы:

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===== "Мягкая" =====
Провоцируется сотрудниками, подобравшимися слишком близко к гнезду, но ничего не укравшими, либо находящимися близко к блуждающему жуку слишком долго. Жук устроит короткую погоню и вернётся в спокойное состояние, как только между ним и целью будет набрана дистанция.
</div>

===== "Сильная" =====
Провоцируется ударом по жуку. Жук станет преследовать сотрудника, пока видит его, и прекратит погоню только убив его или если не сможет обнаружить его в течении 15 секунд. По окончании этой фазы он вернётся к охране гнезда на 15 секунд и на всём протяжении будет издавать низкий злой жужжащий звук; если он заметит сотрудника во время жужжания, то тут же вернётся к атаке. Если нет, то вернётся уже к обычному блужданию.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===== "Супер" =====
Провоцируется кражей предмета из гнезда Жука-Собирателя или если предмет из гнезда съест [[Maneater/ru|Людоед]]. Работает так же, как сильная атаку за исключением того, что жужжание будет продолжаться, пока в гнездо не будут возвращены все украденные предметы, а предметы, съеденные Людоедом, вернуть уже не получится.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

В большинстве случаев Жуки-Собиратели должны быть убиты как можно скорее чтобы избежать уноса лута далеко от выходов и чтобы не сталкиваться с большим роем позже. Одного жука можно достаточно легко убить просто нанеся один удар, а затем оббегая его по-кругу, чтобы избежать урона, нанося при этом ещё 2 удара, когда он пролетает мимо; жуки очень плохо заворачивают. Одного или нескольких жуков можно уничтожить выстрелом из дробовика, если тот есть у сотрудников в наличии. 

Сотрудникам стоит складывать весь найденный [[scrap|лом]] снаружи, чтобы предотвратить его кражу жуками, хотя на некоторых лунах в таких случаях вместо жуков лут прикарманят [[Baboon Hawk/ru|Бабуиновые Ястребы]]. Не забывайте, что иногда Жуки-Собиратели могут помочь; если гнездо жуков находится близко к выходу, то сотрудникам стоит оставить их в покое до конца дня, после чего убить и забрать стасканный ими за весь день лут.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные факты ==

* У Жуков-Собирателей всегда было 3 ХП. В ранних версиях они умирали от двух ударов из-за глюка, где лопаты и знаки наносили жукам урон дважды за один взмах.

== 生成概率 ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

截至*[[v65|V65版本]]，出现“囤积虫[[infestation|虫灾]]”的概率为2.63%。在周年庆期间（10月23日），该概率会降至1.2%。

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== 机制 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
囤积虫在被激怒前不会主动攻击员工。它们会和员工一起在地图上搜寻物品，包括废料、工具以及玩家尸体，并将其带回巢穴囤积。同一颗卫星上的所有囤积虫共用一个巢穴。
</div> 

== 状态 ==
囤积虫共有三种状态：游荡、警戒和攻击。

==== 游荡状态 ====
囤积虫会在地图各处徘徊，搜寻区域内的废料。一旦发现物品，它会径直走过去捡起，并带回预设的巢穴，随后进入**警戒状态**持续15秒，之后恢复为游荡状态。

==== 警戒状态 ====
囤积虫会一动不动地趴在巢穴顶部守护自己的物品。如果它看到或听到有员工过于靠近巢穴，也会进入该状态，并且直到所有员工都远离足够距离后，才会恢复为游荡状态。

==== 攻击状态 ====
囤积虫会发出响亮而愤怒的尖鸣，并腾空而起追击员工。攻击状态分为三个子阶段：

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===== “温和”攻击 =====
在员工过于靠近巢穴但未偷走任何物品，或长时间靠近处于游荡状态的虫子时触发。虫子会进行短时间追击，在双方拉开足够距离后便会恢复温顺状态。
</div>

===== “强力”攻击 =====
该状态由**攻击囤积虫**触发。只要虫子能看见目标员工，就会持续追击，直到将其击杀，或是在约15秒内无法找到目标才会罢休。
此阶段结束后，它会回到**警戒状态**并持续15秒，期间会发出低沉、愤怒的嗡嗡声；若在嗡嗡作响时再次发现该员工，会立刻重新进入强力攻击状态；若未发现，则恢复正常的游荡状态。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===== “终极”攻击 =====
该状态在**从囤积虫的巢穴拿走物品**，或被**食人花**吃掉物品时触发。效果与强力攻击相同，区别在于虫子会持续发出嗡嗡声，直到所有被盗物品被放回巢穴；被食人花吃掉的物品无法找回。
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

在大多数情况下，囤积虫应当尽快击杀，以防止废料被搬到远处，或是后续不得不一次性面对多只囤积虫。单只囤积虫比较容易处理：先打它一下，然后横向移动躲避它的攻击，等它飞过时再补两下即可；它们的转向速度相当慢。如果有霰弹枪，一枪就能同时解决一只或多只囤积虫。 

员工应将所有[[scrap|废料]]丢在室外，以防被虫子偷走，不过在某些卫星上，这可能会导致废料转而被**狒狒鹰**拿走。
但要注意，囤积虫有时也能派上用场；如果虫子的巢穴靠近出口，员工可以先放任它们活动，等到当天后期再击杀虫子并回收废料。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Trivia ==
</div>

- 囤积虫的生命值始终为 **3点**。在旧版本中，由于铲子和标牌一次挥击会对虫子造成多次判定的漏洞，看起来像是只有 **2点生命值**。

The '''Hygrodere''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It moves slowly along the ground towards nearby employees or sources of noise while covering a large surface area, rapidly damaging employees upon contact. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Offense]].

Hygroderes are large slimes or amoeba-like entities with green or cyan coloration.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary}}
== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Mechanics ==

A Hygrodere moves extremely slowly around the map and always attempts to move towards the nearest employee. It takes a few hits to kill an employee. Unlike most other indoor entities, Hygroderes are unable to open doors, but are able to squeeze through them if they are open. It is attracted to any sort of sound, including [[Clown horn]]s, [[Airhorn]]s, [[Boombox]]es, employee footsteps, etc.

== Strategy ==

Because of the Hygrodere's slow speed, avoiding it is simple unless the employee becomes cornered or is dealing with other entities in the facility. The best course of action is to locate the Hygrodere and track its bubbling sounds to prevent being cornered.

Once a Hygrodere has spotted an employee, it will always know their location, so employees should keep its continual pursuit in mind. As they cannot pass through doors, employees can effectively contain a Hygrodere to a room only accessible by doors via closing them. Employees must bear in mind, however, that the entity’s slow movement speed can make trapping one a very time-consuming process.

They are also attracted to music from [[Boombox]]es, they will chase you and stop right before they touch you, so one may be turned on and dropped to lure the Hygrodere if necessary to free a cornered employee or otherwise draw it away.

An additional danger of the Hygrodere is that they may occasionally camp bunker entrances, possibly because they are attempting to reach employees outside of the building, and thus instantly kill employees upon entry. This scenario should be considered if an employee exited the bunker while a Hygrodere was nearby, but is generally an uncommon occurrence.

Hygrodere can not attack employees that are standing on railings, this can be used to easily get past them in narrow spaces.

* An employee killed by a Hygrodere will only leave their suit behind rather than the whole body, however this is only a cosmetic difference.

<!-- makes no sense on /ru page -->

'''Гигродира''' - враждебная [[Entities/ru|сущность]] внутри здания. Медленно ползёт по полу в сторону сотрудников или источников шума, покрывая при этом огромную площадь, стремительно нанося урон сотрудникам, вошедших с ней в контакт. [[Moons/ru|Луна]], на которой встречается чаще всего - [[Offense/ru|Offense]].

Гигродиры - огромные слаймо- или амёбо-подобные существа с зелёным или голубым окрасом.

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{quote bestiary}}
<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== Шансы появления ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

Гигродира двигается по карте экстремально медленно и всегда пытается двигаться в сторону ближайшего сотрудника. Ей требуется немного ударов, чтобы убить сотрудника. В отличии от других сущностей в здании, Гигродиры не способны открывать двери, но способны протиснуться через них, если они открыты. Их привлекают любого рода звуки, включая [[Clown Horn|Клоунские гудки]], [[Air Horn|Гудки]], [[Boombox/ru|Бумбоксы]], шаги сотрудников и т.д.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Из-за медлительности Гигродиры, избегать её довольно просто если сотрудник не зажат в угол и не занят другой сущностью. Лучшим курсом действий будет обнаружить Гигродиру и ориентироваться на её булькающие звуки чтобы избежать заведение самого себя в угол.

Как только Гигродира заметила сотрудника, она всегда будет знать его местоположение, так что сотрудникам следует помнить про её продолжительное преследование. Так как Гигродиры не могут пройти сквозь двери, сотрудники могут эффективно запереть слизь в комнате, в которую ведут только закрываемые двери, тем не менее, из-за скорости сущности этот процесс является времяёмким.

Они также привлечены к музыке из [[Boombox/ru|Бумбоксов]], из-за чего при преследовании они остановятся прямо перед тем, как коснуться сотрудника, так что можно оставить один включённым на полу, чтобы отманить Гигродиру, если надо освободить зажатого в угол сотрудника или по иной причине увести её.

Дополнительная опасность исходит из того, что Гигродиры любят поджидать под входными дверьми, вероятно потому, что они пытаются достать сотрудников снаружи, следовательно моментально убивая сотрудников, когда те пытаются зайти обратно. Этот сценарий следует рассматривать, если сотрудник покинул здание, когда неподалёку была слизь, но в целом это происходит не часто.

Гигродиры не могут атаковать сотрудников, стоящих на перилах, и это можно использовать, чтобы пройти мимо них в узких пространствах.

'''湿滑胶体'''是一种敌对的室内[[Entities|实体]]。它沿着地面向附近的员工或噪声源缓慢移动，同时覆盖很大的表面区域。它们最常出现在[[Moons|卫星]][[Offense]]上。

湿滑胶体是大型黏液或类似变形虫的实体，呈绿色或青色。

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== 生物图鉴条目 ==
{{quote bestiary}}
<span id="Spawn_chances"></span>
== 生成概率 ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== 机制 ==

'''湿滑胶体'''（下称史莱姆）会以极慢的速度在地图中游荡，并总会试图靠近离它最近的玩家。史莱姆只需要几次攻击就可以杀死玩家。与大多数室内[[Entities/zh-cn|实体]]不同，史莱姆不能主动开门，但它可以挤着通过已经打开的门。史莱姆会被任何声音吸引，包括[[Clown Horn|小丑号角]]、[[Air Horn|气笛]]、[[Boombox/zh-cn|音响]]、玩家的脚步声，等等。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

史莱姆的移动速度很慢。除非玩家被逼至死角或正与其它实体对峙，否则避开史莱姆不算是一件难事。建议留意史莱姆发出的类似冒泡的声音，持续确认它的位置，避免被逼到角落里。

一旦史莱姆发现了一名玩家，它就会永远知道他们的位置，所以员工应该牢记其不断的追逐。由于无法通过门，玩家可以通过关闭门将史莱姆有效地控制在只能通过门进入的房间内。然而，玩家必须记住，史莱姆缓慢的移动速度会使诱捕成为一个非常耗时的过程。

史莱姆也会被[[Boombox/zh-cn|音响]]放出的音乐声吸引。可在必要时打开音响并将其丢到地上，史莱姆就会被引诱至音响所在位置，以此救出被困住的玩家，或只是单纯地将其引走。

有时史莱姆会卡在入口处（可能是想移动至位于室外的玩家附近），于是所有进入室内的玩家都会被它立即杀死。如果在玩家离开室内时，附近恰巧有史莱姆，应当注意此种情况的可能性（虽然确实不常见）。

史莱姆无法攻击站在栏杆上的员工。此特性可用于在狭窄的空间内轻松绕过它。

######## Imperium
{{modded}}

'''Imperium''' is a mod which its developer, giosuel, describes as
<q>a powerful and highly performant all-in-one debugging tool to test and explore game mechanics and functionality in Lethal Company.</q>
It allows for (with the permission the lobby host) spawning items and [[entities]], flight and teleportation,
controlling the game's rendering (shaders), and precise inspection of almost every object and game mechanic.

The mod can be installed from [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/giosuel/Imperium/ its Thunderstore page]
via, for example, the [https://github.com/Kesomannen/gale Gale] mod manager.
Its source code is published [https://github.com/giosuel/Imperium on GitHub] under the [[w:Copyleft|copyleft]] GNU General Public License, version 3.

It also adds [[Shiggy|an easter egg]].

<translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Interior''' refers to the part of a [[moon]]'s surface which lies beyond the entrances&mdash;indoors, and usually underground.
The hazards present here are distinct from the exterior's.
To meet quota, employees must venture inside to gather [[scrap]].

== Interior types == <!--T:35-->

=== <span id="Facility"></span><span id="Factory"></span><span id="The_Facility"></span> The Factory === <!--T:36-->
</translate>
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|<translate><!--T:37--> The main entrance of the Factory</translate>]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:82--> The large fan</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:2-->
The Factory is the most common interior type, mostly found on free moons.

<!--T:15-->
It consists mainly of labyrinthine concrete hallways and corridors, storage rooms, and grated catwalks.

==== Rooms ==== <!--T:38-->

<!--T:3-->
* '''Main entrance:''' The first room employees enter into, consisting of a grated flooring and large fan spinning above.

<!--T:16-->
* '''Catwalks:''' Narrow grated platforms lined with metal railing raised above a deep pit.

<!--T:17-->
* '''Broken catwalks:''' Two catwalks with broken railing separated by a large gap. A bent metal beam spans halfway across the gap allowing employees to jump from one catwalk to the other.

<!--T:18-->
* '''Staircases:''' Grated staircases raised above a pit allowing traversal of both floors of the Factory.

<!--T:19-->
* '''Hallways:''' Sporadically lit concrete hallways arranged in a maze-like configuration.

<!--T:20-->
* '''Hallway intersection room:''' A large hexagon shaped room with multiple routes leading to more hallways. Occasionally features a large boiler in the center of the room.

<!--T:21-->
* '''Storage rooms:''' Large concrete rooms with shelves throughout and occasionally having a staircase leading downwards.

<!--T:22-->
* '''Server rooms:''' Similar to storage rooms, but with dense server racks located throughout the middle.

<!--T:26-->
* '''Liminal office room:''' A room with off-white floors and wallpaper, likely a nod to the internet [[w:Creepypasta|creepypasta]] "[[w:The_Backrooms|The Backrooms]]".

<!--T:23-->
* '''Locker room:''' A large room with a rectangular pit in the middle, as well as stairs leading up to a balcony overlooking the room. Up to two openable lockers can be found lining the walls underneath the balcony's stairs or in the opposite corner.

<!--T:24-->
* '''Manufacturing room:''' An extremely large room featuring four paths deviating from a shared platform. Two paths lead to a large narrow section of the room separated by a pit, the other leads to another narrow area with a conveyor chute lining a wall, while the final path is a catwalk that extends to another room.

<!--T:25-->
* '''Apparatus room:''' A room with shelves, a large power machine, and a socket in the wall next to it containing the [[Apparatus]].

=== <span id="Mansion"></span> The Mansion === <!--T:39-->
</translate>
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|<translate><!--T:40--> The main entrance of the Mansion interior type</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:27-->
The Mansion is primarily found on paid moons, specifically [[Dine]] and [[Rend]], but can appear on any moon as a small chance, excluding March.

<!--T:28-->
It consists mainly of grand carpeted hallways and rooms adorned with bookshelves, fireplaces, and other household furniture.

==== Rooms ==== <!--T:41-->

<!--T:5-->
* '''Main entrance:''' The first room employees enter into, consisting of a large foyer with stairs leading up to a second floor balcony overlooking the room. Occasionally spawning with bookshelves on the ground floor.

<!--T:29-->
* '''Library:''' A room with bookshelves and a staircase allowing traversal of both floors of the Mansion.

<!--T:30-->
* '''Fireplace room:''' A room with a fireplace.

<!--T:31-->
* '''"Window" room:''' A room featuring a screen displaying a farmland scenery.

<!--T:32-->
* '''Staircases:''' A room with a staircase leading upwards. There are two types of rooms devoted to staircases, one which goes straight down and has a closet under the stairs which can contain scrap, and one which wraps around the wall and has a landing midway.

<!--T:33-->
* '''Kitchen:''' A room with checkered flooring and kitchen essentials such as a fridge, table, and oven.

<!--T:84-->
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows. 

<!--T:85-->
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.

<!--T:86-->
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.

<!--T:87-->
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.

<!--T:88-->
* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.

<!--T:89-->
* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.

<!--T:90-->
* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.

==== Strategy ==== <!--T:42-->

<!--T:43-->
To avoid or kill [[entities]] within the Mansion, players can:

<!--T:6-->
* Jump on top of the large bookshelves found in the main entrance. (Entities can make it on top of these bookshelves, so the only use for this is to jump to another disjointed bookshelf in the main room. This will cause the entity to either fall in between the bookshelves or go all the way around to try and kill the player.)
* Jump on top of large tables.
* Jump on top of kitchen counters.

=== <span id="The_Mineshaft"></span>Mineshaft === <!--T:91-->
</translate>
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:92--> Entrance to the Mineshaft</translate>]]

{{main|Mineshaft}}
<translate>
<!--T:93-->
The Mineshaft is an interior added in the [[v60]] update. This interior is most common on [[Offense]], [[Artifice]], [[Vow]] and [[Titan]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]). It contains an elevator down to the main Mineshaft area, which will lead to its main area of profit: A deep cave system. Caves in Mineshafts are found behind doorways that have a blue light above them and focus the majority of Scrap spawns, although the facility part of Mineshaft interiors may also occasionally contain Scrap.

{{unused}}

An office covered in leaves.

== Interior features == <!--T:44-->
</translate>
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:46--> A fire exit inside a Factory</translate>]]
<translate>
=== Fire exits === <!--T:45-->

<!--T:47-->
Every building has at least 1 fire exit, which will lead into a random part of the structure. It can lead into (seemingly) any room, replacing an existing space for a doorway.
These are 2-way doors like the main entrance.

<!--T:72-->
The locations of the fire exit(s) in the exterior aren't randomized.
The articles for each moon include maps with the fire exit locations, for example [[March]] with its unique 3 fire exits.

<!--T:73-->
Locations in specific interiors:
* In [[Factory|Factories]], fire exits will only open into the various catwalk tiles or one of the small rectangular or L-shaped loot rooms.
* In [[Mansion]]s, fire exits will only open into one of the tiles with bookshelves. Sometimes obscured by a bookshelf, though the red glow can still be seen.
* In [[Mineshaft]]s, fire exits lead straight into the hallways, bypassing the elevator. They will never open into the caves.

<!--T:74-->
Due to how the procedural generation of the interior works, fire exits are frequently segmented off from the main entrance by a locked door.{{cite bug|Entering fire exit often leads to locked doors and little else}}

=== Security doors === <!--T:48-->

<!--T:8-->
Found only in the Factory, security doors can be opened and closed using the [[Ship#Terminal|terminal]] aboard the ship. When power is lost, either through a [[#Breaker panel|breaker panel]] or the removal of the apparatus, all security doors will permanently open.

=== Vents === <!--T:49-->

<!--T:9-->
Every interior contains multiple small vents lined along walls. Entities spawn out of vents, making noise as they are about to crawl out. Vents appear as red lines along the walls of the building when viewed on the ship's monitor.

<!--T:75-->
In Mineshafts, the usual grille vents appear in concrete walls, while black cracks appear in rock walls.

</translate><gallery>
File:Vent.png|<translate><!--T:50--> A vent on a Factory wall</translate>
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|<translate><!--T:76--> An example of the rock "vents" exclusive to the Mineshaft</translate>
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:60--> A breaker panel with all switches flipped on</translate>]]
<translate>
=== Breaker panel === <!--T:59-->

<!--T:61-->
The Breaker Panel can be opened to reveal 5 switches, which can be turned to disable or enable power in certain areas of the facility. While it can be used to open and close security doors, it is recommended to just flip them all on, pointing left, when found to allow better visibly for everyone exploring.

<!--T:62-->
While on, it will make a low pitched mechanical humming noise alerting players to its location.

=== Fan === <!--T:77-->

<!--T:78-->
The large fan above the main entrance of the Factory is more than just a decoration. If any employee flies up to it using a [[jetpack]] or [[Tulip Snake]]s, they will immediately be killed by the high-speed rotating fan blades.

=== Steam leaks === <!--T:56-->

<!--T:13-->
Found in the Factory and Mineshaft, steam leaks obscure player vision in hallways similar to [[Weather#Foggy|fog]], only dissipating when turning a valve found nearby.
Leaks can be present at the start of the day, and valves can also blow during the day.
Players continuously shaking their camera while staring at walls within the steam will have increased visibility and a higher chance of finding valves.
An employee with [[full hands]] cannot close valves, they must drop their two-handed item temporarily.

=== Traps === <!--T:51-->

<!--T:79-->
{{main|Traps}}

<!--T:80-->
Traps are manmade hazards found indoors, all posing a great threat to employee safety.

=== Indoor fog === <!--T:96-->

<!--T:97-->
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.

'''Innenräum''' bezeichnet den Teil der Oberfläche eines [[Moon/de|Mondes]], der jenseits der Eingänge liegt&mdash;im Inneren und meist unterirdisch. Die hier vorhandenen Gefahren unterscheiden sich von denen im Außenbereich. Um die Quote zu erfüllen, müssen die Mitarbeiter ins Innere gehen, um [[Scrap/de|Schrott]] zu sammeln.

== Einrichtungen ==

<span id="The_Factory"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Die Fabrik ===
</div>
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|Der Haupteingang der Fabrik]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|Der große Ventilator]]
Die Fabrik ist die häufigste Art von Innenraum und kommt vor allem auf freien Monden vor.

Es besteht hauptsächlich aus verwinkelten Betonfluren und gängen, Lagerräumen und vergitterten Laufstegen.

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== Räume ====

==== Räume ====
* '''Haupteingang:''' Der erste Raum, den die Mitarbeiter betreten, verfügt über einen Gitterboden und einen großen Ventilator, der darüber kreist.

* '''Laufstege:''' Schmale, vergitterte Plattformen, die von Metallgeländern gesäumt sind und über einer tiefen Grube thronen.

* '''Beschädigte Laufstege:''' Zwei Laufstege mit kaputtem Geländer, die durch eine große Lücke voneinander getrennt sind. Ein gebogener Metallträger überspannt die Hälfte der Lücke, sodass die Mitarbeiter von einem Laufsteg zum anderen springen können.

* '''Treppen:''' Gittertreppen, die über einer Grube angebracht sind und den Zugang zu beiden Etagen der Fabrik ermöglichen.

* '''Korridore:''' Sporadisch beleuchtete Betonflure, die labyrinthartig angeordnet sind.

* '''Flurkreuzungen:''' Ein großer, sechseckiger Raum, von dem aus mehrere Wege zu weiteren Fluren führen. Manchmal befindet sich in der Mitte des Raums ein großer Heizkessel.

* '''Lagerräume:''' Große Betonräume, die durchgehend mit Regalen ausgestattet sind und gelegentlich über eine Treppe nach unten führen.

* '''Serverräume:''' Ähnlich wie Lagerräume, jedoch mit dichten Server-Racks, die über den gesamten mittleren Bereich verteilt sind.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Der Backroom:''' Ein Raum mit cremefarbenen Böden und Tapeten, der den [https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Backrooms Backrooms] ähnelt.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Zimmer mit Balkon:''' Ein großer Raum mit einer rechteckigen Vertiefung in der Mitte sowie einer Treppe, die zu einem Balkon mit Blick auf den Raum führt. An den Wänden unterhalb der Balkontreppe oder in der gegenüberliegenden Ecke befinden sich bis zu zwei Schränke.
</div>

* '''Fertigungsraum:''' Ein extrem großer Raum mit vier Wegen, die von einer gemeinsamen Plattform abzweigen. Zwei Wege führen zu einem großen, schmalen Bereich des Raums, der durch eine Grube abgetrennt ist; der andere führt zu einem weiteren schmalen Bereich, an dessen Wand eine Förderrinne verläuft, während der letzte Weg ein Laufsteg ist, der in einen anderen Raum führt.

* '''Appartusraum:''' Ein Raum mit Regalen und einem großen Energiegenerator, in dessen Nähe sich ein Anschluss für den [[Apparatus/de|Apparatus]] an der Wand befindet.

<span id="The_Mansion"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Die Villa ===
</div>
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|Der Haupteingang der Villa]]
Die Villa ist vor allem auf kostenpflichtigen Monden zu finden, insbesondere auf [[Dine/de|Dine]] und [[Rend/de|Rend]], kann aber mit geringer Wahrscheinlichkeit auch auf jedem anderen Mond erscheinen, mit Ausnahme von March.

Es besteht hauptsächlich aus großzügigen, mit Teppichboden ausgelegten Fluren und Räumen, die mit Bücherregalen, Kaminen und anderen Einrichtungsgegenständen ausgestattet sind.

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== Räume ====

* '''Der Haupteingang:''' Der erste Raum, den die Mitarbeiter betreten, besteht aus einem großen Foyer mit einer Treppe, die zu einem Balkon im zweiten Stock führt, von dem aus man den Raum überblicken kann. Gelegentlich tauchen im Erdgeschoss Bücherregale auf.

* '''Bibliothek:''' Ein Raum mit Bücherregalen und einer Treppe, über die man beide Etagen die Villa erreichen kann.

* '''Kaminzimmer:''' Ein Raum mit einer Feuerstelle.

* '''"Fensterraum":''' Ein Raum mit einem Bildschirm, auf dem eine Landschaft mit Ackerflächen zu sehen ist.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Treppen:''' Ein Raum mit einer Treppe, die nach oben führt.
</div>

* '''Küche:''' Ein Raum mit kariertem Bodenbelag und Küchenausstattung wie Kühlschrank, Tisch und Backofen.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.
</div>

</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
==== Strategie ====

Um [[Entities|Kreaturen]] in der Villa zu meiden oder töten, können Spieler:

* Auf eines der großen Bücherregale im Eingangsbereich springen. (Kreaturen können ebenfalls auf die Bücherregale gelangen, deshalb muss man von Regal zu Regal springen, um einen Nutzen davon zu haben. Die Kreaturen fallen dann herunter, zwischen die Regale oder müssen den ganzen Weg auf die andere Seite laufen.)
* Auf die großen Tische springen.
* Auf die große Küchentheke springen.
