<span id="Interior_features"></span>
== Ausstattung ==
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|Ein Notausgang in einer Fabrik]]
<span id="Fire_exits"></span>
=== Notausgänge ===

Jedes Gebäude hat mindestens 1 Notausgang, der in einen zufälligen Teil der Innenstruktur führt. Er kann in scheinbar jeden Raum führen und ersetzt dabei einfach eine normale Tür. Diese Türen sind wie der Haupteingang beidseitig zu öffnen.

Die Lage der Notausgänge im Außenbereich ist nicht zufällig.
Die Artikel zu den einzelnen Monden enthalten Karten mit den Standorten der Notausgänge, zum Beispiel [[March/de|March]] mit seinen drei einzigartigen Notausgängen.

Orte in bestimmten Innenräumen:
* In [[Factory/de|Fabriken]] führen Notausgänge ausschließlich zu den verschiedenen Laufstegplatten oder zu einem der kleinen rechteckigen oder L-förmigen Beuteräume.
* In [[Mansion/de|Villen]] führen Notausgänge nur zu einem der Räume mit Bücherregalen. Manchmal wird es von einem Bücherregal verdeckt, doch der rote Schimmer ist immer noch zu sehen.
* In [[Mineshaft/de|Bergwerksschächten]] führen die Notausgänge direkt in die Flure und umgehen den Aufzug. Sie werden niemals in die Höhlen führen.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to how the procedural generation of the interior works, fire exits are frequently segmented off from the main entrance by a locked door.{{cite bug|Entering fire exit often leads to locked doors and little else}}
</div>

<span id="Security_doors"></span>
=== Sicherheitstüren ===

Diese schweren Metalltüren kommen nur in der Fabrik vor und können mit dem [[Ship#Terminal|Terminal]] am Schiff geöffnet und geschlossen werden. Fällt der Strom aus, entweder durch das Entfernen des [[Apparatus]] oder durch das Betätigen der Schalter im [[Breaker Panel|Schaltkasten]], bleiben die Türen permanent offen.

<span id="Vents"></span>
=== Lüftungsschächte ===

Jede Einrichtung hat kleine Lüftungsschächte, die sich an den Wänden befinden können. Aus diesen können Kreaturen kommen, was ein Geräusch als Warnung verursacht. Auf dem Radar im Schiff sind Lüftungsschächte kleine rote Linien an der Wand.

In Bergwerksschächten sind an den Betonwänden die üblichen Lüftungsgitter zu sehen, während sich an den Felswänden schwarze Risse zeigen.
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|Eine Lüftungsöffnung in einer Fabrikwand
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|Ein Beispiel für die "Lüftungsöffnungen" im Gestein, die nur im Bergwerksschächten zu finden sind
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|Ein Sicherungskasten mit allen Schaltern angeschaltet.]]
<span id="Breaker_panel"></span>
=== Sicherungskasten ===

Der Schalterkasten kann geöffnet werden und beinhaltet 5 Schalter, welche an oder aus gestellt werden können um damit die Elektrizität in der Fabrik an oder aus zu stellen. Obwohl man damit auch geschlossene Sicherheitstüren öffnen kann, ist es eher empfohlen sie alle an zu stellen, damit überall licht herrscht. Wenn ein Schalter nach links schaut ist er an, wenn er nach rechts schaut ist er aus.

Während er an ist, wird er einen leichten tiefen ton summen der sich metallisch anhört und damit Spieler zu dem Ort der Schalterbox führt.

<span id="Fan"></span>
=== Lüfter ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Seit Version 50 ist der große Ventilator über dem Haupteingang der Fabrik mehr als nur eine Dekoration. Sollte ein Mitarbeiter mit einem [[Jetpack/de|Jetpack]] oder [[Tulip Snake/de|Tulpenschlangen]] darauf zufliegen, wird er sofort von den sich mit hoher Geschwindigkeit drehenden Ventilatorflügeln getötet.
</div>

<span id="Steam_leaks"></span>
==== Gaslecks ====

In der Fabrik und im Minenschacht behindern Dampfschwaden die Sicht der Spieler in den Gängen ähnlich wie [[Weather/de#Foggy|Nebel]]; sie lösen sich erst auf, wenn ein in der Nähe befindliches Ventil betätigt wird. Es kann schon zu Beginn des Tages zu Undichtigkeiten kommen, und auch im Laufe des Tages können Ventile versagen. Spieler, die ihre Kamera ständig bewegen, während sie die Wände im Dampf anstarren, haben eine bessere Sicht und eine höhere Chance, Ventile zu finden. Ein Mitarbeiter, der die [[full hands/de|Hände voll]] hat, kann keine Ventile schließen; er muss den Gegenstand, den er mit beiden Händen hält, vorübergehend ablegen.

<span id="Traps"></span>
=== Fallen ===

{{main|Traps/de}}

Fallen sind von Menschen verursachte Gefahrenquellen in Innenräumen, die alle eine große Gefahr für die Sicherheit der Mitarbeiter darstellen.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor fog ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.
</div>

<references />

######## Interiors/en
{{topicon Fandom|Interior}}
{{topicon Fandom|Cabinet|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Elevator|2}}
{{topicon Fandom|Door|3}}
{{topicon Fandom|Fire_Exit|4}}
{{topicon Fandom|Secure_Door|5}}
{{topicon Fandom|Breaker_Box|6}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{split|Factory}}
{{split|Mansion}}
'''Interior''' refers to the part of a [[moon]]'s surface which lies beyond the entrances&mdash;indoors, and usually underground.
The hazards present here are distinct from the exterior's.
To meet quota, employees must venture inside to gather [[scrap]].

== Interior types ==

=== <span id="Facility"></span><span id="Factory"></span><span id="The_Facility"></span> The Factory ===
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|The main entrance of the Factory]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|The large fan]]
The Factory is the most common interior type, mostly found on free moons.

It consists mainly of labyrinthine concrete hallways and corridors, storage rooms, and grated catwalks.

==== Rooms ====

* '''Main entrance:''' The first room employees enter into, consisting of a grated flooring and large fan spinning above.

* '''Catwalks:''' Narrow grated platforms lined with metal railing raised above a deep pit.

* '''Broken catwalks:''' Two catwalks with broken railing separated by a large gap. A bent metal beam spans halfway across the gap allowing employees to jump from one catwalk to the other.

* '''Staircases:''' Grated staircases raised above a pit allowing traversal of both floors of the Factory.

* '''Hallways:''' Sporadically lit concrete hallways arranged in a maze-like configuration.

* '''Hallway intersection room:''' A large hexagon shaped room with multiple routes leading to more hallways. Occasionally features a large boiler in the center of the room.

* '''Storage rooms:''' Large concrete rooms with shelves throughout and occasionally having a staircase leading downwards.

* '''Server rooms:''' Similar to storage rooms, but with dense server racks located throughout the middle.

* '''Liminal office room:''' A room with off-white floors and wallpaper, likely a nod to the internet [[w:Creepypasta|creepypasta]] "[[w:The_Backrooms|The Backrooms]]".

* '''Locker room:''' A large room with a rectangular pit in the middle, as well as stairs leading up to a balcony overlooking the room. Up to two openable lockers can be found lining the walls underneath the balcony's stairs or in the opposite corner.

* '''Manufacturing room:''' An extremely large room featuring four paths deviating from a shared platform. Two paths lead to a large narrow section of the room separated by a pit, the other leads to another narrow area with a conveyor chute lining a wall, while the final path is a catwalk that extends to another room.

* '''Apparatus room:''' A room with shelves, a large power machine, and a socket in the wall next to it containing the [[Apparatus]].

=== <span id="Mansion"></span> The Mansion ===
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|The main entrance of the Mansion interior type]]
The Mansion is primarily found on paid moons, specifically [[Dine]] and [[Rend]], but can appear on any moon as a small chance, excluding March.

It consists mainly of grand carpeted hallways and rooms adorned with bookshelves, fireplaces, and other household furniture.

==== Rooms ====

* '''Main entrance:''' The first room employees enter into, consisting of a large foyer with stairs leading up to a second floor balcony overlooking the room. Occasionally spawning with bookshelves on the ground floor.

* '''Library:''' A room with bookshelves and a staircase allowing traversal of both floors of the Mansion.

* '''Fireplace room:''' A room with a fireplace.

* '''"Window" room:''' A room featuring a screen displaying a farmland scenery.

* '''Staircases:''' A room with a staircase leading upwards. There are two types of rooms devoted to staircases, one which goes straight down and has a closet under the stairs which can contain scrap, and one which wraps around the wall and has a landing midway.

* '''Kitchen:''' A room with checkered flooring and kitchen essentials such as a fridge, table, and oven.

* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows. 

* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.

* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.

* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.

* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.

* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.

* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.

==== Strategy ====

To avoid or kill [[entities]] within the Mansion, players can:

* Jump on top of the large bookshelves found in the main entrance. (Entities can make it on top of these bookshelves, so the only use for this is to jump to another disjointed bookshelf in the main room. This will cause the entity to either fall in between the bookshelves or go all the way around to try and kill the player.)
* Jump on top of large tables.
* Jump on top of kitchen counters.

=== <span id="The_Mineshaft"></span>Mineshaft ===
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|Entrance to the Mineshaft]]

{{main|Mineshaft}}
The Mineshaft is an interior added in the [[v60]] update. This interior is most common on [[Offense]], [[Artifice]], [[Vow]] and [[Titan]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]). It contains an elevator down to the main Mineshaft area, which will lead to its main area of profit: A deep cave system. Caves in Mineshafts are found behind doorways that have a blue light above them and focus the majority of Scrap spawns, although the facility part of Mineshaft interiors may also occasionally contain Scrap.

=== Office ===
{{unused}}
An office covered in leaves.

== Interior features ==
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|A fire exit inside a Factory]]
=== Fire exits ===

Every building has at least 1 fire exit, which will lead into a random part of the structure. It can lead into (seemingly) any room, replacing an existing space for a doorway.
These are 2-way doors like the main entrance.

The locations of the fire exit(s) in the exterior aren't randomized.
The articles for each moon include maps with the fire exit locations, for example [[March]] with its unique 3 fire exits.

Locations in specific interiors:
* In [[Factory|Factories]], fire exits will only open into the various catwalk tiles or one of the small rectangular or L-shaped loot rooms.
* In [[Mansion]]s, fire exits will only open into one of the tiles with bookshelves. Sometimes obscured by a bookshelf, though the red glow can still be seen.
* In [[Mineshaft]]s, fire exits lead straight into the hallways, bypassing the elevator. They will never open into the caves.

Due to how the procedural generation of the interior works, fire exits are frequently segmented off from the main entrance by a locked door.{{cite bug|Entering fire exit often leads to locked doors and little else}}

=== Security doors ===

Found only in the Factory, security doors can be opened and closed using the [[Ship#Terminal|terminal]] aboard the ship. When power is lost, either through a [[#Breaker panel|breaker panel]] or the removal of the apparatus, all security doors will permanently open.

=== Vents ===

Every interior contains multiple small vents lined along walls. Entities spawn out of vents, making noise as they are about to crawl out. Vents appear as red lines along the walls of the building when viewed on the ship's monitor.

In Mineshafts, the usual grille vents appear in concrete walls, while black cracks appear in rock walls.
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|A vent on a Factory wall
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|An example of the rock "vents" exclusive to the Mineshaft
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|A breaker panel with all switches flipped on]]
=== Breaker panel ===

The Breaker Panel can be opened to reveal 5 switches, which can be turned to disable or enable power in certain areas of the facility. While it can be used to open and close security doors, it is recommended to just flip them all on, pointing left, when found to allow better visibly for everyone exploring.

While on, it will make a low pitched mechanical humming noise alerting players to its location.

=== Fan ===

The large fan above the main entrance of the Factory is more than just a decoration. If any employee flies up to it using a [[jetpack]] or [[Tulip Snake]]s, they will immediately be killed by the high-speed rotating fan blades.

=== Steam leaks ===

Found in the Factory and Mineshaft, steam leaks obscure player vision in hallways similar to [[Weather#Foggy|fog]], only dissipating when turning a valve found nearby.
Leaks can be present at the start of the day, and valves can also blow during the day.
Players continuously shaking their camera while staring at walls within the steam will have increased visibility and a higher chance of finding valves.
An employee with [[full hands]] cannot close valves, they must drop their two-handed item temporarily.

=== Traps ===

{{main|Traps}}

Traps are manmade hazards found indoors, all posing a great threat to employee safety.

=== Indoor fog ===

There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A breaker panel with all switches flipped on</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Breaker panel ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Breaker Panel can be opened to reveal 5 switches, which can be turned to disable or enable power in certain areas of the facility. While it can be used to open and close security doors, it is recommended to just flip them all on, pointing left, when found to allow better visibly for everyone exploring.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While on, it will make a low pitched mechanical humming noise alerting players to its location.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Fan ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The large fan above the main entrance of the Factory is more than just a decoration. If any employee flies up to it using a [[jetpack]] or [[Tulip Snake]]s, they will immediately be killed by the high-speed rotating fan blades.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Steam leaks ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Found in the Factory and Mineshaft, steam leaks obscure player vision in hallways similar to [[Weather#Foggy|fog]], only dissipating when turning a valve found nearby.
Leaks can be present at the start of the day, and valves can also blow during the day.
Players continuously shaking their camera while staring at walls within the steam will have increased visibility and a higher chance of finding valves.
An employee with [[full hands]] cannot close valves, they must drop their two-handed item temporarily.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Traps ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Traps}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Traps are manmade hazards found indoors, all posing a great threat to employee safety.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor fog ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.
</div>

<span id="The_Factory"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 공장 ===
</div>
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">공장 내부 유형의 정문</span>]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The large fan</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
공장은 가장 일반적인 인테리어 유형으로, 무료 달에서 가장 많이 사용됩니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
공장의 첫 번째 방은 위에서 돌아가는 대형 선풍기의 그림자가 드리워진 금속 창살 바닥으로 이루어져 있습니다. 나머지 건물은 통로, 어둡거나 희미한 조명의 콘크리트 복도, 간혹 큰 방, 보안 문으로 구성되어 있습니다.
</div>

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== 방 ====

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''정문:''' 위에서 설명한 대로, 플레이어가 처음 입장하는 방입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''캣워크:''' 깊은 구덩이로 둘러싸인, 얇은 금속 통로입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''부서진 캣워크:''' 두 개의 캣워크 구역이 서로 마주보고 있고 그 사이에 간격을 두고 플레이어가 뛰어넘을 수 있도록 철봉이 설치되어 있습니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''계단 통로:''' 깊은 구덩이로 둘러싸인 계단입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''복도:''' 보통 옆에 파이프와 금속 문이 있는 어두운 통로입니다. 보통 미로처럼 배열되어 있습니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''복도 교차 방:''' 더 많은 복도로 연결되는 여러 경로가 있는 육각형 모양의 큰 방입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''창고 방:''' 벽을 따라 선반이 있거나 곳곳에 선반이 배치된 더 크고 대부분 비어 있는 방입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''서버실:''' 창고 방과 비슷하지만 방 중앙에 서버 랙이 빽빽하게 배치되어 있습니다.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Liminal office room:''' A room with off-white floors and wallpaper, likely a nod to the internet [[w:Creepypasta|creepypasta]] "[[w:The_Backrooms|The Backrooms]]".
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''복층형 방:''' 한쪽에는 계단이 있고 가운데에 구덩이가 있는 넓은 개방형 공간으로, 보통 벽에 선반이 늘어서 있고 물건이 놓여 있을 수 있습니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''긴 방:''' 구덩이 옆으로 여러 개의 얇은 통로로 이루어진 긴 2층짜리 방으로, 위쪽에는 계단으로 올라갈 수 있는 출구가 있고 아래쪽 통로에는 여러 개의 출구가 있습니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* ''' 장치 방:''' 선반이 있는 방, 커다란 동력 기계, 그리고 그 옆 벽에 [[apparatus]]가 들어 있는 콘센트가 있습니다.
</div>

<span id="The_Mansion"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 저택 ===
</div>
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|저택 내부 유형의 정문]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
저택은 주로 유료 행성, 특히 [[Dine]]과 [[Rend]]에서 찾을 수 있습니다. 극히 드물기는 하지만 어디에서나 나타날 수 있습니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
맨션의 첫 번째 방은 넓은 로비로, 계단을 통해 2층 발코니로 올라가면 방 중앙이 내려다볼 수 있습니다. 나머지 건물은 카펫이 깔린 방과 복도로 구성되어 있으며 책장, 벽난로 및 기타 가정용 가구가 늘어서 있습니다.
</div>

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== 방 ====

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''정문:''' 플레이어가 처음 입장하는 방은 책장이 측면, 중앙에 스폰되거나, 또는 아예 스폰되지 않는 등 다양합니다. 계단은 2층에 길의 존재 여부와 상관없이 무조건 스폰됩니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''도서관:''' 책장이 있으며 다음 층으로 이어지는 계단이 있는 방입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''벽난로:''' 벽난로가 있는 방입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''창문 방:''' 창문으로 풍경이 투영되는 스크린이 있는 밝은 방입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''나선형 계단:''' 계단으로 이어지는 방은 막다른 골목으로 이어지거나 책장에 막혀 있는 경우가 있습니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''주방:''' 체크무늬 바닥과 냉장고, 테이블, 오븐과 같은 주방 필수품이 구비된 방입니다.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
==== 전략 ====

플레이어는 저택 내에서 [[entities|생명체]]를 피하거나 처치하려면:

* 정문에 있는 커다란 책장 위로 점프하세요. (생명체는 이 책장 위로 올라갈 수 있으므로, 메인 방의 다른 책장 위로 점프하는 것 외에는 다른 용도로 사용할 수 없습니다. 이렇게 하면 엔티티가 책장 사이로 떨어지거나 플레이어를 죽이려고 책장 전체를 돌아다니게 됩니다.)
* 큰 테이블 위로 점프합니다.
* 주방 카운터 위로 점프합니다.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== <span id="The_Mineshaft"></span>Mineshaft ===
</div>
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Entrance to the Mineshaft</span>]]

{{main|Mineshaft}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Mineshaft is an interior added in the [[v60]] update. This interior is most common on [[Offense]], [[Artifice]], [[Vow]] and [[Titan]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]). It contains an elevator down to the main Mineshaft area, which will lead to its main area of profit: A deep cave system. Caves in Mineshafts are found behind doorways that have a blue light above them and focus the majority of Scrap spawns, although the facility part of Mineshaft interiors may also occasionally contain Scrap.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
An office covered in leaves.
</div>

<span id="Interior_features"></span>
== 인테리어 특징 ==
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">공장 내부의 화재 비상구</span>]]
<span id="Fire_exits"></span>
=== 화재 비상구 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
모든 건물에는 최소 1개 이상의 비상구가 있으며, 구조물의 임의의 부분으로 연결됩니다. 비상구는 (겉보기에는) 모든 방으로 연결될 수 있으며, 기존의 출입구 공간을 대체할 수 있습니다.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The locations of the fire exit(s) in the exterior aren't randomized.
The articles for each moon include maps with the fire exit locations, for example [[March]] with its unique 3 fire exits.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Locations in specific interiors:
* In [[Factory|Factories]], fire exits will only open into the various catwalk tiles or one of the small rectangular or L-shaped loot rooms.
* In [[Mansion]]s, fire exits will only open into one of the tiles with bookshelves. Sometimes obscured by a bookshelf, though the red glow can still be seen.
* In [[Mineshaft]]s, fire exits lead straight into the hallways, bypassing the elevator. They will never open into the caves.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to how the procedural generation of the interior works, fire exits are frequently segmented off from the main entrance by a locked door.{{cite bug|Entering fire exit often leads to locked doors and little else}}
</div>

<span id="Security_doors"></span>
=== 보안 문 ===

공장에만 있는 보안 문은 함선에 있는 [[Ship#Terminal|단말기]]를 사용하여 열고 닫을 수 있습니다. [[#Breaker panel|전원 차단기]]를 사용하거나 장치를 제거하면 모든 보안 문이 영구적으로 열립니다.

<span id="Vents"></span>
=== 환풍구 ===

모든 실내에는 벽을 따라 늘어선 작은 환풍구가 여러 개 있습니다. 생명체는 환풍구에서 스폰되며, 기어 나오려고 할 때 소리를 냅니다. 환풍구는 함선 모니터에서 봤을 때 건물 벽을 따라 빨간색 선으로 나타납니다.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In Mineshafts, the usual grille vents appear in concrete walls, while black cracks appear in rock walls.
</div>
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">공장 내부의 환풍구</span>
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">An example of the rock "vents" exclusive to the Mineshaft</span>
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|모든 스위치가 켜져 있는 전원 차단기]]
<span id="Breaker_panel"></span>
=== 전원 차단기 ===

차단기 패널을 열면 5개의 스위치가 표시되며, 이를 돌려 시설의 특정 구역에서 전원을 비활성화하거나 활성화할 수 있습니다. 보안 문를 열고 닫는 데 사용할 수 있지만, 모든 스위치를 왼쪽을 향하도록 모두 켜두면 모든 사람이 더 잘 볼 수 있습니다.

켜져 있는 동안에는 낮은 음조의 기계적인 웅웅거리는 소리를 내며 플레이어에게 위치를 알립니다.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Fan ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The large fan above the main entrance of the Factory is more than just a decoration. If any employee flies up to it using a [[jetpack]] or [[Tulip Snake]]s, they will immediately be killed by the high-speed rotating fan blades.
</div>

<span id="Steam_leaks"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== 증기 누출 ====
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
공장에서만 발견되는 증기는 [[Weather#Foggy|안개]]와 비슷하게 복도에서 플레이어의 시야를 가리고 근처에 있는 밸브를 돌릴 때만 사라집니다. 플레이어가 증기 속 벽을 응시하면서 카메라를 계속 흔들면 시야가 넓어지고 밸브를 찾을 확률이 높아집니다. 밸브는 양손으로 [[scrap|폐품]] 아이템을 들고 있는 플레이어는 돌릴 수 없습니다.
</div>

=== 함정 ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Interior types ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== <span id="Facility"></span><span id="Factory"></span><span id="The_Facility"></span> The Factory ===
</div>
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The main entrance of the Factory</span>]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The large fan</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Factory is the most common interior type, mostly found on free moons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It consists mainly of labyrinthine concrete hallways and corridors, storage rooms, and grated catwalks.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Rooms ====
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Main entrance:''' The first room employees enter into, consisting of a grated flooring and large fan spinning above.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Catwalks:''' Narrow grated platforms lined with metal railing raised above a deep pit.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Broken catwalks:''' Two catwalks with broken railing separated by a large gap. A bent metal beam spans halfway across the gap allowing employees to jump from one catwalk to the other.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Staircases:''' Grated staircases raised above a pit allowing traversal of both floors of the Factory.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Hallways:''' Sporadically lit concrete hallways arranged in a maze-like configuration.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Hallway intersection room:''' A large hexagon shaped room with multiple routes leading to more hallways. Occasionally features a large boiler in the center of the room.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Storage rooms:''' Large concrete rooms with shelves throughout and occasionally having a staircase leading downwards.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Server rooms:''' Similar to storage rooms, but with dense server racks located throughout the middle.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Liminal office room:''' A room with off-white floors and wallpaper, likely a nod to the internet [[w:Creepypasta|creepypasta]] "[[w:The_Backrooms|The Backrooms]]".
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Locker room:''' A large room with a rectangular pit in the middle, as well as stairs leading up to a balcony overlooking the room. Up to two openable lockers can be found lining the walls underneath the balcony's stairs or in the opposite corner.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Manufacturing room:''' An extremely large room featuring four paths deviating from a shared platform. Two paths lead to a large narrow section of the room separated by a pit, the other leads to another narrow area with a conveyor chute lining a wall, while the final path is a catwalk that extends to another room.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Apparatus room:''' A room with shelves, a large power machine, and a socket in the wall next to it containing the [[Apparatus]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== <span id="Mansion"></span> The Mansion ===
</div>
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The main entrance of the Mansion interior type</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Mansion is primarily found on paid moons, specifically [[Dine]] and [[Rend]], but can appear on any moon as a small chance, excluding March.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It consists mainly of grand carpeted hallways and rooms adorned with bookshelves, fireplaces, and other household furniture.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Rooms ====
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Main entrance:''' The first room employees enter into, consisting of a large foyer with stairs leading up to a second floor balcony overlooking the room. Occasionally spawning with bookshelves on the ground floor.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Library:''' A room with bookshelves and a staircase allowing traversal of both floors of the Mansion.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Fireplace room:''' A room with a fireplace.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''"Window" room:''' A room featuring a screen displaying a farmland scenery.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Staircases:''' A room with a staircase leading upwards. There are two types of rooms devoted to staircases, one which goes straight down and has a closet under the stairs which can contain scrap, and one which wraps around the wall and has a landing midway.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Kitchen:''' A room with checkered flooring and kitchen essentials such as a fridge, table, and oven.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Strategy ====
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
To avoid or kill [[entities]] within the Mansion, players can:
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* Jump on top of the large bookshelves found in the main entrance. (Entities can make it on top of these bookshelves, so the only use for this is to jump to another disjointed bookshelf in the main room. This will cause the entity to either fall in between the bookshelves or go all the way around to try and kill the player.)
* Jump on top of large tables.
* Jump on top of kitchen counters.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== <span id="The_Mineshaft"></span>Mineshaft ===
</div>
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Entrance to the Mineshaft</span>]]

{{main|Mineshaft}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Mineshaft is an interior added in the [[v60]] update. This interior is most common on [[Offense]], [[Artifice]], [[Vow]] and [[Titan]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]). It contains an elevator down to the main Mineshaft area, which will lead to its main area of profit: A deep cave system. Caves in Mineshafts are found behind doorways that have a blue light above them and focus the majority of Scrap spawns, although the facility part of Mineshaft interiors may also occasionally contain Scrap.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Office ===
</div>
{{unused}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
An office covered in leaves.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Interior features ==
</div>
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A fire exit inside a Factory</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Fire exits ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Every building has at least 1 fire exit, which will lead into a random part of the structure. It can lead into (seemingly) any room, replacing an existing space for a doorway.
These are 2-way doors like the main entrance.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The locations of the fire exit(s) in the exterior aren't randomized.
The articles for each moon include maps with the fire exit locations, for example [[March]] with its unique 3 fire exits.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Locations in specific interiors:
* In [[Factory|Factories]], fire exits will only open into the various catwalk tiles or one of the small rectangular or L-shaped loot rooms.
* In [[Mansion]]s, fire exits will only open into one of the tiles with bookshelves. Sometimes obscured by a bookshelf, though the red glow can still be seen.
* In [[Mineshaft]]s, fire exits lead straight into the hallways, bypassing the elevator. They will never open into the caves.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to how the procedural generation of the interior works, fire exits are frequently segmented off from the main entrance by a locked door.{{cite bug|Entering fire exit often leads to locked doors and little else}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Security doors ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Found only in the Factory, security doors can be opened and closed using the [[Ship#Terminal|terminal]] aboard the ship. When power is lost, either through a [[#Breaker panel|breaker panel]] or the removal of the apparatus, all security doors will permanently open.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Vents ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Every interior contains multiple small vents lined along walls. Entities spawn out of vents, making noise as they are about to crawl out. Vents appear as red lines along the walls of the building when viewed on the ship's monitor.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In Mineshafts, the usual grille vents appear in concrete walls, while black cracks appear in rock walls.
</div>
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A vent on a Factory wall</span>
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">An example of the rock "vents" exclusive to the Mineshaft</span>
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A breaker panel with all switches flipped on</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Breaker panel ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Breaker Panel can be opened to reveal 5 switches, which can be turned to disable or enable power in certain areas of the facility. While it can be used to open and close security doors, it is recommended to just flip them all on, pointing left, when found to allow better visibly for everyone exploring.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While on, it will make a low pitched mechanical humming noise alerting players to its location.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Fan ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The large fan above the main entrance of the Factory is more than just a decoration. If any employee flies up to it using a [[jetpack]] or [[Tulip Snake]]s, they will immediately be killed by the high-speed rotating fan blades.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Steam leaks ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Found in the Factory and Mineshaft, steam leaks obscure player vision in hallways similar to [[Weather#Foggy|fog]], only dissipating when turning a valve found nearby.
Leaks can be present at the start of the day, and valves can also blow during the day.
Players continuously shaking their camera while staring at walls within the steam will have increased visibility and a higher chance of finding valves.
An employee with [[full hands]] cannot close valves, they must drop their two-handed item temporarily.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Traps ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Traps}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Traps are manmade hazards found indoors, all posing a great threat to employee safety.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor fog ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.
</div>

'''Interior''' se refere à parte da superfície de uma [[moons/pt-br|lua]] que está além de suas entradas&mdash;internas e geralmente está no subsolo. Os perigos presentes aqui são diferentes dos exteriores. Para bater a meta, funcionáries devem se aventurar nos interiores para coletarem [[scrap/pt-br|sucata]].

<span id="Interior_types"></span>
== Tipos de interiores ==

<span id="The_Factory"></span>
=== <span id="Instalação"></span><span id="Fábrica"></span><span id="A Instalação"></span><span id="A Instalacao"></span><span id="Instalacao"></span><span id="Fabrica"></span><span id="A Fabrica"></span><span id="Instalaçao"></span><span id="A Instalaçao"></span>  A Fábrica ===
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|A entrada principal da Fábrica]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|O grande ventilador]]
A fábrica é o tipo de interior mais comum, geralmente encontrada em luas gratuitas.

Ela consiste principalmente de corredores de concreto labirínticos, salas de estoque e passarelas grelhadas.

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== Salas ====

* '''A entrada principal:''' A primeira sala onde ês funcionáries entram, consiste de um chão grelhado e de um grande ventilador girando acima.

* '''Passarelas:''' Plataformas estreitas e grelhadas, com corrimão de ferro, acima de um buraco profundo.

* '''Passarelas quebradas:''' Duas passarelas com corrimão quebrado separadas por um grande vão. Uma viga de metal dobrada passa pela metade do vão, o que permite que funcionáries pulem de uma passarela para a outra.

* '''Escadarias:''' Escadarias grelhadas elevadas acima de buraco, permitindo a travessia entre dois andares da Fábrica.

* '''Corredores:''' Corredores de concreto esporadicamente acendidos arrumados em uma configuração labiríntica.

* '''Sala de intersecção de corredor:''' Uma sala grande de formato hexagonal com múltiplas saídas que levam a corredores. Ocasionalmente apresenta uma grande caldeira no centro da sala.

* '''Salas de estoque:''' Salas grandes de concreto com prateleiras espalhadas e ocasionalmente tendo uma escadaria que desce.

* '''Salas de servidor:''' Parecidas com as salas de estoque, mas com racks densos de servidores espalhados ao redor do meio.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Sala de escritório:''' Uma sala com paredes quase brancas e papel de parede, provavelmente uma referencia à [https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creepypasta creepypasta] da internet, [https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Backrooms "The Backrooms"].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Sala com sacada:''' Uma sala grande com um buraco retangular no meio, e com escadas que levam a uma sacada estando acima do sala. Até dois armários que podem ser abertos são encontrados ou abaixo das escadas da sacada ou no canto oposto.
</div>

* '''Sala de manufatura:''' Uma sala extremamente grande com quatro caminhos saindo de uma plataforma compartilhada. Dois caminhos levam a uma seção longa e estreita que leva a outra área estreita com uma calha transportadora alinhada à parede, enquanto o último caminho é uma passarela que leva a outra sala.

* ''' A sala do Aparelho:''' Uma sala com estantes, um grande gerador, e um soquete na parede que contém o [[apparatus/pt-br|aparelho]].

<span id="The_Mansion"></span>
=== <span id="Mansao"></span><span id="A Mansao"></span><span id="Mansão"></span> A Mansão ===
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|A entrada principal do tipo de interior Mansão]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
A mansão é principalmente encontrada em [[moons/pt-br|luas]] pagas, especialmente [[Dine/pt-br|Dine]] e [[Rend/pt-br|Rend]], mas pode aparecer em qualquer lua, com exceto [[March/pt-br|March]], apesar de extremamente raro.
</div>

Ela consiste principalmente de grandes corredores com carpetes e salas cheias de estantes de livros, lareiras e outros móveis.

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== Salas ====

* '''A entrada principal:''' A primeira sala que ês funcionáries entram, consistindo de um grande hall com escadas que levam a um segundo andar que observa o primeiro. Ocasionalmente estantes de livros geram no primeiro andar.

* '''Biblioteca:''' Uma sala com estantes e uma escada que permitem a travessia entre dois andares da Mansão.

* '''Sala da lareira:''' Uma sala com uma lareira.

* '''Sala com uma "janela":''' Uma sala com várias telas que projetam um cenário de fazenda.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Escadarias:''' Uma sala com uma escadaria que leva acima.
</div>

* '''Cozinha:''' Uma sala com chão xadrez e utensílios de cozinha, como uma geladeira, mesa e fogão.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
==== Estratégia ====

Para evitar ou matar [[entities/pt-br|entidades]] na mansão, funcionáries podem:

* Pular em cima das grandes estantes encontradas na entrada principal. (Entidades conseguem subir nas estantes, então só use-as para alcançar estantes inalcançáveis por inimigos, o que faz com que eles caiam ou vão ao redor para tentar matar ê funcionárie.)
* Pular em cima de mesas
* Pular em cima do balcão da cozinha

<span id="Interior_features"></span>
== Características dos interiores ==
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|Uma saída de emergência dentro de uma fábrica]]
<span id="Fire_exits"></span>
=== Saídas de emergência ===

Todas as instalações têm pelo menos 1 saída de emergência, que levará a uma parte aleatória da estrutura. Ela pode levar à (aparentemente) qualquer sala, substituindo um espaço existente de uma porta. Elas são portas de 2 vias igual à entrada principal.

As localizações da(s) saída(s) de emergências no exterior não são aleatórias.
Os artigos para cada lua incluem mapas com as localizações das saídas de emergência, por exemplo [[March/pt-br|March]] com suas três saídas de emergência.

Localizações em interiores específicos:
* Nas fábricas, as saídas de emergência só abrirão em salas com passarelas ou uma das pequenas salas retangulares com sucata.
* Em mansões, as saídas de incêndio abrirão apenas em salas com estantes de livro. As vezes escondidas atrás de uma estante, mas ainda visíveis por causa de seu brilho vermelho.
* Nas minas, as saídas de incêndio levam direto aos corredores, desviando do elevador. Elas nunca abrirão para as cavernas.

Graças ao modo de funcionamento da geração procedural do interior, as saídas de emergência são geralmente separadas da saída principal por uma porta trancada.{{cite bug|Entrar nas saídas de emergência frequentemente leva a portas trancadas e nada mais}}

<span id="Security_doors"></span>
=== Portas de segurança ===

Encontradas apenas na fábrica, portas de segurança podem ser abertas e fechadas utilizando o [[Ship/pt-br#Terminal|terminal]] na nave. Quando não se tem energia, ou desativando-a no [[#Painel elétrico|painel elétrico]] ou removendo o [[Apparatus/pt-br|aparelho]], todas as portas de segurança vão se abrir permanentemente.

<span id="Vents"></span>
=== Ventilações ===

Todo interior contém múltiplas ventilações pequenas alinhadas nas paredes. [[Entities/pt-br|Entidades]] geram a partir de ventilações, fazendo barulho como se estivessem saindo engatinhando. Ventilações aparecem como linhas vermelhas nas paredes quando vistas do monitor da nave.

Nas minas, as ventilações normais aparecem nas paredes de concreto, enquanto rachaduras pretas aparecem em paredes de pedra.
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|Uma ventilação dentro da Fábrica.
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|Um exemplo das "ventilações" de pedra exclusivas à mina.
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|Um painel elétrico com todos os disjuntores ligados]]
<span id="Breaker_panel"></span>
=== Painel elétrico ===

O painel elétrico pode ser aberto para revelar 5 disjuntores, que podem ser desligados ou ligados para afetar a energia em certas áreas do interior. Enquanto isso pode ser usado para abrir portas de segurança, é recomendado ligar todos os interruptores, virando-os para esquerda, já que permitem melhor visibilidade para aquelus explorando o interior.

Enquanto ligados, o painel de energia vai fazer um barulho grave e mecânico alertando jogadores de sua localização.

<span id="Fan"></span>
=== Ventilador ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Desde a versão 50, o grande ventilador acima da entrada principal da Fábrica é mais do que uma decoração. Se ume funcionárie chegar lá em cima usando uma [[jetpack/pt-br|mochila à jato]] ou uma [[Tulip Snake/pt-br|Cobra Tulip]], elu será instantaneamente mortê pelas hélices que estão girando em alta velocidade.
</div>

<span id="Steam_leaks"></span>
==== Vazamento de vapor ====

Encontradas na fábrica e mina, vazamentos de gás limitam a visão do jogador em corredores, semelhantes à [[Weather/pt-br#névoa|névoa]], apenas dissipando quando uma válvula encontrada perto do vazamento for girada. Vazamentos podem estar presentes desde o inicio do dia e válvulas podem também estourar durante o dia.
Funcionáries continuamente mexendo sua câmera enquanto estiver dentro do vapor vão ter visibilidade aumentada e uma chance maior de achar válvulas.
Ume funcionárie de [[full hands/pt-br|mãos cheias]] não consegue fechar válvulas, elu deve soltar seu item de duas mãos temporariamente para fechá-la.

<span id="Traps"></span>
=== Armadilhas ===

{{main|Traps}}

Armadilhas são perigos feitos por humanos encontradas nos interiores, todas sendo uma grande ameaça à segurança de funcionáries.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor fog ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.
</div>

<span id="Interior_types"></span>
== Типы помещений ==

<span id="The_Factory"></span>
=== <span id="Facility"></span><span id="Factory"></span><span id="The_Facility"></span> Завод ===
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|Главный вход Завода.]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|Огромные лопасти]]
Завод - самый частый тип интерьера, часто встречающийся на бесплатных лунах.

Он состоит в основном из лабиринтоподобных бетонных коридоров, складов и решётчатых мостиков.

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== Комнаты ====

* '''Главный вход''' - первая комната, в которую попадают сотрудники, воспользовавшиеся главным входом, состоящая из решётчатого пола и огромных лопастей, вращающихся сверху.

* '''Мостики:''' Узкие решётчатые платформы с металлическими периллами, висящие над глубокими пропастями.

* '''Проломанные мостики:''' Две секции мостиков друг напротив друга с проломанными периллами, разделённые огромной пропастью. На половину комнаты из под мостиков выпирает погнутая металлическая балка, позволяющая сотрудникам перепрыгивать с одного мостика на другой.

* '''Лестничные площадки:''' Решётчатые лестницы поднятые над пропастью, позволяющие перемещаться между этажами Завода.

* '''Коридоры:''' Беспорядочно освещённые бетонные коридоры, собранные в лабиринтоподобную конфигурацию.

* '''Коридорный перекрёсток:''' Огромная комната в форме восьмиугольника со множеством путей ведущих к другим коридорам. Иногда по центру может располагаться огромный бойлер.

* '''Складские помещения:''' Огромные бетонные комнаты с полками повсюду, иногда с лестницей ведущей вниз.

* '''Серверные:''' Подобны складам, но с густыми стойками серверов распределённых по середине комнаты.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Офисная комната:''' Комната с бежевыми полом и обоями, скорее всего отсылка на интернет [https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Крипипаста крипипасту] [https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Закулисье "The Backrooms"].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Комната с балконом:''' Огромная комната с прямоугольной пропастью по середине, а также лестницей, ведущей на балкон над комнатой. В комнате можно найти до двух открываемых шкафов возле стен под балконом со стороны лестницы и в углу напротив.
</div>

* '''Цех:''' Экстремально огромная комната с четырьмя проходами, исходящими от общей платформы. Два прохода ведут в огромную узкую секцию, разделённую пропастью, другой ведёт в другую узкую часть с конвейерной лентой у стены, а четвёртый является решётчатым мостиком, выходящим в другую комнату.

* '''Комната с Аппаратом:''' Комната с полками, огромной силовой установкой, и слотом в стене, содержащим [[Apparatus|аппарат]].

<span id="The_Mansion"></span>
=== <span id="Mansion"></span> Особняк ===
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|Фойе Особняка.]]
Особняк в основном можно найти на платных лунах, конкретно на [[Dine/ru|Dine]] и [[Rend/ru|Rend]], но может с маленьким шансом появиться в целом где угодно, кроме March.

Он состоит в основном из больших ковровых коридоров и комнат, заставленных книжными полками, каминами и другой утварью.

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== Комнаты ====

* '''Фойе:''' Первая комната, в которую попадают сотрудники, в которой есть лестница, ведущая на балконы второго этажа, выходящие над комнатой. Иногда появляется с книжными полками на нижнем ярусе.

* '''Библиотека:''' Комната с книжными полками и лестницей между этажами.

* '''Каминная:''' Комната с камином.

* '''Комната с "окном"''' Яркая комната с "окнами"-экранами, показывающими фермерский пейзаж.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''Лестница:''' Лестничная площадка, ведущая между этажами.
</div>

* '''Кухня:''' Комната с шахматным полом и кухонной утварью и интерьером, такими как холодильник, стол и печь.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
==== Стратегия ====

Для избегания или убийства [[entities/ru|сущностей]] в особняке игроки могут:

* Запрыгнуть на книжные полки в фойе. (Сущности могут попасть туда, так что игрокам придётся перепрыгивать между полками с одной стороны на другую. Это заставит сущностей упасть между полками, либо начать движение на другой конец балкона чтобы добраться до игрока.)
* Запрыгнуть на большой стол.
* Запрыгнуть на кухонную стойку.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== <span id="The_Mineshaft"></span>Mineshaft ===
</div>
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Entrance to the Mineshaft</span>]]

{{main|Mineshaft}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Mineshaft is an interior added in the [[v60]] update. This interior is most common on [[Offense]], [[Artifice]], [[Vow]] and [[Titan]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]). It contains an elevator down to the main Mineshaft area, which will lead to its main area of profit: A deep cave system. Caves in Mineshafts are found behind doorways that have a blue light above them and focus the majority of Scrap spawns, although the facility part of Mineshaft interiors may also occasionally contain Scrap.
</div>

<span id="Interior_features"></span>
== Особенности интерьера ==
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|Пожарный выход на Заводе]]
<span id="Fire_exits"></span>
=== Пожарные выходы ===

У каждого строения есть как минимум 1 пожарный выход, который будет вести в случайную часть здания. Может вести в (по-видимому) любую комнату, заменяя собой существующее место для дверного прохода. Через пожарный выход можно как войти, так и выйти, аналогично главному входу.

Местоположения пожарных выходов на внешней части карт не случайны. Статьи каждой луны содержат карты с отмеченными местоположениями пожарных выходов, например [[March/ru|March]] с её уникальными тремя пожарными выходами.

Локации в конкретных интерьерах:
* На [[Interiors/ru#Завод|Заводе]] пожарные выходы будут появляться только в комнатах с мостиками, либо в прямоугольных или L-образных складских помещениях.
* В [[Interiors/ru#Особняк|Особняках]] пожарные выходы будут появляться только в комнатах с книжными полками. Иногда они могут закрывать собой пожарные выходы, но сквозь них будет проходить свет от красной лампы и воспользоваться пожарным выходом сквозь них всё ещё возможно.
* В [[Interiors/ru#Шахты (ожидается больше информации)|Шахтах]] пожарные выходы ведут сразу в коридоры в обход лифта. Никогда не появляются в пещерных системах.

Из-за механизма процедурной генерации интерьера пожарные выходы нередко отделены от главного входа запертой дверью.{{cite bug|Entering fire exit often leads to locked doors and little else}}

<span id="Security_doors"></span>
=== Защитные двери ===

Появляющиеся только на Заводе, защитные двери могут быть открыты и закрыты через [[Ship/ru#Терминал|терминал]] корабля. Когда пропадает электричество, либо через [[#Электрощиток|электрощиток]], либо из-за изъятия Аппарата, все защитные двери навсегда откроются.

<span id="Vents"></span>
=== Вентиляции ===

Каждое здание содержит несколько маленьких вентиляций, установленных на стенах. Сущности появляются из вентиляций, издавая звук перед тем, как вылезти. На мониторе корабля вентиляции показываются как красные линии вдоль стен здания.

В шахтах в бетонных стенах появляются обычные решётчатые вентиляции, в то время как в пещерах их роль выполняют чёрные разломы в стене.
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|Вентиляция на стене Завода
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|Пример каменной "вентиляции", появляющейся исключительно в пещерных системах Шахт.
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|Электрощиток со всеми включенным переключателями]]
<span id="Breaker_panel"></span>
=== Электрощиток ===

Электрощиток содержит 5 переключателей, которые можно дёрнуть, чтобы включить или выключить электричество в определённых частях здания. Несмотря на то, что их можно использовать для открытия-закрытия дверей, лучше просто включить их все, переведя в левое положение, чтобы улучшить видимость всех кто сейчас исследует здание.

Будучи включенным, издаёт низкий механический гудящий звук, оповещая игроков о своём местоположении.

<span id="Fan"></span>
=== Лопасти ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Начиная с версии 50, огромные лопасти под потолком главного входа Завода стали более чем декорацией. Если сотрудник влетает в них, используя [[Jetpack|Ракетный Ранец]] или с помощью [[Tulip Snake/ru|Тюльпановых Змей]], его немедленно убьёт быстро вращающимися лопастями.
</div>

<span id="Steam_leaks"></span>
=== Утечки газа ===

Появляющиеся на Заводе и в Шахтах, утечки газа блокируют обзор сотрудника в коридорах подобно [[Weather#Foggy|туману]], пропадая только после поворота вентиля, находящегося неподалёку.
Утечки могут быть уже с начала дня, а могут возникнуть позже с течением времени.
Сотрудники, постоянно мотающие головой и смотрящие в стену внутри зоны утечки будут иметь лучший обзор и больше шансов найти вентиль.
Вентили не могут быть повёрнуты сотрудниками [[Full hands|занятыми руками]]. Они должны временно сбросить двуручный предмет на пол.

<span id="Traps"></span>
=== Ловушки ===

{{main|Traps/ru}}

Ловушки - рукодельные источники опасности внутри зданий, каждая из которых угрожает безопасности сотрудника.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor fog ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.
</div>

'''内部结构'''指在[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]表面各入口后方的室内区域，且通常位于地下。此处的危险要素与室外区别较大。要完成配额任务，员工必须冒险进入室内并搜刮[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]。

<span id="Interior_types"></span>
== 结构类型 ==

<span id="The_Factory"></span>
=== <span id="设施"></span> 工厂 ===
[[File:Factorymainentrance.webp|thumb|工厂的主要入口]]
[[File:FactoryFan.png|thumb|大型风扇]]
工厂是最常见的内部结构类型，大多位于免费星球。

该区域主要由迷宫形的混凝土走廊、储物间和钢格板走道构成。

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== 房间 ====

* '''主要入口：'''员工首先进入的房间。房间内有格栅式的地板，顶部有旋转的大风扇。

* '''高空走道：'''有金属护栏的狭窄格栅平台，建在深坑之上。

* '''断裂走道：'''两段护栏损坏的高空走道，中间隔着很大的空隙。一根弯曲的金属梁伸出至空隙一半的长度，供员工在走道间跳跃往返。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''楼梯井：'''在深坑之上的楼梯；
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''走廊：'''两侧有管道和金属门的黑暗过道，一般用于组成类似迷宫的结构；
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''走廊交汇房：'''大型的六边形房间，多条走廊汇聚于此；
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''储物间：'''面积较大，其墙壁上或内部布置有货架，但大部分情况下没有物品；
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''机房：'''与储物间类似，但房间中间部分密布服务器机架；
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''后室：'''有着米白色地板与墙纸的房间，作为对 [[w:zh:The_Backrooms|The Backrooms]] 的致敬。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''双层房：'''一个一边有着楼梯，中间有深坑的开阔大房间，通常有货架在墙边，里面可能有废料。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''长房间：'''一个两层的有很多两侧是坑的窄通道的长房间，在阶梯的顶部有一个出口，在下面低处的通道处可能有几个出口。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''配电房：'''内部布置有架子和一台大型发电机的房间，其墙上有插槽用于插入 [[Apparatus|发电装置]]。
</div>

<span id="The_Mansion"></span>
=== 豪宅 ===
[[File:Mansionmainentrance.webp|thumb|豪宅的主要入口]]
豪宅主要位于付费星球上（尤其是 [[Dine]] 和 [[Rend]]），但其也可能出现在除 March 以外的其它星球上，不过概率极低。

整体以铺有地毯的宽敞长廊为主，房间内摆放着书架、壁炉以及各类居家陈设。

<span id="Rooms"></span>
==== 房间 ====

* '''正门入口：'''船员最先抵达的房间，是一处宽敞门厅，内设楼梯可通往二层观景露台，能俯瞰整间大厅。一楼区域有时会随机刷新书架。

* '''藏书室： '''布满书架的房间，内置楼梯，可通行宅邸一二两层。

* '''壁炉房：'''设有壁炉的房间。

* '''"观景室:'''内设仿真屏幕，画面为田园田野风光。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* '''楼梯间:'''内设通往上层的楼梯的房间。
</div>

* '''厨房:'''方格地砖铺设，摆放冰箱、餐桌、烤箱等各类厨具设施。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Greenhouse:''' A room with a long row of plants, a countertop with a sink, and screens on the wall and ceiling similar to those in the "window" room, projecting the appearance of a countryside landscape at twilight. Doors leading into or out of the conservatory are white with inset windows.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bathroom:''' A room with a tiled floor similar to that of the kitchen, a counter with a sink, drawers, and cupboards in which items can be found, a toilet, a shower stall, and a bathtub.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Bedroom:''' A room with a double bed, a bedside table, a dresser, a trash can, and a closet.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Party room:''' A room with a dining table and decorations for a birthday party, including floating balloons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Alcove room:''' A room consisting of a square or C-shaped narrow hallway wrapping around an inaccessible space. Two of the walls on the inner side will have alcoves in which scrap can potentially be found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Pool room:''' A room containing a swimming pool. There is a pink inflatable pool floatie that bobs up and down in the water when jumped on, and the deep end is deep enough to submerge a standing employee. Items can sometimes be found in the pool.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* '''Garage:''' A room with a parked car, tool racks on the walls, some cabinets, a recycling bin, and a large pile of cardboard boxes.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
==== 策略 ====

为了躲避或击杀豪宅内的[[Entites/zh-cn|实体]]，玩家可以：

* 如果主入口进来后有大书架，跳到书架顶上。（实体也能到达这些书架的顶上，所以这样做的唯一作用就是再跳到旁边的另一个书架上。这会有两种结果：一种是实体掉在两个书架之间，另一种则是实体也跳上了这个书架继续尝试击杀玩家。）
* 跳到大桌子的顶部。
* 跳到厨房柜台的顶部。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== <span id="The_Mineshaft"></span>Mineshaft ===
</div>
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Entrance to the Mineshaft</span>]]

{{main|Mineshaft}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Mineshaft is an interior added in the [[v60]] update. This interior is most common on [[Offense]], [[Artifice]], [[Vow]] and [[Titan]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]). It contains an elevator down to the main Mineshaft area, which will lead to its main area of profit: A deep cave system. Caves in Mineshafts are found behind doorways that have a blue light above them and focus the majority of Scrap spawns, although the facility part of Mineshaft interiors may also occasionally contain Scrap.
</div>

<span id="Interior_features"></span>
== 内部特点 ==
[[File:Fireexit.png|thumb|工厂内的消防出口]]
<span id="Fire_exits"></span>
=== 消防出口 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
每个建筑至少有一个消防出口，走进后会到达设施内的随机一处地点。消防出口（似乎）可以在室内的任何一个屋子中生成，取代已有的一处空间形成出口。
</div>

外部消防出口位置
各星球外部消防出口的位置固定不变，不会随机刷新。每个星球的维基页面均附有标注消防出口位置的地图，例如[[March]] 就设有3 个独特的消防出口。

特定室内场景出口分布：
* 在[[Factory|工厂]]场景中，消防出口仅连通各类走道平台，或是小型矩形、L型物资房间。
* 在[[Mansion|豪宅]]场景中，消防出口只会通向带有书架的房间区域，有时会被书架遮挡，但依旧能看见红色光亮。
* 在[[Mineshaft|矿井]]场景中，消防出口直接连通走廊，可绕开电梯通行，绝不会连通洞穴区域。

消防出口与正门的隔断机制
由于设施内部采用程序化生成，消防出口与主入口之间经常被一道上锁的门隔开。

<span id="Security_doors"></span>
=== 安全门 ===

安全门只存在于工厂中，可在飞船内使用[[Ship/zh-cn#终端|终端]]来开启或关闭。如果拨动[[#断路器面板|断路器面板]]，或拔出发电装置使工厂失去电力时，所有的安全门将会永久打开。

<span id="Vents"></span>
=== 通风口 ===

每种室内结构都有多个小通风口布置在墙上。实体将从通风口生成，当它们即将爬出的时候会发出声音。通风口在飞船内监视器上以沿墙方向的红线显示。

在矿井场景里，混凝土墙体上会刷新常规的格栅通风口，岩石墙体上则只会出现黑色裂缝。
<gallery>
File:Vent.png|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">工厂内的一个通风口</span>
File:Less_vent_more_crag.webp|矿井专属岩石 “通风口” 示例
</gallery>

[[File:Breakerbox.png|thumb|一个配电箱，里面所有的空开均被打开]]
<span id="Breaker_panel"></span>
=== 配电箱 ===

配电箱可以打开，内有5个空开，这些空开可以转动以激活或断开设施某些区域的电力供应。空开可以用来打开或关闭安全门，建议在发现时将它们全部打开，即开关指向左侧，以便每个人都能更好地探索内部设施。

打开空开时，它会发出低沉的机械嗡嗡声，以提醒玩家它的位置。

<span id="Fan"></span>
=== 风扇 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
截至**50版本**，工厂正门上方的大型风扇不再只是装饰。玩家若借助[[jetpack|喷气背包]]或[[Tulip Snake|郁金香蛇]]飞到风扇位置，会被高速旋转的扇叶瞬间击杀。
</div>

<span id="Steam_leaks"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
==== 蒸汽泄漏 ====
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
蒸汽泄漏只存在于工厂的走廊结构中，会使玩家的视野变得模糊，效果类似[[Weather/zh-cn#大雾|大雾]]天气。要阻止泄漏，玩家只能在蒸汽中寻找泄漏点并关闭位于其附近的阀门，蒸汽才会消散。在蒸汽中贴紧墙壁并仔细观察，同时不断调整视角方向可增加能见度，从而更容易找到阀门。正手持占用双手[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]的玩家不能关闭阀门。
</div>

<span id="Traps"></span>
=== 陷阱 ===

{{main|Traps}}

陷阱是室内出现的人为危险设施，均会对船员的生命安全造成极大威胁。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Indoor fog ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 2% chance every day (or 20% for [[Mechanics#Entity_Infestations|infestation days]]) for the interior to be shrouded in thick fog. Unlike steam leaks, this fog will persist through the entire day and cannot be removed.
</div>

######## Jester
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Template:Direct Quote}}
{{Infobox entity

}}<translate>
<!--T:14-->
The '''Jester''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. Initially, it passively searches for and follows a nearby employee before it randomly stops in place and starts cranking. This causes it to play a tune that becomes increasingly more frantic before it transforms into an extremely aggressive threat that hunts down every remaining employee left in the facility. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

<!--T:15-->
Jesters resemble large [[w:Jack-in-the-box|jack-in-the-boxes]] with pale, doll-like limbs, consisting of a pair of legs and and a single left arm, above which is a thin crank. The box has a purple lining and a pink checkerboard pattern with red outlines. Each side of the box is decorated with a large yellow circle and a faint image of a baby embossed onto its center, with its face scratched out. The "jack" inside the Jester appears to be a large human skull attached to the inside of the box by a large neck made of flesh, veins, and muscle.

== Bestiary entry == <!--T:16-->
</translate>
{{quote bestiary}}
<translate>

<!--T:34-->
== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== Mechanics == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:3-->
The Jester has four possible states: roaming, following, cranking, and chasing.

=== Roaming === <!--T:18-->

<!--T:4-->
Upon spawning, the Jester will roam and wander aimlessly, simultaneously initiating a random timer varying from 13 to 21 seconds (25 to 42 seconds in singleplayer), determining the duration before it switches to its cranking state.

=== Following === <!--T:19-->

<!--T:5-->
The Jester will roam until it detects an employee in its line of sight, where it will then continuously follow them unless a different employee is closer. While following, the Jester decreases its cranking timer by 1 every second, decreasing 15 times faster while stunned.

=== Cranking === <!--T:20-->

<!--T:6-->
Once the timer reaches 0, the Jester begins to crank its box while playing a distorted rendition of [[w:Pop_Goes_the_Weasel|Pop Goes the Weasel]] for a randomly specified amount time, varying from 35 to 40 seconds. The song will get faster and faster as the Jester gets closer to popping, though it will stop (for a moment) if stunned. If it is stunned while in the roaming or following state, it begins cranking after being stunned. While cranking, the Jester cannot move.

=== Chasing === <!--T:21-->

<!--T:7-->
Once the timer reaches 0, the Jester will pop and proceed to rush towards the closest employee, killing them upon contact. The Jester will gain speed while it is chasing someone, with its current speed being reset every time it kills an employee. It is able to detect employees regardless of range or line of sight, quickly narrowing the distance to them, and it persists in this "angered" state as long as any employee remains inside. When there are no living employees left in the building, it returns to its roaming state.

== Strategy == <!--T:22-->

<!--T:10-->
Employees should establish an escape route out of the building when a Jester is discovered, and follow this route as soon as it enters its cranking state. Employees can safely re-enter the building once 5 seconds have passed after the last living employee is removed from the building, as the Jester will have reverted to its roaming state.

<!--T:32-->
Due to Jesters' target selection, an employee standing on top of Mansions' main entrance doors will be targeted last by the Jester during its chase state. If the Jester makes its way towards an employee standing on top of these doors, it means there are no other employees in the building. This employee should then exit and inform the remaining crew, and the building can again be entered after the 5-second timer expires.

<!--T:11-->
Employees should go to great lengths to prevent the Jester from entering its cranking state while it is standing inside important doorways, as it will completely block passage until it begins chasing. If a following Jester is obstructing a doorway, the employee with its attention should drag it away and loop back around to safely escape. If it is already cranking and the doorway has a door, opening and closing the door might push it, too.

<!--T:23-->
It is possible to stand on top of a Jester's box while it is not chasing, and this will keep employees out of range of most other creatures. However, the Jester is able to crank as usual, and it will instantly kill any employee standing on its box when it pops.

<!--T:12-->
Using a [[Zap gun]] on the Jester while it is cranking will result in it being temporarily paused, buying other employees more time to make an escape. In addition, any sort of stun will remove all momentum that a chasing Jester has obtained, making equipment like the [[Radar-booster]] invaluable as it can completely stunlock the Jester with good timing.

<!--T:24-->
Standing on top of a bookshelf or other high place that must be jumped to will break the Jester's pathfinding. It cannot jump or climb, and will choose other targets in the building. If the only living employees in the building were out of reach and another employee enters the building, the Jester will attack this new target first. 

<!--T:25-->
Employees can easily trap the Jester if the crew is in the Facility and a Secure Door is available. One employee can lure the Jester into a dead end with a Secure Door and stand on the outside of the hallway, while another employee at the ship closes the Secure Door, trapping the Jester. This is rather effective since there can only be one Jester per day. However, the Jester will not revert from its chasing state even when trapped in this way so long as living employees remain in the building, so actions such as unplugging the Apparatus should be taken with care; the resulting power outage will open the Secure Door and release the chasing Jester.

<!--T:33-->
The Jesters speed is based on how far away the an employee is. So if you were walking while the jester's behind you, it will be in walking speed as the employee.
</translate>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Spielmechaniken ==

Der Narr hat vier mögliche Zustände: Wandeln, Folgen, Aufziehen und Jagen.

<span id="Roaming"></span>
=== Wandeln ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Wenn der Narr auftaucht, startet er in einem Zustand, in dem er nur ziellos durch das Gebäude wandelt. Zeitgleich erstellt er einen Timer mit zufälliger Länge zwischen 25 und 42 Sekunden, welcher später die Zeit vor dem Aufziehen bestimmt.
</div>

<span id="Following"></span>
=== Folgen ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der Narr wandelt so lange durch das Gebäude, bis er einen Mitarbeiter in seinem Sichtfeld erkennt. Dann wechselt er in einen Zustand, in dem er dem Spieler dauernd folgt, außer ein anderer Spieler kommt ihm näher. In diesem Zustand beginnt schließlich der Timer abzulaufen. Während der Narr betäubt ist, läuft der Timer 15 mal schneller ab.
</div>

<span id="Cranking"></span>
=== Aufziehen ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Erreicht der Timer 0, bleibt der Narr stehen und fängt an, seine Box für eine wiederum zufällige Zeit zwischen 35 und 40 Sekunden aufzuziehen.
</div>

<span id="Chasing"></span>
=== Jagen ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Sobald der Timer abgelaufen ist, verfolgt der Narr den nächsten Mitarbeiter ungeachtet der Distanz zu diesem oder ob er diesen sehen kann. Seine Jagd endet erst, wenn alle Spieler tot sind oder das Gebäude für mindestens 5 Sekunden verlassen, woraufhin er zurück in den Wandel-Zustand geht.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Mitarbeiter können einen Weg aus dem Gebäude festlegen, auf dem sie sofort fliehen sollten, sobald der Narr in die Aufzieh- oder Jagdphase übergeht. Nach 5 Sekunden können die Mitarbeiter sicher wieder in das Gebäude gehen.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to Jesters' target selection, an employee standing on top of Mansions' main entrance doors will be targeted last by the Jester during its chase state. If the Jester makes its way towards an employee standing on top of these doors, it means there are no other employees in the building. This employee should then exit and inform the remaining crew, and the building can again be entered after the 5-second timer expires.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Mitarbeiter sollten den Narr nicht in einem wichtigen Durchgang in den Aufziehzustand wechseln lassen, da er dort stehen bleibt und so den Weg blockiert.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Mitarbeiter können sich auf die Box eines Narren stellen und sind dort außerhalb der Reichweite anderer Kreaturen sicher vor Gefahren. Allerdings wird der Narr Mitarbeiter auf seiner Box sofort töten, sobald er seine Box aufgezogen hat.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Den Narr mit einer [[Zap gun|Betäubungspistole]] zu betäuben, während er seine Kiste aufzieht, pausiert seinen zweiten Timer kurz und gibt den Mitarbeitern etwas mehr Zeit zu fliehen.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Standing on top of a bookshelf or other high place that must be jumped to will break the Jester's pathfinding. It cannot jump or climb, and will choose other targets in the building. If the only living employees in the building were out of reach and another employee enters the building, the Jester will attack this new target first.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

However, the Jester will not revert from its chasing state even when trapped in this way so long as living employees remain in the building, so actions such as unplugging the Apparatus should be taken with care; the resulting power outage will open the Secure Door and release the chasing Jester.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Jesters speed is based on how far away the an employee is. So if you were walking while the jester's behind you, it will be in walking speed as the employee.
