== Reception == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
''Lethal Company'' was published through Steam's Early Access (public beta) program on the 23<sup>rd</sup> of October, 2023.
<br>The game was a surprise hit:<ref>
<tvar name="link-1">[https://www.pcgamer.com/co-op-horror-game-lethal-company-costs-dollar10-and-is-outselling-call-of-duty-on-steam/ Co-op horror game Lethal Company costs $10 and is outselling Call of Duty on Steam]</tvar>, Rick Lane writing for ''PC Gamer''
</ref><ref>
<tvar name="link-2">[https://www.polygon.com/24040561/lethal-company-roblox-popularity-explained Lethal Company was bound to blow up — and now it’s everywhere on social media]</tvar>, Ana Diaz writing for ''Polygon''
</ref>
In its first 3 months of Early Access, player reviews were 98% positive, and it reached a peak of 240k daily<!-- I think that's what the datum is? --> players.<ref name="steamdb-charts">
[<tvar name="url-1">https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/charts/</tvar> SteamDB] (some data hidden to non-logged-in users)
</ref>
<br>After 12 months, about 13M people had bought the game, and the daily player count had consistently been around 25k.<ref name="steamdb-charts" />

<!--T:17-->
Critics and players commonly praise the game's social and comedic elements,<ref>
<tvar name="link-3">[https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/i-respect-lethal-companys-dedication-to-being-a-slapstick-fest-that-makes-zero-sense-whatsoever I respect Lethal Company's dedication to being a slapstick-fest that makes zero sense whatsoever]</tvar>, Alice Bell writing for ''Rock Paper Shotgun''
</ref> which are unorthodox for the horror genre.

<!--T:18-->
The game has attracted a good number of speedrunners on [<tvar name="url-2">https://www.speedrun.com/Lethal_Company</tvar> SRC]
as well as the independent leaderboard [<tvar name="url-3">https://highquotahq.com</tvar> HQHQ].

<!--T:19-->

######## Lethal Company/en

'''''Lethal Company''''' is the subject of this wiki. It's an indie co-op {{native Wikipedia link|en=roguelike}} with horror themes.
<br>As of November 2024, the game has been in Steam's Early Access program for a year,
and its creator, [[Zeekerss]], has put development on hold to focus on {{GENDER:Zeekerss|his|her|their}} other projects.

== Gameplay ==
{{main|Category:Gameplay mechanics}}
{{see also|Tips and Tricks}}
Players are tasked with traveling between deserted moons, scavenging [[scrap]] items from procedurally-generated [[interiors]], and delivering them to the [[the Company]].
The crux of gameplay is surviving the various [[Entities|mobile]] and [[Traps|immobile]] threats on each moon so that scrap can be exfiltrated.
<br>The random elements mean that players have imperfect information and communication is vital, with the game's {{native Wikipedia link|en=Proximity_chat|label=proximity voice chat}}<sup>[<!-- enwiki is a -->stub]</sup> being augmented by unlockable equipment.

After choosing which [[moon]] to land on, players arrive at 8 a.m. and have until midnight to complete the day's work (16 in-game hours lasting 11:30 real-time).
Their job is made harder by their characters' limited carrying capacity and the fact that monsters spawn inside and outside during the course of the day.
Because of this, new players are advised to rush in the morning and leave once it gets dark.
<br>It's also advisable to avoid [[weather]]: moon modifiers which last all day and generally increase the moon's danger without affecting the scrap yield.

The roguelike element is that players have 3 days to gather enough scrap to reach a [[quota]] set by the Company.
If they fail, they get a game over in the form of being "fired", and the game automatically restarts, resetting all progress.<ref group="note">
The list of collected lore fragments and a few other variables are persisted across runs, and can be cleared manually from the main menu.
</ref>
But if they succeed, then a new, higher quota is set for the next 3 days, and the crew is compensated with [[credits]] matching the value of delivered scrap.
These can then be exchanged for [[Store#Equipment|equipment]] and [[Store#Ship_decoration|cosmetics]] via the Company store.
<br>There is a "soft checkpoint" after each day, where any players who didn't return to the [[ship]] alive get reincarnated.
However, if the whole crew dies, all scrap items are deleted from the ship first.

Lethal Company was obviously designed around the multiplayer experience.
While crews can consist of 1&ndash;4 players (without mods), very little in the game adapts to the crew size,<ref group="note">
[[Butler]]s&mdash;an enemy designed around isolating employees from each other&mdash;would have been too unfair for solo, so their health is reduced.
Likewise, [[Cadaver Growth]]s have their mechanics reworked for solo.
[[Snare Flea]]s were also balanced for solo, letting go upon reducing you to critical health.
But apart from not having to spread credits/equipment across multiple players, and never confusing a [[Masked]] for a teammate, no other mechanics favour solo players.
</ref> so having 3 players gives an advantage over 2 and so on.
Singleplayer a.k.a. 'solo' is by far the hardest, with runs often ended by a single mistake.
Solo players also don't have the luxury of getting live feedback from [[Ship#Main_monitor|the ship's radar]].

As a horror game, it's of course able to draw on established tropes like [[Masked|doppelgängers]] and [[Coil-head|'Weeping Angels']],
but it has plenty horrors of its own too, such as the pack-hunting [[Baboon hawk]]s, or the imposing [[Barber]], heard and not seen until it's too late.
The prox. chat feature can contribute to the horror as well as comedy:
Hearing a [[Walkie-talkie|walkie]] transmission cut off mid-sentence could be the funniest thing if you were watching the [[Bracken]] sneak up behind your clueless teammate,
or it could leave you with a sense of dread if they were behind you mere moments earlier.<!-- this prox chat bit feels like what Wikipedians call 'original research', but it's clearly true and deserves a mention somewhere —YoshiRulz -->

== Reception ==

''Lethal Company'' was published through Steam's Early Access (public beta) program on the 23<sup>rd</sup> of October, 2023.
<br>The game was a surprise hit:<ref>
[https://www.pcgamer.com/co-op-horror-game-lethal-company-costs-dollar10-and-is-outselling-call-of-duty-on-steam/ Co-op horror game Lethal Company costs $10 and is outselling Call of Duty on Steam], Rick Lane writing for ''PC Gamer''
</ref><ref>
[https://www.polygon.com/24040561/lethal-company-roblox-popularity-explained Lethal Company was bound to blow up — and now it’s everywhere on social media], Ana Diaz writing for ''Polygon''
</ref>
In its first 3 months of Early Access, player reviews were 98% positive, and it reached a peak of 240k daily<!-- I think that's what the datum is? --> players.<ref name="steamdb-charts">
[https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/charts/ SteamDB] (some data hidden to non-logged-in users)
</ref>
<br>After 12 months, about 13M people had bought the game, and the daily player count had consistently been around 25k.<ref name="steamdb-charts" />

Critics and players commonly praise the game's social and comedic elements,<ref>
[https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/i-respect-lethal-companys-dedication-to-being-a-slapstick-fest-that-makes-zero-sense-whatsoever I respect Lethal Company's dedication to being a slapstick-fest that makes zero sense whatsoever], Alice Bell writing for ''Rock Paper Shotgun''

as well as the independent leaderboard [https://highquotahq.com HQHQ].

######## Lethal Company/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
'''''Lethal Company''''' é o assunto dessa wiki. É um jogo indie, co-op e [[w:pt:Roguelike|roguelike]] com temas de terror.
<br>Desde novembro de 2024, o jogo esteve no programa de Acesso Antecipado da Steam por um ano,
e seu criador, [[Zeekerss/pt-br|Zeekerss]], pausou seu desenvolvimento para focar em seus outros projetos.

== Gameplay ==
{{main|Category:Gameplay mechanics}}
{{see also|Tips and Tricks}}
Jogadores devem viajar entre luas abandonadas, recolhendo itens de [[scrap/pt-br|sucata]] de [[interiors/pt-br|interiores]] gerados processualmente e entregá-los para [[the Company/pt-br|a Companhia]]
O foco da gameplay é sobreviver as várias ameaças [[entities/pt-br|móveis]] e [[traps/pt-br|imóveis]] em cada lua para que a sucata seja resgatada.
<br>Os elementos aleatórios fazem com que jogadores tenham informação imperfeita e a comunicação é vital, com o [[w:Proximity_chat|chat de voz por proximidade]]<sup>[stub]</sup> ser melhorado com equipamento que pode ser desbloqueado.

Depois de escolher qual [[moons/pt-br|lua]] pousar, jogadores chegam às 8 da manhã (am) e têm até a meia-noite para completarem o dia de trabalho (16 horas no jogo que duram 11 min e 30 s em tempo real). Seu trabalho é dificultado pela capacidade de carga limitada de seus personagens e o fato de que monstros são gerados no interior e exterior ao longo do dia.
Por causa disso, jogadores iniciantes são aconselhados para se apressarem na manhã e saírem quando ficar escuro.
<br>Também é aconselhável desviar das [[weather/pt-br|condições climáticas]]: modificadores da lua que duram o dia todo e geralmente aumentam a dificuldade da lua sem alterar a quantidade de sucata.

O elemento roguelike é que jogadores têm 3 dias para reunir sucata o suficiente para alcançar uma [[quota/pr-br|meta]] proposta pela Companhia.
Se falharem, recebem um game over na forma de serem "demitides" e o jogo automaticamente se reinicia, recomeçando todo o progresso.<ref group="note">
A lista de fragmentos da história e algumas outras variáveis são mantidas entre as sessões e podem ser limpas manualmente no menu principal.
</ref>
Mas se alcançarem-na, uma nova e mais alta meta será colocada para os próximos 3 dias e a tripulação e compensada com [[credits/pt-br|créditos]] com o mesmo valor da sucata entregada. Esses podem ser trocados por [[Store/pt-br#Equipamento|equipamento]] e [[Store/pt-br#Decoração da nave|cosméticos]] via a loja da Companhia.
<br>Tem um checkpoint após cada dia, onde jogadores que não retornaram a [[ship/pt-br|nave]] com vida são reincarnades.
Porém, se toda a tripulação morrer, todos os itens de sucata são deletados da nave antes.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Lethal Company foi obviamente feito ao redor da experiencia multiplayer. Enquanto as tripulações podem ter de 1&ndash;4 jogadores (sem modificações), poucas coisas no jogo se adapta a tamanhos diferentes da tripulção,<ref group="note">
[[Butler/pt-br|Mordomos]]s&mdash;um inimigo feito para isolar jogadores entre si&mdash;seria injusto demais ao jogar singleplayer, então sua vida foi reduzida.
[[Snare Flea/pt-br|Pulgas Traiçoeiras]] também foram equilibradas para o singleplayer, te soltando ao reduzir sua vida à condição crítica.
Mas além de não ter que dividir os créditos/equipamento entre vários jogadores e nunca confundir ume [[Masked/pt-br|mascarade]] por ume colega, nenhuma outra mecânica favorece jogadores singleplayer.
</ref> então 3 jogadores têm vantagem sobre 2 e por aí.
Singleplayer é de longe o modo mais difícil, com sessões geralmente terminadas por um único erro.
Jogadores singleplayer não têm o luxo de receberem feedback ao vivo do [[Ship/pt-br#Monitor principal|radar da nave]].
</div>

Já que é um jogo de terror, é claro que é capaz de utilizar temas já estabelecidos como os [[Masked/pt-br|doppelgängers]] e [[Coil-head/pt-br|''Weeping Angels'']], mas ele também tem vários terrores próprios, como os [[Baboon Hawk/pt-br|Gaviões Babuínos]] que caçam em grupos, ou o [[Barber/pt-br|Barbeiro]] ameaçador, ouvido, mas não visto até que seja tarde demais.
O chat de voz por proximidade também pode contribuir para o terror e a comédia:
Ouvir uma transmissão por [[Walkie-talkie/pt-br|Walkie-talkie]] ser cortada poderia ser a coisa mais engraçada se você estiver vendo um [[Bracken/pt-br|Bracken]] se esgueirar atrás de seu colega sem nem saber,
ou pode te deixar com um senso de medo caso elu estava atrás de você a meros momentos.

<span id="Plot"></span>
== História ==
{{main|Lore}}
O jogo começa ''in medias res''&mdash;a tripulação foi contratada pela [[the Company/pt-br|Companhia]] e é o seu primeiro dia como catadores.
Enquanto a Companhia está sempre presente, é apenas por nome e a única comunicação "oficial" que ês funcionáries têm é por meio de mensagens pré-gravadas na [[ship/pt-br|nave]] e na prédio da Companhia.
Parece que a tripulação está sozinha no espaço e os sistemas automatizados estão explorando seu trabalho até que a meta fique alta demais e ela seja "demitida".
<br>Além de um pouco de história contada pelo ambiente e algumas ''cutscenes'' misteriosas, o resto da história do jogo e contada por meio de [[Data_chip/pt-br|fragmentos da história colecionáveis]] e pelo [[bestiary/pt-br|bestiário]], porém, isso pode mudar.

== Desenvolvimento ==
{{see also|Version history|Cut Content}}

O jogo é construído no motor da Unity 2022.
Ele utiliza a High Definition Render Pipeline da Unity, mas com um tamanho de tela de 860x520 para aumentar a performance.{{cite YouTube|video-id=Z_-am00EXIc|title=The Strange Graphics Of LETHAL COMPANY|creator=Acerola|start-timestamp=4:42}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
O único desenvolvedor [[Zeekers]] esteve documentando o processo de desenvolvimento em seu [https://www.patreon.com/zeekerss Patreon].
</div><br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Games which inspired ''Lethal Company'' include [https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/ ''Phasmophobia''] and [https://store.steampowered.com/app/63610/Riven_1997/ ''Riven''].<ref group="note"><q>
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/ ''Phasmophobia'' (2020)] for its use of proximity voice chat.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302240/Labyrinthine/ ''Labyrinthine'' (2023)] for its awesome second chapter that would dramatically separate us with walls of vines and force us to explore alone.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/63610/Riven_1997/ ''Riven'' (1997/2024)] for its industrial environments and atmosphere.
I think [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com ''SCP'' (ongoing)] was an early inspiration for its themes of corporate secrecy and the idea of a modern take on a bestiary of mythical creatures.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/753640/Outer_Wilds/ ''Outer Wilds'' (2020)] was another inspiration for sure, but it's hard to say exactly how.
</q></ref>{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=5:10}}
</div>

Já que ainda não foi terminado, o jogo possui um bom número de [[Known_bugs/pt-br|bugs]].

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
[[Zeekerss]] has said that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he's|she's|they're}} not sure how many content updates there will be after the game leaves Early Access, but that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he'll|she'll|they'll}} likely make some.{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=2:02}}
</div><br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A port of the game to consoles is '''not''' planned to be among these updates.{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=2:33}}
</div>

<span id="Reception"></span>
== Recepção ==

''Lethal Company'' foi publicado pelo programa de Acesso Antecipado da Steam (beta público) no dia 23 de outubro de 2023.
<br>O jogo foi um sucesso surpresa:<ref>
[https://www.pcgamer.com/co-op-horror-game-lethal-company-costs-dollar10-and-is-outselling-call-of-duty-on-steam/ Co-op horror game Lethal Company costs $10 and is outselling Call of Duty on Steam], Rick Lane writing for ''PC Gamer''
</ref><ref>
[https://www.polygon.com/24040561/lethal-company-roblox-popularity-explained Lethal Company was bound to blow up — and now it’s everywhere on social media], Ana Diaz writing for ''Polygon''
</ref>
Em seus primeiros 3 meses de Acesso Antecipado, análises dos jogadores estavam em 98% positivas e alcançou uma alta de 240 mil jogadores diáries.<ref name="steamdb-charts">
[https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/charts/ SteamDB] (alguns dados são escondidos para usuáries não logades)
</ref>
<br>Depois de 12 meses, por volta de 13 milhões de pessoas compraram o jogo e a contagem de jogadores diáries ficou consistentemente por volta de 25 mil.<ref name="steamdb-charts" />

Críticos e jogadores comumente elogiam os elementos sociais e cômicos do jogo,<ref>
[https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/i-respect-lethal-companys-dedication-to-being-a-slapstick-fest-that-makes-zero-sense-whatsoever I respect Lethal Company's dedication to being a slapstick-fest that makes zero sense whatsoever], Alice Bell writing for ''Rock Paper Shotgun''
</ref> o que é incomum o gênero de terror.

O jogo atraiu um bom número de ''speedrunners'' em [https://www.speedrun.com/Lethal_Company SRC] e também na tabela de lideranças independente [https://highquotahq.com HQHQ].

Um grupo de [[Crossovers/pt-br#Fortnite|Cosméticos baseados em ''Lethal Company'']] foram adicionados ao ''Fortnite'' da Epic Games em junho de 2024

== Notas e referências ==

######## Lethal Company/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
'''''Lethal Company''''' - тема данной вики. Это инди ко-оп [https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roguelike рогалик] с элементами хоррора.
<br>На Ноябрь 2024 игра была в программе Раннего Доступа Steam год, и её создатель, [[Zeekerss/ru|Zeekerss]], приостановил разработку, чтобы сконцентрироваться на других его проектах.

<span id="Gameplay"></span>
== Геймплей ==
{{main|Category:Gameplay mechanics}}
{{see also|Tips and Tricks}}
Перед игроками поставлена задача по путешествию между пустеющими лунами, сбору [[scrap|лома]] из процедурно-генерируемых [[interiors/ru|интерьеров]] и его доставке [[the Company|Компании]]. Мешать игрокам в выживании и выполнении задач будут разные [[Entities/ru|подвижные]] и [[Traps/ru|неподвижные]] угрозы на каждой луне.
<br>Наличие элементов рандома означает, что у игроков нет надёжной информации и важно коммуницирование между ними, с системой [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proximity_chat Трёхмерных аудиоэффектов]<!-- термин упоминается в статье игры на русской Википедии, тем не менее по этой теме нет собственной статьи на русском, а термин "бесконтактный чат" считаю недостаточно исчерпывающим --><sup>[<!-- enwiki is a -->stub]</sup>, вызывающей решаемые открывающимся снаряжением затруднения в коммуникации.

После выбора [[Moons/ru|луны]] для посадки, игроки прибывают на поверхность в 8 утра игрового времени и должны до полночи завершить дневные задачи (до полночи 16 внутриигровых часов, что примерно занимает 11,5 минут реального времени).
Работа усложняется ограниченным инвентарём персонажей и тем, что внутри и снаружи здания в течение дня появляются монстры.
Из-за этого новым игрокам рекомендуется сразу идти внутрь и покидать луну, как только начинает смеркаться.
<br>Также рекомендуется избегать [[Weather/ru|погодных условий]]: модификаторов лун, которые длятся весь игровой день и в целом ухудшают опасность лун, не предлагаю никакого бонуса взамен.

Элемент рогалика заключается в том, что у игроков есть 3 дня на то, чтобы собрать достаточно лома для достижения [[quota|квоты]] Компании.
Если игроки провалили эту задачу, их "увольняют" и игра начинается сначала, сбрасывая весь прогресс.<ref group="note">
Список собранных фрагментов предыстории и некоторые другие игровые переменные сохраняются между забегами и могут быть сброшены в главном меню.
</ref>
Если же игроки выполняют поставленную задачу, они должны будут достигнуть новой, более высокой квоты за следующие 3 дня, и экипаж получает компенсацию [[credits|кредитами]] согласно ценности сданного лома.
Эти кредиты можно обменять на [[Store/ru#Снаряжение|снаряжение]] и [[Store/ru#Декор_корабля|косметику]] через магазин Компании.
<br>Конец каждого дня является "мягкой контрольной точкой", при достижении которой игроки, не вернувшиеся на [[ship/ru|корабль]] живыми реинкарнируют.
Тем не менее, если экипаж погибает целиком, с корабля сначала пропадает весь собранный до этого лом.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Lethal Company очевидно была сделана, основываясь на многопользовательском аспекте.
Хотя экипаж может составлять 1&ndash;4 игрока (без модов), очень немногое в игре адаптируется к размеру экипажа,<ref group="note"> [[Butler/ru|Дворецкий]] &mdash; противник, сделанный, чтобы обыграть случаи разделения игроков &mdash; был бы слишком несправедлив по отношению к игрокам-одиночкам, потому в одиночной игре у него снижено здоровье.
[[Snare Flea/ru|Потолочные Блохи]] также были сбалансированы для одиночной игры, при игре в которой они единожды отпускают жертву, когда та достигает критического здоровья от её захвата.
Но за исключением отпадания нужды разделять кредиты и снаряжение между несколькими игроками и думать дважды, является ли гуманоидный силуэт [[Masked/ru|Одержимым]] или союзником, других механик для игроков-одиночек не предусмотрено.
</ref> так что экипаж в 3 человека будет сильнее экипажа из 2-х и так далее. Одиночная игра, т.и.к. 'соло' - однозначно самая сложная, в которой забеги прерываются из-за одной ошибки.
Также одинокие игроки не обладают роскошью своевременного получения информации с [[Ship/ru#Основной_монитор|радара корабля]].
</div>

Как хоррор игра, Lethal Company также может черпать вдохновения из устоявшихся тропов, таких, как [[Masked/ru|двойники]] и [[Coil-head/ru|'Плачущие Ангелы']],
но также обладает и своими страшилками, такими как [[Baboon Hawk/ru|Бабуиновые Ястребы]], ведущими групповую охоту, или внушительный [[Barber/ru|Барбер]], которого слышно, но не видно, пока не станет слишком поздно.
Особенность в виде трёхмерных аудиоэффектов дополняет элемент как хоррора, так и комедии:
Звук прерывания передачи через [[Walkie-talkie|рацию]] посреди предложения может быть как самым весёлым моментом, если вы следили по камере за тем, как говорящего товарища утащил подкравшийся к ним сзади [[Bracken/ru|Орляк]], так и вызывать ужас если говорящий был прямо у вас за спиной секундой ранее.

<span id="Plot"></span>
== Сюжет ==
{{main|Lore}}
Игра начинается ''in medias res'' &mdash; экипаж был нанят [[the Company|Компанией]] и начинает первый рабочий день в роли мусорщиков.
Хотя Компания вездесуща, в основном она проявляется лишь в упоминаниях, и единственное "официальное" общение с ней происходит через предзаписанные речи и фразы, проигрывающиеся через динамики [[ship/ru|корабля]] и у здания Компании.
По всей видимости экипаж одинок в космосе, а автоматизированные системы выжимают из него лом до тех пор, пока квота не вырастает до недостижимых значений и тот не будет всем составом "уволен".
<br>Помимо малого количества информации, передаваемой через окружение и пары загадочных катсцен,
вся остальная история игры рассказывается через [[Sigurd_Logs/ru|находимые кусочки истории]] и [[bestiary|бестиарий]], хотя конечно в будущем это может поменяться.

== Разработка ==
{{see also|Version history|Cut Content}}

Игра сделана на движке Unity 2022.
Она использует HDPR (High Definition Render Pipeline) Unity, но с холстом размера всего лишь 860x520 для компенсации производительности.{{cite YouTube|video-id=Z_-am00EXIc|title=The Strange Graphics Of LETHAL COMPANY|creator=Acerola|start-timestamp=4:42}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Соло-разработчик [[Zeekerss/ru|Zeekerss]] документировал свой процесс разработки на [https://www.patreon.com/zeekerss Patreon].
<br>Lethal Company начинала, как совершенно другой проект; изначально планировалось сделать весь геймплей внутри здания, где игроки продвигались к новым заводам с помощью лифта.
Согласно самому раннему доступному посту об игре, она впервые была показана на Patreon в Мае 26 2022, хотя сама разработка по-видимому началась гораздо ранее.
</div><br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Games which inspired ''Lethal Company'' include [https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/ ''Phasmophobia''] and [https://store.steampowered.com/app/63610/Riven_1997/ ''Riven''].<ref group="note"><q>
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/ ''Phasmophobia'' (2020)] for its use of proximity voice chat.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302240/Labyrinthine/ ''Labyrinthine'' (2023)] for its awesome second chapter that would dramatically separate us with walls of vines and force us to explore alone.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/63610/Riven_1997/ ''Riven'' (1997/2024)] for its industrial environments and atmosphere.
I think [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com ''SCP'' (ongoing)] was an early inspiration for its themes of corporate secrecy and the idea of a modern take on a bestiary of mythical creatures.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/753640/Outer_Wilds/ ''Outer Wilds'' (2020)] was another inspiration for sure, but it's hard to say exactly how.
</q></ref>{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=5:10}}
</div>

В следствии того, что игра ещё не завершена, в ней закономерно имеются и [[Known_bugs|баги]].

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
[[Zeekerss]] has said that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he's|she's|they're}} not sure how many content updates there will be after the game leaves Early Access, but that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he'll|she'll|they'll}} likely make some.{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=2:02}}
</div><br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A port of the game to consoles is '''not''' planned to be among these updates.{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=2:33}}
</div>

<span id="Reception"></span>
== Принятие публикой ==

''Lethal Company'' была опубликована через программу Раннего Доступа Steam (публичная бета) 23 октября 2023.
<br>Игра оказалась неожиданным успехом:<ref>
[https://www.pcgamer.com/co-op-horror-game-lethal-company-costs-dollar10-and-is-outselling-call-of-duty-on-steam/ Co-op horror game Lethal Company costs $10 and is outselling Call of Duty on Steam], статья Рика Лэйна для ''PC Gamer''
</ref><ref>
[https://www.polygon.com/24040561/lethal-company-roblox-popularity-explained Lethal Company was bound to blow up — and now it’s everywhere on social media], статья Анны Диаз для ''Polygon''
</ref>
За первые 3 месяца раннего доступа, игра достигла 98% позитивных отзывов игроков и 240 тыс. ежедневных игроков.<ref name="steamdb-charts">
[https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/charts/ SteamDB] (некоторая информация скрыта от тех, кто не вошёл в аккаунт)
</ref>
<br>Спустя 12 месяцев около 13 миллионов игроков купило игры, а ежедневное количество игроков стабильно удерживалось около 25 тысяч.<ref name="steamdb-charts" />

Критики и игроки одинаково хвалят социальные и комедийные элементы игры,<ref>
[https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/i-respect-lethal-companys-dedication-to-being-a-slapstick-fest-that-makes-zero-sense-whatsoever I respect Lethal Company's dedication to being a slapstick-fest that makes zero sense whatsoever], статья Элис Белл для ''Rock Paper Shotgun''
</ref> обычно чуждые для хоррор игр.

Игра привлекла немалое количество спидранеров на [https://www.speedrun.com/Lethal_Company SRC]
а также собственную независимую таблицу рекордов [https://highquotahq.com HQHQ].

Группа [[Crossovers#Fortnite| косметики в стиле ''Lethal Company'']] была добавлена в ''Fortnite'' от Epic Games в Июне 2024.

######## Lethal Company/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
'''''致命公司'''''是本维基的主题。这是一款带有恐怖题材的独立合作类[[w:Roguelike|类Roguelike]]游戏。
<br>截至2024年11月，该游戏已在Steam抢先体验阶段上线一年，
其开发者[[Zeekerss]]已暂停开发工作，转而专注于{{GENDER:Zeekerss|他|她|他们}}的其他项目。

<span id="Gameplay"></span>
== 玩法 ==
{{main|Category:Gameplay mechanics}}
{{see also|Tips and Tricks}}
玩家的任务是在荒芜的卫星之间穿梭，从程序生成的[[interiors|内部设施]]中搜集[[scrap|废料]]，并将其上交至[[the Company|公司大楼]]。
游戏的核心玩法在于在各个卫星上的各类[[Entities|实体]]与[[Traps|陷阱]]威胁中存活下来，以便成功撤离并带走废料。
<br>游戏中的随机元素意味着玩家无法掌握完整信息，因此沟通至关重要；游戏内置的[[w:Proximity_chat|近距离语音聊天]]功能还可通过可解锁装备得到强化。

在选定要登陆的[[moon|卫星]]后，玩家会在上午8点抵达，并必须在午夜前完成当日工作（游戏内16小时，现实时长11分30秒）。
角色有限的负重能力，以及白天期间怪物会在室内外不断生成，都让任务变得更加困难。
因此建议新手玩家在早上抓紧行动，天一黑就撤离。
同时也建议避开[[weather|天气]]：这类卫星全域效果会持续一整天，通常只会提升卫星的危险程度，而不会增加废料收益。

其类Roguelike元素在于：玩家有3天时间搜集足够的废料，以达到公司设定的[[quota|目标配额]]。
若未能完成，玩家将以“被解雇”的形式宣告游戏结束，游戏会自动重启并清空所有进度。
已收集的剧情碎片列表及少量其他数据会在各轮游戏间保留，玩家可在主菜单手动清除。
若成功完成配额，则会为接下来3天设定一个全新且更高的配额，小队也会根据上交废料的价值获得[[credits|信用点]]作为报酬。
这些信用点可在公司商店兑换[[Store#Equipment|装备]]与[[Store#Ship_decoration|装饰外观]]。
每天结束后会有一个“软检查点”，所有未能活着返回[[ship|飞船]]的玩家都将复活。
但如果整支小队全部阵亡，飞船上的所有废料将会被直接清空。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
《致命公司》的设计显然围绕多人联机体验展开。
小队人数可包含1–4名玩家（无模组情况下），但游戏内几乎没有机制会根据小队人数进行适配，
[[Butler|管家]]——一种以将员工彼此孤立为设计核心的敌人——对单人游玩过于不公平，因此其生命值被降低。
[[Snare Flea|缠绕蚤]]也为单人模式做了平衡，在将玩家血量打至濒死时会松开。
但除了无需将信用点/装备分给多名玩家，以及不会把[[Masked|覆面者]]误认成队友外，没有其他机制偏向单人玩家。
因此3人组队会比2人更有优势，以此类推。
单人游玩是目前难度最高的模式，往往一次失误就会导致整局结束。
单人玩家也无法享受来自[[Ship#Main_monitor|飞船雷达]]的实时信息支援。
</div>

作为一款恐怖游戏，它自然沿用了经典的恐怖套路，例如[[Masked|覆面者]]与[[Coil-head|弹簧头]]，
但同时也拥有许多原创的恐怖元素，比如群体狩猎的[[Baboon hawk|狒狒鹰]]，或是气势逼人的[[Barber|理发师]]——你只能听见它的声音，等看见时往往已来不及躲避。

近距离语音聊天功能既能营造恐怖氛围，也能制造喜剧效果：
如果你亲眼看见[[Bracken|蕨影]]悄悄摸到你毫无察觉的队友身后，那么听到[[Walkie-talkie|对讲机]]里的声音说到一半突然中断，可能会觉得十分滑稽；
但如果队友刚才还在你身后，下一秒通讯就突然切断，则会让你陷入深深的恐惧。
<!-- 这段关于近距离语音的描述有点像维基人所说的“原创研究”，但显然是真实体验，值得在某处提一下——YoshiRulz -->

<span id="Plot"></span>
== 剧情 ==
{{main|Lore}}
游戏从事件中途开始——小队已被[[the Company|公司]]雇佣，这是他们作为废料回收员的第一天。
公司虽无处不在，但大多只以一个名号存在，员工唯一能接触到的“官方”沟通，只有在[[ship|飞船]]和公司大楼里播放的预录消息。
小队仿佛孤身置身宇宙，而自动化系统在不断压榨他们搜集废料，直到配额高到无法完成，最终他们无可避免地被“解雇”。
除了少量环境叙事和几段隐晦的过场动画外，
游戏其余剧情均通过[[Data_chip|可收集的剧情碎片]]与[[bestiary|生物图鉴]]展开，当然这些内容后续仍可能变动。

== 开发历程 ==
{{参见|版本历史|删减内容}}

这款游戏使用Unity 2022引擎开发。
它采用了 Unity 的高清渲染管线（HDRP），但将画布尺寸设为 **860x520** 以优化性能。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
独立开发者[[Zeekerss]]一直在{{GENDER:Zeekerss|他的|她的|他们的}}[https://www.patreon.com/zeekerss Patreon]平台上记录开发过程。
《致命公司》最初的立项与成品截然不同；游戏原本计划全程在室内场景进行，玩家通过电梯前往新的工厂。
根据现存最早的相关游戏帖子，该项目首次在Patreon上公布预告的时间为{{#formatdate:2022-05-26|mdy}}，而实际开发工作似乎比这要早得多。
</div><br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Games which inspired ''Lethal Company'' include [https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/ ''Phasmophobia''] and [https://store.steampowered.com/app/63610/Riven_1997/ ''Riven''].<ref group="note"><q>
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/ ''Phasmophobia'' (2020)] for its use of proximity voice chat.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302240/Labyrinthine/ ''Labyrinthine'' (2023)] for its awesome second chapter that would dramatically separate us with walls of vines and force us to explore alone.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/63610/Riven_1997/ ''Riven'' (1997/2024)] for its industrial environments and atmosphere.
I think [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com ''SCP'' (ongoing)] was an early inspiration for its themes of corporate secrecy and the idea of a modern take on a bestiary of mythical creatures.
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/753640/Outer_Wilds/ ''Outer Wilds'' (2020)] was another inspiration for sure, but it's hard to say exactly how.
</q></ref>{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=5:10}}
</div>

由于游戏尚未完成，自然存在不少[[Known_bugs|已知bug]]。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
[[Zeekerss]] has said that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he's|she's|they're}} not sure how many content updates there will be after the game leaves Early Access, but that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he'll|she'll|they'll}} likely make some.{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=2:02}}
</div><br><div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A port of the game to consoles is '''not''' planned to be among these updates.{{cite YouTube|video-id=LtkX9v2ypVc|title=We Interviewed the Creator of Lethal Company|creator=Company Jig|start-timestamp=2:33}}
</div>

<span id="Reception"></span>
== 游戏评价 ==

《致命公司》于**2023年10月23日**通过Steam抢先体验（公开测试）计划发行。

这款游戏成为了一匹现象级黑马：<ref>
[https://www.pcgamer.com/co-op-horror-game-lethal-company-costs-dollar10-and-is-outselling-call-of-duty-on-steam/ Co-op horror game Lethal Company costs $10 and is outselling Call of Duty on Steam]，作者 Rick Lane，刊登于《PC Gamer》
</ref><ref>
[https://www.polygon.com/24040561/lethal-company-roblox-popularity-explained Lethal Company was bound to blow up — and now it’s everywhere on social media]，作者 Ana Diaz，刊登于《Polygon》
在抢先体验的前三个月内，玩家好评率高达98%，每日玩家峰值达到24万人。<ref name="steamdb-charts">
[https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/charts/ SteamDB]（部分数据对未登录用户隐藏）
上线12个月后，游戏销量已达约**1300万份**，每日玩家数量稳定在2.5万人左右。<ref name="steamdb-charts" />

评测媒体与玩家普遍称赞了游戏的社交与喜剧元素，[https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/i-respect-lethal-companys-dedication-to-being-a-slapstick-fest-that-makes-zero-sense-whatsoever I respect Lethal Company's dedication to being a slapstick-fest that makes zero sense whatsoever]，作者 Alice Bell，刊登于《Rock Paper Shotgun》
这些元素在恐怖游戏品类中显得十分另类。

这款游戏在 [https://www.speedrun.com/Lethal_Company SRC] 以及独立排行榜 [https://highquotahq.com HQHQ] 上吸引了大量速通玩家。

2024年6月，Epic Games旗下的《堡垒之夜》中加入了一组[[Crossovers#Fortnite|《致命公司》主题装饰外观]]。

== Overview == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:2-->
'''Lockpickers''' are tools used to gain access to locked doors. Upon placing one on a locked door, it remains there for 30 seconds before falling to the ground and unlocking the door. They are not consumed through use allowing them to be used repeatedly.

== Strategy == <!--T:5-->

<!--T:6-->
As lockpickers are not conductive, they are a viable alternative to [[key]]s while on [[moons]] subject to [[Weather#Stormy|stormy weather]].
</translate>

== Firemní popis ==

{{terminal|Paklíčovnici dovolují neomezený potenciál pro účinnost při práci. Poháněno AI softwarem, dostanou vás přes jakékoliv zamčené dveře.
}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

'''Paklíčocníci''' jsou nástroje použity k získání přístupu k uzamčených dveří. Jestli položen na zamčené dveře, zůstane tam na 30 sekund než spadne na zem a odemkne dveře. Nejsou zkonzumovaný přes použití což dovoluje opakované použití.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

Protože paklícovníci nejsou vodivý, jsou vhodná alternativa pro [[key|klíče]] když na [[moons/cs|měsících]] kteří mají [[Weather#Stormy|bouřlivé počasí]].

== Beschreibung der Firma ==

{{terminal|<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dietriche öffnen euer grenzenloses Effizienzpotenzial im Job. Von firmeneigener KI-Software angetrieben, bringen sie euch durch jedes Schloss.
</div>
}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

'''Dietriche''' sind Werkzeuge, die verschlossene Türen öffnen können. Setzt man einen auf ein Schloss, bleibt er für 30 Sekunden dort, bevor er auf den Boden fällt und das Schloss öffnet. Sie werden dabei nicht zerstört und können wiederverwendet werden.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

Da Dietriche nicht leitfähig sind, sind sie eine nützliche Alternative zu [[Key|Schlüsseln]] während einem [[Weather#Stormy/de|Gewitter]].

== Company description ==

{{terminal|Lock-pickers will unlock your limitless potential for efficiency on the job. Powered by proprietary AI software, they will get you access through any locked door.
}}

== Overview ==

'''Lockpickers''' are tools used to gain access to locked doors. Upon placing one on a locked door, it remains there for 30 seconds before falling to the ground and unlocking the door. They are not consumed through use allowing them to be used repeatedly.

== Strategy ==

As lockpickers are not conductive, they are a viable alternative to [[key]]s while on [[moons]] subject to [[Weather#Stormy|stormy weather]].

== Descripción de La Compañía ==

{{terminal|<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Las ganzúas abrirán un potencial ilimitado para la eficiencia en el trabajo. Impulsado por software patentado de IA, te darán acceso a cualquier puerta cerrada.
</div>
}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

Las '''Ganzúas''' son herramientas para conseguir acceso a puertas cerradas. Poniéndolo sobre una, permanece ahí por 30 segundos antes de caer al suelo y abrir la puerta. No tienen usos limitados y se pueden utilizar repetidamente.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estrategia ==

Como las ganzúas no con conductivas, son una buena alternativa a las [[key]]s (Llaves) en las [[moons]] (Lunas) con [[Weather#Stormy|stormy weather]] (Clima de tormenta).
{{navbox items}}

== Opis w Organizacji ==

{{terminal|Otwieracze Zamków odblokują Twój nieograniczony potencjał wydajności w pracy. Dzięki zastrzeżonemu oprogramowaniu AI zapewniają dostęp przez każde zamknięte drzwi.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

'''Otwieracz Zamków''' to narzędzie używane do otwierania zamkniętych drzwi. Po umieszczeniu jednego na zamkniętych drzwiach pozostaje tam przez 30 sekund, po czym spada na ziemię otwierając drzwi. Nie ulegają zużyciu w trakcie użytkowania, co pozwala na ich wielokrotne użycie.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategia ==

Ponieważ Otwieracze nie przewodzą prądu, są dobrą alternatywą dla [[Key/pl|kluczy]], podczas gdy na [[Moons/pl|księżycu]] panuje [[Weather#Stormy/pl|burza]]

== Descrição da Companhia ==

{{terminal|Arrombadores vão desbloquear seu potencial ilimitado para eficiência no trabalho. Energizados por um software de IA proprietário, eles vão ganhar acesso a qualquer porta trancada.
}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

'''Arrombadores''' são ferramentas usadas para ganhar acesso a portas trancadas. Ao colocar um em uma porta trancada, ele fica lá por 30 segundos antes de cair no chão e destrancar a porta. Eles não são consumidos com o uso, permitindo eles a serem usados repetidamente.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estratégia ==

Já que arrombadores não são condutivos, eles são uma alternativa viável a [[key/pt-br|chaves]] enquanto as [[moons/pt-br|luas]] estiver com uma [[Weather/pt-br|tempestade]].

== Описание компании ==

{{terminal|"Отмычки откроют ваш безграничный потенциал в эффективности на работе. Оснащенные проприетарным ИИ, они предоставят вам доступ к любой запертой двери."

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Общая информация ==

'''Отмычка''' - инструмент для получения доступа к закрытым на ключ дверям. После установки отмычки на запертую дверь, она останется там на 30 секунд, после чего упадет на пол, открыв дверь. Также, они не ломаются после использования, что позволяет использовать их повторно.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Так как отмычки не являются проводниками электричества, они являются хорошей альтернативой [[key|ключам]] на [[moons/ru|лунах]], подверженных [[Weather#Stormy|штормовой погоде]].

== 公司描述 ==

{{terminal|开锁器能解锁你在工作效率上的无限潜能。由公司专有 AI 软件驱动，能开启任何被锁上的门。
}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

'''开锁器'''是用于将锁上的门打开的工具。要解锁一扇门，将其放置在门上并等待 30 秒即可，解锁后开锁器会掉到地上。开锁器不是一次性用品，因此可以重复使用。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

由于开锁器并不导电，若[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]被[[Weather/zh-cn#暴风雨|暴风雨]]影响，它可以作为[[Key|钥匙]]的替代品来开门。

== The Company ==
{{main|The Company}}
'''The Company''' is the organization that the employees work for, and is also the namesake of the game. It is the supplier of the [[Ship]] and all equipment associated with employees, such as the Echo Scanner (often referred to as simply the scanner).<ref name="scanner-clipboard" /> This scanner sends information about wildlife to the Company's research team, which then sends existing information to the ship's [[Bestiary]].<ref name="researchteam-clipboard" /> 

The "Company Credits" system fluctuates over time, and is also associated solely with the Company.<ref name="credits-clipboard" /> Higher management for the Company operates remotely from across the solar system, and is not actually present on [[Gordion]].<ref name="remotework-nonsense" />

While often referred to as an actual company, "the Company" is also used to refer to [[The_Company#The_Company_Monster|the Company Monster]] within the Company Building.<ref name="company-clipboard" /> This monster is only visible when disturbing it long enough for it to lash out at employees, though is often audibly growling when disturbed or snoring. [[Sigurd]] has also referred to it as if it were a living and moving being, though without descriptors other than it being fast and "so big it covers the sky".<ref name="company-hiding" />

The Company Building is also where rumors about the Golden Planet are directed towards. Sigurd describes it as an existing story,<ref name="goldenplanetstory-goldenplanet" /> though claims a voice in the walkie talkie at the Company Building told him its true fate of being eaten by the "beast", likely the Company.<ref name="goldenplanet-goldenplanet" /> There are also distorted "screams" and other sounds that are heard from behind the wall, which is described by Sigurd<ref name="screams-screams" /> and also something that is able to be heard in-game.<ref name="screams-walkietalkie" />

=== Halden Electronics ===
A corporate entity of unclear relationship to the company that produces most or all of the equipment used by company employees, including the [[Company Cruiser]]. Other items with Halden Electronics branding include the operating system seen when starting up the game, and components of employees' suits according to the service manual on the [[clipboard]]. The back of the [[Microwave]] bears a trademark from H. E. Electronics, which may be the same corporation.

== The Boat ==

Briefly mentioned in the bestiary entry for [[Bunker Spider]]s and [[Old Bird]]s, the Boat is a nebulous entity<ref group="note" name="entity-confusion"/> described with an authority on human travel and settlement in the Thistle Nebula.<ref name="boat-bird" /> It is also referenced to have taken an unspecified "trip" around the Thistle Nebula at least several hundreds of years before the 1960s.<ref name="boat-bunker" />

The Bunker Spider entry also mentions another existing article on "Speculation on Increased Speciation Around the Fading Nebulae", though it is unspecified if this is due to some influence the Boat has enacted.

== The ITDA ==

The ITDA is an agency mentioned in the bestiary entries for the Bunker Spider, [[Cadaver Growth]], and [[Vain Shroud]], and has been around since the 1960s. The meaning of the acronym is not currently confirmed. As it is referred to hold authority on classifying and responding to dangerous or invasive wildlife, the ITDA is likely to be some sort of environmental management agency.<ref name="itda-vain" /><ref name="itda-bunker" /><ref name="itda-cadaver" />

== <span id="Sigurd"></span>Sigurd's crew ==

=== Sigurd ===
<!--{{redirect|Sigurd|the log entries in his name|Sigurd Logs}}-->
Sigurd is a former employee of the Company, who presumably was stationed on the ship present in-game. He is the person who wrote the majority of the logs found as data chips, as well as numerous additions to existing Bestiary entries<ref name="sigurd-firstlog" /> and the entirety of the [[Jester]] and [[Butler]] pages.<ref name="sigurd-jester" /><ref name="sigurd-butler" /> 

Most additions to wildlife bestiaries are made with the intent to provide advice for dealing with these creatures.<ref name="sigurdbestiary-snareflea" /> Often, they will also contain personal anecdotes, such as his attachment to [[Hoarding Bug]]s<ref name="sigurdbestiary-hoardingbug" /> and [[Maneater]]s,<ref name="sigurdbestiary-maneater" /> or lamenting encounters such as with the [[Bracken]].<ref name="sigurdbestiary-bracken" /> He has also given most creatures a "Sigurd's danger level" evaluation, though these are blatantly opinion-based and often not actually indicative of danger.<ref name="dangerlevel-leviathanmaneater" />

The journal entries found in the "log entry system" detail the story of him and his crew, as well as his own thoughts on his life and the job. They begin relatively innocuously until Rich's death, at which point the team "wakes up" and begins to investigate more into the Company, with him detailing their findings.<ref name="sigurd-nonsense" /> As the quota increases,<ref name="sigurd-realjob" /> Sigurd's mentality deteriorates into seeing manifestations of Rich on Vow<ref name="sigurdrich-realjob" /> and his father in the ship's vents,<ref name="sigurddad-teamsynergy" /> as well as becoming aggressive to the point of expressing (more extreme) homicidal urges.<ref name="sigurdaggro-teamsynergy" /><ref name="sigurdaggro-work" /> 

Following the vent incident on October 13th, Sigurd is described as "practically catatonic" after attempting to stop the crew from cleaning it of what he saw as his father's remains.<ref name="vent-letterofresignation" /> Days later, he returned to work and writing on the terminal with "Work", claiming to be perfectly well despite refusing to speak and eat.<ref name="vent-work" /> It is currently unknown what happened to Sigurd after October 15th, 1968, the date of Sigurd's last log.

=== Desmond ===
{{redirect|Desmond|the log entry named after him|Sigurd Logs#Desmond - Oct 9}}

'''Desmond''' is presumed to have been the leader of Sigurd's crew.<ref name="desmond-behindthewall" /><ref name="desmond-nonsense" /><ref name="desmond-realjob" /><ref name="desmond-letterofresignation" />
He added the feature for Sigurd to make the written [[Sigurd Logs|logs]],<ref name="logs-firstlog" /> is credited with a notable amount of knowledge of the terminal,<ref name="terminal-swingofthings" /> and helped Sigurd with uncovering the mystery of The Company.<ref name="company-idea" /><ref name="company-nonsense" /> As of "[[Sigurd_Logs#16._Work_-_Oct_15|Work]]", his current task is "some big rebellion" involving diagrams that cover the wall, as described by Sigurd; this is likely to be for the (nonfunctional) [[Gordion#The_Drill|drill]] beneath the Company Building.{{cite Patreon|date=2023-09-26|slug=beta-test-bug-89844466|title=The beta test + bug fixing!}}

Two of the fifteen logs were written by Desmond, with the first suspecting their team would not meet their quota, and the second describing an incident with the intake vent and his resigning.<ref name="desmondwrite-desmond" /><ref name="desmondwrite-letterofresignation" />

A common misconception has existed for some time that Sigurd and Desmond are brothers; this is neither confirmed nor alluded to in any logs. It is more likely to be discouraged from referrals to Sigurd's father as "his father" from Desmond,<ref name="brother-letterofresignation" /> as well as Sigurd's referral to his brother and Desmond in his first log, which would be strangely worded if they were one and the same.<ref name="brother-firstlog" />

=== Jess === 

'''Jess''' was a minor member of the crew, and had not done anything notable by Sigurd besides dismissing The Golden Planet as a myth<ref name="jess-goldenplanet" /> and recounting the vent incident to Desmond.<ref name="jess-letterofresignation" />

=== Richard === 

'''Richard''', another minor member of the crew, had done nothing notable but was repeatedly described as smelling poorly.<ref name="rich-mummy" /><ref name="rich-swingofthings" /><ref name="rich-behindthewall" />
The reasoning for this smell is never given, though it had persisted after his death.<ref name="smell-idea" />
According to Desmond, he was killed by a [[Bracken]] on September 7, 1968 with no witnesses present.
<ref name="richdeath-goodbye" />

=== Lucas === 

'''Lucas''' was Richard's replacement, another minor member of the crew. He had also done nothing notable but was presumably the least experienced worker; Sigurd describes him as "confused and scared all the time".

== Cosmography ==

{{for|moons as gameplay mechanics|Moons}}
=== Planets ===
All playable moons are satellites of larger planets. The names of two such planets are known: "Big Grin" and "No Service". In earlier versions of the game, 3D models for these planets—as well as a third icy planet—existed, though they could only be viewed outside of the ship during orbit via no-clipping.

[[File:Lethal Company v80 0-5 screenshot.png|thumb|316x316px|The Autopilot Ship orbiting No Service in earlier versions of the game.]][[File:Orbit.webp|left|thumb|202x202px|The Autopilot Ship orbiting Big Grin in earlier versions of the game.]]'''"Big Grin"''' is a gas giant confirmed to be orbited by Experimentation, Assurance, and Offense. This is supported by their descriptions: Experimentation explicitly orbits Big Grin, Assurance is described as a twin of Experimentation, and Offense is said to have broken off from Assurance, suggesting all three exist within the same planetary system.[[File:Icemoon.png|left|thumb|201x201px|The Autopilot Ship orbiting Placeholder Ice World in earlier versions of the game.]]'''"No Service"''' is confirmed to be orbited by the "Green Witches" (Vow, March, and Adamance), which is directly mentioned in Adamance's description. It is unknown whether No Service has a habitable surface.
'''The icy planet(s)''' have no confirmed moons explicitly tied to them in lore, and the model may have originally served as mere placeholders for the snowy moons. It is possible that multiple icy planets exist, due to differences in lore between Rend, Dine, and Titan. Titan’s description suggests it may have once been a more active or inhabited moon, potentially orbiting a more active planet prior to extensive mining and a major cataclysm. In contrast, Rend and Dine appear to have always been cold, possibly due to orbiting a white dwarf star.

However, Titan uses the same star texture as Rend and Dine, though this is likely an oversight. It is possible that Rend and Dine share a planetary system, but this remains speculative.

'''The Golden Planet''' is a mythical celestial body mentioned in Sigurd’s logs, believed in folklore to have been destroyed by a meteor. However, Sigurd later hears claims from a mysterious voice that the planet was actually consumed by a colossal “beast,” with victims allegedly trapped inside it. Its existence remains unconfirmed, and it is treated as a haunting legend tied to the wider cosmic horror surrounding the Company.

'''Additional planets''' are implied by the fact that all visitable locations in-game are described as moons. Hidden moons such as Embrion, Artifice, and Liquidation as well as Gordion likely orbit their own planets, though these planets have not received unique models and previously shared the icy planet placeholder visuals with pre-V50 moons.

=== Stars ===
[[File:4Stars.png|thumb|The 4 Stars that appear in game Clockwise starting Top Left: Small Red Stars, Yellow Star, Big Red Star and White Dwarf Star]]There is a star visible on the skybox of every in-game moon. Currently, there are four different star textures that appear in-game: a white dwarf star, a yellow star resembling the Sun, a small red star, and a large red star visible only on Embrion.

'''Small Red Star'''

The star visible from moons known to orbit "Big Grin", as well as from Artifice, appears small and red. This could indicate either a nearby red dwarf or a more distant red giant or supergiant. However, its small apparent size is more consistent with a closer, less luminous star. The exact classification is not confirmed in-game.

The star observed from Artifice appears visually identical in color and apparent size to the star seen from moons associated with "Big Grin". This may suggest a shared stellar environment; however, it is also possible that this similarity is due to reused visual assets rather than a confirmed lore connection.[[File:StarComparison1.png|left|thumb|A comparison of the Stars on Artifice (Left) and the one  on Experimentation (Right). As you can see, the same texture is used.]][[File:StarComparison2.png|left|thumb|Despite the Star looking identical across the three snowy moons (Left to Right, Rend, Dine, Titan) there is no lore confirmation they are the same star.]]

'''Yellow Star'''

The star visible from the Green Witch moons known to orbit "No Service" appears medium-sized and yellow. This is consistent with a Sun-like main sequence star befitting of the earth like conditions on these moons, though the exact classification is not confirmed in-game.

'''The White Dwarf Star'''

This star is visible from the three non-hidden snowy moons: Rend, Dine, and Titan. It is described in the lore of Rend and Dine as a white dwarf. However, it is possible that multiple (up to 3 different) stars are being represented here, due to differences in lore between Titan and the other snowy moons and no confirmation of ties between Rend and Dine.

'''The Large Red Star'''

This star is only visible from Embrion. It appears significantly larger in the sky and may represent either a very close red dwarf or a relatively close red giant. It is unclear whether this star is a closer version of the related to the star seen in the "Big Grin" system and/or Artifice system or represents a separate system entirely.

######## Lore/Speculation

== The endgame ==

=== "DON'T TELL" device ===
(desmonds drill)
Tucked away in the scaffolding on Gordion is a large machine of unknown purpose, apparently placed there by "rogue" employees behind the back of the Company.
Given its location, Zeekerss likely included it to set up an end goal/cutscene which he'll finish designing later.{{cite Patreon|date=2024-09-01|slug=conflicted-many-111231647|title=Conflicted, undecided, many options}}

The device has been painted with <q>BATTERY</q>, so perhaps what we see is only the power supply and other parts remain to be added.
Maybe a drill? That would explain the rails leading right up to the wall.

Or maybe it's an explosive device, and the thing mostly-wired up to it is a detonator with its plunger missing.

In any case, it has 2 receptacles on the side like those that Apparatuses are found in
(and like the one which powered the elevator in early builds of the game{{cite YouTube|video-id=v8TF91guA78|title=We Played the OLDEST Versions of Lethal Company|creator=Shubbunlimited|start-timestamp=4:08}}),
but as of v64 these are non-functional.

== What happened before ==

=== The Boat ===

The Boat was probably a expedition that discovered the Thistle Nebula (place where the game happens) much before the game events. This expedition probably brought some earth species that originated the entities that we find in the game.

== Sigurd's time ==

On Earth (if that exists in-universe), this is the post-modern era, Sigurd being a young man at the time he joined the Company.<ref name="log-real-job" />

=== 1939 ===

The Caswella Mine begins operating in the asteroid belt of Lepus.<ref name="bestiary-maneater" />

=== between 1939 and 1951 ===

War draws to a close.<ref name="bestiary-maneater" /><!-- as in World War II? -->

=== 1951 ===

==== June 23rd ====

Brett Goldent, a senior mining operator stationed at the Caswella Mine, is found dead on the lowest level, his body <q>eviscerated.</q><ref name="bestiary-maneater" />
The miners claim it was the doing of "the Maneater", but management is dismissive, and his death is recorded as <q>an accident resulting from faulty equipment.</q>
However, the press obviously runs with the "Maneater" story.

==== after June 23rd ====

Mining operations cease at Caswella Mine.<ref name="bestiary-maneater" />

=== 1957 ===

Brett Goldent's son, Simon, organises an expedition into Caswella Mine <q>to put to rest the mystery of his father's death</q> and to dispel the "Maneater" myth,
but to their horror they find the [[Maneater]] to be a very real and very large arthropod.<ref name="bestiary-maneater" />

=== 1963 ===

Botanist Alex Kurt first documents [[Vain shroud]]s in CoRoT-7b. A few weeks later they are found on the other side of the same interplanetary system, and before the end of the year [[the ITDA]] classifies them as a <q>noxious weed</q>.<ref name="bestiary-vain-shroud" />

=== 1965 ===

==== October 6th ====
<!-- may also be June 10th -->

The ITDA approves a kill-on-sight order for [[Bunker spider]]s.<ref name="bestiary-bunker-spider" />

=== 1968 ===

==== mid-August ====

Sigurd, Richard, Desmond, and Jess are onboarded at the Company.<ref name="log-shady" /><ref name="log-hiding" />

Sigurd begins "contributing" to the [[bestiary]].<ref name="log-first-log" />
(It's not mentioned whether he continues to do so after he starts writing logs, or if all his additions are from the week or so prior to that.)

==== August 22nd ====

Desmond programs a dedicated journaling feature into the [[Terminal]] for Sigurd.<ref name="log-first-log" />

==== sometime between August 27th and 31st ====

(The log "Golden planet" is listed as "August ??", but it must be after "Swing of things".)

Sigurd has a conversation via [[Walkie-talkie]] with an entity which he believes is inside the Company building.<ref name="log-golden-planet" />
The voice claims <q>the Golden planet actually existed, its not a legend</q> and that <q>it didn't just hit a meteor [... it] was swallowed up by the "beast".</q>
Because this is a second-hand account of what was apparently a manic speaker, it's not conclusive,
but the voice may have implied that he was on the Golden Planet to witness it get "eaten".

==== September 7th ====

Richard goes missing while scavenging on Vow and is left for dead; Sigurd is convinced he was abducted by a [[Bracken]].<ref name="log-goodbye" /><ref name="log-real-job" />

==== September 13th ====

Sigurd calls their "manager" at the Company and reports Richard's death.<ref name="log-screams" />

==== September 18th ====

Desmond theorises that there is <q>a way to use the phone call [Sigurd] made to the company number to find [out] where the voice comes from,</q> or in other words, triangulation.<ref name="log-idea" />

==== sometime between September 18th and 27th ====

Lucas joins the crew.<ref name="log-nonsense" />

==== September 27th ====

The triangulation reveals their "manager" is actually <q>across the whole solar system.</q><ref name="log-nonsense" />
Sigurd takes this, and the ravings of the voice he spoke to a month prior,
as proof that the Company building houses a monster, and they are employed to keep it fed and contained.

==== October 15th ====

The final log is written by Desmond, who states <q>I am encrypting these logs to keep them hidden, as I fear the system will be wiped if they are found.</q><ref name="log-desmond" />

== 22nd century ==

=== 2084 ===
<!-- yes I know this is in the 21st century, but we can rename this heading when there are more events and we have a fuller picture -->

[[Halden Electronics]] releases the first version of BG IG, a "System-Act Ally".<ref name="game-startup" />

=== 2108 ===

[[Halden Electronics]] releases what may be their last version of BG IG.<ref name="game-startup" />

=== between 2100 and 2143 ===

Tensions rise between the Buemoch military and that of the Anglen Empire.<ref name="bestiary-old-bird" />

==== December 18th ====

<q>Over fifty</q> [[Old Bird]]s invade the Anglen Capital.
The automatons had never been seen&mdash;or at least never documented&mdash;publically at this point,
and were <q>one of the first extra-orbital weapons to be used.</q><ref name="bestiary-old-bird" />

== 24th century ==
<!-- as above, this is a lame heading -->

=== 2356 ===

[[5-Embrion]] is classified as <q>Condemned for the purposes of travel or settlement by the Boat; Old Birds were described by witness accounts as "lining the horizon".</q><ref name="bestiary-old-bird" />
It's hypothesised that Embrion was <q>likely used as a testing ground for the Old Bird's flying and landing capabilities.</q>

=== 2384 ===

Under Remora, a <q>post-punk project,</q> releases the song ''Old Birds'' and it becomes a cult hit.<ref name="bestiary-old-bird" />

=== 2387 ===

Street artist Land Eyrie depicts [[Old Bird]]s <q>flying and landing between planets in an arrangement similar to a flock of geese,</q>
and in naming his piece after the Under Remora song, he solidifies "Old Bird" as the name of the automatons in the public consciousness.<ref name="bestiary-old-bird" />
<!-- I have to say, this is A-tier worldbuilding —YoshiRulz -->

== Present day ==

=== 2532 ===
<!-- the date is given as <q>Tue 3-7-2532</q>, but under the Gregorian calendar (as Sigurd appears to be using), March 7th would be a Friday, and July 3rd a Thursday -->

The player is onboarded at the Company.<ref name="terminal-onboarding" />

== Company Description ==
<blockquote>
Used to communicate with any crew member from any distance, no walkie talkie required! The horn can be heard from anywhere. But what does it mean? That's up to you!

== Overview ==
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The loud horn is a [[ship]] upgrade employees can buy for {{credits|100}}, which adds a pole with a pull cord.
Pulling the cord plays a horn noise. This noise can be heard across the entire [[Moons|map]], including inside the structure,
and can be used to signal the crew or attract wildlife to the ship (specifically the front, opposite from the door).
</translate>

== Overview ==
The loud horn is a [[ship]] upgrade employees can buy for {{credits|100}}, which adds a pole with a pull cord.
Pulling the cord plays a horn noise. This noise can be heard across the entire [[Moons|map]], including inside the structure,
and can be used to signal the crew or attract wildlife to the ship (specifically the front, opposite from the door).
{{navbox furniture}}

######## Magic 7 ball
{{topicon Fandom|Magic_7_Ball}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item}} 
The '''Magic 7 ball''' is a mid-value [[Scrap]]. It's a play on the iconic toy series "[[w:Magic 8 Ball|Magic 8 Ball]]". Despite its name, it has no magical properties and cannot give answers to questions.

Can only be found on some paid moons.

== Welcome to the Unofficial Lethal Company Wiki! ==
This is the most active wiki for the game ''[[Lethal Company]]'', created by [[Zeekerss]]. You can expect this wiki to offer you an in-depth look at the mechanics behind much of the content in the game.

<!--T:2-->
Lethal Company is a multiplayer survival horror game in which players are tasked with gathering enough scrap items from hostile moons to meet an ever-increasing company profit quota. The moons have harsh weather conditions and hazards and are filled with unique monsters, traps, and complex game mechanics. All these aspects tied together with in-game proximity chat lead to endless hours of gameplay and funny, memorable moments.

== Did you know? ==
* The [[Bracken]], if present, chooses a favorite room when the company [[ship]] lands; it will store the [[Bodies]] of its prey in that location.
* [[Turret]]s and [[Laser Pointer]]s emit the same laser.
* [[Landmine]]s will not explode until they are stepped off of. Additionally, dropped [[scrap]] will continuously weigh them down, preventing them from exploding.
* [[Turret]]s, when hit with a [[Shovel]], [[Stop Sign]] or [[Yield sign|Yield Sign]] will make a charging sound and start firing whilst spinning around wildly.
* The company [[ship]] and delivery [[dropship]] will kill any employees standing underneath them when landing.
* Repeatedly holding "noisy" scrap items (such as the [[Robot Toy]] or [[Teeth]]) by swapping inventory or dropping them has a small chance to silence them until they are held again.
* Weight does not affect jump height and stamina consumption from jumping.
* The longest possible run is <tvar name="days">{{formatnum:152}}</tvar> days and the highest [[quota]] you then complete is <tvar name="quota">{{formatnum:52567}}</tvar>.{{citation needed}}

An exact <abbr title="end of service">EOS</abbr> date has not been given.

== هل تعلم؟ ==
* [[Manticoil|Manticoils]] يُشار إليها بشكل متبادل باسم "Manticoils" و "Mantacoils" - اسم الملف يستخدم "i" بينما يستخدم إدخال المعجم "a"، ويمكن كتابة أيًا منهما للوصول إلى الملف.
* يختار [[Bracken|البراكين]] غرفة مفضلة في بداية كل جولة حيث سيحمل جثث اللاعبين بعد قتلهم.
* [[Interiors#Turrets|البنادق الآلية]] و [[Laser Pointer|مؤشرات الليزر]] يصدرون نفس الليزر.
* [[Interiors#Turrets|البنادق الآلية]] عندما يتعرضون لضربة بمجرفة ستصدر صوت شحن وتدور أثناء إطلاق النار حوالي 3 مرات.
* يمكن لسفينة التوصيل أن تقتل اللاعب إذا كان يقف تحت نقطة هبوطها مباشرة.
* تكرار إسقاط والتقاط أي عناصر خردة "صاخبة" مثل [[Robot Toy|لعبة الروبوت]] أو [[Teeth|الأسنان]] له فرصة صغيرة لصمتها.
* الوزن لا يؤثر على ارتفاع القفز أو استهلاك الطاقة من القفز.
* أطول مدة تشغيل ممكنة هي 152 يومًا وأعلى [[quota|كمية]] تكتمل بعد ذلك هي 52567.
</div>

== التاريخ ==
بدأت شركة قاتلة كمشروع مختلف جدًا؛ في البداية، كان من المخطط أن تحدث اللعبة بأكملها في الأماكن المغلقة، مع وصول اللاعبين إلى مصانع جديدة بمصعد. وفقًا لأقدم منشور متاح يتعلق باللعبة، تم تلميحها لأول مرة على باتريون في 26 مايو 2022، على الرغم من أن التطوير يبدو أنه يعود إلى ما قبل ذلك بكثير.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The game is [[Version_history|regularly updated]] with new items, monsters, and environments.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
أكد زيكرس أنه يود العودة إلى مشاريع أكبر بعد الانتهاء من دعم شركة قاتلة. لم يتم إصدار تاريخ دقيق لنهاية دعم اللعبة.
</div>

Lethal Company je multiplayerová hororová hra o přežití ve které hráči jsou pověřený se sbírání šrotu z nepřátelských měsíců aby splnili pořád-zvyšující kvótu. Měsíce mají drsné počasí a nebezpečí a jsou plné s unikátní příšerami, pastmi, a komplexními herními mechanikami. Všechny tyhle aspekty dohromady s hlasovým chatem vede k nekonečným hodinám hraní a srandovních, památných momentů.

== Vědděli jste? ==
* [[Bracken]], (pokud je přítomen) si vybírá svojí oblíbenou místnost jak přistane [[ship|loď]]; v té místnosti si bude skladovat těla své oběti.

* Váha neovlivňuje výšku skoku nebo spotřebu staminy ze skákání.
* Nejdelší možný běh hry je 152 dnů a nejvyšší [[quota|kvótu]] co můžeš splnit je 52567.

== Historie ==
Lethal Company začalo jako velmi obtížný projekt; zpočátku, celá hra byla plánovaná se odehrát vevnitř, hráči by se dostávaly k nových továren výtahem. Podle nejdřívější dostupnou post týkající se hry, bylo poprvé ukázáno na Patreon 26. Května 2022, ale zdá se, že vývoj začal mnohem, mnohem dřív.

Hra je [[Version_history|pravidelně aktualizována]] s novými předměty, příšery a prostředí.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Zeekerss uvedl, že by rád se vrátil k větších projektů až dokončí Lethal Company. Přesné EOS datum ještě nevyšlo.
</div>

== Willkommen im inoffiziellen Lethal Company Wiki! ==
Dieses Wiki ist das aktivste Wiki für das Spiel ''[[Lethal Company]]'', von [[Zeekerss]]. Dieses Wiki bietet einen tieferen Blick in die Funktionsweise der Inhalte und Spielmechaniken.

Lethal Company ist ein Mehrspieler Survival-Horrorspiel in dem Spieler die Aufgabe haben, so viel Schrott wie möglich von gefährlichen Monden zu sammeln, um die immer größer werdende Profitquote der Firma zu erfüllen. Die Monde weisen extreme Wetterbedinungen sowie Gefahren auf und sind mit einzigartigen Monstern, Fallen und komplexen Spielmechaniken gefüllt. Im Zusammenspiel mit dem entfernungsbasierten Sprachchat führen diese Aspekte endlose Stunden Gameplay, sowie lustige und anderweitig besondere Momente herbei.

Dieses Wiki wird ständig weiterentwickelt, also zögere nicht, einen Beitrag zu leisten! Aktuell haben wir {{NUMBEROFACTIVEUSERS}} aktive Editoren (von {{NUMBEROFUSERS}} Nutzern insgesamt), die {{NUMBEROFARTICLES}} Artikel und {{NUMBEROFFILES}} Dateien instand halten. Wir brauchen also all die Hilfe die wir kriegen können! Alle Informationen zu diesem Wiki und zur Bearbeitung [[Project:About|finden Sie hier]].

''Dieses Wiki wird nur wenig Informationen zu Mods enthalten. Wer nach Hilfe beim Modding sucht, sollte [https://lethal.wiki lethal.wiki] besuchen.''

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Wusstest du schon? ==
* [[Manticoil|Manticoils]] werden sowohl "Manticoils", als auch "Mantacoils" bezeichnet - der Dateiname nutzt ein "i", während im Bestiarium ein "a" benutzt wird. Beide Schreibweisen können genutzt werden, um auf die Datei zuzugreifen.
* Der [[Bracken/de|Bracken]] wählt sich einen Raum am Start jeder Runde als "Nest" zu welchem er getötete Spieler schleppt.
* [[Interiors/de#Geschütze|Geschütze]] und [[Laser Pointer]] nutzen den gleichen Laser. 
* Schlägt man sie mit einer Schaufel, geben [[Interiors/de#Geschütze|Geschütze]] einen Laut von sich und beginnen sich mit Dauerfeuer circa 3 Mal um die eigene Achse zu drehen.
* Die Abwurfkapsel, die gekaufte Gegenstände liefert, kann Spieler töten, wenn diese direkt auf ihrem Landepunkt stehen.
* "Lautstarker" Schrott, wie [[Robot Toy|Spielzeugroboter]] oder das [[Teeth|Gebiss]], haben bei wiederholtem Fallenlassen und Aufheben eine kleine Chance ruhig zu bleiben. 
* Gewicht beeinflusst weder Sprunghöhe, noch den Ausdauerverbrauch beim Springen.
* Der längstmögliche Spieldurchgang ist 152 Tage lang mit einer Profitquote von 52 567.
</div>

==Geschichte==
Lethal Company begann als ganz anderes Projekt; anfangs war geplant, dass das gesamte Spiel drinnen stattfindet und Spieler mit einem Aufzug neue Fabriken erreichen. Gemäß des ersten Posts über das Spiel, gab es auf Patreon am 26. Mai 2022 einen ersten Teaser. Die Entwicklung reicht scheinbar jedoch noch viel weiter zurück.

Das Spiel wird [[Version_history|regelmäßig aktualisiert]] mit neuen Gegenständen, Monstern und Umgebungen.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Zeekerss hat erklärt, dass nach Lethal Company wieder ein größeres Projekt wahrscheinlich ist. Ein exaktes Enddatum für die Unterstützung von Lethal Company wurde noch nicht bekanntgegeben.
</div>

Τα φεγγάρια έχουν δύσκολες καιρικές συνθήκες και κινδύνους και είναι γεμάτα με μοναδικά τέρατα, παγίδες και πολύπλοκους μηχανισμούς παιχνιδιών. Όλες αυτές οι πτυχές που συνδέονται με τη συνομιλία εγγύτητας εντός του παιχνιδιού οδηγούν σε ατελείωτες ώρες παιχνιδιού και αστείες, αξέχαστες στιγμές.

== == Το ξέρατε; ==
* Τα [[Manticoil|Manticoil]] αναφέρονται εναλλακτικά ως "Manticoil" και "Mantacoils" - το όνομα του αρχείου χρησιμοποιεί ένα "i", το λήμμα κτηνωδών χρησιμοποιεί ένα "a" και οποιαδήποτε ορθογραφία μπορεί να πληκτρολογηθεί για πρόσβαση στο αρχείο.
* Το [[Bracken]] επιλέγει ένα αγαπημένο δωμάτιο στην αρχή κάθε γύρου όπου θα φέρει τα πτώματα των παικτών μόλις τους σκοτώσει.
* [[Εσωτερικά#Πυργίσκοι|Πυργίσκοι]] και [[Δείκτης λέιζερ|δείκτες λέιζερ]] εκπέμπουν το ίδιο λέιζερ.
* Το [[Interiors#Turrets|Turrets]] όταν χτυπηθεί με [[Shovel|shovel]] θα κάνει έναν ήχο φόρτισης και θα περιστρέφεται ενώ πυροβολεί περίπου 3 φορές.
* Το dropship παράδοσης μπορεί να σκοτώσει έναν παίκτη εάν στέκεται ακριβώς κάτω από το σημείο προσγείωσης του.
* Το να ρίχνετε και να μαζεύετε επανειλημμένα τυχόν «θορυβώδη» σκραπ, όπως το [[Robot Toy]] ή το [[Teeth]] έχει μια μικρή πιθανότητα να τα σιγήσει.
* Το βάρος δεν επηρεάζει το ύψος του άλματος και την κατανάλωση αντοχής από το άλμα.
* Η μεγαλύτερη δυνατή διαδρομή είναι 152 ημέρες και το υψηλότερο [[quota]] που θα ολοκληρώσετε είναι 52567
</div>

== Ιστορία ==
Η Lethal Company ξεκίνησε ως ένα πολύ διαφορετικό έργο. Αρχικά, ολόκληρο το παιχνίδι είχε προγραμματιστεί να γίνει σε εσωτερικούς χώρους, με τους παίκτες να φτάνουν σε νέα εργοστάσια μέσω ανελκυστήρων. Σύμφωνα με την παλαιότερη διαθέσιμη ανάρτηση σχετικά με το παιχνίδι, παρουσιάστηκε για πρώτη φορά στο Patreon στις 26 Μαΐου 2022, αν και η ανάπτυξη φαίνεται να πηγαίνει πολύ, πολύ πιο πίσω από αυτό.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The game is [[Version_history|regularly updated]] with new items, monsters, and environments.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ο Zeekerss δήλωσε ότι θα ήθελε να επιστρέψει σε μεγαλύτερα έργα αφού ολοκληρώσουν την υποστήριξη της Lethal Company. Δεν έχει ανακοινωθεί ακριβής ημερομηνία EOS.
</div>

== Welcome to the Unofficial Lethal Company Wiki! ==
This is the most active wiki for the game ''[[Lethal Company]]'', created by [[Zeekerss]]. You can expect this wiki to offer you an in-depth look at the mechanics behind much of the content in the game.

Lethal Company is a multiplayer survival horror game in which players are tasked with gathering enough scrap items from hostile moons to meet an ever-increasing company profit quota. The moons have harsh weather conditions and hazards and are filled with unique monsters, traps, and complex game mechanics. All these aspects tied together with in-game proximity chat lead to endless hours of gameplay and funny, memorable moments.

This wiki is a constant work in progress, so please feel free to contribute!
We’re currently at {{NUMBEROFACTIVEUSERS}} active editors (of {{NUMBEROFUSERS}} users total),
maintaining {{NUMBEROFARTICLES}} articles and {{NUMBEROFFILES}} files.
We’ll need all the help we can get! Everything about this wiki and editing [[Project:About|can be found here]].

''Please note that this wiki will not contain much information relating to modding. Those looking for modding help should check out [https://lethal.wiki lethal.wiki].''

== Did you know? ==
* The [[Bracken]], if present, chooses a favorite room when the company [[ship]] lands; it will store the [[Bodies]] of its prey in that location.
* [[Turret]]s and [[Laser Pointer]]s emit the same laser.
* [[Landmine]]s will not explode until they are stepped off of. Additionally, dropped [[scrap]] will continuously weigh them down, preventing them from exploding.
* [[Turret]]s, when hit with a [[Shovel]], [[Stop Sign]] or [[Yield sign|Yield Sign]] will make a charging sound and start firing whilst spinning around wildly.
* The company [[ship]] and delivery [[dropship]] will kill any employees standing underneath them when landing.
* Repeatedly holding "noisy" scrap items (such as the [[Robot Toy]] or [[Teeth]]) by swapping inventory or dropping them has a small chance to silence them until they are held again.
* Weight does not affect jump height and stamina consumption from jumping.
* The longest possible run is {{formatnum:152}} days and the highest [[quota]] you then complete is {{formatnum:52567}}.{{citation needed}}

== History ==
{{main|Lethal Company#Development}}

The game is [[Version_history|regularly updated]] with new items, monsters, and environments.

Zeekerss has stated{{citation needed}} that {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he'd|she'd|they'd}} like to return to bigger projects after {{GENDER:Zeekerss|he's|she's|they're}} done supporting ''Lethal Company''.
An exact <abbr title="end of service">EOS</abbr> date has not been given.

== ¡Bienvenido a la wiki no oficial de Lethal Company! ==
Esta es la wiki no oficial más activa para el juego ''[[Lethal Company/es|Lethal Company]]'', creado por [[Zeekerss/es|Zeekers]]. Puedes esperar que esta wiki te ofrezca un vistazo profundo a las mecánicas detrás de la mayoría del contenido del juego.

Lethal Company es un juego multijugador del género survival-horror en el cual los jugadores tienen la tarea de recoger suficiente chatarra en lunas hostiles para alcanzar una cuota cada vez mayor de ganancias dada por la compañía. Las lunas cuentan con condiciones climáticas adversas y peligrosas y están llenas de monstruos, trampas y mecánicas complejas y únicas. Todos estos aspectos en conjunto con el chat de proximidad te llevarán a horas de gameplay sin fin y a experimentar muchos momentos graciosos y memorables.

Esta wiki está en constante desarrollo, así que siéntete libre de contribuir. Hasta el momento, tenemos {{NUMBEROFACTIVEUSERS}} editores activos (de un total de {{NUMBEROFUSERS}} usuarios), quienes mantienen {{NUMBEROFARTICLES}} artículos y {{NUMBEROFFILES}} archivos. ¡Necesitamos toda la ayuda posible! Todo lo que necesitará saber sobre esta wiki y edición [[Project:About|lo puede encontrar aquí.]].

''Por favor toma en cuenta que esta wiki no contiene información relacionada a mods. Si eso es lo que buscas, te recomendamos que revises [https://lethal.wiki lethal.wiki]''

== ¿Sabías qué? ==
* El [[Bracken/es|Bracken]] escoge una habitación favorita una vez la [[ship|nave]] aterriza y es allí adonde llevará los cadáveres de sus presas tras asesinarlas.
* Las [[Turret/es|torretas]] y los [[Laser Pointer/es|punteros láser]] emiten el mismo láser.
*Las [[Landmine|minas terrestres]] no explotarán asta el momento en el que dejen de ser pisadas, además, la [[scrap|chatarra]] permite mantener un peso encima de las minas, lo que evita su explosión. 
* Al ser golpeadas con una [[Shovel/es|pala]],[[Stop Sign|señal de STOP]] o [[Yield sign|señal de ceda el paso]] las [[Interiors/es#Turrets|torretas]] harán un sonido de carga y girarán sobre sí mismas mientras disparan por doquier.
* La [[ship|nave]] y la [[dropship|nave de entrega]] son capaces de aplastar y matar a un empleado si este se encuentra debajo su punto de aterrizaje.
*Agarrar y soltar repetidamente cualquier trozo de chatarra ruidoso, como el [[Robot Toy/es|robot de juguete]] o la [[Teeth/es|dentadura]] tiene una ligera probabilidad de silenciar dicho objeto.
* El peso que lleva el jugador no afecta ni a la altura de sus saltos ni al consumo de "stamina" al saltar.
*La partida más larga posible es de {{formatnum:152}} días y la [[Quota/es|cuota]] más alta posible es de {{formatnum:52567}}.

== Historia ==
Lethal Company empezó como un proyecto muy diferente: el juego entero se llevaría a cabo solo en interiores y los jugadores alcanzarían nuevas fábricas con un ascensor. Según la 
publicación más antigua disponible relacionada con el juego, el primer teaser fue en Patreon en 26 de mayo del 2022, aunque el desarrollo parece haber comenzado mucho antes de esa fecha.

El juego es [[Version_history/es|actualizado con regularidad]] con nuevos objetos, monstruos y ecosistemas.

Zeekerss manifestó que le gustaría volver a proyectos más grandes una vez finalizado el desarrollo de Lethal Company. Una fecha exacta que marque el <abbr title="fin del servicio">EOS</abbr> de Lethal Company no ha sido dada.

== Welcome to the Unofficial Lethal Company Wiki! ==
This is the most active wiki for the game ''[[Lethal Company]]'', created by [[Zeekerss]]. You can expect this wiki to offer you an in-depth look at the mechanics behind much of the content in the game.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lethal Company is a multiplayer survival horror game in which players are tasked with gathering enough scrap items from hostile moons to meet an ever-increasing company profit quota. The moons have harsh weather conditions and hazards and are filled with unique monsters, traps, and complex game mechanics. All these aspects tied together with in-game proximity chat lead to endless hours of gameplay and funny, memorable moments.
</div>

== Did you know? ==
* The [[Bracken]], if present, chooses a favorite room when the company [[ship]] lands; it will store the [[Bodies]] of its prey in that location.
* [[Turret]]s and [[Laser Pointer]]s emit the same laser.
* [[Landmine]]s will not explode until they are stepped off of. Additionally, dropped [[scrap]] will continuously weigh them down, preventing them from exploding.
* [[Turret]]s, when hit with a [[Shovel]], [[Stop Sign]] or [[Yield sign|Yield Sign]] will make a charging sound and start firing whilst spinning around wildly.
* The company [[ship]] and delivery [[dropship]] will kill any employees standing underneath them when landing.
* Repeatedly holding "noisy" scrap items (such as the [[Robot Toy]] or [[Teeth]]) by swapping inventory or dropping them has a small chance to silence them until they are held again.
* Weight does not affect jump height and stamina consumption from jumping.
* The longest possible run is {{formatnum:152}} days and the highest [[quota]] you then complete is {{formatnum:52567}}.{{citation needed}}
</div>
