'''March''' - одна из трёх [[Moons/ru|лун]] средней сложности вместе со своим пустынным антиподом, [[Offense/ru|Offense]], и лесным партнёром [[Adamance/ru|Adamance]]. Обе средние луны довольно похожи изнутри, у March больший размер карты, а [[Offense/ru|Offense]] предлагает чуть больше лута. По сравнению с Offense, на March появляется большее количество ульев, но на ней также более опасная внешняя территория из-за постоянных ям с вязкой грязью и [[Forest_Keeper/ru|Хранителей Леса]]. Имеет уровень риска "B".
</div>

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=61-March

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: March находится в состоянии постоянной мороси. Её местность обширна.

ИСТОРИЯ: Эту луну часто не замечают из-за её близнеца, Vow.

ФАУНА: Неизвестно}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Как и [[Vow/ru|Vow]], March обладает густой лесной поверхностью. Не поддерживает дождливую погоду, а скорее находится под дождём круглосуточно, скорее всего из-за насыщенной влагой атмосферы. Места с вязкой грязью на March всегда одинаковы в отличие от [[Vow/ru|Vow]]. Местность March довольно холмистая, а также по ней везде раскиданы деревья.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The interior layout will always be the [[Factory]].
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Чтобы добраться до главного входа, нужно следовать за огоньками прямо напротив огромной впадины сзади корабля. Хорошей стратегией будет также проверить все пожарные выходы, коих на March 3, вместо того, чтобы продолжать слишком долго блуждать возле главного входа, для максимизации количества собранного лута. Также хорошей стратегией будет выйти на охоту за ульями, так как шанс появления [[Circuit Bees/ru|пчёл]] на March самый высокий.
</div>

{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}
<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Кривые шансов спавна ===
[[File:March_spawn_curve.png|thumb]]
На March ночные сущности начинают появляться около 2 часов дня. В отличии от лёгких лун вроде [[Assurance/ru|Assurance]] или [[Vow/ru|Vow]], скорость появления ночных сущностей продолжает плавно расти с пиком в полночь. Между 9 и 11 часами скорость резко растёт в первый раз прежде чем на мгновение ослабнуть. Подобно [[Vow/ru|Vow]], у дневных сущностей продлён таймер появления в начале дня перед плавным уменьшением со временем. Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.
<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные факты ==
March - единственная луна со множеством пожарных выходов.

March - единственная луна, у которой в качестве интерьера выступает исключительно и только [[Завод]] и которая не поддерживает наличие [[Особняк|Особняка]] или [[Шахты|Шахт]].

<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Directly north of the ship, far out of bounds, there is a secret circle of large, stone [[Toilet paper|Teliots]]. It is difficult to reach this on foot before the ship leaves, and requires at least one [[Extension Ladder]] to get out of bounds. Using [[TZP-Inhalant]], the [[Cruiser]], or multiple [[jetpack]]s to move faster is helpful.</span>

######## March/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = March
| image = March.png
| routecost = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''March''' 是三个中等难度[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]中的其中一个，另外两个则是沙漠星球 [[Offense/zh-cn|Offense]]与它的森林姊妹星球[[Adamance]]。March 的危险等级为“B”，但实际比[[Experimentation/zh-cn|Experimentation]]要难很多。两个中等难度星球的内部结构差异并不大，只不过 March 的外部地图更大，而 [[Offense/zh-cn|Offense]] 生成的物品略多一些。与 Offense 相比，March 可能会生成更多的蜂窝，不过固定生成的流沙点位和[[Forest Giant/zh-cn|森林守护者]]也使得室外更加危险。
</div>

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=61-March

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：March 终年阴雨，地形更为广阔。

历史：此星球因其孪生星球 Vow 的存在而被忽视。

生态：未知}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== 环境 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
与 [[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]] 非常相似， March 拥有郁郁葱葱的森林景观。它不会出现阴雨天气，但很可能是由于其潮湿饱和的大气而持续降雨。 March 的流沙点总是在同一个位置，而不是像 [[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]] 那样随机生成。 March 的地形是丘陵地带，一堆树散落在地图周围。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The interior layout will always be the [[Factory]].
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
跟着从船尾方向看到的灯光走，绕过中间的大水坑就可以到达主要入口。不过，与其长时间在主要入口进出，建议同时看看另外 3 个消防出口，可能有助于收集到最多的废料。在 March 上收集蜂窝也是一个可行的方案，因为目前 March 有着最高的[[Circuit Bees/zh-cn|电路蜂群]]生成概率。
</div>

== 实体 ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== 室内 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
就像在 [[Offense/zh-cn|Offense]] 上一样，[[Thumper/zh-cn|打击者]]和[[Bunker Spider/zh-cn|地堡蜘蛛]]是 March 最常见的室内实体。建议携带一把[[Shovel/zh-cn|铲子]]，因为这两个实体都可以在几次打击后被杀死。
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== 夜间 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
[[Baboon Hawk/zh-cn|狒狒鹰]]和[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]是 March 最常见的夜间实体。 March 茂密的森林和岩石让你更容易从森林守护者身边溜走。
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== 日间 ===

March 是最有可能找到[[Circuit Bees/zh-cn|电路蜜蜂]]的星球。如果玩家有经验将蜂巢带回船上而不会死亡，那么四处寻找蜂巢是一种可行的策略。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}
<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== 生成概率曲线 ===
[[File:March_spawn_curve.png|thumb]]
在 March 上，夜间实体在下午2点左右开始生成。与[[Assurance/zh-cn|Assurance]]或[[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]]等简单的星球相反，夜间实体生成概率从那时起稳步增加，直到凌晨12点达到峰值。在晚上9点到11点之间，生成概率先是上升，然后瞬间下降。与[[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]]类似，日间实体在一天开始时有一个延长的生成计时器，然后也会随着时间的推移逐渐减少。有关解释请参见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。
<span id="Trivia"></span>

<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Directly north of the ship, far out of bounds, there is a secret circle of large, stone [[Toilet paper|Teliots]]. It is difficult to reach this on foot before the ship leaves, and requires at least one [[Extension Ladder]] to get out of bounds. Using [[TZP-Inhalant]], the [[Cruiser]], or multiple [[jetpack]]s to move faster is helpful.</span>

######## Mask Hornets/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity|id=ButlerBees
| name = Mask Hornets
| power_level = 2
| diversity_level = 0
| attack_damage = 10
| stun_multiplier = 0.6
| door_speed_multiplier = 0.08
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|ButlerBees}}
| altname = Butler Bees, Facility Bees
| attack_speed = 0.5s
| contact_damage = 10
| dps = 20
| see_through_fog = No
| cause_of_death = Stabbing
}}
'''Mask Hornets''' are [[entities]] found [[indoors]] that are spawned from killed [[Butler]]s. Once spawned, they roam the facility looking for employees and act similarly to [[Circuit bees]]. They stay in the facility until the ship leaves the [[moon]]. 
== {{section heading/Bestiary entry}} ==
{{quote bestiary|MaskHornet}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
Mask Hornets spawn when a Butler is killed, and although invincible, they cannot exit the facility or open locked doors. They attack the nearest employee and give chase at a slightly slower speed than the employee's default walking speed. When roaming the facility, they move slower and can be heard by their loud buzzing.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
If possible, try to avoid spawning them until later in the afternoon to keep their presence to a minimum. If spawned, employees can close doors in front of the hornets to buy time and gain distance.

Because Mask Hornets behave very similarly to [[Circuit Bees]], they can be handled in a similar manner.

Mask Hornets take 6 seconds to open doors, meaning trapping them behind a door is a useful strategy, such as with [[Coil-head]]s and [[Jester]]s.
== {{section heading/Notes}} ==
Mask Hornets are invincible, so talk with your teammates before killing [[Butler]]s, as secretly releasing these can be a detriment to your run.

There are certain places where Mask Hornets cannot reach you, allowing you to hide until getting teleported out or getting help.

######## Mask Hornets/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity|id=ButlerBees
| name = Mask Hornets
| power_level = 2

| stun_multiplier = 0.6
| door_speed_multiplier = 0.08
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|ButlerBees}}
| altname = Butler Bees, Facility Bees
| attack_speed = 0.5s
| contact_damage = 10

| see_through_fog = No
| cause_of_death = Stabbing
}}
'''Масочные Шершни''' - [[Entities/ru|сущности]], которых можно встретить внутри здания и которые появляются при убийстве [[Butler/ru|Дворецких]]. После своего появления блуждают по комплексу в поисках сотрудников и ведут себя подобно [[Circuit bees/ru|Пчелиному рою]]. Остаются в здании до тех пор, пока корабль не покинет луну. 
== {{section heading/Bestiary entry}} ==
{{quote bestiary|MaskHornet}}

== {{section heading/Mechanics}} ==
Масочные Шершни появляются при убийстве Дворецкого, и хотя они являются неуязвимыми, они не могут покинуть здание или открыть запертые двери. Атакуют ближайшего сотрудника и преследуют со скоростью суть меньшей скорости походки сотрудника налегке. В отсутствие целей двигаются замедленно. Всё время жужжат.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
По возможности следует избегать их появления (следовательно - убийства Дворецких) как можно дольше, чтобы избежать их присутствия в течении дня. Сотрудники могут закрывать перед ними двери, чтобы выиграть время и набрать дистанцию.

Так как Масочные Шершни ведут себя подобно Пчёлам, с ними можно обращаться аналогично.

У Масочных шершней уходит 6 секунд на открытие дверей, что значит что аналогично [[Coil-head/ru|Пружиноголовым]] и [[Jester/ru|Балагуру]] их можно надолго задержать с помощью дверей.
== {{section heading/Notes}} ==
Так как Масочные шершни неуязвимы, убивать дворецкого следует заранее обсудив это с коллегами (или просто предупредив их).

В случае, если Масочные шершни вызывают проблемы, можно спрятаться в одном из некоторых мест, куда они не могут добраться в ожидании телепортации.

######## Masked

{{about|the enemy|the scrap item|Masks (Item)}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The '''Masked''', also referred to as the '''Mimic''', is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. While capable of spawning naturally, it also spawns if an employee wears a [[Masks (Item)|mask]] for a certain period of time, causing them to become possessed. When active, it can freely enter and leave the facility, attempting to hunt down employees and imitate their behaviors in order to grab and infect them into more Masked. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Artifice]].

<!--T:65-->
Masked appear as typical employees with orange uniforms, though with a white comedy mask fused to their heads. Their eyes glow a bright pink while they are in the process of infecting employees.

== Bestiary Entry == <!--T:45-->

<!--T:14-->
Cannot be scanned.

== Spawn chances == <!--T:64-->
</translate>
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}
<translate>
== Mechanics == <!--T:47-->

<!--T:16-->
Masked spawn two ways. The first is naturally as an enemy (these will still show up as a blue dot like an employee, but cannot be switched to and teleported on the cameras), while the other is by an employee using a [[Masks (Item)|Mask]]. Tragedy masks and Comedy masks have a 65% chance every 5 seconds to possess and kill the employee holding it up to their face; they are otherwise harmless. If a Masked is spawned this way, it still appears as an employee on [[Ship|cameras]] and can even be teleported. An employee who is killed by putting on a Tragedy mask will produce a Masked with a tragedy mask; all other Masked will have comedy masks.<ref name="tragedymasked" />

<!--T:66-->
Naturally spawned Masked will always wear the default orange suit. Employees converted into Masked who were wearing [[suits]] purchased from the store will retain their original suit.

<!--T:17-->
Masked can detect sound. Upon hearing a sound, they look towards it but may not always move towards the sound's source to investigate.<ref name="mimic_hear_noise" />

<!--T:67-->
Masked can operate the elevator in the [[Interiors|mineshaft interior]].

<!--T:18-->
If the Masked gets in range to attack an employee, it grabs them and vomits blood into their face, converting them into another Masked. This will spawn them with employee properties. This attack can be interrupted if another employee hits the Masked with a [[shovel]].

<!--T:19-->
Despite popular belief, there is no indication that a mask can attach to an employee's body postmortem. An employee killed while holding the mask up to their face will drop it near their body, but if the mask attaches to an employee's face and the employee is killed by other means in the short interval before the mask itself kills them, the employee will have the mask attached to their face with red eyes, and will appear as a dead masked. Note that this scenario does not lead to possession of a dead body, as that is not possible. <ref name="huantedmaskitem_event_loop" />

<!--T:20-->
Masked operate in 3 different modes which determine the majority of their behavior:

=== Roaming === <!--T:48-->

<!--T:5-->
In this state, Masked roam around the map searching for employees and are most easily distinguished on the radar as they look around randomly, often spinning in circles. Masked will also start and stop running based on random chance. This random looking and running adheres to a stamina bar and is governed by the logic described underneath. <ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />

<!--T:21-->
'''Randomly looking''': 
  Every 0.7 to 5 seconds:
  Change direction left or right up to 60 degrees at a time.
  Taking 0.25 to 2 seconds to change.

<!--T:49-->
'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 35%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 20%

<!--T:50-->
'''Randomly stop running''':
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 20%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 70%
 
  -- If a Masked stops running it will set its stamina bar to -6, meaning it is unable to run *randomly* for 11 seconds.

<!--T:22-->
If no employees are inside the facility whilst in the roaming state, a mask will consistently stop its search and head for the exit.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:23-->
While roaming, Masked will check their line of sight for any employee. If an employee is seen, it will switch to the Pursuit state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:24-->
Furthermore, Masked will build up 'interest' in the ship whilst in this state. When enough interest is gathered, they will switch to the Ambush state if the ship is not too far away from their position.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

=== Pursuit === <!--T:51-->

<!--T:6-->
In pursuit mode, the Masked has spotted an employee (or the Masked has been seen in ambush mode) and is pursuing them. When the Masked first enters this state, it stops and stares at the targeted employee for 2 to 5 seconds<ref name="masked_update" />. This timer immediately ends if the Masked is damaged<ref name="masked_hit_enemy" />.

<!--T:25-->
In pursuit mode, it retains eye contact with its target and starts heading towards them. Notably, the running randomly logic differs from the logic in the roaming state. When a Masked is in pursuit, the percentage chance to both stop and start running randomly change significantly.<ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />

<!--T:26-->
'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 11.66%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 6.66%

<!--T:52-->
'''Randomly stop running''': 
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 84%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 94%

<!--T:27-->
Furthermore, if the route to their target is more than 17 units away, they are guaranteed to start running, only stopping when within 12 units of their target or out of stamina.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:28-->
Masked will stop staring at and moving towards an employee if line-of-sight has been broken for at least 3.5 seconds. After this time, Masked will consider their target 'lost in chase', and will start looking for them by walking around. After line-of-sight has been broken for 10 seconds, they revert back to their roaming state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:29-->
Interestingly, Masked broaden but also shorten their field-of-view when in this mode compared to the field-of-view in the roaming state. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 50. Additionally, Masked gain 'proximity awareness' meaning they can 'see' in a circle (of 1 unit) around them.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:30-->
Masked are able to switch their target at any time in this state if another employee is closer in their line-of-sight<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />.

=== Ambush === <!--T:53-->

<!--T:7-->
Masked switch to ambush mode if enough 'interest' has been gathered by roaming the facility. When they are in this state, they start walking towards the ship and look for a spot inside the ship to hide in. <ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:31-->
Whilst moving towards the ship, Masked will lose interest in the ship, eventually returning to a roaming state<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. If a mask is inside the ship, they will no longer lose interest in the ship, staying in this state until seeing an employee or being seen by an employee<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. Whilst waiting in ambush, Masked will crouch. Notably, this is the only time Masked ever crouch.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<!--T:32-->
In this state, Masked change their field of view once again. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 20 if compared to their field of view while roaming.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

== Strategy == <!--T:54-->

<!--T:8-->
It is recommended if you see a Masked to create as much distance and open space as possible, along with making sure all employees know of its existence to not cause more Masked to spawn.

<!--T:33-->
Masked do not retain any [[Spray paint]] on them, allowing possible indication of possession.

<!--T:34-->
If an employee is transforming into a Masked, the animation of the possession is long enough for another employee to kill the Masked. Because of this, with good reaction time and teamwork you can kill any accidental spawns, and at least damage Masked formed from employees turning.

<!--T:35-->
Similar to the [[Forest Keeper|forest keeper]]'s grab, there is a small window to where the employee may be saved by another party especially if multiple employees are present. Hitting the Masked with a melee weapon and killing it, a successful teleport, or stunning it with a [[Stun grenade]], [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or a [[Radar-booster]].

<!--T:36-->
A [[Shovel|shovel]] can dispatch a Masked with relative ease as a shovel has more range than a Masked's grab. Using a [[kitchen knife]] is possible but much riskier due to its short range.

<!--T:37-->
On the monitor, Masked will still seem like employees and there is no visual difference except in their behavior. Masked will frequently spin in circles when roaming. Employees turned into Masked will be seen as normal employees, despite the Masked behavior of the employee and can still be teleported, bringing danger to other employees on the ship. Masked that are not employees (i.e. spawned Masked) will not have a switchable spot on the monitor, therefore giving clues as to where a Masked is.

<!--T:68-->
The [[inverse teleporter]] cannot remove a Masked from the ship.

<!--T:38-->
Masked also seem to be capable of simple strategy, as groups of 2 or 3 will coordinate to trap employees. This is most evident when by the ship as one masked will usually hide inside while the others patrol the area around the ship.

<!--T:39-->
Masked can be hurt by [[eyeless dog]]s when coming into contact with them, but eyeless dogs do not intentionally attack Masked. [[Old Bird]]s target all entities within their field of vision, including Masked. [[Baboon hawk]]s can attack Masked if they remain in proximity for prolonged periods of time, but this is uncommon, even on [[Adamance]].

######## Masked/cs
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity|id=MaskedPlayerEnemy
| name = Maskovaný
| altname = Maskovaný, Mimika
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 0
| max_spawned = 10
| pip_size = Hráč
| door_speed_multiplier = 2
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}
| stun_multiplier = 0.75
| attack_damage = Instant kill
| cause_of_death = Strangulation
}}
{{about|the enemy|the scrap item|Masks (Item)}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Entity známe jako "Maskovaný", také zvané "Masky" nebo "Mimiky", mají schopnost vzít vzhled běžných zaměstnanců. Vizuálně vypadají nezřetelně od běžných zaměstnanců kromě jejich [[Masks (Item)|Tragické/Komedické masky]] na jejich obličeji a standartní oranžový oblek. Masky se toulají po zařízením s primárním cílem ulovit  jakéhokoliv zaměstnance na které narážejí. Masky se mohou skrčit, ale můžou jenom jestli se schovávají na lodi, čekající ať mohou přepadnout zaměstnance.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked appear as typical employees with orange uniforms, though with a white comedy mask fused to their heads. Their eyes glow a bright pink while they are in the process of infecting employees.
</div>

<span id="Bestiary_Entry"></span>
== Zápis v Bestiáři ==

Nemůže být v současné době skenovaný.

== Spawn chances ==
</div>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mechaniky ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Současně, Masky se mohou objevit dvěma cestami. První je za nepřítele (ty se pořád budou objevovat jako modrá tečka jako zaměstnanec, ale nemůže se na ně přepnout ani teleportovaný přes kamery), zatímco druhá je když zaměstnanec používá [[Masks (Item)|Masku]]. Tragické a Komediální masky mají 65% šanci každých 5 sekund na ovládnutí a zabití zaměstnance který ji drží u obličeje; jsou bezpečné jestli jsou jenom v inventáři. Jestli Maskovaný se objevil touhle cestou, stále se bude zobrazovat jako zaměstnanec, a může se ho pořád ovládnutého zaměstnance sledovat přes [[Ship/cs|kamery]] a také je možný být teleportován.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Naturally spawned Masked will always wear the default orange suit. Employees converted into Masked who were wearing [[suits]] purchased from the store will retain their original suit.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskovaní '''mohou''' slyšet zvuk. Jak jeden uslyší a podívají se směrem k němu, ale občas za ním nepůjdou ke zdroji zvuku.<ref name="mimic_hear_noise" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked can operate the elevator in the [[Interiors|mineshaft interior]].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jestli Maskovaný je v rozsahu aby mohl zaútočit na zaměstnance, vezme ho a začne chrlit krev na jejich obličej, což je promění do dalšího Maskovaného. Takhle budou mít vlastnosti zaměstnance.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Navzdory všeobecnému přesvědčení, není žádná indikace že maska se může připevnit na tělo zaměstnance posmrtně. Avšak, zaměstnanec zabit když drží masku k obličeji ji budou mít připevněnou na obličeji, ale jestli maska se připevní k obličeji zaměstnance a je potom zabit, zaměstnanec bude mít masku připevněnou k obličeji s červenýma očima a bude vypadat jako mrtvý Maskovaný. Všimněte si, že při tomhle scénáři se nestane ovládnutí mrtvého těla, to není možné. <ref name="huantedmaskitem_event_loop" />
</div>

Masky fungují ve třech různých módů což určuje většinu jejich chování:

=== Roaming ===

V tomto stavu Masky se toulají po mapě a hledají zaměstnance a jsou lehce rozlišeni na radar že se náhodně dívají kolem , občas se točí v kruzích. Masky také začnou a přestanou běhat na náhodné šanci. Tohle náhodné dívání kolem a běhání se dodržuje podle stamina baru a řídí se podle ligiky popsanou pod. <ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />

'''Náhodné hledání''':
  Každých 0.7 až 5 sekund:
  Změnit směr doleva nebo doprava až o 60 stupňů najednou.
  Trvání 0.25 až 2 sekund změnit.

'''Náhodný začátek běhání''':
  JESTLI neběhá:
    JESTLI má alespoň 5 sekund výdrže:
      JESTLI venku: šance začít běhat = 35%
      NENÍ venku: šance začít běhat = 20%

'''Náhodné zastavení běhání''':
  JESTLI už běhá:
    JESTLI výdrž = 0: Přestat běhat ihned
    JINAK:
      JESTLI venku: šance zastavit běh = 20%
      NENÍ venku: šance zastavit běh = 70%
  -- Jestli Maska přestane běhat náhodně si nastaví bar výdrže na -6, což znamená že nebude moct *náhodně* běhat 11 sekund.

Jestli žádný zaměstnanec je vevnitř zařízení když je v roaming stavu, Maska hned zastaví svoje hledání a půjde přímo do východu.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Při roamingu, Masky zkontrolují své zorné pole pro nějakého zaměstnance. Jestli jednoho uvidí, hned se změní na Pronásledovací stav.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Navíc, Masky si vybuduje 'zájem' v loď v tomhle stavu. Když dost zájmu je shromážděno, změní se na Přepadoví stav jestli loď není moc daleko od jejich pozice.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<span id="Pursuit"></span>
=== Pronásledování ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jestli Maska spatřila zaměstnance (nebo někdo ji viděl v přepadovém stavu) a pronásleduje je. Když maska poprvé vstoupí do tohoto stavu, zastaví a bude zírat na cíleného zaměstnance 2 až 5 sekund<ref name="masked_update" />. Tenhle časovač ihned zastaví jestli je Maskovaný zraněn<ref name="masked_hit_enemy" />.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
V pronásledujícím stavu udržuje oční kontakt s jejím cílem a začne chodit k nim. Význačně, náhodné běhání se liší od logiky ve roamingovým stavu. Jestli Maska je v pronásledování, procentová šance k aby zastavil i začal běhat se náhodně výrazně změní.<ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />
</div>

'''Náhodný začátek běhání:'''
  JESTLI neběhá:
    JESTLI má alespoň 5 sekund výdrže:
      JESTLI venku: šance začít běhat = 11.66%
      NENÍ venku: šance začít běhat = 6.66%

'''Náhodné zastavení běhání''':
  JESTLI už běhá:
    JESTLI výdrž = 0: Přestat běhat ihned
    JINAK:
      JESTLI venku: šance zastavit běh = 84%
      NENÍ venku: šance zastavit běh = 94%

Mimoto, pokud cesta k jejich cíli je více než 17 jednotek daleko, jsou zaručeni začít běhat, jenom zastaví až jsou 12 jednotek daleko od cíle nebo jim došla výdrž.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Masky občas přestanou zírat a hýbat se ke zaměstnanci jestli přímá viditelnost není pro alespoň 3.5 sekund. Po tomhle času, Masky zváží jejich cíl za 'ztracen v pronásledováním', a začnou je hledat tím že budou kolem chodit. Jestli není přímá viditelnost pro 10 sekund, změní se na jejich roaming stav.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Zajímavě, Maskovaní rozšíří ale taky zkrátí jejich zorné, pole když jsou v tomhle stavu oproti zorného pole v jejich roaming stavu. Jde od šířky 45 a vzdálenosti 60 na šířku 70 a vzdálenost 50. Dodatečně, Masky dostanou 'vědomí blízkosti', což znamená že 'vidí' do kruhu' (1 jednotky) kolem jich.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Je důležité poznamenat že Masky si mohou změnit cíl kdykoli jsou v tomhle stavu jestli je další zaměstnanec blíž v jejich zorném poli<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />.
</div>

<span id="Ambush"></span>
=== Přepadení ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskovaní si změní na tenhle mód  jestli dost 'zájmu' je nasbírán roamingem zařízení. Když jsou v tomhle stavu začnou chodit do lodě, kde potom hledají místo kam se schovat. <ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

Když chodí k lodi. Masky ztrácí zájem v loď, časem se vrátí do roaming stavu<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. Jestli Maska je v lodi, přestane ztrácet v loď zájem, takže v tomhle stavu zůstane dokud nespatří zaměstnance nebo jestli je viděl zaměstnanec<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. Když čekají v záloze, Maskovaní se skrčí. Význačně, tohle je jediný čas kdy se Masky skrčí.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

V tomhle stavu, Masky si znovu změní zorné pole. Ze šířky 45 a vzdálenosti 60 na šířky 70 a vzdálenosti 20 jestli porovnán k zorném poli při roamingu.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

Je doporučeno jestli uvidíte Maskovaného abyste dostali so největší vzdálenost v otevřeném prostou jak je to možno, zatímco si dáváte pozor že všichni zaměstnanci ví o jeho existenci aby se neobjevili další Maskovaní.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskovaní neuchovávají žádnou [[Spray Paint|Bravu ve spreji]] na nich, což umožňuje indikaci ovládnutí.
</div>

Jestli zaměstnanec se proměňuje do Maskovaného, animace je dost dlouhá na zabití Maskovaného, kvůli tomu s dobrou reakční dobou a spoluprací můžete zabít jakékoliv náhodné objevení a alespoň ublížit Maskovaného proměněn ze zaměstnance.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Podobně k chvatu [[Forest Keeper/cs|lesního strážce]], je malé okno kde může zaměstnanec být zachráněn jinou partii hlavně když více zaměstnanců je přítomno. Ublížením Maskovaného se zbraní na blízko a zabíjení jej, povedený teleport nebo omráčení se [[Stun Grenade/cs|omračujícím granátem]], [[Homemade Flashbang|domácím flashbangem]], [[Zap Gun/cs|zapovací pistolí]] nebo [[Radar Booster/cs|radarovým posilovačem]].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
[[Shovel/cs|Lopata]] může vyslat Maskovaného docela lehce, protože lopata má větší rozsah než chvat Maskovaného.
</div>

Na monitoru, Maskovaní vypadají jako zaměstnanci a není žádný viditelný rozdíl v jejich chování. Masky se obvykle točí v kruhu při roamingu. Zaměstnanci proměnění do Maskovaného budou viditelný jako normální zaměstnanec i při chování Maskovaného a mohou pořád býti teleportováni, přinášející nebezpečí k ostatním zaměstnancům na lodi. Maskovaní kteří nejsou zaměstnanci (např. objevený Maskovaný) nebudou mít přepínatelné místo na monitoru, což napovídá kde Maskovaný je.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The [[inverse teleporter]] cannot remove a Masked from the ship.
</div>

Maskovaní jsou možné jednoduché strategie, protože skupiny 2 nebo 3 se začnou koordinovat aby dali zaměstnance do pasti. Tohle je nejvíce evidentní u lodě, zatímco 1 maskovaný se bude schovávat ve lodi ostatní budou zatím patrolovat kolem lodi.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskovaní mohou být ublíženi [[eyeless dog/cs|nevidomými psy]] jestli dosáhnou kontaktu s nimi, ale nevidomý psi přímo neútočí na maskované.
</div>

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Drobnosti ==
* Maskovaní i přes navzdory všeobecného přesvědčení, '''NEJSOU''' inspirováni [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-035 SCP 035], jak bylo uvedeno v patreonu.
* Zaměstnanci zabiti Maskou nepustí jejich předměty ani šrot.
* Také existuje něco jako "Masková Ruleta", kde všichni zaměstnanci se střídají mezi tím, kdo si nasadí masku a kdokoli se stane Maskovaný je zabit, což dělá hru nebezpečně zábavnou.
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* Both living and dead Masked can make the same laughing noises as the comedy mask item.
</div>

<span id="History"></span>
== Historie ==
=== {{section heading/Version X|69}} ===
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Fixed some wonky behavior with the masked enemy that had to do with the elevator.
</div>

=== [[Version 49|Verze 49]] ===
Neznámý hotfix.

=== [[Version 47|Verze 47]] ===
Spravil se problém který se stal když maskovaný byl vyrušen když přeměňoval zaměstnance, tak se mohlo stát že zaměstnanec bude zaseklý a nemohl hýbat s jejich myší a synchronizovat pozici s ostatními zaměstnanci.

Zabráněno případu kde maskovaný mohl vytvořit mnoho duplikátu stejného zaměstnance jestli nějakým způsobem nemohl zaměstnanec zemřít, což potom následoval chaos.

=== [[Version 45|Verze 45]] ===
Představen.

######## Masked/de
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity|id=MaskedPlayerEnemy

{{about|the enemy|the scrap item|Masks (Item)}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Kreaturen die als "Maskierte", "Masken" oder "Mimics" bekannt sind, sehen aus wie reguläre Spieler. Das einzige optische Merkmal, das sie von normalen Spielern unterscheidet, ist die von ihnen getragene [[Masks (Item)|Komödien-/Tragödienmaske]]. Maskierte wandeln in den Innenräumen umher, mit dem Hauptziel jeden Spieler zu jagen dem sie über den Weg laufen.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked appear as typical employees with orange uniforms, though with a white comedy mask fused to their heads. Their eyes glow a bright pink while they are in the process of infecting employees.
</div>

<span id="Bestiary_Entry"></span>
== Eintrag im Bestiarium ==

Maskierte können zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt nicht gescannt werden und haben keinen Eintrag im Bestiarium.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Spawn chances ==
</div>
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Spielmechaniken ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Momentan gibt es zwei Möglichkeiten für Maskierte aufzutreten: 
Zuerst können sie gewöhnlich als Gegner erscheinen. In diesem Fall erscheinen sie auf dem Radar wie normale Spieler, man kann sie aber nicht mit dem Radar verfolgen oder teleportieren.
Für die zweite Methode, muss ein Mitarbeiter eine [[Masks (Items)|Maske]] aufsetzen. Diese hat alle 5 Sekunden eine 65% Chance den Spieler zu töten und dadurch in einen Maskierten zu verwandeln. Wird ein Maskierter auf diesem Wege erschaffen, taucht er als normaler Spieler auf und kann per [[Ship|Radar]] verfolgt oder teleportiert werden.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Naturally spawned Masked will always wear the default orange suit. Employees converted into Masked who were wearing [[suits]] purchased from the store will retain their original suit.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Maskierten '''können''' Geräusche wahrnehmen. Hören sie ein Geräusch, sehen sie in die entsprechende Richtung. Allerdings laufen sie nicht unbedingt zur Quelle.<ref name=mimic_hear_noise><code>DetectNoise</code> - https://pastebin.com/hKviAUFy</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked can operate the elevator in the [[Interiors|mineshaft interior]].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kommt ein Maskierter nah genug an einen Spieler, greift er diesen und speit Blut über ihn. Der Spieler wird dadurch in einen weiteren Maskierten verwandelt, der (wie beim Aufsetzen der Maske) Spielereigenschaften hat.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Es gibt keinen Hinweis darauf, dass Maskierte von einer Leiche im Nachhinein Besitz ergreifen können.<ref name=huantedmaskitem_event_loop><code>HauntedMaskItem</code> main event loop - https://pastebin.com/dEmHqCJr</ref>
</div>

Maskierte agieren in 3 verschiedenen Modi, die einen Großteil ihres Verhaltens bestimmen:

<span id="Roaming"></span>
=== Wandelnd ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
In diesem Zustand suchen die Maskierten nach Spielern und wandeln über die Karte. So können sie am leichtesten auf dem Radar erkannt werden, da sie sich zufällig umsehen, dabei oft im Kreis drehen und auch zufällig losrennen. Dieses Verhalten basiert auf einer Ausdauerleiste und der folgenden Logik.<ref name=look_and_run_randomly_masked><code>LookAndRunRandomly</code> - https://pastebin.com/NqBTmZEC</ref>
</div>

'''Zufällig Umsehen''':
  Alle 0,7 bis 5 Sekunden: 
  Bis zu 60° auf einmal nach rechts oder links drehen.
  0,25 bis 2 Sekunden Dauer zum Ändern.

'''Zufällig Rennen starten''':
  FALLS nicht am Laufen: 
     FALLS mindestens 5 Sekunden Ausdauer vorhanden: 
        FALLS an der Oberfläche: Chance Rennen starten = 35%
        NICHT an der Oberfläche: Chance Rennen starten = 20%

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Zufällig Rennen beenden''': 
  FALLS bereits am Rennen:
     FALLS Ausdauer = 0: Sofort beenden
     SONST:
        FALLS an der Oberfläche: Chance Rennen zu beenden = 20%
        NICHT an der Oberfläche: Chance Rennen zu beenden = 70%

  -- Wenn ein Maskierter das Rennen beendet, wird seine Ausdauer auf -6 gesetzt. Das bedeutet er kann *zufällig* 11 Sekunden lang nicht rennen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ist ein Maskierter im Wandeln-Zustand, während sich kein Spieler in den Innenräumen befindet, bricht er seine Suche ab und begibt sich in Richtung des Ausgangs.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked><code>DoAiInterval</code> - https://pastebin.com/RewHgkNe</ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Im Wandelnd-Zustand überprüfen Maskierte ihre Sichtlinie nach Mitarbeitern. Wird ein Mitarbeiter gesehen, geht der Maskierte in den Verfolgung-Zustand über.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
In diesem Zustand bauen Maskierte außerdem 'Interesse' am Schiff auf. Ist ausreichend Interesse aufgebaut, gehen Maskierte in den Überfall-Zustand über, solange das Schiff nicht zu weit von ihrer Position entfernt ist.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<span id="Pursuit"></span>
=== Verfolgung ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ein Maskierter hat einen Mitarbeiter erkannt (oder der Maskierte wurde im Überfall Modus gesehen) und verfolgt ihn. Wenn der Maskierte in diesen Zustand wechselt, stoppt er und starrt das Ziel für 2 bis 5 Sekunden an<ref name=masked_update><code>Update</code> - https://pastebin.com/v35bTvw4</ref>. Diese Zeit wird sofort abgebrochen, wenn der Maskierte Schaden erleidet<ref name=masked_hit_enemy><code>HitEnemy</code> - https://pastebin.com/G1r1uzRX</ref>.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Im Verfolgungsmodus hält der Maskierte Augenkontakt mit seinem Ziel und beginnt auf es zuzulaufen. Zusätzlich ändert sich die Logik für das zufällige Rennen in diesem Zustand. Die Wahrscheinlichkeiten loszurennen und wieder normal zu laufen ändern sich deutlich.<ref name=look_and_run_randomly_masked></ref>
</div>

'''Zufällig Rennen starten''': 
  FALLS nicht am Laufen: 
     FALLS mindestens 5 Sekunden Ausdauer vorhanden: 
        FALLS an der Oberfläche: Rennen starten = 11,66%
        NICHT an der Oberfläche: Rennen starten = 6,66%

'''Zufällig Rennen beenden''': 
  FALLS am Laufen: 
     FALLS Ausdauer = 0: Sofort beenden
     SONST: 
        FALLS an der Oberfläche: Chance Rennen zu beenden= 84%
        NICHT an der Oberfläche: Chance Rennen zu beenden= 94%

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ist der Maskierte weiter als 17 Einheiten von seinem Ziel entfernt, fängt er an zu rennen und stoppt erst wenn er innerhalb von 12 Einheiten ist oder keine Ausdauer mehr hat.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskierte hören mit dem Anstarren auf und laufen auf den Mitarbeiter zu, falls ihre Sichtlinie für mindestens 3,5 Sekunden gebrochen wird. Nach dieser Zeitspanne behandeln sie ihr Ziel als 'auf der Jagd verloren' und suchen nach ihm. Bleibt die Sichtlinie für 10 Sekunden gebrochen, gehen sie in ihren Wandelnd-Status zurück.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Interessanterweise ändert sich das Sichtfeld der Maskierten in diesem Zustand von einer Breite/Länge von 45/60 im Wandelnd-Zustand auf eine Breite/Länge von 70/50. Außerdem können sie innerhalb von 1 Einheit im Kreis um sich sehen.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Weiterhin wichtig ist, dass Maskierte in diesem Zustand ihr Ziel jederzeit auf einen näheren Mitarbeiter ändern können, solange dieser sich in ihrem Sichtfeld befindet<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>.
</div>

<span id="Ambush"></span>
=== Überfall ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskierte wechseln in diesen Modus wenn genug 'Interesse' beim Wandeln der Innenräume aufgebaut wurde. In diesem Zustand laufen sie in Richtung Schiff und suchen dort nach einem Versteck.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Während sie auf das Schiff zulaufen, verlieren sie Interesse am Schiff und kehren in den Wandelnd-Modus zurück, wenn sie zu viel Interesse verlieren<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>. Erreicht ein Maskierter hingegen das Schiff, verliert er kein Interesse mehr und bleibt in diesem Zustand, bis er einen Mitarbeiter sieht oder selbst gesehen wird<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>. Beim Warten bleibt der Maskierte geduckt in seinem Versteck. Dies ist auch der einzige Zeitpunkt zu dem sie sich ducken.<ref name=do_ai_interval_masked></ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
In diesem Zustand ändern die Maskierten ihr Sichtfeld wieder. Sie gehen im Vergleich zu ihrem Wandelnd-Zustand von einer Breite/Länge von 45/60 zu einer Breite/Länge von 70/20 über.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Begegnet man einem Maskierte wird empfohlen sich so weit wie möglich von ihm zu entfernen und alle Spieler über seine Existenz in Kenntnis zu setzen, damit keine weiteren Maskierten entstehen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Sprüht man einen Maskierten mit dem [[Spray Paint|Farbspray]] an, bleibt keine Farbe an ihm haften.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Wird ein Spieler in einen Maskierten verwandelt, ist die Animation lang genug um den Maskierten zu töten. So kann mit guter Reaktionszeit und Teamwork ein neu entstandener Maskierter getötet und ein weiterer Maskierter zumindest verletzt werden.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ähnlich wie beim Griff der [[Forest Keeper|Waldhüter]] gibt es ein kleines Fenster während dem ein Spieler von einem anderen Spieler gerettet werden kann. Hierfür kann der gegriffene Spieler teleportiert werden oder der Maskierte mit einer Waffe getötet oder betäubt werden.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Da [[Shovel|Schaufeln]] eine größere Reichweite als die Maskierten haben, kann ein bewaffneter Spieler einen Maskierten recht leicht besiegen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Auf dem Monitor sehen Maskierte aus wie normale Spieler und ihr einziges Erkennungsmerkmal ist ihr Verhalten. Sie drehen sich oft im Kreis, während sie durch die Gänge laufen.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The [[inverse teleporter]] cannot remove a Masked from the ship.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskierte scheinen auch simple Strategien ausführen zu können. Gruppen von 2 oder 3 arbeiten häufig zusammen, um Spieler in eine Falle zu locken. Das beste Beispiel hierfür ist in der Nähe des Schiffs, wo ein Maskierter sich normalerweise im Schiff versteckt, während alle anderen das Gebiet um das Schiff ablaufen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Maskierte können von augenlosen Hunden verletzt werden, obwohl diese sie nicht absichtlich angreifen.
</div>

######## Masked/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity|id=MaskedPlayerEnemy
| name = Masked
| altname = Mimic
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 0
| max_spawned = 10
| pip_size = Player
| door_speed_multiplier = 2
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}

| attack_damage = Instant kill
| cause_of_death = Strangulation

{{about|the enemy|the scrap item|Masks (Item)}}
The '''Masked''', also referred to as the '''Mimic''', is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. While capable of spawning naturally, it also spawns if an employee wears a [[Masks (Item)|mask]] for a certain period of time, causing them to become possessed. When active, it can freely enter and leave the facility, attempting to hunt down employees and imitate their behaviors in order to grab and infect them into more Masked. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Artifice]].

Masked appear as typical employees with orange uniforms, though with a white comedy mask fused to their heads. Their eyes glow a bright pink while they are in the process of infecting employees.

== Bestiary Entry ==

Cannot be scanned.

== Spawn chances ==
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}
== Mechanics ==

Masked spawn two ways. The first is naturally as an enemy (these will still show up as a blue dot like an employee, but cannot be switched to and teleported on the cameras), while the other is by an employee using a [[Masks (Item)|Mask]]. Tragedy masks and Comedy masks have a 65% chance every 5 seconds to possess and kill the employee holding it up to their face; they are otherwise harmless. If a Masked is spawned this way, it still appears as an employee on [[Ship|cameras]] and can even be teleported. An employee who is killed by putting on a Tragedy mask will produce a Masked with a tragedy mask; all other Masked will have comedy masks.<ref name="tragedymasked" />

Naturally spawned Masked will always wear the default orange suit. Employees converted into Masked who were wearing [[suits]] purchased from the store will retain their original suit.

Masked can detect sound. Upon hearing a sound, they look towards it but may not always move towards the sound's source to investigate.<ref name="mimic_hear_noise" />

Masked can operate the elevator in the [[Interiors|mineshaft interior]].

If the Masked gets in range to attack an employee, it grabs them and vomits blood into their face, converting them into another Masked. This will spawn them with employee properties. This attack can be interrupted if another employee hits the Masked with a [[shovel]].

Despite popular belief, there is no indication that a mask can attach to an employee's body postmortem. An employee killed while holding the mask up to their face will drop it near their body, but if the mask attaches to an employee's face and the employee is killed by other means in the short interval before the mask itself kills them, the employee will have the mask attached to their face with red eyes, and will appear as a dead masked. Note that this scenario does not lead to possession of a dead body, as that is not possible. <ref name="huantedmaskitem_event_loop" />

Masked operate in 3 different modes which determine the majority of their behavior:

=== Roaming ===

In this state, Masked roam around the map searching for employees and are most easily distinguished on the radar as they look around randomly, often spinning in circles. Masked will also start and stop running based on random chance. This random looking and running adheres to a stamina bar and is governed by the logic described underneath. <ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />

'''Randomly looking''': 
  Every 0.7 to 5 seconds:
  Change direction left or right up to 60 degrees at a time.
  Taking 0.25 to 2 seconds to change.

'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 35%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 20%

'''Randomly stop running''':
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 20%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 70%
 
  -- If a Masked stops running it will set its stamina bar to -6, meaning it is unable to run *randomly* for 11 seconds.

If no employees are inside the facility whilst in the roaming state, a mask will consistently stop its search and head for the exit.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

While roaming, Masked will check their line of sight for any employee. If an employee is seen, it will switch to the Pursuit state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Furthermore, Masked will build up 'interest' in the ship whilst in this state. When enough interest is gathered, they will switch to the Ambush state if the ship is not too far away from their position.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

=== Pursuit ===

In pursuit mode, the Masked has spotted an employee (or the Masked has been seen in ambush mode) and is pursuing them. When the Masked first enters this state, it stops and stares at the targeted employee for 2 to 5 seconds<ref name="masked_update" />. This timer immediately ends if the Masked is damaged<ref name="masked_hit_enemy" />.

In pursuit mode, it retains eye contact with its target and starts heading towards them. Notably, the running randomly logic differs from the logic in the roaming state. When a Masked is in pursuit, the percentage chance to both stop and start running randomly change significantly.<ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />

'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 11.66%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 6.66%

'''Randomly stop running''': 
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 84%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 94%

Furthermore, if the route to their target is more than 17 units away, they are guaranteed to start running, only stopping when within 12 units of their target or out of stamina.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Masked will stop staring at and moving towards an employee if line-of-sight has been broken for at least 3.5 seconds. After this time, Masked will consider their target 'lost in chase', and will start looking for them by walking around. After line-of-sight has been broken for 10 seconds, they revert back to their roaming state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Interestingly, Masked broaden but also shorten their field-of-view when in this mode compared to the field-of-view in the roaming state. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 50. Additionally, Masked gain 'proximity awareness' meaning they can 'see' in a circle (of 1 unit) around them.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Masked are able to switch their target at any time in this state if another employee is closer in their line-of-sight<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />.

=== Ambush ===

Masked switch to ambush mode if enough 'interest' has been gathered by roaming the facility. When they are in this state, they start walking towards the ship and look for a spot inside the ship to hide in. <ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

Whilst moving towards the ship, Masked will lose interest in the ship, eventually returning to a roaming state<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. If a mask is inside the ship, they will no longer lose interest in the ship, staying in this state until seeing an employee or being seen by an employee<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. Whilst waiting in ambush, Masked will crouch. Notably, this is the only time Masked ever crouch.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

In this state, Masked change their field of view once again. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 20 if compared to their field of view while roaming.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />

== Strategy ==

It is recommended if you see a Masked to create as much distance and open space as possible, along with making sure all employees know of its existence to not cause more Masked to spawn.

Masked do not retain any [[Spray paint]] on them, allowing possible indication of possession.

If an employee is transforming into a Masked, the animation of the possession is long enough for another employee to kill the Masked. Because of this, with good reaction time and teamwork you can kill any accidental spawns, and at least damage Masked formed from employees turning.

Similar to the [[Forest Keeper|forest keeper]]'s grab, there is a small window to where the employee may be saved by another party especially if multiple employees are present. Hitting the Masked with a melee weapon and killing it, a successful teleport, or stunning it with a [[Stun grenade]], [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or a [[Radar-booster]].

A [[Shovel|shovel]] can dispatch a Masked with relative ease as a shovel has more range than a Masked's grab. Using a [[kitchen knife]] is possible but much riskier due to its short range.

On the monitor, Masked will still seem like employees and there is no visual difference except in their behavior. Masked will frequently spin in circles when roaming. Employees turned into Masked will be seen as normal employees, despite the Masked behavior of the employee and can still be teleported, bringing danger to other employees on the ship. Masked that are not employees (i.e. spawned Masked) will not have a switchable spot on the monitor, therefore giving clues as to where a Masked is.

The [[inverse teleporter]] cannot remove a Masked from the ship.

Masked also seem to be capable of simple strategy, as groups of 2 or 3 will coordinate to trap employees. This is most evident when by the ship as one masked will usually hide inside while the others patrol the area around the ship.

Masked can be hurt by [[eyeless dog]]s when coming into contact with them, but eyeless dogs do not intentionally attack Masked. [[Old Bird]]s target all entities within their field of vision, including Masked. [[Baboon hawk]]s can attack Masked if they remain in proximity for prolonged periods of time, but this is uncommon, even on [[Adamance]].

== Trivia ==
* Masked are, despite popular belief, '''NOT''' inspired by [https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-035 SCP 035], as stated in a patreon post.
* Employees killed by a Masked do not drop items or scrap.
* There is such thing as "Mask Roulette", where all employees take a turn putting on a mask, and whoever gets Masked is killed, therefore making the game dangerously fun.
* Both living and dead Masked can make the same laughing noises as the comedy mask item.

== History ==
=== {{section heading/Version X|69}} ===
Fixed some wonky behavior with the masked enemy that had to do with the elevator.

=== [[Version 49]] ===
Unknown hotfix.

=== [[Version 47]] ===
Fixed an issue which occurred when the masked enemy was interrupted while converting an employee, which could result in the employee becoming stuck or unable to move their mouse and sync position to other employees.

Prevented a case where the masked enemy could create dozens of duplicates of the same employee if that employee was somehow not allowed to die, resulting in chaos.

=== [[Version 45]] ===
Introduced.

[[Category:Entities]]

######## Masked/pl
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity|id=MaskedPlayerEnemy
| name = <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Masked</span>
| altname = <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Mimic</span>
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 0
| max_spawned = 10
| pip_size = <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Player</span>
| door_speed_multiplier = 2
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}
| stun_multiplier = 0.75
| attack_damage = Instant kill
| cause_of_death = Strangulation
}}
{{about|the enemy|the scrap item|Masks (Item)}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The '''Masked''', also referred to as the '''Mimic''', is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. While capable of spawning naturally, it also spawns if an employee wears a [[Masks (Item)|mask]] for a certain period of time, causing them to become possessed. When active, it can freely enter and leave the facility, attempting to hunt down employees and imitate their behaviors in order to grab and infect them into more Masked. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Artifice]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked appear as typical employees with orange uniforms, though with a white comedy mask fused to their heads. Their eyes glow a bright pink while they are in the process of infecting employees.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Bestiary Entry ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Cannot be scanned.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Spawn chances ==
</div>
{{WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances|MaskedPlayerEnemy}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Mechanics ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked spawn two ways. The first is naturally as an enemy (these will still show up as a blue dot like an employee, but cannot be switched to and teleported on the cameras), while the other is by an employee using a [[Masks (Item)|Mask]]. Tragedy masks and Comedy masks have a 65% chance every 5 seconds to possess and kill the employee holding it up to their face; they are otherwise harmless. If a Masked is spawned this way, it still appears as an employee on [[Ship|cameras]] and can even be teleported. An employee who is killed by putting on a Tragedy mask will produce a Masked with a tragedy mask; all other Masked will have comedy masks.<ref name="tragedymasked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Naturally spawned Masked will always wear the default orange suit. Employees converted into Masked who were wearing [[suits]] purchased from the store will retain their original suit.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked can detect sound. Upon hearing a sound, they look towards it but may not always move towards the sound's source to investigate.<ref name="mimic_hear_noise" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked can operate the elevator in the [[Interiors|mineshaft interior]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the Masked gets in range to attack an employee, it grabs them and vomits blood into their face, converting them into another Masked. This will spawn them with employee properties. This attack can be interrupted if another employee hits the Masked with a [[shovel]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Despite popular belief, there is no indication that a mask can attach to an employee's body postmortem. An employee killed while holding the mask up to their face will drop it near their body, but if the mask attaches to an employee's face and the employee is killed by other means in the short interval before the mask itself kills them, the employee will have the mask attached to their face with red eyes, and will appear as a dead masked. Note that this scenario does not lead to possession of a dead body, as that is not possible. <ref name="huantedmaskitem_event_loop" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked operate in 3 different modes which determine the majority of their behavior:
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Roaming ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In this state, Masked roam around the map searching for employees and are most easily distinguished on the radar as they look around randomly, often spinning in circles. Masked will also start and stop running based on random chance. This random looking and running adheres to a stamina bar and is governed by the logic described underneath. <ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly looking''': 
  Every 0.7 to 5 seconds:
  Change direction left or right up to 60 degrees at a time.
  Taking 0.25 to 2 seconds to change.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 35%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 20%
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly stop running''':
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 20%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 70%
 
  -- If a Masked stops running it will set its stamina bar to -6, meaning it is unable to run *randomly* for 11 seconds.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If no employees are inside the facility whilst in the roaming state, a mask will consistently stop its search and head for the exit.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While roaming, Masked will check their line of sight for any employee. If an employee is seen, it will switch to the Pursuit state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furthermore, Masked will build up 'interest' in the ship whilst in this state. When enough interest is gathered, they will switch to the Ambush state if the ship is not too far away from their position.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Pursuit ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In pursuit mode, the Masked has spotted an employee (or the Masked has been seen in ambush mode) and is pursuing them. When the Masked first enters this state, it stops and stares at the targeted employee for 2 to 5 seconds<ref name="masked_update" />. This timer immediately ends if the Masked is damaged<ref name="masked_hit_enemy" />.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In pursuit mode, it retains eye contact with its target and starts heading towards them. Notably, the running randomly logic differs from the logic in the roaming state. When a Masked is in pursuit, the percentage chance to both stop and start running randomly change significantly.<ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 11.66%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 6.66%
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly stop running''': 
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 84%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 94%
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furthermore, if the route to their target is more than 17 units away, they are guaranteed to start running, only stopping when within 12 units of their target or out of stamina.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked will stop staring at and moving towards an employee if line-of-sight has been broken for at least 3.5 seconds. After this time, Masked will consider their target 'lost in chase', and will start looking for them by walking around. After line-of-sight has been broken for 10 seconds, they revert back to their roaming state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Interestingly, Masked broaden but also shorten their field-of-view when in this mode compared to the field-of-view in the roaming state. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 50. Additionally, Masked gain 'proximity awareness' meaning they can 'see' in a circle (of 1 unit) around them.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked are able to switch their target at any time in this state if another employee is closer in their line-of-sight<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Ambush ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked switch to ambush mode if enough 'interest' has been gathered by roaming the facility. When they are in this state, they start walking towards the ship and look for a spot inside the ship to hide in. <ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Whilst moving towards the ship, Masked will lose interest in the ship, eventually returning to a roaming state<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. If a mask is inside the ship, they will no longer lose interest in the ship, staying in this state until seeing an employee or being seen by an employee<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. Whilst waiting in ambush, Masked will crouch. Notably, this is the only time Masked ever crouch.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In this state, Masked change their field of view once again. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 20 if compared to their field of view while roaming.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is recommended if you see a Masked to create as much distance and open space as possible, along with making sure all employees know of its existence to not cause more Masked to spawn.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked do not retain any [[Spray paint]] on them, allowing possible indication of possession.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an employee is transforming into a Masked, the animation of the possession is long enough for another employee to kill the Masked. Because of this, with good reaction time and teamwork you can kill any accidental spawns, and at least damage Masked formed from employees turning.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Similar to the [[Forest Keeper|forest keeper]]'s grab, there is a small window to where the employee may be saved by another party especially if multiple employees are present. Hitting the Masked with a melee weapon and killing it, a successful teleport, or stunning it with a [[Stun grenade]], [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or a [[Radar-booster]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A [[Shovel|shovel]] can dispatch a Masked with relative ease as a shovel has more range than a Masked's grab. Using a [[kitchen knife]] is possible but much riskier due to its short range.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
On the monitor, Masked will still seem like employees and there is no visual difference except in their behavior. Masked will frequently spin in circles when roaming. Employees turned into Masked will be seen as normal employees, despite the Masked behavior of the employee and can still be teleported, bringing danger to other employees on the ship. Masked that are not employees (i.e. spawned Masked) will not have a switchable spot on the monitor, therefore giving clues as to where a Masked is.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The [[inverse teleporter]] cannot remove a Masked from the ship.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked also seem to be capable of simple strategy, as groups of 2 or 3 will coordinate to trap employees. This is most evident when by the ship as one masked will usually hide inside while the others patrol the area around the ship.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked can be hurt by [[eyeless dog]]s when coming into contact with them, but eyeless dogs do not intentionally attack Masked. [[Old Bird]]s target all entities within their field of vision, including Masked. [[Baboon hawk]]s can attack Masked if they remain in proximity for prolonged periods of time, but this is uncommon, even on [[Adamance]].
</div>

</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While roaming, Masked will check their line of sight for any employee. If an employee is seen, it will switch to the Pursuit state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furthermore, Masked will build up 'interest' in the ship whilst in this state. When enough interest is gathered, they will switch to the Ambush state if the ship is not too far away from their position.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Pursuit ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In pursuit mode, the Masked has spotted an employee (or the Masked has been seen in ambush mode) and is pursuing them. When the Masked first enters this state, it stops and stares at the targeted employee for 2 to 5 seconds<ref name="masked_update" />. This timer immediately ends if the Masked is damaged<ref name="masked_hit_enemy" />.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In pursuit mode, it retains eye contact with its target and starts heading towards them. Notably, the running randomly logic differs from the logic in the roaming state. When a Masked is in pursuit, the percentage chance to both stop and start running randomly change significantly.<ref name="look_and_run_randomly_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly start running''': 
  IF not running:
    IF has at least 5 seconds of stamina:
      IF outside: chance to start running = 11.66%
      NOT outside: chance to start running = 6.66%
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Randomly stop running''': 
  IF already running:
    IF stamina = 0: Stop running immediately
    ELSE:
      IF outside: chance to stop running = 84%
      NOT outside: chance to stop running = 94%
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furthermore, if the route to their target is more than 17 units away, they are guaranteed to start running, only stopping when within 12 units of their target or out of stamina.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked will stop staring at and moving towards an employee if line-of-sight has been broken for at least 3.5 seconds. After this time, Masked will consider their target 'lost in chase', and will start looking for them by walking around. After line-of-sight has been broken for 10 seconds, they revert back to their roaming state.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Interestingly, Masked broaden but also shorten their field-of-view when in this mode compared to the field-of-view in the roaming state. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 50. Additionally, Masked gain 'proximity awareness' meaning they can 'see' in a circle (of 1 unit) around them.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked are able to switch their target at any time in this state if another employee is closer in their line-of-sight<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Ambush ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked switch to ambush mode if enough 'interest' has been gathered by roaming the facility. When they are in this state, they start walking towards the ship and look for a spot inside the ship to hide in. <ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Whilst moving towards the ship, Masked will lose interest in the ship, eventually returning to a roaming state<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. If a mask is inside the ship, they will no longer lose interest in the ship, staying in this state until seeing an employee or being seen by an employee<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />. Whilst waiting in ambush, Masked will crouch. Notably, this is the only time Masked ever crouch.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In this state, Masked change their field of view once again. Going from a width of 45 and a range of 60 to a width of 70 and a range of 20 if compared to their field of view while roaming.<ref name="do_ai_interval_masked" />
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is recommended if you see a Masked to create as much distance and open space as possible, along with making sure all employees know of its existence to not cause more Masked to spawn.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked do not retain any [[Spray paint]] on them, allowing possible indication of possession.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an employee is transforming into a Masked, the animation of the possession is long enough for another employee to kill the Masked. Because of this, with good reaction time and teamwork you can kill any accidental spawns, and at least damage Masked formed from employees turning.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Similar to the [[Forest Keeper|forest keeper]]'s grab, there is a small window to where the employee may be saved by another party especially if multiple employees are present. Hitting the Masked with a melee weapon and killing it, a successful teleport, or stunning it with a [[Stun grenade]], [[Homemade flashbang]], [[Zap gun]], or a [[Radar-booster]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A [[Shovel|shovel]] can dispatch a Masked with relative ease as a shovel has more range than a Masked's grab. Using a [[kitchen knife]] is possible but much riskier due to its short range.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
On the monitor, Masked will still seem like employees and there is no visual difference except in their behavior. Masked will frequently spin in circles when roaming. Employees turned into Masked will be seen as normal employees, despite the Masked behavior of the employee and can still be teleported, bringing danger to other employees on the ship. Masked that are not employees (i.e. spawned Masked) will not have a switchable spot on the monitor, therefore giving clues as to where a Masked is.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The [[inverse teleporter]] cannot remove a Masked from the ship.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked also seem to be capable of simple strategy, as groups of 2 or 3 will coordinate to trap employees. This is most evident when by the ship as one masked will usually hide inside while the others patrol the area around the ship.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Masked can be hurt by [[eyeless dog]]s when coming into contact with them, but eyeless dogs do not intentionally attack Masked. [[Old Bird]]s target all entities within their field of vision, including Masked. [[Baboon hawk]]s can attack Masked if they remain in proximity for prolonged periods of time, but this is uncommon, even on [[Adamance]].
</div>
