<span id="Game_variables"></span>
== 游戏变量 ==

右侧的信息框展示了定义游戏数值的全局变量。这些变量以及其他卫星、实体、废料相关的特定变量将采用[[w:驼峰式命名法|驼峰命名法]]进行引用（例如“时长”将记作 <code>hourLength</code>，卫星的“地图尺寸乘数”将记作 <code>mapSizeMultiplier</code>）。

游戏变量是静态的，这意味着它们对所有玩家都相同，并且在一局游戏过程中不会发生改变。这些变量可能会在 Zeekerss 未来对《致命公司》的更新中进行调整。

<span id="General_principles"></span>
== 通用规则 ==

<span id="Time_calculations"></span>
== 时间计算 ==

《致命公司》中的时间由变量 `hourLength` 和 `hoursCount` 定义。为了能结合曲线使用时间，需要采用归一化时间。
获取归一化时间的方法是：用当前时间除以总时间（`hourLength * hoursCount`）。
归一化时间的取值范围在 0 到 1 之间，可以理解为一天中已经过去的时间比例。

<span id="Animation_curves"></span>
== 动画曲线 ==

《致命公司》中的许多机制都基于Unity引擎的[[animation curve|动画曲线]](sslocal://flow/file_open?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.unity3d.com%2FManual%2Fanimeditor-AnimationCurves.html&flow_extra=eyJsaW5rX3R5cGUiOiJjb2RlX2ludGVycHJldGVyIn0=)。动画曲线是一种数学函数，它将一个X值（如一天中的时间）映射到另一个Y值（如生成概率）。在《致命公司》中，曲线采用[[Hermite cubic spline|Hermite三次样条]]插值算法计算。简单来说，系统会根据一组输入点（关键帧，即图中的黑点）以及定义曲线在各点附近“弯曲”方式的斜率，来计算出最终的实际曲线（橙色线条）。

以下是[[Experimentation|实验性星球]]的三条实体生成曲线。<br>[[File:Experimentation_spawn_curve.png|x300px]]<br>而这便是[[Baboon Hawk|狒狒鹰]]的生成概率曲线。<br>[[File:Baboon_hawk_probability.png|x300px]]<br>在描述从曲线中获取的数值时，将使用伪函数 <code>curve.eval(Y)</code>。

<span id="Entity_spawning"></span>
== 实体生成 ==

《致命公司》中的实体生成机制相当复杂，且依赖大量变量。本章节将详细介绍各类生成算法及其相关参数。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
实体生成循环会在每一轮开始时运行一次，之后会周期性执行，直到当天结束或飞船提前撤离。生成循环的间隔时间由 `spawningCooldown` 决定。冷却值为 2（默认值）表示游戏会等待 2 小时后才执行下一次生成循环。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Spawn waves use a slightly different time calculation than normalized time, referred to henceforth as ''spawn wave time''. Instead of current time, the variable <code>currentHour</code> is used, evaluating to <code>(currentHour * hourLength) / (hourLength * hoursCount)</code>. <code>currentHour</code>, despite its name, is the hour before the next spawn wave, which occurs two hours later. This causes values in the curve to be sampled an hour later than they reasonably should be.<ref group="note" name="bug" />
</div>

<span id="Spawning_requirements"></span>
=== 生成条件 ===

某一实体类别的生成算法，仅在该类别的能力计数（Power Count）尚未达到上限时才会执行。
例如：若[[Bracken|蕨影]]（能力等级 3）和一只[[Thumper|打击者]]（能力等级 3）已出现在[[Assurance]]上，则该星球的室内最大能力值（Max Indoor Power）6已被占满，在能力计数下降之前，不会再生成额外的室内实体。 

单个实体的生成算法还会受到该类别多样性能力计数（Diversity Power Count）的限制。
例如：若[[Feiopar|黑豹]]（多样性能力等级 2）与[[Baboon Hawk|狒狒鹰]]（多样性能力等级 1）都在[[March]]上生成，该星球的室外最大多样性能力值（Max Outdoor Diversity Power）3 就已被占满。当天仍可继续生成更多飞虫怪和狒狒鹰，但不会再刷新其他任何种类的实体。
杀死当前所有的飞虫怪或狒狒鹰，也不会减少该计数。

<span id="Spawning_algorithm_(Daytime_Entities)"></span>
=== 生成算法（日间实体） ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
日间实体的生成数量取决于星球的日间生成概率曲线与日间生成偏差值。基础生成数量通过日间归一化时间**代入曲线计算得出。日间归一化时间的计算方式为当前时间除以总时间，以此将时间表示为 0 到 1 之间的小数。
</div> 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
实际生成数量为一个在以下范围内随机选取的数值。
最小生成数量：daytimeCurve.eval(normalizedTime) - daytimeSpawnDeviation
最大生成数量：daytimeCurve.eval(normalizedTime) + daytimeSpawnDeviation
</div>

随后该生成数量会被限制在 0 到 20 之间。地图中同时存在的日间实体数量永远不会超过 20 个。

确定需要生成的实体数量后，游戏会进一步确定具体生成哪些实体。针对每个实体生成位，游戏会根据各实体是否满足生成条件来创建一份生成概率列表。生成条件通过以下因素计算：

- 最大数量：该实体的生成数量不会超过其自身的最大数量
- 能力等级：新增实体的能力等级不会超过该星球的日间最大能力值
- 最晚生成时间：该实体的最晚生成时间尚未超过（例如漫游蝗在晚上7点41分后停止生成）

不符合生成条件的实体，其生成概率会被设为 0。符合条件的实体，其当前对应星球的生成概率，会再乘以该实体基于游戏内时间计算的'''生成概率曲线'''数值。
如果该实体启用了'''生成数量衰减'''机制并拥有对应的'''生成数量衰减曲线'''，其生成概率还会额外乘以该曲线的数值，该数值根据当前已生成的同类实体数量计算得出。
最后，游戏会从符合条件的实体列表中随机按权重抽取一个实体，并立即在预设的日间实体生成点之一生成该实体。

<span id="Spawning_algorithm_(Outdoor_Entities)"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 生成算法（夜间实体） ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
夜间实体的生成数量取决于星球的''夜间生成概率曲线'''和'''夜间生成偏差值'''。基础生成数量通过将''归一化时间''代入曲线计算得出。归一化时间由当前时间除以总时间计算得到，这样可以将时间表示为0到1之间的小数。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
实际生成数量同样是在一个范围内随机选取的数值。最小生成数量取决于距离必须完成配额的剩余天数（`daysUntilDeadline`）。过去的天数越多，实体生成的概率就越高。

*'''Min Spawn Count:''' <code>nighttimeCurve.eval(normalizedTime) + abs(daysUntilDeadline-3) / 1.6 - 3</code>
*'''Max Spawn Count:''' <code>nighttimeCurve.eval(normalizedTime) + 3</code>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
随后该生成数量会被限制在 `minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn` 和 20 之间。变量 `minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn` 默认设为 0，但如果当前星球处于[[eclipsed|日食]]天气，则会变更为预设值。每个星球在日食期间都有各自的 `minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn` 数值，可在其单独页面中查看。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
确定将要生成的实体数量后，游戏会确定具体生成哪些实体。对于每个实体生成位，会根据各实体是否满足生成条件来创建一份生成概率列表。生成条件根据以下因素判定：

*'''Max Count:''' 该实体的生成数量不会超过其自身的'''Max Count'''
*'''Power Level:''' 新增实体的能力等级不会超过该星球的'''Max Nighttime Power'''
*'''Diversity Power Level:''' 新增实体的多样性等级不会超过该星球的'''Max Outdoor Diversity Power'''
*'''Latest Spawn Time:''' 该实体的最晚生成时间尚未超过
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
不符合生成条件的实体，其生成概率会被设为0。符合条件的实体会将其当前在该星球的生成概率，乘以根据当前游戏内时间计算得出的自身'''Spawn Probability Curve'''数值。
如果该实体使用'''Spawn Count Falloff'''机制并因此拥有对应的'''Spawn Count Falloff'''曲线，其生成概率还会额外乘以该曲线的数值，该数值根据当前已生成的同类实体数量计算得出。
最后，游戏会从符合条件的实体列表中随机抽取一个加权索引。被选中的实体会立即在某个预设的夜间实体生成点生成。
</div>

<span id="Spawning_algorithm_(Indoor_Entities)"></span>
=== 生成算法（室内实体） ===

室内实体的生成算法比前两种更为复杂，因为室内敌人不会立即生成，而是会被分配一个通风口和一个计时器，用于确定该实体从该通风口出现的时间。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
室内实体的生成数量取决于星球的'''Indoor Spawn Probability Curve'''和'''Indoor Spawn Deviation'''。基础生成数量通过将''归一化时间''代入曲线计算得出。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
实际生成数量同样是在一个范围内随机选取的数值。与室外实体一样，最小生成数量取决于距离必须完成配额的剩余天数（`daysUntilDeadline`）。过去的天数越多，室内实体生成的概率就越高。

*'''Min Spawn Count:''' <code>indoorCurve.eval(normalizedTime) + abs(daysUntilDeadline-3) / 1.6 - indoorSpawnDeviation</code>
*'''Max Spawn Count:''' <code>indoorCurve.eval(normalizedTime) + indoorSpawnDeviation</code>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
随后该生成数量会被限制在 `minEnemiesToSpawn`、20 以及地图上空闲通风口数量三者之间。每一个被选中的实体后续都必须能分配到一个空闲通风口。
变量 `minEnemiesToSpawn` 默认设为 0，但在当前星球出现[[Weather|日食]]时会变更为预设值，或是在拾取[[apparatus|装置]]后有 70% 概率变为 2。每个星球在月蚀期间都有各自的 `minEnemiesToSpawn` 数值，可在其单独页面中查看。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The variable <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code> is set to 0 by default but can change to a predefined value if the current moon is [[Weather|eclipsed]], or to 2 (with a 70% chance) when an [[apparatus]] is collected. Each moon has its own <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code> during eclipses which can be found on their individual pages.
</div>

除此之外，在数值限制生效前，如果已经过去一天且 `minEnemiesToSpawn` 仍为 0（当前星球未发生日食，且装置未提升生成速率），满足以下任一条件时，`minEnemiesToSpawn` 将会被设为 1。

* 当前回合已收集的废料比例达到或超过收益配额，且时间在上午 11:24 之后（设计本意是超过配额的 80%，但一处代码错误导致比例会向下取整为 100% 的整数倍）
* 当前回合已收集的废料价值超过地图总废料价值的 65%
* 累计已有至少 5 个回合（无需连续）满足：收集了价值超过 30 信用点的废料，且无玩家死亡。若任意时刻有玩家死亡，该计数将从 0 重新开始。

确定需要生成的实体数量后，游戏会确定具体生成哪些实体。对于每个实体生成位，系统会根据各实体是否满足生成条件来创建一份生成概率列表。生成条件根据以下因素计算：

*'''Max Count:''' 该实体的生成数量不会超过其自身的'''Max Count'''
*'''Power Level:''' 新增实体的强度等级不会超过该星球的'''Max Indoor Power'''
*'''Diversity Power Level:''' 新增实体的多样性等级不会超过该星球的'''Max Indoor Diversity Power'''
*'''Latest Spawn Time:''' 该实体的最晚生成时间尚未超过

不符合生成条件的实体，其生成概率会被设为0。符合条件的实体会将其当前在该星球的生成概率，乘以根据当前游戏内时间计算得出的自身'''Spawn Probability Curve'''数值。
使用'''Spawn Count Falloff'''机制并因此拥有'''Spawn Count Falloff'''曲线的实体，其生成概率还会额外乘以该曲线的数值，该数值根据当前已生成的同类实体数量计算得出。

最后，游戏会从符合条件的实体列表中随机抽取一个加权索引。随后，被选中的实体会被分配到地图上一个随机选取的空闲通风口，并附带一个随机确定的生成延迟。该生成延迟会被限制在当前时间与下一个生成周期开始之间。

室内实体的`spawningDelay`参数决定了通风口爬行音效会提前多久播放。该音效一开始音量较低，并会随时间逐渐变大。当`spawningDelay`结束后，音效停止，通风口打开，被分配的实体在通风口前方生成。随后通风口重置，准备好在下一生成周期中被再次分配。

<span id="Entity_Infestations"></span>
===实体侵扰===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
每天开始时，游戏会进行一次概率判定，几率为1.5%。如果当前日不是10月23日（致命公司的周年纪念日），则会额外再进行一次约1.429%的概率判定。只要其中任意一次判定成功（总概率约2.907%），当天就有可能出现室内实体侵扰。
</div>

目前共有两种侵扰类型。如果[[Nutcrackers|胡桃夹子]]出现在室内实体列表中，且25%概率判定成功，设施将会发生胡桃夹子侵扰。
否则，如果[[Hoarding Bugs|囤积虫]]在室内实体列表中，设施将会发生囤积虫侵扰。
若两个条件均不满足，则本次侵扰判定无效。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在侵扰发生的天数里，对应实体会被标记为侵扰实体：室内强度上限会提升至 30（囤积虫）或 20（胡桃夹子），且最小生成数量增加 2。
此外，所有标准生成概率（包括概率为 0 的情况）及概率修正都会被忽略，侵扰实体的生成概率直接设为 100，其余所有实体的概率均乘以 0.075。
其他原本就会阻止实体生成的条件（如最大生成数量限制）依然生效。
</div>

因此，在达到侵扰实体的最大生成数量之前，几乎所有生成的怪物都会是该类型实体，不过偶尔也会生成其他实体。在此之后，其余所有实体会以相同概率生成，直到达到强度上限。

侵扰效果仅影响室内生成。

<span id="Special_Enemies"></span>
=== 特殊敌人 ===

'''特殊敌人系统'''用于在每个生成波次中，优先生成特定星球上的指定敌人。在计算完普通生成权重后，特殊敌人的权重会被设定为与预设百分比相符的数值。
若该百分比为100%，则每个生成波次都会被强制至少生成一个该指定敌人，除非该敌人已达到最大生成数量，或是已达到星球的室内强度上限。 

并非每个星球都必须存在特殊敌人。该系统目前仅用于[[Adamance]]上的[[Cadaver Growth|尸骸增生体]]，其生成百分比设定为100%。

<span id="Scrap_spawning"></span>
== 废料生成 ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{for|information on days that spawn only one scrap type|Single scrap day}}
</div>

<span id="Rarity"></span>
=== 稀有度 ===

在生成另一件废料物品时，游戏会使用**随机数生成器（RNG）**，并结合对应星球的“稀有度表”进行判定。

这些表格列出了所有可生成的废料及其相对稀有度，数值均为简单的整数。（你可以把这些数值看作抽奖或彩票里的“奖券”：数值为2的物品被选中的概率是数值为1的两倍。）

因此，我们可以计算出每种废料的生成概率：用该废料的相对稀有度除以表格中所有稀有度数值的总和。你在其他文章的类似表格中看到的百分比，正是基于这些概率计算得出的。
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTable|Dine}}
（相关计算由【模块:稀有度】处理，数据挖掘得出的稀有度表存储在该模块的子页面中。更多信息详见【项目:维基自动化】。）

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Quota ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Quota is increased every four days by a few random factors, the number of quotas passed (<code>quotaCount</code>), and furniture luck.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
An integer value, dubbed the ''quota to add'', is set to <code>(quotaCount * (quotaCount / 16))</code>, increased by 1, then clamped between 0 and 10,000. The randomizer curve value, dubbed the ''curve sample'', is evaluated as a random percentage minus furniture luck * 1.5. Then, the quota to add is multiplied by 100 and <code>randomizerCurve.eval(curveSample) + 1</code>. This is then added to the current quota amount, then clamped between 0 and 1 billion.{{ref code|TimeOfDay.SetNewProfitQuota}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Overtime credits is decided by subtracting '''total sold - quota''', dividing by 5, and adding or subtracting multiples of 15 dependent on the day sold. On 3 days left, 30 will be added; then 15 added for 2 days, none for 1 day, and 15 subtracted for 0 days. The formula in game is as follows:
* <code>(total sold - quota) / 5 + (15 * daysUntilDeadline)</code>
where <code>daysUntilDeadline</code> is -1 for 0 days left and 2 for 3 days left.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
After these values are calculated and set, amount of quota fulfilled is reset, the time until deadline is set to <code>totalTime * 4</code>, present furniture items are added to the luck counter for next quota, and the flag for [[HUD#Advertisements|advertisements]] is reset.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Furniture luck ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furniture luck is a system used primarily by quota increase randomization, but is also used to decide [[Vain Shroud]] growth. Each furniture item has a specified luck value, and when the new quota is set, furniture luck is updated to include the percentages of all furniture items that have been present since last quota. Here is the table for each furniture item and its luck:
</div>
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Name</span> !! <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Luck</span>
|-
| [[Classic painting]] || 0.60%
|- 
| [[Cozy lights]] || 0.50%
|- 
| [[Disco ball]] || 6.00%
|- 
| [[Dog house]] || 0.70%
|- 
| [[Electric chair]] || 1.20%
|- 
| [[Fridge]] || 1.00%
|- 
| [[Goldfish]] || 0.60%
|- 
| [[Inverse Teleporter]] || 0.40%
|- 
| [[Jack-o-Lantern]] || 1.20%
|- 
| [[Loud horn]] || 0.25%
|- 
| [[Microwave]] || 1.00%
|- 
| [[Plushie pajama man]] || 0.30%
|-

| [[Romantic table]] || 0.50%

|-

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furniture must be kept on the ship and unstored for the whole quota for it to factor into luck for the next quota. This is ''not'' the case for items with negative luck, which have a specific case where its luck is always counted if it is ever unstored during the whole quota. This is to prevent exploitation by removing it before the new quota is calculated and negating the negative luck.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
For Vain Shroud growth, luck is not recalculated; instead, it is read from the previous quota's luck value, as assigning a new quota is the only time it is recalculated.
</div>

######## Metal sheet
{{topicon Fandom|Tattered_metal_sheet}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Scraps/AutoInfobox|infobox
| scrap = MetalSheet
}}
The '''Metal sheet''' (or "Tattered metal sheet") is a heavy, low-value [[Scrap]] that's commonly found on low-tier moons. Due to its weight and value, it can be argued that it's the worst item in the entire game.

[[File:Metal_sheet_variants.webp|thumb|right|Both variants of Metal sheets]]
[[File:Back of Metal sheet.png|thumb|An employee holding a Metal sheet from a 3rd person perspective, to show the steel bolt textures found on the back.]]

== Item Variants ==
There are 2 possible appearances of the Metal sheet:

* A sheet with more jagged edges, horizontal lines with a seam down the middle, 4 holes torn through it, and 7 steel bolts attached to the back (Commonly referred to by players as the "4-hole" sheet)
* A sheet with more straight edges, vertical lines, 2 holes torn through it, and 8 steel bolts attached to the back (Commonly referred to by players as the "2-hole" sheet)

The default appearance is the 4-hole sheet, which will be chosen upon reloading a save file containing the item due to the game not saving item variants.

== Trivia ==

* As briefly mentioned above, both variants of Metal sheet have some steel bolts attached to the back, which you might not ever notice in-game due to them being located on the underside of the sheet while it's on the floor. It is fairly easy to see while looking at somebody else holding the item though.

######## Meteor shower
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
{{spoilers}}

The '''meteor shower''' is a random event which affects a moon's surface.
Unlike [[weather]], the shower has a small chance to begin at any time during the day,<!-- presumably rerolled on the amount of time -->
and lasts 12 in-game hours or about 8:30 real-time.
<br>When a meteor shower is imminent, an [[w:Emergency_Alert_System|EAS]]-style weather bulletin appears on the [[HUD#Emergency_weather_alert|HUD]].

Meteors will appear as entry fireballs far above the surface, falling to the surface in "waves".
They are relatively slow-moving and can be outran by any employee paying attention to what's overhead.
<br>A meteor will pass through water and trees, destroying the latter, and explode upon impact with the ground.
Anything standing in that spot<sup>[verify]</sup> will die, and any nearby employees will be flung back without taking damage.
<br>It will leave no crater or meteorite after impact, only a char decal.

There is no in-game sign of whether a meteor shower will occur on any given moon or day until the weather bulletin appears.

== History ==

=== [[Version 64]] ===

Introduced.

######## Mineshaft

== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:17-->
Most entities can ride the elevator, but only [[Masked]] can push the buttons by themselves. This means it is possible to trap [[Coil-Head]]s, Maneaters, and [[Jester]]s at the top of the elevator,<tvar name="citation">{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=7:08}}</tvar> though the latter can't be done solo without abusing an exploit. After this has been done, employees can use the fire exit to continue looting.

<!--T:18-->
It is perfectly safe to ride the elevator from atop its carriage. Jumping on top of the elevator carriage while it's at the lower level keeps employees out of range of most entities, and scrap can be placed up there to keep it out of the reach of [[Hoarding Bug]]s.<tvar name="citation">{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=8:00}}</tvar>

<!--T:19-->
Employees should take caution when inside of underwater tunnels, as it is easy to get stuck on the ceiling geometry and drown. Additionally, in certain layouts, it is possible for the underwater tunnels to generate one-way only, requiring employees to take specific routes to get around to a specific spot. If an employee gets stuck on a wall while underwater, it is recommended to go back and regain stamina before proceeding forward. Attempting to brute-force the underwater tunnels is likely to lead in death.

######## Mineshaft/en
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|Entrance to the Mineshaft]]
[[File:CavesEntrance.png|thumb|Entrance to the Cave System]]
{{stub}}
'''The Mineshaft''' is an [[interior]] added in the [[v60]] update for ''Lethal Company''.
This interior is most common on [[Vow]], [[Offense]], and [[Artifice]] but can appear on any moon (except [[March]]).

== Overview ==

=== Main Entrance ===

The Main Entrance of the Mineshaft will always be at the elevator. The room will always contain a first and second floor, and the Main Entrance door can be on either. Sometimes there can be [[Key|keys]] on either floor.

The Main Entrance consits of a room with a stairwell that goes to the top of the room, a railway and minecarts, 2 lights on the roof, and an elevator leading to the facility part of the Mineshaft interior where the cave doors are found.

The elevator will always be on the first floor of the room. While the elevator is quite small, all four employees can squeeze inside of it at once.

Pressing the button inside the elevator will shut its door and the elevator will go down regardless of employees being inside or not. The elevator can be called thanks to a button on a beam next to it, available both in Main Entrance and down in the Mineshaft interior's facility part.

=== Mineshaft ===

The elevator leads down to the main area, or "facility" part of the Mineshaft. The Fire Exit will always be located in this area, although there is no guarantee that the Main Entrance and the Fire Exit facilities will directly connect, as it can generate on the other side of the cave system.

=== Cave System ===

The cave system is claustrophobic in nature, comprised of uneven tunnels, open abandoned mineshafts, and deep holes that can kill employees. It is accessed via doors with a blue light above them, or in some cases, a hole in the wall where a door would be.

Cave sections may lead to waterlogged tunnels that employees can crawl through to access other sections of the caves. [[Entities]] such as the [[Bracken]] can enter the waterlogged tunnels as well, even if they appear too large; in certain cases, only their feet will be visible.

Vents in the caves are replaced with dark cracks in the wall, although they will still make vent sounds.

Fire Exits always spawn at or around entrances to the cave system.

If [[Maneater]] spawns in the Mineshaft, after it matures its chosen nest will always be within the cave system.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
Most entities can ride the elevator, but only [[Masked]] can push the buttons by themselves. This means it is possible to trap [[Coil-Head]]s, Maneaters, and [[Jester]]s at the top of the elevator,{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=7:08}} though the latter can't be done solo without abusing an exploit. After this has been done, employees can use the fire exit to continue looting.

It is perfectly safe to ride the elevator from atop its carriage. Jumping on top of the elevator carriage while it's at the lower level keeps employees out of range of most entities, and scrap can be placed up there to keep it out of the reach of [[Hoarding Bug]]s.{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=8:00}}

Employees should take caution when inside of underwater tunnels, as it is easy to get stuck on the ceiling geometry and drown. Additionally, in certain layouts, it is possible for the underwater tunnels to generate one-way only, requiring employees to take specific routes to get around to a specific spot. If an employee gets stuck on a wall while underwater, it is recommended to go back and regain stamina before proceeding forward. Attempting to brute-force the underwater tunnels is likely to lead in death.<!--

Underwater tunnels can be very dangerous for multiple employees to enter at once, as employee collision is much more solid when crouching,<ref>[https://www.patreon.com/posts/second-creature-148201645 Second creature finished] via Patreon. Posted January 14th, 2026 by Zeekerss.</ref> and if one employee needs to go back for air another employee behind them will block their escape. Employees should only enter the underwater tunnels one at a time to prevent deaths from drowning.-->

This means it is possible to trap [[Coil-Head]]s, Maneaters, and [[Jester]]s at the top of the elevator,{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=7:08}} though the latter can't be done solo without abusing an exploit. After this has been done, employees can use the fire exit to continue looting.

It is perfectly safe to ride the elevator from atop its carriage. Jumping on top of the elevator carriage while it's at the lower level keeps employees out of range of most entities, and scrap can be placed up there to keep it out of the reach of [[Hoarding Bug]]s.{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=8:00}}

Employees should take caution when inside of underwater tunnels, as it is easy to get stuck on the ceiling geometry and drown. Additionally, in certain layouts, it is possible for the underwater tunnels to generate one-way only, requiring employees to take specific routes to get around to a specific spot. If an employee gets stuck on a wall while underwater, it is recommended to go back and regain stamina before proceeding forward. Attempting to brute-force the underwater tunnels is likely to lead in death.<!--

Underwater tunnels can be very dangerous for multiple employees to enter at once, as employee collision is much more solid when crouching,<ref>[https://www.patreon.com/posts/second-creature-148201645 Second creature finished] via Patreon. Posted January 14th, 2026 by Zeekerss.</ref> and if one employee needs to go back for air another employee behind them will block their escape. Employees should only enter the underwater tunnels one at a time to prevent deaths from drowning.-->

######## Mineshaft/zh
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:MinesEntrance.png|thumb|矿井入口]]
[[File:CavesEntrance.png|thumb|洞穴系统入口]]
{{stub}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''矿井'''是《''Lethal Company''》在 [[v60]] 更新中加入的一种室内区域。该室内区域最常出现在 [[Vow]]、[[Offense]]、[[Dine]] 和 [[Artifice]]，但也可能出现在除 [[March]] 以外的任何月球上。
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Main Entrance ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Main Entrance of the Mineshaft will always be at the elevator. The room will always contain a first and second floor, and the Main Entrance door can be on either. Sometimes there can be [[Key|keys]] on either floor.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Main Entrance consits of a room with a stairwell that goes to the top of the room, a railway and minecarts, 2 lights on the roof, and an elevator leading to the facility part of the Mineshaft interior where the cave doors are found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The elevator will always be on the first floor of the room. While the elevator is quite small, all four employees can squeeze inside of it at once.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Pressing the button inside the elevator will shut its door and the elevator will go down regardless of employees being inside or not. The elevator can be called thanks to a button on a beam next to it, available both in Main Entrance and down in the Mineshaft interior's facility part.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Mineshaft ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The elevator leads down to the main area, or "facility" part of the Mineshaft. The Fire Exit will always be located in this area, although there is no guarantee that the Main Entrance and the Fire Exit facilities will directly connect, as it can generate on the other side of the cave system.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Cave System ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The cave system is claustrophobic in nature, comprised of uneven tunnels, open abandoned mineshafts, and deep holes that can kill employees. It is accessed via doors with a blue light above them, or in some cases, a hole in the wall where a door would be.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Cave sections may lead to waterlogged tunnels that employees can crawl through to access other sections of the caves. [[Entities]] such as the [[Bracken]] can enter the waterlogged tunnels as well, even if they appear too large; in certain cases, only their feet will be visible.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Vents in the caves are replaced with dark cracks in the wall, although they will still make vent sounds.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Fire Exits always spawn at or around entrances to the cave system.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If [[Maneater]] spawns in the Mineshaft, after it matures its chosen nest will always be within the cave system.
</div>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==

Most entities can ride the elevator, but only [[Masked]] can push the buttons by themselves. This means it is possible to trap [[Coil-Head]]s, Maneaters, and [[Jester]]s at the top of the elevator,{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=7:08}} though the latter can't be done solo without abusing an exploit. After this has been done, employees can use the fire exit to continue looting.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is perfectly safe to ride the elevator from atop its carriage. Jumping on top of the elevator carriage while it's at the lower level keeps employees out of range of most entities, and scrap can be placed up there to keep it out of the reach of [[Hoarding Bug]]s.{{cite YouTube|video-id=DFfZkqrJuTc|title=New Mineshaft Interior Strategies! - Lethal Company|creator=Bread|start-timestamp=8:00}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Employees should take caution when inside of underwater tunnels, as it is easy to get stuck on the ceiling geometry and drown. Additionally, in certain layouts, it is possible for the underwater tunnels to generate one-way only, requiring employees to take specific routes to get around to a specific spot. If an employee gets stuck on a wall while underwater, it is recommended to go back and regain stamina before proceeding forward. Attempting to brute-force the underwater tunnels is likely to lead in death.
</div><!--

<!--T:34-->
=== Other Moons ===
* The [[weekly challenge]] moon has a random name (e.g., Rapo-87) but uses one of the standard moon templates.

== Moon properties == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:20-->
=== Difficulty/Hazard Level/Cost ===
Moons are ordered roughly by difficulty in the ship's terminal.
Easier moons have fewer hazards and lower scrap, while harder moons cost credits, feature more hazards, and offer more loot.
Cost applies once per orbital change.

<!--T:5-->
Hazard level is a fixed in-game value for each moon, serving as a difficulty indicator, but it's just an estimate not based on anything.

=== Map size multiplier === <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Moon maps are procedurally generated. The multiplier determines indoor map size—larger multipliers produce more complex layouts. [[8-Titan]] has the largest (2.2×), while [[41-Experimentation]] and [[220-Assurance]] are the smallest (1×).

=== Min/Max scrap === <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Each moon has a defined scrap spawn range. Scrap value is randomized. More scrap generally means higher potential loot.

<!--T:22-->
''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''

<!--T:23-->
''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''

=== Max powers === <!--T:24-->

<!--T:25-->
Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.

=== Default layout === <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
Each moon has a default layout—[[Factory]], [[Mineshaft]], or [[Mansion]]—used most often. Other layouts may rarely appear, except for [[61-March]], which is fixed.

<!--T:21-->
=== Possible weather ===
Weather includes Rain, Storms, Fog, Flooding, and Eclipses. Weather does not affect loot, only difficulty.

<!--T:35-->

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Eigenschaften von Monden ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Schwierigkeit/Gefahrenstufe/Kosten ===
Die Schwierigkeit eines Mondes folgt der Liste im Terminal des Schiffes. Die ersten drei sind einfache Monde mit im Durchschnitt weniger wertvollem Schrott und weniger gefährlichen Kreaturen. 
Die nächsten beiden sind etwas schwieriger, bieten dafür aber mehr bzw. wertvolleren Schrott. 
Die letzten drei Monde sind die gefährlichsten. Selbst bei normalem Wetter gibt es hier Nebel oder Schneestürme, die es erschweren sich auf der Oberfläche zurechtzufinden.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Gefahrenstufe ist die Bewertung des Spiels für die Schwierigkeit der Monde. Dieser Wert ist für jeden Mond festgelegt und hat keinen Einfluss auf das Spiel, außer den Mitarbeitern eine weiterer Indikator zu sein.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Mapgröße Multiplikator ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Das Layout der Innenräume auf den Monden ist prozedural generiert und somit bei jeder Landung des Schiffs anders. Die Größe ist an den Mapgrößenmultiplikator des Mondes gebunden. [[Experimentation/de|41-Experimentation]] und [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] haben die kleinsten Layouts mit dem Multiplikator 1; [[Titan|8-Titan]] hat den größten mit 2,35. Größere Innenräume sind meist mit größeren Labyrinthstrukturen, sowie mehr vernetzten Laufstegen und Fluren verbunden, weshalb es deutlich leichter ist dort die Orientierung zu verlieren.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Min/Max Schrott ===

Jede Karte hat definierte Minimal- und Maximalanzahl für die Schrottgegenstände, welche gefunden werden können. Der Wert der Gegenstände ist zufällig und basiert auf den Loot Tabellen der Monde. Trotzdem ist es möglich, dass auf einem Mond nur Gegenstände mit geringem oder besonders hohem Wert spawnen. Im Durchschnitt ist der erbeutete Wert der Gegenstände dennoch höher, wenn die Zahl der Gegenstände höher ist.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Max powers ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.
</div>

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Standard Layout ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
In den meisten Fällen wird auf einem Mond immer dieselbe Art Einrichtung erscheinen, entweder die [[Interiors#The Factory/de|Fabrik]] oder die [[Mansion|Villa]]. Allerdings besteht immer eine kleine Chanche, dass die andere Art auftaucht (außer auf [[March|61-March]]). Die Wahrscheinlichkeit hierfür variiert und kann auf der Wikiseite der jeweiligen Monde gefunden werden.
</div>

=== Mögliches Wetter ===
Diese Wetterbedingungen können auf dem jeweiligen Mond auftreten. Das Wetter hat jedoch '''keinen Einfluss''' auf die Anzahl und den Wert von auftauchendem Schrott, sondern macht es nur schwieriger für Mitarbeiter Schrott zu bergen.

=== Other Moons ===
* The [[weekly challenge]] moon has a random name (e.g., Rapo-87) but uses one of the standard moon templates.

== Moon properties ==

=== Difficulty/Hazard Level/Cost ===
Moons are ordered roughly by difficulty in the ship's terminal.
Easier moons have fewer hazards and lower scrap, while harder moons cost credits, feature more hazards, and offer more loot.
Cost applies once per orbital change.

Hazard level is a fixed in-game value for each moon, serving as a difficulty indicator, but it's just an estimate not based on anything.

=== Map size multiplier ===

Moon maps are procedurally generated. The multiplier determines indoor map size—larger multipliers produce more complex layouts. [[8-Titan]] has the largest (2.2×), while [[41-Experimentation]] and [[220-Assurance]] are the smallest (1×).

=== Min/Max scrap ===

Each moon has a defined scrap spawn range. Scrap value is randomized. More scrap generally means higher potential loot.

''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''

''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''

=== Max powers ===

Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.

=== Default layout ===

Each moon has a default layout—[[Factory]], [[Mineshaft]], or [[Mansion]]—used most often. Other layouts may rarely appear, except for [[61-March]], which is fixed.

=== Possible weather ===
Weather includes Rain, Storms, Fog, Flooding, and Eclipses. Weather does not affect loot, only difficulty.

== Notes ==

* [[20-Adamance]] has the highest chance of [[Mansion]] layout among free moons (~2% as of v81).

Las '''lunas''' son cuerpos celestiales en las cuales los empleados pueden aterrizar para explorarlas y recoletar [[Scrap/es|chatarra]]. Algunas de las lunas son más peligrosas y tienen más valor general del botín que otras.

Las lunas pueden ser afectadas por el [[Weather/es|clima]], como tormentas o eclipses.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Propiedades de las lunas ==

=== Dificultad/Riesgo/Coste ===
La dificultad es un criterio basado en el orden en el que se encuentran listadas las lunas en la terminal de la nave. Las tres primeras ([[Experimentation/es|41-Experimentation]], [[Assurance/es|220-Assurance]] y [[Vow/es|56-Vow]]) son lunas fáciles a las que viajar, que cuentan con menos botín y por lo general criaturas menos peligrosas. Las tres siguientes ([[Offense/es|21-Offense]], [[Adamance|20-Adamance]] y [[March/es|61-March]]), son algo más difíciles, son más peligrosas, pero ofrecen más botín. Las últimas tres lunas ([[Rend/es|85-Rend]], [[Dine/es|7-Dine]] y [[Titan/es|8-Titan]]) son las lunas más difíciles, con limitaciones como una densa niebla en el exterior, ventiscas y otros obstáculos que hacen difícil la navegación hacia la entrada al edificio.

El '''riesgo''' es una definición interna del juego sobre la dificultad de la luna. Es un valor fijo por cada luna y no tiene ninguna influencia más allá de ser un indicador para los empleados.

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
== Tamaño del mapa ==

El mapa interior de las lunas está generado de manera procedural, cuya semilla cambia cada vez que la nave aterriza. El tamaño del mapa generado depende de un multiplicador, único para cada luna. Así pues mientras [[Experimentation/es|41-Experimentation]] y [[Assurance/es|220-Assurance]] tienen los mapas más pequeños con un valor de 1, [[Titan|8-Titan]] cuenta con un mapa cuyo multiplicador tiene un valor de 2.2. Los mapas más grandes pueden generar laberintos más extensos con un mayor número de pasillos y pasadizos interconectados, dificultando la orientación y haciendo más probable perderse.

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Chatarra mínima/máxima ===

Cada mapa tiene cantidades prefijadas sobre la cantidad mínima y máxima de chatarra que se puede generar en ellos. El valor de estos objetos es aleatorio y se basa principalmente en las tablas de botín que se pueden generar en la luna, así que si bien algunas lunas pueden generar muchos objetos, es probable tanto tener suerte y que se genere chatarra de alto valor como el caso contrario y que solo se genere chatarra sin valor. Como promedio, si el valor de la chatarra máxima generada es bastante alto suele significar que hay un mayor valor total de botín.

'''''Nota:''' El valor interno por Chatarra máxima es más que el listado aquí. Siendo esto porque al generar chatarra, el juego usa un máximo exclusivo que representa el numero máximo actual de piezas de Chatarra generadas por nivel.''

'''''Nota:''' Es posible que una luna tenga más capacidad de chatarra. Siendo esto por el [[Apparatus]] (El aparato) y [[Bee Hive]] (Colmena) que no están contadas (Aunque tengan valor). Por ejemplo:Es posible escanear 18 objetos en [[Offense|21-Offense]]: con un maximo de 17 de chatarra más el [[Apparatus]]''

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== Poderes Máximos ===

El poder máximo dentro de la [[Interiors/es| Fabrica]] y el poder máximo de la Noche afecta cuantas entidades pueden generarse por mara. Revisa [[Mechanics#Spawning Requirements | Requerimientos de generación]] Para tener más detalles

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Entorno predeterminado ===

La disposición del mapa define el entorno del mapa interior que puede ser  [[Interiors/es|fábrica]], [[Interiors/es|mina]] o la [[Interiors/es|mansión]].

Todas las lunas, excepto [[61-March]] y [[56-Vow]] tienes la posibilidad (muy baja) de contener los 3 diferentes interiores en vez de tener uno por determinado.

El ratio de aparición de cada interior en cada luna pueden ser encontrados en la página individual de cada luna.

=== Posibilidades climáticas ===
Son los climas que las lunas pueden experimentar. Cabe mencionar que el clima de las lunas '''no influye bajo ningún concepto''' la cantidad o el valor del botín de las mismas, únicamente hace la experiencia más difícil.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Kuun ominaisuudet ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Vaikeusaste / riskitaso / kustannukset ===
'''Vaikeusaste''' on luokitus, joka perustuu siihen, miten kuut ovat järjestyksessä aluksen terminaalissa. Kolme ensimmäistä kuuta ovat helppoja, ja niissä on ''keskimäärin'' vähemmän saalista ja vähemmän vaarallisia olentoja. Kaksi seuraavaa ovat hieman vaikeampia. Näihin kuihin on vaarallisempaa matkustaa, mutta ne tarjoavat myös enemmän saalista. Kolme viimeistä ovat vaikeimpia kuita, joiden ulkoiset olosuhteet, kuten tiheä sumu ja lumimyrskyt, vaikeuttavat navigointia sisäänkäynnille.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Riskitaso''' määrittelee pelin sisäisen määritelmän siitä, kuinka vaikea kuu on. Tämä arvo on kiinteä jokaiselle kuulle, eikä sillä ole muuta vaikutusta kuin se, että se on indikaattori työntekijöille.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Kartan kokokerroin ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kuun sisätilakartta luodaan proseduraalisesti, ja siemen vaihtuu joka kerta, kun alus laskeutuu. Tämän generoidun kartan koko riippuu kuun ''Kartan kokokertoimesta''. [[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] ja [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] ovat pienimpiä karttakoolla 1, kun taas [[Titan|8-Titan]] on suurin kertoimella 2,35. Suuremmat karttakoot voivat johtaa suurempiin sokkelorakenteisiin ja useampiin toisiinsa kietoutuneisiin käytäviin ja siten suurempaan eksymismahdollisuuteen.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Minimi- / Maksimiromu ===
</div>

Kullakin kartalla on ennalta määritetty vähimmäis- ja enimmäismäärä romuesineitä, joita voi syntyä. Näiden esineiden arvo on satunnainen ja perustuu kuun saalistaulukkoon. Vaikka joissakin kuissa voi siis syntyä paljon esineitä, on silti mahdollista, että sinulla on onnea tai epäonnea ja saat vain arvoltaan vähäisiä tai arvokkaita esineitä. Keskimäärin kuitenkin korkeampi maksimiromu tarkoittaa yleensä korkeampaa saaliin arvoa.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Max powers ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.
</div>

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Oletusasetelma ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kartan ulkoasu määrittää sisäkarttatyypin, joka voi olla joko [[Interiors#The_Factory|Laitos]] tai [[Interiors#The_Mansion|Kartano]]. Jokaisella kuulla paitsi [[March|61-March]] on pieni mahdollisuus (yleensä hyvin pieni) syntyä vastakkaisella asetelmalla oletusasetelman sijaan. Mahdollisuudet tähän löytyvät kunkin kuun omalta sivulta.
</div>

=== Mahdollinen sää ===
Kaikki säät, joita kuussa voi olla. Kannattaa huomata, että kuun säällä ei ole '''mitään vaikutusta''' kuun saaliin määrään tai arvoon, vaan se vain vaikeuttaa työntekijöiden työtä.

'''Les Lunes''' sont des corps célestes où les employés peuvent explorer et collecter du [[Scrap|Scraps]]. Certaines lunes sont plus dangereuses que d'autres mais contiennent bien plus de valeur de scrap en moyenne.

Les lunes peuvent aussi être affectées par la [[Weather|météo]] telle que des tempêtes ou une éclipse.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Propriétés des Lunes ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Difficulté / Niveau de danger / Coût ===
Les lunes sont rangées par groupe de difficulté dans le terminal. Les trois premières lunes sont très simples avec moins de scrap à collecter et beaucoup moins de créatures en général. Les 2 suivantes sont un peu plus dures mais offrent plus de ferrailles. Les 3 dernières sont les lunes les plus difficiles avec des conditions météorologiques naturelles rendant difficile la navigation jusqu'à l'entrée avec des tempêtes de neige et un brouillard intense mais avec un gros loot à la clé
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Le niveau de danger''' se réfère à quel point une lune est dangereuse. Cette valeur est fixe pour chaque lune et n'a aucune influence en dehors d’être un indicateur pour les employés.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Multiplicateur de la taille intérieure ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La carte intérieure de la lune est générée de manière procédurale  avec une "graine" de génération qui change à chaque atterrissage. La taille de cette carte générée dépend du multiplicateur de la taille intérieure [[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] et [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] ont toutes deux la valeur la plus petite de multiplicateur fixée à 1.0 tandis que [[Titan|8-Titan]] a la valeur la plus élevée avec une valeur fixée à 2.35. Les cartes les plus grandes peuvent générer des labyrinthes plus grands et donc une plus grande possibilité de se perdre dans le complexe intérieur.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Scraps Min / Max ===

Chaque lune a un nombre minimum et maximum de scraps pouvant apparaître. La valeur de ces objets est aléatoire et elle est basée sur la table d'objets qui est différent pour chacune des lunes. Même si certaines lunes peuvent contenir beaucoup d'objets, cela est toujours possible d'être chanceux ou non et n'avoir que des objets avec beaucoup de valeur ou bien au contraire peu de valeur. En général, plus le nombre d'objets moyen est élevé plus la valeur du butin sera élevée.

'''''Note:''' Les valeurs internes pour le nombre de Scrap maximale sont supérieur de 1 avec la valeur listée ici. Cela est dû au fait que, lorsque le jeux génère de la Scrap ce dernier utilise une valeur unique maximale du nombre de pièce de scraps généré sur une lune.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''''Note:''' Il est possible qu'il y est plus de Scrap sur la lune que le maximum possible. Cela est dû car le [[Coeur d'énergie]] et les [[Ruche d'abeilles|Ruches]] ne sont pas comptabilisés. Par exemple, il est possible de scanner 18 objets sur [[Offense|21-Offense]]: le maximum de scrap est 17 plus le Coeur d'énergie.
</div>

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== Puissance de Spawn max ===

La puissance de spawn intérieur et la puissance de spawn de nuit affecte combien d'entités peuvent spawn sur la map. Regardez [[Mécaniques#Conditions de Spawn]] pour plus de détail.

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Disposition par défaut ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La disposition par défaut défini le type d'intérieur qui peut être soit [[L'Usine|L'Usine]] ou bien [[Le Manoir|Le Manoir]]. Toutes les lunes sauf [[March|61-March]] ont une très faible chance d'apparaître (normalement vraiment faible) avec un intérieur opposé à celui par défaut. Les chances pour que cela arrive peuvent être trouvées sur chaque page des lunes.
</div>

=== Météo possible ===
Toutes les météos possible sur une lune. Il est important de noter que la météo n'a ''aucune influence'' sur le nombre ou la valeur de la ferraille et rend seulement l'expédition plus difficile pour les employés.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Hold tulajdonságok ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Difficulty/Hazard Level/Cost ===
Moons are ordered roughly by difficulty in the ship's terminal.
Easier moons have fewer hazards and lower scrap, while harder moons cost credits, feature more hazards, and offer more loot.
Cost applies once per orbital change.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Hazard level is a fixed in-game value for each moon, serving as a difficulty indicator, but it's just an estimate not based on anything.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Map size multiplier ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Moon maps are procedurally generated. The multiplier determines indoor map size—larger multipliers produce more complex layouts. [[8-Titan]] has the largest (2.2×), while [[41-Experimentation]] and [[220-Assurance]] are the smallest (1×).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Min/Max scrap ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Each moon has a defined scrap spawn range. Scrap value is randomized. More scrap generally means higher potential loot.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Max powers ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Default layout ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Each moon has a default layout—[[Factory]], [[Mineshaft]], or [[Mansion]]—used most often. Other layouts may rarely appear, except for [[61-March]], which is fixed.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Possible weather ===
Weather includes Rain, Storms, Fog, Flooding, and Eclipses. Weather does not affect loot, only difficulty.
</div>

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Properti bulan ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Kesulitan/Tingkat Risiko/Biaya ===
Kesulitan adalah sebuah klasifikasi berdasarkan urutan bulan pada terminal kapal. Tiga bulan pertama diklasifikasikan sebagai bulan yang mudah untuk dijelajahi dengan hasil jarahan yang lebih sedikit dan makhluk yang lebih jinak pada umumnya. Kedua bulan selanjutnya sedikit lebih sulit. Bulan-bulan ini lebih berisiko untuk dijelajahi tetapi memiliki hasil jarahan yang lebih banyak. Tiga bulan terakhir adalah bulan yang paling sulit dengan kondisi luar yang berkabut tebal maupun badai salju semakin mempersulit perjalanan menuju pintu masuk.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Tingkat risiko adalah bagaimana gim mendefinisikan kesulitan bulan tersebut. Setiap bulan akan memiliki tingkat risikonya masing-masing dan nilai ini hanya bertujuan untuk membantu pekerja mengestimasikan kesulitan bulan tersebut.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Pengali ukuran peta ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Daerah dalam ruangan dari masing-masing bulan dihasilkan secara prosedural dengan ''seed'' yang berubah setiap kali kapal mendarat. Ukurannya ini yang kemudian dipengaruhi dengan pengali ukuran peta. [[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] dan [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] memiliki ukuran peta terkecil dengan pengali 1, sedangkan [[Titan|8-Titan]] memiliki ukuran peta terbesar dengan pengali 2,35. Semakin besar ukuran peta maka ukuran labirin akan semakin besar pula, dengan catwalk dan lorong yang semakin berkaitan satu sama lainnya, membuat kemungkinan tersesat semakin lebih besar.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Rongsokan Min/Maks ===

Setiap peta memiliki jumlah rongsokan minimum maupun maksimum yang dapat muncul. Nilai dari item-item ini adalah acak dan ditentukan oleh tabel pijah masing-masing bulan. Sehingga, meskipun pada beberapa bulan bisa bermunculan banyak item, tetap saja ada kemungkinan Anda bisa beruntung mendapatkan banyak item bernilai tinggi maupun tidak beruntung mendapatkan item yang bernilai rendah. Akan tetapi, pada umumnya, nilai ''Rongsokan Maks'' yang semakin besar berarti nilai hasil jarahan secara keseluruhan juga semaking tinggi.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Max powers ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.
</div>

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Tata ruang bawaan ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Tata ruang peta menentukan jenis ruangan interior pada peta tersebut, antara [[The Facility|Pabrik]] atau [[The Mansion|Rumah Besar]]. Setiap bulan kecuali [[March|61-March]] memiliki kemungkinan (biasanya sangat kecil) untuk muncul dengan tata ruang yang berlawanan dari bawaannya. Tingkat kemungkinan terjadinya hal ini dapat ditemukan pada halaman bulan masing-masing.
</div>

=== Kemungkinan cuaca ===
Semua kemungkian cuaca yang bisa dialami oleh sebuah bulan. Perlu diperhatikan bahwa cuaca pada bulan '''tidak memiliki pengaruh''' sama sekali pada jumlah jarahan maupun nilai dari bulan tersebut, dan hanya mempersulit para pekerja.

'''Lune''' sono corpi celestiali su cui gli impiegati possono atterrare per esplorare e collezionare [[scarti]]. Alcune lune sono più pericolose ma hanno un bottino maggiore delle altre.

Le lune possono anche essere influenzate dal [[meteo]] per esempio tempeste o eclissi.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Proprietà della luna ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Difficoltà / Livello di pericolo / Costo ===
'''Difficoltà''' è una valutazione basata su come le lune sono ordinate nel terminale della nave. Le prime tre sono lune facili da visitare con rispettivamente poco bottino e poche creature pericolose ''solitamente''. Le prossime due sono un po' più difficili. Quelle lune sono più difficili da attraversare ma offrono più bottino. Le ultime tre sono le lune più difficili con delle condizioni esterne come nebbia fitta e bufere di neve che rendono più arduo raggiungere l'entrata.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Il '''Livello di pericolo''' indica la definizione del gioco di quanto una luna sia difficile. Questo valore è fisso per ogni luna e non ha alcuna influenza oltre al fatto di essere un indicatore per gli impiegati.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Moltiplicatore grandezza della mappa ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La mappa interna della luna viene generata proceduralmente con un seme che cambia ogni volta all'atterraggio della nave. La grandezza di questa mappa generata dipende dal ''Moltiplicatore Grandezza della Mappa'' delle lune.
[[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] e [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] hanno la mappa più piccola con un moltiplicatore di 1 mentre [[Titan|8-Titan]] ha la più grande con un moltiplicatore di 2.35. Le mappe di grandezza più larghe possono portare alla formazione di enormi labirinti e più passerelle e corridoi intrecciati che perciò aumentano la probabilità di perdersi.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Scarti Minimi / Massimi ===

Ogni mappa ha un valore predefinito minimo e massimo di oggetti di scarto che possono essere generati. Il valore di questi oggetti è casuale ed è basato sulla tabella del bottino delle lune. Perciò sebbene alcune lune possano generare molti oggetti, è possibile essere molto fortunati o sfortunati e quindi trovare solo oggetti ad alto o a basso valore in una missione. In media però, un valore di scarti massimi più alto solitamente significa che si troverà molto bottino.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Internally, Max Scrap is one higher due to exclusive maximums used during generation.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
''Note: Additional items like [[Apparatus]] and [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]] may exceed Max Scrap count. For example, [[21-Offense]] may show 19 items due to 18 scrap + 1 Apparatus.''
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Max powers ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Max indoor and nighttime power influence potential entity spawns. See [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] for details.
</div>

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Interno predefinito ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La mappa interna definisce il tipo di interno che può essere [[La Struttura]] oppure [[La Magione]]. Ogni luna tranne [[March|61-March]] ha una piccola possibilità (in media molto piccola) di generare l'interno opposto invece di quello predefinito. Le probabilità che succede si trovano nella pagina individuale di ogni luna.
</div>

=== Condizioni meteo possibili ===
Tutte le condizioni meteorologiche che possono colpire una luna. Bisogna far notare che il meteo di una luna '''non influenza''' in nessun modo la quantità o il valore del bottino su quella luna e rende solamente il tutto più difficile per gli impiegati.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== 위성 속성 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 난이도/위험 수준/비용 ===
난이도는 함 터미널에서 달의 순서를 기준으로 한 등급입니다. 처음 세 개는 각각 평균적으로 전리품이 적고 덜 위험한 생물로 여행하기 쉬운 달입니다. 다음 두 가지는 조금 더 어렵습니다. 이 달은 여행하기에 더 위험하지만 더 많은 전리품을 제공합니다. 마지막 3개는 짙은 안개와 눈 폭풍과 같은 외부 조건으로 인해 입구까지 이동하기가 더 어려워지지만 전리품이 가장 많은 가장 어려운 달입니다.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
위험 수준은 달의 난이도를 게임 내에서 정의합니다. 이 값은 모든 달에 대해 고정되어 있으며 직원에게 지표가 되는 것 외에는 영향을 미치지 않습니다.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== 맵 크기 배율 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
달의 실내 맵은 함선이 착륙할 때마다 시드가 바뀌면서 절차적으로 생성됩니다. 생성된 맵의 크기는 달 지도 크기 승수에 따라 달라집니다. [[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] 및 [[Assurance|220-Assurance]]는 배수가 1로 가장 작은 맵 크기를 가지며, [[Titan|8-Titan]]은 배수가 2.35로 가장 큽니다. 지도 크기가 클수록 미로 구조가 커지고 통로와 통로가 더 얽혀 길을 잃을 가능성이 높아집니다.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== 최소/최대 폐품 개수 ===

각 맵에는 생성 가능한 스크랩 아이템의 최소 및 최대 수량이 미리 정의되어 있습니다. 이 아이템의 가치는 무작위이며 달의 전리품 표에 따라 결정됩니다. 따라서 일부 달에서 많은 아이템이 생성되더라도 운이 좋거나 나쁘면 한 번에 낮은 가치 또는 높은 가치의 아이템만 획득할 수 있습니다. 하지만 평균적으로 최대 폐품이 높을수록 전반적으로 전리품 가치가 높습니다.

'''''참고:''' 최대 폐품의 내부 값은 여기에 나열된 값보다 하나 더 높습니다. 이는 폐품을 생성할 때 게임이 독점적인 최대값을 사용하므로 이는 레벨에서 생성되는 실제 폐품의 개수를 나타냅니다.''

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''''참고:''' 행성에는 최대 폐품 수보다 더 많은 아이템이 있을 수 있습니다. 이는 [[Apparatus]]와 [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]]가 이 범위에서 고려되지 않기 때문입니다. 예를 들어, [[Offense|21-Offense]]에서는 17개의 폐품과 장치를 포함하여 최대 18개의 항목을 스캔하는 것이 가능합니다.''
</div>

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== 최대 파워 ===

최대 실내 파워과 최대 야간 파워는 맵에 생성될 수 있는 개체 수에 영향을 미칩니다. 자세한 내용은 [[Mechanics#생성 요구 사항]]을 확인하세요.

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== 기본 배치 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
맵 배치는 실내 맵 유형을 정의하며, [[Interiors#The Factory|공장]] 또는 [[Interiors#The Mansion|저]]이 될 수 있습니다. [[March|61-March]]을 제외한 모든 달은 기본 레이아웃 대신 반대 레이아웃으로 생성될 약간의 기회(보통 매우 적음)가 있습니다. 발생 가능성은 각 달의 개별 페이지에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
</div>

=== 가능한 날씨 ===
달이 경험할 수 있는 모든 날씨입니다. 달의 날씨는 해당 달의 전리품 양이나 가치에 '''전혀 영향을 미치지 않으며'''직원들을 더 힘들게 할 뿐이라는 점에 유의할 필요가 있습니다.

######## Moons/pl

'''Księżyce''' to ciała niebieskie, na których można wylądować by eksplorować i zebrać [[Scrap/pl|złom]]. Część z nich jest bardziej niebezpieczna od reszty, lecz jest również bardziej wartościowa w łup.

Księżyce mogą posiadać różną [[Weather/pl|pogodę]] jak na przykład burzę czy zaćmienie.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Właściwości Księżyców ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Trudność / Poziom Ryzyka / Cena ===
Trudność to ocena względem kolejności księżyców w terminalu. Pierwsze trzy są bezpieczne wraz z zmniejszoną ilością złomu oraz ilością groźnych bytów. Kolejne dwa są nieco trudniejsze. Są bardziej niebezpieczne by na nich lądować, ale oferują więcej łupu. Trzy ostatnie są najtrudniejszymi księżycami z trudnymi warunkami zewnętrznymi, takimi jak gęsta mgła i burze śnieżne co utrudnia dodatkowo nawigację do wejścia, lecz mają najwięcej złomu.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Poziom Ryzyka określa definicję w grze jak ciężki jest dany księżyc. Ta skala jest określona dla każdego księżyca i nie ma żadnego innego znaczenia jak być wskazówką dla zatrudnionych graczy.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Mnożnik wielkości mapy ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Rozmieszczenie pomieszczeń na danym księżycu jest za każdym razem losowo generowane wraz z tzw. "ziarnem" zmienianym za każdym lądowaniem statku. Wielkość tej wygenerowanej mapy jest zależna od ''mnożnika wielkości mapy'' księżyca. [[Experimentation/pl|41-Experimentation]] oraz [[Assurance/pl|220-Assurance]] mają najmniejszy przelicznik równy 1, gdy [[Titan/pl|8-Titan]] ma największy równy 2,2. Większa mapa prowadzi do zwiększenia się labiryntów bardziej splecionych mostków i korytarzy co zwiększa prawdopodobieństwo na zgubienie się.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Najmniej / Najwięcej złomu ===

Każda mapa ma swoją predefiniowaną minimalną i maksymalną ilość złomu jaka może się pojawić. Łączna wartość tych przedmiotów jest losowa i generowana zależnie od księżyca. Więc mimo iż niektóre księżyce mogą mieć bardzo dużo przedmiotów to i tak jest to możliwe by być fortunnym bądź pechowym i dostać minimalnie bądź maksymalnie warte przedmioty podczas rundy. Lecz ogólnie większa ilość łupu znaczy większą jego wartość.

'''''Info:''' Pierwotne wartości dla maksymalnej ilości złomu są o jedno wyższe niż wartości podane tutaj. Jest tak, ponieważ gra podczas generowania złomu wykorzystuje ekskluzywne maksimum, dlatego reprezentuje ono rzeczywistą maksymalną liczbę złomu pojawiającego się na danym poziomie.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''''Info:''' Możliwe jest by mieć więcej przedmiotów na księżycu niż maksymalna wartość. Jest tak, ponieważ [[Apparatus/pl|Baterie]] i [[Bee Hive/pl|Ule]] nie są wliczane w tą wartość. Na przykład, jest to możliwe by w komendzie '''scan''' pokazało 18 przedmiotów na [[Offence/pl|21-Offence]]: maksymalne 17 złomu plus Bateria.''
</div>

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== Maksymalna Moc ===

Maksymalna moc wnętrza i maksymalna moc nocna wpływa ile bytów może pojawić się na mapie. Sprawdź [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements|Warunki pojawiania się]] dla więcej informacji.

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Podstawowy plan ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Rozplanowanie mapy określa jej wewnętrzną część, a konkretnie wybór pomiędzy [[Interiors#The Facility/pl|bazą]] a [[Interiors#The Mansion/pl|rezydencją]]. Każdy księżyc, nie licząc [[March/pl|61-March]], ma malutką szansę (naprawdę małą) by stworzyć się z przeciwnym planem niż normalnie. Szanse na to mogą zostać znalezione na stronie każdego księżyca z osobna.
</div>

=== Możliwa Pogoda ===
Określa jakie pogody mogą wystąpić na księżycu. Warty uwagi jest fakt, że pogoda nie ma '''żadnego''' jakiegokolwiek wpływu na ilość i wartość złomu i utrudnia tylko zadanie dla zatrudnionych graczy.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Propriedades das luas ==

=== Dificuldade/Nível de Perigo/Custo ===
Dificuldade é uma classificação baseada em como as luas são ordenadas no terminal da nave. As três primeiras são luas fáceis de viajar, com respectivamente menos sucata e criaturas menos perigosas em média. As próximas três são um pouco mais perigosas, mas também oferecem mais sucata. As cinco últimas são as luas mais difíceis que carregam a maior quantidade de sucata, com condições externas como neblina densa e tempestades de neve que tornam mais difícil a navegação até a entrada.

O nível de perigo é a definição do jogo de quão difícil é uma lua. Esse valor é fixo para cada lua e não tem outra influência além de ser um indicador para ês funcionáries.

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Multiplicador de Tamanho de Mapa ===

O mapa interno da lua é gerado processualmente com uma seed que muda toda vez que a nave pousa. O tamanho deste mapa gerado depende do multiplicador de tamanho de mapa da lua. [[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] e [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] têm o menor tamanho de mapa com um multiplicador de 1 enquanto [[Titan|8-Titan]] tem o maior com um multiplicador de 2,2. Tamanhos maiores de mapas podem levar a estruturas labirínticas maiores, passarelas e corredores mais entrelaçados e portanto, uma maior possibilidade de se perder.

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Min./Máx. de sucata  ===

Cada mapa tem uma quantidade mínima e máxima predefinida de sucata que pode aparecer. O valor desses itens é aleatório e baseado na tabela de sucata da lua. Portanto, mesmo que algumas luas possam gerar muitos itens, ainda é possível ter muita sorte ou azar e obter apenas itens de baixo ou alto valor numa partida. Porém, em média, um máximo de sucata mais alto geralmente significa um valor geral de saque mais alto.

'''''Nota:''' Os valores internos para o máximo de sucata são subtraídos um para a listagem aqui. Por que quando gera sucata, o jogo usa um número máximo exclusivo portanto esses valores representam o número máximo de sucata real em uma lua.''

'''''Nota:''' É possível que tenham mais itens em uma lua do que o número máximo de sucata. Isso se deve ao fato de que o [[Apparatus/pt-br|Aparelho]] e a [[Bee Hive/pt-br|Colmeia]] não são contabilizados nesse número. Por exemplo, é possível escanear 18 itens na lua [[Offense|21-Offense]]: onde o número máximo é 17, porém, foi gerado um Aparelho.''

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== Valor máximo de poder ===

O valor máximo de poder do interior e o valor máximo de poder do exterior noturno afeta quantas entidades podem ser geradas em um mapa. Leia [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements]] para mais detalhes.

<!-- Favor atualizar para a versão pt-br quando está lançar -->

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Instalação padrão ===

A instalação do mapa define o tipo de interior que pode ser a [[Interiors/pt-br#A Instalaçao|fábrica]], a [[Interiors/pt-br#Mina/pt-br|mina]] ou a [[Interiors/pt-br#A Mansao| mansão]].
Toda lua exceto [[61-March/pt-br|61-March]] e [[56-Vow/pt-br|56-Vow]] tem uma pequena chance (normalmente muito pequena) de aparecer todos os três tipos de instalação ao invés da padrão.
As chances de isso acontecer podem ser encontradas nos artigos individuais de cada lua.

=== Clima possível ===
Todos os climas uma lua pode experienciar. Vale notar que o clima de uma lua '''não tem influência''' qualquer na quantia de saque ou no valor daquela lua e apenas dificulta para ês funcionáries.

######## Moons/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{stub en only}}
'''Луны''' являются небесными телами, на которых сотрудники могут найти [[scrap/ru|лом]]. Чем выше риск опасной ситуации на луне, тем более ценен лом на ней.

На лунах может быть разная [[weather/ru|погода]], например шторм или затмение.

=== Другие луны ===
* Луны из [[weekly challenge|еженедельного испытания]] обладают случайным названием (например Rapo-87), но используют поверхность любой другой стандартной луны в игре.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Особенности лун ==

=== Сложность/Уровень опасности/Цена ===
Сложность зависит от порядкового номера луны в терминале. Первые 3 луны легкие, но и имеют в среднем меньше предметов и не очень опасных сущностей. Три следующие немного посложнее. Отправляться на них опаснее, но они также содержат больше предметов. Последние пять считаются самыми сложными, содержащими больше всего предметов, но также имеют внешние условия вроде тумана, снежной бури и других уникальных усложнений которые делают передвижение ко входу труднее.

Уровень опасности является внутриигровым определением сложности луны. Это значение фиксировано для каждой луны и не влияет ни на что, просто является индикатором для сотрудников.

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Множитель размера карты ===

Внутренние помещения лун являются процедурно генерирующимися, завися от сида, который меняется при каждой посадке. Их размер зависит от множителя размера карты. [[Experimentation/ru|41-Experimentation]] и [[Assurance/ru|220-Assurance]] имеют самый маленький размер здания, имея множитель 1, а самым большим является [[Titan|8-Titan]], имея множитель 2.2. Более большой размер  может приводить к большим лабиринтам, неприятным разветвлениям, следовательно большему шансу потеряться.

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Минимальное/максимальное кол-во скрапа ===

Каждая карта имеет установленное минимальное и максимальное количество металлолома, которое может заспавниться. Цена продажи этих предметов рандомная и зависит от луны. Даже если некоторые луны могут иметь много предметов, это не значит, что они будут дорогими.

'''''Замечание:''' внутренние значения для максимального лута на один больше значений, указанных здесь. Так было решено потому, что игра использует исключающий максимум, следовательно значения здесь отражают действительный максимум лута на уровне.''

'''''Замечание:''' возможно иметь на луне больше максимального значения лута. Это возможно вследствие того, что [[Apparatus/ru|Аппарат]] и [[Bee Hive|Пчелиные ульи]] не учитываются в этом диапазоне. например можно найти 18 предметов на [[Offense/ru|21-Offense]]: максимальные 17 предметов плюс Аппарат.''

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== Максимальная сила ===

Макс. внутренняя сила и макс. ночная сила влияют на количество сущностей, которые могут появиться на карте. Смотри [[Mechanics#Spawning requirements|Механики]] для деталей.

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Стандартный тип здания ===

Тип здания определяет тип карты внутри здания, которым могут быть [[Interiors/ru#Завод|Завод]], [[Interiors/ru#Шахты (ожидается больше информации)|Шахты]] или [[Interiors/ru#Особняк|Особняк]].
На каждой луне, кроме [[March/ru|61-March]] и [[Vow/ru|56-Vow]] имеется небольшой шанс (часто очень мизерный) появления для всех типов здания вместо стандартного.
Эти шансы могут быть найдены на индивидуальной странице каждой луны.

=== Возможная погода ===
Погода, которая может быть на луне. Стоит заметить, что погода '''не влияет''' на кол-во предметов и их ценность, только усложняет жизнь сотрудникам.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== Ay özellikleri ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Zorluk/Risk seviyesi/Maliyet ===
Zorluk, geminin terminalinde ayların nasıl sıralandığına dayanan bir derecelendirmedir. İlk üçü, sırasıyla daha az ganimet ve ortalama olarak daha az tehlikeli yaratıklarla seyahat etmek için kolay aylardır. Sonraki ikisi biraz daha zordur. Bu aylara seyahat etmek daha tehlikelidir ancak aynı zamanda daha fazla ganimet sunar. Son üçü ise girişe gitmeyi zorlaştıran yoğun sis ve kar fırtınası gibi dış koşullara sahip en zor aylardır ancak en fazla ganimete sahiptir.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Risk seviyesi, bir ayın ne kadar zor olduğunun oyun içi tanımını belirler. Bu değer her ay için sabittir ve çalışanlar için bir gösterge olmanın dışında herhangi bir etkisi yoktur.
</div>

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== Harita boyutu çarpanı ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ayın iç mekan haritası, gemi her iniş yaptığında "seed"'in (tohum) değişmesiyle prosedürel olarak oluşturulur. Oluşturulan bu haritanın boyutu, ayların harita boyutu çarpanına bağlıdır. [[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] ve [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] 1 çarpanıyla en küçük harita boyutuna sahipken [[Titan|8-Titan]] 2,35 çarpanıyla en büyük harita boyutuna sahiptir. Daha büyük harita boyutları, daha büyük labirent yapılarına ve daha fazla iç içe geçmiş patika ve koridorlara ve dolayısıyla daha yüksek kaybolma olasılığına yol açabilir.
</div>

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== Min/Maks hurda ===

Her haritada ortaya çıkabilecek minimum ve maksimum hurda eşya miktarı önceden tanımlanmıştır. Bu eşyaların değeri rastgeledir ve ayların ganimet tablosuna dayanır. Bu nedenle, bazı aylarda çok fazla eşya ortaya çıkabilse de, gerçekten şanslı veya şanssız olmak ve bir koşuda yalnızca düşük değerli veya yüksek değerli eşyalar elde etmek hala mümkündür. Ortalama olarak, daha yüksek maksimum hurda genellikle genel olarak daha yüksek ganimet değeri anlamına gelir.

'''''Not:''' Maksimum Hurda için dahili değerler burada listelenen değerden bir yüksektir. Bunun nedeni, hurda üretirken oyunun özel bir maksimum kullanmasıdır, bu nedenle bunlar bir seviyede ortaya çıkan gerçek maksimum hurda parçalarını temsil eder.''

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''''Not:''' Bir gezegende maksimum hurda sayısından daha fazla öğe olması mümkündür. Bunun nedeni [[Aparat]] ve [[Arı Kovanı|Arı Kovanları]]'nın bu aralıkta hesaba katılmamasıdır. Örneğin, [[Offense|21-Offense]] üzerinde 18 öğe taramak mümkündür: maksimum 17 adet hurda artı aparat.''
</div>

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== Maksimum güçler ===

Maksimum iç mekan gücü ve maksimum gece gücü, bir haritada kaç varlığın ortaya çıkabileceğini etkiler. Ayrıntılar için [[Mekanikler#Doğma gereksinimleri]]'ni kontrol edin.

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== Varsayılan düzen ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Harita düzeni, [[İç Mekânlar#Fabrika|Fabrika]] veya [[İç Mekanlar#Köşk|Köşk]] olabilen iç mekan harita türünü tanımlar. [[March|61-March]] dışındaki her ayın, varsayılan düzen yerine tam tersi bir düzenle ortaya çıkma şansı vardır (genellikle çok küçüktür). Bunun gerçekleşme olasılığı her ayın kendi sayfasında bulunabilir.
</div>

=== Olası hava durumu ===
Bir ayın yaşayabileceği tüm hava koşulları. Bir ayın hava durumunun o aydaki ganimet miktarı veya değeri üzerinde '''hiçbir etkisi olmadığını''' ve sadece çalışanlar için daha zor hale getirdiğini belirtmek gerekir.

<span id="Moon_properties"></span>
== 星球属性 ==

=== 难度/危险等级/开销 ===
难度是根据飞船终端上的星球排序进行的评级。前三个星球是平均而言容易到达的、危险生物较少，但所含有的物品数量也相对较少的星球。接下来的三个星球则有一些困难，比前三个更危险一点，但能提供更多物品。最后五个是最难的星球，生成的废品数量最多，但它们也有外部条件，如浓雾、暴风雪和其他独特的威慑因素，这些都增加了前往入口的难度。

危险等级是游戏内定义的每个星球的困难程度。每个星球的危险等级都是不变的，且不会对游戏造成任何影响，仅供参考。

<span id="Map_size_multiplier"></span>
=== 地图尺寸乘数 ===

星球的室内地图会在每次飞船降落时用种子随机生成的，地图大小取决于地图尺寸乘数。[[Experimentation|41-Experimentation]] 和 [[Assurance|220-Assurance]] 具有最小的地图尺寸，其乘数为 1，而 [[Titan|8-Titan]] 具有最大的地图，其乘数为 2.2。更大的地图会产生更大的迷宫结构、更交叉重叠的走廊和楼梯以及更大的迷宫，意味着员工更有可能在大地图中迷路。

<span id="Min/Max_scrap"></span>
=== 最小/最大废料数 ===

每张地图都有预设的最小和最大的可生成废料数。这些物品的价值都是随机的并且基于星球的战利品表。因此即使有些星球可以生成很多物品，但是依然有可能在一次游戏中倒霉地得到低价值物品或幸运地得到高价值物品。不过平均而言，更高的最大废料数常常意味着整体上更高的战利品价值。

'''''注：'''游戏内部代码所使用的“最多废料数”值比上表所列的要大，差值为 1。这是因为游戏在生成废料时使用了不包含最大值的比较模式，所以表中列出的是游戏内实际生成的最多废料数。''

'''''注：'''实际星球上生成的物品数可能比最多废料数要多，因为[[Apparatus/zh-cn|发电装置]]和[[Bee Hive|蜂巢]]不算在这一限制内。例如可能在[[Offense|21-Offense]]上扫描到船外有 18 件物品，实际是 17 个废料外加 1 个发电装置。''

<span id="Max_powers"></span>
=== 最大能量值 ===

最大室内能量和最大夜间能量会影响地图中具体能生成多少实体。可在[[Mechanics#Spawning requirements|机制页的“生成需求”]]一节了解详情。

<span id="Default_layout"></span>
=== 默认结构 ===

每个星球都有一个最常被使用默认布局——[[Factory/zh-cn|工厂]]、[[Mineshaft/zh-cn|矿井]]或[[Mansion/zh-cn|豪宅]]。其他布局可能出现，除了固定的[[March/zh-cn|61-March]]。

=== 可能的天气 ===
一个星球可以出现的所有天气。值得注意的是，星球的天气对战利品的数量和价值没有'''任何影响'''，天气只会增加员工的工作难度。

######## Mug
{{topicon Fandom|Coffee_Mug}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=<!--no-->
|primary-use=<!--none-->
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=Yes (undocumented)
}}
The '''Mug''' (or, "Coffee mug") is a low-to-mid-value Scrap that can spawn in one of 5 different variants. 

The Coffee Mug is one of the few non-rare items (implying [[Gold bar]]s, [[Cash register]]s and [[Zed Dog]]s are excluded here) that have a large price fork, similarly to the [[Rubber Ducky]] or [[Laser Pointer]].

== Item Variants ==
[[File:Mug Variants.png|thumb|Each variant of Mug placed next to each other in the [[Facility]].]]
There are 5 possible appearances of the Mug:

* Lavender with a small white creature drawn on the front.
* Plain red
* Red with a graphic on the front reading: "#1 MUG".
* A light green mug with a graphic on the front depicting a cow & rising sun behind it
* A dark gray mug with large yellow text with an orange outline reading: "MORNING! MORNING! MORNING!".

The default appearance is the lavender mug, which will be chosen upon reloading a save file containing the item due to the game not remembering item variants.

== Trivia ==

The "small white creature" found on the lavender variant of Mug comes from the profile picture of Puffo, who is one of [[Zeekerss]]' friends & original testers of Lethal Company.

The light green variant of Mug uses a cow graphic taken from the painting [[W:Wivenhoe Park (painting)|Wivenhoe Park]], by John Constable. This is the same painting that's used in the "fake window" room of [[Mansion|Mansions]], as well as in both variants of the [[Painting]] item.

The name of this item is different in its scan node, being called "Coffee mug" instead of "Mug" which is how it's referred to everywhere else in the game.

######## Nutcracker
{{topicon Fandom}}

The '''Nutcracker''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It initially patrols and surveys its surroundings for any signs of movement. Upon detecting movement from a nearby entity or employee, it chases after them and uses a variety of deadly attacks, such as kicking or blasting the target with a [[shotgun]]. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

Nutcrackers are tall, skinny biomechanical entities that appear to be larger-than-life versions of their [[w:Nutcracker doll|real-life counterparts]]. They have hollow white eyes, circular red cheeks, and an outfit resembling that of a [[w:Red coat (military uniform)|British red coat]], and are also armed with a shotgun and a belt containing eight shotgun shells around their waist. Upon opening their mouth, a small, cyclopic entity with a yellow iris, connected by fleshy veins to the Nutcracker's torso, can also be seen.
