== Mechanics == <!--T:4-->

<!--T:5-->
The Nutcracker spawns carrying a [[Shotgun]], which serves as its primary form of offense. It has infinite ammo for this shotgun, and can shoot twice before having to reload. The Nutcracker drops its shotgun and 2 [[Ammo|shells]] upon death, with any unfired shells remaining in the gun.

<!--T:6-->
The Nutcracker is also capable of kicking any employee if they get too close, instantly killing them and immediately sending the Nutcracker into the attack state, possibly dooming any other nearby employees.

<!--T:7-->
The Nutcracker cannot take damage until its eye is exposed, but can register being attacked. A shotgun blast or several shovel hits will make the Nutcracker immediately start attacking the instigating employee.

<!--T:8-->
As of version 47, Nutcrackers can aim while moving, making it much more adept at corner kills. 

<!--T:9-->
The Nutcracker has 3 behavioral states which are described below.

=== Patrol === <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
The Nutcracker patrols, wandering around the facility. In this state it cannot see, and thus has no awareness of its surroundings.

<!--T:12-->
Every 8 to 17 seconds<ref>https://pastebin.com/SDWBuQ9U</ref>, a Nutcracker will check a certain list of conditions:<ref>https://pastebin.com/84efYzkE</ref>

<!--T:13-->
 At least 4 seconds have passed since the last inspection
 AND
 (
   The distance to the nearest employee is short enough (27 units - almost maximum shotgun range) 
   OR
   Successfully pass a 40% chance
 )

<!--T:14-->
If the above conditions succeed, the Nutcracker enters the scanning state.

=== Scanning === <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
The Nutcracker stops moving and scans its surroundings, raising its headpiece and turning counterclockwise in increments until it has turned a full 360 degrees or the below conditions are met. In this state the Nutcracker has a field of view of 140 degrees.<ref>https://pastebin.com/msJzae0M</ref>

<!--T:17-->
The Nutcracker will move to the attack state if:

<!--T:18-->
* The employee is within line-of-sight or too close to the Nutcracker<ref>https://pastebin.com/0PmVZCHF</ref>

<!--T:19-->
* That same employee is also 'moving'<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref>
** Performing an emote
** Moving the mouse/turning
** Crouching down or standing up
** Walking or sprinting
Note: Walking or sprinting without moving the camera wouldn't alert the Nutcracker, which seemed to be a bug. This behavior is fixed in v50.

<!--T:20-->
If the above conditions are not met, the Nutcracker will return to patrolling. 

=== Attack === <!--T:21-->
</translate>
[[File:Nutcracker Alert.ogg|thumb|200px|<translate><!--T:52--> The "metal ringing" sound when a Nutcracker targets an employee</translate>]]
[[File:Nutcracker Angry.ogg|thumb|200px|<translate><!--T:53--> The music looped during a Nutcracker's attack</translate>]]
<translate>

<!--T:22-->
The Nutcracker targets an employee. A metal ringing will sound when an employee is targeted, and distorted whistling with marching drums will play to indicate the attack state is in effect. At this point, the targeted employee can no longer freeze to avoid being seen until the attack state ends.

<!--T:23-->
In this state, the Nutcracker will follow and attack the targeted employee until the employee dies or line of sight has been broken for a sufficient amount of time (at least 12 seconds), at which point the Nutcracker will move to the scanning state, and then back to the patrolling state if no employee is found.

<!--T:60-->
The Nutcracker cannot see employees <em>other</em> than the targeted employee unless they move, even in this state. If it sees an employee moving when they are significantly closer to the Nutcracker than its target is, or when it has not seen its target in 3 seconds, it will change its target to that employee, regardless of which sub-phase it is in.

<!--T:61-->
There are 3 sub-phases during this state.

<!--T:62-->
==== Pursuing ====
While attacking, the Nutcracker moves towards the employee's last known position at speed of 7 units per second. If the employee was seen in the last 0.5 seconds, it paths directly to the employee, stopping 1 unit away, otherwise it calculates a position 5-6 units away from the employee and stops when within 2 units of said position. While moving, it will strafe to ensure it faces the employee to allow the aiming phase to trigger.

<!--T:63-->
==== Aiming ====
Every frame, if each of the following checks pass, the Nutcracker progresses to the aiming phase:
* Line of sight with employee
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* Not reloading or aiming
* Time since last kick >1 second
* Angle to employee is within 30 degrees
* The held shotgun has shells loaded
The time taken to aim changes depending based on the amount of shells in the shotgun. With two shells loaded, it will spend 1.75 seconds aiming, while with one, it takes 1.3 seconds. If the Nutcracker's HP is 1, the aim time is always 0.5 seconds.
Every time the Nutcracker enters the aiming phase, it increments a counter for the employee it is aiming at. If the current targeted employee is different to the employee targeted last time it aimed, the counters for all employees are reset. While this counter is less than or equal to 2, the Nutcracker cannot move while aiming, but for all subsequent shots it slows down to a speed of 2.25 units per second.
After the aim timer has elapsed, it fires a shot, using a shell from the shotgun. After the shot, it waits 0.35 seconds, retaining the movement speed from the aim phase.

<!--T:64-->
While aiming, the Nutcracker cannot kick.

<!--T:65-->
==== Reloading ====
The reloading phase is activated when:
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* The held shotgun has no shells loaded
While reloading, the Nutcracker cannot move. This phase lasts exactly 1.74 seconds during which it is most vulnerable, as it cannot move, shoot, or kick. After the time has elapsed, the shotgun will have 2 shells loaded, and the Nutcracker will return to the pursuing phase.

<!--T:57-->
The hit detection and damage is [[Shotgun#Mechanics|explained in the Shotgun article]]. (It's the same logic as when an employee uses a shotgun.)

== Strategy == <!--T:24-->

<!--T:25-->
The Nutcracker can be a very dangerous adversary due to its extremely lethal shotgun that can instantly kill any employee caught out in the open, making cover a must for most fights with a Nutcracker. However, despite this danger the Nutcracker is usually an enemy worth killing, as the shotgun it drops is a very powerful weapon and can be sold to help meet quota. Do not be fooled by the ‘grab’ prompt that appears when hovering over an active Nutcracker’s shotgun, a Nutcracker’s shotgun cannot be taken from its hands until it is dead. '''There is no way to get around fighting the Nutcracker if you want its shotgun.''' 

<!--T:26-->
Be warned when fighting a Nutcracker that it can instantly kill you by kicking you if you come into physical contact with it but cannot kick you if it is firing or reloading its shotgun. Additionally, sometimes the Nutcracker will chase you while running backwards, and is unable to shoot you whilst doing so. If it touches you while this is happening, it will kick you and kill you, so it is advised to circle an obstacle and hope it starts facing you again. This is likely not an intended mechanic and is therefore (probably) a bug.

<!--T:27-->
Nutcrackers can also kill other monsters with their shots, however they will not intentionally target other monsters, so getting this to happen will require an employee to be targeted by a Nutcracker and bait its shots into collaterally killing other enemies. If you decide to take the attention of 2 Nutcrackers at once, one may kill the other depending on their positioning relative to you and to each other, giving you the opportunity to take the dead Nutcracker's shotgun and kill the one left alive with it.

<!--T:51-->
Technically speaking, it is possible to jump a shotgun blast from a Nutcracker but requires amazing timing and a decent amount of distance.

<!--T:28-->
Below are some strategies for dealing with a Nutcracker.

=== Ambush (Shovel) === <!--T:29-->

<!--T:30-->
This is one of the quickest methods of killing a Nutcracker, but it requires multiple employees with multiple [[Shovel]]s. This strategy is very simple: 2-4 employees grab shovels, group up around the Nutcracker while it's in its patrol state and hit it to death as soon as it enters its scanning state and raises its headpiece, as there is a short delay before the Nutcracker can fire out of its scanning state. Stunning the Nutcracker with either a [[Homemade flashbang]]/[[Stun grenade]] or a [[Zap gun]] can aid this strategy, allowing more time for the Nutcracker to be beaten down without repercussion. Be careful when trying to kill a Nutcracker this way, as it can be very easy to hit or be hit by your fellow employees while trying to gang up on the Nutcracker.

=== Ambush (Shotgun) === <!--T:31-->

<!--T:32-->
This is much the same as the above method, only it is both easier and faster, as it requires only one employee and one shotgun instead of multiple employees and multiple shovels. Simply walk up to a Nutcracker with a loaded shotgun and shoot it point blank at any point when its eye is exposed. If done correctly the Nutcracker will instantly die, as a shotgun can do up to 5 damage per shot if the target is close enough.

=== Bait and Hit === <!--T:33-->

<!--T:34-->
This strategy is not reliant on employee count. Find cover you're comfortable with then get a Nutcracker to target you before retreating to the aforementioned cover. Peek out of cover for a moment to bait out its first shot, repeat to bait out its second shot, and then attack once with a shovel while it's reloading and start the sequence over. A Nutcracker will make the same metal ringing noises mentioned in the attack state section every time it's about to fire, which can make knowing when to take cover easier. This strategy can be done with one employee as the bait and another as the attacker, or with one employee as both the bait and attacker. Note that Nutcrackers have 5 hit points and thus take 5 hits from a shovel to die, and that a Nutcracker on its last health point will reload and fire much faster. Because of this it's recommended to hit the Nutcracker a total of 3 times, then finish it off with 2 consecutive hits to avoid dealing with a low health Nutcracker.

<!--T:35-->
'''Note:''' due to Nutcrackers being able to aim while moving as of version 47, along with being more aggressive with its kick attack, this strategy now requires constant movement and good reflexes to properly dodge.

=== Landmine === <!--T:58-->

<!--T:59-->
A landmine can be used to instantly kill a Nutcracker. A Nutcracker will chase a targeted employee while in the attack state, which can be utilized to draw the Nutcracker toward a landmine to kill it. Note that Nutcrackers cannot activate landmines on their own, so it is on the employee to activate it. Things that will trip a landmine include scrap, live or spent stun grenades, and employees.

=== Spike Trap === <!--T:66-->

<!--T:67-->
If a Nutcracker is underneath a descending spike trap, the trap will instantly kill it. This is much easier to arrange with spike traps that operate on a timed interval than with motion-activated spike traps. A patrolling Nutcracker may walk under a nearby spike trap on its own initiative, or an attacking Nutcracker may pass beneath one while chasing an employee. Once the Nutcracker is dead, the safest method for employees to retrieve its shotgun without themselves being killed by the spike trap is to have another employee turn the trap off at the terminal. Depending on the trap interval and positioning of the Nutcracker's corpse, it may be possible (if risky) for an employee to simply run through and grab the shotgun between intervals.

=== Avoid === <!--T:38-->

<!--T:39-->
If you wish not to fight a Nutcracker, you must take advantage of the quirks of its patrol and scanning states. While a Nutcracker is patrolling it is effectively blind, meaning you can pass by one safely in this state as long as you keep your distance to avoid being kicked. If a Nutcracker enters the scanning state as you're passing by, stand completely still when it turns to face you and wait for it to continue turning, as it cannot detect you unless you are in its line of sight ''and'' moving. Note that even actions you may think count as stationary, like moving your camera or emoting, count as moving and will allow the Nutcracker to target you.<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref> It is recommended to keep your eye on the Nutcracker as you pass by so that, should it enter its scanning state while you're nearby, you know when you're out of its vision and can thus move freely.

== History == <!--T:40-->

<!--T:41-->
=== [[Version 45]] ===
* Introduced.

<!--T:42-->
=== [[Version 47]] ===
* Nutcracker can now move while aiming.

<!--T:55-->
=== [[Version 50]] ===
* Nutcracker can now aim downwards, rendering the "crouch cheese" strategy of crouching just outside of kicking range impossible.
* Nutcracker can now see employees walking, sprinting, and jumping while in the scanning state, even if the employees in question do not turn their camera while moving.

== Mechanics ==

The Nutcracker spawns carrying a [[Shotgun]], which serves as its primary form of offense. It has infinite ammo for this shotgun, and can shoot twice before having to reload. The Nutcracker drops its shotgun and 2 [[Ammo|shells]] upon death, with any unfired shells remaining in the gun.

 At least 4 seconds have passed since the last inspection
 AND

   The distance to the nearest employee is short enough (27 units - almost maximum shotgun range) 
   OR
   Successfully pass a 40% chance
 )

If the above conditions succeed, the Nutcracker enters the scanning state.

The Nutcracker stops moving and scans its surroundings, raising its headpiece and turning counterclockwise in increments until it has turned a full 360 degrees or the below conditions are met. In this state the Nutcracker has a field of view of 140 degrees.<ref>https://pastebin.com/msJzae0M</ref>

* The employee is within line-of-sight or too close to the Nutcracker<ref>https://pastebin.com/0PmVZCHF</ref>

** Moving the mouse/turning
** Crouching down or standing up
** Walking or sprinting

=== Attack ===
[[File:Nutcracker Alert.ogg|thumb|200px|The "metal ringing" sound when a Nutcracker targets an employee]]
[[File:Nutcracker Angry.ogg|thumb|200px|The music looped during a Nutcracker's attack]]

The Nutcracker targets an employee. A metal ringing will sound when an employee is targeted, and distorted whistling with marching drums will play to indicate the attack state is in effect. At this point, the targeted employee can no longer freeze to avoid being seen until the attack state ends.

In this state, the Nutcracker will follow and attack the targeted employee until the employee dies or line of sight has been broken for a sufficient amount of time (at least 12 seconds), at which point the Nutcracker will move to the scanning state, and then back to the patrolling state if no employee is found.

The Nutcracker cannot see employees <em>other</em> than the targeted employee unless they move, even in this state. If it sees an employee moving when they are significantly closer to the Nutcracker than its target is, or when it has not seen its target in 3 seconds, it will change its target to that employee, regardless of which sub-phase it is in.

There are 3 sub-phases during this state.

==== Pursuing ====
While attacking, the Nutcracker moves towards the employee's last known position at speed of 7 units per second. If the employee was seen in the last 0.5 seconds, it paths directly to the employee, stopping 1 unit away, otherwise it calculates a position 5-6 units away from the employee and stops when within 2 units of said position. While moving, it will strafe to ensure it faces the employee to allow the aiming phase to trigger.

==== Aiming ====
Every frame, if each of the following checks pass, the Nutcracker progresses to the aiming phase:
* Line of sight with employee
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* Not reloading or aiming
* Time since last kick >1 second
* Angle to employee is within 30 degrees
* The held shotgun has shells loaded
The time taken to aim changes depending based on the amount of shells in the shotgun. With two shells loaded, it will spend 1.75 seconds aiming, while with one, it takes 1.3 seconds. If the Nutcracker's HP is 1, the aim time is always 0.5 seconds.
Every time the Nutcracker enters the aiming phase, it increments a counter for the employee it is aiming at. If the current targeted employee is different to the employee targeted last time it aimed, the counters for all employees are reset. While this counter is less than or equal to 2, the Nutcracker cannot move while aiming, but for all subsequent shots it slows down to a speed of 2.25 units per second.
After the aim timer has elapsed, it fires a shot, using a shell from the shotgun. After the shot, it waits 0.35 seconds, retaining the movement speed from the aim phase.

While aiming, the Nutcracker cannot kick.

==== Reloading ====
The reloading phase is activated when:
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* The held shotgun has no shells loaded
While reloading, the Nutcracker cannot move. This phase lasts exactly 1.74 seconds during which it is most vulnerable, as it cannot move, shoot, or kick. After the time has elapsed, the shotgun will have 2 shells loaded, and the Nutcracker will return to the pursuing phase.

The hit detection and damage is [[Shotgun#Mechanics|explained in the Shotgun article]]. (It's the same logic as when an employee uses a shotgun.)

== Strategy ==

The Nutcracker can be a very dangerous adversary due to its extremely lethal shotgun that can instantly kill any employee caught out in the open, making cover a must for most fights with a Nutcracker. However, despite this danger the Nutcracker is usually an enemy worth killing, as the shotgun it drops is a very powerful weapon and can be sold to help meet quota. Do not be fooled by the ‘grab’ prompt that appears when hovering over an active Nutcracker’s shotgun, a Nutcracker’s shotgun cannot be taken from its hands until it is dead. '''There is no way to get around fighting the Nutcracker if you want its shotgun.''' 

Be warned when fighting a Nutcracker that it can instantly kill you by kicking you if you come into physical contact with it but cannot kick you if it is firing or reloading its shotgun. Additionally, sometimes the Nutcracker will chase you while running backwards, and is unable to shoot you whilst doing so. If it touches you while this is happening, it will kick you and kill you, so it is advised to circle an obstacle and hope it starts facing you again. This is likely not an intended mechanic and is therefore (probably) a bug.

Nutcrackers can also kill other monsters with their shots, however they will not intentionally target other monsters, so getting this to happen will require an employee to be targeted by a Nutcracker and bait its shots into collaterally killing other enemies. If you decide to take the attention of 2 Nutcrackers at once, one may kill the other depending on their positioning relative to you and to each other, giving you the opportunity to take the dead Nutcracker's shotgun and kill the one left alive with it.

Technically speaking, it is possible to jump a shotgun blast from a Nutcracker but requires amazing timing and a decent amount of distance.

Below are some strategies for dealing with a Nutcracker.

=== Ambush (Shovel) ===

This is one of the quickest methods of killing a Nutcracker, but it requires multiple employees with multiple [[Shovel]]s. This strategy is very simple: 2-4 employees grab shovels, group up around the Nutcracker while it's in its patrol state and hit it to death as soon as it enters its scanning state and raises its headpiece, as there is a short delay before the Nutcracker can fire out of its scanning state. Stunning the Nutcracker with either a [[Homemade flashbang]]/[[Stun grenade]] or a [[Zap gun]] can aid this strategy, allowing more time for the Nutcracker to be beaten down without repercussion. Be careful when trying to kill a Nutcracker this way, as it can be very easy to hit or be hit by your fellow employees while trying to gang up on the Nutcracker.

=== Ambush (Shotgun) ===

This is much the same as the above method, only it is both easier and faster, as it requires only one employee and one shotgun instead of multiple employees and multiple shovels. Simply walk up to a Nutcracker with a loaded shotgun and shoot it point blank at any point when its eye is exposed. If done correctly the Nutcracker will instantly die, as a shotgun can do up to 5 damage per shot if the target is close enough.

=== Bait and Hit ===

This strategy is not reliant on employee count. Find cover you're comfortable with then get a Nutcracker to target you before retreating to the aforementioned cover. Peek out of cover for a moment to bait out its first shot, repeat to bait out its second shot, and then attack once with a shovel while it's reloading and start the sequence over. A Nutcracker will make the same metal ringing noises mentioned in the attack state section every time it's about to fire, which can make knowing when to take cover easier. This strategy can be done with one employee as the bait and another as the attacker, or with one employee as both the bait and attacker. Note that Nutcrackers have 5 hit points and thus take 5 hits from a shovel to die, and that a Nutcracker on its last health point will reload and fire much faster. Because of this it's recommended to hit the Nutcracker a total of 3 times, then finish it off with 2 consecutive hits to avoid dealing with a low health Nutcracker.

'''Note:''' due to Nutcrackers being able to aim while moving as of version 47, along with being more aggressive with its kick attack, this strategy now requires constant movement and good reflexes to properly dodge.

=== Landmine ===

A landmine can be used to instantly kill a Nutcracker. A Nutcracker will chase a targeted employee while in the attack state, which can be utilized to draw the Nutcracker toward a landmine to kill it. Note that Nutcrackers cannot activate landmines on their own, so it is on the employee to activate it. Things that will trip a landmine include scrap, live or spent stun grenades, and employees.

=== Spike Trap ===

If a Nutcracker is underneath a descending spike trap, the trap will instantly kill it. This is much easier to arrange with spike traps that operate on a timed interval than with motion-activated spike traps. A patrolling Nutcracker may walk under a nearby spike trap on its own initiative, or an attacking Nutcracker may pass beneath one while chasing an employee. Once the Nutcracker is dead, the safest method for employees to retrieve its shotgun without themselves being killed by the spike trap is to have another employee turn the trap off at the terminal. Depending on the trap interval and positioning of the Nutcracker's corpse, it may be possible (if risky) for an employee to simply run through and grab the shotgun between intervals.

=== Avoid ===

If you wish not to fight a Nutcracker, you must take advantage of the quirks of its patrol and scanning states. While a Nutcracker is patrolling it is effectively blind, meaning you can pass by one safely in this state as long as you keep your distance to avoid being kicked. If a Nutcracker enters the scanning state as you're passing by, stand completely still when it turns to face you and wait for it to continue turning, as it cannot detect you unless you are in its line of sight ''and'' moving. Note that even actions you may think count as stationary, like moving your camera or emoting, count as moving and will allow the Nutcracker to target you.<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref> It is recommended to keep your eye on the Nutcracker as you pass by so that, should it enter its scanning state while you're nearby, you know when you're out of its vision and can thus move freely.

== History ==

=== [[Version 45]] ===
* Introduced.

=== [[Version 47]] ===
* Nutcracker can now move while aiming.

=== [[Version 50]] ===
* Nutcracker can now aim downwards, rendering the "crouch cheese" strategy of crouching just outside of kicking range impossible.
* Nutcracker can now see employees walking, sprinting, and jumping while in the scanning state, even if the employees in question do not turn their camera while moving.

The '''Nutcracker''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It initially patrols and surveys its surroundings for any signs of movement. Upon detecting movement from a nearby entity or employee, it chases after them and uses a variety of deadly attacks, such as kicking or blasting the target with a [[shotgun]]. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

Nutcrackers are tall, skinny biomechanical entities that appear to be larger-than-life versions of their [[w:Nutcracker doll|real-life counterparts]]. They have hollow white eyes, circular red cheeks, and an outfit resembling that of a [[w:Red coat (military uniform)|British red coat]], and are also armed with a shotgun and a belt containing eight shotgun shells around their waist. Upon opening their mouth, a small, cyclopic entity with a yellow iris, connected by fleshy veins to the Nutcracker's torso, can also be seen.

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mecánicas ==

El Cascanueces aparece portando una [[Shotgun|Escopeta]], la cual es su principal forma de ataque. Tiene munición infinita para su escopeta, puede disparar hasta dos veces antes de tener que recargar. 
El Cascanueces soltará su escopeta y 2 [[Ammo|cartuchos]] al morir, además la escopeta mantendrá los cartuchos que no se hayan disparado.

El Cascanueces puede patear a cualquier empleado que se le acerque demasiado, lo que instantáneamente eliminara al jugador y activará el modo de ataque de los Cascanueces, lo que podría condenar al resto de empleados que se encuentren cerca del Cascanueces.

El Cascanueces no puede recibir daño hasta que su ojo esté expuesto, pero puede registrar que ha sido atacado. Un disparo de escopeta o una serie de palazos hará que el Cascanueces ataque al empleado instigador.

Desde la versión 47, el Cascanueces puede apuntar mientras se mueve, lo que le facilita eliminar empleados por las esquinas. 

El Cascanueces tiene 3 estados de comportamiento que se describirán a continuación.

<span id="Patrol"></span>
=== Patrullar ===

El Cascanueces patrullará la instalación. En este estado no puede ver, por lo que no es consciente de sus alrededores.

Cada entre 8 y 17 segundos, un Cascanueces comprobará una lista de condiciones:

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Si al menos 4 segundos han pasado desde la última inspección 
Y
(
La distancia hasta el empleado más cercano es lo suficientemente corta (27 unidades - casi el máximo rango de la escopeta) o conseguir pasar una probabilidad del 40%
)
</div>

Si las condiciones anteriores suceden, entonces el Cascanueces entra en su modo de escaneo.

<span id="Scanning"></span>
=== Escanear ===

El Cascanueces deja de moverse y escanea sus alrededores, levantando su cabeza y girándose en dirección antihoraria hasta hacer un giro de 360 grados o si las condiciones siguientes se cumplen. En este estado el Cascanueces tiene un campo de visión de 140 grados.
<ref>https://pastebin.com/msJzae0M</ref>

El Cascanueces cambiará al modo ataque si:

*El empleado está en el campo de visión del Cascanueces o muy cerca de este mismo.
<ref>https://pastebin.com/0PmVZCHF</ref>

*Ese mismo empleado se esta 'moviendo' <ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref>
**Haciendo una acción (Emote)
**Moviendo el ratón
**Agachándose o levantándose
**Caminando o corriendo

Si no suceden las condiciones anteriores, el Cascanueces volverá a patrullar. 

<span id="Attack"></span>
=== Atacar ===
[[File:Nutcracker Alert.ogg|thumb|200px|El sonido de un "timbre mecánico" cuando un Cascanueces detecta un empleado]]
[[File:Nutcracker Angry.ogg|thumb|200px|La música que suena durante el ataque de un Cascanueces]]

El Cascanueces detecta al empleado. Un timbre metálico suena cuando un empleado es detectado, y un silbato junto a tambores de marcha suenan para indicar que el Cascanueces está en estado de ataque. En este punto el empleado detectado no puede detenerse para evitar que el Cascanueces lo vea hasta que el estado de ataque finalice.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
En este estado, el Cascanueces seguirá y atacará al empleado detectado hasta que muera o lo pierda de vista por suficiente tiempo (Al menos 12 segundos), en ese punto el Cascanueces volverá al estado de escaneo, y entonces volverá a patrullar si no encuentra ningún empleado. Adicionalmente, el Cascanueces no ignorará a otros empleados mientras esté en el estado de ataque, incluso si el empleado detectado originalmente muere o consigue evadir al Cascanueces.
</div>

</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estrategia ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
El Cascanueces es un adversario muy peligroso por su letal escopeta, pueden eliminar instantáneamente a cualquier empleado. A pesar de eso, vale mucho la pena eliminar a un Cascanueces por su escopeta. Es una arma muy poderosa y puede ayudar a cumplir la cuota.
A pesar de que parezca que puedes agarrar la escopeta de las manos del Cascanueces, es imposible. '''Si quiere la escopeta tienes que enfrentarte al Cascanueces.'''
</div> 

Ten en cuenta al pelear contra un Cascanueces que puede eliminarte instantáneamente con una patada si  haces contacto físico con él, pero no puede patearte si está disparando o recargando. Adicionalmente, el Cascanueces puede empezar a correr al revés, no puede dispararte, pero si te toca te pateará y morirás, así que se recomienda rotar algún obstáculo y esperar que vuelva a mirar hacia tu dirección.
Esta mecánica no es intencional, es (probablemente) un error.

Los Cascanueces pueden matar a otros enemigos con su escopeta, pero ellos no intentarán atacarlos intencionalmente, para que esto pase un empleado debe ser detectado por el Cascanueces e intentar que los disparos de la escopeta cause daño colateral a otro enemigo, eliminándolo en el acto.
Si decides enfrentarte a 2 Cascanueces al mismo tiempo, uno puede matar al otro dependiendo de su posición relativa a la tuya y a la del otro Cascanueces, esto te da la oportunidad de obtener la escopeta del Cascanueces eliminado y utilizarla para eliminar al Cascanueces restante más fácilmente.

Técnicamente, es posible saltar los disparos de una escopeta de Cascanueces, pero requiere una sincronización increíble y una distancia decente.

A continuación encontrarás algunas estrategias para lidiar con un Cascanueces.

<span id="Ambush_(Shovel)"></span>
=== Asalto (Pala) ===

Este es uno de los métodos más rápidos para eliminar un Cascanueces, pero requiere múltiples empleados con múltiples [[Shovel|Pala]]s. 
Es una estrategia simple: Entre 2 y 4 empleados agarrarán palas y rodearán al Cascanueces mientras está patrullando, en el momento en el que comience a escanear, los empleados lo apalizarán hasta la muerte, ya que un Cascanueces tarda algo de tiempo en empezar a disparar. 

Aturdir al Cascanueces con una [[Homemade flashbang|Granada cegadora casera]]/[[Stun grenade|Granada aturdidora]] o una [[Zap gun|Pistola Eléctrica]] puede ser de mucha ayuda, ya que puede permitir a los empleados eliminar al Cascanueces sin ningún problema. 
Pero se debe tener cuidado, ya que se puede acabar aturdiendo a otros empleados por accidente.

<span id="Ambush_(Shotgun)"></span>
=== Asalto (Escopeta) ===

Es similar al método anterior, pero es más fácil y rápido, solo requiere un empleado con una escopeta. Simplemente acércate al Cascanueces con la escopeta cargada y dispárale directamente en el momento en el que su ojo esté expuesto. Si se hace correctamente el Cascanueces morirá instantáneamente, ya que la escopeta puede hacer hasta 5 de daño si el objetivo está lo suficientemente cerca.

<span id="Bait_and_Hit"></span>
=== Señuelo y ataque ===

En esta estrategia no importa el número de empleados disponibles. 

Encuentra un lugar donde cubrirte de los ataques del Cascanueces, como por ejemplo una esquina, sal de esa esquina para que el Cascanueces te vea, en el momento en el que se prepare para disparar escóndete (Sabrás que se está preparando para disparar por el timbre metálico que suena al detectar a alguien), así le harás fallar su primer disparo, repite lo mismo otra vez para que falle su segundo disparo, si es necesario cambia de lugar para cubrirte. 
Al fallar los dos disparos, el Cascanueces recargará su escopeta, ahí el empleado deberá atacar al Cascanueces.

En esta estrategia un empleado puede ser el señuelo, mientras que el otro atacará al Cascanueces.

Se debe tener en cuenta que el Cascanueces tiene 5 puntos de vida, lo que significa que se debe golpear 5 veces con la pala. Un Cascanueces en su último punto de vida dispara y recarga mucho más rápido, por eso es importante que el último ataque que un empleado le haga a un Cascanueces le reste sus 2 últimos puntos de vida restantes para evitar tener que lidiar con un Cascanueces con poca vida (Como, por ejemplo, restarle 1-2-2 cada vez que el Cascanueces esté recargando su escopeta).

'''Nota:''' Desde la versión 47 el Cascanueces puede apuntar mientras se mueve y además es más agresivo con sus patadas, esta estrategia requiere movimiento constante y buenos reflejos.

<span id="Landmine"></span>
=== Mina Terrestre ===

Puedes utilizar una mina terrestre para eliminar al Cascanueces instantáneamente.
Un Cascanueces perseguirá a un empleado mientras esté en su modo ataque, esto te da la oportunidad de hacer que se acerque a una mina terrestre y eliminarlo. Ten en cuenta que los Cascanueces no pueden activar las minas terrestres por sí mismos, así que un empleado deberá activarla. Puedes utilizar chatarra, el casquete utilizado de una granada aturdidora (O una granada aturdidora que aún no haya sido utilizada) y puedes tú mismo pisarla

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Spike Trap ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If a Nutcracker is underneath a descending spike trap, the trap will instantly kill it. This is much easier to arrange with spike traps that operate on a timed interval than with motion-activated spike traps. A patrolling Nutcracker may walk under a nearby spike trap on its own initiative, or an attacking Nutcracker may pass beneath one while chasing an employee. Once the Nutcracker is dead, the safest method for employees to retrieve its shotgun without themselves being killed by the spike trap is to have another employee turn the trap off at the terminal. Depending on the trap interval and positioning of the Nutcracker's corpse, it may be possible (if risky) for an employee to simply run through and grab the shotgun between intervals.
</div>

<span id="Avoid"></span>
=== Evitar ===

Si no desear pelear con un Cascanueces, puedes aprovechar como patrulla para evitarlo con más facilidad, ya que en este estado el Cascanueces es ciego, así que mientras que no hagas contacto físico con él, podrás evitarlo fácilmente. 
Si el Cascanueces empieza a escanear sus alrededores, debes quedarte completamente quieto mientras te esté mirando, recuerda que no te verá si no estás en su campo de visión. Cualquier movimiento de tu cámara o una acción (Emote) hará que el Cascanueces te detecte.
<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref> Se recomienda tener un ojo sobre el Cascanueces para saber cuando te podrás mover y cuando deberás detenerte.

The '''Nutcracker''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It initially patrols and surveys its surroundings for any signs of movement. Upon detecting movement from a nearby entity or employee, it chases after them and uses a variety of deadly attacks, such as kicking or blasting the target with a [[shotgun]]. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

Nutcrackers are tall, skinny biomechanical entities that appear to be larger-than-life versions of their [[w:Nutcracker doll|real-life counterparts]]. They have hollow white eyes, circular red cheeks, and an outfit resembling that of a [[w:Red coat (military uniform)|British red coat]], and are also armed with a shotgun and a belt containing eight shotgun shells around their waist. Upon opening their mouth, a small, cyclopic entity with a yellow iris, connected by fleshy veins to the Nutcracker's torso, can also be seen.

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mécanique ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Le Casse-noisette apparaît portant un [[Fusil à double canon]], qui lui sert à attaquer. Son fusil a des munitions illimitées et peut tirer deux fois avant de devoir recharger. Le Casse-noisette dépose son Fusil et 2 [[Cartouche|Cartouches]] à sa mort, sans aucune dans le fusil.
</div>

Le Casse-noisette est également capable de frapper un employé si celui-ci se tient trop près de lui, le tuant instantanément et passant le Casse-noisette en mode attaque, possiblement en tirant sur n'importe quel employé trop proche.

Le Casse-noisette ne peut pas prendre de dommages tant ses yeux sont exposés, mais peut détecter s'il est attaqué. Un tir de Fusil ou des coups de pelle le font entrer immédiatement en mode attaque contre le joueur qui l'a agressé.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Depuis la V47, Casse-Noisette peut viser tout en se déplaçant, ce qui le rend beaucoup plus apte à tuer dans les coins.
</div> 

Le Casse-Noisette a 3 états comportementaux qui sont décrits ci-dessous.

<span id="Patrol"></span>
=== Patrouille ===

Le Casse-noisette déambule dans l'établissement. Dans cet état il ne peut pas voir et n'a donc aucune conscience de son environnement.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Every 8 to 17 seconds<ref>https://pastebin.com/SDWBuQ9U</ref>, a Nutcracker will check a certain list of conditions:<ref>https://pastebin.com/84efYzkE</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
 At least 4 seconds have passed since the last inspection
 AND
 (
   The distance to the nearest employee is short enough (27 units - almost maximum shotgun range) 
   OR
   Successfully pass a 40% chance
 )
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the above conditions succeed, the Nutcracker enters the scanning state.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Scanning ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker stops moving and scans its surroundings, raising its headpiece and turning counterclockwise in increments until it has turned a full 360 degrees or the below conditions are met. In this state the Nutcracker has a field of view of 140 degrees.<ref>https://pastebin.com/msJzae0M</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker will move to the attack state if:
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* The employee is within line-of-sight or too close to the Nutcracker<ref>https://pastebin.com/0PmVZCHF</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* That same employee is also 'moving'<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref>
** Performing an emote
** Moving the mouse/turning
** Crouching down or standing up
** Walking or sprinting
Note: Walking or sprinting without moving the camera wouldn't alert the Nutcracker, which seemed to be a bug. This behavior is fixed in v50.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the above conditions are not met, the Nutcracker will return to patrolling.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Attack ===
</div>
[[File:Nutcracker Alert.ogg|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The "metal ringing" sound when a Nutcracker targets an employee</span>]]
[[File:Nutcracker Angry.ogg|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The music looped during a Nutcracker's attack</span>]]

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker targets an employee. A metal ringing will sound when an employee is targeted, and distorted whistling with marching drums will play to indicate the attack state is in effect. At this point, the targeted employee can no longer freeze to avoid being seen until the attack state ends.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In this state, the Nutcracker will follow and attack the targeted employee until the employee dies or line of sight has been broken for a sufficient amount of time (at least 12 seconds), at which point the Nutcracker will move to the scanning state, and then back to the patrolling state if no employee is found.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker cannot see employees <em>other</em> than the targeted employee unless they move, even in this state. If it sees an employee moving when they are significantly closer to the Nutcracker than its target is, or when it has not seen its target in 3 seconds, it will change its target to that employee, regardless of which sub-phase it is in.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There are 3 sub-phases during this state.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Pursuing ====
While attacking, the Nutcracker moves towards the employee's last known position at speed of 7 units per second. If the employee was seen in the last 0.5 seconds, it paths directly to the employee, stopping 1 unit away, otherwise it calculates a position 5-6 units away from the employee and stops when within 2 units of said position. While moving, it will strafe to ensure it faces the employee to allow the aiming phase to trigger.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Aiming ====
Every frame, if each of the following checks pass, the Nutcracker progresses to the aiming phase:
* Line of sight with employee
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* Not reloading or aiming
* Time since last kick >1 second
* Angle to employee is within 30 degrees
* The held shotgun has shells loaded
The time taken to aim changes depending based on the amount of shells in the shotgun. With two shells loaded, it will spend 1.75 seconds aiming, while with one, it takes 1.3 seconds. If the Nutcracker's HP is 1, the aim time is always 0.5 seconds.
Every time the Nutcracker enters the aiming phase, it increments a counter for the employee it is aiming at. If the current targeted employee is different to the employee targeted last time it aimed, the counters for all employees are reset. While this counter is less than or equal to 2, the Nutcracker cannot move while aiming, but for all subsequent shots it slows down to a speed of 2.25 units per second.
After the aim timer has elapsed, it fires a shot, using a shell from the shotgun. After the shot, it waits 0.35 seconds, retaining the movement speed from the aim phase.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While aiming, the Nutcracker cannot kick.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Reloading ====
The reloading phase is activated when:
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* The held shotgun has no shells loaded
While reloading, the Nutcracker cannot move. This phase lasts exactly 1.74 seconds during which it is most vulnerable, as it cannot move, shoot, or kick. After the time has elapsed, the shotgun will have 2 shells loaded, and the Nutcracker will return to the pursuing phase.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The hit detection and damage is [[Shotgun#Mechanics|explained in the Shotgun article]]. (It's the same logic as when an employee uses a shotgun.)
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker can be a very dangerous adversary due to its extremely lethal shotgun that can instantly kill any employee caught out in the open, making cover a must for most fights with a Nutcracker. However, despite this danger the Nutcracker is usually an enemy worth killing, as the shotgun it drops is a very powerful weapon and can be sold to help meet quota. Do not be fooled by the ‘grab’ prompt that appears when hovering over an active Nutcracker’s shotgun, a Nutcracker’s shotgun cannot be taken from its hands until it is dead. '''There is no way to get around fighting the Nutcracker if you want its shotgun.'''
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Be warned when fighting a Nutcracker that it can instantly kill you by kicking you if you come into physical contact with it but cannot kick you if it is firing or reloading its shotgun. Additionally, sometimes the Nutcracker will chase you while running backwards, and is unable to shoot you whilst doing so. If it touches you while this is happening, it will kick you and kill you, so it is advised to circle an obstacle and hope it starts facing you again. This is likely not an intended mechanic and is therefore (probably) a bug.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Nutcrackers can also kill other monsters with their shots, however they will not intentionally target other monsters, so getting this to happen will require an employee to be targeted by a Nutcracker and bait its shots into collaterally killing other enemies. If you decide to take the attention of 2 Nutcrackers at once, one may kill the other depending on their positioning relative to you and to each other, giving you the opportunity to take the dead Nutcracker's shotgun and kill the one left alive with it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Technically speaking, it is possible to jump a shotgun blast from a Nutcracker but requires amazing timing and a decent amount of distance.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Below are some strategies for dealing with a Nutcracker.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Ambush (Shovel) ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This is one of the quickest methods of killing a Nutcracker, but it requires multiple employees with multiple [[Shovel]]s. This strategy is very simple: 2-4 employees grab shovels, group up around the Nutcracker while it's in its patrol state and hit it to death as soon as it enters its scanning state and raises its headpiece, as there is a short delay before the Nutcracker can fire out of its scanning state. Stunning the Nutcracker with either a [[Homemade flashbang]]/[[Stun grenade]] or a [[Zap gun]] can aid this strategy, allowing more time for the Nutcracker to be beaten down without repercussion. Be careful when trying to kill a Nutcracker this way, as it can be very easy to hit or be hit by your fellow employees while trying to gang up on the Nutcracker.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Ambush (Shotgun) ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This is much the same as the above method, only it is both easier and faster, as it requires only one employee and one shotgun instead of multiple employees and multiple shovels. Simply walk up to a Nutcracker with a loaded shotgun and shoot it point blank at any point when its eye is exposed. If done correctly the Nutcracker will instantly die, as a shotgun can do up to 5 damage per shot if the target is close enough.
</div>

<span id="Bait_and_Hit"></span>
=== Appâter et cogner ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Cette stratégie ne dépend pas du nombre d'employés. Trouvez une couverture avec laquelle vous êtes à l'aise, puis faites en sorte que Casse-Noisette vous cible avant de vous retirer dans la couverture susmentionnée. Regardez hors de votre abri pendant un moment pour amorcer son premier tir, répétez pour amorcer son deuxième tir, puis attaquez une fois avec une pelle pendant qu'il recharge et recommencez la séquence. Un Casse-Noisette émettra les mêmes bruits de sonnerie métallique mentionnés dans la section sur le mode attaque à chaque fois qu'il est sur le point de tirer, ce qui peut permettre de savoir plus facilement quand se mettre à couvert. Cette stratégie peut être mise en œuvre avec un joueur comme appât et un autre comme attaquant, ou avec un joueur comme appât et attaquant. A noter que les Casse-Noisette ont 5 points de vie et prennent donc 5 coups de pelle pour mourir, et qu'un Casse-Noisette sur son dernier point de vie se rechargera et tirera beaucoup plus vite. Pour cette raison, il est recommandé de frapper Casse-Noisette 3 fois au total, puis de le terminer avec 2 coups consécutifs pour éviter d'avoir affaire à un Casse-Noisette à faible santé.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Remarque :''' étant donné que Casse-Noisette est capable de viser tout en se déplaçant à partir de la [[version 47]], en plus d'être plus agressif avec son attaque au pied, cette stratégie nécessite désormais un mouvement constant et de bons réflexes pour esquiver correctement.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Landmine ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A landmine can be used to instantly kill a Nutcracker. A Nutcracker will chase a targeted employee while in the attack state, which can be utilized to draw the Nutcracker toward a landmine to kill it. Note that Nutcrackers cannot activate landmines on their own, so it is on the employee to activate it. Things that will trip a landmine include scrap, live or spent stun grenades, and employees.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Spike Trap ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If a Nutcracker is underneath a descending spike trap, the trap will instantly kill it. This is much easier to arrange with spike traps that operate on a timed interval than with motion-activated spike traps. A patrolling Nutcracker may walk under a nearby spike trap on its own initiative, or an attacking Nutcracker may pass beneath one while chasing an employee. Once the Nutcracker is dead, the safest method for employees to retrieve its shotgun without themselves being killed by the spike trap is to have another employee turn the trap off at the terminal. Depending on the trap interval and positioning of the Nutcracker's corpse, it may be possible (if risky) for an employee to simply run through and grab the shotgun between intervals.
</div>

<span id="Avoid"></span>
=== Pour l'éviter ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If you wish not to fight a Nutcracker, you must take advantage of the quirks of its patrol and scanning states. While a Nutcracker is patrolling it is effectively blind, meaning you can pass by one safely in this state as long as you keep your distance to avoid being kicked. If a Nutcracker enters the scanning state as you're passing by, stand completely still when it turns to face you and wait for it to continue turning, as it cannot detect you unless you are in its line of sight ''and'' moving. Note that even actions you may think count as stationary, like moving your camera or emoting, count as moving and will allow the Nutcracker to target you.<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref> It is recommended to keep your eye on the Nutcracker as you pass by so that, should it enter its scanning state while you're nearby, you know when you're out of its vision and can thus move freely.
</div>

== Historique ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== [[Version 45]] ===
Introduction.
</div>

=== [[Version 47]] ===
* Casse-Noisette peut désormais tirer en bougeant.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== [[Version 50]] ===
* Nutcracker can now aim downwards, rendering the "crouch cheese" strategy of crouching just outside of kicking range impossible.
* Nutcracker can now see employees walking, sprinting, and jumping while in the scanning state, even if the employees in question do not turn their camera while moving.
</div>

The '''Nutcracker''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It initially patrols and surveys its surroundings for any signs of movement. Upon detecting movement from a nearby entity or employee, it chases after them and uses a variety of deadly attacks, such as kicking or blasting the target with a [[shotgun]]. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

Nutcrackers are tall, skinny biomechanical entities that appear to be larger-than-life versions of their [[w:Nutcracker doll|real-life counterparts]]. They have hollow white eyes, circular red cheeks, and an outfit resembling that of a [[w:Red coat (military uniform)|British red coat]], and are also armed with a shotgun and a belt containing eight shotgun shells around their waist. Upon opening their mouth, a small, cyclopic entity with a yellow iris, connected by fleshy veins to the Nutcracker's torso, can also be seen.

== Meccaniche ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Lo Schiaccianoci viene generato impugnando un a [[Shotgun|Fucile a Pompa]]. Lo Schiaccianoci ha proiettili infiniti per questo fucile, e può sparare due volte prima di dover ricaricare. Lo Schiaccianoci lascia il suo Fucile a Pompa e 2 [[Shotgun Shell|Cartucce]] quando muore, insieme a qualsiasi cartucce non sparate ancora nella canna del fucile.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker is also capable of kicking any employee if they get too close, instantly killing them and immediately sending the Nutcracker into the attack state, possibly dooming any other nearby employees.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker cannot take damage until its eye is exposed, but can register being attacked. A shotgun blast or several shovel hits will make the Nutcracker immediately start attacking the instigating employee.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
As of version 47, Nutcrackers can aim while moving, making it much more adept at corner kills.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker can be a very dangerous adversary due to its extremely lethal shotgun that can instantly kill any employee caught out in the open, making cover a must for most fights with a Nutcracker. However, despite this danger the Nutcracker is usually an enemy worth killing, as the shotgun it drops is a very powerful weapon and can be sold to help meet quota. Do not be fooled by the ‘grab’ prompt that appears when hovering over an active Nutcracker’s shotgun, a Nutcracker’s shotgun cannot be taken from its hands until it is dead. '''There is no way to get around fighting the Nutcracker if you want its shotgun.'''
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Be warned when fighting a Nutcracker that it can instantly kill you by kicking you if you come into physical contact with it but cannot kick you if it is firing or reloading its shotgun. Additionally, sometimes the Nutcracker will chase you while running backwards, and is unable to shoot you whilst doing so. If it touches you while this is happening, it will kick you and kill you, so it is advised to circle an obstacle and hope it starts facing you again. This is likely not an intended mechanic and is therefore (probably) a bug.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Nutcrackers can also kill other monsters with their shots, however they will not intentionally target other monsters, so getting this to happen will require an employee to be targeted by a Nutcracker and bait its shots into collaterally killing other enemies. If you decide to take the attention of 2 Nutcrackers at once, one may kill the other depending on their positioning relative to you and to each other, giving you the opportunity to take the dead Nutcracker's shotgun and kill the one left alive with it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Technically speaking, it is possible to jump a shotgun blast from a Nutcracker but requires amazing timing and a decent amount of distance.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Below are some strategies for dealing with a Nutcracker.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Ambush (Shovel) ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This is one of the quickest methods of killing a Nutcracker, but it requires multiple employees with multiple [[Shovel]]s. This strategy is very simple: 2-4 employees grab shovels, group up around the Nutcracker while it's in its patrol state and hit it to death as soon as it enters its scanning state and raises its headpiece, as there is a short delay before the Nutcracker can fire out of its scanning state. Stunning the Nutcracker with either a [[Homemade flashbang]]/[[Stun grenade]] or a [[Zap gun]] can aid this strategy, allowing more time for the Nutcracker to be beaten down without repercussion. Be careful when trying to kill a Nutcracker this way, as it can be very easy to hit or be hit by your fellow employees while trying to gang up on the Nutcracker.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Ambush (Shotgun) ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This is much the same as the above method, only it is both easier and faster, as it requires only one employee and one shotgun instead of multiple employees and multiple shovels. Simply walk up to a Nutcracker with a loaded shotgun and shoot it point blank at any point when its eye is exposed. If done correctly the Nutcracker will instantly die, as a shotgun can do up to 5 damage per shot if the target is close enough.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Bait and Hit ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This strategy is not reliant on employee count. Find cover you're comfortable with then get a Nutcracker to target you before retreating to the aforementioned cover. Peek out of cover for a moment to bait out its first shot, repeat to bait out its second shot, and then attack once with a shovel while it's reloading and start the sequence over. A Nutcracker will make the same metal ringing noises mentioned in the attack state section every time it's about to fire, which can make knowing when to take cover easier. This strategy can be done with one employee as the bait and another as the attacker, or with one employee as both the bait and attacker. Note that Nutcrackers have 5 hit points and thus take 5 hits from a shovel to die, and that a Nutcracker on its last health point will reload and fire much faster. Because of this it's recommended to hit the Nutcracker a total of 3 times, then finish it off with 2 consecutive hits to avoid dealing with a low health Nutcracker.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''Note:''' due to Nutcrackers being able to aim while moving as of version 47, along with being more aggressive with its kick attack, this strategy now requires constant movement and good reflexes to properly dodge.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Landmine ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A landmine can be used to instantly kill a Nutcracker. A Nutcracker will chase a targeted employee while in the attack state, which can be utilized to draw the Nutcracker toward a landmine to kill it. Note that Nutcrackers cannot activate landmines on their own, so it is on the employee to activate it. Things that will trip a landmine include scrap, live or spent stun grenades, and employees.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Spike Trap ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If a Nutcracker is underneath a descending spike trap, the trap will instantly kill it. This is much easier to arrange with spike traps that operate on a timed interval than with motion-activated spike traps. A patrolling Nutcracker may walk under a nearby spike trap on its own initiative, or an attacking Nutcracker may pass beneath one while chasing an employee. Once the Nutcracker is dead, the safest method for employees to retrieve its shotgun without themselves being killed by the spike trap is to have another employee turn the trap off at the terminal. Depending on the trap interval and positioning of the Nutcracker's corpse, it may be possible (if risky) for an employee to simply run through and grab the shotgun between intervals.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Avoid ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If you wish not to fight a Nutcracker, you must take advantage of the quirks of its patrol and scanning states. While a Nutcracker is patrolling it is effectively blind, meaning you can pass by one safely in this state as long as you keep your distance to avoid being kicked. If a Nutcracker enters the scanning state as you're passing by, stand completely still when it turns to face you and wait for it to continue turning, as it cannot detect you unless you are in its line of sight ''and'' moving. Note that even actions you may think count as stationary, like moving your camera or emoting, count as moving and will allow the Nutcracker to target you.<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref> It is recommended to keep your eye on the Nutcracker as you pass by so that, should it enter its scanning state while you're nearby, you know when you're out of its vision and can thus move freely.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

######## Nutcracker/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity
| name = Nutcracker
| power_level = 1
| diversity_level = 1
| max_count = 10
| door_speed_multiplier = 2
| pip_size = Medium
| internal_id = Nutcracker
| attack_damage = 5-100 (Shotgun)<br> Instant Kill (Kick)
| attack_speed = 1s (Shooting)<br>1.5s (Reloading)
| contact_damage = Instant Kill (Kick)
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|Nutcracker}}
| stun_multiplier = 0.5
| cause_of_death = Gunshots (Shotgun)<br> Kicking (Kick)

The '''Nutcracker''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It initially patrols and surveys its surroundings for any signs of movement. Upon detecting movement from a nearby entity or employee, it chases after them and uses a variety of deadly attacks, such as kicking or blasting the target with a [[shotgun]]. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

Nutcrackers are tall, skinny biomechanical entities that appear to be larger-than-life versions of their [[w:Nutcracker doll|real-life counterparts]]. They have hollow white eyes, circular red cheeks, and an outfit resembling that of a [[w:Red coat (military uniform)|British red coat]], and are also armed with a shotgun and a belt containing eight shotgun shells around their waist. Upon opening their mouth, a small, cyclopic entity with a yellow iris, connected by fleshy veins to the Nutcracker's torso, can also be seen.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Spawn chances ==
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mecânicas ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
O '''Quebra-nozes''' surge carregando uma [[Shotgun/pt-br|escopeta]], que serve como sua principal forma de ataque. Ele tem munição infinita para essa escopeta e pode atirar duas vezes antes de precisar recarregar. O Quebra-nozes solta sua escopeta e 2 [[Shotgun Shell/pt-br|balas de escopeta]] quando morre, com qualquer bala não atirada ficar na arma.
</div>

O Quebra-nozes também é capaz de chutar qualquer funcionárie se elu chegar perto demais, instantaneamente matando-e e fazendo o Quebra-nozes entrar em seu estado de ataque, possivelmente condenando outres funcionáries próximes.

O Quebra-nozes não recebe dano até seu olho estiver exposto, mas pode registrar ser atacado. Um tiro de escopa ou vários golpes com a pá fará com que o Quebra-nozes comece a atacar ê funcionárie instigadore.

À partir da versão 47, Quebra-nozes conseguem mover enquanto mirar, tornando-o mais adepto ao matar em curvas. 

O Quebra-nozes tem três estados comportamentais, que estão descritos abaixo.

<span id="Patrol"></span>
=== Patrulha ===

O Quebra-nozes patrulha, andando ao redor da instalação. Nesse estado ele não consegue ver, então não tem percepção de seu ambiente.

A cada 8 à 17 segundos<ref>https://pastebin.com/SDWBuQ9U</ref>, um Quebra-nozes analisará uma seguinte lista de condições: <ref>https://pastebin.com/84efYzkE</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
 Se pelo menos 4 segundos se passaram desde a última inspeção
 E
 (
   A distância ae funcionárie mais próxime é curta o suficiente (27 unidades - quase  o alcance máximo da escopeta)
   OU
   Acertar uma chance de 40%
 )
</div>

Se as condições acimas forem encontradas, o Quebra-nozes entra em seu estado de análise.

<span id="Scanning"></span>
=== Análise ===

O Quebra-nozes para de se mover e analisa seus arredores, levantando sua cabeça e girando em sentido anti-horário em incrementos até ele virar 360 graus ou as condições abaixo são encontradas. Nesse estado, o Quebra-nozes tem um campo de visão de 140 graus.<ref>https://pastebin.com/msJzae0M</ref>

O Quebra-nozes entrará em seu estado de ataque se:

* Ê funcionárie está em seu campo de visão ou perte demais do Quebra-nozes.<ref>https://pastebin.com/0PmVZCHF</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* Esse mesme funcionárie está também se 'movendo'<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref>
** Fazendo um emote
** Mover o mouse/se virar
** Se agachar ou levantar
** Andar ou correr
Nota: Andar ou corre sem mover a câmera não alertará o Quebra-nozes, o que parece ser um bug. Isso foi concertado na v50.
</div>

Se as condições acima não forem encontradas, o Quebra-nozes retornará à patrulha. 

<span id="Attack"></span>
=== Ataque ===
[[File:Nutcracker Alert.ogg|thumb|200px|<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">O som de "toque metálico" quando um Quebra-nozes mira em ume funcionárie</span>]]
[[File:Nutcracker Angry.ogg|thumb|200px|A música que toca durante um ataque do Quebra-nozes]]

O Quebra-nozes mira em ume funcionárie. Um toque de metal vai tocar quando ume funcionárie for mirade e assovios distorcidos com baterias de marcha irão tocar para indicar que o estado de ataque está em efeito. Nesse ponto, ê funcionárie mirade não poderá mais ficar parade para não ser viste até que o estado de ataque acabe.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Nesse estado, o Quebra-nozes vai seguir e atacar ê funcionárie que estiver mirando até matá-le ou sua visão for cortada por uma quantidade suficiente de tempo (no mínimo 12 segundos), que então o Quebra-nozes voltará a seu estado de análise e depois a seu estado de patrulha se nenhum funcionárie for encontrade. Além do mais, o Quebra-nozes não ignorará outres funcionáries localizados enquanto estiver no seu estado de ataque caso ê funcionárie original morra ou consiga desviar do Quebra-nozes.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The Nutcracker cannot see employees <em>other</em> than the targeted employee unless they move, even in this state. If it sees an employee moving when they are significantly closer to the Nutcracker than its target is, or when it has not seen its target in 3 seconds, it will change its target to that employee, regardless of which sub-phase it is in.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There are 3 sub-phases during this state.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Pursuing ====
While attacking, the Nutcracker moves towards the employee's last known position at speed of 7 units per second. If the employee was seen in the last 0.5 seconds, it paths directly to the employee, stopping 1 unit away, otherwise it calculates a position 5-6 units away from the employee and stops when within 2 units of said position. While moving, it will strafe to ensure it faces the employee to allow the aiming phase to trigger.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Aiming ====
Every frame, if each of the following checks pass, the Nutcracker progresses to the aiming phase:
* Line of sight with employee
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* Not reloading or aiming
* Time since last kick >1 second
* Angle to employee is within 30 degrees
* The held shotgun has shells loaded
The time taken to aim changes depending based on the amount of shells in the shotgun. With two shells loaded, it will spend 1.75 seconds aiming, while with one, it takes 1.3 seconds. If the Nutcracker's HP is 1, the aim time is always 0.5 seconds.
Every time the Nutcracker enters the aiming phase, it increments a counter for the employee it is aiming at. If the current targeted employee is different to the employee targeted last time it aimed, the counters for all employees are reset. While this counter is less than or equal to 2, the Nutcracker cannot move while aiming, but for all subsequent shots it slows down to a speed of 2.25 units per second.
After the aim timer has elapsed, it fires a shot, using a shell from the shotgun. After the shot, it waits 0.35 seconds, retaining the movement speed from the aim phase.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While aiming, the Nutcracker cannot kick.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
==== Reloading ====
The reloading phase is activated when:
* Time since last shot >0.75 seconds
* The held shotgun has no shells loaded
While reloading, the Nutcracker cannot move. This phase lasts exactly 1.74 seconds during which it is most vulnerable, as it cannot move, shoot, or kick. After the time has elapsed, the shotgun will have 2 shells loaded, and the Nutcracker will return to the pursuing phase.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The hit detection and damage is [[Shotgun#Mechanics|explained in the Shotgun article]]. (It's the same logic as when an employee uses a shotgun.)
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estratégia ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
O Quebra-nozes pode ser um adversário muito perigoso, graças à sua escopeta extremamente letal que pode instantaneamente matar ume funcionárie que for pegue desprevenide, ou seja, cobertura é necessária para a maioria das lutas contra um Quebra-nozes. Porém, mesmo com esse perigo, o Quebra-nozes é geralmente um inimigo que vale a pena matar, já que a escopeta que ele solta é uma arma muito poderosa e pode ser usada para cumprir a meta. Não seja enganade com a mensagem de ‘pegar’ que aparece quando coloca o mouse em cima da escopeta de um Quebra-nozes ativo, ela não pode ser pega até que o Quebra-nozes esteja morto. '''Não tem como evitar uma luta com um Quebra-nozes caso queira sua escopeta.'''
</div> 

Tenha cuidado ao lutar com um Quebra-nozes já que ele pode instantaneamente te matar com um chute caso você toque nele, mas ele não consegue te atirar enquanto estiver mirando ou recarregando sua escopeta. Além do mais, às vezes o Quebra-nozes te perseguirá enquanto anda de costas, sendo incapaz de atirar enquanto faz isso. Se ele te tocar enquanto isso acontece, ele te vai te chutar e te matar, então é recomendado andar ao redor de um obstáculo e esperar que ele esteja olhando para você novamente. Isso provavelmente não é uma mecânica planejada é então é (provavelmente) um ''bug''.

Quebra-nozes também conseguem matar outras entidades com seus tiros, mas eles não irão intencionalmente mirar nelas, então, para fazer isso acontecer, é necessário que ume funcionárie esteja sendo mirade por um Quebra-nozes e atrair seu tiro para acertar outras entidades. Se você decidir pegar a atenção de dois Quebra-nozes de uma vez, um pode matar o outro dependendo de suas posições relativas à você e entre si, te dando a oportunidade de pegar a escopeta do Quebra-nozes morto e matar o outro vivo com ela.

Tecnicamente falando, é possível pular por cima de um tiro de escopeta de um Quebra-nozes, mas isso precisa de um ''timing'' incrível e uma distância decente.

Abaixo estão algumas estratégias para lidar com um Quebra-nozes.

<span id="Ambush_(Shovel)"></span>
=== Emboscada (Pá) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Esse é um dois métodos mais rápidos para matar um Quebra-nozes, mas precisa de vários funcionáries com várias [[Shovel/pt-br|pás]]. Essa estratégia é simples: 2 à 4 funcionáries pegam pás, se grupam ao redor do Quebra-nozes enquanto ele está na sua fase de patrulha e bater nele até a morte quando entrar no estado de análise e levanta sua cabeça, já que tem um pequeno atraso antes do Quebra-nozes atirar quando ver alguém. Atordoar o Quebra-nozes com ou uma [[Homemade Flashbang/pt-br|granada de luz artesanal]]/[[Stun grenade/pt-br|granada de atordoamento]] ou uma [[Zap gun/pt-br|arma de choque]] pode ajudar nessa estratégia, permitindo mais tempo para o Quebra-nozes ser derrotado sem consequências. Tenha cuidado ao matar um Quebra-nozes dessa forma, já que pode ser muito fácil acertar seus colegas enquanto tenta acertar o Quebra-nozes.
</div>

<span id="Ambush_(Shotgun)"></span>
=== Emboscada (Escopeta) ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Esse é igual ao método acima, mas é mais fácil e rápido, já que precisa de apenas ume funcinonárie e uma escopeta, ao invés de váries funcionáries com várias pás. Apenas chegue perto de um Quebra-nozes com uma escopeta carregada e atire-o à queima-roupa quando seu olho estiver exposto. Se feito corretamente o Quebra-nozes deveria instantaneamente morrer, já que uma escopeta pode dar até 5 de dano por tiro se o alvo estiver próximo o suficiente.
</div>

<span id="Bait_and_Hit"></span>
=== Esconder e Bater ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Essa estratégia não confia na contagem de funcionáries. Ache um esconderijo em que você esteja confortável e faça um Quebra-nozes mirar em você antes de você se esconder na tal cobertura. Saia dela por um momento para ativar o primeiro tiro, repita para o segundo, então bata nele com uma pá enquanto ele está recarregando e reinicia a sequência. Um Quebra-nozes fará o mesmo toque de metal mencionado na seção do estado de ataque toda vez que ele for atirar, que deixará mais fácil saber quando se deve se esconder. Essa estratégia pode ser feita com ume funcionárie ou dois com ume agindo como isca e ê outre como ê atacante, ou com ume como isca e atacante e outre como só atacante. Note que um Quebra-nozes tem 5 pontos de vida, então precisam de 5 golpes com uma pá para morrer e que um Quebra-nozes no seu último ponto de vida atirará e recarregará muito mais rapidamente. Por causa disso é recomendado acertar o Quebra-nozes 3 vezes em um ciclo e então acabar com ele com mais 2 golpes consecutivos para evitar ter de lidar com um Quebra-nozes com pouca vida.
</div>

'''Nota:''' já que os Quebra-nozes podem mover enquanto miram desde a versão 47, junto de ser mais agressivo com seu ataque de chute, essa estratégia agora precisa de movimento constante e bons reflexos para poder desviar.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Landmine ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A landmine can be used to instantly kill a Nutcracker. A Nutcracker will chase a targeted employee while in the attack state, which can be utilized to draw the Nutcracker toward a landmine to kill it. Note that Nutcrackers cannot activate landmines on their own, so it is on the employee to activate it. Things that will trip a landmine include scrap, live or spent stun grenades, and employees.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Spike Trap ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If a Nutcracker is underneath a descending spike trap, the trap will instantly kill it. This is much easier to arrange with spike traps that operate on a timed interval than with motion-activated spike traps. A patrolling Nutcracker may walk under a nearby spike trap on its own initiative, or an attacking Nutcracker may pass beneath one while chasing an employee. Once the Nutcracker is dead, the safest method for employees to retrieve its shotgun without themselves being killed by the spike trap is to have another employee turn the trap off at the terminal. Depending on the trap interval and positioning of the Nutcracker's corpse, it may be possible (if risky) for an employee to simply run through and grab the shotgun between intervals.
</div>

<span id="Avoid"></span>
=== Desviar ===

Se você não quiser lutar um Quebra-nozes, você deve tomar vantagem das características dos estados de patrulha e análise. Enquanto um Quebra-nozes estiver patrulhando ele é cego, ou seja, você pode passar com segurança nesse estado enquanto mantiver distância para não ser chutade. Se um Quebra-nozes entrar no estado de análise enquanto você estiver passando, fique completamente parade quando ele se virar para você e espere ele continuar a se virar, já que ele não te detecta caso estiver fora de seu campo de visão ''e'' se movendo. Note que até ações que você acha que são estacionárias, como mover sua câmera ou dançar, contam como movimento e vai permitir o Quebra-nozes a te perseguir.<ref>https://pastebin.com/q6a2Tdzb</ref> É recomendado ficar de olho num Quebra-nozes enquanto você passa para que, caso entre no estado de análise enquanto você estiver perte, você saiba quando estiver fora de sua visão e se mover com segurança.

######## Nutcracker/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox entity
| name = Nutcracker
| power_level = 1

| door_speed_multiplier = 2
| pip_size = Medium
| internal_id = Nutcracker
| attack_damage = 5-100 (Shotgun)<br> Instant Kill (Kick)
| attack_speed = 1s (Shooting)<br>1.5s (Reloading)
| contact_damage = Instant Kill (Kick)
| hits-to-kill = {{#invoke:Entities/AutoHitsToKill|for|Nutcracker}}

| cause_of_death = Gunshots (Shotgun)<br> Kicking (Kick)

The '''Nutcracker''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It initially patrols and surveys its surroundings for any signs of movement. Upon detecting movement from a nearby entity or employee, it chases after them and uses a variety of deadly attacks, such as kicking or blasting the target with a [[shotgun]]. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Rend]].

Nutcrackers are tall, skinny biomechanical entities that appear to be larger-than-life versions of their [[w:Nutcracker doll|real-life counterparts]]. They have hollow white eyes, circular red cheeks, and an outfit resembling that of a [[w:Red coat (military uniform)|British red coat]], and are also armed with a shotgun and a belt containing eight shotgun shells around their waist. Upon opening their mouth, a small, cyclopic entity with a yellow iris, connected by fleshy veins to the Nutcracker's torso, can also be seen.
