######## Quota
{{topicon Fandom|Profit_Quota}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Stub}}
<onlyinclude>
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The Company establishes a '''Quota''', the minimum amount of credits that the crew must earn by selling [[scrap]] at the Company headquarters on [[Gordion]]. Displayed above the monitor in the [[ship]], players are informed of the amount of credits, how many they have already earned, and the number of days remaining to fulfill it. Players always start each run with a balance of {{credits|60}}. Failure to meet this deadline will lead to the crew being fired and ejected into space, wiping all progress made on that save.

<!--T:2-->
While the deadline to reach Quota is three days, players may travel to Gordion sooner if they manage to meet it early. Players need not head back on the day of the deadline when they meet the quota, and any extra scrap can be saved for the next, assuming that at least one player survives on the crew's visit to the next moon.

<!--T:3-->
As of [[version 40]], the function <code>SetNewProfitQuota()</code> inside <code>TimeOfDay.cs</code> contains the relevant code to calculate newer minimums after the initial starting quota, as well as the Overtime Bonus. The resulting explanations below were based on that version of the game and may have been adjusted since.

<!--T:4-->
== New quota calculation ==
:''Syntax Note:'' The ∈ symbol only represents the bounds of the equation result.

<!--T:5-->
The new quota calculation is governed by a set of three equations.

<!--T:6-->
The function first calculates a ''Time Multiplier'', essentially the square of how many times players fulfill the quotas, in a range limited from 0 to 10<sup>4</sup>.

<!--T:7-->
<math>(Time Multiplier = 1 + \frac{QuotasFulfilledTimes^2}{16}) \in [0, 10^4]</math>

<!--T:8-->
The game then introduces randomization via a curve.

<!--T:9-->
<math>Randomizer Offset = 100 \times Time Multiplier \times (1 + EvaluateCurve(Random(-0.503,0.503)))</math>

<!--T:10-->
Then the new quota is registered by adding the old quota and the randomized offset.

<!--T:11-->
<math>(New Profit Quota = Old Quota + Randomizer Offset) \in [0, 10^9]</math>

== Overtime Bonus == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
An Overtime Bonus rewards the crew for quickly completing their quota ahead of the deadline, or for going above and beyond the quota's value.

<!--T:14-->
It is governed by the following equation.

<!--T:15-->
<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{ScrapSold - Quota}{5} + 15 \cdot DaysUntilDeadline</math>

<!--T:16-->
Currently, the amount of Overtime Bonus received upon reaching the Quota seems to be 15 short of what the equation would suggest, which might be the result of the DaysUntilDeadline variable being set to -1 when selling with zero days left on the terminal. With this in mind, you should expect to subtract 15 when selling right at the deadline mark.

<!--T:17-->
The bonus equation changes when players have zero days left in the deadline:

<!--T:18-->
<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{Scrap Sold - Quota}{5} - 15</math>

<!--T:19-->
To calculate how much scrap to sell to reach a precise total value of credits, calculate:

<!--T:20-->
<math>SoldScrap = \frac{5 \cdot WantedCredits + Quota + 75}{6}</math>
</translate>
</onlyinclude>

######## Quota/en
{{topicon Fandom|Profit_Quota}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Stub}}
<onlyinclude>
The Company establishes a '''Quota''', the minimum amount of credits that the crew must earn by selling [[scrap]] at the Company headquarters on [[Gordion]]. Displayed above the monitor in the [[ship]], players are informed of the amount of credits, how many they have already earned, and the number of days remaining to fulfill it. Players always start each run with a balance of {{credits|60}}. Failure to meet this deadline will lead to the crew being fired and ejected into space, wiping all progress made on that save.

While the deadline to reach Quota is three days, players may travel to Gordion sooner if they manage to meet it early. Players need not head back on the day of the deadline when they meet the quota, and any extra scrap can be saved for the next, assuming that at least one player survives on the crew's visit to the next moon.

As of [[version 40]], the function <code>SetNewProfitQuota()</code> inside <code>TimeOfDay.cs</code> contains the relevant code to calculate newer minimums after the initial starting quota, as well as the Overtime Bonus. The resulting explanations below were based on that version of the game and may have been adjusted since.

== New quota calculation ==
:''Syntax Note:'' The ∈ symbol only represents the bounds of the equation result.

The new quota calculation is governed by a set of three equations.

The function first calculates a ''Time Multiplier'', essentially the square of how many times players fulfill the quotas, in a range limited from 0 to 10<sup>4</sup>.

<math>(Time Multiplier = 1 + \frac{QuotasFulfilledTimes^2}{16}) \in [0, 10^4]</math>

The game then introduces randomization via a curve.

<math>Randomizer Offset = 100 \times Time Multiplier \times (1 + EvaluateCurve(Random(-0.503,0.503)))</math>

Then the new quota is registered by adding the old quota and the randomized offset.

<math>(New Profit Quota = Old Quota + Randomizer Offset) \in [0, 10^9]</math>

== Overtime Bonus ==

An Overtime Bonus rewards the crew for quickly completing their quota ahead of the deadline, or for going above and beyond the quota's value.

It is governed by the following equation.

<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{ScrapSold - Quota}{5} + 15 \cdot DaysUntilDeadline</math>

Currently, the amount of Overtime Bonus received upon reaching the Quota seems to be 15 short of what the equation would suggest, which might be the result of the DaysUntilDeadline variable being set to -1 when selling with zero days left on the terminal. With this in mind, you should expect to subtract 15 when selling right at the deadline mark.

The bonus equation changes when players have zero days left in the deadline:

<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{Scrap Sold - Quota}{5} - 15</math>

To calculate how much scrap to sell to reach a precise total value of credits, calculate:

<math>SoldScrap = \frac{5 \cdot WantedCredits + Quota + 75}{6}</math>
</onlyinclude>

######## Quota/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom|Profit_Quota}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Stub}}
<onlyinclude>
A Companhia estabelece uma '''Meta''', a quantidade mínima de créditos que uma tripulação deve ganhar ao vender [[scrap/pt-br|sucata]] no quartel-general da Companhia em [[Gordion/pt-br|Gordion]]. Mostrado acima no monitor na [[ship/pt-br|nave]], jogadores são informades da quantidade restante de créditos, quantos que elus já receberam e o número de dias restantes para concluí-la. Jogadores sempre iniciam uma sessão com {{credits|60}}. Se a meta não for concluída, a tripulação será demitida e ejetada para o espaço, apagando todo o progresso feito naquele ''save''.

Mesmo que o prazo para concluir a Meta seja de três dias, jogadores podem viajar para Gordion mais cedo se elus conseguirem batê-la antes. Jogadores não precisam voltar no dia do prazo quando eles alcançarem a meta e qualquer sucata que sobrar pode ser guardada para a próxima, assumindo que pelo menos ume funcionárie sobreviva os dias seguintes.

Desde a [[version 40/pt-br|versão 40]], a função code>SetNewProfitQuota()</code> dentro de<code>TimeOfDay.cs</code> contem o código relevante para calcular novos mínimos para a meta inicial e também o Bônus de Hora Extra. As explicações abaixo foram baseadas nessa versão do jogo e podem ter sido ajustadas desde então.

== Novo cálculo da meta ==
: ''Nota de Sintaxe:'' O símbolo ∈ apenas representa os limites do resultado da equação.

O novo cálculo da meta é governado por um conjunto de três equações.

A função primeiro calcula um ''Time Multiplier'', essencialmente o quadrado de quantas vezes jogadores terminarem as metas, em um alcance limitado entre 0 e 10<sup>4</sup>.

<math>(Time Multiplier = 1 + \frac{QuotasFulfilledTimes^2}{16}) \in [0, 10^4]</math>

O jogo introduz elementos aleatórios por meio de uma curva

<math>Randomizer Offset = 100 \times Time Multiplier \times (1 + EvaluateCurve(Random(-0.503,0.503)))</math>

Então a nova meta é registrada ao adicionar a meta antiga e a diferença aleatória.

<math>(New Profit Quota = Old Quota + Randomizer Offset) \in [0, 10^9]</math>

<span id="Overtime_Bonus"></span>
== Bônus de Hora Extra ==

Um Bônus de Hora Extra recompensa a tripulação por rapidamente concluir sua meta antes do prazo, ou por vender acima do valor da meta.

É governado pela seguinte equação.

<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{ScrapSold - Quota}{5} + 15 \cdot DaysUntilDeadline</math>

Atualmente, a quantidade de Bônus de Hora extra recebida ao alcançar a Meta parece ser 15 a menos do que a equação sugeria, o que pode ser o resultado da variável DaysUntilDeadline ser -1 quando se vende com zero dias restantes no terminal. Com isso em mente, você deve subtrair 15 quando se vende bem no prazo.

A equação do bônus muda quando jogadores têm zero dias restantes no prazo:

<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{Scrap Sold - Quota}{5} - 15</math>

Para calcular quanta sucata se deve vender para alcançar um valor preciso de créditos, calcule:

<math>SoldScrap = \frac{5 \cdot WantedCredits + Quota + 75}{6}</math>
</onlyinclude>

######## Quota/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom|Profit_Quota}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Stub}}
<onlyinclude>
员工必须在位于 [[Gordion/zh-cn|Gordion]] 的公司总部出售[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]来完成公司指定的最低金额要求，即所谓“'''配额'''”。当次配额要求、已完成金额，以及所剩期限（天数）将显示在[[Ship/zh-cn|飞船]]监视器上方。每轮游戏开始时，玩家都持有 {{credits|60}} 金额。若未能在期限内完成配额要求，员工将被开除并弹射到太空中，同时清空相应存档槽位的所有数据。

尽管完成配额的期限为三天，但如果玩家能提早完成，也可以提前前往 Gordion。如此，玩家在期限截止日就可以不用再专门前往 Gordion，且若至少有一人能在当天降落后存活，剩余未出售的废料就可以留到下一次配额轮次使用。

截至[[Version 40|版本 40]]，初始配额后新配额的最低值与加班奖金的计算逻辑位于 <code>TimeOfDay.cs</code> 的 <code>SetNewProfitQuota()</code> 函数中。下文所述详解基于此版本，新版本可能有行为变更。

== 新配额计算 ==
:''语法说明：''符号 ∈ 仅用于表示算式结果的取值范围。

新配额的计算由一组三个方程式决定。

首先，函数会计算出一个''时间乘数（Time Multiplier）''，本质上是玩家完成配额次数（QuotasFulfilledTimes）的平方，限制在 0~10<sup>4</sup> 区间内。

<math>(Time Multiplier = 1 + \frac{QuotasFulfilledTimes^2}{16}) \in [0, 10^4]</math>

随后，游戏从一条曲线中引入随机值（Randomizer Offset）。

<math>Randomizer Offset = 100 \times Time Multiplier \times (1 + EvaluateCurve(Random(-0.503,0.503)))</math>

将得到的随机值与原有配额相加，就确定了新配额的数值。

<math>(New Profit Quota = Old Quota + Randomizer Offset) \in [0, 10^9]</math>

<span id="Overtime_Bonus"></span>
== 加班奖金 ==

若员工提前或超额完成配额，会发放加班奖金。

其由以下公式决定。

<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{ScrapSold - Quota}{5} + 15 \cdot DaysUntilDeadline</math>

{| class="wikitable"
|+ 注
|-
! 名称 !! 对应值
|-
| ScrapSold || 本轮配额售出的废料价值
|-
| Quota || 本轮配额值
|-
| DaysUntilDeadline || 距离截止日的天数
|}

目前，加班奖金的实际值似乎比公式理论计算值少 15。这可能是因为 <code>DaysUntilDeadline</code> 变量在终端显示“仅剩 0 天”时，其实际值为 -1。于此，若是在截止日当天才售出废料，你应该在预估奖金时减去 15。

在截止日当天，计算公式变为：

<math>OvertimeBonus = \frac{Scrap Sold - Quota}{5} - 15</math>

若要计算包含奖金后实际结算的金额，使用：

<math>SoldScrap = \frac{5 \cdot WantedCredits + Quota + 75}{6}</math>

{| class="wikitable"
|+ 注
|-
! 名称 !! 对应值
|-
| WantedCredits || 预期金额
|}
</onlyinclude>

== Strategy == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
Employees can place the radar booster right at the main entrance of indoors to act as a beacon in case an employee gets lost. It can also be placed to relocate loot or keep watch for enemies.

<!--T:19-->
It could alternatively act as a long lasting light source while held, but it also consistently occupies the right side of view, making it dangerous if there's hostile entities coming from your right side.

=== Doorway guardian === <!--T:20-->

<!--T:21-->
A radar booster can be placed right in front of the ship doorway. It can be used to repeatedly <code>flash</code> incoming [[Forest Keeper|forest keepers]], clearing a path for outside employees, or <code>ping</code> to guide lost employees back to their right track.

=== Flashbang strategy === <!--T:22-->

<!--T:23-->
The <code>flash</code> command gives an employee a way of repeatedly disabling a creature. Due to its fairly short cooldown, lack of maximum uses, and the fact that the booster can be easily moved around, one could easily set up an ambush for [[Thumper]]s (or any other indoor entity), making their disposal significantly easier. One does have to be wary of the fact that the blinding flash does also blind and slow the employee.

<!--T:24-->
A radar booster can be given to a [[Hoarding Bug]] to locate its nest. Additionally, the <code>flash</code> command may be used to disable any guarding Hoarding Bugs.

<!--T:25-->
The employee could also carry the radar booster with them on maps where forest keepers are particularly prevalent, as the Forest Keeper can be stunned with the radar booster's flash. If the command is timed well enough, the employee can make an easy escape.

<!--T:26-->
The command also disables [[Coil-Head]]s for a brief period of time, allowing the employee to turn around and look for an escape.

== Overview ==

The '''Radar Booster''' can be purchased in the [[Store]]. When turned on, it can be used as another camera from the [[Ship#Terminal|terminal]]. It also appears when an employee scans (right clicks).

The radar booster will be assigned a random name the first time it is turned on. The assigned name can then be filled into the <code>[RADAR BOOSTER NAME]</code> mentioned below. All the possible names are:

''Betty, George, Billy, Kablam, Susie, Igor, Gilbert, Daryl, Seth, Sam, Brody, Blue, Freddy, Sam,<ref group="note" name="sam" /> Bobbie, Louie, Albert''

But if the radar booster wasn't turned on since purchased, it will stay "Unnamed" while scanning, and can neither be viewed on the ship camera, nor be selected from the terminal command.

== Available commands ==

The following commands are only available on the [[Ship#Terminal|ship terminal]], and it requires the target radar booster to be turned on beforehand by holding it and clicking LMB.

[[File:GhostDevicePing.ogg|thumb|Radar booster ping sound]]

 PING [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
This command will cause the radar booster to emit a "hello" sound, helping guide employees to its location or attract sound-sensitive entities to it.

[[File:RadarBoosterFlash.ogg|thumb|Radar booster flash sound]]

 FLASH [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
This command will cause the radar booster to flash. The effects are similar to a [[stun grenade]] exploded in the radar booster's position, except there's no [[damage]] to the employees standing at the center, and the stun time has only 1.75 seconds at base.
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|radar_booster}}
Despite the short stun time, this flashing ability allows for some very interesting tactics because of its reusability and portability.

== Strategy ==

Employees can place the radar booster right at the main entrance of indoors to act as a beacon in case an employee gets lost. It can also be placed to relocate loot or keep watch for enemies.

It could alternatively act as a long lasting light source while held, but it also consistently occupies the right side of view, making it dangerous if there's hostile entities coming from your right side.

=== Doorway guardian ===

A radar booster can be placed right in front of the ship doorway. It can be used to repeatedly <code>flash</code> incoming [[Forest Keeper|forest keepers]], clearing a path for outside employees, or <code>ping</code> to guide lost employees back to their right track.

=== Flashbang strategy ===

The <code>flash</code> command gives an employee a way of repeatedly disabling a creature. Due to its fairly short cooldown, lack of maximum uses, and the fact that the booster can be easily moved around, one could easily set up an ambush for [[Thumper]]s (or any other indoor entity), making their disposal significantly easier. One does have to be wary of the fact that the blinding flash does also blind and slow the employee.

A radar booster can be given to a [[Hoarding Bug]] to locate its nest. Additionally, the <code>flash</code> command may be used to disable any guarding Hoarding Bugs.

The employee could also carry the radar booster with them on maps where forest keepers are particularly prevalent, as the Forest Keeper can be stunned with the radar booster's flash. If the command is timed well enough, the employee can make an easy escape.

The command also disables [[Coil-Head]]s for a brief period of time, allowing the employee to turn around and look for an escape.

== History ==

=== [[Version 45]] ===
* Added <code>flash</code> command.
* Increased cost to 60 scrap.
=== [[Version 40]] ===

Pinging and camera monitoring functional, purchasable in store.

=== Version 35 ===

A placeholder <code>RadarBoosterItem</code> class included, but the radar booster cannot actually function.

== Описание Компании ==
{{terminal|Радарные усилители имеют множество применений!

Используйте команду "SWITCH" перед названием радарного усилителя, чтобы начать наблюдение за ним на главном  мониторе. Он должен быть активированным.

Используйте команду "PING" перед названием радарного усилителя, чтобы устройство проиграло специальный звук.

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Общая информация ==

'''Радарный усилитель''' можно купить в [[Store/ru|магазине]]. Когда активирован, может быть использован как ещё одна точка просмотра на [[Ship/ru#Терминал|терминале]]. Он также появляется, когда сотрудник сканирует (нажимает правую кнопку мыши).

Радарному усилителю присвоится случайное имя, когда его впервые активируют. Присвоенное имя затем можно ввести в поле <code>[RADAR BOOSTER NAME]</code>. Все  возможные имена:

''Betty, George, Billy, Kablam, Susie, Igor, Gilbert, Daryl, Seth, Sam, Brody, Blue, Freddy, Sam,<ref group="note" name="sam" /> Bobbie, Louie, Albert''

Но если радарный усилитель не активировали с момента его покупки, он останется "Безымянным" во время сканирования, и его нельзя будет ни просмотреть на камере корабля, ни выбрать с помощью команды терминала.

<span id="Available_commands"></span>
== Доступные команды ==

Следующие команды доступны только на [[Ship/ru#Терминал|терминале]] и требуют предварительного активирования радарного усилителя удержанием в руках и нажатием ЛКМ.

[[File:GhostDevicePing.ogg|thumb|Звук радарного усилителя при команде "PING"]]

 PING [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
Эта команда заставит радарный усилитель проиграть звук "hello", помогая направлять сотрудников к его местоположению, или привлекая к нему сущностей, которые реагируют на звук.

[[File:RadarBoosterFlash.ogg|thumb|Звук радарного усилителя при команде "FLASH"]]

 FLASH [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
Эта команда заставит радарный усилитель издать вспышку. Эффект аналогичен взрыву [[stun grenade/ru|светошумовой гранаты]] на позиции радарного усилителя, за исключением того, что сотрудники, стоящие в центре, не получают урона, а время оглушения составляет всего 1.75 секунды.
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|radar_booster}}
Несмотря на короткое время оглушения, эта способность позволяет использовать очень интересные тактики благодаря возможности многократного использования и портативности.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегии ==

Сотрудники могут разместить радарный усилитель прямо у главного входа в помещение, чтобы он служил маяком на случай, если сотрудник заблудится. Его также можно разместить для нахождения лома или наблюдения за врагами.

В качестве альтернативы он может действовать как источник света, пока он удерживается, но он также постоянно занимает правую сторону обзора, что делает его опасным, если с правой стороны от вас ходят враждебные сущности.

<span id="Doorway_guardian"></span>
=== Защита дверного проема ===

Радарный усилитель можно разместить прямо перед дверью корабля. Его можно использовать для многократного <code>FLASH</code> входящих [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранителей леса]], расчистки пути для других сотрудников или <code>PING</code>, чтобы направить потерявшихся сотрудников обратно на правильный путь.

<span id="Flashbang_strategy"></span>
=== Стратегия светошумовой гранаты ===

Команда <code>FLASH</code> даёт сотруднику возможность неоднократно оглушать сущностей. Из-за его довольно короткого времени восстановления, отсутствия количества максимальных использований и того факта, что усилитель можно легко перемещать, можно легко устроить засаду для [[Thumper/ru|Топотунов]] (или любого существа в здании), что значительно упростит их убийство. Но следует опасаться того факта, что ослепляющая вспышка также ослепляет и замедляет сотрудника.

Радарный усилитель можно передать [[Hoarding Bug/ru|Жуку-собирателю]], чтобы обнаружить его гнездо. Кроме того, команду <code>FLASH</code> можно использовать для оглушения любых защищающихся Жуков-собирателей.

Сотрудник также может носить с собой радарный усилитель на картах, где особенно часты Хранители леса, поскольку Хранитель леса может быть оглушен вспышкой радарного усилителя. Если команда достаточно скооперирована, сотрудник может легко сбежать.

Команда также оглушает [[Coil-Head/ru|Пружиноголовых]] на короткий период, позволяя сотруднику развернуться и поискать выход.

######## Radar-booster/tr
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|audible=When <code>PING</code>ed
|battery=No
|weapon=Yes
|primary-use=<q>Turn on booster</q>
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=Yes (undocumented)
}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Company description ==
</div>
{{terminal|Radar boosters come with many uses!

Use the "SWITCH" command before the radar booster's name to view it on the main monitor. It must be activated.

Use the "PING" command before the radar booster's name to play a special sound from the device.
}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Overview ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The '''Radar Booster''' can be purchased in the [[Store]]. When turned on, it can be used as another camera from the [[Ship#Terminal|terminal]]. It also appears when an employee scans (right clicks).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The radar booster will be assigned a random name the first time it is turned on. The assigned name can then be filled into the <code>[RADAR BOOSTER NAME]</code> mentioned below. All the possible names are:
</div>

''Betty, George, Billy, Kablam, Susie, Igor, Gilbert, Daryl, Seth, Sam, Brody, Blue, Freddy, Sam,<ref group="note" name="sam" /> Bobbie, Louie, Albert''

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
But if the radar booster wasn't turned on since purchased, it will stay "Unnamed" while scanning, and can neither be viewed on the ship camera, nor be selected from the terminal command.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Available commands ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The following commands are only available on the [[Ship#Terminal|ship terminal]], and it requires the target radar booster to be turned on beforehand by holding it and clicking LMB.
</div>

[[File:GhostDevicePing.ogg|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Radar booster ping sound</span>]]

 PING [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This command will cause the radar booster to emit a "hello" sound, helping guide employees to its location or attract sound-sensitive entities to it.
</div>

[[File:RadarBoosterFlash.ogg|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Radar booster flash sound</span>]]

 FLASH [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This command will cause the radar booster to flash. The effects are similar to a [[stun grenade]] exploded in the radar booster's position, except there's no [[damage]] to the employees standing at the center, and the stun time has only 1.75 seconds at base.
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|radar_booster}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Despite the short stun time, this flashing ability allows for some very interesting tactics because of its reusability and portability.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Employees can place the radar booster right at the main entrance of indoors to act as a beacon in case an employee gets lost. It can also be placed to relocate loot or keep watch for enemies.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It could alternatively act as a long lasting light source while held, but it also consistently occupies the right side of view, making it dangerous if there's hostile entities coming from your right side.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Doorway guardian ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A radar booster can be placed right in front of the ship doorway. It can be used to repeatedly <code>flash</code> incoming [[Forest Keeper|forest keepers]], clearing a path for outside employees, or <code>ping</code> to guide lost employees back to their right track.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Flashbang strategy ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The <code>flash</code> command gives an employee a way of repeatedly disabling a creature. Due to its fairly short cooldown, lack of maximum uses, and the fact that the booster can be easily moved around, one could easily set up an ambush for [[Thumper]]s (or any other indoor entity), making their disposal significantly easier. One does have to be wary of the fact that the blinding flash does also blind and slow the employee.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A radar booster can be given to a [[Hoarding Bug]] to locate its nest. Additionally, the <code>flash</code> command may be used to disable any guarding Hoarding Bugs.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The employee could also carry the radar booster with them on maps where forest keepers are particularly prevalent, as the Forest Keeper can be stunned with the radar booster's flash. If the command is timed well enough, the employee can make an easy escape.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The command also disables [[Coil-Head]]s for a brief period of time, allowing the employee to turn around and look for an escape.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== History ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== [[Version 45]] ===
</div>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Added <code>flash</code> command.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Increased cost to 60 scrap.</span>
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== [[Version 40]] ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Pinging and camera monitoring functional, purchasable in store.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Version 35 ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
A placeholder <code>RadarBoosterItem</code> class included, but the radar booster cannot actually function.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

<span id="Company_description"></span>
== 公司描述 ==
{{terminal|雷达增幅器有多种用途！

在雷达增幅器的名称前使用“SWITCH”命令，可将其切换为主监视器的监视目标。雷达增幅器须已启用。

在雷达增幅器的名称前使用“PING”命令，可使其播放一段特殊音频。
}}
<span id="Overview"></span>
== 概览 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''雷达增幅器'''可于[[Store/zh-cn|商店]]中购得。将其打开后可用于飞船[[Ship/zh-cn#终端|终端]]的额外摄像头。雷达增幅器还会在玩家右键扫描时显示。
</div>

雷达增幅器会在首次打开后被分配一个随机名称，可填入下述的<code>[RADAR BOOSTER NAME]</code>中。所有可能的名称如下：

''Betty, George, Billy, Kablam, Susie, Igor, Gilbert, Daryl, Seth, Sam, Brody, Blue, Freddy, Sam,<ref group="note" name="sam" /> Bobbie, Louie, Albert''

但若雷达增幅器在购买后从未打开过，扫描显示的名称将为“Unnamed”（未命名），并且这一雷达增幅器还不能被切换为监视目标，终端也无法选中它。

<span id="Available_commands"></span>
== 可用命令 ==

以下命令只在[[Ship/zh-cn#终端|飞船终端]]中可用，并且在使用前需要先打开雷达增幅器（将其拿在手上并按鼠标左键）。

[[File:GhostDevicePing.ogg|thumb|PING 命令播放的声音]]

 PING [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
这一指令会使雷达增幅器发出一声“hello”，可帮助玩家定位其位置，也能将附近可听见声音的实体吸引过去。
</div>

[[File:RadarBoosterFlash.ogg|thumb|雷达增幅器闪光声音]]

 FLASH [RADAR BOOSTER NAME]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
这一命令会使雷达增幅器发出强烈闪光。其效果类似于一颗[[Stun Grenade/zh-cn|震撼弹]]在雷达增幅器位置爆炸，只不过身处附近的玩家不会受到伤害，闪光基准时间也只有 1.75 秒。
</div>
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|radar_booster}}
尽管闪光时间较短，其良好的重用性与雷达增幅器的便携性允许玩家创造出非常有趣的策略。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

######## Record player
{{topicon Fandom|Record_Player}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox Furniture
| name = Record Player
| image = Record_Player.png
| defaultprice = 120
| luck = 0.50%
}}
== Overview ==
The record player is a [[:Category:Furniture|furniture]] item that can be purchased from the [[Computer Terminal|terminal]] and placed in the ship. Employees can interact with it, causing it to play music. Once the song ends, there's about a second of quiet before the song repeats.

== Strategy ==
Despite producing sound while activated, [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]] cannot hear the music or the record-scratching noises and will not be attracted onto the ship by it.

== Trivia ==

Taking a closer look at the Record player while its song is playing, it can be seen that the vinyl record isn't actually spinning.

The model of the Record player is reused from [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717770/The_Upturned/ The Upturned], another game made by [[Zeekerss]]. However, the audio that plays from it in is different from what's heard in that game.

=== Parameters ===

; <code>version</code>
: The version of LC used for the run, as shown in the main menu, excluding the <code>v</code> prefix.
; <code>quota</code>
: Which quota (1&ndash;n) it was.
; <code>day</code>
: Which day of the quota (1&ndash;3) it was.
; <code>moon</code>
: The moon's English name, without the number.
; <code>weather</code>
: The weather conditions.
; <code>seed</code>
: The RNG seed, which is shown on-screen after initiating a landing.
; <code>interior</code>
: <code>1</code> for Factory, <code>2</code> for Mansion, <code>5</code> for Mineshaft. (Use <code>1</code> for Factory on March too.)
; <code>sid</code>
: If it's a SID, which item was picked.
; <code>sum</code>
: Mathematical expression for the total value of scrap collected. See examples below.
; <code>p1</code>&ndash;<code>p4</code>
: Players' names.
; <code>p1v</code>&ndash;<code>p4v</code>
: Citations ({{t|cite YouTube}}) with players' PoVs.

== Overview ==
'''Red pill''' is an unused entity. Originally a featureless, literal red pill,{{cite YouTube|video-id=qvRh623bJl4|unlisted=y|title=scary red pill|creator=Zeekerss}}

tracking employees from any distance, chasing them down, and killing them upon contact.

== Overview ==
'''Red pill''' is an unused entity. Originally a featureless, literal red pill,{{cite YouTube|video-id=qvRh623bJl4|unlisted=y|title=scary red pill|creator=Zeekerss}}
the current model is that of [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2803406998 "Obunga"],
a [[fandom:gmod:Nextbots#Era_of_Sanic_Clones|NextBot meme]] of 44th United States president Barack Obama.

If spawned in with mods, its behavior is not unlike NextBots:
tracking employees from any distance, chasing them down, and killing them upon contact.
<br>Red pills seem to have no hitbox, making them unkillable, not even by [[Spike Trap]]s.

== Visão geral ==
'''Pílula Vermelha''' é uma entidade não utilizada. Originalmente era uma literal pílula vermelha, sem nada que a destacasse,{{cite YouTube|video-id=qvRh623bJl4|unlisted=y|title=scary red pill|creator=Zeekerss}} mas o modelo atual é o de  [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2803406998 "Obunga"] um [[fandom:gmod:Nextbots#Era_of_Sanic_Clones|meme de NextBot]] do antigo presidente estado-unidense Obama.

Se gerada com modificações, seu comportamento é igual ao de NextBots:
rastreando funcionáries de qualquer distância, perseguindo-ês e matando-ês ao entra em contato. <br>Pílulas vermelhas não parecem ter ''hitbox'', fazendo-as imortais, nem mesmo por [[Spike Traps/pt-br|Armadilhas de Espinhos]]

== Общая информация ==
'''Красная Пилюля''' - неиспользуемая [[Entities/ru|сущность]]. Изначально непримечательная красная пилюля{{cite YouTube|video-id=qvRh623bJl4|unlisted=y|title=scary red pill|creator=Zeekerss}}, в данный момент является моделью [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2803406998 "Obunga"], [[fandom:gmod:Nextbots#Era_of_Sanic_Clones|NextBot мема]] бывшего американского президента Обамы.

Если вызвать с помощью модов, поведение не будет ничем отличаться от NextBots: выслеживают сотрудников с любой дистанции, преследуют их и мгновенно убивают их при контакте.
<br>У "Красной Пилюли" по-видимому отсутствует хитбокс, что делает её неубиваемой, даже [[Spike Trap|Платформой с шипами]].

######## Red soda
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Scraps/AutoInfobox|infobox
| scrap = SodaCanRed
}}
The '''Red soda''' is a low-to-high-value [[Scrap]] with a design resembling a Coca-Cola can, except the text simply reads “SODA”. The tab of the can has been opened, so it's implied to be an empty tin can despite weighing multiple pounds. The bottom of the can reads "2 FL OZ.", despite being in the shape of a traditional 12 fl oz soda can.

As it is made of metal, a Red Soda can trigger lightning strikes when held by an employee or when on the ground during [[stormy]] weather.

== Trivia ==

It's possible the text at the bottom was originally supposed to say "12 FL OZ." but the 1 was erased because it was funny. This could also double as an explanation for why the Red soda is so heavy in-game, as most of the space inside the can may be occupied by metal to leave only enough space for 2 fl oz. of fluid.

######## Rend
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Rend
| image = Rend Map.png
| routecost = 550
}}<translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Rend''' is one of the three snowy [[moons]] together with [[Dine]] and [[Titan]]. It has a hazard level of "A" and is a substantial step up in difficulty from the moons that can be routed to freely. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Rend is 550 credits.

== Description == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{Template:Terminal|text=85-Rend

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

<translate>
<!--T:11-->
CONDITIONS: Its planet orbits white dwarf star, making for inhospitable, cold conditions. Constant blizzards decrease visibility.

<!--T:12-->
HISTORY: Several famous travelers went missing here, giving it some reputation. Their bodies are unlikely to be found due to the planet's conditions.

<!--T:13-->
FAUNA: It's highly unlikely for complex life to exist here.
</translate>}}
<translate>
<!--T:27-->
(This description is identical to [[Dine]]'s.)

<!--T:2-->
== Environment ==
Rend is a very snowy and rocky moon, orbiting a white dwarf star. The constant snowstorm is similar to Foggy weather on other moons, except it's less dense. The snowstorm not only makes it harder to see but also muffles voices and entity sounds. Lights  are set up that lead directly to the main entrance. Rend and its snowy counterpart [[Dine]] both have the [[Mansion]] as their default indoor layout, although the [[Mineshaft]] can also appear infrequently on Rend and there is a small chance of the [[Factory]].

<!--T:3-->
== Strategy ==
The walk from the ship to the main entrance is long, and it's not hard to get lost in the snow storm. It is important to check  your time to make sure you don't get caught off guard by nighttime creatures. It may prove helpful to leave someone at the ship with a [[Walkie-talkie]] as mansions are quite difficult to traverse, along with this map's constant snowstorms. The fire exit can be accessed without an extension ladder but is quite far away and it is very easy to lose track of the ship on the way back.

=== Weather === <!--T:25-->

<!--T:28-->
Rend can have stormy or eclipsed weather.

==== Eclipsed ==== <!--T:26-->

<!--T:4-->
Rend spawns at minimum 3 nighttime and 3 indoor entities at the start of the game.

'''Rend''' ist einer von drei verschneiten [[Moons|Monden]]; die anderen sind [[Dine]] und [[Titan]]. Er hat eine Gefahrenstufe von "A", ist aber deutlich schwerer als Monde mit einer Gefahrenstufe von "B" wie zum Beispiel [[Experimentation]]. Eine Gebühr von 550 Credits muss gezahlt werden, um das Schiff in Rends Umlaufbahn zu bringen.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Beschreibung ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=85-Rend

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

BEDINGUNGEN: Rends Planet umkreist einen weißen Zwergstern, weshalb er unbewohnbar kalt ist. Konstante Schneestürme reduzieren die Sichtweite.

GESCHICHTE: Einige berühmte Reisende sind hier verschwunden, was Rend berüchtigt macht. Aufgrund der Bedingungen des Planeten ist es unwahrscheinlich, dass ihre Leichen gefunden werden.

FAUNA: Es ist höchst unwahrscheinlich dass komplexes Leben hier existiert.}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Umwelt ==
Rend ist ein verschneiter Mond mit vielen Felsen, der einen Weißen Zwerg umkreist. Der nie endende Schneesturm verhält sich wie nebeliges Wetter auf anderen Planeten, nur mit etwas besseren Sichtverhältnissen. Durch den Schneesturm ist es nicht nur die Sicht eingeschränkt, auch ist es schwieriger Stimmen oder Geräusche von Kreaturen zu hören. Eine Kette aus großen Lichtern helfen bei der Orientierung und führen vom Schiff zum Haupteingang bzw. zurück. Rend und sein schneebedecktes Gegenstück [[Dine]] haben beide die [[Interiors#The Mansion/de|Villa]] als standardmäßigen Innenraum.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategie ==
Der Weg vom Schiff zum Haupteingang ist lang und man kann sich leicht verlaufen. Man sollte auf die Zeit achten, um nicht von nachtaktiven Kreaturen überrascht zu werden. Es kann helfen jemanden mit einem [[Walkie-Talkie]] am Schiff zu lassen, da neben dem Schneesturm die Villa auch besonders schwierig zu durchqueren ist. Der Notausgang kann ohne ausfahrbare Leiter erreicht werden, ist jedoch ziemlich weit entfernt und birgt das Risiko, sich auf dem Rückweg zu verlaufen.
</div>

######## Rend/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Rend
| image = Rend Map.png
| routecost = 550
}}'''Rend''' is one of the three snowy [[moons]] together with [[Dine]] and [[Titan]]. It has a hazard level of "A" and is a substantial step up in difficulty from the moons that can be routed to freely. The cost to change the ship's orbit to Rend is 550 credits.

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=85-Rend

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Its planet orbits white dwarf star, making for inhospitable, cold conditions. Constant blizzards decrease visibility.

HISTORY: Several famous travelers went missing here, giving it some reputation. Their bodies are unlikely to be found due to the planet's conditions.

FAUNA: It's highly unlikely for complex life to exist here.}}
(This description is identical to [[Dine]]'s.)

== Environment ==
Rend is a very snowy and rocky moon, orbiting a white dwarf star. The constant snowstorm is similar to Foggy weather on other moons, except it's less dense. The snowstorm not only makes it harder to see but also muffles voices and entity sounds. Lights  are set up that lead directly to the main entrance. Rend and it's snowy counterpart [[Dine]] both have the [[Mansion]] as their default indoor layout.

== Strategy ==
The walk from the ship to the main entrance is long, and it's not hard to get lost in the snow storm. It is important to check  your time to make sure you don't get caught off guard by nighttime creatures. It may prove helpful to leave someone at the ship with a [[Walkie-talkie]] as mansions are quite difficult to traverse, along with this map's constant snowstorms. The fire exit can be accessed without an extension ladder but is quite far away and it is very easy to lose track of the ship on the way back.

=== Weather ===

Rend can have stormy or eclipsed weather.

==== Eclipsed ====

Rend spawns at minimum 3 nighttime and 3 indoor entities at the start of the game.

== Loot table ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Rend}}
{{special scrap spawn explainer|facility=y|nutcrackers=y|butlers=y}}
== Entities ==

=== Indoor ===

The [[Nutcracker]] is the most common indoor entity on Rend followed by the [[Jester]]. Both these entities are very dangerous and extreme caution is advised when encountering them. The Nutcracker can be killed when executed correctly whereas the Jester just has to be avoided.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
=== Nighttime ===

[[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Forest Keeper]]s are the most common nighttime entities on Rend. If spawned together, they can pose a significant threat to employee safety if not handled correctly.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
=== Daytime ===
Rend does not support daytime entities.

=== Spawn chance curves ===
On Rend, nighttime entities start spawning at around 3pm. This rate  peaks at 12am. Indoor entities spawn in a linear fashion on Rend, with a steady upwards trend. Daytime entities are unable to spawn despite the curve's constant multiplier of 1 (This is how the game defines it). See [[Mechanics]] for interpretation.

[[File:Rend_spawn_curve.png|950px]]
== Data chips ==
{{spoilers}}
There are 2 data chips on the surface:

"[[Sigurd_Logs#Nonsense_-_Sep_27|Nonsense]]" can be found by climbing out of the fire exit chasm, moving forward past the lamppost, then following the edge of the pit, then following the cliff walls into the clearing.

"[[Sigurd_Logs#8._Golden_planet_-_Sep_??|Golden Planet]]" can be found by moving parallel to the cabin walls facing the ship, then moving around and up the hill.

On Rend, nighttime entities start spawning at around 3pm. This rate  peaks at 12am. Indoor entities spawn in a linear fashion on Rend, with a steady upwards trend. ######## Rend/it
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Rend
| image = Rend Map.png
| routecost = 550
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Rend ''' è una delle tre [[Moons|lune]] innevate insieme a [[Dine]] e [[Titan]]. Ha un livello di rischio di “A”, tuttavia è sostanzialmente più difficile di ogni luna con un livello di rischio di “B”, per esempio [[Experimentation]]. Il costo per cambiare la rotta della nave a Rend è 550 crediti.
</div>

<span id="Description"></span>
== Descrizione ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=85-Rend

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDIZIONI: Il suo pianeta orbita attorno a una stella nana bianca, creando condizioni inospitali e fredde. Le costanti bufere di neve riducono la visibilità.

STORIA: Parecchi esploratori famosi sono scomparsi qui, dandogli una certa reputazione. È improbabile che i loro corpi saranno mai trovati a causa delle condizioni del pianeta.

FAUNA: È altamente improbabile che vita complessa possa esistere qui.}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
(This description is identical to [[Dine]]'s.)
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Environment ==
Rend is a very snowy and rocky moon, orbiting a white dwarf star. The constant snowstorm is similar to Foggy weather on other moons, except it's less dense. The snowstorm not only makes it harder to see but also muffles voices and entity sounds. Lights  are set up that lead directly to the main entrance. Rend and it's snowy counterpart [[Dine]] both have the [[Mansion]] as their default indoor layout.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
The walk from the ship to the main entrance is long, and it's not hard to get lost in the snow storm. It is important to check  your time to make sure you don't get caught off guard by nighttime creatures. It may prove helpful to leave someone at the ship with a [[Walkie-talkie]] as mansions are quite difficult to traverse, along with this map's constant snowstorms. The fire exit can be accessed without an extension ladder but is quite far away and it is very easy to lose track of the ship on the way back.
</div>

######## Rend/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Rend
| image = Rend Map.png
| routecost = 550
}}'''Rend''' - одна из трёх снежных [[Moons/ru|лун]] вместе с [[Dine/ru|Dine]] и [[Titan/ru|Titan]]. Имеет уровень опасности "A" и является внушительно более сложной луной по сравнению с любой из тех, перелёт на которые является бесплатным . Стоимость перелёта на орбиту - {{credits|550}}.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=85-Rend

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: Планета на орбите вокруг белого карлика, что создаёт на ней неприветливые, холодные условия. Постоянные снежные бури ухудшают видимость.

ИСТОРИЯ: Несколько популярных путешественников сгинули здесь, создавая этому месту "репутацию". Их тела уже вряд ли можно найти из-за погодных условий.

ФАУНА: Маловероятно наличие сложных форм жизни.}}
(Описание идентично таковому у [[Dine/ru|Dine]])

== Окружение ==
Rend - очень заснеженная и каменистая луна на орбите белого карлика. Постоянные снежные штормы подобны туманной погоде на других лунах, только не такие густые. Шторм не только ограничивает видимость, но и приглушает голоса и звуки сущностей. Ко входу ведут установленные фонарные столбы. Rend и его партнёр [[Dine/ru|Dine]] оба имеют [[Особняк]] в качестве стандартной внутренней структуры.

== Стратегия ==
Путь от корабля ко главному входу длинный, и не сложно потеряться в шторме. Важно следить за временем чтобы убедиться, что тебя не застанет врасплох ночная сущность. Имеет смысл оставить кого-нибудь на корабле с [[Walkie-talkie|рацией]], так как исследовать особняки  и передвигаться в них трудно, а также из-за постоянных снежных штормов на карте. Пожарный выход доступен и без выдвижной лестницы, но расположен довольно далеко и по пути назад к кораблю можно легко потеряться.

<span id="Weather"></span>
=== Погода ===

На Rend может быть шторм или затмение.

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
==== Затмение ====

Rend спавнит как минимум 3 ночные сущности и 3 сущности в здании в начале игры.

== Таблица Лута ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Rend}}

<span id="Entities"></span>
== Сущности ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Внутри здания ===

[[Nutcracker/ru|Щелкунчик]] - самая часто встречающаяся сущность внутри здания на Rend, за которой следует [[Jester/ru|Балагур]]. Обе эти сущности очень опасны и при встрече с ними рекомендуется проявлять осторожность. Щелкунчик может быть убит при правильном исполнении, в то время как Балагура лучше всего просто избегать.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== Ночные ===

[[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепые псы]] и [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранители Леса]] - самые часто встречающиеся ночные сущности на Rend. Появившись вместе они могут нести серьёзную угрозу безопасности сотрудникам если с ними неправильно обращаться.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
=== Дневные ===
На Rend жизнь дневных сущностей невозможна.

=== Кривые шансов спавна ===
На Rend ночные сущности начинают появляться после 3 часов дня с пиком в полночь. Шанс спавна сущностей внутри здания линеен со стабильным увеличением. Дневные сущности заспавниться не могут несмотря на постоянный множитель кривой 1 (Это то, как его определяет игра). Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.

{{spoilers}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
На поверхности находятся 3 чипа данных:
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
 Для того, чтобы найти запись "[[Sigurd Logs/ru#Чепуха - 27 Сен|Чепуха]]", вы должны, выбравшись из разлома с пожарным выходом, пройти прямо мимо фонарного столба и продолжать идти вверх по холму, пока вы не взберётесь на него.
Осторожно продолжайте идти вперёд, пока вы не наткнётесь на другой разлом, заем сверните направо так, чтобы двигаться вдоль него, и двигайтесь прямо вперёд.
Скалы начнут поднимать сбоку от вас и в конце-концов вы придёте в тупик, где лежит чип данных.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

Вы должны протиснуться между холмом и деревом. Продолжаёте двигаться прямо и заберитесь на следующую гору по правую руку.
Путь наверх лежит на ближайшем склоне на стороне, смотрящей от главного входа. Чип данных лежит на маленьком уступе на вершине склона.
</div>

######## Rend/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}

{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Rend

| routecost = 550
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Rend''' 是与 [[Dine/zh-cn|Dine]] 和 [[Titan/zh-cn|Titan]] 一样的被积雪覆盖的[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]。它的危险等级为“A”，但实际上它比危险等级为“B”的星球，例如 [[Experimentation/zh-cn|Experimentation]]要危险得多。将飞船导航到 Rend 的轨道上需要 550 信用点。
</div>

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=85-Rend

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：此星球绕白矮星运行，因此环境寒冷且不宜居住。长期的暴风雪使能见度极低。

历史：多位著名旅行者在此失踪，该星球的知名度因此有所提升。考虑到星球的环境条件，这些旅行者的尸体大概率无法找回。

生态：几乎不可能存在复杂生命体。}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
(This description is identical to [[Dine]]'s.)
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 环境 ==
Rend 是一个绕白矮星运行的多雪且岩石星球，其上持续的暴风雪类似于其它星球的大雾天气，只不过暴风雪的密度较低。暴风雪不仅会降低能见度，还会减弱玩家和实体发出的声音。地图内设有灯柱，一路引导至主要入口。与同样下雪的 [[Dine/zh-cn|Dine]] 相同，Rend 的默认室内结构也是[[Interiors/zh-cn#The Mansion|豪宅]]。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 策略 ==
从飞船到主要入口的路程较长，并且途中也容易在暴风雪里迷路。务必留意时间，以免被夜间实体突袭而措手不及。考虑到豪宅并不容易探索，再加上途中暴风雪的影响，如果能有一名员工在飞船内用[[Walkie-Talkie|对讲机]]提供协助会更好。尽管不用伸缩梯就可使用消防出口，但其距离相对也较远，并且也很容易在回船途中迷路。
</div>

{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
=== 日间 ===
Rend 上不会生成日间实体。

=== 生成概率曲线 ===
Rend 上的夜间实体大约在下午 3 点生成，其概率于午夜 12 点达到最高值；室内实体的生成数量呈线性稳定增长趋势。虽然日间实体的生成概率乘数恒为 1，但其并不能生成（游戏定义如此）。曲线绘制方式详见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。

上去的路就在附近；背向主要入口的斜坡。数据芯片位于斜坡顶部的小平台上。

######## Roaming Locusts/en
<languages/>{{Infobox entity
| name = Roaming locust
| image = Roaminglocusts.png
| image2 = Roaminglocustrender.webp
| sciname = Anacridium-vega
| danger = 0%
| power_level = 1
| max_count = 5
| pip_size = None
}}'''Roaming locusts''' are small harmless insects found outdoors swarming in spherical formations.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=Roaming locusts


Known as Roaming Locusts, this is a species of grasshopper. Unlike some species which are more prone to jump or fly, Roaming Locusts are almost never grounded and stay close together even when in smaller numbers. They will quickly disperse when a predator disrupts them but are highly attracted to light.}}
== Mechanics ==

Roaming locusts will disperse when approached by a player, [[entities]], and eventually on their own after some time.

== Trivia ==

* Along with [[Manticoil|Manticoils]], Roaming locusts are one of the two entities that cannot harm players.
* Locusts were originally meant to drift towards light, having possibly served as a ship hazard. This behavior was never added.

== Entrer de l'encyclopédie ==


Connus sous le nom de Criquets Migrateurs, il s'agit d'une espèce de sauterelle. Contrairement a certaines espèces qui peuvent sauter et / ou voler, les Criquets Migrateurs sont presque jamais au sol et ils restent très proche l'un de l'autres meme quand ils sont en plus petit nombres. Ils se disperseront  rapidement quand un prédateur les interromps mais il sont énormément attirer par la lumières.}}
== Mechanics ==

Les Criquets Migrateurs se disperseront quand approcher par un jouer, [[entités]], and éventuellement reviendront a leur place après quelque temps.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== En rapport ==

* En echo avec le [[Manticoil|Manticoils]], Les Criquet Migrateurs fait partie des deux seuls entité qui peuvent pas attacker les joueurs.
* À l'origine, les criquets étaient censés être attirés par la lumière, ce qui aurait pu en faire un danger pour les navires. Ce comportement n'a finalement jamais été intégré.

######## Roaming Locusts/ru
<languages/>{{Infobox entity
| name = Кочующая Саранча
| image = Roaminglocusts.png
| image2 = Roaminglocustrender.webp
| sciname = Anacridium-vega
| danger = 0%
| power_level = 1
| max_count = 5
| pip_size = None
}}'''Кочующая Саранча''' - маленькие безвредные насекомые, обитающие снаружи в сферических стаях.

== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=Roaming locusts


Известные, как Кочующая Саранча, являются видом кузнечиков. В отличие от видов, которые предпочитают скакать или перелетать, Кочующая Саранча почти всё время проводит в отрыве от земли и придерживается друг друга даже в малых количествах. Они быстро разлетятся, если их потревожит хищник, но зато их привлекает свет.}}
== Механики ==

Кочующая Саранча разбежится при приближении игрока, [[entities/ru|сущности]] и, в конце-концов, сами по себе.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные факты ==

* Вместе с [[Manticoil/ru|Мантикоилами]] являются двумя единственными сущностями, неспособными навредить игроку.
* Изначально планировалось, что Саранча будет двигаться в сторону источников света, будучи угрозой кораблю. Данное поведение так и не было добавлено в игру.

######## Roaming Locusts/zh-cn
<languages/>{{Infobox entity
| name = 漫游蝗虫
| image = Roaminglocusts.png
| image2 = Roaminglocustrender.webp
| sciname = Anacridium-vega
| danger = 0%
| power_level = 1
| max_count = 5
| pip_size = None
}}'''漫游蝗虫'''是一种在户外发现的无害小昆虫，会以球形群体的形式成群聚集。

== 生物图鉴条目 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=Roaming locusts


名为漫游蝗虫，属于蝗虫的一个品种。与其他更擅长跳跃或飞行的种类不同，漫游蝗虫几乎从不着陆，即便数量较少也会紧密聚集在一起。当受到捕食者惊扰时它们会迅速散开，但对光线有强烈的趋向性。

== 机制 ==

当玩家、[[entities|实体]]靠近时，漫游蝗虫会四散飞开，一段时间后也会自行散开。

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== 趣闻 ==

* 与[[Manticoils|四翼鸟]]一样，漫游蝗虫是两种不会对玩家造成伤害的实体之一。
* 蝗虫原本设定会朝光源漂移，可能曾被设计为飞船的一种威胁，但这一行为最终并未实装。

######## Romantic table
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox Furniture
| name = Romantic table
| image = Romantic Table 1.jpg
| defaultprice = 120
| luck = 0.50%
}}

== Overview ==
The Romantic Table is a furniture item that can be bought in the [[Store]]. It is a rectangular table with a magenta tablecloth and a candelabra on top. Interacting with the candelabra will light and unlight it, causing it to emit a small glow and quiet sound of candle flames.

== Scrap list ==

* '''Weight''': How heavy an item is to carry. Affects the player's movement speed and stamina consumption.
* '''Conductive''': If an item will cause a player to be struck by lightning during [[Stormy|stormy weather]].
* '''Two-handed''': If an item requires a player to use both hands to carry.

== Mechanics == <!--T:10-->

=== Single scrap days === <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
{{main|Single scrap day}}

<!--T:20-->
There's a chance that when scraps are generated at the start of a day, they're all the same scrap item rather than random items.
This is intentional and there are some safeguards to ensure the total value isn't lower than normal.

=== Variants === <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Some scrap items come in several variations.<ref group="note">
As of v68:
* [[Easter egg]] <code>meshVariants</code> even though they seem to differ in UV map only
** <code>f8ed4d6d07726e24289be8d5dbc3ac52</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere_3</code>)
** <code>2a66a44fbe626154a82724e8a0a19d32</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.001_1</code>)
** <code>8f4570f2c335c2a43a837adf49a127a8</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.002</code>)
** <code>3c4969f36ac234e46be19ef9031b3a4b</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.003</code>)
** <code>848d9bb47d47c5b45808c05dff16d993</code> R/B/Y (default)
* [[Flask]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>05d228f194dbb9a43a2826f31ea06d5c</code> conical
** <code>3ecf58d216515ea44ab880dc230f357c</code> round (default)
* [[Metal sheet]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>bfa3f55416fb43443bc4d275882bd544</code> 4-hole (default)
** <code>743c7dd8859195e47813cfda942b99ce</code> 2-hole
* [[Mug]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>e47a8b44aa6f9b54586a7f43d81c42d2</code> blank red
** <code>9c23ad4bd3f2268498a1fe98d56c7ed3</code> #1 MUG
** <code>7c76578fd54cc6e45a8f79d9caa2daae</code> cow
** <code>84a9ba2f84eda1e4fb957fea456255fc</code> MORNING! x3
** <code>738ea9191589de74395611ece4ec1425</code> doodle creature (default)
* [[Painting]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>8f672fd63e3ba584dbcb0c2438149533</code> lake
** <code>3e1c024c84a38c746a26e247394d2f6d</code> sky (default)

<!--T:13-->
[[Comedy]]/[[Tragedy]] are programmed as separate items rather than a model swap.
The 2 [[clipboard]] variants are also programmed as separate items, with the same behaviour (and model?) but different textures.
</ref>
The item's variant is set upon generation, and is determined by the moon seed.
Due to a bug,{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}
saving and reloading the lobby will reset all these to whichever variant is listed in their prefab.

<!--T:14-->
Scrap's variants are set as part of the <code>RoundManager.SyncScrapValuesClientRpc</code> method, paraphrased below.
Note that there are 2 parallel mechanisms: <code>meshVariants</code> and <code>materialVariants</code>. But since no item uses both at once, it doesn't complicate RNG.
<syntaxhighlight lang="csharp">
Random rngScrapVariants = new(randomMapSeed + 210);
foreach (GrabbableObject component in scrapItems) { // collection comes from callsite in `RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel`
	if (component.itemProperties.meshVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.meshVariants);
	}
	if (component.itemProperties.materialVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.materialVariants);
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

'''Schrott''' sind alle Gegenstände, welche auf [[Moons/de|Monden]] gefunden werden können. Das Ziel der Mitarbeiter ist es, möglichst viel Schrott zu sammeln und verkaufen, um die [[Quota|Profitquote]] der Firma zu erfüllen.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Eigenschaften == 
* '''Mindest- und Maximalwert''': Das Minimum und Maximum für den ein Gegesntand verkauft werden kann.
* '''Gewicht''': Wie schwer ein Gegenstand ist. Beeinflusst Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit und Ausdauer von Mitarbeitern.
* '''Leitfähigkeit''': Ob ein Gegenstand während [[Weather#Stormy|Gewittern]] Blitze anzieht.
* '''Zweihändig''': Ob ein Objekt mit beiden Händen getragen werden muss.
</div>

######## Scrap/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{redirect|Items|purchasable equipment items|Store#Equipment}}

'''Scrap''' are items found on [[moons]]. Collecting and selling scrap is the [[Quota|primary objective]] of the game.

== Scrap list ==
* '''Min/Max Value''': The minimum and maximum amount of money an item can sell for.
* '''Weight''': How heavy an item is to carry. Affects the player's movement speed and stamina consumption.
* '''Conductive''': If an item will cause a player to be struck by lightning during [[Stormy|stormy weather]].
* '''Two-handed''': If an item requires a player to use both hands to carry.

{{#invoke:Scraps/AllScrapTable|allScrapTables}}
== Scrap spawn chances ==

{{see also|Mechanics#Rarity}}

Scrap items that spawn on the floor in indoor areas such as the [[Facility]] and the [[Mansion]].
{{#invoke:Scraps/AllMoonsSpawnChances|allMoonsTable}}
'''''Note:''' These are the chances to generate as floor loot so items with special spawn conditions such as the [[Apparatus]], [[Hive]], [[Egg]], [[Body]], and [[Shotgun]] will appear as unable to spawn.''

== Mechanics ==

=== Single scrap days ===

{{main|Single scrap day}}

There's a chance that when scraps are generated at the start of a day, they're all the same scrap item rather than random items.
This is intentional and there are some safeguards to ensure the total value isn't lower than normal.

=== Variants ===

Some scrap items come in several variations.<ref group="note">
As of v68:
* [[Easter egg]] <code>meshVariants</code> even though they seem to differ in UV map only
** <code>f8ed4d6d07726e24289be8d5dbc3ac52</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere_3</code>)
** <code>2a66a44fbe626154a82724e8a0a19d32</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.001_1</code>)
** <code>8f4570f2c335c2a43a837adf49a127a8</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.002</code>)
** <code>3c4969f36ac234e46be19ef9031b3a4b</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.003</code>)
** <code>848d9bb47d47c5b45808c05dff16d993</code> R/B/Y (default)
* [[Flask]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>05d228f194dbb9a43a2826f31ea06d5c</code> conical
** <code>3ecf58d216515ea44ab880dc230f357c</code> round (default)
* [[Metal sheet]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>bfa3f55416fb43443bc4d275882bd544</code> 4-hole (default)
** <code>743c7dd8859195e47813cfda942b99ce</code> 2-hole
* [[Mug]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>e47a8b44aa6f9b54586a7f43d81c42d2</code> blank red
** <code>9c23ad4bd3f2268498a1fe98d56c7ed3</code> #1 MUG
** <code>7c76578fd54cc6e45a8f79d9caa2daae</code> cow
** <code>84a9ba2f84eda1e4fb957fea456255fc</code> MORNING! x3
** <code>738ea9191589de74395611ece4ec1425</code> doodle creature (default)
* [[Painting]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>8f672fd63e3ba584dbcb0c2438149533</code> lake
** <code>3e1c024c84a38c746a26e247394d2f6d</code> sky (default)

[[Comedy]]/[[Tragedy]] are programmed as separate items rather than a model swap.
The 2 [[clipboard]] variants are also programmed as separate items, with the same behaviour (and model?) but different textures.
</ref>
The item's variant is set upon generation, and is determined by the moon seed.
Due to a bug,{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}
saving and reloading the lobby will reset all these to whichever variant is listed in their prefab.

Scrap's variants are set as part of the <code>RoundManager.SyncScrapValuesClientRpc</code> method, paraphrased below.
Note that there are 2 parallel mechanisms: <code>meshVariants</code> and <code>materialVariants</code>. But since no item uses both at once, it doesn't complicate RNG.
<syntaxhighlight lang="csharp">
Random rngScrapVariants = new(randomMapSeed + 210);
foreach (GrabbableObject component in scrapItems) { // collection comes from callsite in `RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel`
	if (component.itemProperties.meshVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.meshVariants);
	}
	if (component.itemProperties.materialVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.materialVariants);
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

'''La chatarra''' son ítems encontrados en [[moons/es|lunas]]. Recogiendo y vendiendo chatarra es el [[Quota/es|objetivo primario]] del juego.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Propiedades ==
* '''Valor Min/Max''': La máxima y mínima cantidad de dinero por el que un objeto se puede vender.
* '''Peso''': Cuanto pesa llevar un objeto. Afecta la velocidad de movimiento del jugador y su consumo de stamina.
* '''Conductividad''': Si un objeto causara que un jugador sea golpeado por rayos durante [[Weather#Stormy/es|climas de tormenta]].
* '''Ambas Manos''': Si un objeto requiere que el jugador use ambas manos.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
'''''Note:''' These are the chances to generate as floor loot so items with special spawn conditions such as the [[Apparatus]], [[Hive]], [[Egg]], [[Body]], and [[Shotgun]] will appear as unable to spawn.''

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Mechanics ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Single scrap days ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Single scrap day}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There's a chance that when scraps are generated at the start of a day, they're all the same scrap item rather than random items.
This is intentional and there are some safeguards to ensure the total value isn't lower than normal.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Variants ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Some scrap items come in several variations.<ref group="note">
As of v68:
* [[Easter egg]] <code>meshVariants</code> even though they seem to differ in UV map only
** <code>f8ed4d6d07726e24289be8d5dbc3ac52</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere_3</code>)
** <code>2a66a44fbe626154a82724e8a0a19d32</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.001_1</code>)
** <code>8f4570f2c335c2a43a837adf49a127a8</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.002</code>)
** <code>3c4969f36ac234e46be19ef9031b3a4b</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.003</code>)
** <code>848d9bb47d47c5b45808c05dff16d993</code> R/B/Y (default)
* [[Flask]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>05d228f194dbb9a43a2826f31ea06d5c</code> conical
** <code>3ecf58d216515ea44ab880dc230f357c</code> round (default)
* [[Metal sheet]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>bfa3f55416fb43443bc4d275882bd544</code> 4-hole (default)
** <code>743c7dd8859195e47813cfda942b99ce</code> 2-hole
* [[Mug]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>e47a8b44aa6f9b54586a7f43d81c42d2</code> blank red
** <code>9c23ad4bd3f2268498a1fe98d56c7ed3</code> #1 MUG
** <code>7c76578fd54cc6e45a8f79d9caa2daae</code> cow
** <code>84a9ba2f84eda1e4fb957fea456255fc</code> MORNING! x3
** <code>738ea9191589de74395611ece4ec1425</code> doodle creature (default)
* [[Painting]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>8f672fd63e3ba584dbcb0c2438149533</code> lake
** <code>3e1c024c84a38c746a26e247394d2f6d</code> sky (default)
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
[[Comedy]]/[[Tragedy]] are programmed as separate items rather than a model swap.
The 2 [[clipboard]] variants are also programmed as separate items, with the same behaviour (and model?) but different textures.
</ref>
The item's variant is set upon generation, and is determined by the moon seed.
Due to a bug,{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}
saving and reloading the lobby will reset all these to whichever variant is listed in their prefab.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Scrap's variants are set as part of the <code>RoundManager.SyncScrapValuesClientRpc</code> method, paraphrased below.
Note that there are 2 parallel mechanisms: <code>meshVariants</code> and <code>materialVariants</code>. But since no item uses both at once, it doesn't complicate RNG.
<syntaxhighlight lang="csharp">
Random rngScrapVariants = new(randomMapSeed + 210);
foreach (GrabbableObject component in scrapItems) { // collection comes from callsite in `RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel`
	if (component.itemProperties.meshVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.meshVariants);
	}
	if (component.itemProperties.materialVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.materialVariants);
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Ominaisuudet ==
* '''Minimi-/Maksimiarvo''': Pienin ja suurin summa, jolla esine voidaan myydä.
* '''Paino''': Kuinka raskas esine on kantaa. Vaikuttaa pelaajan liikkumisnopeuteen ja kestävyyden kulutukseen.
* '''Johtavuus''': Aiheuttaako esine pelaajalle salamaniskun [[Weather#Stormy|myrskyisän sään]] aikana.
* '''Kaksikätinen''': Jos esine vaatii pelaajan käyttävän molempia käsiä kantamiseen.

Les '''Déchets''' sont les objets trouvés sur les [[Lunes]]. Collectez et vendez votre ferraille pour atteindre le quota qui est votre [[Quota|Objectif principal]] dans le jeu.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Propriétés ==
* '''Valeur Min/Max''': La valeur minimum et maximum de crédits auquel un objet est vendu.
* '''Poids''': Le poids d'un item en LBS (1 kg = 2.20 lbs). Affecte la vitesse de déplacement et la consommation d'endurance.
* '''Conducteur''': Si un item est conducteur, le joueur risque de se faire frapper par la foudre sur les lunes avec le temps [[Weather#Stormy|Météo orageuse]].
* '''Deux mains''': Si un item a besoin d'être tenu à deux mains.
</div>

'''Rongsokan''' adalah benda-benda yang dapat ditemukan di [[Moons/id|Bulan]]. [[Quota/id|Tugas utama]] Anda adalah untuk mengumpulkan dan menjual rongsokan.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Properti ==
* '''Harga Min/Maks''': Harga minimum dan maksimum barang yang dapat dijual.
* '''Berat''': Seberapa berat barang tersebut untuk dibawa. Mempengaruhi kecepatan bergerak dan penggunaan stamina.
* '''Konduktif/Tidak''': Apakah barang tersebut bisa menyebabkan pekerja tersambar petir ketika [[Weather#Stormy/id|cuaca badai]].
* '''Perlu Kedua Tangan/Tidak''': Apakah barang tersebut mengharuskan pekerja untuk membawanya dengan menggunakan kedua tangan.
</div>

Gli '''Scarti''' sono oggetti trovati sulle [[lune]]. Raccogliere e vendere scarti è l'[[Quota|obiettivo principale]] del gioco.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Proprietà ==
* '''Valore Minimo/Massimo''': La quantità minima e massima di crediti che si può ricevere quando un oggetto viene venduto.
* '''Peso''': Il peso di un oggetto per trasportarlo. Influenza la velocità di movimento del giocatore e il consumo della stamina.
* '''Conducibilità''': Se un oggetto farà colpire il giocatore da un fulmine durante una [[Meteo#Tempestoso|condizione tempestosa]].
* '''A Due Mani''': Se un oggetto richiede il giocatore di utilizzare entrambe le mani per trasportarlo.
</div>

</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Single scrap day}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There's a chance that when scraps are generated at the start of a day, they're all the same scrap item rather than random items.
This is intentional and there are some safeguards to ensure the total value isn't lower than normal.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Variants ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Some scrap items come in several variations.<ref group="note">
As of v68:
* [[Easter egg]] <code>meshVariants</code> even though they seem to differ in UV map only
** <code>f8ed4d6d07726e24289be8d5dbc3ac52</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere_3</code>)
** <code>2a66a44fbe626154a82724e8a0a19d32</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.001_1</code>)
** <code>8f4570f2c335c2a43a837adf49a127a8</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.002</code>)
** <code>3c4969f36ac234e46be19ef9031b3a4b</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.003</code>)
** <code>848d9bb47d47c5b45808c05dff16d993</code> R/B/Y (default)
* [[Flask]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>05d228f194dbb9a43a2826f31ea06d5c</code> conical
** <code>3ecf58d216515ea44ab880dc230f357c</code> round (default)
* [[Metal sheet]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>bfa3f55416fb43443bc4d275882bd544</code> 4-hole (default)
** <code>743c7dd8859195e47813cfda942b99ce</code> 2-hole
* [[Mug]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>e47a8b44aa6f9b54586a7f43d81c42d2</code> blank red
** <code>9c23ad4bd3f2268498a1fe98d56c7ed3</code> #1 MUG
** <code>7c76578fd54cc6e45a8f79d9caa2daae</code> cow
** <code>84a9ba2f84eda1e4fb957fea456255fc</code> MORNING! x3
** <code>738ea9191589de74395611ece4ec1425</code> doodle creature (default)
* [[Painting]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>8f672fd63e3ba584dbcb0c2438149533</code> lake
** <code>3e1c024c84a38c746a26e247394d2f6d</code> sky (default)
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
[[Comedy]]/[[Tragedy]] are programmed as separate items rather than a model swap.
The 2 [[clipboard]] variants are also programmed as separate items, with the same behaviour (and model?) but different textures.
</ref>
The item's variant is set upon generation, and is determined by the moon seed.
Due to a bug,{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}
saving and reloading the lobby will reset all these to whichever variant is listed in their prefab.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Scrap's variants are set as part of the <code>RoundManager.SyncScrapValuesClientRpc</code> method, paraphrased below.
Note that there are 2 parallel mechanisms: <code>meshVariants</code> and <code>materialVariants</code>. But since no item uses both at once, it doesn't complicate RNG.
<syntaxhighlight lang="csharp">
Random rngScrapVariants = new(randomMapSeed + 210);
foreach (GrabbableObject component in scrapItems) { // collection comes from callsite in `RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel`
	if (component.itemProperties.meshVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.meshVariants);
	}
	if (component.itemProperties.materialVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.materialVariants);
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
</div>

######## Scrap/pl
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Items|purchasable equipment items|Store#Equipment}}
</div>

'''Złom''' można znaleźć na [[moons/pl|księżycach]] w formie przedmiotów. Zbieranie i sprzedawanie go należy do [[Quota/pl|głównych celów]] tej gry.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Właściwości ==
* '''Minimalna/Maksymalna Wartość''': Największa i najmniejsza ilość pieniędzy za jaką sprzeda się dany przedmiot
* '''Ciężar''': Ile waży dany przedmiot. Wpływa na prędkość poruszania się oraz użycie staminy.
* '''Przewodnictwo''': Czy przedmiot spowoduje porażenie piorunem gracza podczas [[Weather#Stormy/pl|burzy]].
* '''Oburącz''': Czy niesienie przedmiotu wymaga użycia dwóch rąk.
</div>

######## Scrap/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Items|purchasable equipment items|Store#Equipment}}
</div>

'''Sucata''' são itens encontrados em [[moons/pt-br|luas]]. Coletar e vender sucata é o [[Quota/pt-br|objetivo principal]] do jogo.

== Propriedades ==
* '''Valor Mín./Máx.''': A quantia mínima e máxima de dinheiro por qual um item pode ser vendido.
* '''Peso''': Quão pesado um item é para carregar. Afeta a velocidade de movimento e o consumo de stamina do jogador.
* '''Condutivo''': Se um item pode fazer o jogador ser atingido por um raio durante [[Weather/pt-br#Tempestade|clima tempestuoso]].
* '''De duas mãos''': Se um item requer um jogador a usar as duas mãos para carregar.

{{#invoke:Scraps/AllScrapTable|allScrapTables}}
<span id="Scrap_spawn_chances"></span>
== Chance de aparecimento da sucata ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{see also|Mechanics#Rarity}}
</div>

Itens de sucata que aparecem no chão em áreas interiores como a [[Interiors#The_Facility/pt-br|Fábrica]] e a [[Interiors#The_Mansion/pt-br|Mansão]].
{{#invoke:Scraps/AllMoonsSpawnChances|allMoonsTable}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''''Nota:''' Essas são as chances de geração como saque no chão, então itens com condições especiais de geração como [[Apparatus/pt-br|Aparaelho]], [[Bee Hive/pt-br|Colméia]], [[Player Body/pt-br|Corpo]] e [[Shotgun/pt-br|Espingarda]] vão aparecer como incapazes de gerar.''
</div>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mecânicas ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Single scrap days ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Single scrap day}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There's a chance that when scraps are generated at the start of a day, they're all the same scrap item rather than random items.
This is intentional and there are some safeguards to ensure the total value isn't lower than normal.
</div>

<span id="Variants"></span>
=== Variantes ===

Alguns itens sucatas vêm em várias variações
Na v68:
* [[Mug/pt-br|Caneca de Café]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>e47a8b44aa6f9b54586a7f43d81c42d2</code> vazia vermelha
** <code>9c23ad4bd3f2268498a1fe98d56c7ed3</code> CANECA #1
** <code>7c76578fd54cc6e45a8f79d9caa2daae</code> vaca
** <code>84a9ba2f84eda1e4fb957fea456255fc</code> MANHÃ! x3
** <code>738ea9191589de74395611ece4ec1425</code> desenho de criatura (padrão)
* [[Metal sheet/pt-br|Folha de Metal]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>bfa3f55416fb43443bc4d275882bd544</code> 4 buracos (padrão)
** <code>743c7dd8859195e47813cfda942b99ce</code> 2 buracos
* [[Flask/pt-br|Frasco]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>05d228f194dbb9a43a2826f31ea06d5c</code> cônico
** <code>3ecf58d216515ea44ab880dc230f357c</code> redondo (padrão)
* [[Easter egg/pt-br|Ovo de páscoa]] <code>meshVariants</code> mesmo que eles só parecem se diferenciar apenas no mapa UV
** <code>f8ed4d6d07726e24289be8d5dbc3ac52</code> desconhecido (modelo <code>Sphere_3</code>)
** <code>2a66a44fbe626154a82724e8a0a19d32</code> desconhecido (modelo <code>Sphere.001_1</code>)
** <code>8f4570f2c335c2a43a837adf49a127a8</code> desconhecido (modelo <code>Sphere.002</code>)
** <code>3c4969f36ac234e46be19ef9031b3a4b</code> desconhecido (modelo <code>Sphere.003</code>)
** <code>848d9bb47d47c5b45808c05dff16d993</code> Vermelho/Azul/Amarelo (padrão)

As máscaras de [[Comedy/pt-br|Comédia]] e [[Tragedy/pt-br|Tragédia]] são programadas como itens separados ao invés de uma troca de modelo.
As duas variações da [[clipboard/pt-br|prancheta]] também são programadas como itens separados, com o mesmo comportamento (e modelo?) mas texturas diferentes.
</ref>
A variação do item é definida em sua geração e e determinada pela ''seed'' da lua.
Graças a um bug,{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}} salvar e recarregar a partida fará com que eles se reiniciem para o padrão.

As variantes das sucatas são partes do método <code>RoundManager.SyncScrapValuesClientRpc</code>, parafraseado abaixo.
Nota que há 2 mecanismos paralelos:<code>meshVariants</code> e <code>materialVariants</code>. Mas já que nenhum item usa os dois, isso não complica a ''RNG''.
<syntaxhighlight lang="csharp">
Random rngScrapVariants = new(randomMapSeed + 210);
foreach (GrabbableObject component in scrapItems) { // collection comes from callsite in `RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel`
	if (component.itemProperties.meshVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.meshVariants);
	}
	if (component.itemProperties.materialVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.materialVariants);
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
