######## Scrap/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Items|purchasable equipment items|Store#Equipment}}
</div>

'''Металлоломом''' являются все предметы, найденные на [[moons/ru|лунах]]. Сбор и продажа лома является [[Quota|основной целью]] игры.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Характеристика ==
* '''Мин/макс ценность металлолома''': Минимальная и максимальная цена, за которую может быть продан предмет.
* '''Вес''': Вес предмета. Чем предмет тяжелее, тем медленнее будет двигаться игрок и тем быстрее будет использоваться выносливость.
* '''Токопроводимость''': Во время [[Weather#Stormy|штормовой погоды]] предмет будет электризоваться, и через время в него ударит молния. В случае, если игрок будет находиться рядом с предметом во время удара молнией, он умрет.
* '''Имеет заряд''': Нужно ли предмет заряжать или нет.
* '''Занимает руки''': Нужно ли предмету занимать обе руки или нет. Когда такой предмет находится у игрока в руках, тот не сможет поднять другой любой предмет или переключить слот в инвентаре.
</div>

{{#invoke:Scraps/AllScrapTable|allScrapTables}}
<span id="Scrap_spawn_chances"></span>
== Шанс спавна лома ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{see also|Mechanics#Rarity}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Лом который спавнится на полу в помещениях типа [[Interiors/ru#Завод|Завод]] и [[Interiors/ru#Особняк|Особняк]].
</div>
{{#invoke:Scraps/AllMoonsSpawnChances|allMoonsTable}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''''Заметка:''' Здесь указаны шансы генерации обычного лута лежащего в комплексе, так что предметы со специальными условиями спавна такие как [[Apparatus/ru|Реактор]], [[Bee Hive|Пчелиный Улей]], [[Player Body|Тело Игрока]], и [[Shotgun/ru|Дробовик]] отображены как предметы без возможности спавна.''
</div>

######## Scrap/tr
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Items|purchasable equipment items|Store#Equipment}}
</div>

'''Hurdalar,''' [[moons/tr|Aylar]]`da bulunan öğelerdir. Hurda toplamak ve satmak oyunun [[Quota|birincil hedefidir]].

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Özellikler ==
* '''Min/Maks Değer''': Bir eşyanın satılabileceği minimum ve maksimum para miktarı.
* '''Ağırlık''': Bir eşyanın ne kadar ağır olduğu. Oyuncunun hareket hızını ve stamina tüketimini etkiler.
* '''İletkenlik''': Bir eşyanın [[Weather#Stormy|Fırtınalı hava]] sırasında oyuncuya yıldırım çarpmasına neden olup olmayacağı.
* '''İki el gerektiren''': Eğer bir eşya oyuncunun taşımak için iki elini de kullanmasını gerektiriyorsa.
</div>

{{#invoke:Scraps/AllScrapTable|allScrapTables}}
<span id="Scrap_spawn_chances"></span>
== Hurda Oluşma İhtimalleri ==

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Mechanics ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Single scrap days ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Single scrap day}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There's a chance that when scraps are generated at the start of a day, they're all the same scrap item rather than random items.
This is intentional and there are some safeguards to ensure the total value isn't lower than normal.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Variants ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Some scrap items come in several variations.<ref group="note">
As of v68:
* [[Easter egg]] <code>meshVariants</code> even though they seem to differ in UV map only
** <code>f8ed4d6d07726e24289be8d5dbc3ac52</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere_3</code>)
** <code>2a66a44fbe626154a82724e8a0a19d32</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.001_1</code>)
** <code>8f4570f2c335c2a43a837adf49a127a8</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.002</code>)
** <code>3c4969f36ac234e46be19ef9031b3a4b</code> unknown (model <code>Sphere.003</code>)
** <code>848d9bb47d47c5b45808c05dff16d993</code> R/B/Y (default)
* [[Flask]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>05d228f194dbb9a43a2826f31ea06d5c</code> conical
** <code>3ecf58d216515ea44ab880dc230f357c</code> round (default)
* [[Metal sheet]] <code>meshVariants</code>
** <code>bfa3f55416fb43443bc4d275882bd544</code> 4-hole (default)
** <code>743c7dd8859195e47813cfda942b99ce</code> 2-hole
* [[Mug]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>e47a8b44aa6f9b54586a7f43d81c42d2</code> blank red
** <code>9c23ad4bd3f2268498a1fe98d56c7ed3</code> #1 MUG
** <code>7c76578fd54cc6e45a8f79d9caa2daae</code> cow
** <code>84a9ba2f84eda1e4fb957fea456255fc</code> MORNING! x3
** <code>738ea9191589de74395611ece4ec1425</code> doodle creature (default)
* [[Painting]] <code>materialVariants</code>
** <code>8f672fd63e3ba584dbcb0c2438149533</code> lake
** <code>3e1c024c84a38c746a26e247394d2f6d</code> sky (default)
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
[[Comedy]]/[[Tragedy]] are programmed as separate items rather than a model swap.
The 2 [[clipboard]] variants are also programmed as separate items, with the same behaviour (and model?) but different textures.
</ref>
The item's variant is set upon generation, and is determined by the moon seed.
Due to a bug,{{cite bug|(nitpick) Some furniture's and items' states aren't included in saves}}
saving and reloading the lobby will reset all these to whichever variant is listed in their prefab.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Scrap's variants are set as part of the <code>RoundManager.SyncScrapValuesClientRpc</code> method, paraphrased below.
Note that there are 2 parallel mechanisms: <code>meshVariants</code> and <code>materialVariants</code>. But since no item uses both at once, it doesn't complicate RNG.
<syntaxhighlight lang="csharp">
Random rngScrapVariants = new(randomMapSeed + 210);
foreach (GrabbableObject component in scrapItems) { // collection comes from callsite in `RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel`
	if (component.itemProperties.meshVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.meshVariants);
	}
	if (component.itemProperties.materialVariants.IsNotEmpty()) {
		component.gameObject.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = rngScrapVariants.GetNextItem(component.itemProperties.materialVariants);
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
</div>

######## Scrap/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Items|purchasable equipment items|Store#Equipment}}
</div>

'''废料'''是可在[[moons/zh-cn|星球]]上发现的一类物品，收集和出售废料是游戏的[[Quota|主要目标]]。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 属性 ==
* '''最小/最大价值'''：一个物品可以卖出的最小和最大价值。
* '''重量'''：一个物品拿起来有多重，重量会让玩家走得比平常更慢。
* '''可导电'''：若物品可导电，它就有可能在[[Weather/zh-cn#暴风雨|暴风雨]]天气中让玩家被闪电劈中。
* '''需双手'''：玩家是否需要使用双手拿取物品。
</div>

== 机制 ==

<span id="Single_scrap_days"></span>
=== 单一废品日 ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Single scrap day}}
</div>

全同物资日
每日开局刷新物资时，有概率刷出全部为同一种废品，而非随机混搭。
该设定为官方刻意设计，同时设有数值保底，确保整体总价值不会低于常规水准。

######## Shiggy
[[Category:Pages_describing_modded_content]]
{{merge|Imperium}}
'''Shiggy''' is a modified version of the unused [[Red pill]] entity, added surreptitiously by [[Imperium]].<ref>[https://github.com/giosuel/imperium/blob/v0.2.7/Imperium/src/Core/Lifecycle/ObjectManager.cs#L681 ObjectManager.cs:681], the source behind Imperium's spawn menu, from v0.2.7</ref>
Its assets are not in the base game, nor are they in Imperium's source repository.<ref group="note">
[https://github.com/giosuel/imperium/blob/v0.2.7/Imperium/Imperium.csproj#L95-L98 The MSBuild project file references these 2 paths], but while the file is checked-in, the dir is not.
If you're curious, Shiggy has the appearance of [https://x.com/oishii_unaju/status/1044854315075219457 this GIF] of a fox girl called Kemomimi-chan.
</ref>

######## Ship
{{topicon Fandom|The_Ship}}
{{topicon Fandom|Monitors|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Terminal|2}}
{{topicon Fandom|Storage|3}}
{{topicon Fandom|Electric_Coil|4}}
{{topicon Fandom|Intercom|5}}
{{topicon Fandom|Bunkbeds|6}}
{{topicon Fandom|File_Cabinet|7}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox Furniture
| name = <translate><!--T:1--> Ship</translate>
| image = Ship Transparent.webp
| defaultprice = 0
}}<translate>
<!--T:2-->
The '''Autopilot''' '''Ship''' is where every crew begins their run in ''Lethal Company'', and is their base of operations and overall safest location. However, several entities can enter the ship; [[Eyeless Dog]]s, [[Baboon Hawk]]s, [[Kidnapper Fox]]es, [[Maneater]]s, [[Ghost Girl]], [[Circuit Bees]], [[Masked]], [[Giant Sapsucker]]s, [[Cadaver Bloom]]s, and [[Feiopar]]s are all capable of entering.

<!--T:46-->
The door is at the aft (back) of the ship and the monitors at the fore (front).<ref group="note">
This is confirmed by a line in the [[clipboard|"Training manual" clipboard]]: <q>[...] the electric coil located on the right [''recte'' starboard] interior wall of the ship [...]</q>
</ref>
Thus the ship takes off forwards, and reverses in to land.

== Included utilities == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
By default, the ship contains a main monitor, a terminal, a brake lever, a recharge station, four secondary monitors, door controls, a light switch, a cupboard, a filing cabinet, and a bunk bed.

=== Main monitor === <!--T:5--> 

<!--T:6-->
The screen gives an employee a simplistic top-down view of the employee they are observing, with the following symbols representing various things:
</translate>
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|<translate><!--T:39--> Examples of red circle sizes (a.k.a. radar pip size) for different entities</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
* Blue Circle: Player characters. The cone in front of them is their field of vision.
* Yellow/Green Triangle: Scrap items that can be sold.
* Blue Line: A fire exit (small blue line) or the main entrance (large blue line).
* Blue Line With Yellow Dots: Represents a locked door that needs a key to open.
* Red Circle: A nearby creature. Different sizes of circles represent different entities. However, the circle's behavior and speed (and players' reactions to it) is the most important factor in deciding which entity it represents.
* Swarm of Tiny Gray Dots: [[Circuit Bees]] (outdoors) or [[Mask Hornets]] (indoors).
* Red Square/Triangle: Represents landmines and turrets respectively.
* Red Line: Represents a vent.
* Letter with a Number: A code associated with the equipment it controls. Can be over secure doors, [[landmine]]s, [[turret]]s, and [[Spike Trap|spike trap]]s. Typing the codes into the terminal will open/close the door or temporarily disable landmines, turrets, and spike traps.

<!--T:8-->
The white button to the left of the Monitor switches perspectives between different players. The red button below it turns the main monitor on and off.

<!--T:9-->
The main monitor can also be viewed from the terminal by using the "VIEW MONITOR" command, and the perspective can be switched with the "SWITCH" command.

<!--T:10-->
Before landing on a moon, the main monitor displays flavor text about the moon that is currently selected. Depending on the text's length, it may also display the moon's current weather.

=== <span id="Ship_control_lever"></span> Brake lever === <!--T:16-->

<!--T:17-->
The '''Brake lever''' allows employees to land the ship on the moon they are orbiting, as well as allowing them to start the ship when they have landed to end the day and go back into orbit.

<!--T:18-->
While employees frequently land on Gordion on the final day (Day 0) to sell and meet quota, maximizing profit, it is possible to land and sell there earlier. When the ship lands on Gordion and nothing is sold, the day counter does not decrease. It is also possible to land on a moon other than Gordion on the final day, which always results in the quota being failed and subsequent disciplinary action.

=== Terminal === <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
The Computer Terminal has a variety of functions, including navigation, shopping, and viewing bestiary entries.

<!--T:13-->
Commands are ''not'' case sensitive. Some commands only depend on the first 3 letters; for example, "ada", "adasdfghj", "adama", etc. will be recognized as the command for "adamance". The following commands can be used on the terminal:
</translate>

|<translate><!--T:50--> Displays the second page of commands.</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:15-->
Commands can be copied from the chat into the terminal to allow quick access to a specific command.

</translate>[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|<translate><!--T:63--> The coil</translate>]]<translate>

=== Coil === <!--T:19-->

<!--T:72-->
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}

<!--T:20-->
The coil can be used to recharge battery-powered objects, allowing them to be reused after their battery is depleted. [[Walkie-talkie]]s, [[Flashlight]]s, [[Pro-flashlight]]s, [[Zap gun]]s, [[Boombox]]es, [[Jetpack]]s, [[Hairdryer]]s, and [[Laser pointer]]s are rechargeable using this method.

</translate>{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]<translate>

=== Secondary monitors === <!--T:21-->

<!--T:22-->
There are four monitors outside of the main monitor.

<!--T:23-->
The rightmost monitor shows a camera pointed out the back of the ship. It can be used to see threats that may be coming towards the ship, including the [[Ghost Girl]].

<!--T:24-->
The top-rightmost monitor shows the inside of the ship at a very low resolution, thus serving a mostly cosmetic purpose.

<!--T:25-->
There are then two monitors above the main monitor - the leftmost shows the employees' quota, and the other shows the amount of days left until quota is due. The quota monitor also shows the total amount employees have sold after they sell at the company building on [[Gordion]]. The days left monitor always counts down from three, showing "NOW" once the ship has taken off from the moon left on the final day.

</translate>{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|<translate><!--T:40--> The door controls</translate>]]<translate>

=== Door controls === <!--T:26-->

<!--T:41-->
The door controls are used to open and temporarily close the ship's exit door. It has two buttons and a display. Pressing the green button with a vertical bar opens the door, while pressing the red one with a circle closes the door. The display is used to show the percentage on how long the door will stay closed. When the percentage reaches 0%, the door opens, and it takes around 6 seconds to reach 100% again. When started on 100%, the door stays closed for about 30 seconds. There is also a small monitor screen above the door controls that shows what is going on outside the door.

<!--T:27-->
It is useful to keep [[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Masked]] out of the ship for a time, and to prevent Eyeless Dogs from being alerted to talking or dropping items inside the ship.

=== Light switch === <!--T:42-->

<!--T:28-->
The light switch turns the lights on or off. This is useful in the event that lightning strikes the ship, as it forces the lights off, and an employee will need to manually turn them back on. A [[Remote]] can also be used to turn the lights on and off.

<!--T:64-->
If an employee has bought [[Cozy Lights]] and/or the [[disco ball]], they will be turned on in the event that the light switch is turned off.

</translate>{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|<translate><!--T:66--> The magnet (orange box) and the lever (blue circle)</translate>]]<translate>

=== Magnet === <!--T:65-->

<!--T:67-->
On the outside of the ship, on the side without railing, is a magnet that holds the [[Company Cruiser]] to the ship so that it may be taken into orbit. It is turned on and off with a lever located on the outside corner of the ship, accessible by standing on the railing at the end opposite the ship door. Once the Cruiser is attached, nothing can dislodge it other than turning the magnet off again.

=== Decorations === <!--T:29-->

<!--T:30-->
The three starting decorations are a red cupboard, a filing cabinet, and a bunk bed. Additional decorations may be bought and placed inside the ship from the [[Store]]. The cupboard may be used as storage for tools or scrap items, and the filing cabinet and bunk bed are largely cosmetic (though can be used to store tools and scrap on top of it).

<!--T:71-->
Furniture placed "into storage" is in fact moved far outside the map, to the fixed point (800, -100, 0).

=== Store upgrades === <!--T:31-->

<!--T:32-->
More information about store upgrades can be found on the [[Store]] page.

== Bugs == <!--T:33-->

=== Clipping === <!--T:34-->

<!--T:35-->
The employee can clip through the ship with the help of the bunk beds or cupboards.{{cite YouTube|video-id=eOe3xhf9NpY|title=How to Clip through the Ship's Ceiling and Floor in Lethal Company(v45)|creator=Alt 1}}

<!--T:68-->
Note that some of these are inconsistent in multiplayer, and doing this while in space will teleport the employee back inside if they succeed.

<!--T:36-->
To clip through the Cupboards, press B to start "placing" them in order to go inside, then jump and press E or scroll to cancel the placement. If on top of the cupboard and partially in the ceiling, then jumping will cause the employee to be clipped out of bounds. While easier to complete, it is less consistent in multiplayer and can result in needing to be rescued from the wall of the ship.

<!--T:38-->
The same method can be used with Bunk Beds to clip out of bounds. It is more difficult to pull off, but is also more consistent. Canceling placement without jumping can cause the employee to be clipped through the floor or wall, with varying consistency that might require a rescue.

=== Corner spot === <!--T:43-->

<!--T:44-->
The left corner  of the ship (while facing towards the brake lever) is considered “outside”, meaning standing there and yelling can act as a pseudo loud horn, and Eyeless Dogs will rush outside the ship next to where the corner is are; however, standing too close to the wall can also allow them to attack through it.

<!--T:45-->
This can also be used as a safe spot; by angling the terminal in a way where it completely blocks off access to this corner by walking, staying completely silent will make dogs unable to kill the employee.

<!--T:69-->
This corner can also be used as a safe spot against the Kidnapper Fox. By placing the filing cabinet in this corner and standing on top of it against the corner when the Fox tries to sneak onto the ship, it will be lured to the outside wall, allowing it to easily be killed by crouching and hitting it.

<span id="Included_utilities"></span>
== Grundausstattung ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Während es viele Verbesserungen für das Schiff gibt, ist standardmäßig immer folgendes vorhanden: ein Hauptmonitor, ein Computer Terminal, ein Kontrollhebel, eine Aufladestation, vier Sekundärmonitore, zwei Knöpfe für die Türsteuerung, ein Lichtschalter, ein Schrank, ein Lagerregal und ein Etagenbett für 4 Personen.
</div>

<span id="Main_monitor"></span>
=== Hauptmonitor === 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der Bildschirm zeigt eine einfache Übersicht der Umgebung des gewählten Spielers mit den folgenden Symbolen:
</div>
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Examples of red circle sizes (a.k.a. radar pip size) for different entities</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* Blauer Kreis: Spielercharaktere. Der Kegel vor ihnen ist ihr Sichtfeld und ggf. ihre eingeschaltene Taschenlampe.
* Gelb-grüne Dreiecke: Schrott der eingesammelt und beim Firmensitz verkauft werden kann.
* Blaue Linie: Ein Notausgang (kurze blaue Linie) oder der Haupteingang (lange blaue Linie).
* Blaue Linie mit gelben Punkten: Stellt eine verschlossene Tür dar, für die ein Schlüssel benötigt wird.
* Roter Kreis: Eine Kreatur. Je nach Art der Kreatur, ist der Kreis unterschiedlich groß und geformt.
* Rote Linie: Ein Lüftungsschacht. Kreaturen können aus diesen herauskommen.
* Rotes Viereck oder Dreieck: Stellen Tretminen und Geschütze dar.
* Buchstabe und Zahl: Ein code der mit dem darüberstehenden Symbol verbunden ist (entweder eine Mine, eine Tür oder ein Geschütz). Tippt man den Code in den Computer ein wird die entsprechende Tür geöffnet/geschlossen bzw. das Geschütz oder die Mine kurzzeitig deaktiviert.
</div>

Der weiße Knopf links neben dem Monitor wechselt die Anzeige zwischen den Spielern. Der rote Knopf schaltet den Monitor aus.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Man kann das Radarbild außerdem im Computer über den Befehl "view monitor" anzeigen lassen.
</div>

Bevor man auf einem Mond landet, zeigt der Monitor einige Informationen zum gewählten Mond. Je nach der länge des Textes zeigt er auch sein aktuelles Wetter.

<span id="Brake_lever"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Kontrollhebel ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der Kontrollhebel wird benutzt, um das Schiff zu landen bzw. wieder abzuheben und so den Tag zu beenden. Vor dem Landen sollte immer das Wetter der Monde überprüft werden. Spieler die sich zum Zeitpunkt des Abhebens außerhalb des Schiffes befinden, werden zurückgelassen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Auch wenn man die meiste Zeit erst am letzten Tag (Tag 0) auf Gordion zum Verkaufen landet, ist es möglich bereits davor dort zu landen. Landet das Schiff auf Gordion und hebt wieder ab, ohne dass etwas verkauft wurde, wird dafür kein Tag berechnet. Außerdem ist es möglich am finalen Tag auf einem anderen Planeten als Gordion zu landen, was immer zdazu führt, dass die Profitquote nicht erreicht wird und die Mitarbeiter den Disziplinarmaßnahmen unterzogen werden.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Spieler können das Computer Terminal nutzen, um verschiedene Dinge im Spiel zu tun, wie navigieren, einkaufen,und Einträge im Bestiarium lesen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

</div>

<span id="Coil"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Aufladestation ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Aufladestation wird benutzt, um batteriebetriebene Gegenstände wieder aufzuladen.  Das [[Walkie-Talkie]], die [[Flashlight|Taschenlampe]] und [[Pro-Flashlight|Profi Taschenlampe]], die [[Zap Gun|Betäubungspistole]], die [[Boombox]], das [[Jetpack]], der [[Hairdryer|Föhn]] und [[Laser Pointer|Laserpointer]] können hier aufgeladen werden.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
<span id="Secondary_monitors"></span>
=== Sekundärmonitore ===

Es gibt vier weitere Monitore neben dem Hauptmonitor.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der rechte Monitor zeigt das Bild einer Kamera, die am Ausgang des Schiffs platziert ist. Sie ist besonders nützlich um das [[Ghost Girl|Geistermädchen]] zu entdecken, kann aber auch genutzt werden, um andere Bedrohungen in der Nähe des Schiffs zu erkennen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der obere rechte Monitor zeigt das Innere des Schiffs in extrem niedriger Auflösung und ist deshalb eher kosmetischer Natur.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dann gibt es zwei Monitore über dem Hauptmonitor - der linke zeigt die Profitquote und der andere die Anzahl Tage, die noch übrig sind, um die Profitquote zu erreichen. Der Profitmonitor zeigt auch an, wie viel bereits verkauft wurde, wenn man auf [[Gordion]] am Verkaufen ist. Der Monitor der die Tage anzeigt, zählt von drei runter und zeigt "NOW" an, wenn man nach dem letzten Tag abhebt.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The door controls</span>]]
<span id="Door_controls"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Türsteuerung und Lichtschalter ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The door controls are used to open and temporarily close the ship's exit door. It has two buttons and a display. Pressing the green button with a vertical bar opens the door, while pressing the red one with a circle closes the door. The display is used to show the percentage on how long the door will stay closed. When the percentage reaches 0%, the door opens, and it takes around 6 seconds to reach 100% again. When started on 100%, the door stays closed for about 30 seconds. There is also a small monitor screen above the door controls that shows what is going on outside the door.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Türsteuerung wird benutzt, um die Schiffstür kurzzeitig zu schließen oder wieder zu öffnen. Kreaturen die in das Schiff gealngen können, wie [[Eyeless Dog|augenlose Hunde]] und [[Masks (Enemy)|Maskierte]], können mithilfe der Türsteuerung kurzzeitig ausgeschlossen werden. Sobald die Tür wieder öffnet, lockt der Ton diese jedoch wieder an.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Light switch ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Der Lichtschalter schaltet das Licht im Schiff ein oder aus. Wird das Schiff von einem Blitz getroffen, gehen die elektrischen Geräte aus und das Licht kann mit dem Lichtschalter wieder eingeschalten werden. Sollte man [[Cozy Lights|Gemtliche Beleuchtung]] gekauft haben, geht diese an sobald das Licht über den Lichtschalter ausgeschalten wird. Eine [[Remote|Fernbedienung]] kann aus der Ferne benutzt werden, um die Lichter im Schiff ein oder aus zu schalten.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an employee has bought [[Cozy Lights]] and/or the [[disco ball]], they will be turned on in the event that the light switch is turned off.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The magnet (orange box) and the lever (blue circle)</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Magnet ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
On the outside of the ship, on the side without railing, is a magnet that holds the [[Company Cruiser]] to the ship so that it may be taken into orbit. It is turned on and off with a lever located on the outside corner of the ship, accessible by standing on the railing at the end opposite the ship door. Once the Cruiser is attached, nothing can dislodge it other than turning the magnet off again.
</div>

<span id="Decorations"></span>
=== Dekorationen ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die drei standardmäßigen Dekorationen sind ein rotes Lagerregal, ein Schrank und ein Etagenbett. Zusätzliche Artikel können im [[Store|Shop]] erworben werden. Das Lagerregal kann genutzt werden, um Gegenstände darin organisiert zu lagern. Die anderen beiden sind hauptsächlich kosmetischer Natur (man kann aber auch auf diese Gegenstände legen).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furniture placed "into storage" is in fact moved far outside the map, to the fixed point (800, -100, 0).
</div>

<span id="Store_upgrades"></span>
=== Verbesserungen aus dem Shop ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Auf der [[Store|Shop]]-Seite können Infos zu den Verbesserungen und anderen Artikel gefunden werden, die im Shop für das Schiff erhältlich sind.
</div>

== Bugs ==

<span id="Clipping"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Clipping<ref>https://youtu.be/eOe3xhf9NpY</ref> ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Spieler können mithilfe des Lagerregals oder Etagenbetts durch die Decke des Schiffs hindurchschlüpfen. Im Mehrspielermodus ist das nicht immer möglich und falls man dabei im Weltraum ist, wird man sofort zurück ins Schiff teleportiert.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Note that some of these are inconsistent in multiplayer, and doing this while in space will teleport the employee back inside if they succeed.
</div>

Um dies mit dem Lagerregal zu erreichen, muss man den Einrichtungsmodus nutzen (standardmäßig B drücken) und das Lagerregal so verschieben, dass man selbst darin steht. Indem man es dann in sich platziert, während man springt, sollte man teilweise in die Decke ragen und mit einem weiteren Sprung außen auf dem Schiff landen. Diese Option ist die einfachere von beiden, um beim Landen auf das Dach zu gelangen, funktioniert jedoch nicht immer im Mehrspielermodus. Man sollte diese Technik erst im Weltraum ausprobieren, da man bei einem Fehler feststecken kann und Hilfe braucht, um wieder freizukommen.

Um das mit dem Etagenbett zu schaffen, muss man wieder den Einrichtungsmodus aktivieren, dann selbst in das Bett rein laufen, springen und dabei das Bett wieder platzieren. Diese Variante funktioniert immer, ist dafür beim Landen aber um einiges schwieriger (oder eventuell sogar unmöglich).

Benutzt man diese Technik, ohne zu springen, fällt man stattdessen durch den Boden des Schiffs oder in die Wand. Im Einzelspielermodus kann man so immer durch den Boden gelangen, während es im Mehrspielermodus manchmal auch vorkommt, dass man stecken bleibt.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Corner spot ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The left corner (while facing towards the brake lever) is considered “outside”, meaning standing there and yelling can act as a pseudo loud horn, as the dogs will rush outside the ship next to where the corner is are - be careful because if this, standing too close to the wall can have dogs attack through it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This can also be used as a safe spot; by angling the terminal in a way where it completely blocks off access to this corner by walking, staying completely silent will make dogs unable to kill the employee.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This corner can also be used as a safe spot against the Kidnapper Fox, and as a way to easily kill it. Place the filing cabinet in the corner, then stand on top of it against the corner when the Fox tries to sneak onto the ship. It will be lured to the outside wall and you will be able to crouch and hit it.
</div>

{{Infobox Furniture
| name = Ship
| image = Ship Transparent.webp
| defaultprice = 0
}}The '''Autopilot''' '''Ship''' is where every crew begins their run in ''Lethal Company''. The ship is your base of operations, and overall safest location. However, several entities can enter the ship: [[Eyeless Dog]]s, [[Baboon Hawk]]s, [[Kidnapper Fox]]es, [[Maneater]]s, [[Ghost Girl]], [[Circuit Bees]], [[Masked]], [[Giant Sapsucker]]s, [[Cadaver Bloom]]s, and [[Feiopar]]s.

The door is at the aft (back) of the ship and the monitors at the fore (front).<ref group="note">
This is confirmed by a line in the [[clipboard|"Training manual" clipboard]]: <q>[...] the electric coil located on the right [''recte'' starboard] interior wall of the ship [...]</q>
</ref>
Thus the ship takes off forwards, and reverses in to land.

== Included utilities ==

By default, the ship contains a main monitor, a terminal, a brake lever, a recharge station, four secondary monitors, door controls, a light switch, a cupboard, a filing cabinet, and a bunk bed.

=== Main monitor === 

The screen gives an employee a simplistic top-down view of the employee they are observing, with the following symbols representing various things:
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|Examples of red circle sizes (a.k.a. radar pip size) for different entities]]
* Blue Circle: Player characters. The cone in front of them is their field of vision.
* Yellow/Green Triangle: Scrap items that can be sold.
* Blue Line: A fire exit (small blue line) or the main entrance (large blue line).
* Blue Line With Yellow Dots: Represents a locked door that needs a key to open.
* Red Circle: A nearby creature. Different sizes of circles represent different entities. However, the circle's behavior and speed (and players' reactions to it) is the most important factor in deciding which entity it represents.
* Swarm of Tiny Gray Dots: [[Circuit Bees]] (outdoors) or [[Mask Hornets]] (indoors).
* Red Square/Triangle: Represents landmines and turrets respectively.
* Red Line: Represents a vent.
* Letter with a Number: A code associated with the thing it's over. Can be over secure doors, landmines, turrets, and spike traps. You can type the codes into the terminal to open/close a door or to temporarily disable landmines, turrets, and spike traps.

The white button to the left of the Monitor switches perspectives between different players. The red button below it turns the main monitor on and off.

The main monitor can also be viewed from the terminal by using the "VIEW MONITOR" command, and the perspective can be switched with the "SWITCH" command.

Before landing on a moon, the main monitor displays flavor text about the moon that is currently selected. Depending on the text's length, it may also display the moon's current weather.

=== <span id="Ship_control_lever"></span> Brake lever ===

The '''Brake lever''' allows employees to land the ship on the moon they are orbiting, as well as allowing them to start the ship when they have landed to end the day and go back into orbit.

While employees frequently land on Gordion on the final day (Day 0) to sell and meet quota, maximizing profit, it is possible to land and sell there earlier. When the ship lands on Gordion and nothing is sold, the day counter does not decrease. It is also possible to land on a moon other than Gordion on the final day, which always results in the quota being failed and subsequent disciplinary action.

=== Terminal ===

The Computer Terminal has a variety of functions, including navigation, shopping, and viewing bestiary entries.

Commands are ''not'' case sensitive. Some commands only depend on the first 3 letters; for example, "ada", "adasdfghj", "adama", etc. will be recognized as the command for "adamance". The following commands can be used on the terminal:
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Input !! Result
|-
|'''HELP'''
|Displays the first page of commands.
|-
|'''OTHER'''
|Displays the second page of commands.
|-
|'''MOONS'''
|Allows players to choose between [[moons]] to land in and observe weather conditions for all moons.
|-
|'''STORE'''
|Opens the [[Store]].
|-
|'''BESTIARY'''
|Opens the [[Bestiary]].
|-
|'''STORAGE'''
|Accesses objects placed into storage.
|-
|'''EJECT'''
|Gently retires the employees in the ship, used to reset runs (command can only be done by Host).
|-
|'''VIEW MONITOR'''
|Toggles on and off the main monitor's map camera.
|-
|'''SWITCH [Player name]'''
|Switches view on the map camera to the specified player. Switches in order when no player name is specified.
|-
|'''PING [Radar booster name]'''
|Makes the specified radar booster play a sound.
|-
|'''FLASH [Radar booster name]'''
|Makes the specified radar booster flash at anyone looking at it, stunning enemies.
|-
|'''TRANSMIT [message]'''
|Puts a message on everyone's screen if the [[Signal Translator]] has been bought.
|-
|'''SCAN'''
|Returns the amount of items left on the current moon.
|-
|'''SIGURD'''
|Opens up the [[Sigurd Logs]].
|}
By pressing / to open chat, typing the command you want quick access to, pressing Ctrl+A to select it, and pressing Ctrl+C to copy it, you can then paste it with Ctrl+V, allowing quick access to a specific command.
[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|The coil]]
=== Coil ===

{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}

The coil can be used to recharge battery-powered objects, allowing them to be reused after their battery is depleted. [[Walkie-talkie]]s, [[Flashlight]]s, [[Pro-flashlight]]s, [[Zap gun]]s, [[Boombox]]es, [[Jetpack]]s, [[Hairdryer]]s, and [[Laser pointer]]s are rechargeable using this method.
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
=== Secondary monitors ===

There are four monitors outside of the main monitor.

The rightmost monitor shows a camera pointed out the back of the ship. It can be used to see threats that may be coming towards the ship, including the [[Ghost Girl]].

The top-rightmost monitor shows the inside of the ship at a very low resolution, thus serving a mostly cosmetic purpose.

There are then two monitors above the main monitor - the leftmost shows the employees' quota, and the other shows the amount of days left until quota is due. The quota monitor also shows the total amount employees have sold after they sell at the company building on [[Gordion]]. The days left monitor always counts down from three, showing "NOW" once the ship has taken off from the moon left on the final day.
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|The door controls]]
=== Door controls ===

The door controls are used to open and temporarily close the ship's exit door. It has two buttons and a display. Pressing the green button with a vertical bar opens the door, while pressing the red one with a circle closes the door. The display is used to show the percentage on how long the door will stay closed. When the percentage reaches 0%, the door opens, and it takes around 6 seconds to reach 100% again. When started on 100%, the door stays closed for about 30 seconds. There is also a small monitor screen above the door controls that shows what is going on outside the door.

It is useful to keep [[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Masked]] out of the ship for a time, and to prevent Eyeless Dogs from being alerted to talking or dropping items inside the ship.

=== Light switch ===

The light switch turns the lights on or off. This is useful in the event that lightning strikes the ship, as it forces the lights off, and an employee will need to manually turn them back on. A [[Remote]] can also be used to turn the lights on and off.

If an employee has bought [[Cozy Lights]] and/or the [[disco ball]], they will be turned on in the event that the light switch is turned off.
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|The magnet (orange box) and the lever (blue circle)]]
=== Magnet ===

On the outside of the ship, on the side without railing, is a magnet that holds the [[Company Cruiser]] to the ship so that it may be taken into orbit. It is turned on and off with a lever located on the outside corner of the ship, accessible by standing on the railing at the end opposite the ship door. Once the Cruiser is attached, nothing can dislodge it other than turning the magnet off again.

=== Decorations ===

The three starting decorations are a red cupboard, a filing cabinet, and a bunk bed. Additional decorations may be bought and placed inside the ship from the [[Store]]. The cupboard may be used as storage for tools or scrap items, and the filing cabinet and bunk bed are largely cosmetic (though can be used to store tools and scrap on top of it).

Furniture placed "into storage" is in fact moved far outside the map, to the fixed point (800, -100, 0).

=== Store upgrades ===

More information about store upgrades can be found on the [[Store]] page.

== Bugs ==

=== Clipping ===

The employee can clip through the ship with the help of the bunk beds or cupboards.{{cite YouTube|video-id=eOe3xhf9NpY|title=How to Clip through the Ship's Ceiling and Floor in Lethal Company(v45)|creator=Alt 1}}

Note that some of these are inconsistent in multiplayer, and doing this while in space will teleport the employee back inside if they succeed.

With the Cupboards, press B on them and go inside them(the doors will still have collision), jump and press E or scroll to cancel the placement, you should be on top of it, partially in the ceiling, jumping again should put you outside, this is the easier option for ceiling clipping as you land, since you cannot move objects while the ship is moving, but is inconsistent in multiplayer, make sure you test this in space before trying to use it on a moon, not jumping can get you stuck inside, needing someone else to get you out

With the Bunk Beds, Press B to go inside them, Jump and press E or scroll to clip onto the roof of the ship, unlike the Cupboards, this is consistent but is much harder(or maybe even impossible) to perform while landing

Pressing E or scrolling with the Bunk Beds without jumping can either clip you through the floor or the wall, in solo you consistently clip through the floor, in multiplayer it is inconsistent, and you may get stuck.

=== Corner spot ===

The left corner (while facing towards the brake lever) is considered “outside”, meaning standing there and yelling can act as a pseudo loud horn, as the dogs will rush outside the ship next to where the corner is are - be careful because if this, standing too close to the wall can have dogs attack through it.

This can also be used as a safe spot; by angling the terminal in a way where it completely blocks off access to this corner by walking, staying completely silent will make dogs unable to kill the employee.

This corner can also be used as a safe spot against the Kidnapper Fox, and as a way to easily kill it. Place the filing cabinet in the corner, then stand on top of it against the corner when the Fox tries to sneak onto the ship. It will be lured to the outside wall and you will be able to crouch and hit it.

<span id="Main_monitor"></span>
=== Monitor Principal === 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La pantalla te da un una vista simple de lo que el jugador que observas esta mirando, con los siguientes símbolos representando cosas varias:
</div>
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|Ejemplos de escala en los puntos rojos (A.k.a tamaño de puntos en el radar) para distintas entidades]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* Circulo azul: Jugadores. El cono enfrente es su campo de vista.
* El triangulo verde/amarillo: Chatarra.
* Línea azul: Salida de emergencia (Si es pequeña) o la entrada principal (Si es grande).
* Línea azul con puntos amarillos: Representa una puerta cerrada que necesita una [[Key | Llave]] para abrirse
*Circulo Rojo: Una entidad cercana. Distinto tamaño representa distinta especie.
* Cuadrado o Triángulo Rojo: Representa una mina (Cuadrado) o torreta (Triángulo) activos.
* Línea Roja: Representa una ventilación
* Número con una letra: Es el código que se puede poner en la terminal para desactivar torretas o minas, y si es una puerta, abrir o cerrar.
</div>

El botón blanco a la izquierda del monitor cambia entre monitorear jugadores. El botón rojo apaga o prende el monitor.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
También se puede ver la perspectiva de el monitor central usando el comando "VIEW MONITOR" en la terminal.
</div>

Antes de alunizar, el monitor central proyectara un texto sobre aquella luna. dependiendo de la longitud del texto, puede (o no) mostrar su clima actual

<span id="Brake_lever"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Palanca de control de la nave ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The '''Brake lever''' allows employees to land the ship on the moon they are orbiting, as well as allowing them to start the ship when they have landed to end the day and go back into orbit.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While employees frequently land on Gordion on the final day (Day 0) to sell and meet quota, maximizing profit, it is possible to land and sell there earlier. When the ship lands on Gordion and nothing is sold, the day counter does not decrease. It is also possible to land on a moon other than Gordion on the final day, which always results in the quota being failed and subsequent disciplinary action.
</div>

=== Terminal ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Los jugadores puede usar la terminal para hacer varias cosas en el juego, incluyendo navegación, compras y ver las entradas del bestiario
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Los Comandos '''NO''' se cambian con bloqueo de mayúsculas o no. Los siguientes comandos se pueden usar en la terminal:
</div>
{| class="wikitable sortable"

By pressing / to open chat, typing the command you want quick access to, pressing Ctrl+A to select it, and pressing Ctrl+C to copy it, you can then paste it with Ctrl+V, allowing quick access to a specific command.
</div>
[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The coil</span>]]
<span id="Coil"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Estación de recarga ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The coil can be used to recharge battery-powered objects, allowing them to be reused after their battery is depleted. [[Walkie-talkie]]s, [[Flashlight]]s, [[Pro-flashlight]]s, [[Zap gun]]s, [[Boombox]]es, [[Jetpack]]s, [[Hairdryer]]s, and [[Laser pointer]]s are rechargeable using this method.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
<span id="Secondary_monitors"></span>
=== Monitores Secundarios ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There are four monitors outside of the main monitor.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The rightmost monitor shows a camera pointed out the back of the ship. It can be used to see threats that may be coming towards the ship, including the [[Ghost Girl]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The top-rightmost monitor shows the inside of the ship at a very low resolution, thus serving a mostly cosmetic purpose.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There are then two monitors above the main monitor - the leftmost shows the employees' quota, and the other shows the amount of days left until quota is due. The quota monitor also shows the total amount employees have sold after they sell at the company building on [[Gordion]]. The days left monitor always counts down from three, showing "NOW" once the ship has taken off from the moon left on the final day.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The door controls</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Door controls ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The door controls are used to open and temporarily close the ship's exit door. It has two buttons and a display. Pressing the green button with a vertical bar opens the door, while pressing the red one with a circle closes the door. The display is used to show the percentage on how long the door will stay closed. When the percentage reaches 0%, the door opens, and it takes around 6 seconds to reach 100% again. When started on 100%, the door stays closed for about 30 seconds. There is also a small monitor screen above the door controls that shows what is going on outside the door.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
It is useful to keep [[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Masked]] out of the ship for a time, and to prevent Eyeless Dogs from being alerted to talking or dropping items inside the ship.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Light switch ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The light switch turns the lights on or off. This is useful in the event that lightning strikes the ship, as it forces the lights off, and an employee will need to manually turn them back on. A [[Remote]] can also be used to turn the lights on and off.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an employee has bought [[Cozy Lights]] and/or the [[disco ball]], they will be turned on in the event that the light switch is turned off.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The magnet (orange box) and the lever (blue circle)</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Magnet ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
On the outside of the ship, on the side without railing, is a magnet that holds the [[Company Cruiser]] to the ship so that it may be taken into orbit. It is turned on and off with a lever located on the outside corner of the ship, accessible by standing on the railing at the end opposite the ship door. Once the Cruiser is attached, nothing can dislodge it other than turning the magnet off again.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Decorations ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The three starting decorations are a red cupboard, a filing cabinet, and a bunk bed. Additional decorations may be bought and placed inside the ship from the [[Store]]. The cupboard may be used as storage for tools or scrap items, and the filing cabinet and bunk bed are largely cosmetic (though can be used to store tools and scrap on top of it).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furniture placed "into storage" is in fact moved far outside the map, to the fixed point (800, -100, 0).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Store upgrades ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
More information about store upgrades can be found on the [[Store]] page.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Bugs ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Clipping ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The employee can clip through the ship with the help of the bunk beds or cupboards.{{cite YouTube|video-id=eOe3xhf9NpY|title=How to Clip through the Ship's Ceiling and Floor in Lethal Company(v45)|creator=Alt 1}}
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Note that some of these are inconsistent in multiplayer, and doing this while in space will teleport the employee back inside if they succeed.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
With the Cupboards, press B on them and go inside them(the doors will still have collision), jump and press E or scroll to cancel the placement, you should be on top of it, partially in the ceiling, jumping again should put you outside, this is the easier option for ceiling clipping as you land, since you cannot move objects while the ship is moving, but is inconsistent in multiplayer, make sure you test this in space before trying to use it on a moon, not jumping can get you stuck inside, needing someone else to get you out
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
With the Bunk Beds, Press B to go inside them, Jump and press E or scroll to clip onto the roof of the ship, unlike the Cupboards, this is consistent but is much harder(or maybe even impossible) to perform while landing
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Pressing E or scrolling with the Bunk Beds without jumping can either clip you through the floor or the wall, in solo you consistently clip through the floor, in multiplayer it is inconsistent, and you may get stuck.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Corner spot ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The left corner (while facing towards the brake lever) is considered “outside”, meaning standing there and yelling can act as a pseudo loud horn, as the dogs will rush outside the ship next to where the corner is are - be careful because if this, standing too close to the wall can have dogs attack through it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This can also be used as a safe spot; by angling the terminal in a way where it completely blocks off access to this corner by walking, staying completely silent will make dogs unable to kill the employee.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This corner can also be used as a safe spot against the Kidnapper Fox, and as a way to easily kill it. Place the filing cabinet in the corner, then stand on top of it against the corner when the Fox tries to sneak onto the ship. It will be lured to the outside wall and you will be able to crouch and hit it.
</div>

<span id="Included_utilities"></span>
== Dołączone narzędzia ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Chociaż istnieje wiele ulepszeń, które można dokupić do statku, to na początku znajdują się na nim: główny monitor, terminal, dźwignia sterowania statkiem, stacja ładująca, cztery monitory pomocnicze, sterowanie drzwiami, przełącznik światła, szafka, szafa na dokumenty oraz łóżko piętrowe.
</div>

<span id="Main_monitor"></span>
=== Główny monitor === 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ekran dostarcza prostego widoku z góry postaci, którą obserwujesz, z następującymi symbolami reprezentującymi różne elementy:
</div>
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Examples of red circle sizes (a.k.a. radar pip size) for different entities</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
* Niebieski Okrąg: Postacie graczy. Stożek przed nimi to ich pole widzenia.
* Żółty/Zielony Trójkąt: Przedmioty złomu, które można sprzedać.
* Niebieska Linia: Wyjście ewakuacyjne (mała niebieska linia) lub główne wejście (duża niebieska linia).
* Niebieska Linia z Żółtymi Kropkami: Reprezentuje zamknięte drzwi, które wymagają klucza do otwarcia.
* Czerwony Okrąg: Bliski byt. Różne wielkości okręgów reprezentują różne istoty.
* Czerwony Kwadrat/Trójkąt: Reprezentuje odpowiednio: miny lądowe i wieżyczki strzelnicze.
* Czerwona Linia: Reprezentuje wentylację.
* Litera z Numerem: Kod związany z obiektem, nad którym się znajduje. Może dotyczyć drzwi zatrzaskowych, min i wieżyczek. Kody można wpisać w terminalu, aby otworzyć/zamknąć drzwi lub tymczasowo wyłączyć wieżyczki i miny.
</div>

Biały przycisk po lewej stronie monitora przełącza perspektywę między różnymi graczami. Czerwony przycisk poniżej włącza i wyłącza główny monitor.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Możesz także oglądać główny monitor z terminala, używając polecenia "VIEW MONITOR".
</div>


Przed lądowaniem na księżycu, główny monitor wyświetla tekst smakowy dotyczący obecnie wybranego księżyca. W zależności od długości tekstu, może również pokazywać aktualną pogodę na księżycu.

<span id="Brake_lever"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Dźwignia sterowania statkiem ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Dźwignia sterowania statkiem pozwala na wylądowanie statku na obecnym księżycu, którym okrążasz, oraz umożliwia uruchomienie statku po wylądowaniu, aby zakończyć dzień i powrócić na orbitę, bez względu na obecność wszystkich graczy. Zawsze zaleca się sprawdzenie warunków pogodowych na wybranym księżycu przed lądowaniem.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Chociaż gracze często lądują na Gordion w ostatnim dniu (Dzień 0), aby sprzedać towary i spełnić normę, maksymalizując zyski, istnieje możliwość wylądowania i sprzedaży wcześniej. Kiedy statek wyląduje na Gordion i nic nie zostanie sprzedane, licznik dni nie będzie się zmniejszał. Istnieje także możliwość wylądowania na innej planecie niż Gordion w ostatnim dniu, co zawsze skutkuje niepowodzeniem normy i następnymi środkami dyscyplinarnymi.
</div>

=== Terminal ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

Gracze mogą używać terminala komputerowego do różnych czynności w grze, takich jak nawigacja, zakupy czy przeglądanie wpisów w bestiariuszu.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

Polecenia NIE są rozróżniane pod względem wielkości liter. Oto polecenia, które można używać na terminalu:

[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The coil</span>]]
<span id="Coil"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Stacja ładująca ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Stacja ładująca to urządzenie, w którym można naładować przedmioty zasilane baterią, umożliwiając ich dodatkowe użycie po wyczerpaniu baterii. Naładować można przedmioty takie jak: [[Walkie-Talkie/pl|Krótkofalawki]], [[Flashlight/pl|Latarki]], [[Pro-Flashlight/pl|Super-Latarki]], [[Zap Gun/pl|Działka Paraliżujące]], [[Boombox/pl|Radia]], [[Jetpack/pl|Plecaki Odrzutowe]], [[Hairdryer/pl|Suszarki]] i [[Laser Pointer/pl|Wskaźniki Laserowe]].
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
<span id="Secondary_monitors"></span>
=== Monitory pomocnicze ===


Istnieją cztery monitory poza głównym monitorem.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Najbardziej na prawo umieszczony monitor pokazuje kamerę skierowaną w tył statku. Jest to najbardziej przydatne do obserwacji [[Ghost Girl/pl|Dziewczynki Ducha]], ale może także być używane do zauważania innych zagrożeń, które zbliżają się do statku.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Najwyżej po prawej stronie umieszczony monitor pokazuje wnętrze statku o bardzo niskiej rozdzielczości, służąc głównie celom kosmetycznym.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Obok znajdują się dwa monitory nad głównym monitorem - najbardziej na lewo pokazuje twoją normę, a drugi pokazuje ilość dni pozostałych do terminu wykonania normy. Monitor z normą pokazuje także całkowitą ilość sprzedanych produktów po odwiedzeniu budynku firmy na [[Gordion/pl|Gordion]]. Monitor dni pozostałych zawsze odlicza od trzech, wyświetlając "NOW" (TERAZ) po starcie statku z ostatniego księżyca w ostatnim dniu.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The door controls</span>]]
<span id="Door_controls"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Sterowanie drzwiami i przełącznik światła ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The door controls are used to open and temporarily close the ship's exit door. It has two buttons and a display. Pressing the green button with a vertical bar opens the door, while pressing the red one with a circle closes the door. The display is used to show the percentage on how long the door will stay closed. When the percentage reaches 0%, the door opens, and it takes around 6 seconds to reach 100% again. When started on 100%, the door stays closed for about 30 seconds. There is also a small monitor screen above the door controls that shows what is going on outside the door.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

Sterowanie drzwiami służy do otwierania i tymczasowego zamykania drzwi, z których wychodzisz ze statku. Jest przydatne, aby na pewien czas trzymać [[Eyeless Dog/|Bezokie Psy]] i [[Masks (Enemy)/pl|Omaskowanych]] z dala od statku, ale gdy drzwi się otworzą, hałas związany z otwieraniem drzwi przyciągnie je z powrotem do statku.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Light switch ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Przełącznik światła włącza lub wyłącza światła. Jest to przydatne w przypadku uderzenia pioruna w statek, ponieważ wymusi wyłączenie świateł, a następnie będzie trzeba je ręcznie ponownie włączyć. Jeśli gracz zakupił [[Cozy Lights/pl|Przyjemne Światełka]], zostaną one włączone w przypadku wyłączenia przełącznika światła. [[Remote/pl|Pilot]] również może być używany do włączania lub wyłączania świateł.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If an employee has bought [[Cozy Lights]] and/or the [[disco ball]], they will be turned on in the event that the light switch is turned off.
</div>
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The magnet (orange box) and the lever (blue circle)</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Magnet ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
On the outside of the ship, on the side without railing, is a magnet that holds the [[Company Cruiser]] to the ship so that it may be taken into orbit. It is turned on and off with a lever located on the outside corner of the ship, accessible by standing on the railing at the end opposite the ship door. Once the Cruiser is attached, nothing can dislodge it other than turning the magnet off again.
</div>

<span id="Decorations"></span>
=== Dekoracje ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

Trzy początkowe dekoracje to czerwona szafa, szafka na dokumenty i łóżko piętrowe. Dodatkowe dekoracje można zakupić i umieścić wewnątrz statku w [[Store/pl|sklepie]]. Szafa może być używana jako przechowywanie narzędzi lub przedmiotów złomu, a szafka na dokumenty i łóżko piętrowe są głównie kosmetyczne (choć można na nich przechowywać narzędzia i przedmioty złomu).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Furniture placed "into storage" is in fact moved far outside the map, to the fixed point (800, -100, 0).
</div>

<span id="Store_upgrades"></span>
=== Ulepszenia w sklepie ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jeśli chcesz zobaczyć i dowiedzieć się więcej o płatnych przedmiotach, które można kupić dla statku, przejdź do strony [[Store/pl|Sklep]] i zajrzyj na ich odpowiednie strony.
</div>

<span id="Bugs"></span>
== Błędy  ==

<span id="Clipping"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Zahaczanie<ref>https://youtu.be/eOe3xhf9NpY</ref> ===
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Można przechodzić przez statek przy użyciu łóżek piętrowych lub szafek, należy jednak zauważyć, że niektóre z nich mogą działać niespójnie w trybie wieloosobowym, a próba tego podczas przebywania w kosmosie spowoduje teleportację z powrotem do środka statku, jeśli się uda.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Note that some of these are inconsistent in multiplayer, and doing this while in space will teleport the employee back inside if they succeed.
</div>

Z szafkami, naciśnij klawisz B na nich i wejdź do środka (drzwi nadal będą miały kolizję), skocz i naciśnij klawisz E lub przewiń, aby anulować umieszczanie. Powinieneś być na górze, częściowo w suficie, ponowne skok powinno cię umieścić na zewnątrz. To jest łatwiejsza opcja do przechodzenia przez sufit, ponieważ nie można przesuwać przedmiotów, gdy statek się porusza, ale działa niespójnie w trybie wieloosobowym. Upewnij się, że przetestujesz to w kosmosie, zanim spróbujesz tego na księżycu; nie skakanie może spowodować utknięcie wewnątrz, wymagające pomocy od innego gracza, aby cię wyciągnąć.

Przy łóżkach piętrowych naciśnij klawisz B, aby wejść do nich, skocz i naciśnij klawisz E lub przewiń, aby zaczepić się na dachu statku. W przeciwieństwie do szafek, ta metoda działa konsekwentnie, ale jest znacznie trudniejsza (a być może nawet niemożliwa) do wykonania podczas lądowania.


Naciśnięcie klawisza E lub przewinięcie z łóżkami piętrowymi bez skakania może skutkować przechodzeniem przez podłogę lub ścianę. W trybie pojedynczym przechodzisz konsekwentnie przez podłogę, w trybie wieloosobowym jest to niespójne i możesz utknąć.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Corner spot ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The left corner (while facing towards the brake lever) is considered “outside”, meaning standing there and yelling can act as a pseudo loud horn, as the dogs will rush outside the ship next to where the corner is are - be careful because if this, standing too close to the wall can have dogs attack through it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This can also be used as a safe spot; by angling the terminal in a way where it completely blocks off access to this corner by walking, staying completely silent will make dogs unable to kill the employee.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This corner can also be used as a safe spot against the Kidnapper Fox, and as a way to easily kill it. Place the filing cabinet in the corner, then stand on top of it against the corner when the Fox tries to sneak onto the ship. It will be lured to the outside wall and you will be able to crouch and hit it.
</div>

######## Ship/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom|The_Ship}}
{{topicon Fandom|Monitors|1}}

{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox Furniture
| name = Nave
| image = Ship Transparent.webp
| defaultprice = 0
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
A '''Autopilot Ship''' é o local onde toda equipe começa sua sessão em ''Lethal Company''. A nave será a sua base de operações e local mais seguro. Porém, várias [[entities/pt-br|entidades]] podem entrar na nave: [[Eyeless Dog/pt-br|Cães Cegos]], [[Baboon Hawk/pt-br|Falcões Babuínos]], [[Kidnapper fox/pt-br|Raposas Raptoras]], [[Maneater/pt-br|Devorador de Homens]], [[Ghost Girl/pt-br|Garota Fantasma]], [[Circuit Bees/pt-br|Abelhas Elétricas]] e [[Masks (enemy)/pt-br|Mascarades]].
</div>

A porta está na popa (trás) da nave e os monitores estão na proa (frente) <ref group="note">Isso é confirmado em uma frase na [[clipboard/pt-br|prancheta do Manual de Instruções]]: <q>[...] the electric coil located on the right [''recte'' starboard] interior wall of the ship [...]</q></ref>.
Portanto, a nave decola para frente e pousa dando ré.

<span id="Included_utilities"></span>
== Utilidades incluídas ==

Por padrão, a nave contém um monitor principal, um terminal, uma alavanca de freio, uma estação de recarga, quatro monitores secundários, controles para a porta, um interruptor, um armário, um fichário e um beliche.

<span id="Main_monitor"></span>
=== Monitor principal === 

A tela dá a ume funcionárie uma visão simples de cima para baixo de funcionárie que elu está observando, com os seguintes símbolos representando várias coisas:
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|Exemplos de tamanhos do círculo vermelho (vulgo, tamanho da detecção no radar) para diferentes entidades]]
* Círculo azul: Funcionáries. O cone em sua frente indica seu campo de visão.
* Triângulo amarelo/verde: Sucata que pode ser vendida.
* Linha azul: Uma saída de emergência (linha azul pequena) ou a entrada principal (linha azul grande).
* Linha azul com pontos amarelos: Indica uma porta trancada, que precisa de uma chave para abrir. <!-- Por favor verificar -->
* Círculo vermelho: Uma [[entities/pt-br|entidade]] nas proximidades. Círculos de tamanhos diferentes indicam entidades diferentes. Porém o comportamento e velocidade do ponto (também a reação de funcionárie) devem ser os fatores principais para identificar a entidade.
* Vários pontos cinzas pequenos: Indicam ou as [[Circuit Bees/pt-br|Circuit Bees]] (quando no exterior) ou as [[Mask Hornets/pt-br|Mask Hornets]] (quando no interior).
* Quadrado/Triângulo vermelho: Representa minas terrestres e torretas, respectivamente.
* Linha vermelha: Representa uma ventilação.
* Letras com números: Um código associado com a coisa no qual está sobre. Pode estar sobre portas reforçadas, torretas e armadilhas de espinhos. Você pode digitar códigos no terminal para abrir/fechar a porta ou desabilitar temporariamente as armadilhas. (O código da mina terrestre é visto pelê funcionárie quando a escaneia)

O botão branco a esquerda do Monitor muda as perspectivas entre os jogadores. O botão vermelho debaixo dele desliga e liga o monitor.

Você pode ver o monitor principal do terminal, usando o comando "VIEW MONITOR" e a perspectiva pode ser mudada com o comando "SWITCH [nome de funcionárie]"

Antes de pousar em uma lua, o monitor principal mostra texto informativo sobre a lua que está selecionada. Dependendo do tamanho do texto, pode mostrar o clima atual da lua.

<span id="Brake_lever"></span>
=== Alavanca de freio ===

A '''Alavanca de freio''' permite funcionáries a pousar a nave na lua em que estão orbitando, também permite que elus iniciem a nave pousada para terminar o dia e voltar à órbita.

Enquanto funcionáries frequentemente pousem em Gordion no último dia (Dia 0) para vender e bater a meta, é possível pousar e vender itens antes. Se a nave pousar em Gordion e nada for vendido, o contador de dias não diminuirá. Também é possível pousar em outra lua que não seja Gordion no último dia, o que sempre resulta em uma meta não concluída e ação disciplinaria logo em seguida.

=== Terminal ===

O Terminal de Computação tem uma variedade de funções, incluindo navegação, compras e ver entradas no bestiário.

Comandos ignoram letras maiusculas/minúsculas. Alguns comandos apenas dependem das primeiras três letras; por exemplo: "ada", "adasdfghj", "adama", etc. são reconhecidos como o comando "adamance". Os comandos a seguir podem ser usados no terminal:
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Entrada !! Resultado
|-
|'''HELP'''
|Mostra a primeira página de comandos.
|-
|'''OTHER'''
|Mostra a segunda página de comandos.
|-
|'''MOONS'''
|Permite os jogadores a escolher entre as [[Moons/pt-br|luas]] para pousar e observar as condições climáticas de todas as luas.
|-
|'''STORE'''
|Abre a [[Store/pt-br|Loja]].
|-
|'''BESTIARY'''
|Abre o  [[Bestiary/pt-br|Bestiário]].
|-
|'''STORAGE'''
|Acessa objetos colocados no armazém.
|-
|'''EJECT'''
|Gentilmente retira ês funcionáries  da nava, usado para reiniciar sessões (só pode ser utilizado pelo Host)
|-
|'''VIEW MONITOR'''
|Liga e desliga a  câmera do mapa do monitor principal.
|-
|'''SWITCH [Player name]'''
|Troca a perspectiva na câmera do mapa para ê funcionárie especificade. Troca em ordem caso ninguém seja especificade.
|-
|'''PING [Radar booster name]'''
|Faz o [[radar booster/pt-br|radar booster]] especificado tocar um som
|-
|'''FLASH [Radar booster name]'''
|Faz o radar booster especificado dar um flash em qualquer um olhando para ele, atordoado entidades.
|-
|'''TRANSMIT [message]'''
|Coloca uma mensagem na tela de todo mundo se o [[Signal Translator/pt-br|Tradutor de Sinal]] foi comprado.
|-
|'''SCAN'''
|Indica a quantidade de itens restantes na lua.
|-
|'''SIGURD'''
|Abre os [[Sigurd Logs/pt-br|Registros de Sigurd]]
|}
Apertando "/" para abrir o chat de texto e digitar o comando nele, você pode apertar "Ctrl+A" para selecioná-lo, "Ctrl+C" para colá-lo e "Ctrl+V" para copiá-lo, permitindo o acesso rápido a um comando.
[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|A estação de recarga]]
<span id="Coil"></span>
=== Estação de recarga ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}
</div>

A estação de recarga pode ser usada para recarregar objetos com bateria, permitindo eles serem reutilizados depois que suas baterias acabarem. [[Walkie-talkie/pt-br|Walkie-talkies]], [[Flashlight/pt-br|lanternas]], [[Pro-flashlight/pt-br|lanternas-pro]], [[Zap gun/pt-br|armas de choque]], [[Boombox/pt-br|caixas de som]], [[Jetpack/pt-br|mochilas à jato]], [[Hairdryer/pt-br|secadores de cabelo]] e [[Laser pointer/pt-br|apontadores laser]] são recarregáveis por esse método.
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
<span id="Secondary_monitors"></span>
=== Monitores secundários ===

Tem quatro monitores além do monitor principal.

O monitor da direita mostra uma câmera apontada para a popa da nave. Ela pode ser usada para identificar ameaças que podem estar vindo até a nave, incluindo a [[Ghost Girl/pt-br|Garota Fantasma]].

O monitor superior direito mostra o interior da nave, em uma baixíssima resolução, servindo para uma função cosmética.

Tem mais dois monitores acima do monitor principal - o da esquerda mostra a meta des funcionáries e o outro mostra os dias restantes para o prazo da meta. O monitor da meta também mostra a quantidade de dinheiro recebida das vendas em [[Gordion/pt-br|Gordion]]. O monitor de dias restantes sempre contra de três para zero, substituindo o "0" para "NOW" no último dia.
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|Os controles das portas]]
<span id="Door_controls"></span>
=== Controles das portas ===

Os controles das portas são usados para temporariamente fechar e abrir a porta de saída da nave. Eles tem dois botões e uma tela. Apertar o botão verde com uma barra vertical abre a porta e o vermelho com um círculo dentro fecha a porta. A tela é usada para mostrar por quanto tempo a porta ficará fechada. Quando a porcentagem chega a 0%, a porta abre e demora cerca de 6 segundos para recarregar de volta até 100%. Se fechá-la com 100%, a porta ficará fechada por volta de 30 segundos. Também tem um pequeno monitor acima dos controles mostrando o que está  acontecendo do outro lado da porta.

É útil para não deixar [[Eyeless Dog/pt-br|Cães Cegos]] e [[Masks (enemy)/pt-br|Mascarades]] fora da nave por um tempo e para prevenir os Cães Cegos de serem alertados quando alguém conversa ou solta itens na nave.

<span id="Light_switch"></span>
=== Interruptor ===

O interruptor liga e desliga as luzes. Isso é útil caso um raio caia na nave, o que forçará as luzes a se desligarem, e ê funcionárie precisará ligar elas novamente manualmente. Um [[Remote/pt-br|Controle remoto]] também pode ser usado para ligar e desligar as luzes.

Se ume funcionárie  comprou as [[Cozy lights/pt-br|luzes aconchegantes]] e/ou a [[Disco ball/pt-br|bola de disco]], elas serão ativadas caso as luzes estejam desligadas.
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|O Imã (caixa laranja) é a alavanca (círculo azul)]]
<span id="Magnet"></span>
=== Imã ===

Do lado de fora da nave, no lado sem passarela, há um imã que acopla o [[Cruiser/pt-br|Company Cruiser]] à nave para que se possa decolar com ele. Ele é ligado e desligado com uma alavanca do no canto de fora da nave, estando no fim da passarela e do lado oposto da porta da nave. Quando o Cruiser está acoplado nada mais pode tirá-lo de lá, exceto quando se desliga o imã.

<span id="Decorations"></span>
=== Decorações ===

As três decorações inicias são um armário vermelho, um  fichario e um beliche. Decorações adicionais podem ser compradas na [[Store/pt-br|Loja]] e colocadas dentro da nave. O armário pode ser usado como armazém para ferramentas ou sucata, o fichario e beliche são apenas cosméticos (mas podem ser usados para colocar ferramentas e sucata em cima deles).

Móveis "armazenados" são realmente movidos para muito longe do mapa, para o ponto fixo (800, -100, 0).

<span id="Store_upgrades"></span>
=== Melhorias na loja ===

Mais informações sobre as melhorias podem ser vistas no artigo da [[Store/pt-br|loja]].

== Bugs ==

<span id="Clipping"></span>
=== Atravessia ===

Ê funcionárie consegue atravessar  a nave com a ajuda do beliche ou armário.{{cite YouTube|video-id=eOe3xhf9NpY|title=How to Clip through the Ship's Ceiling and Floor in Lethal Company(v45)|creator=Alt 1}}

Nota que alguns desses bugs são inconsistentes no modo multiplayer, e fazer eles no espaço teleportará ê funcionárie para dentro da nave se elu conseguir.

Com o armário, pressione "B" nele e fique dentro dele (as portas ainda terão colisão), pule e pressione "E" ou gire o mouse para cancelar a seleção, você deveria estar em cima dele, parcialmente no teto, pular de novo te colocará para fora. Essa é a opção mais fácil para atravessar o teto da nave enquanto ela estiver pousando, já que você não consegue mover itens enquanto a nave se move, mas é inconsistente no multiplayer, faça certeza de testar antes de pousar, pois se feito errado pode ter deixar presê e precisar de outra pessoa para te resgatar.

Com o beliche, pressione "B" para ficar dentro dele, pule e pressione "E" ou gire o mouse para atravessar no teto da nave. Diferente do armário, esse método é consistente, mas é muito mais difícil (ou até mesmo impossível) de fazê-lo enquanto a nave está pousando.

Pressionar "E" ou rodar o mouse com o beliche sem pular fará com que você ou atravesse o chão ou a parede. No singleplayer você consistentemente atravessará o chão, já no multiplayer é inconsistente e você pode ficar presê.

<span id="Corner_spot"></span>
=== Canto ===

O canto esquerdo (enquanto se vira para a alavanca de freio) é considerado "fora da nave", ou seja, estar ali e gritar pode funcionar como uma [[Loud horn/pt-br|buzina alta]] falsa, já que os Cães Cegos vão correr para fora da nave, onde aquele canto está - tenha cuidado enquanto faz isso, porque se estiver próxime demais da parede, os Cães Cegos podem atacar através dela.

Isso também pode ser usado como um lugar seguro; fazendo com que o terminal bloqueie completamente o canto e ficar em silêncio fará com que os Cães Cegos sejam incapazes de matar ê funcionárie.

Também serve como um lugar seguro para a Raposa Raptora e um jeito fácil de matá-la. Coloque o fichario no canto e fique em cima dele quando a Raposa Raptora tentar chegar na nave. Ela será atraída para a parede externa e você será capaz de de agachar e bater nela.

'''Корабль с Автопилотом''' - место, где игроки начинают игру в ''Lethal Company''. Корабль является базой операций и в целом самой безопасной локацией.Тем не менее, некоторые сущности могут проникнуть на корабль: [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Безглазые псы]], [[Baboon Hawk/ru|Бабуиновые Ястребы]], [[Kidnapper Fox/ru|Лис-похититель]], [[Maneater/ru|Людоед]], [[Ghost Girl/ru|Девочка-призрак]], [[Circuit Bees/ru|Пчелиный рой]] и [[Masks (Enemy)/ru|Одержимые]].
