Дверь находится в корме (задней части) корабля, а мониторы в передней части.<ref group="note">
Это подтверждается строкой в [[clipboard|планшете с учебным пособием]]: <q>[...] электрическая катушка находится в правой [''прямо'' астролябию[sic]] стене корабля [...]</q></ref>. Так, корабль взлетает вперёд и приземляется задом.

<span id="Included_utilities"></span>
== Утилиты ==

Изначально на корабле есть только: основной монитор, терминал, рычаг взлёта/посадки, катушка, 4 вторичных монитора, панель управления дверьми, выключатель света, шкаф с полками, картотека и четырёхъярусная кровать.

<span id="Main_monitor"></span>
=== Основной монитор === 

Экран даёт упрощённый вид сверху на наблюдаемого сотрудника и его окрестности вместо со следующими символами и маркерами, обозначающими разные вещи:
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|Примеры размеров красных кружков (т.и.к. размер сигнала радара) разных сущностей.]]
* Синий кружок: Игроки. Конус перед ними - их зона видимости (ещё им отмечаются [[Radar-booster/ru|Радарные усилители]], а также [[Masked/ru|Одержимые]], в том числе те, в которых превратились игроки - прим. переводчика).
* Жёлто-зелёный треугольник: Лут, который можно продать.
* Голубая линия: Пожарный выход (маленькая линия) или главный вход (огромная линия).
* Голубая линия с жёлтыми точками: дверь, запертая на ключ.
* Красный кружок: Сущность поблизости. Разные размеры означают разных сущностей.
* Тусклый маленький красный кружок: Мина.
* Красный треугольник: Турель. Красный конус перед ней - её зона видимости (не отражает действительную дальность её видимости - прим. переводчика).
* Красная линия: Вентиляция.
* Буква с цифрой: Код, принадлежащий защитной двери или ловушке. Можно ввести в терминал, чтобы открыть/закрыть дверь или временно отключить ловушки.

Белая кнопка слева от монитора переключает наблюдение между игроками (и радарными усилителями). Красная кнопка чуть ниже отключает-включает монитор.

Также монитор можно увидеть на терминале с помощью команды "view monitor", а сменять наблюдаемый объект можно с помощью команды "switch".

Перед посадкой на луну основной монитор показывает информацию о текущей луне. В зависимости от длинны текста может найтись место и для текущих погодных условий на поверхности луны если таковые есть.

<span id="Brake_lever"></span>
=== <span id="Ship_control_lever"></span> Рычаг взлёта/посадки ===

'''Рычаг взлёта/посадки''' позволяет сажать корабль на луну, на орбите которой он находится, а также взлетать с луны обратно на орбиту, заранее заканчивая день.

Хотя сотрудники чаще садятся на [[Gordion/ru|Gordion]] на финальный (нулевой) день чтобы продать лут повыгоднее и достичь квоты, сесть на неё можно и раньше. Если при посадке на Gordion ничего не было продано, счётчик дней до выполнения квоты не уменьшится. Также на последнем дне возможно сесть не на Gordion, что приведёт к недостижению квоты вовремя и дисциплинарным мерам при последующем взлёте.

<span id="Terminal"></span>
=== Терминал ===

Компьютерный терминал имеет разнообразный функционал, включая навигацию, закупки в магазине и просмотр записей о сущностях в Бестиарии.

Команды ''не'' чувствительны к регистру. Некоторые команды зависят только от первых треёх букв; например команды "ada", "adasdfghj", "adama" и т.д. будут восприняты, как команда "adamance" На терминале можно использовать следующие команды:
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Ввод !! Вывод
|-
|'''HELP'''
|Показывает первую страницу списка команд.
|-
|'''OTHER'''
|Показывает вторую страницу списка команд.
|-
|'''MOONS'''
|Позволяет игрокам просматривать список [[Moons/ru|лун]] для приземления, а также текущую погоду на них.
|-
|'''STORE'''
|Открывает [[Store/ru|Магазин]].
|-
|'''BESTIARY'''
|Открывает [[Bestiary|Бестиарий]].
|-
|'''STORAGE'''
|Доступ к размещаемым объектам в хранилище.
|-
|'''EJECT'''
|Выбрасывает всех в космос, используется для преждевременного перезапуска (команду может ввести только хост).
|-
|'''VIEW MONITOR'''
|Переключает показ радара с основного монитора на терминале.
|-
|'''SWITCH [Player name]'''
|Сменяет вид на радаре между игроками и радарными усилителями. Если имя цели не указано, переходит к следующей по порядку.
|-
|'''PING [Radar booster name]'''
|Проигрывает звук с определённого радарного усилителя.
|-
|'''FLASH [Radar booster name]'''
|Издаёт вспышку с радарного усилителя, оглушая противников и слепя смотрящих на неё сотрудников.
|-
|'''TRANSMIT [message]'''
|Передаёт всем на экран сообщение если был куплен [[Signal Translator|Транслятор сигнала]].
|-
|'''SCAN'''
|Выдаёт количество и общую стоимость лута за пределами корабля.
|-
|'''SIGURD'''
|Открывает [[Sigurd Logs/ru|Записи Сигурда]].
|}
Можно открыть чат с помощью /, написать туда желаемую команду, нажать Shift+A чтобы выделить всё и Ctrl+C/Ctrl+X чтобы скопировать команду, после чего её можно будет быстро вставлять в монитор с помощью Ctrl+V.
[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|Катушка]]
<span id="Coil"></span>
=== Катушка ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}
</div>

катушку можно использовать, чтобы зарядить зарядить предметы, работающие от батареек, позволяя продлить использование предмета или использовать его по новой если тот сел. [[Walkie-Talkie|Рации]], [[Flashlight/ru|Фонарики]], [[Pro-Flashlight|Про-Фонарики]]s, [[Zap Gun/ru|Электропушки]], [[Boombox/ru|Бумбоксы]], [[Jetpack|Ракетные ранцы]], [[Hairdryer|Фены]] и [[Laser Pointer|Лазерные указки]] перезаряжаются этим методом.
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
<span id="Secondary_monitors"></span>
=== Вторичные мониторы ===

Помимо основного монитора есть ещё четыре.

Самый правый монитор показывает камеру, направленную за корабль. Показывает угрозы, подходящие сзади к кораблю, включая [[Ghost Girl/ru|Девочку-призрака]].

Самый правый верхний монитор показывает низкокачественный вид с камеры внутри корабля, потому в основном исключительно косметический.

Далее есть 2 монитора над основным монитором - левый показывает квоты, а правый - количество дней, оставшихся до её выполнения. Монитор квоты также показывает общую ценность уже проданного в здании компании на [[Gordion/ru|Gordion]] лута. Монитор количества дней всегда отсчитывает от трёх дней, показывая сообщение "NOW" ("СЕЙЧАС") как только корабль улетает с луны в последний день.
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|панель управления дверьми]]
<span id="Door_controls"></span>
=== Панель управления дверьми ===

Панель управления дверьми используется для отпирания и временного запирания выходной двери корабля. Имеет две кнопки и дисплей. Нажатие на зелёную кнопку с вертикальной чертой отпирает дверь, нажатие на красную с кругом - запирает. На дисплее показывается процентный показатель времени, которое дверь ещё будет оставаться запертой. Когда показатель достигает 0%, дверь открывается, после чего на возвращение показателя от 0% к 100% уйдёт примерно 6 секунд. При показателе в 100% дверь будет оставаться запертой примерно 30 секунд. Над дисплеем также есть маленький монитор, показывающий, что происходит снаружи дверей.

Двери полезны в удержании [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепых Псов]] и [[Masks (Enemy)/ru|Одержимых]] снаружи корабля, а также не позволяют Слепым Псам слышать разговоры и звуки падающих вещей, доносящихся изнутри корабля.

<span id="Light_switch"></span>
=== Выключатель света ===

Выключатель света включает и выключает свет. Полезен, когда молния ударяет в корабль, так как её удар в корабль выключает на корабле свет. Также для переключения света можно использовать [[Remote|Пульт]].

Если сотрудник купил [[Cozy Lights|Уютные Лампочки]] и/или [[disco ball|Диско Шар]], те сразу включатся, если будет выключен основной свет.
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|Магнит (оранжевый прямоугольник) и рычаг (синий круг)]]
<span id="Magnet"></span>
=== Магнит ===

Снаружи корабля на месте пробела, где нет внешней палубы, находится магнит, удерживающий у корабля Крузер Компании, чтобы тот можно было взять с собой на орбиту. Он переключается рычагом, находящемся на внешнем углу корабля, доступ к которому можно получить с внешней палубы с края, противоположного двери. Как только Крузер примагничен - ничто, кроме выключения магнита, не сможет его оторвать.

<span id="Decorations"></span>
=== Декор ===

Три начальных декоративных предмета на корабле - красный шкаф с полками, картотека и многоярусная кровать. Новый декор можно купить в [[Store/ru|Магазине]] и разместить в корабле. В шкафу можно хранить инструменты и лут, а картотека и кровать в основном косметические (хотя на них можно скинуть предметы и использовать для разных тактик).

Декор, "убранный в хранилище", на самом деле перемещается далеко за карту в точку 800, -100, 0.

<span id="Store_upgrades"></span>
=== Улучшения в магазине ===

Чтобы узнать больше об улучшениях, которые можно купить для корабля, смотри страницу [[Store/ru|Магазин]].

<span id="Bugs"></span>
== Баги ==

<span id="Clipping"></span>
=== Прохождение сквозь стены ===

Можно пройти сквозь стену с помощью кровати или шкафа.{{cite YouTube|video-id=eOe3xhf9NpY|title=How to Clip through the Ship's Ceiling and Floor in Lethal Company(v45)|creator=Alt 1}}

Учитывайте, что некоторые из способов ненадёжны в мультиплеере, а успешное их использование на орбите приведёт к телепортации сотрудника обратно внутрь.

Можно забраться на шкаф, нажав B, пройдя внутрь (у дверец шкафа всё ещё будет коллизия), прыгнув и нажав E или покрутив колёсиков мыши, после чего вы будете частично в потолке, а с последующим прыжком окажетесь снаружи. Это самый лёгкий способ пройти через потолок во время приземления, так как при движении корабля нельзя двигать предметы, но не надёжен в мультиплеере. Если не прыгнуть при приземлении, можно застрять в потолке, из-за чего, чтобы выбраться, вам понадобится помощь.

В случае кроватей, нажатие B, прохождение внутрь, прыжок и нажатие E/прокрутка колёсика мыши, в отличии от шкафа, перенесёт вас сразу на крышу. Этот способ надёжен, но его сложнее (или даже невозможно) исполнить во время приземления.

Нажатие на E/прокручивание колёсика мыши при нахождении внутри кровати без совершения прыжка постоянно будет проталкивать вас под пол в одиночной игре и через пол или стену, с риском застрять, в мультиплеере.

<span id="Corner_spot"></span>
=== Позиция в углу ===

Левый угол рядом с рычагом считается "внешней территорией", означая, что если встать туда и начать издавать громкие звуки, можно имитировать функционал громкого гудка, так как псы устремятся наружу к внешней стене угла. При этом следует быть аккуратным, так как по этой же причине псы снаружи могут съесть сотрудника, забившегося в этот угол.

Эту же позицию можно наоборот использовать, как безопасную позицию; установив терминал под таким углом и в такую позицию, что он начинает блокировать доступ к углу и оставаясь предельно тихим можно избежать смерти от пробравшихся внутрь псов.

Этот угол также можно использовать как безопасное укрытие против Лиса-похитителя, а также для того, чтобы легко его убить. Для этого нужно установить в угол картотеку, затем запрыгнуть на нее уперевшись в угол когда Лис попытается прокрасться в корабль. В следствие этого Лис будет выманен наружу и можно будет пригнувшись убить его сквозь стену.

<span id="Included_utilities"></span>
== 设备 ==

默认情况下，飞船包含一个主显示器、一台终端、一个飞船制动杆、一个充电站、四个副显示器、舱门控制器、灯光开关、一个晾衣架、一个储物柜和一个多层床。

<span id="Main_monitor"></span>
=== 主监视器 === 

在屏幕上，员工可以一个简单的俯视角视图来观察选中的员工。显示器上的以下几个符号代表着不同的事物：
[[File:EntityRadarPipSizes.png|thumb|300px|不同实体的红圈大小（又称雷达吸点大小）示例]]
* 蓝色圆圈：玩家。前方的扇形代表着该玩家的视野。
* 黄/绿色三角形：可出售的废料。
* 蓝色线条：消防出口（较细）或者主要入口（较粗）。
* 带有黄点的蓝色线条：需要钥匙才能打开的门。
* 红色圆圈：附近的实体，不同的圆圈大小代表不同的实体。不过圆圈的行为和速度（以及玩家对它的反应）才是判断其是何种实体的关键。
* 大群小灰点：[[Circuit Bees|电路蜂群]]（室外）或[[Mask Hornets|管家蜜蜂]]（室内）。
* 红色正方形/三角形：分别代表地雷和炮台。
* 红色线条：通风口。
* 字母-数字组合：在对应位置上的对应事物的代码。这个代码可以代表安全门、地雷、炮台或尖刺陷阱。你可以在终端上输入对应代码来开启/关闭安全门，或者暂时停用炮台、地雷和尖刺陷阱。

监视器左侧白色的按钮能切换至不同玩家的视角。红色的按钮可以打开或关闭主监视器。

可以在终端中输入“VIEW MONITOR”指令来查看主监视器。输入“SWITCH”可以切换监视目标。

在降落到星球上之前，主监视器会显示一段关于此星球的文本。取决于文本的长度，它可能会显示该星球当前的气候情况。

<span id="Brake_lever"></span>
=== <span id="Ship_control_lever"></span>飞船制动杆 ===

飞船制动杆可让飞船往返于环绕轨道和星球表面之间。拉下控制杆后，即使还有玩家在飞船外部行动，飞船仍会照常起飞。同时建议在每次降落前确认所环绕星球的天气情况。

通常情况下员工都只在最后一天（显示剩余 0 天时）才会去 Gordion 售卖废料以达到最大收益，但员工也可以提早降落卖货。如果降落在 Gordion 却没有售卖任何物品，期限天数计数器不会减少。员工也可以在最后一天降落到其它普通星球上，不过起飞后会直接判定为未达成主要目标，紧接着执行违纪处分程序。

<span id="Terminal"></span>
=== 终端 ===

电脑终端有许多用途，包括导航飞船，购物，以及查看生物图鉴。

指令'''不区分大小写'''。部分指令只需输入前 3 个字母，例如“ada”“adasdfghj”“adama”等都会被识别为命令“adamance”。以下是终端中的可用命令：
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! 输入 !! 结果
|-
|'''HELP'''
|显示指令列表的第一页。
|-
|'''OTHER'''
|显示指令列表的第二页。
|-
|'''MOONS'''
|能让员工了解不同[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]的天气情况，并选择要降落的星球。
|-
|'''STORE'''
|打开[[Store/zh-cn|商店]]。
|-
|'''BESTIARY'''
|打开[[Bestiary|生物图鉴]]。
|-
|'''STORAGE'''
|查看储存起来的物品。
|-
|'''EJECT'''
|温和地开除飞船中的员工，用于重置游戏（该命令只能由主机使用）。
|-
|'''VIEW MONITOR'''
|打开/关闭主监视器视角。
|-
|'''SWITCH [Player name]'''
|切换主监视器至指定玩家。若不指定玩家，将会按顺序轮换监视目标。
|-
|'''PING [Radar booster name]'''
|让指定的雷达增幅器播放一次声音。
|-
|'''FLASH [Radar booster name]'''
|让指定的雷达增幅器发出闪光，可眩晕敌人。
|-
|'''TRANSMIT [message]'''
|如果购买了[[Signal Translator|信号转换器]]，在所有人的屏幕上显示一段消息。
|-
|'''SCAN'''
|查看当前星球上剩余的物品的数量。
|-
|'''SIGURD'''
|打开 [[Sigurd Logs/zh-cn|Sigurd 的日志]]。
|}
按下 / 可以打开聊天框，输入你想快速输入的指令，按下 Ctrl+A 选择全部，再按 Ctrl+C 拷贝，然后就可以用 Ctrl+V 粘贴出那个指令。
[[File:Ship coil.png|thumb|150px|线圈长这样]]
<span id="Coil"></span>
=== 线圈 ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{redirect|Coil|the interior entity|Coil-head}}
</div>

线圈可为使用电池供电的物品充电，使其在电量耗尽后能重新运作。[[Walkie-Talkie|对讲机]]、[[Flashlight/zh-cn|手电筒]]、[[Pro-Flashlight|Pro手电筒]]、[[Zap Gun|电击枪]]、[[Boombox/zh-cn|音响]]、[[Jetpack|喷气背包]]、[[Hairdryer|电吹风]]和[[Laser Pointer|激光指示器]]都可在此充电。
{{clear}}[[File:Ship monitors.png|thumb|250px]]
<span id="Secondary_monitors"></span>
=== 副监视器 ===

在主监视器外有四个副监视器。

最右侧的监视器会显示对准飞船尾部的摄像机画面，可用于查看即将靠近飞船的威胁。[[Ghost Girl/zh-cn|幽灵小女孩]]也在监视器中可见。

右上角的监视器显示的舱内画面分辨率非常低，因此更多只是作为装饰。

在主监视器上方有两个监视器——最左边显示目标配额，另一个显示距离配额到期还有多少天。配额监视器还会显示在[[Gordion/zh-cn|Gordion]]的公司大楼销售后的总销售额。显示配额到期的监视器总是从 3 开始倒数，而在最后一天从星球上起飞之后会显示“现在”(NOW)。
{{clear}}[[File:Door_Controls.png|thumb|300px|舱门控制器长这样]]
<span id="Door_controls"></span>
=== 舱门控制器 ===

舱门控制器可用于打开或是暂时关闭飞船的出口。其上有两个按钮与一面显示屏。按下画有竖线的绿色按钮开门，画有圆圈的红色按钮关门。显示屏指示了舱门还可保持多长时间的关闭，当显示值为 0% 舱门将强制开启。从 0% 恢复到 100% 大约需要开门 6 秒，而于 100% 时关门，舱门则可以保持 30 秒左右的关闭。舱门控制器上方还有一台小监视器可用于观察门外的情况。

它可以用来将[[无眼狗]]和[[面具(敌人)]]暂时拒之船外，并防止在船内说话或丢弃物品造成的声响引起警戒。

<span id="Light_switch"></span>
=== 照明开关 ===

照明开关能将电灯打开或关上。这在闪电击中飞船时很有用，闪电会迫使电灯关闭，因此员工得手动重新打开它们。此外，[[遥控器]]也同样可以开关电灯。

如果员工购买了 [[Cozy Lights]] 和/或 [[disco ball]]，这些灯将在照明开关关闭时亮起
{{clear}}[[File:Ship magnet and lever.png|thumb|200px|磁铁（橙框）和开关拉杆（蓝圈）长这样]]
<span id="Magnet"></span>
=== 磁铁 ===

在飞船外侧无栏杆的一侧装有一块磁铁，可将公司巡洋舰吸附在飞船上，以便将其带入轨道。磁铁由飞船外侧角落处的一根控制杆进行开关操作，需站在与舱门相对一端的栏杆上才能触及。一旦巡洋舰被吸附固定，除再次关闭磁铁外，任何方式都无法使其脱离。

<span id="Decorations"></span>
=== 装饰品 ===

初始的三件装饰为：一个红色储物柜、一个文件柜和一张双层床。更多装饰可从[[Store|商店]]购买并放置在飞船内部。
储物柜可用于存放工具或废料物品，而文件柜和双层床主要起装饰作用（不过也可以在其顶部放置工具和废料）。

被“存入储物”的家具实际上会被移到地图外很远的固定坐标点(800, -100, 0)处。

<span id="Store_upgrades"></span>
=== 商店升级 ===

有关商店升级的更多信息，可在[[Store|商店]]页面查看。

<span id="Bugs"></span>
== 漏洞 ==

<span id="Clipping"></span>
=== 穿模 ===

员工可以借助双层床或储物柜卡模穿透飞船。

需要注意的是，这些方法在多人游戏下并不一定有效，且如果员工在飞船仍位于太空时成功卡了出去，游戏会把他传送回来。

使用储物柜卡模的方法：
对准储物柜按B进入内部（柜门仍会保留碰撞判定），跳跃并按E或滚动滚轮取消放置，你就会出现在柜子顶部，部分身体卡入天花板中。再次跳跃即可穿出飞船外部。
这种方法更适合卡天花板，因为落地后可以稳定站着。飞船移动时无法移动物体，因此该方法在多人模式中效果不稳定。务必先在太空测试，再到卫星上使用。如果不跳跃，可能会被卡在柜子内部，需要其他玩家帮忙才能脱困。

使用双层床卡模：
按 B 进入床内，跳跃并按E 或滚动滚轮，即可卡到飞船顶部。
与储物柜不同，这个方法成功率稳定，但在着陆时操作难度大得多（甚至可能无法实现）。

使用双层床时，不跳跃直接按E或滚动滚轮，会让你穿透地板或墙壁。
单人模式下基本都会穿透地板，多人模式则不稳定，还可能被卡住。

<span id="Corner_spot"></span>
墙角漏洞点

站在左侧墙角（需面向飞船制动杆）会被游戏视作处在室外，因此，在此处大声哔哔能起到类似于响亮喇叭（飞船升级）的作用，周围的无眼狗将冲向离此处最接近的船外的位置，注意把控距离，如果站得太靠近墙，狗可能会透过墙咬到你。

这也可以当作一个安全点位使用：
将终端调整角度，使其完全挡住从行走路径进入该角落的通道，保持完全静音即可让无眼狗无法击杀员工。

这个角落还可以用作对抗劫持狐狸的安全点位，同时也是轻松击杀它的方法。将文件柜放在角落，当狐狸试图偷偷溜上飞船时，站在柜子顶部紧贴角落。它会被吸引到外墙位置，你就可以蹲下攻击它。

{{navbox furniture}}

######## Ship Controls
{{merge|Ship}}
=== Control Lever ===
The '''Control Lever''' is found furthest from the door in [[Ship|The Ship]]. Interacting with it will bring [[Ship|The Ship]] onto or off of a [[:Category:Moons|Moon]].

=== Monitor System ===
The '''Monitor System''' is found above The '''Control Lever'''. While you can use this, it is recommended to use The '''[[Computer Terminal]]''' for a better picture (and access to other commands). During missions, the '''Monitor System''' tracks all employee locations. The '''Red Button''' toggles the '''Monitor System''' on and off; the '''Grey Button''' cycles through each employee.

=== Computer Terminal ===
The '''[[Computer Terminal]]''' can also view co workers with the command ''"View Monitor"'' and has access to 3 additional [[Computer Terminal#Terminal Commands|Commands]] to aid the team. When a co worker is near a locked door (cyan door with 2 yellow dots at the edge), a landmine (a darker red circle), or a turret, (red rectangle) you can enter a two-character code ID (a letter followed by a number) displayed on the screen to open and close the door, or disable the turret or mine for 5 seconds.

'''Blue''' dots represent employees, '''Red''' dots represent threats, '''Green-Yellow''' dots represent [[scrap]], and '''Blue-Cyan''' lines represent doors, entrances, and vents.

This is a powerful tool your team should consider using. 

=== Strategy ===
A common strategy is to leave a ''"Ship Operator"'' behind with a [[Walkie-talkie]] who can inform the team inside the building of [[Scrap]], '''[[Entities|Danger]]''', '''[[:Category:Traps|Traps]]''', or '''Exits'''. The ''"Ship Operator"'' can easily check the time, keeping the team informed on when to leave.

######## Shotgun

<!--T:2-->
The '''Shotgun''' is a [[scrap]] item that also functions as a weapon. It does not generate naturally, and is instead only wielded and dropped by [[Nutcracker]]s, along with however many [[Ammo|shells]] the Nutcracker had in the shotgun when it died, with 2 extra shells dropped alongside it. It has a fixed sell value of {{credits|60}} regardless of how many shells are loaded.

== Mechanics == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
When fired, the Shotgun computes two hitscans{{cite YouTube|video-id=wdlQYrd3dio|title=Lethal Company: Shotguns, Shovels and Knives|creator=alter ego|start-timestamp=5:08}}
<!-- Fandom has screenshots from that video along the right side of the page; not a bad idea -->
to work out damage dealt to [[entities]], and separately to employees:
* Entities that are inside an ellipsoid (stretched ball) area around and in front of the shotgun will be dealt 5 or 3 damage at close range, or 2 damage at mid range. The distance at which a shot will do no damage is fairly close, about the length of the [[Cruiser]].
* Employees who are inside a cone-shaped area emanating forward from the barrels will be dealt 100 [[damage]] (insta-kill) at close or mid range, or at farther ranges, 40, 20, or no damage. This hitbox applies whether the gun is fired by a [[Nutcracker]] or by a fellow employee.<!-- presumably the misfire too; does the misfire hit entities as well? -->
* Again, these are ''hitscans'', despite the visuals. Multiple entities can be damaged in a single shot and it has nothing to do with the particles. Shots are blocked by most&mdash;but not all&mdash;world geometry and objects.
** Notably, catwalks in the [[Factory]] are transparent to the shotgun.{{cite YouTube|video-id=wdlQYrd3dio|title=Lethal Company: Shotguns, Shovels and Knives|creator=alter ego|start-timestamp=6:28}}
** The hitscan doesn't take crouching into consideration. That is to say, crouching won't make the shot less likely to hit you, and it won't reduce the damage you take, unless of course it's to duck your head behind something solid.

<!--T:6-->
It has 3 unique controls:
* Pressing {{keybind|Item Secondary use}} will turn the safety on and off, stopping the gun from accidentally firing.
* Pressing {{keybind|Item primary use}} will cause it to fire one of the two shells.
* Pressing {{keybind|Item Tertiary use}} will cause it to load a shell from the inventory into the shotgun if one is there, with a maximum of 2 shells per shotgun.

<!--T:16-->
If you meet the conditions to reload and you press {{keybind|Item Tertiary use}}, a reload animation begins playing.
The animation is visible and audible to fellow employees, but not to entities,{{check}} and you can't fire until it's finished. But you can cancel it.
When the animation is nearly done, the leftmost [[Ammo]] from your inventory is consumed and the number of shells in the Shotgun is increased,
then the animation finishes (during which you still can't fire). Ammo will NOT be taken from a worn [[Belt bag]], nor the ground.

<!--T:17-->
There's no visual indication of whether the Shotgun is loaded, but you can diagnose it with sound cues:
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Sound from pressing<br>{{keybind|Item Tertiary use|short=y}}<br>with no Ammo on hand, and 
! sound from pressing<br>{{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}}<br>with the safety on !! means
|-
| [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]] || [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]]
! No shells left
|-
| [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]] || [[File:ShotgunSafetyOn.ogg]]
! 1 shell left
|-
| (silent) || [[File:ShotgunSafetyOn.ogg]]
! 2 shells left
|}
Or you could just grab [[Ammo]] and try loading it.

<!--T:8-->
It is technically a scrap item, meaning if all employees die, it will disappear from the ship.
While it appears that you hold it with both hands, it does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.

<!--T:9-->
Dropping a loaded shotgun with the safety OFF has a 5% chance of causing a shot to be fired, potentially killing the person who stepped on it/dropped it and others within the line of fire. When such a shotgun is in the world or a player's hands (but not when in inventory), it also has a 4% chance of misfiring every 37.15 seconds on average. (The timer is reset to  a random number between 28 and 50 each check, with a 5% chance of it immediately checking again after 2 seconds instead.)

<!--T:11-->
Bug: Sometimes the shotgun will do no damage to enemies. If you are in a situation where the shotgun should've killed an enemy and it didn't, shooting the second shot will likely lead to the same result. Try repositioning the enemy to kill them, as the game might think the shot is being blocked by something.

######## Shotgun/en
{{topicon Fandom|Double-barrel}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=No, but see info on misfires
|audible=When fired
|force-show-conductive=y
|primary-use=<q>Fire</q>
|secondary-use=<q>Turn safety [on/off]</q>
|tertiary-use=<q>Reload</q>
|inspectable=<!--no-->
}}
The '''Shotgun''' is a [[scrap]] item that also functions as a weapon. It does not generate naturally, and is instead only wielded and dropped by [[Nutcracker]]s, along with however many [[Ammo|shells]] the Nutcracker had in the shotgun when it died, with 2 extra shells dropped alongside it. It has a fixed sell value of {{credits|60}} regardless of how many shells are loaded.

== Mechanics ==

When fired, the Shotgun computes two hitscans{{cite YouTube|video-id=wdlQYrd3dio|title=Lethal Company: Shotguns, Shovels and Knives|creator=alter ego|start-timestamp=5:08}}
<!-- Fandom has screenshots from that video along the right side of the page; not a bad idea -->
to work out damage dealt to [[entities]], and separately to employees:
* Entities that are inside an ellipsoid (stretched ball) area around and in front of the shotgun will be dealt 5 or 3 damage at close range, or 2 damage at mid range. The distance at which a shot will do no damage is fairly close, about the length of the [[Cruiser]].
* Employees who are inside a cone-shaped area emanating forward from the barrels will be dealt 100 [[damage]] (insta-kill) at close or mid range, or at farther ranges, 40, 20, or no damage. This hitbox applies whether the gun is fired by a [[Nutcracker]] or by a fellow employee.<!-- presumably the misfire too; does the misfire hit entities as well? -->
* Again, these are ''hitscans'', despite the visuals. Multiple entities can be damaged in a single shot and it has nothing to do with the particles. Shots are blocked by most&mdash;but not all&mdash;world geometry and objects.
** Notably, catwalks in the [[Factory]] are transparent to the shotgun.{{cite YouTube|video-id=wdlQYrd3dio|title=Lethal Company: Shotguns, Shovels and Knives|creator=alter ego|start-timestamp=6:28}}
** The hitscan doesn't take crouching into consideration. That is to say, crouching won't make the shot less likely to hit you, and it won't reduce the damage you take, unless of course it's to duck your head behind something solid.

It has 3 unique controls:
* Pressing {{keybind|Item Secondary use}} will turn the safety on and off, stopping the gun from accidentally firing.
* Pressing {{keybind|Item primary use}} will cause it to fire one of the two shells.
* Pressing {{keybind|Item Tertiary use}} will cause it to load a shell from the inventory into the shotgun if one is there, with a maximum of 2 shells per shotgun.

If you meet the conditions to reload and you press {{keybind|Item Tertiary use}}, a reload animation begins playing.
The animation is visible and audible to fellow employees, but not to entities,{{check}} and you can't fire until it's finished. But you can cancel it.
When the animation is nearly done, the leftmost [[Ammo]] from your inventory is consumed and the number of shells in the Shotgun is increased,
then the animation finishes (during which you still can't fire). Ammo will NOT be taken from a worn [[Belt bag]], nor the ground.

There's no visual indication of whether the Shotgun is loaded, but you can diagnose it with sound cues:
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Sound from pressing<br>{{keybind|Item Tertiary use|short=y}}<br>with no Ammo on hand, and 
! sound from pressing<br>{{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}}<br>with the safety on !! means
|-
| [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]] || [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]]
! No shells left
|-
| [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]] || [[File:ShotgunSafetyOn.ogg]]
! 1 shell left
|-
| (silent) || [[File:ShotgunSafetyOn.ogg]]
! 2 shells left
|}
Or you could just grab [[Ammo]] and try loading it.

It is technically a scrap item, meaning if all employees die, it will disappear from the ship.
While it appears that you hold it with both hands, it does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.

Dropping a loaded shotgun with the safety OFF has a 5% chance of causing a shot to be fired, potentially killing the person who stepped on it/dropped it and others within the line of fire. When such a shotgun is in the world or a player's hands (but not when in inventory), it also has a 4% chance of misfiring every 37.15 seconds on average. (The timer is reset to  a random number between 28 and 50 each check, with a 5% chance of it immediately checking again after 2 seconds instead.)

Bug: Sometimes the shotgun will do no damage to enemies. If you are in a situation where the shotgun should've killed an enemy and it didn't, shooting the second shot will likely lead to the same result. Try repositioning the enemy to kill them, as the game might think the shot is being blocked by something.

A '''escopeta''' é um item utilizado pelo [[Nutcracker/pt-br|Quebra-Nozes]]. Ele irá soltá-la quando for morto, junta com os [[Ammo/pt-br|cartuchos]] que estavam na escopeta quando morreu e mais 2 cartuchos extras. Ela sempre vale 60 créditos.

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Mecânicas ==

Quando atirada. a escopeta calcula dois ''hitscans''{{cite YouTube|video-id=wdlQYrd3dio|title=Lethal Company: Shotguns, Shovels and Knives|creator=alter ego|start-timestamp=5:08}} para decidir o dano dado a [[entities/pt-br|entidades]] e separadamente para funcionáries:
* Entidades que estiverem dentro de uma área com o formato de um elipsoide <!-- Não tem acento --> (bola alongada) ao redor e na frente da escopeta receberão de 3 a 5 de dano se estiverem a uma curta distância, ou 2 se estiverem a uma média distância. A distância onde um tiro não dará nenhum dano é bem próxima, sendo aproximadamente o tamanho de um [[Cruiser/pt-br|Cruiser]].
* Funcionáries que estiverem dentro de uma área com o formato de um cone, que tem usa ponta nos barris, sofrerão 100 de [[damage/pt-br|dano]] (morte súbita) se estiverem a uma curta ou média distância, ou, em distâncias maiores, de 0 a 40 de dano. Essa ''hitbox'' é aplicada quando um [[Nutcracker/pt-br|Quebra-nozes]] ou ume funcionárie usam a escopeta, não havendo diferenças nos dois casos.
* Portanto, esses são ''hitscans'', mesmo com os visuais. Várias entidades podem ser danificadas com um único tiro e isso não tem nada a ver com as partículas. Tiros são bloqueados pela maioria - mas não todos - os objetos e geometria do mundo.
** É notável destacar que as passarelas, encontradas na [[Interiors/pt-br#A Fábrica|Fábrica]], são transparentes para a escopeta.{{cite YouTube|video-id=wdlQYrd3dio|title=Lethal Company: Shotguns, Shovels and Knives|creator=alter ego|start-timestamp=6:28}}
** O ''hitscan'' não leva em consideração se ê funcionárie se agachar. Ou seja, se agachar não fará com que os tiros tenham uma menor chance de te atingir e não reduzirá o dano recebido, a não ser que você se agache atrás de um objeto sólido.

Ela tem 3 controles únicos:
* Apertar {{keybind|Item Secondary use}} irá ativar/desativar o modo de segurança, impedindo que a arma atire acidentalmente.
* Apertar {{keybind|Item primary use}} (botão esquerdo do mouse) irá atirar uma das 2 balas.
* Apertar {{keybind|Item Tertiary use}} fará com que carregue um cartucho no inventário, caso haja um lá, com um máximo de 2 cartuchos por escopeta.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If you meet the conditions to reload and you press {{keybind|Item Tertiary use}}, a reload animation begins playing.
The animation is visible and audible to fellow employees, but not to entities,{{check}} and you can't fire until it's finished. But you can cancel it.
When the animation is nearly done, the leftmost [[Ammo]] from your inventory is consumed and the number of shells in the Shotgun is increased,
then the animation finishes (during which you still can't fire). Ammo will NOT be taken from a worn [[Belt bag]], nor the ground.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There's no visual indication of whether the Shotgun is loaded, but you can diagnose it with sound cues:
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Sound from pressing<br>{{keybind|Item Tertiary use|short=y}}<br>with no Ammo on hand, and 
! sound from pressing<br>{{keybind|Item primary use|short=y}}<br>with the safety on !! means
|-
| [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]] || [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]]
! No shells left
|-
| [[File:ShotgunBlastFail.ogg]] || [[File:ShotgunSafetyOn.ogg]]
! 1 shell left
|-
| (silent) || [[File:ShotgunSafetyOn.ogg]]
! 2 shells left
|}
Or you could just grab [[Ammo]] and try loading it.
</div>

Ela é tecnicamente uma [[Scrap|sucata]], então se todos ês funcionáries morrerem, ela desaparecerá da nave.
Mesmo que pareça que você a segura com as duas mãos, ela não deixa você com as [[hands full/pt-br|mãos cheias]], ou seja não é um item de duas mãos.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
É aconselhável deixar o modo de segurança DESATIVADO enquanto você estiver com a escopeta para poder atirar quando precisar; mas SEMPRE deixe o modo de segurança ATIVADO quando for soltar a arma no chão.
Andar sobre ou soltar uma escopeta carregada com o modo de segurança DESATIVADO pode fazer com que a arma atire, potencialmente matando a pessoa que pisou nela/soltou ela e outras na linha de fogo.
</div>

Bug: Algumas vezes a escopeta não dará dano nos inimigos. Se você está numa situação em que a arma deveria matar um inimigo e não funcionou, disparar pela segunda vez provavelmente irá dar no mesmo resultado. Tente mudar o inimigo de lugar para mata-lo, pois o jogo pode pensar que o tiro foi bloqueado por alguma coisa.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Дробовик - предмет, с которым ходит [[Nutcracker/ru|Щелкунчик]]. Если убить Щелкунчика, с него выпадет дробовик со всей заряженной в него на момент смерти [[Shotgun Shell|картечью]], а также ещё две картечи рядом. Стоимость варьируется между 30 и 90 кредитов.
</div>

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Дробовик наносит до 5 урона (в эквиваленте ударов лопатой) по здоровью [[entities/ru|сущностей]] вблизи, урон падает с увеличением дистанции до цели. Этого достаточно, чтобы убить почти любого противника в игре за исключением [[Eyeless Dog/ru|безглазых псов]], по которым трудно попасть.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
У него есть 3 уникальных клавиши:
* Нажатие на "Q" переключит предохранитель, при включенном предохранителе дробовик не выстрелит, если его выбросить.
* Нажатие на "ЛКМ" произведёт выстрел одной из картечей, заряженной в дробовик.
* Нажатие на "Е" зарядит одну картечь в дробовик из инвентаря, максимум 2 на дробовик.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

then the animation finishes (during which you still can't fire). Ammo will NOT be taken from a worn [[Belt bag]], nor the ground.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Технически дробовик считается лутом, а значит если все сотрудники умрут, он пропадёт с корабля.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Рекомендуется ВЫКЛЮЧАТЬ предохранитель если его кто-то берёт, чтобы всегда быть готовым выстрелить; и ВСЕГДА ВКЛЮЧАТЬ обратно предохранитель когда дробовик сбрасывается на землю. Если сбросить дробовик на землю или пройтись по нему, когда его предохранитель ВЫКЛЮЧЕН, можно спровоцировать выстрел, убивая того, кто наступил на дробовик и остальных на линии огня.
</div>

Баг: Иногда дробовик не наносит урон сущностям. Если сущность не умерла от первого выстрела, когда точно должна была, то скорее всего второй выстрел тоже её не убьёт. Следует выманить противника в другое место и потом попробовать снова, так как скорее всего игра думает, что выстрел был чем-то блокирован.

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Übersicht ==

Die '''Schaufel''' kann genutzt werden, um [[Entities/de|Kreaturen]] zu eliminieren oder [[Bunker Spider|Bunkerspinnen]]netze zu zerstören. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Schaufeln verursachen 1 Schaden. [[Stop Sign|Stoppschilder]] und [[Yield Sign|Vorfahrt gewähren Schilder]] sind in der Funktion identisch mit Schaufeln, wiegen aber viel mehr.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While it appears that you hold it with both hands, it does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.
<br>However, it is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strategie ==

Die Schaufel wird schnell zum besten Begleiter, da sie die standardmäßige Verteidigung ist. Generell ist es eine gute Strategie zurückhaltend und vorsichtig zu sein, aber manchmal kann es sich lohnen eine große Bedrohung aus dem Spiel zu nehmen.

Für einen tiefergehenden Einblick, wie die Schaufel gegen bestimmte [[Entities/de|Kreaturen]] benutzt werden kann, kann die Seite der jeweiligen Kreatur besucht werden.

== Overview ==

The '''Shovel''' can be used to eliminate [[Entities]] or destroy [[Bunker Spider]] webs. 

Shovels do 1 HP damage to entities. [[Stop sign]]s and [[Yield sign]]s are functionally identical to shovels, but are much heavier.

While it appears that you hold it with both hands, it does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.
<br>However, it is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].

== Strategy ==

The shovel will become your best friend as it is your base defense weapon.  While it is generally a good idea to not be aggressive and not be reckless, sometimes it can pay off by getting a large threat off the field.

See the [[Entities]] article for in depth usage of the shovel on each enemy.

== Trivia ==
In [[Version 73]] and earlier, the Company store's description read "For self-defense!".

== History ==

=== [[Version 47]] ===

* Made shovel collisions more consistent; you can now hit enemies around corners and nearby objects without it blocking the shovel.

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Descripción general ==

La '''Pala''' puede ser usada para eliminar [[Entities/es|Entidades]] o destruir telas de [[Bunker Spider/es|Arañas de Bunker]]. 

La pala hace 1 de daño. Las [[Stop Sign/es|Señales de Stop]] y las [[Yield Sign/es|Señales de Ceda el Paso]] son funcionalmente idénticas a las palas, Pero mucho más pesadas.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
A pesar de que parece que es sostenida con ambas manos, no cuenta como [[hands full]], así que, de cierta manera, no es un objeto que sea sostenido con ambas manos.
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estrategia ==

La pala se convertirá en tu mejor amiga ya que es tu arma de defensa básica. Si bien generalmente es una buena idea no ser agresivo ni imprudente, a veces puede dar sus frutos al sacar una gran amenaza del campo.

Mira el articulo de [[Entities/es|Entidades]] para un uso en profundidad de la pala en cada enemigo.

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Общий обзор ==

'''Лопата''' может быть использована для обезвреживания [[Entities/ru|Сущностей]] или расчистки от паутины  [[Bunker Spider/ru|Бункерного Паука]]. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Лопаты наносят 1 урон по здоровью сущностей. [[Stop Sign|Знак "STOP"]] и [[Yield Sign|Знак "YIELD"]] идентичны лопате за исключением большего веса.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While it appears that you hold it with both hands, it does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.
<br>However, it is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Лопата станет вашим лучшим другой, так как это ваш базовый метод защиты. Хотя в целом хорошей идеей будет не проявлять агрессию и не быть безбашенным, иногда избавление от большой угрозы может окупиться.

За углублённой тактикой использования лопаты против каждого противника и их количеством ХП переходи на страницу [[Entities/ru|сущностей]].

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Trivia ==
In [[Version 73]] and earlier, the Company store's description read "For self-defense!".
</div>

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Genel Bakış ==

Oyun içinde "shovel" olarak geçen '''kürek''', [[Entities/tr|Varlıklar]]'ı öldürmek veya [[Bunker Spider]]'ların ağlarını yok etmek için kullanılabilir. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kürekler 1 hasar verir. [[Stop Sign|Dur İşaretleri]] ve [[Yield Sign|Yield İşaretleri]] işlevsel olarak küreklerle aynıdır, ancak çok daha ağırdır.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While it appears that you hold it with both hands, it does not make your [[hands full]], so in that sense it is not a two-handed item.
<br>However, it is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Strateji ==

Kürek, temel savunma silahınız olduğu için en iyi arkadaşınız olacaktır.  Agresif olmamak ve pervasız davranmamak genellikle iyi bir fikir olsa da, bazen büyük bir tehdidi sahadan çıkararak işe yarayabilir.

Küreğin her düşman üzerinde derinlemesine kullanımı için [[Entities/tr|Varlıklar]] makalesine bakın.

<span id="Overview"></span>
== 概览 ==

'''铲子'''可以用来消灭[[Entities/zh-cn|实体]]或者摧毁[[Bunker Spider/zh-cn|地堡蜘蛛]]的蛛网。 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
铲子可对实体造成1点HP的伤害。[[Stop Sign|Stop标志牌]]和[[Yield Sign|Yield标志牌]]在功能上和铲子类似，但是更重。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
虽然看起来是双手持握，但并不会占用你的[[hands full|手持位已满]]，因此从这个角度来说，它并不算双手武器。
</div>

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

作为你的基础防御武器，铲子会成为你最好的朋友。尽管一般情况下，不主动出击、不鲁莽行事是个好主意；但在某些情况下，可以通过驱赶巨大威胁来获得相应的回报。

查看[[Entities/zh-cn|实体]]文章来了解铲子针对每个敌人的进阶用法。

== 冷知识 ==
在73 版本及更早版本中，公司商店对该物品的描述为：“用于自卫！”

<span id="History"></span>
== 历史 ==

* 使铲子碰撞更加一致；现在你可以击中拐角处的敌人和附近的物体，而不会挡住铲子。

######## Shower
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox Furniture
| name = Shower
| image = Furniture shower.jpg
| defaultprice = 180
| luck = 1.50%
}}
== Overview ==
'''The Shower''' is a [[:Category:Furniture|Furniture Item]] that can be purchased from the [[Computer Terminal]] in [[Ship|The Ship]]. It can be interacted with to toggle the water on or off. The sound of the shower's running water is audible to nearby employees and wildlife alike.

The shower can also be used to cure infection from a [[Cadaver Growth]] in its very early stages. For more details on infection mechanics, see its [[Cadaver Growth#Infection_phase|Mechanics]] page.

== Trivia ==
*There are a few myths in the community involving the shower's function:
**The shower is said reduce insanity and repel the [[Ghost Girl]], but this is not true.
**The shower is also said to increase the value of [[Body|corpses]] that are put in the shower, but this is also not true.

{{navbox furniture}}

######## Signal Translator
{{topicon Fandom|Signal_translator}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox Furniture
| name = Signal Translator
| image = signalTranslator.webp
| defaultprice = 255
| luck = -1.20%
}}
== Company Description ==
<blockquote>
Use the "transmit" command to broadcast a text message to all crewmates. The message must be under 10 letters.
</blockquote>

== Overview ==
The Signal Translator is a ship upgrade that can be bought at the [[Store]] for 255 credits.

This upgrade allows you to use the [[Computer Terminal]] to directly send text messages to players using the transmit command. Its position does not matter and it cannot be interacted with outside of the terminal. The signal translator emits a sound when broadcasting, this cannot be heard by [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]].

;Syntax: '''transmit''' [Message Text]

==Strategy==
As indicated by the game stating the message must be ''under'' 10 characters, it can only send '''9''' characters. Special characters are filtered out before sending, but not numbers or mathematical symbols such as +, =, < or >. This can allow for compact instructions and abbreviations to be sent, such as "4PM", "Spin=Tele", "Coil+Jack" or more.

To save more time you can set up codes with your team beforehand, such as 1 = dogs, 2 = forest keeper, 3 = masked, etc. This will put the time for a player to receive the message at a little less than 3 seconds.

== History ==

=== [[Version 45]] ===
Introduced.

{{navbox furniture}}

######## Sigurd
{{Template:Spoilers}}
{{Stub}}
{{delete|Redundant with [[Lore#Sigurd]], supported with no other responses on [[Talk:Lore]]}}
{{about|the named character|the terminal command|Sigurd Logs|the item which reveals the command|Sticky note}}

'''Sigurd''' is a former employee of the Company, who presumably was garrisoned on the ship present in-game. He is the person who wrote the majority of [[Sigurd Logs|the logs]] found as data chips on different moons that details the story of him and his crew.

As the story progresses, Sigurd slowly starts having nightmares about the company, and begins uncovering the plot about how the collected scrap is fed to a giant monster on the other side of the wall on [[Gordion]]. After [[Lore#Desmond|Desmond]] traces a call made to the Company, they discover the call recipient was not The Company Building, but was a group somewhere across the solar system, further alluding to the mystery that is The Company. He suggests going to this solar system to investigate, but is shut down by Desmond. 

Within "[[Sigurd Logs#Letter of Resignation - Oct 13|Letter of Resignation]]", Sigurd is described as "practically catatonic" following an incident with the intake vent containing human remains he saw as his own father. Days later, he returned to work and writing on the terminal with "[[Sigurd_Logs#16._Work_-_Oct_15|Work]]", claiming to be perfectly well despite refusing to speak and eat. 

It is currently unknown what happened to Sigurd after October 15th 1968, the date of Sigurd's last log.

<translate>
== Trivia == <!--T:16-->
</translate>
* <translate><!--T:78--> The dates on Sigurd's logs state the year is 1968, a year before the [[w:Apollo_11|moon landing]].</translate>
* <translate><!--T:43--> The [[#Golden planet|Golden Planet]] is possibly referencing real life planets and asteroids made of pure gold or other rare materials, such as [[w:16_Psyche|16 Psyche]].</translate>
* <translate><!--T:80--> Sigurd mentions several scrap items which don't appear in-game as of v81:</translate>
** <translate><!--T:81--> <q>frying pans and a big nail</q> in "Mummy" (Though possibly referencing [[Dust pan]]s and [[Big bolt]]s)</translate>
** <translate><!--T:82--> <q>a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps and a bundle of cords</q> in "Goodbye"</translate>
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <translate><!--T:49--> In [[#Behind The Wall|"Behind The Wall"]], Sigurd talks about a 120% sell rate, which is unseen in-game; however, after leaving Gordion, the sell rate will be 123% for a short window of time.{{check}}</translate>
** <translate><!--T:83--> The mentions of a 120% sell rate and <q>watching it like stupid stocks</q> may be an artifact of the log being written during an earlier phase of the game's development. Before the current system, the quota was hour based and the company's selling rate would fluctuate with every passing hour, including the chance to go above 100%.</translate>
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.
* In "First Log", Sigurd says that he's taking up journaling <q>to keep [himself] sane,</q> then from the later logs it seems he became insane anyway.<!--
--> Sigurd even makes a callback to that line in "Team Synergy".

== Trivia ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Das Datum in Sigurds Protokollen wird als 1968 angegeben, das Jahr vor der [https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mondlandung Mondlandung].</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Der[[#Goldener Planet - ?? Aug.|Goldene Planet]] spielt wahrscheinlich auf echte Planeten und Asteroiden an, die aus purem Gold oder anderen seltenen Materialien bestehen, wie [https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/(16)_Psyche (16) Psyche].</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Sigurd mentions several scrap items which don't appear in-game as of v81:</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>frying pans and a big nail</q> in "Mummy" (Though possibly referencing [[Dust pan]]s and [[Big bolt]]s)</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps and a bundle of cords</q> in "Goodbye"</span>
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">In [[#Behind The Wall|"Behind The Wall"]], Sigurd talks about a 120% sell rate, which is unseen in-game; however, after leaving Gordion, the sell rate will be 123% for a short window of time.{{check}}</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The mentions of a 120% sell rate and <q>watching it like stupid stocks</q> may be an artifact of the log being written during an earlier phase of the game's development. Before the current system, the quota was hour based and the company's selling rate would fluctuate with every passing hour, including the chance to go above 100%.</span>
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

'''Sigurd Logs''' are journal entries mostly written by [[Sigurd]], with some later entries being written by [[Desmond]]. These can be found in the exteriors of various [[moons]] in the form of collectable data chips.

== Logs ==

As of version 81, the game has 16 available logs.

Due to the poor keyboard quality mentioned in log [[#Mummy|"Mummy"]], this page '''kept the typos''' found in the original texts. All logs were taken directly from the game's source code.

Each log has a brief description of where it is located. For a more in-depth guide with visuals, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cocdmOAgqVc this video] can be used.

== Trivia ==
* The dates on Sigurd's logs state the year is 1968, a year before the [[w:Apollo_11|moon landing]].
* The [[#Golden planet|Golden Planet]] is possibly referencing real life planets and asteroids made of pure gold or other rare materials, such as [[w:16_Psyche|16 Psyche]].
* Sigurd mentions several scrap items which don't appear in-game as of v81:
** <q>frying pans and a big nail</q> in "Mummy" (Though possibly referencing [[Dust pan]]s and [[Big bolt]]s)
** <q>a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps and a bundle of cords</q> in "Goodbye"
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* In [[#Behind The Wall|"Behind The Wall"]], Sigurd talks about a 120% sell rate, which is unseen in-game; however, after leaving Gordion, the sell rate will be 123% for a short window of time.{{check}}
** The mentions of a 120% sell rate and <q>watching it like stupid stocks</q> may be an artifact of the log being written during an earlier phase of the game's development. Before the current system, the quota was hour based and the company's selling rate would fluctuate with every passing hour, including the chance to go above 100%.
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

== Trivia ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">La fecha en los registros de Sigurd transcurren durante el año 1968, un año antes del [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_11 aterrizaje lunar].</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">El [[#Golden planet - Aug ??|Planeta Áureo]] probablemente hace referencia a planetas y asteroides compuestos de puro oro y otros materiales raros en la vida real, como por ejemplo  [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/16_Psyche Psyche 16].</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Sigurd menciona chatarra  que no se encuentra en el juego desde la versión 73</span>
** <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy"><q>sartenes y un gran clavo</q> en "Apesta!" (Aunque puede que se esté refiriendo a [[Big Bolt|big bolts]] y [[Dust pan|dust pans]])</span>
** <q>un par de tijeras, una caja llena de sellos y un manojo de cuerdas</q> en "Adiós"
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">En [[#Sound behind the wall - Sep 4|"El sonido detrás de la pared"]], Los registros hablan de un ratio de venta del 120%, el cual no puede ser visto dentro del juego, Aunque tras abandonar Gordion, el ratio de venta será de 123% por un leve periodo de tiempo.</span>
** La mención de un ratio de venta del 120% y <q>lo ha estado mirando como si fueran las acciones de una empresa.</q> pueden ser un artefacto del registro siendo escrito en un estado temprano del desarrollo del juego. Antes del actual sistema, la cuota era horaria y el ratio de venta de la compañía cambiaba en torno a cada hora, a veces superando el 100%
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Trivia ==
</div>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The dates on Sigurd's logs state the year is 1968, a year before the [[w:Apollo_11|moon landing]].</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The [[#Golden planet|Golden Planet]] is possibly referencing real life planets and asteroids made of pure gold or other rare materials, such as [[w:16_Psyche|16 Psyche]].</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Sigurd mentions several scrap items which don't appear in-game as of v81:</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>frying pans and a big nail</q> in "Mummy" (Though possibly referencing [[Dust pan]]s and [[Big bolt]]s)</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps and a bundle of cords</q> in "Goodbye"</span>
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">In [[#Behind The Wall|"Behind The Wall"]], Sigurd talks about a 120% sell rate, which is unseen in-game; however, after leaving Gordion, the sell rate will be 123% for a short window of time.{{check}}</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The mentions of a 120% sell rate and <q>watching it like stupid stocks</q> may be an artifact of the log being written during an earlier phase of the game's development. Before the current system, the quota was hour based and the company's selling rate would fluctuate with every passing hour, including the chance to go above 100%.</span>
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

== Trivia ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">As datas nos registros de Sigurd dizem que o ano é 1968, um ano antes do [https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_11 pouso na Lua].</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">O [[#Planeta Dourado - ?? de Agosto|Planeta Dourado]] está possivelmente referenciando planetas e asteroides reais que são feitos de ouro puro, ou outros materiais raros, como o [https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/16_Psique 16 Psique].</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Sigurd mentions several scrap items which don't appear in-game as of v81:</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>frying pans and a big nail</q> in "Mummy" (Though possibly referencing [[Dust pan]]s and [[Big bolt]]s)</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><q>a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps and a bundle of cords</q> in "Goodbye"</span>
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Em [[#Um som atrás da parede - 4 de Setembro|Um som atrás da parede]], o registro fala sobre uma taxa de venda de 120%, o que não é possível no jogo, porém, depois de sair de Gordion, a taxa de venda estará em 123% por um curto período de tempo.</span>
** <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The mentions of a 120% sell rate and <q>watching it like stupid stocks</q> may be an artifact of the log being written during an earlier phase of the game's development. Before the current system, the quota was hour based and the company's selling rate would fluctuate with every passing hour, including the chance to go above 100%.</span>
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== Интересные Факты ==
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Даты в записях Сигурда гласят, что год 1968, за год до посадки на луну.</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">[[#Золотая Планета - ?? Авг|Золотая Планета]] возможно является отсылкой на настоящие планеты и астероиды, состоящие из чистого золота или других редких материалов, такие как Psyche 16.</span>
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">Сигурд упоминает некоторые предметы, не появляющиеся в игре на момент версии 64:</span>
** <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy"><q>сковородка и большой гвоздь</q> в "Тут несёт!" (Хотя возможно подразумевается [[Big Bolt|большой болт]] и [[Dust pan|совочек для пыли]])</span>
** <q>пара ножниц, коробка, полная марок и пучок кабелей</q> в "Прощай"
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">В [[#Звуки из-за стены - 4 Сен|"Звуки из-за стены"]] запись говорит о наценке в 120%, что в игре не встречается, хотя после улёта с Gordion, перед увольнением или после последнего дня квоты, в короткий промежуток времени наценка будет 123% перед обновлением квоты.</span>
** Упоминания множителя продажи в 120% и фраза <q>онсмотрел на них как на глупый фонд</q> могут быть отголосками того, что эта запись была сделана в ранней фазе разработки игры. До нынешней системы, квота основывалась на часах, а не днях, и множитель продажи компании бы колебался с каждым прошедшим часом, а также мог преодолеть предел в 100%.
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== 杂项 ==
* Sigurd 的日志时间戳显示其年份为 1968 年，即[[w:zh:阿波罗11号|阿波罗 11 号]]登月的前一年。
* [[#Golden Planet|黄金星球]]可能指的是类似[[w:zh:灵神星|灵神星]]这种在现实世界中确实存在的、主要由纯金或其它稀有金属构成的行星或小行星。
* 截至版本 81，Sigurd 提到的部分废料在游戏中并不存在：
** “木乃伊”一篇中提到的“几个煎锅和大钉子”(但也可能指的是[[Dust pan|防尘盘]]和[[Big bolt|大螺栓]])
** “再见”一篇中提到的“一把剪刀，一整箱邮票和一捆绳子”
** "a rusty metal grinder" in "Work"
* <span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">[[#墙后的声音 - 9/4|“墙后的声音”]]中提到了在游戏中并未出现过的120%废料出售价格倍率。不过，在离开Gordion后的短时间内，游戏内的废料出售价格倍率可达123%。</span>
** 日志中出现的120%出售价格倍率以及<q>他就跟炒股一样看这蠢价格。</q>，可能是游戏早期开发阶段编写的日志遗留了下来。在以前的机制中，配额是按小时算的，而公司的出售价格倍率则每个小时都有所波动，包括倍率超过100%的情况。
* In "Screams", Sigurd describes [[Walkie-talkie]]s playing screams constantly at the wall of the Company Building. This is reflected in-game, and two unique sounds can be heard when activating a walkie talkie near the wall where the drill faces.

######## Single scrap day
{{topicon Fandom|Single_Item_Day}}
{{interlangbox}}
A '''Single scrap day''' or '''SID''' (Single item day)  is an indoor event that causes all [[scrap]] spawned on a day to be the same. This can be a great boon to the employees as almost all SIDs increase the total value of a moon's scrap.

An important note is although SIDs can increase the total value of a moon, depending on the scrap chosen, the moons total weight can increase significantly (and rarely to the point full clearing is near impossible).

== Mechanics ==
=== Chosen scrap ===
The chance of a SID occurring on any moon is 4.2%.{{ref code|RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel}}

The scrap kind for a SID is chosen in a different way from normal scrap, all scrap on a given moon has an equal chance of being chosen. This means that both a [[Gold bar]] SID and [[Metal sheet]] SID have the exact same chance of occurring (given the moon has both scrap).

But if the chosen scrap is has a ''rarity'' below 5 (see below for a list of these and an explanation) or a 2 handed item, the chosen item is rerolled. This reroll can only happen 2 times and if the final item chosen still doesn't meet the needed conditions, there's a 60% chance the SID is skipped altogether.<ref name="giosuel-spreadsheet"/>

=== Scrap value ===
The scrap value is clamped between {{credits|50}} and {{credits|170}}, so if a scrap's value is below {{credits|50}} or above {{credits|170}} its value is set to the appropriate value (so a {{credits|15}} value [[Brush]] becomes {{credits|50}}).

Additionally, if a moon’s total value is higher than {{credits|4500}} each item’s value is multiplied 0.7 (30% reduction) and if the total value is lower than {{credits|600}} ({{credits|1500}} if the chosen scrap is a 2 handed) each item’s value is multiplied by 1.4 (40% increase).<ref name="giosuel-spreadsheet"/>

=== What is rarity? ===
{{main|Mechanics#Rarity}}
Rarity is the way Lethal Company handles chances for things to spawn. Scrap (and entities) have a rarity for each moon, and they are used alongside the sum of all rarities to calculate the chance for any one thing to spawn.
<br>The rarity values are per-moon; each moon's rarity table has been datamined and is stored as a [[Special:PrefixIndex/Module:Rarities/Data|subpage of Module:Rarities]]. ([[Module:Rarities|That script]] handles all the calculations for the tables across this wiki.)

== Trivia ==
* Due to the {{credits|600}} minimum on total scrap value, SIDs always improve the scrap value on any moon before [[Adamance]] (including [[Embrion]])
** [[Titan]] is a notable outlier in this pattern as SIDs also only give profit on this moon
== References == 

<references>
<ref name="giosuel-spreadsheet">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xub33yZJhaaRtVIJbJS6rGzeYh6VbQIiz5xHc4qjIhY giosuel's Single Item Day Analysis] (updated for [[v69]], accessed {{#formatdate:2025-10-20}})</ref>
</references>

<!--T:15-->
The '''Snare Flea''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It attaches itself to the ceiling and waits for employees to approach it, before dropping to the floor and attempting to suffocate them by wrapping itself around their head. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Assurance]].

<!--T:16-->
Snare Fleas are large, light-pink insectoid entities resembling lice or centipedes. They have five pairs of legs and an exoskeleton split into eight segments on  their back. Their heads have three pairs of black eyes arranged in a triangular formation, as well as small brown jaws, forcipules, and segmented antennae. 

== Bestiary entry == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
{{quote bestiary|SnareFlea}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
== Mechanics ==
Snare Fleas wait on the ceiling of any room or corridor. When an employee walks underneath a Snare Flea, it attempts to drop onto the employee's head. If the Snare Flea misses and falls onto the floor, it chases the employee for some time. If the Snare Flea successfully captures the employee, it wraps around their head, obstructing their view, muffling their voice, and forcing them to drop all of their items. It slowly damages the affected employee until it is removed or the employee dies. In singleplayer, the Snare Flea detaches on its own once the employee reaches critical health.

<!--T:7-->
Fleas can be killed by having the suffocating employee exit the facility, or when hit by a [[Shovel]]. If no one has a [[Shovel]] and the exit is near, the affected employee can be guided to the exit by voice.

<!--T:8-->
If the employee is alone and grabbed by a Flea, they may still free themself. If the employee has [[Shovel]] or [[Stop sign]], they should remain calm and scan the ground to locate their [[scrap]]. A Stop sign will be displayed however if your Shovel does not appear, it is likely beside your scrap items.
Once you've grabbed your weapon, attacking will hit the '''Snare Flea''' and free you.

<!--T:9-->
If a employee is successfully [[Teleporter|teleported]] while a Snare Flea is wrapped around their head, the Snare Flea dies.

<!--T:10-->
Stunning a Snare Flea while wrapped around the head of an employee will also cause them to release the employee, such as with a [[Stun grenade]] or [[Zap gun]].

<!--T:4-->
== Strategy ==
Snare Fleas are either lethal or a mere annoyance depending on your current situation. Hitting one while it has grabbed a worker will knock it off, but they can be difficult to hit otherwise. With this in mind, you can hit it off a coworker, try to get another hit in, then drop your shovel for your fellow coworker you rescued to repeat the process if the Snare Flea grabs you. If you find it while alone, your best bet is to avoid it as they don't attack outside a very small area, however this may make some halls or doorways difficult to pass.

<!--T:11-->
In the event that you are attached to by the Snare Flea and have no friends to assist you or a nearby exit to leave through, jumping into a pit is an effective means of killing the Snare Flea and increasing the survivability of your coworkers. In the event that you had a Shovel on you before being grabbed, you can pick it back up and hit the Snare Flea off yourself. 

<!--T:12-->
In singleplayer, if you are grabbed and do not have a Shovel or Stop Sign to knock it off, the Snare Flea will detach voluntarily once you reach critical health, regardless of your health beforehand. Be wary that it will not die if it detaches this way and if it grabs onto you a second time you will die.
[[File:Screenshot.png|left|thumb|222x222px]]
It is advantageous to carry a kitchen knife with you. When a flea bites you, use the scanner to quickly find the knife on the floor. Unlike a shovel, a knife is considered a scrap, so a scan can help you find it.

</translate>

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Spielmechaniken ==
'''Schlingenflöhe''' lauern an der Decke von Korridoren oder Räumen. Sobald ein Spieler in ihre Reichweite oder direkt unter ihnen hindurch läuft, lassen sie sich fallen. Sobald sie ihr Ziel erreicht haben oder falls sie direkt auf ihm landen, schlingen sie sich um dessen Kopf und erwürgen es langsam. Während man umschlungen ist, wird die Sicht des Spielers geblockt und die Stimme gedämpft. Auch lässt man alle Gegenstände aus dem Inventar fallen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Diese Kreaturen können normal mit einer [[Shovel|Schaufel]] getötet werden. Außerdem sterben sie, wenn man die Innenräume verlässt während man einen Schlingenfloh auf dem Kopf hat (entweder per Teleporter oder falls ein Ausgang in der Nähe ist).
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ist ein Spieler alleine und wird von einem Schlingenfloh gefangen, kann dieser sich dennoch befreien, solange er etwas zum Verteidigen dabei hat. Die Gegenstände, die fallengelassen wurden, können mit dem Scanner gefunden und wieder aufgehoben werden.
Sobald man seine Waffe wieder in der Hand hat reicht ein Angriff aus, um den Floh zu treffen und sich zu befreien.
</div>

Mit dem [[Teleporter]] können Schlingenflöhe auch ganz ohne Waffen sicher getötet werden. Wird ein Spieler erfolgreich teleportiert, während ein Schlingenfloh um den Kopf gewickelt ist, stirbt die Kreatur.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Betäubt man einen '''Schlingenfloh''' mit [[Stun Grenade|Betäubungsgranaten]] oder der [[Zap Gun|Betäubungspistole]], während dieser auf einem Spieler ist, gibt er den Spieler frei.
</div>

== Strategie ==
Schlingenflöhe sind mal der sichere Tod und mal nur eine kleine Unannehmlichkeit. Sie zu treffen kann sich als schwierig erweisen, wenn sie nicht um einen Mitarbeiter geschlungen sind. Ist man im Team mit einer Schaufel unterwegs, kann man sich abwechselnd von einem Floh erwischen lassen und ihn so leicht erledigen. Ist man dagegen allein unterwegs, ist die beste Taktik, einen Bogen um ihn zu machen. Ihre Reichweite ist sehr gering, aber das kann dennoch einige Räume oder Wege unzugänglich machen.

In dem Fall dass man von einem Schlingenfloh ergriffen wird und keinen Weg hat sich zu retten, kann man auch in einen Abgrund springen, um den Floh so mit in den Tod zu nehmen und es den anderen Mitarbeitern leichter zu machen. Hat man eine Schaufel dabei, sollte man ruhig bleiben, da man die Schaufel wieder aufnehmen und den Floh so loswerden kann. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Als Einzelspieler lässt ein Schlingenfloh los, sobald man kritische Verletzungen erlitten hat. Allerdings bleibt der Floh aggressiv und kann sich sofort wieder um den Spieler schlingen und ihn so töten.
</div>

{{Template:Direct Quote}}
The '''Snare Flea''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It attaches itself to the ceiling and waits for employees to approach it, before dropping to the floor and attempting to suffocate them by wrapping itself around their head. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Assurance]].

Snare Fleas are large, light-pink insectoid entities resembling lice or centipedes. They have five pairs of legs and an exoskeleton split into eight segments on  their back. Their heads have three pairs of black eyes arranged in a triangular formation, as well as small brown jaws, forcipules, and segmented antennae. 

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary|SnareFlea}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Mechanics ==
Snare Fleas wait on the ceiling of any room or corridor. When an employee walks underneath a Snare Flea, it attempts to drop onto the employee's head. If the Snare Flea misses and falls onto the floor, it chases the employee for some time. If the Snare Flea successfully captures the employee, it wraps around their head, obstructing their view, muffling their voice, and forcing them to drop all of their items. It slowly damages the affected employee until it is removed or the employee dies. In singleplayer, the Snare Flea detaches on its own once the employee reaches critical health.

Fleas can be killed by having the suffocating employee exit the facility, or when hit by a [[Shovel]]. If no one has a [[Shovel]] and the exit is near, the affected employee can be guided to the exit by voice.

If the employee is alone and grabbed by a Flea, they may still free themself. If the employee has [[Shovel]] or [[Stop sign]], they should remain calm and scan the ground to locate their [[scrap]]. A Stop sign will be displayed however if your Shovel does not appear, it is likely beside your scrap items.
Once you've grabbed your weapon, attacking will hit the '''Snare Flea''' and free you.

If a employee is successfully [[Teleporter|teleported]] while a Snare Flea is wrapped around their head, the Snare Flea dies.

Stunning a Snare Flea while wrapped around the head of an employee will also cause them to release the employee, such as with a [[Stun grenade]] or [[Zap gun]].

== Strategy ==
Snare Fleas are either lethal or a mere annoyance depending on your current situation. Hitting one while it has grabbed a worker will knock it off, but they can be difficult to hit otherwise. With this in mind, you can hit it off a coworker, try to get another hit in, then drop your shovel for your fellow coworker you rescued to repeat the process if the Snare Flea grabs you. If you find it while alone, your best bet is to avoid it as they don't attack outside a very small area, however this may make some halls or doorways difficult to pass.

In the event that you are attached to by the Snare Flea and have no friends to assist you or a nearby exit to leave through, jumping into a pit is an effective means of killing the Snare Flea and increasing the survivability of your coworkers. In the event that you had a Shovel on you before being grabbed, you can pick it back up and hit the Snare Flea off yourself. 

In singleplayer, if you are grabbed and do not have a Shovel or Stop Sign to knock it off, the Snare Flea will detach voluntarily once you reach critical health, regardless of your health beforehand. Be wary that it will not die if it detaches this way and if it grabs onto you a second time you will die.
[[File:Screenshot.png|left|thumb|222x222px]]
It is advantageous to carry a kitchen knife with you. When a flea bites you, use the scanner to quickly find the knife on the floor. Unlike a shovel, a knife is considered a scrap, so a scan can help you find it.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Mecanicas ==
'''Snare Fleas''' Esperan en el techo de cualquier habitación/pasillo. Una vez que un jugador está dentro del alcance o debajo, procederá a envolver su cabeza, obstruyendo su visión, amortiguando y distorsionando su voz, y dañando lentamente al jugador afectado hasta que sea eliminado o muerto y obligando a dicho jugador a soltar todos sus elementos de inventario.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Al Snare flea se le puede matar haciendo que el jugador que se está asfixiando salga de las instalaciones o cuando se las golpea con una [[shovel]] (Pala). Si nadie tiene una [[shovel]] (pala) y la salida está cerca, el jugador afectado puede ser guiado hasta la salida mediante voz.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Si el jugador esta solo y es agarrado por una, puede que aun se pueda salvar. Si el jugador tiene una [[Shovel]] (Pala) o una [[Stop Sign]], deberán calmarse, escanear el suelo junto a su [[:Category:Scrap|Scrap]] (chatarra). la [[Stop Sign]] (Señal de Stop) aparecerá escaneada. las [[Shovel]]s (pala) no se escanean, es probable que esté al lado de tu [[:Category:Scrap|Scrap Metal]] (Chatarra).
Una vez hayas agarrado tu arma, atacar golpeará al '''Snare Flea''' liberándote.
</div>

Si eres [[Teleporter|teleported]] (teletransportado) con éxito mientras tienes uno en la cabeza, morirá en la nave.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Aturdir un '''Snare Flea''' mientras esta en tu cabeza, provocara que suelten al jugador, como con una [[Stun Grenade]] (Granada aturdidora) o la [[Zap Gun]] (Pistola Zap).
</div>

== Estrategia ==
Snare Fleas son letales o una mera molestia dependiendo de su situación actual. Golpear a uno mientras ha agarrado a un empleado lo matará, pero de lo contrario puede ser difícil golpearlo. Con esto en mente, puedes golpear a un compañero de trabajo, intentar darle otro golpe y luego dejar caer tu pala para que tu compañero de trabajo que rescataste repita el proceso si el Snare Flea te atrapa. Si lo encuentras solo, lo mejor que puedes hacer es evitarlo, ya que no atacan fuera de un área muy pequeña; sin embargo, esto puede dificultar el paso de algunos pasillos o puertas.

En el caso de que estés atado por un Snare Flea y no tengas amigos que te ayuden o una salida cercana para salir, saltar a un pozo es un medio eficaz para matar a Snare Flea y aumentar la capacidad de supervivencia de tus compañeros de trabajo. En el caso de que tuvieras una pala antes de que te agarraran, puedes volver a levantarla y golpear la Snare Flea tú mismo. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
En un jugador, si te agarran y no tienes una pala o una señal de stop para derribarlo, el Snare flea se desprenderá voluntariamente una vez que alcances una salud crítica, independientemente de tu salud de antemano. Ten cuidado que no morirá si se desprende de esta manera y si te agarra por segunda vez morirás.
</div>

== Mekaniikat ==
'''Ansakirput''' odottavat minkä tahansa käytävän tai huoneen katossa. Kun pelaaja on lähellä tai alla, ne kiertyvät pelaajan pään ympäri, estäen tämän näkemisen, vaimentaen ja vääristäen heidän ääntään, ja hitaasti vahingoittaen pelaajaa kunnes se irrotetaan tai pelaaja on kuollut sekä pakottaa pelaajan pudottamaan kaikki esineet tavaraluettelossaan.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Kirput voi tappaa, saamalla tukehtuva pelaaja poistumaan laitoksesta tai kun niitä lyö lapiolla. Jos kenelläkään ei ole [[Shovel|lapiota]] ja poistumistie on lähellä, pelaaja voidaan ohjata ovelle äänellä.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jos pelaaja on yksin ja kirppu nappaa hänet, hän voi yhä pelastaa itsensä. Jos pelaajalla on [[Shovel|lapio]] tai [[Stop Sign|STOP-merkki]], hänen pitäisi pysyä rauhallisena ja etsiä maasta hänen [[:Category:Scrap|romujaan]]. [[Stop Sign|STOP-merkki]] näkyy mutta jos sinun [[Shovel|lapiosi]] ei tule näkyviin, se on todennäköisesti [[:Category:Scrap|Romumetallisi]] vieressä.
Kun olet napannut aseesi, lyöntisi osuu '''Ansakirppuun''' ja se vapauttaa sinut.
</div>

Jos kirppu onnistuneesti [[Teleporter|teleportataan]] kun se on kietoutunut sinun tai toisen työntekijän pään ympärille, kirppu kuolee.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Ansakirpun''' tainnuttamien esimerkiksi [[Stun Grenade|Tainnutuskranaatilla]] tai [[Zap Gun|Zap aseella]] kun se on kietoutunut pelaajan pään ympäri aiheuttaa pelaajan vapautumisen.
</div>

== Strategia ==
Ansakirput ovat joko tappavia tai pelkkiä ärsykkeitä riippuen sen hetkisestä tilanteestasi. Kirpun lyöminen kun se on napannut työntekijän pudottaa kirpun, mutta niihin voi olla vaikea osua muuten. Tämän mielessä pitäen, voit lyödä sen pois työtoverin päästä, koittaa osua uudestaan, sitten pudottaa lapio pelastamallesi työtoverille jotta voit tehdä saman uudestaan jos Ansakirppu nappaa sinut. Jos löydät sen ollessasi yksin, paras vaihtoehtosi on välttää sitä koska ne eivät hyökkää muualle kuin hyvin pienelle alueelle, kuitenkin tämä saattaa vaikeuttaa joidenkin käytävien ja ovien läpi kulkemista.

Tilanteessa jossa Ansakirppu kietoutuu pääsi ympärille ja sinulla ei ole ystäviä lähellä jotka voivat auttaa tai et ole lähellä ovea josta poistua laitoksesta, kuoppaan hyppääminen on hyvä tapa tappaa Ansakirppu ja parantaa työtoveriesi selviytymis mahdollisuuksia. Tilanteessa jossa sinulla oli lapio enne napatuksi tulemista, voit nostaa sen takaisin ylös maasta ja lyödä Ansakirppua itse. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">

Yksinpelissä, jos sinut napataan ja sinulla ei ole lapiota tai STOP-merkkiä jolla lyödä se pois, Ansakirppu irtaantuu vapaaehtoisesti kun saavutat kriittisen terveyden, riippumatta aikaisemmasta terveydestäsi. Ole varovainen sillä se ei kuole kun se irtaantuu. Tällä tavalla jos se nappaa sinut uudestaan, se tappaa sinut.
</div>
