<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Mécanisme ==
La '''Puce-Leurre''' attend au plafond des pièces et couloirs. Une fois qu'un joueur est à portée ou en-dessous, la '''Luce-Leurre''' va s'enrouler autour de la tête de ce dernier, étouffant et distordant la voix, et faisant tomber l'intégralité de l’inventaire du joueur. La '''Puce-Leurre''' blesse lentement le joueur affecté jusqu'à sa mort ou jusqu'à ce que cette dernière soit enlevée.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Les '''Puce-Leurres''' peuvent être tuées par un joueur affecté en sortant du complexe, ou en recevant un coup de [[pelle]]. Si aucun joueur n'a de [[pelle]] et que la sortie est proche, le joueur affecté peut être guidé par la voix jusqu'à cette dernière.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Si un joueur est seul et se fait attrapé par une '''Puce-Leurre''', ce dernier peut quand même se libérer seul. Si le joueur à une [[pelle]] ou un [[panneau stop]], ce dernier doit rester calme et scanner le sol pour localiser leurs débris. Un [[panneau stop]] sera scanné, à l'inverse d'une [[pelle]] qui sera vraisemblablement proche des débris.
Une fois votre arme en main, donner un coup touchera la '''Puce-Leurre''' et vous libérera.
</div>

Si un employé est téléporté avec succès pendant qu'une '''Puce-Leurre''' l’asphyxie, elle mourra.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La '''Puce-Leurre''' libérera un joueur si elle est immobilisé en utilisant une [[Stun Grenade|Grenade Assourdissante]] ou un [[Zap Gun]]
</div>

== Stratégie ==
Les '''Puce-Leurres''' peuvent être soit létales ou une simple nuisance dépendant de la situation. La frapper une fois alors qu'elle entoure un joueur la fait tomber, mais peuvent être difficile à frapper autrement. En sachant cela, vous pouvez la frapper lorsqu'elle est accroché à un employé, la poursuivre pour essayé de lui mettre un second coup, et lâcher votre arme si elle s'accroche à vous afin que l'employé récemment libéré puisse la frapper. Si vous rencontrez un '''Puce-Leurre''' en étant seul, la meilleur stratégie est de l'éviter car elle ne vous poursuivra pas en dehors d'une petite zone, attention cependant à l'environnement telles que les portes ou les tuyaux qui peuvent rendre la navigation compliquée.

Dans l'éventualité qu'une '''Puce-Leurre''' se serai accroché à votre tête, que vous n'avez pas de [[pelle]] et qu'aucun employé ne soit proche, sauté dans un trou afin de tuer la '''Puce-Leurre''' peut grandement augmenter la survivabilité de vos compagnons. Dans le cas où vous aviez une pelle dans d'être saisis, vous pouvez frapper la '''Puce-Leurre''' vous-même. 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
En solo, si vous êtes attrapé et que vous n'avez aucun arme à proximité, la '''Puce-Leurre''' se détachera une fois votre santé arrivée à un état critique, sans prendre compte de votre santé avant d'être attrapé. Cependant, vous mourrez si la '''Puce-Leurre''' vous attaque une seconde fois.
</div>

== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{quote bestiary|SnareFlea}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Механики ==
'''Потолочная блоха''' поджидает на потолке любых комнат/коридоров. Как только сотрудник окажется в поле её атаки, блоха спрыгивает на лицо игрока и обволакивает своим телом голову, лишая игрока зрения и в добавок приглушая голос а также постепенно нанося этому сотруднику урон до тех пор, пока её с него не снимут или не убьют и заставляя его выронить все предметы.
</div>

Блох можно убить двумя способами: либо вывести сотрудника к ближайшему выходу, либо снять блоху с головы [[shovel| лопатой]] или любым другим оружием. Если же не оказалось под рукой [[shovel|лопаты]] или выхода, то остаётся вести сотрудника к выходу подзывая к себе.

Если сотрудник один и был захвачен Блохой, он всё ещё может освободить себя. Если у сотрудника была [[Shovel|Лопата]] или [[Stop Sign|Дорожный знак]], они должны оставаться спокойными и сканировать пол. Дорожный знак появится на сканере, но если у вас была лопата, то скорее всего она лежит где-то под вами среди лута.
Как только оружие было подобрано, атака им ударит '''Потолочную Блоху''' и освободит игрока.

Если успешно [[Teleporter|телепортирована]] вместе с игроком, вокруг головы которого была обёрнута, Блоха немедленно умрёт.

Оглушение Потолочной Блохи, захватившей сотрудника, будь то с помощью [[Stun grenade/ru|Светошумовой гранаты]] или [[Zap Gun/ru|Электро-пушки]], заставит её отпустить сотрудника.

== Стратегия ==
Потолочные Блохи могут быть как летальными, так и просто надоедливыми в зависимости от ситуации. Удар по ней, когда она захватила сотрудника собьёт её, но в ином случае попасть по ней может быть сложно. Можно сбивать её с головы союзника, пытаться дать ещё один удар, после чего сбрасывать лопату союзнику на случай, если Блоха переключит своё внимание на вас, и повторять процесс. Если же вы одни - лучше будет просто избегать её, так как она не атакует вне маленькой зоны прямо под ней, но это затруднит проход по некоторым коридорам и через некоторые дверные проёмы.

Если вы были схвачены Блохой и по-близости нет ни друзей, ни выходов, можно спрыгнуть с блохой на голове в пропасть чтобы увеличить шансы союзников на выживание. Если у вас была с собой лопата на момент захвата, можно нащупать её на полу и сбить ей с себя Блоху. 

В одиночной игре, если вас схватила Блоха и у вас нет лопаты или знака, чтобы сбить её, Блоха сама оставит вас в покое как только ваше состояние станет критическим, вне зависимости от состояния здоровья до этого. Блоха не умрёт если отсоединится от вас таким образом и если схватит вас второй раз - уже точно убьёт.
[[File:Screenshot.png|left|thumb|222x222px]]
Весомым преимуществом будет ношение с собой кухонного ножа. Когда блоха начинает душить вас, используйте сканер, чтобы найти на полу нож. В отличие от лопаты, нож считается лутом, а потому будет отображаться сквозь блоху при сканировании.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The '''Snare Flea''' is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It attaches itself to the ceiling and waits for employees to approach it, before dropping to the floor and attempting to suffocate them by wrapping itself around their head. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Assurance]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Snare Fleas are large, light-pink insectoid entities resembling lice or centipedes. They have five pairs of legs and an exoskeleton split into eight segments on  their back. Their heads have three pairs of black eyes arranged in a triangular formation, as well as small brown jaws, forcipules, and segmented antennae.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Bestiary entry ==
</div>
{{quote bestiary|SnareFlea}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Mechanics ==
Snare Fleas wait on the ceiling of any room or corridor. When an employee walks underneath a Snare Flea, it attempts to drop onto the employee's head. If the Snare Flea misses and falls onto the floor, it chases the employee for some time. If the Snare Flea successfully captures the employee, it wraps around their head, obstructing their view, muffling their voice, and forcing them to drop all of their items. It slowly damages the affected employee until it is removed or the employee dies. In singleplayer, the Snare Flea detaches on its own once the employee reaches critical health.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Fleas can be killed by having the suffocating employee exit the facility, or when hit by a [[Shovel]]. If no one has a [[Shovel]] and the exit is near, the affected employee can be guided to the exit by voice.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the employee is alone and grabbed by a Flea, they may still free themself. If the employee has [[Shovel]] or [[Stop sign]], they should remain calm and scan the ground to locate their [[scrap]]. A Stop sign will be displayed however if your Shovel does not appear, it is likely beside your scrap items.
Once you've grabbed your weapon, attacking will hit the '''Snare Flea''' and free you.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If a employee is successfully [[Teleporter|teleported]] while a Snare Flea is wrapped around their head, the Snare Flea dies.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Stunning a Snare Flea while wrapped around the head of an employee will also cause them to release the employee, such as with a [[Stun grenade]] or [[Zap gun]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Strategy ==
Snare Fleas are either lethal or a mere annoyance depending on your current situation. Hitting one while it has grabbed a worker will knock it off, but they can be difficult to hit otherwise. With this in mind, you can hit it off a coworker, try to get another hit in, then drop your shovel for your fellow coworker you rescued to repeat the process if the Snare Flea grabs you. If you find it while alone, your best bet is to avoid it as they don't attack outside a very small area, however this may make some halls or doorways difficult to pass.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In the event that you are attached to by the Snare Flea and have no friends to assist you or a nearby exit to leave through, jumping into a pit is an effective means of killing the Snare Flea and increasing the survivability of your coworkers. In the event that you had a Shovel on you before being grabbed, you can pick it back up and hit the Snare Flea off yourself.
</div> 

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
In singleplayer, if you are grabbed and do not have a Shovel or Stop Sign to knock it off, the Snare Flea will detach voluntarily once you reach critical health, regardless of your health beforehand. Be wary that it will not die if it detaches this way and if it grabs onto you a second time you will die.
[[File:Screenshot.png|left|thumb|222x222px]]
It is advantageous to carry a kitchen knife with you. When a flea bites you, use the scanner to quickly find the knife on the floor. Unlike a shovel, a knife is considered a scrap, so a scan can help you find it.
</div>

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 机制 ==
'''缠缚蚤'''会埋伏在任何房间或通道的天花板上。一旦员工进入它的攻击范围或在其下方，缠缚蚤就会缠绕员工的头部、遮挡员工视野、使员工发出的声音模糊失真，并在被移除或员工死亡之前缓慢对员工造成伤害。同时，该员工物品栏中的所有物品也会被强制丢弃在地上。
</div>

缠缚蚤会在被窒息的员工离开设施时死亡，也可被[[Shovel|铲子]]击杀。如果周围没有员工持有[[Shovel|铲子]]但出口距离不远时，其他同事可以用语音引导被窒息的员工前往出口。

即使员工在孤身一人的情况下被缠缚蚤缠绕，他仍有机会自救。如果该员工持有[[Shovel|铲子]]或[[Stop Sign|停止标志牌]]，此时应保持冷静，同时扫描地面以定位掉落的[[:Category:Scrap|废料]]所在位置。铲子或停止标志牌一般也会掉在附近。
在捡起武器后，直接攻击会打到'''缠缚蚤'''上并解除它对员工的束缚。

如果在被缠绕时成功地将玩家[[Teleporter|传送]]回船，缠缚蚤也会死亡。

使用[[Stun Grenade|眩晕手雷]]或[[Zap Gun|电击枪]]眩晕缠缚蚤也可以让它释放员工。

== 策略 ==
缠缚蚤可能只会造成轻微的困扰，但也可能是致命的，具体取决于玩家所处的状况。当它缠绕其他员工时，攻击它就可以将其敲下，但在除此之外的情况下很难击中它。基于此，你可以先将缠缚蚤从其他员工身上敲下来，然后再尝试攻击它。如果没有击中，将你的铲子丢给其他员工，这样在你被缠绕时，其他员工可重复上述步骤以处理缠缚蚤。但如果你在孤身一人时遇到了缠缚蚤，最好绕着它走，因为它的攻击范围很小。然而，这可能使一部分门口或走廊变得难以通过。

若你不幸被缠缚蚤缠住，且附近没有队友协助或出口以供逃脱，你可以跳进坑里与缠缚蚤同归于尽，同时增加其他员工的生存几率。但如果你在被缠绕前持有铲子，可以试着把它捡回来，自己把缠缚蚤敲掉。 

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在单人游戏中，如果你被缠缚蚤缠绕且并未携带可以敲掉它的铲子或Stop标志牌，缠缚蚤会在你进入严重受伤状态时自行脱离，无论先前的生命值如何。需要注意的是，通过这种方式脱离的缠缚蚤不会死亡。如果它再次缠住你，你就会死亡。
</div>

######## Spectator
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
A spectator is an employee who has died of [[Damage|any means]] and watches over any living employee.

While spectating, you and other dead employees may speak with each other. Chat is unavailable while spectating.
<br/>While living employees cannot hear the conversations of spectating employees, spectators can hear all audio that the employee they are spectating can hear and everything they say.
Spectators also see the employee in third person.

No employee can be revived until the [[ship]] is back in orbit, but the [[bodies]] should be recovered unless unreachable so that the death penalty is not as bad.
<br/>Employees will be taken out of spectator mode and brought back alive once the ship is orbiting a moon and the results of your grade is finished.

Spectators can send the send back earlier which gives the living employees 2 in game hours to make it back to the ship before it leaves.
<br/>All spectators at the time of sending back the ship must all confirm the leaving of the ship and a casted vote cannot be taken back.

If an employee dies while someone is spectating them, they will just spectate another employee.

######## Spike Trap/en

}}{{Stub}}
'''Spike Traps''' are large mechanical devices found [[interiors|indoors]]. Lined with rows of sharp spikes, they will periodically slam down, killing anything below them.

== Mechanics ==

There are 2 spike trap types, interval traps and detection traps.

=== Interval Trap ===

80% chance for a spike trap to be an interval trap.

The fastest and slowest an interval trap will slam is: 0.8-26.2

=== Detection Trap ===

20% chance for a spike trap to be a detection trap.

This type of trap will have an invisible trip wire, and upon touching it, the spike trap almost immediately activates.

Slam time: 1/10

== Strategy ==

=== Interval Traps ===

Wait until the interval trap slams, and then quickly run to the other side of the interval trap.

=== Detection Traps ===

An employee can jump over the tripwire.

The safest way to tell if a trap is a detection trap is to wait until it slams. If it doesn't slam, then it's a detection trap.

An employee with less than 10 lbs of items can sprint straight through a detection trap, since the slam time isn't fast enough to kill a running employee.

######## Spike Trap/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Infobox trap
| image = Spike Trap Render.png
| image2 = spiketrapingame.webp
| damage = Insta-kill
| damage_speed = 0.8-26.2s (Interval)<br>Immediate (Detection)
| damage_type = AOE
| cause_of_death = Crushing
}}{{Stub}}
'''尖刺陷阱'''是出现在[[indoors|室内]]的大型机械装置。装置上排列着多排锋利尖刺，会周期性地猛然砸下，击杀下方的任何物体。

<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== 机制 ==

尖刺陷阱共有两种类型：间歇式陷阱和感应式陷阱。

<span id="Interval_Trap"></span>
=== 间歇式陷阱 ===

尖刺陷阱有80%的概率为间歇式陷阱。

间歇式陷阱触发砸下的最快与最慢间隔为：0.8–26.2

<span id="Detection_Trap"></span>
=== 感应式陷阱 ===

尖刺陷阱有20%的概率为感应式陷阱。

这类陷阱设有一根隐形触发线，一旦触碰到，尖刺陷阱几乎会立刻启动。

砸下时间：1/10

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

<span id="Interval_Traps"></span>
=== 间歇式陷阱 ===

等间歇式陷阱砸下后，迅速跑到陷阱的另一侧。

<span id="Detection_Traps"></span>
=== 感应式陷阱 ===

员工可以跳过这根触发线。

判断一个陷阱是否为感应触发型陷阱最安全的方法是等待它砸下。如果它始终不砸下，那它就是感应触发型陷阱。

携带物品重量不足10磅的员工可以直接冲刺穿过感应式陷阱，因为陷阱砸下的速度不足以击杀奔跑中的员工。

<span id="Occurrence"></span>
== 生成位置 ==
{| class="wikitable"

<!--T:12-->
The '''Spore Lizard''' is a docile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It flees from employees when spotted, and releases a dense cloud of spores from its tail or bites in self-defense when cornered. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Experimentation]].

<!--T:13-->
Spore Lizards are quadrupedal entities, and have olive-green scales, a large sucker-shaped mouth with pink lips and small, sharp jaws in place of their face, and a large purple ball at the ends of their tails.

== Bestiary entry == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{quote bestiary|SporeLizard}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<translate>
== Mechanics == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:7-->
Spore Lizards are passive entities, only attacking employees when threatened or cornered. In their normal state, they will wander the [[Interiors|facility]], making squelching sounds as they walk. When a Spore Lizard detects an employee from afar, it will stare at them, hissing and rattling its tail. It will then attempt to back away, still looking at the employee as it attempts to break line of sight, before skittering off. If approached too closely, the Spore Lizard will bite the employee and release a cloud of pink spores that limit visibility, giving the Spore Lizard an opportunity to escape.

<!--T:4-->
== Strategy ==
While the Spore Lizard may come across as intimidating, it most certainly isn't dangerous. It will only attack with a non-lethal bite in very close range, so an employee's best option is to simply respect it and leave it alone. The Spore Lizard will often hiss long before a employee even comes close enough for it to bite, so evading them is usually trivial.

<!--T:8-->
The only real danger of a Spore Lizard presents itself when other wildlife is nearby. A Spore Lizard releasing its spores during a time in which another, much more lethal creature is on the hunt, can pose a serious risk. To avoid this situation, simply take note of the general area a Spore Lizard is wandering in, and try to avoid it when being pursued by more dangerous wildlife.

<!--T:14-->
Due to its sheer retreating speed, an employee can opt to chase down the spore Lizard as it runs after being frightened. This strategy operates similar to the [[Bracken]] since the spore Lizard also knows the facility more than the employee. However, unlike the Bracken, the spore Lizard will prioritize spacing itself from you first rather than sprinting through the building, so the employee has to give the spore Lizard room to run away and follow its footsteps after. Also unlike the Bracken strategy, the spore Lizard does not have a favourite room, so following it will lead an employee to random rooms rather than deep rooms, which can be a downside for most. The upside is that a spore Lizard is far, far safer than a Bracken.

== History == <!--T:5-->
</translate>

== Spielmechaniken ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Sporenechsen''' sind passive Kreaturen, die Spieler nur dann angreifen, wenn sie selbst bedroht oder die Enge getrieben werden. Im Normalzustand wandern sie durch die Korridore und machen bei jedem Schritt Watschelgeräusche. Bemerkt eine Sporenechse einen Mitarbeiter, starrt sie diesen an und versucht mit rasselndem Schwanz und Zischlauten bedrohend zu wirken. Während sie den Spieler weiter anstarrt, versucht sie sich dann zu entfernen und aus dessen Sicht zu entkommen. Nähert man sich einer Sporenechse, beißt sie den Spieler und lässt eine lila Sporenwolke frei, die die Sicht behindert und der Echse eine Fluchtmöglichkeit gibt.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategie == 
Während Sporenechsen einschüchternd wirken können, sind sie in Wahrheit völlig ungefährlich. Sie greifen nur mit nicht-tödlichen Bissen an, also kann man sie einfach in Ruhe lassen und Abstand halten. Da die Sporenechsen oft schon Zischen bevor man überhaupt in ihre Nähe kommt, ist es trivial ihnen auszuweichen.
</div>

Sporenechsen können nur gefährlich werden, wenn sich noch andere Kreaturen in der Nähe befinden. Lassen sie eine Sporenwolke frei, während sich noch eine andere gefährlichere Kreatur in der Umgebung befindet, kann das zu einem Problem werden. Um solche Situationen zu vermeiden, sollte man sich merken wo die Sporenechse in etwa lang läuft und entsprechende Gänge bei einer Flucht vor gefährlichen Monstern vermeiden.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to its sheer retreating speed, an employee can opt to chase down the spore Lizard as it runs after being frightened. This strategy operates similar to the [[Bracken]] since the spore Lizard also knows the facility more than the employee. However, unlike the Bracken, the spore Lizard will prioritize spacing itself from you first rather than sprinting through the building, so the employee has to give the spore Lizard room to run away and follow its footsteps after. Also unlike the Bracken strategy, the spore Lizard does not have a favourite room, so following it will lead an employee to random rooms rather than deep rooms, which can be a downside for most. The upside is that a spore Lizard is far, far safer than a Bracken.
</div>

The '''Spore Lizard''' is a docile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It flees from employees when spotted, and releases a dense cloud of spores from its tail or bites in self-defense when cornered. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Experimentation]].

Spore Lizards are quadrupedal entities, and have olive-green scales, a large sucker-shaped mouth with pink lips and small, sharp jaws in place of their face, and a large purple ball at the ends of their tails.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary|SporeLizard}}

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
== Mechanics ==

Spore Lizards are passive entities, only attacking employees when threatened or cornered. In their normal state, they will wander the [[Interiors|facility]], making squelching sounds as they walk. When a Spore Lizard detects an employee from afar, it will stare at them, hissing and rattling its tail. It will then attempt to back away, still looking at the employee as it attempts to break line of sight, before skittering off. If approached too closely, the Spore Lizard will bite the employee and release a cloud of pink spores that limit visibility, giving the Spore Lizard an opportunity to escape.

== Strategy ==
While the Spore Lizard may come across as intimidating, it most certainly isn't dangerous. It will only attack with a non-lethal bite in very close range, so an employee's best option is to simply respect it and leave it alone. The Spore Lizard will often hiss long before a employee even comes close enough for it to bite, so evading them is usually trivial.

The only real danger of a Spore Lizard presents itself when other wildlife is nearby. A Spore Lizard releasing its spores during a time in which another, much more lethal creature is on the hunt, can pose a serious risk. To avoid this situation, simply take note of the general area a Spore Lizard is wandering in, and try to avoid it when being pursued by more dangerous wildlife.

Due to its sheer retreating speed, an employee can opt to chase down the spore Lizard as it runs after being frightened. This strategy operates similar to the [[Bracken]] since the spore Lizard also knows the facility more than the employee. However, unlike the Bracken, the spore Lizard will prioritize spacing itself from you first rather than sprinting through the building, so the employee has to give the spore Lizard room to run away and follow its footsteps after. Also unlike the Bracken strategy, the spore Lizard does not have a favourite room, so following it will lead an employee to random rooms rather than deep rooms, which can be a downside for most. The upside is that a spore Lizard is far, far safer than a Bracken.

== History ==

== {{section heading/Spawn chances}} ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}
<span id="Mechanics"></span>
== Механики ==

'''Споро-ящеры''' - пассивные сущности, атакующие сотрудников только если чувствуют угрозу или зажаты в угол. В нормальном состоянии они блуждают по [[interiors|зданию]], издавая чавкающие звуки, когда шагают. Когда Споро-ящер замечает сотрудника издали, он начнёт таращиться на него, шипя и гремя своим хвостом. Он попробует отступить, продолжая смотреть на сотрудника, пытаясь прервать линию видимости, перед тем, как унестись прочь. Если к нему приблизиться слишком близко, Споро-ящер укусит сотрудника и выпустит облако розовых спор, ограничивающих видимость, давая Споро-ящеру возможность улизнуть.

== Стратегия ==
Хотя Споро-ящер может показаться устрашающим, он совершенно точно не опасен. Он атакует только нелетальным укусом вблизи, так что лучший вариант для сотрудника - просто уважать его пространство и оставить его в покое. Споро-ящер часто будет шипеть на сотрудника если подойти к нему достаточно близко, чтобы он мог укусить, так что его избегание часто само собой разумеющееся.

Единственная ситуация, когда Споро-ящеры несут действительную опасность, когда другие сущности рядом. Облако споров, которое испускает Споро-ящер, может нести серьёзный риск, когда другая, более опасная сущность, вышла на охоту. Чтобы избежать этой ситуации, стоит просто учитывать общее местоположение, в котором бродит Споро-ящер, и пытаться избегать его во время преследования более опасной сущностью.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to its sheer retreating speed, an employee can opt to chase down the spore Lizard as it runs after being frightened. This strategy operates similar to the [[Bracken]] since the spore Lizard also knows the facility more than the employee. However, unlike the Bracken, the spore Lizard will prioritize spacing itself from you first rather than sprinting through the building, so the employee has to give the spore Lizard room to run away and follow its footsteps after. Also unlike the Bracken strategy, the spore Lizard does not have a favourite room, so following it will lead an employee to random rooms rather than deep rooms, which can be a downside for most. The upside is that a spore Lizard is far, far safer than a Bracken.
</div>

== 机制 ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''孢子蜥蜴'''是被动型实体，只会在被威胁或被逼至角落时攻击玩家。在正常模式下，孢子蜥蜴会在设施中游荡，并在行走时发出吧唧声。若其在远处发现员工，它会盯着员工发出嘶嘶声，同时摇动自己的尾巴。随后它会尝试后退，并在试图摆脱视线接触前持续注视玩家，最后迅速逃离。如果玩家离它太近，孢子蜥蜴会咬伤玩家并释放一团用于降低能见度的粉色孢子云，随后孢子蜥蜴会趁机逃离。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 应对措施 ==
虽然孢子蜥蜴给人的感觉十分吓人，但它并不危险。它只会在非常近的距离进行非致命性的撕咬，所以玩家最好保持自重，不要管它。当玩家靠近到足以孢子蜥蜴进行撕咬的距离时，它会在咬人之前发出嘶嘶声，时间很长，因此躲避它们的攻击可谓是小事一桩。
</div>

孢子蜥蜴能够带来的唯一危险，是当附近存在其他实体的时候。当你正在被更具危害性的实体追杀时，孢子蜥蜴释放出的孢子可能会让你的情况雪上加霜。为了避免这种情况，只需注意孢子蜥蜴游荡的大致区域，并在被实体追捕时尽可能地避开它。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Due to its sheer retreating speed, an employee can opt to chase down the spore Lizard as it runs after being frightened. However, unlike the Bracken, the spore Lizard will prioritize spacing itself from you first rather than sprinting through the building, so the employee has to give the spore Lizard room to run away and follow its footsteps after. == {{section heading/Company description}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
None present.

== Overview == <!--T:2-->

<!--T:3-->
'''Spray paint''' is a tool item that can be used to paint walls and floors, as well as other surfaces such as on-ship furniture items and even other employees. A can of spray paint must be shaken before it can be used- otherwise, the paint will dissipate into the air instead of being applied. Paint cannot be used infinitely, and a can will eventually run out of paint after about 30 seconds of applying it to a surface (including time taken shaking the can). Paint also comes in four different colors, those being red, yellow, green, and purple; spray paint color is randomly generated upon landing at a moon, and all spray paint purchased on that moon will be the same color.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:4-->
Spray paint can be effectively used as a "breadcrumb trail", allowing an employee to easily mark doorways or walls that lead back to facility entrances or fire exits. Additionally, it can also be used to outline dangerous rooms (i.e rooms with [[Traps|traps]]), as well as dead-ends and explored areas to prevent casualties or wasting time respectively. Employees should make sure to clearly communicate to fellow employees what a certain spray paint marking means so as to prevent confusion and use the tool effectively.
Spray-paint can also be applied to other employees, allowing potential easy identifying of [[Masked]].
</translate>
== {{section heading/History}} ==

=== {{section heading/Version X|45}} ===
<translate>
<!--T:5-->
Introduced.
</translate>
=== {{section heading/Version X|47}} ===
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Spray paint should now always disappear from the moon when you enter orbit.
</translate>
== {{section heading/Trivia}} ==
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
Color of the paint seems to be randomly selected for every employee.

<!--T:8-->
Some employees may see more paint than others.
</translate>

== Overview ==

'''Spray paint''' is a tool item that can be used to paint walls and floors, as well as other surfaces such as on-ship furniture items and even other employees. A can of spray paint must be shaken before it can be used- otherwise, the paint will dissipate into the air instead of being applied. Paint also comes in four different colors, those being red, yellow, green, and purple; spray paint color is randomly generated upon landing at a moon, and all spray paint purchased on that moon will be the same color.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
Spray paint can be effectively used as a "breadcrumb trail", allowing an employee to easily mark doorways or walls that lead back to facility entrances or fire exits. Additionally, it can also be used to outline dangerous rooms (i.e rooms with [[Traps|traps]]), as well as dead-ends and explored areas to prevent casualties or wasting time respectively. Employees should make sure to clearly communicate to fellow employees what a certain spray paint marking means so as to prevent confusion and use the tool effectively.
Spray-paint can also be applied to other employees, allowing potential easy identifying of [[Masked]].

== {{section heading/Company description}} ==
Отсутствует.

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Общая информация ==

'''Спрей-краска''' - инструмент, который можно использовать для нанесения меток на стены и пол, а также на другие поверхности, как например на декор корабля или даже на других сотрудников. Банка спрей-краски надо встряхнуть перед использованием - иначе краска просто распылится в воздухе вместо нанесения на поверхность. Не может использоваться бесконечно и в конце-концов краска закончится примерно через 30 секунд непрерывного использования (включая встряхивания банки). Краска поставляется в четырёх цветах, а именно красный, жёлтый, зелёный и фиолетовый; эти цвета случайно определяются заранее при посадке на луну, и вся краска, купленная на этой луне, будет одинакового цвета.
== {{section heading/Strategy}} ==
Спрей-краску можно эффективно использовать по методу "хлебных крошек", позволяя сотруднику легко помечать дверные проёмы или стены, ведущие на выход. Дополнительно их можно использовать для отметки опасных комнат (например содержащие [[Traps/ru|ловушки]]), а также тупики и исследованные ответвления во избежание потерь человеческих и временных соответственно. Сотрудникам также следует заранее обговорить с коллегами значения определённых меток, чтобы избежать недопониманий и эффективно использовать инструмент.
Спрей-краску также можно использовать для нанесения на других сотрудников, облегчая разделение между настоящими коллегами и [[Masked/ru|Одержимыми]].

######## Sticky note
{{topicon Fandom|Sticky_Note}}
{{interlangbox}}

The '''Sticky note''' is a pedagogical item which generates in the [[ship]], hidden just to the left of the [[Terminal]].
Its sole purpose is to reveal the otherwise hidden command <code>SIGURD</code>, which is used to read unlocked [[Sigurd Logs]].

The Sticky note does not show up on the [[scanner]].
<br>It is one of the few equipment items that can't be put in the [[utility slot]].

Attempting to sell it will add {{credits|1}} to the ledger, but this doesn't count towards the total.

######## Store
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
{{interlangbox}}
[[File:Store.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:14--> The store</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The '''Store''' is a [[Computer Terminal|terminal]] command which can be used to purchase and deliver various items.

== Usage ==
{{split|Dropship}}

<!--T:2-->
The store can be accessed by typing "store" in the ship's terminal. This returns a full list of all the items that can be purchased on that day. Employees are always able to buy any equipment, but ship upgrades and ship decorations have a random rotation of purchasable items that changes every day.

<!--T:12-->
Items can be purchased by typing the name of an item and the desired number of that item (e.g. "flashlight 3") into the terminal.
If this ship is already on a moon, a drop pod delivers the bought items 17 seconds after purchase
(or 27 seconds if this is the first order of the day, and with the caveat that the dropship's timer doesn't start until 8:09 AM when the [[ship]] has landed).
Once landed, the drop pod plays a melody so it can be located by employees.
Items must be retrieved quickly as the pod leaves after just 30 seconds, regardless of whether the items were dispensed or not.

<!--T:13-->
If the ship is in orbit at the time of buying, the drop pod lands on the next moon the employees land on.

<!--T:41-->
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.

<!--T:3-->
=== Sales ===
It is possible for items to be on sale, meaning they can be purchased at a reduced price. This can happen randomly and every item has its own maximum sale percentage, this being 80% for most of the items. Item sales are re-rolled every day.

<!--T:4-->
== Store items ==
Items purchasable are split into four categories: equipment, ship upgrades, ship decoration, and suits.

######## Store/cs
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|Obchod]]
'''Obchod''' je [[Computer Terminal|terminálový]] příkaz ve kterém se může nakupovat a doručovat různé předměty.

== Použití ==
Pro přístup k obchodu, napište "store" do terminálu lodě. Tohle vyndá seznam všech předmětů které se dá ten den koupit. Zaměstnanci vždycky můžou koupit jakékoliv vybavení ale loďové vylepšení a dekorace mají náhodnou rotaci předmětů které se dají koupit co se mění každý den.

Aby jste koupili předmět, musíte napsat jméno předmětu  kterého chcete v angličtině a kolik ho chcete koupit (např. "flashlight 3") do terminálu. Jestli už jste na nějakém měsíci, doručovací raketa do půl hodiny přinese ty předměty které jste koupili. Až přistane, doručovací raketa hraje melodii aby mohla být lehce lokalizována zaměstnanci. Zaměstnanci jsou doporučeni předměty z rakety získat co nejrychleji, protože za malou dobu doručovací raketa odletí pryč, '''i když ty předměty ještě v ní jsou'''.

Jestli loď je ještě na oběžné dráze když nakupujete, doručovací raketa přistane na měsíci, na který přistanete.

Loďová vylepšení a dekorace a obleky se dají koupit pouze jednou. Pokušení o koupení duplikátu vám dá vzkaz <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q> pokud je ale váš zůstatek moc nízký, dostanete běžný nedostatek-peněz vzkaz.

=== Sales ===
Je možné pro předměty že je na ně sleva, neboli budou mít menší cenu. To se může stát náhodně a každý předmět má svojí vlastní maximální slevu, což je 80% pro většinu předmětů. Slevy předmětů se mění každý den.

== Obchodní předměty ==
Předměty ke koupi jsou rozděleny do čtyř kategorií: vybavení, loďové vylepšení, loďové dekorace, a obleky.

== Drobnosti ==
* V obchodě je předmět jménem [[Mapper tools|Mapovací nástroje]], který stojí [[File:Scrap_Currency_Symbol_Gray.svg|6px]] 30. V jeho informační stránce se říká že to hráčům dá pohled shora, pomocí detekce světla, avšak ve hře předmět je jenom lopata. Momentálně není žádné známé využití pro tenhle předmět, předpokládá se že to je plánovaný/vyřazený kontent.
*Uvítací podložka má doopravdy cenu [[File:Scrap_Currency_Symbol_Gray.svg|6px]] 50 protože je jiná konfigurace mezi vnitřními assety.
* [[Extension Ladder|Vysunovací žebřík]] může být použit jako zbraň jestli spadne na hráče.

######## Store/de
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|Der Shop]]
Der '''Shop''' ist ein Befehl im Terminal, der zum Kaufen von Gegenständen benutzt werden kann.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Nutzung ==
Auf den Shop kann zugegriffen werden, indem man "store" in das Terminal im Schiff eingibt. Dieser Befehl ruft eine Liste aller Gegenstände auf, die an diesem Tag gekauft werden können. Ausrüstung und Verbesserungen für das Schiff sind immer verfügbar, während von den Dekorationen immer nur eine kleine tägliche Auswahl gekauft werden kann.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Um einen Gegenstand zu kaufen, muss der Name des Gegenstandes und die gewünschte Anzahl in das Terminal eingegeben werden (Bsp.: "flashlight 3" für 3 Taschenlampen). Befindet das Schiff sich bereits auf der Oberfläche eines Mondes, werden gekaufte Gegenstände innerhalb einer halben Stunde per Abwurfkapsel geliefert. Diese spielt eine Melodie, die Spielern hilft sie zu finden und sollte möglichst schnell geöffnet werden, da sie sonst '''mit dem Gegenständen''' wieder zurückkehrt.
</div>

unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.

=== Rabatte === 
Es kommt vor, dass der Shop Rabatte anbietet und Gegenstände so zu einem niedrigeren Preis gekauft werden können. Diese Rabatte sind zufällig und werden zu Beginn jedes Tages neu ausgewürfelt. Jeder Gegenstand hat einen internen Maximalrabatt, der bei den meisten Gegenständen bei 80% liegt.

== Gegenstände im Shop ==
Es gibt 4 Kategorien von Gegenständen die im Shop gekauft werden können: Ausrüstung, Schiffverbesserungen, Dekoration und Anzüge.

######## Store/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|The store]]
The '''Store''' is a [[Computer Terminal|terminal]] command which can be used to purchase and deliver various items.

== Usage ==
The store can be accessed by typing "store" in the ship's terminal. This returns a full list of all the items that can be purchased on that day. Employees are always able to buy any equipment, but ship upgrades and ship decorations have a random rotation of purchasable items that changes every day.

Items can be purchased by typing the name of an item and the desired number of that item (e.g. "flashlight 3") into the terminal.
If this ship is already on a moon, a drop pod delivers the bought items 17 seconds after purchase
(or 27 seconds if this is the first order of the day, and with the caveat that the dropship's timer doesn't start until 8:09 AM when the [[ship]] has landed).
Once landed, the drop pod plays a melody so it can be located by employees.
Items must be retrieved quickly as the pod leaves after just 30 seconds, regardless of whether the items were dispensed or not.

If the ship is in orbit at the time of buying, the drop pod lands on the next moon the employees land on.

Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.

=== Sales ===
It is possible for items to be on sale, meaning they can be purchased at a reduced price. This can happen randomly and every item has its own maximum sale percentage, this being 80% for most of the items. Item sales are re-rolled every day.

== Store items ==
Items purchasable are split into four categories: equipment, ship upgrades, ship decoration, and suits.

== Trivia ==
* There is an unlisted item in the store called [[mapper tools]], costing {{credits|30}}. Its informational page states it will give employees an overhead view of their surroundings using light-detection; however, purchasing one just gets you a shovel. If spawned in with mods, the tool functions as a portable version of the ship's main monitor.
*The welcome mat has an actual cost of {{credits|50}} because of a different configuration between internal assets.
* The [[Extension ladder]] can be used as a weapon if it falls on an employee.

La '''tienda''' es un comando de la [[terminal del ordenador|terminal]] el cual puede ser usado para enviar varios objetos.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Uso ==
Para acceder a la tienda, escribe "Store" en la terminal de la nave. esto mostrará una lista de todos lo objetos que pueden ser comprados en el día. Los empleados siempre podrán comprar equipamiento pero las mejoras de la nave y las decoraciones tienen una rotación aleatoria de compra que cambia todos los días.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Para comprar un objeto, escribe el nombre de este y la cantidad que quieras (Ej: "Linterna 3") en la terminal. si ya has llegado a una luna, una capsula traerá los objetos comprados en media hora. Una vez aterrizada, la capsula tocara una melodía para que sea localizada por empleados. Se recomienda que los empleados recojan los objetos rápido ya que la capsula se marcha pasado un tiempo, aunque los objetos '''fueron o no recogidos'''.
</div>

=== Ofertas ===
Es posible que algunos objetos estén de oferta, significando que pueden ser comprados por un precio reducido. esto puede pasar aleatoriamente y todos los objetos tienen su valor máximo de oferta, siendo este de 80% para la mayoría de objetos. Las ofertas de objetos rotan cada día.

Su página informativa indica que se les brinda a los jugadores una vista aérea de su entorno mediante detección de luz; sin embargo, en el juego el objeto es solo una pala. No se conoce ningún uso para esta herramienta por el momento, posiblemente sea contenido planificado/desechado.
</div>
*<span class="mw-translate-fuzzy">La Alfombra de Bienvenida tiene un costo actual de [[File:Scrap_Currency_Symbol_Gray.svg|6px]] 50 porque tiene una configuración distinta en los archivos del juego</span>

* The [[Extension ladder]] can be used as a weapon if it falls on an employee.

######## Store/fi
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The store</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Kauppa''' on [[Computer Terminal|Terminaalin]] komento jota voi käyttää esineiden kuten [[Flashlight|taskulamppujen]] ja [[Shovel|lapioiden]] tilaamiseen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Käyttö ==
Päästäksesi kauppaan, kirjoita "store" aluksen terminaaliin. Tämä palauttaa täyden listan kaikista esineistä, joita voi ostaa kyseisen päivän aikana. Työntekijät pystyvät aina ostamaan mitä tahansa varusteita, mutta aluksen päivityksissä ja sisustuksissa on satunnainen kierto ostettavia esineitä, joka muuttuu joka päivä.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ostaaksesi esineen, kirjoita esineen nimi ja määrä (esim. "flashlight 3") terminaaliin. Jos olet jo valmiiksi kuussa, pudotuskapseli tuo ostetut esineet puolen tunnin sisällä. Laskeutumisen jälkeen, kapseli soittaa melodiaa, jotta työntekijät voivat löytää sen. Työntekijöitä suositellaan hakemaan esineet nopeasti sillä kapseli lähtee hetken kuluttua uudestaan, riippumatta siitä '''otettiinko esineet vai ei'''.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jos alus on kiertoradalla ostoajankohtana, pudotuskapseli laskeutuu seuraavaan kuuhun johon työntekijät menevät.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

=== Allennukset ===
Esineiden on mahdollista olla alennuksessa, joka tarkoittaa että ne voidaan ostaa alennetulla hinnalla.. Tämä voi tapahtua satunnaisesti ja jokaisella esineellä on oma maksimi alennusprosentti, joka on 80% suurimmalle osalle esineistä. Esineiden alennukset uusiutuvat joka päivä.

== Kaupan esineet ==
Ostettavat esineet on jaoteltu neljään kategoriaan: varusteisiin, aluksen päivityksiin, aluksen sisustuksiin ja pukuihin.

######## Store/fr
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|La Boutique de la Company]]
La '''Boutique''' c'est une [[Terminal d'ordinateur|Commande]] du terminal qui peut être utilisé pour acheter et se faire livrer différents outils.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Usage ==
The store can be accessed by typing "store" in the ship's terminal. This returns a full list of all the items that can be purchased on that day. Employees are always able to buy any equipment, but ship upgrades and ship decorations have a random rotation of purchasable items that changes every day.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Items can be purchased by typing the name of an item and the desired number of that item (e.g. "flashlight 3") into the terminal.
If this ship is already on a moon, a drop pod delivers the bought items 17 seconds after purchase
(or 27 seconds if this is the first order of the day, and with the caveat that the dropship's timer doesn't start until 8:09 AM when the [[ship]] has landed).
Once landed, the drop pod plays a melody so it can be located by employees.
Items must be retrieved quickly as the pod leaves after just 30 seconds, regardless of whether the items were dispensed or not.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the ship is in orbit at the time of buying, the drop pod lands on the next moon the employees land on.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Sales ===
It is possible for items to be on sale, meaning they can be purchased at a reduced price. This can happen randomly and every item has its own maximum sale percentage, this being 80% for most of the items. Item sales are re-rolled every day.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Store items ==
Items purchasable are split into four categories: equipment, ship upgrades, ship decoration, and suits.
</div>

######## Store/id
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The store</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Toko''' adalah sebuah perintah pada [[Computer Terminal|terminal]] yang bisa digunakan untuk membeli barang seperti [[Flashlight|senter]] dan [[Shovel|sekop]].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Kegunaan ==
Untuk mengakses toko, pekerja dapat mengetik "store" pada terminal kapal. Pada layar kemudian akan ditampilkan daftar lengkap barang-barang yang bisa dibeli pada hari itu, Pekerja bisa membeli peralatan kapan saja, tetapi ''upgrade'' dan dekorasi kapal akan memiliki rotasi acak yang berubah setiap harinya.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Untuk membeli sebuah barang, ketik nama barang dan jumlah yang Anda ingin beli (contoh "flashlight 3") ke dalam terminal. Apabila Anda sudah berada di bulan, sebuah ''drop pod'' akan mendarat untuk mengirimkan barang yang sudah dibeli sekitar setengah jam setelah pembelian. ''Drop pod'' akan selalu memainkan sebuah melodi sehingga bisa ditemukan para pekerja. Para pekerja disarankan untuk segera mengumpulkan barang karena setelah beberapa waktu, baik '''sudah diambil ataupun belum sama sekali''', ''pod'' akan pergi secara otomatis.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Ketika kapal sedang berada di dalam orbit saat pembelian, ''drop pod'' akan mendarat ke bulan selanjutnya yang akan dikunjungi para pekerja.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

=== Diskon ===
Ada kemungkinan untuk beberapa barang mendapatkan diskon, sehingga para pekerja dapat membelinya dengan harga yang lebih rendah. Hal ini terjadi secara acak dan masing-masing barang memiliki persentase diskon maksimum, yaitu 80% untuk mayoritas barang. Diskon akan berubah setiap harinya.

== Toko Barang ==
Barang-barang yang dapat dibeli oleh para pekerja dapat dibagi menjadi empat kategori: perlengkapan, ''upgrade'' kapal, dekorasi kapal, dan pakaian.

######## Store/it
{{topicon Fandom}}

<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The store</span>]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Il '''Negozio è un comando del [[Terminale del Computer|terminale]] che viene usato per consegnare strumenti come [[Torcia|torce]] e [[Pala|pale]]. Gli strumenti acquistabili sono separati in 4 tipi: equipaggiamento, migliorie della nave, decorazione della nave, e tute.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
= Uso =
Per accedere al negozio, scrivere "negozio" nel terminale della nave. Ciò mostrerà l'intera lista di tutti gli oggetti che possono essere acquistati in quel giorno. Gli impiegati sono sempre in grado di comprare equipaggiamento ma le migliore e le decorazioni della nave hanno una rotazione casuale di oggetti acquistabili che cambia ogni giorno.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Items can be purchased by typing the name of an item and the desired number of that item (e.g. "flashlight 3") into the terminal.
If this ship is already on a moon, a drop pod delivers the bought items 17 seconds after purchase
(or 27 seconds if this is the first order of the day, and with the caveat that the dropship's timer doesn't start until 8:09 AM when the [[ship]] has landed).
Once landed, the drop pod plays a melody so it can be located by employees.
Items must be retrieved quickly as the pod leaves after just 30 seconds, regardless of whether the items were dispensed or not.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the ship is in orbit at the time of buying, the drop pod lands on the next moon the employees land on.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Sconti ===
Gli strumenti possono essere messi in sconto, cioè possono essere comprati a un prezzo ridotto. Questo può succedere casualmente e ogni oggetto ha la sua percentuale massima di sconto, che corrisponde a 80% per la maggior parte degli oggetti. Gli sconti degli oggetti cambiano ogni giorno.
</div>

== Curiosità ==
* C'è un oggetto nel negozio chiamato [[Strumenti del cartografo]], e costa [[File:Scrap_Currency_Symbol.svg|6px]] 30. La sua pagina informativa afferma che conferisce ai giocatori una vista dall'alto dei dintorni utilizzando un rilevatore di luce, ma nel gioco l'oggetto è semplicemente una pala. Non c'è nessun uso conosciuto dello strumento al momento, quindi probabilmente si tratta di contenuto in sviluppo/scartato.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Per comprare un oggetto, scrivere il nome dell'oggetto e la quantità (es. "torcia 3") nel terminale. Se sei su una luna, la capsula delle consegne porterà gli oggetti acquistati entro una mezz'ora. Appena atterrata, la capsula delle consegne suonerà una melodia per aiutare gli impiegati a localizzarla. Gli impiegati sono consigliati di raccogliere gli oggetti velocemente poiché dopo un certo tempo la capsula se ne andrà, anche se gli acquisti '''non sono stati riscattati'''.
</div>

######## Store/pl
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|Sklep w grze]]
'''Sklep''' to komenda w [[Computer Terminal/pl|terminalu]], której używa się by dostarczać przedmiotów.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Użycie ==
By mieć widok sklepu należy wpisać "store" w terminalu na statku. Wyświetli to pełną listę wszystkich możliwych do kupienia rzeczy na dany dzień. Pracownicy mogą zawsze kupić sprzęt, ale ulepszenia statku oraz jego dekoracje są ustawiane losowo na dany dzień.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Aby kupić przedmiot należy wpisać jego nazwę oraz podać jego ilość (np. "flashlight 3") do terminalu. Jeżeli jesteś już na księżycu kapsuła dostarczy na powierzchnię zakupione przedmioty w przeciągu pół godziny. Po wylądowaniu kapsuła zacznie grać melodię by móc być zlokalizowanym przez pracowników. Należy jednak działać szybko, ponieważ kapsuła odleci po czasie niezależnie czy przedmioty '''zostały zebrane czy nie'''.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jeżeli statek jest na orbicie w momencie kupowania, kapsuła wyląduje na księżycy, na którym wyląduje załoga.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

=== Przeceny ===
Istnieje możliwość, by przedmioty były przecenione, co oznacza że ich cena się zmniejszyła. Dzieje się to losowo i każdy przedmiot ma swój maksymalny procent przeceny, lecz większość ma 80%. Przeceny są losowane każdego dnia

= Przedmioty w Sklepie =
Przedmioty, które da się kupić, można podzielić na cztery kategorie: wyposażenie, ulepszenia statku, dekoracja statku i kombinezony

######## Store/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|A loja]]
A '''Loja''' é um dos comandos do [[Computer Terminal|Terminal]] que pode ser usado para comprar vários itens.

== Uso ==
A loja pode ser acessada ao digitar "store" no terminal da nave. Isso vai mostrar uma lista completa de itens que podem ser comprados naquele dia. Ês funcionáries podem sempre comprar qualquer equipamento, mas melhorias e decorações da nave têm uma rotação aleatória de itens compráveis que muda todo dia.

Itens podem ser comprados ao digitar seu nome (em inglês) e sua quantidade desejada (exemplo: "flashlight 4") no terminal.
Se a nave já estiver em uma [[Moons/pt-br|lua]], uma nave de entregas entrega o item comprado depois de 17 segundos após a compra (ou 27 segundos se for a primeira compra do dia, além de que o ''timer'' da nave de entregas só começa quando for 8:09 AM depois de a [[ship/pt-br|nave]] pousar).
Ao pousar, a nave de entregas toca uma música para que ela possa ser localizada por funcionáries.
Itens devem ser recuperados rapidamente, já que a nave de entregas vai embora depois de apenas 30 segundos, independente de os itens terem sidos coletados ou não.

Se a nave estiver em órbita na hora que comprar algo, a nave de entregas vai pousar na próxima lua em que ês funcionáries forem.

Melhorias da nave, decorações e trajes só podem ser comprados uma vez.
Tentar comprar um extra resulta na mensagem <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q> (Isso já foi desbloqueado na sua nave!) a não ser que não haja dinheiro o suficiente na nave, que nesse caso a mensagem padrão de falta de dinheiro é mostrada.

=== Promoções ===
E possível que itens fiquem em promoção, significando que eles podem ser comprados por um preço reduzido. Isso pode acontecer aleatoriamente é cada item tem sua própria porcentagem  de desconto máxima, essa sendo 80% para a maioria dos itens. Promoções de itens são redefinidas todo dia.

== Itens Da Loja ==
Itens compráveis são divididos em quatro categorias: equipamento, melhorias de nave, decorações da nave, e roupas.

== Trivia ==
* Há um item não listado na loja chamado de [[Mapper tools/pt-br|ferramentas de mapeamento]], custando {{credits|30}}. Sua página informacional diz que esse item dá para ês funcionáries uma visão de cima de seus arredores usando detecção de luz, porém ao comprar um, você só recebe uma pá. Se gerado utilizando mods, a ferramenta serve como uma versão portátil do monitor principal da nave.
*O tapete de bem-vinde tem um custo real de {{credits|50}}, por causa de configurações diferentes nos arquivos internos.
* A [[Extension Ladder/pt-br|Escada extensível]] pode ser usada como uma arma se ela cair em ume funcionárie.

######## Store/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|Магазин]]
'''Магазин''' это одна из команд (STORE) в [[Ship/ru#Терминал|терминале]]. Нужен для покупки предметов.

== Использование ==
Доступ к магазину можно получить с помощью ввода команды "store" в терминал корабля. Она выводит список всех доступных для покупки вещей. Покупка любого снаряжения доступна всегда, а улучшения и декорации корабля ограничены, но изменяются каждый день.

Предметы можно приобрести, введя их название и желаемое количество (например "flashlight 3") в терминал.
Если корабль уже приземлился, то модуль снабжения доставит предметы через 17 секунд после покупки. (или 27, если это первая покупка за день, причем таймер начнёт отсчёт только после 8:09 утра после приземления [[Ship/ru|корабля]]).
При приземлении модуль начнёт играть мелодию, позволяющую сотрудникам найти его.
Предметы должны быть забраны быстро, так как модуль улетает через 30 секунд вне зависимости от того, были ли предметы выданы.

Если во время покупки корабль находится на орбите, модуль приземлится на следующую луну на которую спустятся сотрудники.

Улучшения корабля, декор и костюмы можно купить только единожды. Попытка купить дубликат выведет сообщение <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>, но если ваш баланс слишком мал, то вместо этого будет выдано обычное сообщение о нехватке средств.

=== Скидки ===
Иногда предмет может продаваться по скидке. Это случается наугад, но ограничивается максимальной скидкой для каждого из предметов. Скидки меняются каждый день.

== Ассортимент магазина ==
Покупаемые предметы разделены на четыре категории: снаряжение, апгрейды корабля, декор корабля и костюмы.

== Интересные факты ==
* В магазине имеется, но не показывается предмет под названием [[Mapper tools|Инструменты картографа]], стоящий {{credits|30}}. Страница с информацией о предмете говорит, что он даёт сотрудникам вид сверху на окрестности используя light-detection; хотя при покупке будет доставлена обычная лопата. При выдаче предмета с помощью модов напрямую работает как портативная версия основного монитора корабля.
*Дверной коврик имеет настоящую цену в {{credits|50}} из-за отличающейся конфигурации между внутренними материалами.
* [[Extension ladder/ru|Выдвижную лестницу]] можно использовать, как оружие, если она упадёт на сотрудника.

######## Store/tr
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|Mağaza]]
'''Mağaza''' çeşitli öğeleri satın almak ve teslim etmek için kullanılabilen bir [[Bilgisayar Terminali|terminal]] komutudur.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Kullanım ==
Mağazaya erişmek için gemi terminaline "store" yazın. Bu, o gün satın alınabilecek tüm öğelerin tam bir listesini getirecektir. Çalışanlar her zaman herhangi bir ekipman satın alabilirler ancak gemi yükseltmeleri ve gemi dekorasyonları her gün değişen rastgele bir satın alınabilir öğe rotasyonuna sahiptir.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Bir eşya satın almak için terminale eşyanın adını ve kaç tane almak istediğinizi (örneğin "3 flashlight") yazın. Eğer zaten bir aydaysanız, bir teslimat kapsülü satın aldığınız eşyaları yarım saat içinde teslim edecektir. İndikten sonra, teslimat kapsülü çalışanlar tarafından bulunabilmesi için bir melodi çalar. Çalışanlara eşyaları hızlı bir şekilde almaları tavsiye edilir, çünkü bir süre sonra kapsül, eşyalar toplansada toplanmasa da oradan ayrılır.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Gemi satın alma sırasında yörüngede ise, teslimat kapsülü çalışanların gittiği bir sonraki aya inecektir.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

=== İndirimler ===
Ürünlerin indirime girmesi mümkündür, yani indirimli fiyattan satın alınabilirler. Bu rastgele gerçekleşebilir ve her öğenin kendi maksimum indirim yüzdesi vardır, bu çoğu öğe için %80'dir. Ürün indirimleri her gün yeniden belirlenir.

== Mağaza öğeleri ==
Satın alınabilir öğeler dört kategoriye ayrılır: ekipman, gemi yükseltmeleri, gemi dekorasyonu ve giysiler.

######## Store/uk
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|Магазин]]
'''Магазин''' це [[Computer Terminal|terminal]] команда, завдяки якій можна використовувати для покупки та доставки різних предметів.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Використання ==
Щоб отримати доступ до магазину, напишіть "store" в терміналі корабеля. Це відкрие повний список всіх предметів, які можна придбати в цей день. Працівники завжди зможуть придбати будь-яке обладнення, але покращення для корабеля та декорації для нього мають випадкову ротацію предметів, що змінюється щодня.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Items can be purchased by typing the name of an item and the desired number of that item (e.g. "flashlight 3") into the terminal.
If this ship is already on a moon, a drop pod delivers the bought items 17 seconds after purchase
(or 27 seconds if this is the first order of the day, and with the caveat that the dropship's timer doesn't start until 8:09 AM when the [[ship]] has landed).
Once landed, the drop pod plays a melody so it can be located by employees.
Items must be retrieved quickly as the pod leaves after just 30 seconds, regardless of whether the items were dispensed or not.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
If the ship is in orbit at the time of buying, the drop pod lands on the next moon the employees land on.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Ship upgrades and decor and suits can only be purchased once.
Attempting to buy a duplicate results in the message <q>This has already been unlocked for your ship!</q>
unless your balance is too low, in which case you get the usual out-of-funds message.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Sales ===
It is possible for items to be on sale, meaning they can be purchased at a reduced price. This can happen randomly and every item has its own maximum sale percentage, this being 80% for most of the items. Item sales are re-rolled every day.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Store items ==
Items purchasable are split into four categories: equipment, ship upgrades, ship decoration, and suits.
</div>

######## Store/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{topicon Fandom|Dropship|1}}
{{topicon Fandom|Decor|2}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
<languages/>
[[File:Store.png|thumb|终端的商店页面]]
'''商店'''（store）是一条用于给船员提供如[[Flashlight|手电筒]]和[[Shovel|铲子]]等物品的[[Computer Terminal|终端]]命令。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 用法 ==
在飞船的终端中输入“store”即可访问商店。这将返回当天所有可购买物品的完整列表。员工总是可以购买任何装备，但飞船升级和飞船装饰类物品每天会随机轮换可购买的物品。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
要购买物品，向终端输入物品名称和你想要购买的数量（例如“flashlight 3”）。如果飞船已降落在星球上，一个投放仓会在半小时内将订购物品运送过来。投放仓在降落后会播放音乐，使其更容易被找到。建议员工尽快取得物品，因为'''无论物品是否取得'''，投放仓都会在一段时间后离开。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
如果订购时飞船正在轨道上，投放仓会降落在员工前往的下一个星球上。
</div>

飞船升级、装饰以及外观套装'''只能购买一次'''。
若尝试重复购买，系统会提示：'''该物品已为你的飞船解锁！'''
除非你的余额不足，此时会显示常规的'''资金不足'''提示。

=== 折扣 ===
物品可能会打折出售，这意味着它们可以以更低的价格购买。打折随机发生，且每个物品都有自己的最大折扣百分比，大多数物品的最大折扣为 80％。物品的折扣每天都会轮换。

== 商店物品 ==
可购买的物品被分为四类：装备、飞船升级、飞船装饰和服装。

== Strategie ==

Betäubungsgranaten sind besonders nützlich, um Gegner zu betäuben, die nicht im Nahkampf getötet werden können und eine sichere Flucht zu ermöglichen.

== Company description ==

None present.

== Overview ==

Stun grenades are explosive weapons intended to disorient [[entities]]. Upon being thrown, stun grenades will take 2.25 seconds to detonate, with anything caught in the blast being stunned for 7.5 seconds at base. The actual stun time is affected by the entity's [[Entities#Properties|stun multiplier]], and the formula is:
<!-- TODO: specify the actual range -->
 baseStunTime * stunMultiplier
Additionally, the employee who is holding the grenade when it explodes will take 20 [[damage]].

Below is a quick reference of actual stun times for each stunnable entity.
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|stun_grenade}}
== Strategy ==

Stun grenades can be used to disorient and gain distance from threats, especially those that cannot be killed with melee weapons.

The shell of a used stun grenade can be picked up and thrown again. These spent grenades can be used to activate [[Traps#Landmines|landmines]] from a safe distance by throwing the empty shell onto them.

== History ==

=== [[Version 45]] ===
* Decreased cost to 30

<span id="Overview"></span>
== Visão Geral ==

Granadas de atordoamento são armas explosivas feitas para desorientar [[entities/pt-br|entidades]]. Ao serem jogadas, granadas de atordoamento vão demorar 2,25 segundos para detonarem, com qualquer coisa pega na explosão ser atordoada por, no mínimo, 7,5 segundos. O tempo real de atordoamento é afetado pelo [[Entities/pt-br|multiplicador de atordoamento]] das entidades, é a formula é:
<!-- TODO: specify the actual range -->
 baseStunTime * stunMultiplier
Além do mais, ê funcionárie que estiver segurando a granada quando ela explodir, sofrerá 20 de [[damage/pt-br|dano]].

Abaixo está uma lista do tempos reais de atordoamento para cada entidade atordoavel.
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|stun_grenade}}
<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estratégia ==

Granadas de atordoamento podem ser usadas para desorientar e ganhar distância das ameaças, especialmente aquelas que não podem ser mortas por ataques físicos.

A casca de uma granada de atordoamento usada pode ser pega e jogada novamente. Essas granadas usadas podem ser utilizadas para detonarem [[Landmine/pt-br|minas terrestres]] a uma distância segura ao jogar a casca vazia nelas.

== Общий обзор ==

Светошумовые гранаты - взрывчатка, предназначенная для оглушения [[Entities/ru|сущностей]]. После выдёргивания чеки, гранате понадобится 2.25 секунды, прежде чем взорваться. Всё, что попадет в радиус взрыва будет оглушено на 7.5 секунд по стандарту. Действительное время оглушения зависит от множителя оглушения сущности, формула следующая:
<!-- TODO: specify the actual range -->
 baseStunTime * stunMultiplier
Дополнительно, сотрудник, держащий гранату в руках в момент взрыва получит 20 [[damage|урона]].

Ниже указана краткая таблица действительного времени оглушения для каждой оглушаемой сущности.
{{#invoke:Entities/AutoStunTimeTable|stun_grenade}}
<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Светошумовые гранаты могут быть использованы для дезориентации [[Entities/ru|сущностей]] и получения форы, в особенности тех, которых нельзя убить в ближнем бою.

Оболочка взорванной гранаты может быть подобрана и брошена снова.
Оболочками можно активировать [[Traps/ru|мины]] с безопасной дистанции, кинув её в них.

眩晕手雷是用于震慑[[Entities/zh-cn|实体]]的爆炸性武器。扔出后，眩晕手雷会在 2.25 秒后爆炸，爆炸范围内的任何生物将被眩晕 7.5 秒（基础值），实际眩晕时间还取决于实体的[[Entities/zh-cn#属性|眩晕乘数]]。计算公式为：

######## Suits
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{about|the cosmetic outfits|employees' corpses, which can have the appearance of an empty suit|Body}}

'''Suits''' function as ways to customize the employee's appearance. At the start of each game, only the [[Orange Suit]] is unlocked, except for the [[Weekly Challenge]] where it is replaced by the [[Purple Suit]]. The rest of the unlockable suits must be purchased from the [[Store|store]] via the [[Computer Terminal]].
All unlocked suits are displayed on a rack against the starboard (right) wall of the ship.
Employees can change their appearance at any time (cannot have [[full hands]]) by walking up a suit and holding {{keybind|Interact}}.

Different suits do not provide any direct gameplay advantages beyond cosmetic differences. Sound effects from certain suits, such as the [[Bunny Suit]], are purely cosmetic and will not alert [[Eyeless Dogs]] or other sound-sensitive [[Entities]]. [[Masked]] that spawn on their own will always wear the orange suit, but employees converted into Masked will wear whatever suit they were originally wearing.

== Suit Listings ==

=== Default Suits ===
* [[Orange Suit]], the starting suit for all normal games.
* [[Purple Suit]], the suit used in the [[Weekly Challenge]] game type.

=== Purchasable Suits ===
* [[Green Suit]] - {{credits|60}}
* [[Purple Suit]] - {{credits|70}}
* [[Hazard Suit]] - {{credits|90}}
* [[Bee Suit]] - {{credits|110}}
* [[Bunny Suit]] - {{credits|200}} - makes a spring sound effect heard by players when jumping.
* [[Pajama Suit]] - {{credits|900}}

== Trivia ==

* The default orange suit was originally a tan color, inspired by the Ghost Busters<ref>[[File:Zeekers-Ghost-Busters.png|x200px]]</ref>.

######## TZP-Inhalant/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|primary-use=<q>Take TZP</q> (hold)

The '''TZP-Inhalant''' is a type of [[scrap]] that can be purchased from the [[store]] for {{credits|80}} [[credits]]. It temporarily increases an employee's speed, lowers the burden of their inventory weight, and reduces stamina drain when used by holding down left click. It can be used for 38 seconds before running out.

Inhaling too much results in the employee's vision going red and yellow and their voice becoming higher pitched. With excessive use, their vision will have a smoke effect overlaid.

== Company description ==
{{terminal|This safe and legal medicine can be administered to see great benefits to your performance on the job! Your ability to move LONG distances while carrying HEFTY objects will be second to none! Warning: TZP gas may impact the brain with extended exposure. Follow instructions manual provided with the canister.


Don't forget to share!}}
== Strategy ==

The TZP-Inhalant is best used for escaping threats that can normally outrun the employee, such as [[Thumper|Thumpers]], [[Jester|Jesters]], [[Bracken|Brackens]], and [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]].

TZP-Inhalant is also useful for securing a large amount of [[scrap]] before dangerous [[Entities|entities]] become active in a facility.

It is also good for collecting [[Bee Hive|Bee Hives]], as it allows employees to outrun the [[Circuit Bees]] and secure the hive.

== Trivia ==
* TZP is short for "Tetrazenylpurine", as printed on the can's label. This chemical does not exist in real life.
* The back of the can has a barcode that says "uh why".

######## TZP-Inhalant/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!--normal-->
|primary-use=<q>Take TZP</q> (hold)
|secondary-use=<!--none-->
|tertiary-use=<!--none-->
|inspectable=Yes (undocumented)
}}
'''TZP吸入剂'''是一种[[scrap|废品]]类道具，可从[[store|商店]]花费80[[credits|信用点]]购买。
按住鼠标左键使用时，它能临时提升员工的移动速度、减轻背包负重压力，并减少体力消耗。
该道具可持续使用38秒，之后耗尽。

吸入过量会导致员工的视野变成红黄色，音调变高。过度使用时，视野还会出现烟雾叠加的特效。

<span id="Company_description"></span>
== 公司描述 ==
{{terminal|这种安全合法的药物可显著提升你的工作表现！在搬运重物时仍能长途跋涉的能力将无人能及！
警告：长时间接触TZP气体可能对大脑产生影响。请遵照罐体附带的说明书使用。


别忘了分享！}}
<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 趣闻 ==

TZP吸入剂最适合用来逃脱通常速度快于员工的威胁，例如[[Thumpers|打击者]]、[[Jesters|小丑盒子]]、[[Brackens|蕨影]]和[[Eyeless Dogs|无眼狗]]。

TZP 吸入剂也可用于在危险 [[entities|实体]] 于设施内苏醒前，快速搜刮大量 [[scrap|废料]]。

它也适用于收集[[Bee Hive|蜂巢]]，因为它能让员工跑得过[[Circuit Bees|电路蜜蜂]]并顺利拿到蜂巢。

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== 趣闻 ==
* 罐体标签上标明，TZP 是“四唑基嘌呤”的缩写。该化学物质在现实中并不存在。
* 罐子背面有一个条形码，旁边写着：“呃，为什么”。

######## Teleporter
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{infobox Furniture
| name = Teleporter
| image = Teleporter.png
| defaultprice = 375
}}
== Company Description ==
{{terminal|
Press the button to activate the teleporter. It will teleport whoever is currently being monitored on the ship's radar. They will not be able to keep any of their held items through the teleport. It takes about ten seconds to recharge.
}}
== Overview ==
The Teleporter can be used to teleport the employee currently being monitored on to the ship, dropping all of their items in their position before the teleportation. Another use case is the retrieval of dead employees' bodies. However, this does not work with death to a [[Forest Keeper]], an [[Earth Leviathan]], a [[Giant Sapsucker]], quicksand on [[Weather|Rainy]] moons or [[March]] and [[Adamance]]'s permanent mudpits, drowning on [[Gordion]] and getting consumed by the [[Gordion|'''Company Monster''']].

== Strategy ==
Teleportation can be used to risk one employee acting as bait for some kind of monster to then return them back safely. Teleportation can save an employee from a [[Forest Keeper]]'s grip if they're not eaten yet, or an [[Old Bird]] preparing to burn them, but it's best to activate the teleporter before the entity picks them up due to the delay. It is possible to save an employee who has stepped onto a [[Landmine]] by teleporting them back to the ship before they step off, although the landmine can also be temporarily disarmed from the terminal.

Teleporting an employee who is holding a baby [[Maneater]] is extremely inadvisable. The Maneater will be teleported with them and begin crying immediately, which will cause it to transform unless it can be returned to the interior within 17 seconds. On most moons this is extremely difficult, if not impossible.

######## The Company
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company_Monster}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{stub}}
{{spoilers}}
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
The '''titular company''' of ''Lethal Company'' is a corporate entity that engages in the collection of scrap from abandoned, industrialized moons. Its primary objective is to meet a profit quota through these operations. It incentivizes its contracted workers in two ways. First, by allowing them to use the earnings they make to explore new, potentially more lucrative moons, purchase suits, and decorate their ships. Second, by ejecting the employees into the dark void of space should they fail.

<!--T:12-->
== Selling Scrap ==
Scrap can be sold by landing on [[Gordion]], the moon where the company resides. It is possible to visit the company at any point in the game and no days will be lost. it is advised to wait for the last day before selling as the value at which the company buys scrap drastically increases as time goes on.

<!--T:13-->
* Day 3: Buying at 30%
* Day 2: Buying at 53%
* Day 1: Buying at 77%
* Day 0: Buying at 100%

<!--T:14-->
== The Company Monster ==
The Company Monster is the creature that collects the sold items and supposedly operates the speaker that outputs the voice lines when items are sold. It is also the entity that kills employees when they spam the bell and are too loud.

<!--T:15-->
==== Behavior ====
How the company behaves is based on the '''company mood'''. The company mood before the first quota is reached is always '''Agitated.''' After the first quota has been reached, the mood is chosen randomly at the start of each day. The following three company moods exist in the game.
{| class="wikitable"
|+
!Company Mood
!Irritability
!Starting Patience
!Sensitivity
!Judgement Speed
!Max Player Kills
!Monster Type
|-
|Agitated
|0.8
|2
|0.6
|2
|2
|Tentacles
|-
|Silent Calm
|0.4
|3
|0.7
|5
|1
|Tentacles
|-
|Snoring Giant
|0.5
|2
|0.25
|3
|1
|Tentacles
|}

<!--T:7-->
===== Noise detection =====
The company monster always starts asleep and with the door closed. Every time a [[Audible_sounds|noise]] is detected the door comes closer to opening. The noise can originate from the bell or from any source that is loud enough (above 0.4 loudness), except for the sound of dropping items or sounds that are too far away. This subtracted value is multiplied by the noise loudness and divided by the employee count (i.e. The more employees, the longer it takes for the monster to open the door). The noise also causes the patience level of the monster to drop.

<!--T:16-->
Because of the loudness requirement, Walking, the [[Old Phone]] sounds, [[Teeth]] chattering, the [[Rubber Duckie]] sound and turning a [[Flashlight]]/[[Pro-Flashlight|Pro Flashlight]] on or off can't be heard<ref>https://pastebin.com/emuuKrWH</ref>

<!--T:8-->
===== Patience level =====
The company monster's starting patience level is based on the company mood. The patience level determines how likely the monster is to attack employees and how long it takes to open and close the door. The monster's patience level drops every time a noise is detected. This patience level drop is multiplied by the loudness of the noise and the current company moods irritability. The higher the irritability, the faster the patience drops. There is a 1 second cool down before the next patience level drops can occur.

<!--T:9-->
Once the patience level dropped below 1, the monster starts emitting deep growling sounds to warn the employees that it is about to attack. This noise like every noise the monster makes can vary based on the company mood.

<!--T:10-->
===== Attack =====
Once the patience level drops below 0, every following noise has a 50% chance to cause the monster to come out and attack. The time it takes for the attack to finish depends on the type of company monster which is again defined by the company mood (the only monster type to currently exist in the game is '''Tentacles''').
*'''Tentacles:''' Kill animation takes 3 seconds
*'''Tongue:''' Kill animation takes 2 seconds
*'''Giant Hand:''' Kill animation takes 3 seconds
Depending on the company mood's ''Max employee Kills'', the monster can kill more than one employee before retreating and adding 6 to its patience level. One second after the attack, the door closes again.

<!--T:19-->
===== Selling =====
After the monster takes the scrap it starts evaluating the items which takes a variable amount of time. This time delay is defined by the company mood's ''Judgement Speed''.

<!--T:20-->
There is a 29% chance that the monster attacks immediately after the scrap is evaluated if the average scrap value was smaller or equal to 3 and the patience level is below or equal to 2. If this does not happen, the patience level is raised by 3, the door is closed and a voice line is played on the speaker. If the total value of the scrap sold is less than 25% of the crews current credit amount, a "bad job" sound is played, otherwise a "good job" sound is played.

== Trivia == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
* In the logs written by Sigurd, it is mentioned that the company sometimes buys at higher marks beyond 100%. This is not able to occur ingame.
* Occasionally when starting a new game, there will be a requirement to make a quota of 0. This can be done by immediately landing on Gordion and taking off again, however it will set the [[Gordion|Company Mood]] to random, rather than agitated.
</translate>
