######## The Company/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company_Monster}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{stub}}
{{spoilers}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
{{Stub}}{{Template:Spoilers/pt-br}}
A '''companhia titular''' de ''Lethal Company'' é uma entidade corporativa que atua na coleção de sucata em luas abandonadas e industrializadas. Seu objetivo primário é alcançar uma meta por essas operações. Ela incentiva sues noves funcionáries de duas formas. Primeiro, ao permitir que elus utilizem seus lucros para explorar luas novas e potencialmente mais lucrativas, comprar trajes e decorar suas naves. Segundo, ao ejetar sues funcionáries no vazio escuro do espaço se elus falharem.
</div>

== Vendendo Sucata ==
Sucata pode ser vendida ao pousar em [[Gordion/pt-br|Gordion]], a lua onde a companhia resida. É possível visitar a companhia a qualquer ponto no jogo e nenhum dia será perdido. É recomendado esperar pelo último dia antes de vender, porque o valor de venda aumenta drasticamente ao passar do tempo.

* Dia 3: Comprando a 30%
* Dia 2: Comprando a 53%
* Dia 1: Comprando a 77%
* Dia 0: Comprando a 100%

== O Monstro da Companhia ==
O Monstro da Companhia é a criatura que coleta os itens vendidos e supostamente opera a caixa de som que fala as frases quando os itens são vendidos. Também é a entidade que mata ês funcionáries se elus tocarem o sino demais ou serem autes demais.

==== Comportamento ====
Como a Companhia se comporta é baseado no ''humor da companhia''. O humor da companhia antes da primeira meta é sempre '''Agitado.''' Após a primeira meta ter sido concluída, o humor é escolhido aleatoriamente ao inicio de cada dia. Os três humores a seguir existem no jogo.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===== Detecção de som =====
O Monstro da Companhia sempre inicia adormecido e com a porta fechada. Toda vez que [[Audible_sounds/pt-br|som]] é detectado, o timer para abrir a porta diminui. O som pode se originar do sino ou de qualquer fonte que for alta o suficiente (acima de 0,4 de volume), exceto pelo som que soltar itens ou sons que estão muito longes. Esse valor subtraído é multiplicado pelo volume do som e dividido pela quantidade de funcionáries (ou seja, quantos mais funcionárires, mais demora para o monstro abrir a porta). O som também faz com que o nível de paciência do monstro diminua.
</div>

Por causa na necessidade de volume, andar, o sons do [[Old Phone/pt-br|celular velho]], [[Teeth/pt-br|dentadura]] e [[Rubber Duckie/pt-br|patinho de borracha]] e ao ligar e desligar uma [[Flashlight/pt-br|lanterna]]/[[Pro-Flashlight/pt-br|lanterna pro]] não podem ser ouvidos.<ref>https://pastebin.com/emuuKrWH</ref>

===== Nível de paciência =====
O nível de paciência inicial do monstro da companhia é baseado no humor da companhia. O nível de paciência determina o quão provável o monstro ataca ês funcionáries e quanto tempo precisa para fechar e abrir a porta. O nível de paciência do monstro diminui toda vez que um som é detectado. Essa queda do nível de paciência é multiplicado pelo volume do som e a irritabilidade do humor da companhia atual. Quanto maior a irritabilidade, o mais rápido a paciência diminui. Tem um ''cooldown'' de 1 segundo antes da próxima queda de nível de paciência pode ocorrer.

Quando o nível da paciência diminuiu abaixo de 1, o monstro começa a emitir sons de grunhidos para avisar ês funcionáries que ele irá atacar. Esse som, igual a todo outro som que o monstro faz, varia com base no humor da companhia.

===== Ataque =====
Quando o nível de paciência cai abaixo de 0, cada som seguinte tem uma chance de 50% de fazer o monstro sair e atacar. O tempo que leva para o ataque terminar depende no tipo de monstro da companhia que é, novamente, definido pelo humor da companhia (o único tipo de monstro que atualmente existe no jogo é '''Tentáculos''').
*'''Tentáculos:''' Animação de morte leva 3 segundos
*'''Língua:''' Animação de morte leva 2 segundos
*'''Mão Gigante:''' Animação de morte leva 3 segundos
Dependendo nas ''Eliminações Máximas de Jogadores'' do humor da companhia, o monstro pode matar mais de ume funcionárie antes de recuar e adicionar 6 para seu nível de paciência. Um segundo após o ataque, a porta fecha novamente.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
===== Selling =====
After the monster takes the scrap it starts evaluating the items which takes a variable amount of time. This time delay is defined by the company mood's ''Judgement Speed''.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a 29% chance that the monster attacks immediately after the scrap is evaluated if the average scrap value was smaller or equal to 3 and the patience level is below or equal to 2. If this does not happen, the patience level is raised by 3, the door is closed and a voice line is played on the speaker. If the total value of the scrap sold is less than 25% of the crews current credit amount, a "bad job" sound is played, otherwise a "good job" sound is played.
</div>

* Ocasionalmente ao iniciar um novo jogo, haverá uma necessidade de concluir uma meta de 0. Isso pode ser feito ao imediatamente pousar em Gordion e decolar novamente, porém isso fará com que o [[Gordion/pt-br|Humor da Companhia]] seja aleatório, ao invés de agitado.

######## The Company/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom|The_Company_Monster}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{stub}}
{{spoilers}}
《致命公司》中'''标题所指的公司'''，是一家从废弃工业化卫星收集废料的企业实体。其核心目标是通过此类业务完成利润配额。该公司通过两种方式激励签约员工：第一，允许员工用赚取的收益探索更具价值的新卫星、购买防护服以及装饰飞船；第二，若员工未能完成任务，则将其抛入黑暗的太空虚空。

== 出售废料 ==
废料可通过降落至[[Gordion]]（公司总部所在的卫星）进行出售。游戏中可随时前往该星球，且不会消耗天数。建议等到最后一天再出售，因为公司收购废料的价格会随时间推移大幅上涨。

* 第3天：以30%价格收购
* 第2天：以53%价格收购
* 第1天：以77%价格收购
* 第0天：以100%价格收购

== 公司怪物 ==
公司怪物是负责回收已出售物品的生物，据推测也是它操控着出售物品时播放语音的扬声器。当员工狂按铃铛导致噪音过大时，也是这个实体将其杀死。

==== 行为机制 ====
公司的行为模式取决于**公司情绪**。在完成第一个配额之前，公司情绪始终为**焦躁**。完成首个配额后，每天开始时会随机选择一种情绪。游戏内共有三种公司情绪，如下所示。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
===== 声音检测 =====
公司怪物初始处于沉睡状态，且大门紧闭。每次检测到[[可听声音|声音]]时，开启大门的倒计时就会缩短。声音来源可以是铃铛，或任何响度足够大（超过0.4）的声源，但丢弃物品的声音以及距离过远的声音除外。减少的时间值会按声音响度相乘，并除以员工数量（即：员工越多，怪物开启大门所需的时间越长）。声音同时也会降低怪物的耐心值。
</div>

由于响度要求，行走、[[老式电话]]音效、[[牙齿]]磨牙声、[[橡皮小鸭]]音效，以及开关[[手电筒]]/[[专业手电筒]]都无法被公司怪物听到。

===== 耐心值 =====
公司怪物的初始耐心值取决于公司当前情绪。耐心值决定了怪物攻击员工的概率，以及大门开启和关闭所需的时间。每次检测到声音时，怪物的耐心值都会下降。耐心值的下降幅度会乘以声音响度与当前公司情绪的易怒度。易怒度越高，耐心值下降得越快。下次耐心值下降前会有1秒的冷却时间。

当耐心值降至1以下时，怪物会开始发出低沉的咆哮声，警告玩家它即将发动攻击。和怪物发出的所有声音一样，这种咆哮声也会根据公司的不同情绪而有所变化。

===== 攻击 =====
当耐心值降至0以下后，之后每一次发出声响都有50%的概率使怪物现身并发动攻击。攻击结束所需的时间取决于公司怪物的类型，而该类型同样由公司情绪决定（目前游戏中唯一存在的怪物类型为**触手**）。

***触手：** 击杀动画持续3秒
***舌头：** 击杀动画持续2秒
***巨手：** 击杀动画持续3秒

根据公司情绪对应的**最大击杀员工数**，怪物在撤退前可以击杀多名员工，撤退后其耐心值会增加6点。攻击结束1秒后，大门会再次关闭。

== 趣闻 ==

* 在西格德撰写的日志中提到，公司有时会以**超过100%**的价格收购废料。这一情况**在游戏内实际无法发生**。
* 偶尔在开始新游戏时，会出现利润配额要求为 *0 的情况。只需立即降落在Gordion后再次起飞即可完成任务，但这会使[[Company Mood|公司情绪]]变为随机状态，而非焦躁。

<!--T:9-->
The '''Thumper''', also known as the "Half" or internally as the "Crawler", is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It is incapable of hearing and relies on eyesight to hunt down and attack employees, rapidly accelerating when moving and decelerating when turning corners or upon hitting a wall. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Offense]].

<!--T:17-->
Thumpers are bipedal entities with beige skin, consisting of a shark-like head, black eyes, a mouth with sharp teeth and a pink tongue, and three other separate mouths wrapping around their head. Their bodies only consist of a broad chest and long arms ending in stubby, bloodstained hands.

== Bestiary entry == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{quote bestiary}}
<translate>

<!--T:16-->
== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

<!--T:3-->
== Mechanics ==
Thumpers patrol the facility at a steady pace. They are deaf and rely entirely on sight. After spotting an employee they will pursue them and investigate their last seen areas to find them again if line of sight is broken. Thumpers steadily gain speed while moving and lose some speed when turning. If a Thumper is moving fast enough to hit a wall, it will lose most of its speed in doing so. They can reach speeds faster than any employee can under the right conditions. When a Thumper reaches its target, they will deliver strong and rapid bites until the target is dead.

<!--T:4-->
== Strategy ==
Thumpers are quick and dangerous. They take 4 [[Shovel]] hits to kill and kills an employee in 4 quick bites. They are very fast, steadily gaining speed as they move forward, and lose some speed when turning. If handled poorly, they will reach speeds faster than can be outrun by any means. Taking sharp turns around many corners will significantly aid escape attempts. [[Stun grenade]]s and [[Zap gun]]s can be useful if any are on hand. With good enough execution, an employee can run around a Thumper in a circle, leaving them helpless to attacks.

<!--T:6-->
You can also kill them with a single shovel with enough practice. Be warned that hitting a thumper will increase its speed slightly, which means it will make it harder to kill as the fight progresses. Try fighting the thumper by circling it or baiting it into walls, as these two methods help balance its speed increases.

== History == <!--T:5-->

<!--T:13-->
There used to be a bug that let you simply stand on railings to avoid a thumper's attack, but this was fixed in update 45. Before update 45, thumpers only lost a reasonable amount of speed when turning completely around, letting them get extremely fast, up to around 4x an employee's normal speed.

<!--T:14-->
After update 47, thumpers will now lose significant speed when running into walls. Due to the fact thumpers do not have very fast turning speed, this addition makes thumpers much easier to escape when not armed with a shovel or sign. Before update 47, thumpers would move at a crawl when starting its first chase, and if the thumper cannot find the employee they will continue to gain speed as they are searching for them. After update 47, thumpers now have a higher minimum starting speed, and now if they lose an employee, they will not gain anymore speed looking for them.
</translate>

== Spielmechaniken ==
Stampfer durchstreifen das Gebäude in einem konstanten Tempo. Sie sind taub und verlassen sich ganz auf ihr Sehvermögen. Entdecken sie einen Mitarbeiter, verfolgen sie diesen. Sollten sie ihn aus den Augen verlieren, prüfen sie immer den letzten Ort an dem sie ihn gesehen haben. Stampfer bauen beim Laufen immer mehr Geschwindigkeit auf, aber verlieren einen Teil ihrer Geschwindigkeit wenn sie sich drehen. Genauso verlieren sie einen Großteil ihrer Geschwindigkeit, wenn sie in eine Wand rennen. Unter idealen Umständen können sie schneller werden als Mitarbeiter. Wenn Stampfer ihre Beute schnappen, töten sie diese mit ihren kräftigen Bissen.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Strategie == 
Stampfer sind schnell und gefährlich. Man braucht 4 Treffer mit der [[Shovel|Schaufel]] um sie zu töten, während sie nur 3 Bisse brauchen um einen Mitarbeiter zu töten. Solange sie sich vorwärts bewegen, werden sie immer schneller. Jedoch verlieren sie Tempo beim Wenden. Geht man nicht richtig mit ihnen um, können sie so hohe Geschwindigkeiten erreichen, dass eine Flucht unmöglich wird. Deshalb sollte man beim Wegrennen möglichst viele Haken schlagen oder sich mit Waffen wie den [[Stun Grenades|Betäubungsgranaten]] oder der [[Zap Gun|Betäubungspistole]] verteidigen. Ein besonders geschickter Mitarbeiter kann einen Stampfer in Kreisen laufen lassen, um diesen hilflos Angriffen auszuliefern.
</div>

Man kann sie mit einer einzigen Schaufel und genug Übung töten. Man sollte allerdings im Hinterkopf behalten, dass Stampfer schneller werden, wenn sie geschlagen werden. Deswegen sollte man sich in Kreisen bewegen oder sie gegen Wände rennen lassen, um ihr Tempo unter Kontrolle zu halten.

<span id="History"></span>
== Verlauf ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Vor Version 45 gab es einen Bug, der es Spielern erlaubte einfach auf Geländern zu stehen und so den Angriffen der Stampfer zu entgehen. Auch haben Stampfer vor dieser Version nur einen geringeren Anteil ihrer Geschwindigkeit beim Wenden verloren, wodurch sie bis zu 4x schneller als Spieler werden konnten.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Seit Update 47 verlieren Stampfer nun einen erheblichen Teil ihrer Geschwindigkeit, wenn sie gegen Wände rennen. Da Stampfer sich nicht besonders schnell drehen können, kann man mit dieser Änderungen viel einfacher unbewaffnet vor ihnen entkommen. Vor dieser Änderung waren Stampfer nur zu Beginn langsam und bauten immer mehr Tempo auf, während sie nach Spielern suchten. Mit Version 47 haben sie zwar ein höheres Starttempo, bauen aber nicht mehr Tempo auf, wenn sie ihr Ziel verlieren.
</div>

The '''Thumper''', also known as the "Half" or internally as the "Crawler", is a hostile indoor [[Entities|entity]]. It is incapable of hearing and relies on eyesight to hunt down and attack employees, rapidly accelerating when moving and decelerating when turning corners or upon hitting a wall. The [[Moons|moon]] they are most commonly found on is [[Offense]].

Thumpers are bipedal entities with beige skin, consisting of a shark-like head, black eyes, a mouth with sharp teeth and a pink tongue, and three other separate mouths wrapping around their head. Their bodies only consist of a broad chest and long arms ending in stubby, bloodstained hands.

== Bestiary entry ==
{{quote bestiary}}

== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== Mechanics ==
Thumpers patrol the facility at a steady pace. They are deaf and rely entirely on sight. After spotting an employee they will pursue them and investigate their last seen areas to find them again if line of sight is broken. Thumpers steadily gain speed while moving and lose some speed when turning. If a Thumper is moving fast enough to hit a wall, it will lose most of its speed in doing so. They can reach speeds faster than any employee can under the right conditions. When a Thumper reaches its target, they will deliver strong and rapid bites until the target is dead.

== Strategy ==
Thumpers are quick and dangerous. They take 4 [[Shovel]] hits to kill and kills an employee in 4 quick bites. They are very fast, steadily gaining speed as they move forward, and lose some speed when turning. If handled poorly, they will reach speeds faster than can be outrun by any means. Taking sharp turns around many corners will significantly aid escape attempts. [[Stun grenade]]s and [[Zap gun]]s can be useful if any are on hand. With good enough execution, an employee can run around a Thumper in a circle, leaving them helpless to attacks.

You can also kill them with a single shovel with enough practice. Be warned that hitting a thumper will increase its speed slightly, which means it will make it harder to kill as the fight progresses. Try fighting the thumper by circling it or baiting it into walls, as these two methods help balance its speed increases.

== History ==

There used to be a bug that let you simply stand on railings to avoid a thumper's attack, but this was fixed in update 45. Before update 45, thumpers only lost a reasonable amount of speed when turning completely around, letting them get extremely fast, up to around 4x an employee's normal speed.

After update 47, thumpers will now lose significant speed when running into walls. Due to the fact thumpers do not have very fast turning speed, this addition makes thumpers much easier to escape when not armed with a shovel or sign. Before update 47, thumpers would move at a crawl when starting its first chase, and if the thumper cannot find the employee they will continue to gain speed as they are searching for them. After update 47, thumpers now have a higher minimum starting speed, and now if they lose an employee, they will not gain anymore speed looking for them.

== Mécanismes ==
Les '''cogneurs''' patrouillent l'intérieur à un rythme soutenu. Ils sont sourds et ne se fie qu'à leurs visions. Après avoir repéré un employé, ils vont le poursuivre et enquêter la zone où l'employé a été vu pour la dernière fois. Les '''cogneurs''' gagnent rapidement en vitesse une fois leur proie repérée et en perdent lorsqu'ils tournent. Si un '''Cogneur''' à une grande vitesse et qu'il se cogne à un mur, il perdra la quasi totalité de sa vitesse. Sous les bonnes conditions, un '''Cogneur''' peut atteindre une vitesse supérieur à n'importe quel employé. Une fois que le '''Cogneur''' a atteint sa cible, il délivrera plusieurs morsures rapides jusqu'à la mort de la proie.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Stratégie ==
Les '''cogneurs''' sont rapides et dangereux. Ils meurent en 4 coups de [[Shovel|Pelle]] et tue un employé en 3 morsures. Ils sont très rapides, gagnent constamment de la vitesse en ligne droite, et en perdent lorsqu'ils tournent. Si mal géré, ils gagneront rapidement une vitesse rendant toutes fuites impossibles. Prendre des virages serrés au détour de nombreux angles peut grandement aider la fuite. Des [[Stun Grenade|Grenades assourdissantes]] et un [[Zap Gun]] peuvent être utiles afin de ralentir le '''Cogneur''' et fuir. Avec suffisamment d’entraînement, un employé peut tourner en cercle autour du '''Cogneur''', empêchant toutes morsures de ce dernier.
</div>

Il est possible de tuer un '''Cogneur''' avec seulement une [[Shovel|Pelle]] et de l'entraînement. Un employé essayant de tuer un '''Cogneur''' doit garder en mémoire que ce dernier gagnera en vitesse après avoir reçu un coup, rendant l'affrontement plus difficile. Essayez d'affronter le '''Cogneur''' en tournant autour de lui ou en le faisant foncer dans des murs, afin de constamment réduire sa vitesse.

<span id="History"></span>
== Historique ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Il y avait un bug qui permettait à un employé de se mettre sur un rail afin d'éviter les attaques du '''Cogneur'''. Ce bug a été fixé dans la version 45. Avant cette version, le '''Cogneur''' ne perdait qu'une faible quantité de vitesse après s'être complètement retourné, lui conférant une vitesse jusqu'à 4x fois celle d'un joueur.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
À partir de la version 47, le '''Cogneur''' perdra une grande partie de sa vitesse lors qu'il tapera dans un mur. Couplé au fait que les '''Cogneurs''' se tournent lentement, cet ajout permet de fuir plus facilement si le joueur n'a pas d'arme sur lui. Avant la version 47, le '''Cogneur''' démarré sa chasse avec une vitesse très faible, tout en gagnant progressivement de la vitesse. Maintenant, le '''Cogneur''' commence sa poursuivre avec un vitesse de départ plus élevé, et s'il perd de vue le joueur, il ne gagnera plus de vitesse.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Batedores''', são mencionados como "Metades" as vezes, são seres de duas pernas muito agressivos e são achados em [[interiors|interiores]]. Não possuem audição alguma e são totalmente dependentes em sua visão e vão tentar perseguir ume funcionárie quando encontrarem ume.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Thumpers are bipedal entities with beige skin, consisting of a shark-like head, black eyes, a mouth with sharp teeth and a pink tongue, and three other separate mouths wrapping around their head. Their bodies only consist of a broad chest and long arms ending in stubby, bloodstained hands.
</div>

<span id="Bestiary_entry"></span>
== Entrada do Bestiário ==
{{quote bestiary}}

== Spawn chances ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== Mecânicas ==
Batedores andam pelo interior com uma velocidade constante. Eles são surdos e são totalmente dependentes em sua visão. Após avistar ume funcionárie, eles começarão a persegui-le e investigar a última área que ê avistou para tentar acha-le de novo caso você saia da visão deles. Batedores ganham velocidade enquanto se movem em linha reta e perdem bastante ao tentar fazer uma curva. Se um estiver movendo rápido o suficiente para bater em uma parede, ele vai perder quase toda a sua velocidade. Eles conseguem alcançar velocidades mais rápidas que ume funcionárie consegue. Quando um Batedor pegar o seu alvo ele vai dar mordidas rápidas e fortes até que seu alvo esteja morto.

== Estratégia ==
Batedores são rápidos e perigosos. Eles levam 4 pancadas com a [[Shovel/pt-br|Pá]] para morrerem ao mesmo tempo que matam ês funcionáries com 3 mordidas. Eles ganham velocidade conforme eles andam reto, e perdem velocidade ao fazer curvas. Se você não tomar cuidado, eles podem alcançar velocidades muito rápidas que não poderão ser ultrapassadas. Fazer curvas fechadas ajudam significativamente a sua sobrevivência. [[Stun Grenade/pt-br|granadas de atordoamento]] e [[Zap Gun/pt-br|armas de choque]] podem ser utilizadas contra eles. Utilizando de uma boa tática, ume funcionárie consegue correr de um Thumper em um círculo, abrindo brecha para bater neles.

Você também pode matá-los com apenas uma pá se você possuir bastante prática. Porém tome cuidado pois a cada pancada em um Batedor vai levemente aumentar a velocidade dele, o que significa que vai ser um pouco mais difícil de matá-los. Tente lutar contra um rodando em círculos contra ele ou fazendo com que ele bata em paredes, utilizando desses dois métodos vai facilitar a reduzir a velocidade dele.

<span id="History"></span>
== Histórico ==

Existia um bug no jogo que permitia você ficar em cima dos corrimões para evitar os ataques de um Batedor, isso foi corrigido na versão 45. Antes da versão 45, Batedores perdiam velocidade apenas quando faziam uma curva completa, oque permitia eles a ficar muito rápido, 4 vezes mais rápido que ume funcionárie.

Depois da atualização 47, Batedores agora perdem muito mais velocidade ao bater numa parede, Por conta do fato que Batedores não tem velocidade de curva muito rápida, essa adição fez os Batedores muito mais fáceis de se escapar. Antes da atualização 47, os Batedores iriam andar lentamente antes de sua primeira caçada, e se o Batedor não conseguisse encontrar ê funcionárie, ele ia continuar a ganhar velocidade mesmo assim. Depois da atualização 47, Batedores agora tem um valor de velocidade inicial maior, e quando eles perderem ume funcionárie, eles não vão mais ganhar velocidade enquanto procuram por ele.

== Запись в Бестиарии ==
{{quote bestiary}}

== Шансы появления ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== Механики ==
Топотуны патрулируют здание в устойчивом темпе. Они глухие и опираются исключительно на зрение. Если заметят сотрудника - они станут его преследовать и, в случае если потеряли его из виду, станут исследовать территорию, на которой добыча была в последний раз замечена. Если Топотун движется достаточно быстро, чтобы удариться о стену, то в случае этого потеряет большую часть своей скорости. В подходящих условиях они достигают высоких скоростей быстрее, чем на это способен кто-либо из сотрудников. Когда Топотун достигает своей цели, он будет причинять сильные и стремительные укусы до тех пор, пока цель не умрёт.

== Стратегия ==
Топотуны быстры и опасны. Для их убийства требуется 4 удара [[Shovel/ru|Лопатой]], а сами убивают сотрудников за 4 быстрых укуса. Они очень быстрые, медленно но верно набирают скорость пока движутся вперёд и теряют её на поворотах. Если с ними неосторожно обращаться, они станут настолько быстрыми, что от них более никак нельзя будет оторваться. Совершение резких поворотов через кучу углов сильно увеличит шансы на успешный побег. [[Stun grenade/ru|Светошумовые гранаты]] и [[Zap Gun/ru|Электро-пушки]] могут быть полезными если имеются под рукой. При хорошем исполнении сотрудник может наворачивать круги вокруг Топотуна, оставляя их уязвимыми для безответных атак.

Их также можно убить одной лишь лопатой при достаточном опыте. Имейте в виду, что удары по Топотуну немного увеличивают его скорость, а значит с течением битвы убить его будет сложно. Попробуйте сражаться с ним наворачивая круги или заманивайте его так, чтобы он врезался в стены, так как оба эти метода нивелируют получаемую им от ударов скорость.

<span id="History"></span>
== История ==

Существовал баг, позволявший просто стоять на перилах чтобы избежать атак топотуна, но это исправили в версии 45. До версии 45 Топотуны тратили совсем немного скорости при полном развороте, позволяя им становиться экстремально быстрыми, достигая скорости в четыре раза большей нормальной скорости сотрудника.

После выхода версии 47 Топотуны стали терять значительную часть скорости при врезании в стены. Учитывая, что Топотуны поворачиваются очень медленно, это дополнение делает побег от них намного легче при отсутствии лопаты или дорожного знака. До версии 47 Топотуны двигались со скоростью ползка в начале первой погони и если не могли найти сотрудника, всё равно продолжали набирать скорость в поиске сбежавшей жертвы. После выхода версии 47 минимальная начальная скорость Топотуна увеличилась, а также теперь когда они теряют сотрудника из виду, то больше не ускоряются в его поисках.

== 生成概率 ==
{{Template:WikiAutomated/EntitySpawnChances}}

== 机制 ==
打击者会以稳定的速度在设施内巡逻。它们听不见声音，完全依赖视觉感知环境。一旦其发现员工，打击者就会追逐该员工。若其视线被阻断，打击者会调查员工最后出现的区域，以便再次找到他们。打击者在移动时会逐渐加速，并在转向时损失一部分速度。如果打击者在速度足够快时撞到墙上，它会损失大部分速度。若条件允许，它能跑得比任何员工都要快。当打击者追到它的目标时，它会给予目标强烈而快速的撕咬，直至目标死亡。

== 策略 ==
打击者是速度快且危险的存在。员工需要 4 [[Shovel|铲子]]将其击杀，而打击者只需要 4 次快速撕咬即可杀死员工。它移动速度很快，会在前进时稳定增加速度，在转向时损失部分速度。如果处理不当，它可加速至任何手段都无法逃脱的超高速度。在多个拐角处急转弯、使用[[Stun Grenade|眩晕手雷]]或[[Zap Gun|电击枪]]眩晕打击者，都可以有效地争取到逃生机会。若处理得当，单独一名员工就能绕着打击者转上一圈，使其完全无法发动攻击。

如果有足够的经验，仅使用一把铲子就能杀死打击者。需要注意，打击者受击后，其移动速度会略微增快，意味着其击杀难度会随缠斗时间上升。尝试在缠斗中绕圈或引诱打击者撞到墙上，因为这两种方法可以抑制其速度提升。

<span id="History"></span>
== 历史 ==

曾经存在一个漏洞，玩家只需站在栏杆上就能躲避打击者的攻击，但该漏洞已在第45次更新中修复。在第45次更新之前，打击者在完全转身时仅会损失适量速度，这使得它们速度极快，最高可达玩家正常移动速度的4倍左右。

在V47更新后，重击者撞到墙壁时会大幅损失速度。由于重击者的转向速度本身并不快，这一改动使得玩家在没有铲子或指示牌的情况下也更容易摆脱它们。

在V47更新之前，打击者在开始第一次追击时移动速度会非常缓慢；而如果找不到目标玩家，它们会在搜寻过程中不断加速。V47更新后，打击者拥有了更高的初始最低速度，并且在丢失目标后，不会再因搜寻而继续加速。

== Introduction ==
Lethal Company is a game with many features and in-depth game mechanics, and can feel overwhelming when playing for the first time. This page is meant to help with that by listing helpful tips, tricks, and guides to help you reach those higher quotas!

== Service Manual == <!--T:2-->

<!--T:15-->
{{main|Clipboard}}

<!--T:3-->
== Guide ==
Hey future hires, this page should hopefully teach you a little more about what to expect.

=== General Tips === <!--T:4-->

<!--T:5-->
It is recommended for starting players to come up with a grouping system that works for them.  If that group system is having a person in the ship and everyone else split up in the facility, or if it's splitting off in to groups of two.  Ultimately the best grouping system is whatever your team seems to flow with the best.

<!--T:6-->
It should be a habit to always remember to charge any battery powered tools before you land.  Going in with a dead [[Flashlight]] or dead [[Walkie-talkie]] isn't going to do you any good.

<!--T:7-->
The terminal is an extremely helpful tool, it is recommended to have at least one employee know how to operate it fairly well.

<!--T:8-->
== The rest of this page is in heavy rework ==
=== Moons ===
The moons are where you land to collect scrap.  Some can provide a challenge built into their structure such as [[Assurance]] being a very rocky place that's entrances are fairly far from the ship, or like [[Vow]] and [[Adamance]] that have unstable bridges that can collapse under the stress of too much weight.  They can also have [[Weather|weather]] conditions such as fog, which reduces your ability to see outside hostiles, or rainy conditions, which cause quicksand-like puddles to appear that can be very hard to notice until it's too late.

=== Outside === <!--T:9-->

<!--T:14-->
The outdoor layout of each [[Moons|moon]] is always the same as well as the position in which the ships lands. Once you've familiarized yourself with each, you'll have an easier time reaching the entrance(s) to the inside. In addition to the easily-accessible main entrance, each moon has at least one [[Interiors#Fire exits|Fire exit]], with [[March]] possessing the most (3). These ulterior doors are useful for navigating to different parts of the facility more easily, and for covering more ground as a team at the start of a round. Barring any [[weather]] conditions, the outside is generally safe at the start of a round. As the day progresses, however, spawn rates for hostile enemies will increase, often resulting in [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]], [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]], or even [[Earth Leviathan|Earth Leviathans]] patrolling near the ship.

<!--T:10-->
=== Inside ===
Typically when entering a facility, you'll want to check the main and immediately adjacent rooms for items, as there will often be one or more pieces of [[scrap]] nearby. It's a common strategy to grab these items and place them outside of the main entrance (or any fire exit) to ferry to the ship later -- especially two-handed items. It is extremely useful to take advantage of your scan ability (RMB) to find pieces of loot that may be obscured by darkness or other obstacles, as well as helping you see a little bit better, and it will alert you and your team to enemies like the [[Snare Flea]]. If you and your teammate(s) have purchased [[Walkie-talkie]]s, a member of your team can stay behind at the ship and guide teammates towards loot and away from enemies and traps (such as turrets) using the [[terminal]].

== Anleitungen ==
Hallo zukünftige Mitarbeiter, diese Seite sollte euch hoffentlich etwas beibringen, was ihr zu erwarten habt.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== Allgemeine Tipps ===

Es empfiehlt sich zu Beginn Gedanken über die Gruppenaufteilung zu machen. Dabei kann eine Person am Schiff bleiben und der Rest sich aufteilen oder man kann sich in gleichgroße Gruppen aufteilen und so die Innenräume erkunden. Am Ende ist das System das beste, mit dem jede individuelle Gruppe sich am wohlsten fühlt.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Man sollte sich angewöhnen alle batteriebetriebenen Geräte zu laden, wenn man landet. Weder die [[Flashlight|Taschenlampe]] noch das [[Walkie-Talkie]] nutzen viel wenn sie leer sind.
</div>

Das Terminal am Schiff ist ein äußerst nützliches Hilfsmittel und es empfiehlt sich immer mindestens einen Mitarbeiter zu haben, der sich damit gut auskennt.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Die restliche Seite befindet sich noch in Arbeit ==
=== Monde ===
Die Monden sind die Orte, an denen ihr landet und Schrott sucht. Manche können schon durch ihr Terrain eine Herausforderung sein, wie zum Beispiel [[Assurance/de]], dessen Haupteingang relativ weit vom Schiff entfernt ist und der viele Felsen hat, die eure Bewegungsmöglichkeiten einschränken können. Auch [[Vow/de]] hat ein paar Tücken, mit einer wackeligen Brücke, die Einstürzen kann und einem Notausgang in einer Schlucht. Außerdem können auf jedem Mond gewisse [[Weather|Wetter]]konditionen auftreten, wie Nebel, der die Sicht stark beeinträchtigt und Navigation, sowie das Erkennen von Gefahren schwierig gestaltet. Alternativ könnte es Regen geben, der Treibsand- und Schlammflächen verursacht, in denen unvorsichtige Mitarbeiter versinken könnten.
</div>

Barring any [[weather]] conditions, the outside is generally safe at the start of a round. </div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Innenräume ===
Wenn man die Innenräume betritt, sollte man immer den Eingang nach Objekten absuchen, da es vorkommen kann dass dort bereits Schrott liegt. Hat man jemanden, der die Gruppe vom Schiffsmonitor aus navigiert, kann dieser auf Beute (gelbe Dreiecke) hinweisen oder vor Gegnern (rote Punkte) warnen. Dennoch will man so gut wie immer eine [[Flashlight|Taschenlampe]] dabei haben, um über fehlende Laufstege zu springen und Gegenstände in den dunklen Korridoren besser erkennen zu können.
</div>

######## Tips and Tricks/en
<languages/>
== Introduction ==
Lethal Company is a game with many features and in-depth game mechanics, and can feel overwhelming when playing for the first time. This page is meant to help with that by listing helpful tips, tricks, and guides to help you reach those higher quotas!

== Service Manual ==

{{main|Clipboard}}

== Guide ==
Hey future hires, this page should hopefully teach you a little more about what to expect.

=== General Tips ===

It is recommended for starting players to come up with a grouping system that works for them.  If that group system is having a person in the ship and everyone else split up in the facility, or if it's splitting off in to groups of two.  Ultimately the best grouping system is whatever your team seems to flow with the best.

It should be a habit to always remember to charge any battery powered tools before you land.  Going in with a dead [[Flashlight]] or dead [[Walkie-talkie]] isn't going to do you any good.

The terminal is an extremely helpful tool, it is recommended to have at least one employee know how to operate it fairly well.

== The rest of this page is in heavy rework ==
=== Moons ===
The moons are where you land to collect scrap.  Some can provide a challenge built into their structure such as [[Assurance]] being a very rocky place that's entrances are fairly far from the ship, or like [[Vow]] and [[Adamance]] that have unstable bridges that can collapse under the stress of too much weight.  They can also have [[Weather|weather]] conditions such as fog, which reduces your ability to see outside hostiles, or rainy conditions, which cause quicksand-like puddles to appear that can be very hard to notice until it's too late.

=== Outside ===

The outdoor layout of each [[Moons|moon]] is always the same as well as the position in which the ships lands. Once you've familiarized yourself with each, you'll have an easier time reaching the entrance(s) to the inside. In addition to the easily-accessible main entrance, each moon has at least one [[Interiors#Fire exits|Fire exit]], with [[March]] possessing the most (3). These ulterior doors are useful for navigating to different parts of the facility more easily, and for covering more ground as a team at the start of a round. Barring any [[weather]] conditions, the outside is generally safe at the start of a round. As the day progresses, however, spawn rates for hostile enemies will increase, often resulting in [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]], [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]], or even [[Earth Leviathan|Earth Leviathans]] patrolling near the ship.

=== Inside ===
Typically when entering a facility, you'll want to check the main and immediately adjacent rooms for items, as there will often be one or more pieces of [[scrap]] nearby. It's a common strategy to grab these items and place them outside of the main entrance (or any fire exit) to ferry to the ship later -- especially two-handed items. It is extremely useful to take advantage of your scan ability (RMB) to find pieces of loot that may be obscured by darkness or other obstacles, as well as helping you see a little bit better, and it will alert you and your team to enemies like the [[Snare Flea]]. If you and your teammate(s) have purchased [[Walkie-talkie]]s, a member of your team can stay behind at the ship and guide teammates towards loot and away from enemies and traps (such as turrets) using the [[terminal]].

== Introducción ==
Lethal Company es un juego con muchas características y mecánicas  detalladas y puede sentirse un poco abrumador la primera vez que juegas. Esta página fue hecha para ayudarte con eso y cuenta con consejos, trucos y guías con el fin de que puedas lograr aquellas cuotas más grandes.

<span id="Service_Manual"></span>

== Guía ==
Hola, futuros empleados. Esta página debería poder ayudarlos enseñándoles un poco más sobre qué esperar al jugar Lethal Company.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
== Consejos generales ==

Es recomendable que los jugadores nuevos lleguen a un consenso sobre una dinámica de grupo que funcione para ellos. Esta puede ser que una persona se quede en la nave y el resto se divida en las instalaciones, o bien que el grupo se divida en dos. Al fin y al cabo, la mejor dinámica grupal será aquella con la que tu equipo parezca fluir mejor.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Deberán adoptar el hábito de siempre recargar cualquier herramienta que contenga baterías antes de aterrizar. Jugar con una [[flashlight|linterna]] descargada o un [[walkie-talkie]] muerto no es para nada beneficioso.
</div>

La terminal es una herramienta extremadamente útil y se recomienda que al menos un empleado sepa cómo utilizarla relativamente bien.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== The rest of this page is in heavy rework ==
=== Moons ===
The moons are where you land to collect scrap.  Some can provide a challenge built into their structure such as [[Assurance]] being a very rocky place that's entrances are fairly far from the ship, or like [[Vow]] and [[Adamance]] that have unstable bridges that can collapse under the stress of too much weight.  They can also have [[Weather|weather]] conditions such as fog, which reduces your ability to see outside hostiles, or rainy conditions, which cause quicksand-like puddles to appear that can be very hard to notice until it's too late.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Outside ===
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The outdoor layout of each [[Moons|moon]] is always the same as well as the position in which the ships lands. Once you've familiarized yourself with each, you'll have an easier time reaching the entrance(s) to the inside. In addition to the easily-accessible main entrance, each moon has at least one [[Interiors#Fire exits|Fire exit]], with [[March]] possessing the most (3). These ulterior doors are useful for navigating to different parts of the facility more easily, and for covering more ground as a team at the start of a round. Barring any [[weather]] conditions, the outside is generally safe at the start of a round. As the day progresses, however, spawn rates for hostile enemies will increase, often resulting in [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]], [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]], or even [[Earth Leviathan|Earth Leviathans]] patrolling near the ship.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Inside ===
Typically when entering a facility, you'll want to check the main and immediately adjacent rooms for items, as there will often be one or more pieces of [[scrap]] nearby. It's a common strategy to grab these items and place them outside of the main entrance (or any fire exit) to ferry to the ship later -- especially two-handed items. It is extremely useful to take advantage of your scan ability (RMB) to find pieces of loot that may be obscured by darkness or other obstacles, as well as helping you see a little bit better, and it will alert you and your team to enemies like the [[Snare Flea]]. If you and your teammate(s) have purchased [[Walkie-talkie]]s, a member of your team can stay behind at the ship and guide teammates towards loot and away from enemies and traps (such as turrets) using the [[terminal]].
</div>

######## Tips and Tricks/fi
<languages/>
== Esittely ==
Lethal Company on peli jossa on paljon ominaisuuksia ja perusteellisia pelimekaniikkoja, joka voi tuntua murskaavalta kun pelaa ensimmäistä kertaa. Tämän sivun on tarkoitus auttaa siinä listaamalla vinkkejä, niksejä, ja ohjeita auttamaan sinut pääsemään korkeampiin voittokiintiöihin!

== Ohje ==
Hei tulevat työntekijät, tämän sivun pitäisi toivottavasti opettaa teille vähän mitä odottaa.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== Yleisiä Vinkkejä ===

Aloittavia pelaajia suositellaan keksimään ryhmäytymis järjestelmä joka toimii heille.  Ei ole väliä onko ryhmäytymis järjestely yksi ihminen aluksessa ja kaikki muut hajaantuvat laitokseen, tai kaikki jakaantuvat kahden hengen ryhmiin.  Loppujen lopuksi paras ryhmittymis menetelmä on se joka toimii tiimisi kanssa parhaiten.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Akullisten työkalujen latauksen aina ennen laskeutumista pitäisi olla tapa.  Sisään meneminen tyhjällä [[Flashlight|taskulampulla]] tai tyhjällä [[Walkie-Talkie|Radiopuhelimella]] ei tee sinulle mitään hyvää.
</div>

Terminaali on erittäin hyödyllinen työkalu, on suositeltavaa että ainakin yksi työntekijä osaa käyttää sitä kohtuu hyvin.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Loppu sivu on kovan uusinnan alla ==
=== Kuut ===
Kuut ovat minne laskeudut keräämään romua.  Jotkut voivat tarjota haasteen, joka on sisäänrakennettu niiden rakenteeseen, kuten [[Assurance]] joka on erittäin kivinen, jonka sisäänkäynnit ovat kohtuu kaukana aluksesta, tai kuten [[Vow]] jossa on hutera silta ja hätäpoistumistie rotkon pohjalla.  Niillä voi myös olla [[Weather|säätiloja]] kuten sumu, joka heikentää kykyäsi nähdä vihollisia ja kuun vaaroja ulkona, joka tekee siitä erittäin vaarallisen, jos et tunne kuuta hyvin, tai sitten voi olla sateista, joka aiheuttaa juoksuhiekan tyylisten lammikkojen ilmestymisen, joita voi olla erittäin vaikea huomata ennen kun on liian myöhäistä.
</div>

<span id="Outside"></span>
=== Ulkotilat ===

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The outdoor layout of each [[Moons|moon]] is always the same as well as the position in which the ships lands. Once you've familiarized yourself with each, you'll have an easier time reaching the entrance(s) to the inside. In addition to the easily-accessible main entrance, each moon has at least one [[Interiors#Fire exits|Fire exit]], with [[March]] possessing the most (3). These ulterior doors are useful for navigating to different parts of the facility more easily, and for covering more ground as a team at the start of a round. Barring any [[weather]] conditions, the outside is generally safe at the start of a round. As the day progresses, however, spawn rates for hostile enemies will increase, often resulting in [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]], [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]], or even [[Earth Leviathan|Earth Leviathans]] patrolling near the ship.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Sisätilat ===
Tyypillisesti, kun menet sisälle kannattaa tarkistaa päähuone sillä korkeimmillaan 2-3 esinettä voi syntyä. mutta todellisuudessa kun joku on konsolilla ohjaamassa sinua kohti saalista ja esinetiä ympäri karttaa ja on joku ohjaamassa sinua pois vihollisten (punaiset pisteet kartalla) luota. Mutta kannattaa silti käyttää taskulamppua kun hyppäät rikkoutuneiden siltojen yli ja kun koitat löytää kaiken saaliin mitä voit. (voit myös käyttää scan komentoa nähdäksesi kuinka monta esinettä kartassa on)
</div>

== Bevezetés ==
Lethal Company egy játék sok funkcióval és komplex mechanikával, ami egy új játékost igazán meg tud terhelni. Ennek az oldalnak a célja a játék megkönnyebbítése hasznos tippekkel, trükkökkel és útmutatókkal, hogy magasabb kvótákat is el tudj érni!

== Útmutató ==
Üdv jövőbeli alkalmazottak, ez az oldal remélhetőleg segít megérteni egy részét annak, amire számíthattok.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== Általános tippek ===

Javasolt kezdő játékosoknak egy számukra érthető csoport rendszer létrehozása. Maradhat például egyvalaki a hajón, miközben a többiek mind szétválnak a létesítményben, vagy kettes csoportokban válnak szét. Összességében a legjobb csoport rendszer az, ami a csapat számára a leggördülékenyebb.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Jó szokás az elemmel működő eszközök feltöltése leszállás előtt. Nem fog segíteni egy lemerült [[Flashlight/hu|zseblámpa]] vagy [[Walkie-Talkie/hu|rádió]].
</div>

A terminál egy nagyon hasznos eszköz, javasolt legalább egy dolgozónak megtanulnia a használatát.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Az oldal további része mély átdolgozás alatt áll. ==
=== Holdak ===
A holdakon landolsz, hogy hulladékot gyűjts. Néhány hold kihívást okozhat a domborzatuk miatt, például [[Assurance/hu|Assurance]] egy nagyon sziklás hely, ahol a bejáratok távol vannak a hajótól, vagy [[Vow/hu|Vow]], amin egy instabil híd található és egy tűzkijárat, ami egy szakadékba van beásva. Találkozhatsz különböző [[Weather/hu|időjárással]] is, többet közt köddel, amitől kevésbé látod a kinti veszélyeket, vagy esővel, ami futóhomokhoz hasonló pocsolyákat hoz létre, amiket nehéz észre venni, csak amikor már túl késő.
</div>

<span id="Outside"></span>
=== Kint ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
A kinti domborzata az egyes [[Moons/hu|holdaknak]] mindig ugyanolyan, illetve az is, hogy hol száll le a hajó. Miután megismerted, könnyebb dolgod lesz elérni a bejárato(ka)t. A könnyen elérhető főbejáraton kívül minden holdon van legalább egy [[fire exit/hu|tűzkijárat]], amiből [[March/hu|Marchon]] található a legtöbb (3). Ezek a hátsó ajtók segítenek eljutni a létesítmény különböző részeire és egy csapat több területet tud velük átnézni egy kör elején. Ahogy telik az idő, megnövekszik az ellenséges szörnyek megjelenési esélye, amiért gyakran veszik körül a hajót [[Eyeless Dog/hu|szemetlen kutyák]], [[Forest Keeper/hu||erdő őrök]] vagy akár [[Earth Leviathan/hu|földi leviatánok]].
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Bent ===
Általában, amikor belépsz a létesítménybe, először a főszobát és annak szomszédos termeit érdemes átnézni, hiszen gyakran van egy vagy több darab [[scrap/hu|hulladék]] ezeken a helyeken. Gyakori stratégia, hogy ezeket a hulladékokat kiteszed a főbejárathoz (vagy bármelyik vészkijárathoz), hogy később visszavidd a hajóhoz -- főleg a kétkezes hulladékokat. Nagyon hasznos a szkennered használata (jobb egérgomb), amivel olyan tárgyakat tudsz találni, amik esetleg a sötétben vagy valami más mögött vannak elrejtve, illetve kicsivel jobban is látsz tőle és figyelmeztet téged és a csapatod az esetleges szörnyekről, például a [[Snare Flea/hu|csapda bolháról]]. Ha te és a csapattársa(i)d rendelkeznek [[Walkie-Talkie/hu|rádióval]], valaki a hajónál maradhat és elvezetheti a többieket a zsákmányhoz és el a szörnyektől és csapdáktól (például lövegtorony) a [[terminal/hu|terminál]] segítségével.
</div>

== Wprowadzenie ==
Lethal Company to gra z wieloma fukcjami oraz dogłębnymi mechanikami, które mogą się wydawać przytłaczające grając w tą grę pierwszy raz. Ta strona ma za zadanie pomóc ci poprzez podanie przydatnych wskazówek, porad oraz przewodników byś mógł/a osiągać wyższe normy.

== Poradnik ==
Hej, przyszli pracownicy, ta strona powinna was nauczyć czego mniej więcej oczekiwać.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== Ogólne Wskazówki ===



<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Powinno się nabyć taki zwyczaj by ładować każde urządzenie na energię przed wylądowaniem. Wychodzenie z wyładowaną [[Flashlight|latarką]] lub [[Walkie-Talkie|krótkofalówką]] nie zrobi dla ciebie nic dobrego.
</div>

Terminal jest niesamowicie przydatnym urządzeniem i poleca się posiadanie co najmniej jednego pracownika, który wie jak mniej więcej go używać.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Pozostała część tej strony jest w fazie gruntownych przeróbek ==
=== Księżyce ===
Księżyce to miejsce, w którym lądujesz, aby zebrać złom. Niektóre mogą stanowić wyzwanie wbudowane w ich konstrukcję, na przykład [[Assurance]] to bardzo skaliste miejsce, do którego wejścia są dość daleko od statku, lub jak [[Vow]], które ma niestabilny most i wyjście przeciwpożarowe wewnątrz wąwozu . Mogą również występować warunki [[Weather|pogodowe]], takie jak mgła, która ogranicza zdolność widzenia wrogów na zewnątrz, lub warunki deszczowe, które powodują powstawanie kałuż przypominających ruchome piaski, które mogą być bardzo trudne do zauważenia, dopóki nie będzie za późno.
</div>

<span id="Outside"></span>
=== Zewnątrz ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Układ zewnętrzny każdego [[Moons|księżyca]] jest zawsze taki sam, podobnie jak pozycja, w której lądują statki. Gdy już się z nimi zapoznasz, łatwiej będzie ci dotrzeć do wejść do środka. Oprócz łatwo dostępnego głównego wejścia, każdy księżyc ma co najmniej jedno [[Fire exit|wyjście przeciwpożarowe]], przy czym [[March]] posiada ich najwięcej (3). Te ukryte drzwi są przydatne do łatwiejszego przemieszczania się do różnych części obiektu i do pokonywania większego terenu jako drużyna na początku rundy. O ile nie wystąpią żadne warunki [[Wheather|pogodowe]], na początku rundy na zewnątrz jest ogólnie bezpiecznie. Jednak w miarę upływu dnia częstotliwość pojawiania się niebezpiecznych wrogów będzie rosła, często skutkując patrolowaniem [[Eyeless Dog|Bezokich Psów]], [[Forest Keeper|Opiekunów Lasu]], a nawet [[Earth Leviathan|Wielkich Lewiatanów]] w pobliżu statku.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Wewnątrz ===
Zwykle wchodząc do wnętrz, będziesz chciał sprawdzić główne i bezpośrednio przylegające pomieszczenia pod kątem przedmiotów, ponieważ często w pobliżu będzie jeden lub więcej [[Scrap|złomu]]. Powszechną strategią jest chwytanie tych przedmiotów i umieszczanie ich poza głównym wejściem (lub jakimkolwiek wyjściem przeciwpożarowym), aby później przewieźć je na statek – zwłaszcza przedmioty dwuręczne. Niezwykle przydatne jest wykorzystanie umiejętności skanowania (RMB), aby znaleźć złom, który może być zasłonięty ciemnością lub innymi przeszkodami, a także pomóc ci widzieć trochę lepiej i zaalarmować ciebie i twoją drużynę o wrogach jak [[Snare Flea|Sidlana Pchła]]. Jeśli ty i twoi towarzysze z drużyny kupiliście [[Walkie-Talkie|krótkowalówki]], członek waszej drużyny może pozostać na statku i kierować członków drużyny w kierunku złomu, z dala od wrogów i pułapek (takich jak wieżyczki) za pomocą [[Terminal|terminalu]].
</div>

######## Tips and Tricks/pt-br
<languages/>
== Introdução ==
Lethal Company  é um jogo com muitos recursos e mecânicas secretas que pode ser estressante ao jogar pela primeira vez sem um guia. Esta página tem como objetivo ajudar nisso, listando dicas, truques e guias úteis pra você atingir suas quotas!

<span id="Service_Manual"></span>
== Manual de Serviço ==

{{main|Clipboard/pt-br}}

== Guia ==
Ei future funcionárie, essa página deve te ensinar um pouquinho a mais sobre o que vai acontecer.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== Dicas Gerais ===

É recomendado para jogadores iniciantes elaborarem uma estratégia em grupo que funcione para elus, seja elu ume em que uma pessoa fique na nave e as outras se dividem dentro da instalação ou uma divisão em grupos de dois. Independentemente, a melhor estratégia é aquela que funciona melhor com o seu grupo.

Deve ser um habito sempre lembrar-se de carregar qualquer ferramenta a base de baterias antes de aterrissar. Explorar com uma [[Lantern/pt-br|lanterna]] ou um [[Walkie-talkie/pt-br|walkie-talkie]] sem carga não irá fazer nenhum bem.

O terminal é um ferramenta extremamente útil, é recomendado ter pelo menos ume funcionárie que saiba usá-lo na equipe.

== O resto da página está em desenvolvimento ==
=== Luas ===
As luas são aonde você aterrissa para coletar sucata. Algumas podem ser um desafio explorar, como [[Assurance/pt-br|Assurance]], sendo um lugar bem rochoso com entradas relativamente longe da nave, ou como [[Vow/pt-br|Vow]] e [[Adamance/pt-br|Adamance]] que possuem pontes instáveis que podem desabar sob o estresse de muito peso. Elas também podem ter variações no [[Weather/pt-br|clima]] como neblina, que reduz sua visão no exterior, ou chuva, que causa regiões de lama movediça a aparecerem, que podem ser muito difíceis de perceber até que seja tarde demais.

<span id="Outside"></span>
=== Exterior ===

O exterior de cada [[Lua/pt-br|lua]] é sempre o mesmo assim como a posição onde a nave aterrissa. Uma vez que você esteja familiarizado com cada uma, será mais fácil atingia a entrada para o interior. Além da entrada principal para o interior, cada lua possui ao menos uma [[interiors/pt-br#Saída de Emergência|saída de emergência]], sendo [[March/pt-br|March]] tendo o maior número delas (3). Essas portas são úteis para navegar por diferentes partes da instalação mais facilmente, e para explorar mais áreas como um time no inicio da rodada. Caso não houver nenhuma variação no [[Weather/pt-br|clima]], o exterior é geralmente seguro no inicio da rodada. Ao passar do tempo, entretanto, a chance do aparecimento de criaturas hostis irá crescer, geralmente resultando em [[Eyeless Dog/pt-br|Cães Cegos]], [[Forest Keeper/pt-br|Protetores da Floresta]], [[Earth Leviathan/pt-br|Leviatãs Terrestres]] ou [[Baboon Hawk/pt-br|Gaviões Babuínos]] passeando em volta da nave.

=== Interior ===
Normalmente, ao entrar em uma instalação, você desejará verificar se há itens nas salas principais e imediatamente adjacentes, pois geralmente haverá um ou mais pedaços de [[scrap/pt-br|sucata]] por perto. É uma estratégia comum pegar esses itens e colocá-los fora da entrada principal (ou de qualquer saída de incêndio) para transportá-los para a nave mais tarde - especialmente itens de duas mãos. É extremamente útil aproveitar sua habilidade de scan (RMB) para encontrar pedaços de saque que podem estar na escuridão ou outros obstáculos, além de ajudá-lo a ver um pouco melhor e alertar você e sua equipe sobre inimigos como a [[Snare Flea/pt-br|Pulga Traiçoeira]]. Se você e seu(s) companheire(s) de equipe compraram [[Walkie-Talkie/pt-br|walkie-talkies]], ume membre de sua equipe pode ficar para trás no navio e orientar seus companheires em direção ao saque e para longe de inimigos e armadilhas (como torretas) usando o [[terminal/pt-br|terminal]].

== Руководство ==
Добро пожаловать, будущие сотрудники, эта страница должна научить вас немного о том, чего стоит ожидать.

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== Общие Советы ===

Начинающим игрокам рекомендуется придумать систему группирования, которая придётся им по душе. Это быть система, где один человек остаётся на корабле, а все остальные идут в комплекс, или где две группы по двое все вместе идут в здание. В целом самой лучшей системой будет та, с которой ваша команда играет лучше.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Следует ввести в привычку дозарядку инструментов при первой же возможности. Идти в здание с разряженным [[Flashlight/ru|фонариком]] или [[Flashlight|рацией]] не есть хорошая идея.
</div>

Терминал - очень полезный инструмент, рекомендуется иметь как минимум одного сотрудника в команде, который хорошо знает, как им пользоваться.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== Остальная страница сейчас в процессе сильной переработки ==
=== Луны ===
Луны, это то, где вы будете собирать лут. Некоторые могут привносить сложности, встроенные в свою структуру, такие как [[Assurance/ru|Assurance]] со своим каменистым ландшафтом и удалёнными от корабля входами, или [[Vow/ru|Vow]] со своим нестабильным мостом и пожарным выходом в глубокой впадине. На них также могут быть плохие [[Weather/ru|погодные условия]], которые например ограничивают видимость, что может быть опасным, если вы не знаете карту, или например могут создать ямы с зыбучими песками/глубокой грязью и т.д.
</div>

<span id="Outside"></span>
=== Снаружи ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Внешняя топология каждой из [[Moons/ru|лун]] постоянна, как и место посадки корабля в ней. Как только вы хорошо ознакомились с каждой, вам будет легче находить входы. В дополнение к легкодоступному главному входу, у каждой луны есть как минимум один [[Interiors/ru#Пожарные выходы|пожарный выход]], с самым большим у [[March/ru|March]] (3). Эти скрытые двери полезны для более лёгкого перехода между отдалёнными частями здания и большего покрытия командой в начале раунда. При отсутствии [[weather|погодных условий]], снаружи в целом безопасно в начале раунда. С течением дня, однако, шанс появления враждебных сущностей увеличивается, часто приводя к появлению [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Безглазых Псов]], [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранителей Леса]] или даже [[Earth Leviathan/ru|Земных Левиафанов]], патрулирующих территорию у корабля.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Внутри ===
Обычно, когда вы заходите в здание, вам следует проверить главную и прилегающие комнаты на наличие лута, так как по-близости почти всегда есть хотя бы немного [[scrap|лута]]. Частая стратегия - подбирать эти предметы и выносить их наружу, оставляя возле главного входа (или пожарного выхода), чтобы позже перенести на корабль -- особенно габаритные предметы.Очень полезным будет использовать сканер (ПКМ) для нахождения лута, который загорожен темнотой или иными препятствиями, а также чтобы лучше видеть в темноте, так как он помогает вам и вашей команде своевременно обнаружить противников, таких как [[Snare Flea/ru|Потолочная блоха]]. Если вы и ваши союзники купили [[Walkie-Talkie|рации]], член вашей команды может остаться на корабле и направлять остальную команду к луту и от противников и ловушек (вроде турлей) используя [[Ship/ru#Терминал|терминал]].
</div>

######## Tips and Tricks/zh-cn
<languages/>
== 简介 ==
《致命公司》是一款有着许多特色和深度游戏机制的游戏，初次游玩时可能会让人不知所措。本页面旨在通过列出一系列实用的提示、技巧和指南，帮助你在游戏内达成更高的主要目标！

<span id="Service_Manual"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 服务手册 ==
这是游戏自带的服务手册。
<gallery>
Training1.png
Training2.png
Training3.png
Training4.png
</gallery>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
{{main|Clipboard}}
</div>

== 指南 ==
未来的员工们，希望本页能让你了解你未来可能遇到的状况。

<span id="General_Tips"></span>
=== 通用建议 ===

推荐新手先摸索出一套分工模式。可以是一个人在飞船中提供帮助，其他人分头在设施中搜索；也可以是两人一组分别行动。无论如何，玩得舒服的就是最好的分工模式。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
记得在降落前给带电池的工具充电。携带没电的[[Flashlight/zh-cn|手电筒]]或[[Walkie-Talkie|对讲机]]进入设施并不会有任何帮助。
</div>

飞船终端是一个十分有用的工具，建议小队中至少有一位员工能熟练操作终端。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
== 此页面的剩余部分仍在建设中 ==
=== 星球 ===
星球是你降落并搜寻废料的地方。部分星球因结构特殊，其本身就具有一定的挑战性。例如 [[Assurance/zh-cn|Assurance]] 上岩石遍布，入口也离飞船较远；又比如 [[Vow/zh-cn|Vow]]，其地图中有一条不稳定的桥梁，消防出口又位于峡谷底部。星球也会受[[Weather/zh-cn|天气]]条件影响，例如大雾会降低能见度，使你难以看清敌对实体；又比如阴雨天气，会生成小水坑一样的流沙。流沙往往难以察觉，直到不慎陷入其中才后悔莫及。
</div>

<span id="Outside"></span>
=== 室外 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
在一个[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]中，其室外大致布局，以及飞船的降落点都是不变的。当你熟悉环境之后，你便能更快更轻松地到达设施入口。
除此之外，每一个星球都有至少一个[[fire exit/zh-cn|安全出口]]，其中[[March/zh-cn|March]]最多，拥有3个。这些别有用心的门有助于探索设施的不同部分，让一个团队探索到更多的室内空间。
室外通常是安全的，除非有任何[[Weather/zh-cn|天气]]条件。
随着一天时间的推移，敌对实体的生成率将会大幅增加，可能会遇见[[Eyeless_Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]、[[Forest_Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]，甚至[[Earth_Leviathan/zh-cn|大地利维坦]]在飞船附近游荡。
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 室内 ===
通常情况下，当进入室内时，要检查主房间和紧邻的房间是否有物品，因为附近通常会有一个或多个[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]。一般来说，成员要搬运这些物品至主入口（或任何安全出口）外，以便稍后运送到飞船上，尤其是双手物品。充分利用你的扫描能力（鼠标右键）找到可能因黑暗或被其他障碍物遮挡住的废料。扫描功能还能帮助你更好地看到东西，因为它可以提醒你和你的团队注意到[[Snare_Flea/zh-cn|缠缚蚤]]等实体。如果你和你的队友购买了[[Walkie-Talkie|对讲机]]，你可以让你的团队成员留在船上，使用[[Ship#Terminal/zh-cn|电脑终端]]引导队友搜寻废料、远离敌人和陷阱（如炮塔）。
</div>

######## Titan
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Titan
| image = Titanmap.png
| routecost = 700
}}<translate>
<!--T:3-->
'''Titan''' is the second hardest moon in the game with a hazard level of "S+". The small map size and high nighttime entity spawn chances make it extremely dangerous to navigate the moon even early in the day. Despite that, Titan offers the largest loot amount and value with a whopping maximum of <tvar name="spawnMaximum">37</tvar> scrap pieces that can be found. Titan has by far the largest indoor map size.

== Description == <!--T:4-->
</translate>
{{Template:Terminal|text=8-Titan

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

<translate>
<!--T:5-->
CONDITIONS: A frozen, flat landscape.

<!--T:6-->
HISTORY: It looks like this moon was mined for resources. It's easy to get lost within the giant industrial complex. There are many entrances to it littered about the landscape.

<!--T:7-->
FAUNA: Dangerous entities have been rumored to take residence in the vast network of tunnels.</translate>}}
<translate>
== Environment == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
Titan is a moon with heavy snowfall with a very small outdoor area. The ship lands with its doors facing directly in front of two sets of multiple flights of stairs which are used to access the main entrance. There are a second set of stairs that offer quicker access to Titan's fire exit, although the fire exit shares a landing with the Main Entrance which can also be accessed from the first set of stairs. It can also be used as an escape as entities such as [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]] can walk up the stairs.

The [[Factory]] is the most common interior layout, but the [[Mineshaft]] and the [[Mansion]] also appear quite often.

== Strategy == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Titan is a high-risk, high-reward moon where players must collect and secure as much scrap as possible before indoor and nighttime entities flood the map. Employees are advised not to go too far into the indoor maze as the large indoor map size makes it very easy to get lost which is the last thing you want on Titan.
</translate>
[[File:Titan route annotations.jpg|thumb|<translate><!--T:25--> Route annotations</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:26-->
Employees can quickly reach the Main Entrance by using a [[Jetpack]] over the stairs. This can also be performed before the ship lands by jumping off the ship platform as soon as the door opens, activating the jetpack, and leaning forward to direct yourself towards the entrance. It is worth noting that you can take significant fall [[damage]] or die if you direct it poorly and end up too high or deactivate the jetpack too early/late. Despite the risk, this is an efficient method of reaching the Main Entrance quickly and avoiding any hazardous [[weather]] while reaching it.

<!--T:12-->
Employees can quickly transport loot from the entrances to the ship by dropping items off of the edge. Using an [[Extension Ladder]]<sup>(2)</sup> allows employees to drop objects to ground level instead of landing on the secondary platform. Loitering at the main entrance or fire exit is strongly discouraged as [[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Forest Keeper]]s are capable of climbing the stairs<sup>(1)</sup> killing employees. Employees can also quickly scale down the stairs without taking fall damage<sup>(3)</sup> by dropping onto the stair railing, then dropping onto a small lip in the wall below the edge, dropping onto the secondary platform, and finally falling off the railing on the lower set of stairs onto the ground.

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=8-Titan

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: A frozen, flat landscape.

HISTORY: It looks like this moon was mined for resources. It's easy to get lost within the giant industrial complex. There are many entrances to it littered about the landscape.

== Environment ==

Titan is a moon with heavy snowfall with a very small outdoor area. The ship lands with its doors facing directly in front of two sets of multiple flights of stairs which are used to access the main entrance. There are a second set of stairs that offer quicker access to Titan's fire exit, although the fire exit shares a landing with the Main Entrance which can also be accessed from the first set of stairs. It can also be used as an escape as entities such as [[Eyeless Dog|Eyeless Dogs]] can walk up the stairs.

== Strategy ==

Titan is a high-risk, high-reward moon where players must collect and secure as much scrap as possible before indoor and nighttime entities flood the map. Employees are advised not to go too far into the indoor maze as the large indoor map size makes it very easy to get lost which is the last thing you want on Titan.
[[File:Titan route annotations.jpg|thumb|Route annotations]]
Employees can quickly reach the Main Entrance by using a [[Jetpack]] over the stairs. This can also be performed before the ship lands by jumping off the ship platform as soon as the door opens, activating the jetpack, and leaning forward to direct yourself towards the entrance. It is worth noting that you can take significant fall [[damage]] or die if you direct it poorly and end up too high or deactivate the jetpack too early/late. Despite the risk, this is an efficient method of reaching the Main Entrance quickly and avoiding any hazardous [[weather]] while reaching it.

Employees can quickly transport loot from the entrances to the ship by dropping items off of the edge. Using an [[Extension Ladder]]<sup>(2)</sup> allows employees to drop objects to ground level instead of landing on the secondary platform. Loitering at the main entrance or fire exit is strongly discouraged as [[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Forest Keeper]]s are capable of climbing the stairs<sup>(1)</sup> killing employees. Employees can also quickly scale down the stairs without taking fall damage<sup>(3)</sup> by dropping onto the stair railing, then dropping onto a small lip in the wall below the edge, dropping onto the secondary platform, and finally falling off the railing on the lower set of stairs onto the ground.

== Entities ==

=== Indoor ===

[[Jester]]s are the most common entities on Titan. It is advised to keep your visits to Titan short and efficient as Jesters easily can force employees to leave early if they spawn in the wrong places.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}

=== Nighttime ===

Just like on [[Rend]], [[Eyeless Dog]]s and [[Forest Keeper]]s are the most common nighttime entities on Titan. If spawned together, they can pose a significant threat to employee safety if not handled correctly. [[Earth Leviathan]] can spawn too but pose little to no threat as the ship is very close to the entrance.

Titan does not support daytime entities.

The nighttime spawn curve is almost equal to [[Dine|Dine's]] with the only difference being the map size as on Titan, all entities spawn in a very small area. Indoor entities start spawning at around 8am with a more or less steady rate increase until 12am. See [[Mechanics]] for interpretation.

######## Titan/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}

{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Titan

}}'''Titan''' - вторая сложнейшая луна в игре с уровнем опасности "S+". Маленький размер карты и высокий шанс появления ночных сущностей делают передвижение по луне экстремально опасным даже в начале дня. Вопреки этому, Titan предлагает самое большое количество и ценность лута с колоссальным максимумом в 37 предметов, которые можно найти внутри. Titan имеет самый большой размер внутренней части здания и самый большой шанс появления альтернативного интерьера с более чем 18% шансом того, что интерьером будет [[Особняк]].

ИСТОРИЯ: Похоже, что эту луну разрабатывали из-за её ресурсов. Очень легко потеряться в большом индустриальном комплексе. По округе раскидано множество входов.

ФАУНА: Ходят слухи, что в широких сетях тоннелей поселились опасные сущности.}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

Titan - луна с сильным снегопадом и очень малой внешней территорией. Корабль садится дверьми в сторону двух лестничных площадок прямо неподалёку, которыми можно воспользоваться, чтобы подняться ко входу. Вторая площадка левее даёт быстрый доступ к пожарному выходу, хотя тот и так делит первую площадку вместе с главным входом. Тем не менее её также можно использовать для побега, так как сущности вроде [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепых Псов]] могут забираться по лестнице.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Titan - луна с высоким риском, которая сулит высокую награду, и на которой игроки должны вытащить как можно больше лута до того, как местность снаружи и здание изнутри заполонят сущности. Сотрудникам рекомендуется не слишком углубляться в лабиринт здания, так как большой его размер ведёт к тому, что там легко заблудиться, что является последней проблемой, с которой хотелось бы столкнуться на Titan.
[[File:Titan route annotations.jpg|thumb|Аннотации к маршруту]]
Игроки могут быстро достичь Главного Входа используя [[Jetpack/ru|Ракетный Ранец]] вдоль лестницы. Это также можно совершить перед полной посадкой корабля, спрыгивая с него сразу, как откроются двери, активируя джетпак и наклоняясь вперёд, направляя себя в сторону входа. Стоит заметить, что можно получить значительный [[damage|урон]] от падения или умереть если делать это неаккуратно и оказаться слишком высоко или отключить джетпак слишком рано или поздно. Несмотря на риск, это эффективный метод быстрого достижения Главного Входа и избегания опасной [[weather/ru|погоды]] в процессе.

Сотрудники могут быстро доставлять лут от входов к кораблю, сбрасывая их с края. Использование [[Extension Ladder/ru|Выдвижной лестницы]]<sup>(2)</sup> позволяет сотрудникам сбрасывать предметы на землю прямо рядом с кораблём вместо лестничной платформы. Бездельничать на входе в здание не рекомендуется, так как [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепые Псы]] и [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранители Леса]] способны туда забраться<sup>(1)</sup> и убить игроков. Сотрудники также могут быстро пропустить лестницу и избежать урона<sup>(3)</sup>, спрыгнув на ограждение лестницы, затем прыгая на маленький выступ в стене, спрыгивая на вторичную платформу и, наконец, спрыгивая с ограждения нижней лестничной площадки на землю.

<span id="Entities"></span>
== Сущности ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Внутри здания ===

Как и на [[Dine/ru|Dine]], [[Jester/ru|Балагуры]] - самые частые обитатели Titan. Рекомендуется сводить времяпровождение на Titan к эффективному минимуму, так как Балагуры могут легко заставить сотрудников покинуть здание раньше если они появятся не там, где надо.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}

<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== Ночные ===

Как и на [[Rend/ru|Rend]], [[Eyeless Dog/ru|Слепые Псы]] и [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранители Леса]] - самые часто встречающиеся ночные сущности на Titan. Появившись вместе, они могут нести значительную угрозу безопасности сотрудников, если с ними неправильно обращаться. [[Earth Leviathan/ru|Земной Левиафан]] также имеет шанс появиться, но не несёт особой угрозы, так как корабль находится очень близко ко входу.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== Дневные ===

Titan не поддерживает жизнь дневных сущностей. 

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Кривые шансов спавна ===

Кривая ночного спавна почти аналогична таковой у [[Dine/ru|Dine]] с единственным отличием в том, что размер карты у Titan намного меньше, из-за чего все сущности появляются на меньшей территории. Сущности внутри здания начинают появляться около 8 утра с более или менее плавным ростом скорости вплоть до полночи. Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.
[[File:Titan_spawn_curve.png|950px]]

######## Titan/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox
| moon = Titan
| image = Titanmap.png
| routecost = 700
}}<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
'''Titan''' 是游戏中第二难的星球，其危险评级为“S+”。较小的室外地图大小和较高的夜间实体生成概率使得在此星球上探索极为危险，即使在下午也不安全。不过，Titan 也有着最多的废料生成价值，最大生成数也是极大的 37。Titan 的室内地图大小也是所有星球中最大的，随机生成的室内结构[[Interiors/zh-cn#豪宅|豪宅]]的概率也是最大的 18%。
</div>

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=8-Titan

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：地面冰冻、地形平坦。

历史：此星球疑似被用于开采资源。工业用建筑结构巨大且复杂，很容易在其中迷路。大量入口散布在地表上。

生态：流言称危险实体栖息于错综复杂的庞大隧道网络中。}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== 环境 ==

Titan 有着厚厚的积雪和非常小的室外区域。飞船正好降落在一组通往主要入口的多层楼梯前方。还有另外一组楼梯可快速到达消防出口，且这两组楼梯的起始平台都在地面上。消防出口侧的楼梯也可用作紧急逃生通道，因为[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]等实体可以爬上楼梯。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

Titan 是高风险高回报的星球，玩家应在夜间实体灌满地图之前搜寻并搬运尽可能多的废料回船。建议不要在室内的迷宫里深入太多，因为 Titan 的高地图大小系数使得员工很容易陷入他们最不希望发生的情况——迷路。
[[File:Titan route annotations.jpg|thumb|路线注释]]
玩家可以通过在楼梯上使用[[Jetpack|喷气背包]]快速到达主要入口。这也可以在船着陆时进行，只要门一打开，就从飞船平台上跳下来，启动喷气背包，向前倾斜，将自己引向入口。值得注意的是，如果你使用方式不当，最终飞得太高，或者过早/过晚停用喷气背包，你可能会受到严重的坠落[[damage|伤害]]或直接死亡。尽管存在风险，但这是一种快速到达主要入口并在到达时避免任何危险[[Weather|天气]]的有效方法。

员工可在平台边缘将物品丢到第二个平台上以快速搬运。使用[[Extension Ladder|伸缩梯]]<sup>(2)</sup>还可以将物品直接丢在地上。不建议将物品丢在主要入口或消防出口，因为[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]和[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]可以爬上楼梯<sup>(1)</sup>。员工还能不受摔落伤害地快速下楼<sup>(3)</sup>，首先下到楼梯上，然后跳到墙上的一条小边上，跳到第二个平台上，最后从地面的第二级楼梯平台跳回地面上。

<span id="Entities"></span>
== 实体 ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== 室内 ===

就像在 [[Dine/zh-cn|Dine]] 上一样，[[Jester/zh-cn|小丑盒子]]是 Titan 上最常见的实体。建议您保持对 Titan 的探索简短高效，因为如果小丑盒子在错误的地方生成，那么它就很容易迫使玩家提前离开。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}

<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== 夜间 ===

就像在 [[Rend/zh-cn|Rend]] 上一样，[[Eyeless Dog/zh-cn|无眼狗]]和[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]是 Titan 上最常见的夜间实体。如果一起生成，且处理不当时，它们可能会对玩家构成重大威胁。[[Earth Leviathan/zh-cn|大地利维坦]]也可以生成，但由于船离入口很近，几乎不会构成威胁。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== 日间 ===

Titan 不会生成日间实体。 

<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== 生成概率曲线 ===

夜间实体的生成曲线几乎等于 [[Dine/zh-cn|Dine]] 的，唯一的区别是地图大小，就像在 Titan 上一样，所有实体都在一个非常小的区域内生成。室内实体在早上8点左右开始生成，直到凌晨12点左右，生成速度或多或少会稳定增长。相关解释见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。
[[File:Titan_spawn_curve.png|950px]]

== Overview ==

The '''Toilet''' is a ship decor. It can be purchased from the [[terminal]] for 150 credits. It can be interacted with, causing it to flush, creating a sound which is audible to [[Eyeless Dog]]s.

<!--T:21-->
The jetpack can be used to quickly get small items to the ship or to potentially catch up with the ship if they leave without you and you're good enough at maneuvering. On Vow, for example, while you're in the canyon you can use the jetpack to bypass the long walk up the hill of the canyon. It can be used on maps like Titan to drop things directly onto the ship and get up to the main entrance fairly quickly. You can also fly above entities like [[Eyeless Dog]]s.

<!--T:22-->
The jetpack is a very powerful tool, but it is extremely hard to control and ridden with bugs as of v45 (battery inversion, damage upon takeoff). Study it extensively before committing the credits to using it.

==== <span id="Extension Ladder"></span>[[Extension ladder]] ==== <!--T:23-->

<!--T:24-->
This is a lot cheaper way to get out of low places or to get to high places.

<!--T:25-->

<!--T:26-->
It can get items a lot closer to the ship if you use it like a bridge on Titan and you can still get out of the canyon on Vow.

<!--T:27-->
One big difference is it's a lot easier to leave behind and it can't be used to avoid entities very well.

==== <span id="Stun Grenade"></span>[[Stun grenade]] ==== <!--T:28-->

<!--T:29-->

Some of the more noticeable uses are its stun on [[Thumper]]s, [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]], and [[Coil-Head]]s. As these enemies are all very fast, it can help tremendously to give yourself some distance, or in the case of the Thumper, to kill it.

There are multiple commands that come with the radar booster but it virtually counts as an extra player for anyone doing ship monitoring.

<!--T:32-->
You can see any radar boosters on the main monitor like you can for players, meaning you can set them up at main entrances and fire entrances to see if you have scrap left or you can put it somewhere on the inside you want to go back to, for example the apparatus room.

<!--T:33-->

==== [[Lockpicker]] ==== <!--T:48-->

<!--T:49-->
This is used as an alternative to keys. It can be used an infinite amount of times, but it weighs 10 pounds, takes 30 seconds to unlock a single door, and takes up a slot on the way back to the ship, making it much less convenient than keys. If you have a key shortage or are consistently going to Dine or Rend it can be very helpful, as the Mansion layout usually generates with more locked doors and less paths to bypass them than the Facility layout. As it is very cheap at only 20 credits, it's a good idea to have one just in case.
