The large amount will also be difficult and expensive to deal with using weed killer, and at this point it is usually better utilized for other purposes (such as [[Cadaver Growth]] infections or the [[Cruiser]]).
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Occasionally, Vain Shrouds will grow underneath geometry or on top of buildings, and it will be much more difficult or even impossible to remove these. If interactions with the Kidnapper Fox are to be avoided, destroying weeds around the geometry will result in it spawning inside of the geometry, making it impossible to escape and attack employees.
</div>

######## Version 35
<languages/><translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Version 35''' of Lethal Company was the game's first release build, published by Zeekerss on October 23, 2023.

<!--T:2-->
As its first public build, it does not contain patch notes, but Zeekerss did publish [https://steamcommunity.com/games/1966720/announcements/detail/3723972812691085631 a Steam announcement] alongside the launch of the game.

== Announcement == <!--T:3--></translate>
<blockquote>
Hello and welcome! It has been a long time but the game is finally out in early access.

<h3>The journey here</h3>
The journey here was long and winding, with the most intense and prolonged prototyping phase of any game I have worked on. To give you an idea of this, here is an example: Lethal Company started out as a completely indoor game with an elevator instead of a space ship. The development of the game was actually logged every two weeks from the very beginning, over on my [https://www.patreon.com/zeekerss Patreon]. Many times throughout development I was unsure if what I was making would turn out to be a confusing, broken mess of wasted months of effort, and I even wondered if recording the whole process would somehow ruin it (as it often does). But this has been one of the most fulfilling projects I've ever worked on, requiring friends and faith and humor. I am happy you are now here to see the unfinished product!
<!-- TODO: upload image -->

<h3>What now</h3>
While fixing bugs here and there, I am going to focus on mainly adding new content, cycling between new creatures, items/upgrades, and decorations. I am unsure if updates to Lethal Company should happen weekly or every other week. I think it won't have a rigid schedule but a usual pace you'll come to know. I don't want the game to grow too stale from a tiny, constant drip feed of updates; I want to release updates that have a nice handful of new things to discover each time, so you can come back and be surprised.

A place where you can discuss the game and find friends to play with is our [[Project:Discord|Dark Place Travelers discord]].
</blockquote>

######## Version 35/en
<languages/>'''Version 35''' of Lethal Company was the game's first release build, published by Zeekerss on October 23, 2023.

As its first public build, it does not contain patch notes, but Zeekerss did publish [https://steamcommunity.com/games/1966720/announcements/detail/3723972812691085631 a Steam announcement] alongside the launch of the game.

== Announcement ==
<blockquote>
Hello and welcome! It has been a long time but the game is finally out in early access.

<h3>The journey here</h3>
The journey here was long and winding, with the most intense and prolonged prototyping phase of any game I have worked on. To give you an idea of this, here is an example: Lethal Company started out as a completely indoor game with an elevator instead of a space ship. The development of the game was actually logged every two weeks from the very beginning, over on my [https://www.patreon.com/zeekerss Patreon]. Many times throughout development I was unsure if what I was making would turn out to be a confusing, broken mess of wasted months of effort, and I even wondered if recording the whole process would somehow ruin it (as it often does). But this has been one of the most fulfilling projects I've ever worked on, requiring friends and faith and humor. I am happy you are now here to see the unfinished product!
<!-- TODO: upload image -->

<h3>What now</h3>
While fixing bugs here and there, I am going to focus on mainly adding new content, cycling between new creatures, items/upgrades, and decorations. I am unsure if updates to Lethal Company should happen weekly or every other week. I think it won't have a rigid schedule but a usual pace you'll come to know. I don't want the game to grow too stale from a tiny, constant drip feed of updates; I want to release updates that have a nice handful of new things to discover each time, so you can come back and be surprised.

A place where you can discuss the game and find friends to play with is our [https://discord.gg/jKuCvk6 Dark Place Travelers discord].
</blockquote>

<blockquote>
Hello and welcome! It has been a long time but the game is finally out in early access.

<h3>The journey here</h3>
The journey here was long and winding, with the most intense and prolonged prototyping phase of any game I have worked on. To give you an idea of this, here is an example: Lethal Company started out as a completely indoor game with an elevator instead of a space ship. The development of the game was actually logged every two weeks from the very beginning, over on my [https://www.patreon.com/zeekerss Patreon]. Many times throughout development I was unsure if what I was making would turn out to be a confusing, broken mess of wasted months of effort, and I even wondered if recording the whole process would somehow ruin it (as it often does). I don't want the game to grow too stale from a tiny, constant drip feed of updates; I want to release updates that have a nice handful of new things to discover each time, so you can come back and be surprised.

######## Version 4
{{Unused}}
'''Version 4''' is an early Patreon-exclusive version of the game, much like [[Version 9]]. It is from 2022 and it has many differences in its core structure compared to the final game.

This version of the game can be accessed by getting the beta code from the member-only Discord channel, accessible via supporting [[Zeekerss]] on Patreon.

== Notable differences ==

* Dropped Items used to have gravity and proper collision.
* The [[ship]] looks noticeably different inside. The [[Terminal]] is not present in the ship, and neither is the electric coil, a table of Batteries being in place of the latter.
* Batteries are required to charge Items that consume battery using R instead of the electric coil.
* The only [[Moons|moon]] is [[Experimentation]] and it is vastly different.
* Only three inventory slots are present instead of 4.
* The [[Echo Scanner]] is not present in the game.
* The controls are different as to use [[Store#Equipment|items]] you need to press RMB, and to interact with certain object such as ladders and doors uses LMB.
* There are multiple debug key binds and areas left in the game.
** R is for Freecam.
** H is for speed cheat.
* There is a greeting message when you land the [[ship]].

== Company Greeting ==
The entirety of this greeting is narrated by the "pilot computer".
{{Terminal|text=Welcome to 41 Experimentation.

This moon appears to be abandoned. You are likely to find no signs of life, so it will be an easy job.

Your mission: to collect scrap worth monetary value.

As specified in your contract, you will receive 20% of the earnings accrued by H.E. Global. As also specified, we are not responsible for injuries taken while on the job.}}
H.E. is likely referring to Halden Electronics.

== Unused Mechanics/Items ==
[[File:Batteries.png|thumb|Batteries seen inside of the ship.]]
Some of these mechanics are mentioned in "Notable differences".

The [[mapper]] is present in this version, which is a item that worked like the camera monitor.

Batteries are also found in this version, which charge your battery-fueled items.
There are 10 in the ship, and they can be found throughout The Factory in packages of 1 and 3.

Originally, the elevator which is in game now, you were supposed to insert the apparatus into the elevator in order for the elevator to work.

There is a unused interior called the office.

== History ==

######## Version 4.2
{{Unused}}
{{Stub}}
Version 4.2 is a patreon-exclusive barebones later build of [[Version 4|version 4]], which is a prototype of the gameplay loop system that would go on to be the entire point of the released game.

== Gameplay ==
The interior section of the level and the lift mechanic from V4 have been removed and replaced by the gameplay loop system.

=== Scraps ===
Scrap now actually spawn, but the physics on them have already been removed and replaced by fake physics. Scrap spawns on air for some reason.

=== Terminal ===
The terminal has been added in this version. The only function that it can do is buy items.

######## Version 40
Version 40 was an update for Lethal Company, adding a new creature, various bug fixes, tweaks, and a few balancing changes.<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/3818550310803113739 The Autumnal Update - Version 40]</ref>

''Warning: This changelog does not come from Zeekerss, and thus may not accurately represent the purpose of certain tweaks or may miss certain changes.''

=== New additions ===

* [[Baboon Hawk]]s, a predator that will attack players periodically depending on its fear level.

* [[Inverse teleporter]], a [[ship]] upgrade that allows players to teleport to a random location within a facility.

* A new UI to view players, open their steam profiles, and kick them from the game, accessible with tab by default.

* New [[Radar-booster]]s, which allow you to monitor specific areas in the facility and play noises remotely with the "ping" command.

=== Balancing changes ===

* Tweaked the warning distance by the front door from 6m to 7.7m.

* The [[Bracken]] can no longer kill players whilst in its kill animation or while carrying a player's body.

* Stunning the Forest Giant will now cancel its kill animation.

* [[Eyeless Dog]]s can now be killed. 

* Eyeless dogs can now [[damage]] other enemies.

* [[Stun Gun]]s will no longer target anything behind the player.

* Stun guns will now run its enemy checks 12 times rather than 6 times during its scan warmup.

* The stun gun's range has been increased from 3.5m to 5m.

* Players held by enemies can no longer be teleported.

=== Miscellaneous changes ===

* The [[Thumper]]'s animation speed is now 60% slower than in [[Version 39]].

* The [[Company Building]] instant attack check is now triggered by having less than 3 average profit per item when attempting to sell to the Company Building when its patience is below 2.

* Players can now sneak up on and attack [[Manticoil]]s.

* Moved the shock position for enemies up 0.5m if the enemy does not have an eye.

* Ensured that the [[extension ladder]] kill trigger does not get set incorrectly.

* Players can no longer join games hosted by blocked Steam users' games.

* Added the capability to save "ship items." The effect of this is not currently known.

* Added a setting to invert Y axis.

* Added a save file corruption detection method and screen.

* Simplified microphone save data format.

* Made Eyeless dogs collision detection more accurate.

* Eyeless dogs now go back to 2 suspicion and switch to behaviour state 2 upon ending a kill animation.

* Whether or not power is off at the start of the level is now dependent on level seed (previously was completely random).

* Modified [[Bunker spider]] leg behaviour upon death.

* Players' ears can no longer ring if they are dead.

* Player voice filters are now reset upon death.

* Items will now fall correctly when players die.

* Decreased stun grenade player damage from 40 to 20.

=== Bug Fixes ===

* Added netcode to place an item on the Company Building's sell desk client-side, currently assumed to fix a bug where players could pick items up off the desk.

* Fixed a bug where enemies in vent animations could kill players.

* Fixed a bug where enemies in kill animations could kill players.

* Fixed an issue caused by placing a ladder with exactly 0 rotation.

* Fixed a bug where the [[Bracken]] could start a kill animation twice.

* Rewrote the server response code to fix multiple issues encountered when trying to join lobbies, adding new messages for common issues like full servers or mismatched versions.

* Added various null checks throughout the codebase. Effects of this are hard to gauge.

* Eyeless dogs will no longer howl at a target after they're dead.

* Eyeless dogs now correctly play the correct animation if they've managed to kill a player in a lunge.

* Stun guns will no longer continue to stun enemies after the battery is depleted.

* [[Circuit Bees]]' hives can no longer spawn in the ground.

* Fixed a bug where a dead player's health would not correctly set back to full upon starting the next round.

=== Debug changes ===

* Added a debug line stating "Enemy #(enemy number) was hit with force of (force)" when any enemy is hit.

* Added a debug line stating "use item A1" when a client successfully uses an item.

* Added debug lines stating "use item A", "use item B", "use item D", "use item D", "use item E", and "use item F" at various points in the item use code.

* Added a debug line to the Snare Flea that outputs "Centipede drop off player: (Online player count <= 0); (player health <= 15); (second chance given to singleplayer user)" when stunned.

* Removed debug rays and logs from the [[Bracken]] during its kill animation, after its kill animation, and upon being hit.

* Removed all debug logs from the [[Hoarding Bug]]'s drop item and grab item code aside from a line stating "Hoarder bug: my held item is null when attempting to drop it!!" and a line detailing "Hoarder Bug: Trying to grab another item (new item) while hands are already full with item (old item). Dropping the currently held one."

* Added debug text capabilities on the player's hud. Currently only utilized by the [[Baboon Hawk]] to display its fear level.

* Added a debug log for when settings are not applied.

* Added a debug log when a save file fails to load.

* Added debug logs for various menu messages on the loading screen. "Displaying menu message", "displaying menu message 2", and "displaying menu message 3".

* Added a debug log for a null check in the stun gun's shock ending code. "Error: playerHeldBy is null for owner of zap gun when stopping shock, in client rpc".

* Removed a debug log for when the stun gun is toggled on or off. "Setting isBeingUsed to (true/false)".

* Added debug logs and rays for when random positions on the NavMesh are picked in a sphere. "Got nav mesh position success!", "Get navmesh position failed!".

* Removed a debug log from the Bunker spider triggered when starting to chase a player. "Chasing player".

* Removed a debug log triggered when the Bunker spider played its attack audio ("Playing attack audio").

* Added debug logs for the Inverse Teleporter.

* Added a debug log stating that a player cannot be teleported due to a failed null check. "Targeted player is null".

* Added a few debug logs during the beam up, "Teleport A", "Teleport B", "Teleport C".

* Added debug lines for when a lobby by a blocked player is found. "Hiding lobby by blocked user: (name)", "blocked user: (name); id: (id)", "Blocked users list is null".

* Edited a debug line detailing what enemies are in the radius of a stun grenade. "Stun grenade blew up; enemies radius: (enemies)" to "Stun grenade blew up; enemies in radius: (enemies)".

* Added various debug logs for checking player names in the terminal.

Added chemistry flasks and dramatic Masks, nutcrackers with guns and spray paint cans for funs.

######## Version 47
== Official Patch Notes ==
<blockquote>
Hello employees, I hope you had a good Christmas. Now get back to work!!!

I've been taking a break, catching up on movies and writing and drawing, so this update isn't too crazy but has lots of little things. In Version 50 I hope to add lots of new creatures and map variation. (However since there are big changes in my life, I might not be able to work on it as quickly as I worked on Version 45.)
Edit: Sorry, I'm not as active on Steam so I forgot to mention here: Lethal Company won the Better With Friends award! Thank you, that is so cool.

'''Version 47 Notes:'''
*Added replayable challenge moons
**These are weekly moons that use the same random seed for everyone, based off the current week using the UTC time zone. The profit you make at the end of the challenge day will be uploaded to a leaderboard so you can compare your efficiency to your friends.
**The challenge moons also have randomly generated names, increased amounts of scrap, random starting credits, and other randomly tweaked properties.
**The point of this is less for competition and more to give us all a shared experience. It will also give even the most seasoned employees a challenge; I have no idea what moons will be generated for the months to come, but some of them will surely be crazier than others.
**If you're using a modded client, turn off all mods to guarantee you get the same moon as everyone else.
*Position of random lightning strikes, the destination of the inverse teleporter, contents of gift boxes, and the precise positions of scrap items are now deterministic and based off the random seed.

*Added the server tag feature for the public lobbies list. Type in a tag exactly to filter by servers that were created with that tag.

*Added a new type of hallway to the factory map type.
**For now I'll continue to add more rooms and variety to the current indoor map types, rather than adding new map types.


'''Changes to existing enemies:'''
*The [[thumper]]'s movement has been reworked so its animations and acceleration should be more consistent.
**The [[thumper]] speeds up slightly faster after being hit, but its turn speed drops off more reliably when it reaches high speed.
*The bunker [[spider]] now becomes slightly faster when it is almost dead.
*The bunker [[spider]]'s webs have a slightly larger collision radius.
*The forest [[giant]] is more likely to leave the ship alone after chasing a player near it.
*Slightly increased the audible range of the coilhead's footsteps.
*Made [[nutcracker]]s able to move slightly while aiming
**They only do this if they've fired at the same person several times
*Made the [[jester]] take longer to begin cranking

*Added a new journal entry
*Modified the bunker spider file to patch some confusing continuinity

*You can now take a small amount of damage when falling from a slightly lesser height.
**The height damage increases are intended to make verticality feel more important; for example I felt Titan's return trips were too simple for its level of reward.

'''Fixes :'''
*Fixed an issue introduced in the previous version where landmines instantly exploded when touching them, rather than waiting for players to step off.

*Made [[shovel]] collisions more consistent; you can now hit enemies around corners and nearby objects without it blocking the shovel.

*Fixed an issue which occurred when the masked enemy was interrupted while converting a player, which could result in the player becoming stuck or unable to move their mouse and sync position to other players
**Prevented a case where the masked enemy could create dozens of duplicates of the same player if that player was somehow not allowed to die, resulting in chaos

*Fixed an issue where items were incorrectly considered as being off the ship by the host if a player walked on the ship with them and didn't drop them (and vice-versa).
**[[Spray paint]] should now always disappear from the moon when you enter orbit
**Items from [[gift]] boxes should always stay on the ship when it moves

*Prevented a case where players could take the same item out of a gift box infinite times if it somehow was not able to be despawned

*Decreased the chance of gift boxes to spawn and removed Christmas decor from the item ship. The old item ship music is back.

*Fixed an issue where placing the extension ladder in the cupboard and then moving it would cause the ladder's colliders to become enabled even when holding them, which resulted in erratic movement.<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/3882730411609737888 The Challenge Moons Patch - Version 47]</ref>
</blockquote>

######## Version 50
== Official Patch Notes ==
<blockquote>Hi, it's been a long time, but at long last I have another lethal update to bring you! I hope you'll forgive me for suggesting in a previous post here that lethal updates would be somewhat regular and predictable--that was a bit naïve of me. Sorry, I'm just not working like I have a quota, because that would be ironic.

'''New additions include:'''
*A new forest moon, [[Adamance]]
*Reworked [[Dine]]'s exterior
*Two new [[Tulip Snake|entities]] [[Old Bird|outdoors]], one new [[Butler|entity]] indoors
*Added [[Easter Egg|Easter eggs]] which can be thrown.
*Two new [[suits]] in the rotating shop + a [[disco ball]]
*You can now run down slopes faster.
*A new hazard/trap indoors

'''Changes:'''
*The [[Brass Bell|bell]] now makes chimes when dropped (which will alert enemies within a large radius.)
*[[Baboon Hawk|Baboon hawks]] now spawn in groups of two, have 4 HP instead of 6, and do less damage when stabbing the player.
*Various small changes to the scrap output and spawn rates in moons, with the goal of making more moons rewarding to go to.
*It's possible to bounce off walls when hitting them at a steep angle.
*Slightly increased the weight of the [[shovel]], to make each player less of a self-sufficient killing machine.
*Fixed crouch-sprinting; previously, pressing the crouch button while sprinting would cause you to crouch and then uncrouch at the same time; when spamming the key, this made it possible to sprint without making noise. 
*Falling out of bounds no longer teleports you to the main entrance of the facility
**I know this kind of change might seem antagonistic to speed-runners, etc. But these made it possible to bypass Lethal Company's design and mechanics without requiring any more skill or strategy; I guess it would also make speed runs of Lethal Company less accessible to people who don't want to (or can't) spam a button very fast on the regular. 
**As a side side note, I had targeted the [[jetpack]]'s crazy efficiency for this same reason (safely bypassing part of the game), but I've realized it has an irreplaceable purpose as the most wacky gimmick item, so I will respect that.
*Since the manor layouts are generally more spread out than the facility layouts, manors will now always generate smaller when loaded. This was mostly an issue on [[Titan]], which had a significant chance to generate absurdly large manors.
**To compensate, the size multiplier of indoor levels in [[Rend]] and [[Dine]] have been increased, which should result in them feeling the same as before. Dine now has the same size as Rend.

In the next update I want to add more creatures outside and inside, and I will probably focus a little less on end-game content for a while. I also still want to add more variety to interiors.<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/6574767404458206552 Version 50 - The Hopping Update]</ref></blockquote>

== Hotfixes ==

Also brought [[Adamance]] scrap spawn amounts to be still slightly better than [[March]] but not on par with the ice moons.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/750645598293590077/750645813771763723/1229899844508844234 The Dark Place Travelers Discord]</ref></blockquote>

Despite this small fix, the version number still says 50.

######## Version 60
'''Version 60''' of Lethal Company was released on {{#formatdate:August 17, 2024|mdy}}. Titled "'''The Stuffy Update'''", it contains a number of adjustments, along with the addition of a new interior and new scrap.

v60 is also the first update to remove an entity from the game, the [[Kidnapper Fox]], as part of Zeekerss' goal of ensuring a rotation of content. In its place, the [[Maneater]] was added.

== Official Patch Notes ==
<blockquote>
Hello! I am happy to bring you Version 60.<ref>[https://youtu.be/nQH8RkWGUgc Version 60 Trailer]</ref><ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/6940696210369307295 Version 60 - The Stuffy Update]</ref> This update most prominently features a new interior which is common on Offense, Vow, Dine, and Artifice but can appear on any moon.

Patch notes:
*Removed the Kidnapper Fox (for now)
*Removed the Bog Crawler
*Removed the Goopy Goblin
*Made changes to the Dine entrance positions

* Changes to coilheads
**Coilheads now enter a recharge phase after chasing you for a certain distance.
**Coilheads can lose track of you after a long time of being out of range and line of sight.
**Coilheads cannot complete a jump as easily if they are spotted by a player while jumping.
*Made optimizations to Flowerman and Spore lizard AI to prevent lag spikes when they avoid the player in large maps.
*Added the [[Maneater]]
*Added 7 or 8 new pieces of scrap
*Added a rare chance for every scrap spawned on a moon to be the same type
*Changed the wooden doors of the mansion to have a unique sound effect.
*Added the mineshaft interior.
*Slightly reduced the number of weather to be present on many different moons at once
*And more I can't remember off the top of my head

In the next update I'd like to make store-bought items easier and more efficient to bring with you, even while carrying scrap. I also want to add more furniture that you can buy for the ship. For now, enjoy! And get to work.
</blockquote>

######## Version 64
== Official Patch Notes ==
<blockquote>
Hello, I'm back with another smaller update.<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/4589819013353456830 The Bag Patch - Version 64]</ref> While working on this, I started losing steam, even though I was happy with the direction things are going. So I decided to switch to another project for a while (Welcome To The Dark Place) with the hopes of finishing it soon. Rather than holding onto this update I'm releasing it now as V64 since it has a couple nice features:

*The tactical [[belt bag]] can now be bought from the terminal. It holds 15 non-scrap items and can be accessed by other players while it's around your waist. Use "INFO" to learn more about it.
*A new, rare 0.6% chance weather event can now occur on any day at a random time.
*A few bug fixes
</blockquote>

== Undocumented changes ==

<!-- many others: {{cite YouTube|video-id=7dBIfkiGfT8|title=OFFICIAL UPDATE v64 All Changes - Lethal Company|creator=Bread}} -->

In support of the [[Belt bag]], the camera pitch limit has been expanded, allowing you to look down further than before.

== Hotfix ==

Released September 15th. Patch notes from Discord:
<blockquote>I released a patch to fix rainy and stormy weather, coilheads stopping behind you if you look fully downward, and mechs glitching if their current target is destroyed</blockquote>

######## Version 70
{{topicon Fandom}}

'''Version 70''' of Lethal Company was released on {{#formatdate:May 31, 2025|mdy}}. Titled "'''The Incubating Update'''", it contains an overhaul of the [[ship]]'s radar, new furniture, and an updated [[Mansion]] interior.

== Official patch notes ==

[[File:V70_banner.webp|thumb|right|An employee lounging in the new Sofa chair]]
<blockquote>
Long time no see. The Company has a new update for all you hard workers.

<big>'''Overhauled the radar'''</big>
* Added a face cam which allows you to see your fellow employees on the terminal.
* Reworked the radar's appearance, now using 2D sprites to display rooms.
* Added a compass to the HUD and to the terminal; pinging your scanner makes it more visible at the bottom of the screen. 
* Added a line on the radar which shows the path from the currently viewed player to the exit.
* Added contour lines to represent terrain outdoors
This should bring the radar up to the visual standard of the rest of the game and make it easier to make a difference as the computer guy.

<big>'''Added new furniture'''</big>
* Fridge
* Sofa chair
* Dog house
* Microwave
* Electric Chair
Some of these you can sit on or store scrap inside!

<big>'''Added a new outdoor daytime creature, the Giant Sapsucker'''</big>
<br>(which is common to Vow)

<big>'''Reworked the mansion interior'''</big>
* Added about 8 new rooms/hallways with lots of interactable objects for scrap to hide inside.
* Added cabinets which can spawn in the hallways.
* Shrunk the vertical size of many rooms/hallways in the mansion to a more accurate scale.
* Overhauled the logic used to generate the mansion layouts.
Now the mansion should be more interesting to explore, and has more opportunities to loop back in on itself and create non-linear layouts.

<big>'''Added a new log from Sigurd: "Team Synergy"'''</big>
<br>I am planning to rework the way Sigurd's logs are found so that they will appear like rare scrap in the interiors. For now, this one is in Artifice.

<big>'''Updated the Company Cruiser'''</big>
* Reinforced materials. It can now withstand knocking into many, many trees and rocks.
* The Company Cruiser now passively tries to set itself upright.
* There is now a ''tiny'' boost when pressing down the pedal after changing gears.

'''Various minor bug fixes'''


This is the first of a series of several updates in which I'll be reworking or adding rooms to each interior, as well as adding new creatures, leading up to the update that takes the game out of Early Access. I hope you enjoy the changes here!

{{em dash}}Zeekerss<ref name="steam">{{Cite web
| url         = https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/544484746860693720
| title       = V70 - The Incubating Update
<!--| accessdate  = -->
| author      = Zeekerss
| date        = May 31, 2025
<!--| archiveurl  = -->
<!--| archivedate = -->
}}</ref>
</blockquote>

== Undocumented changes ==

* Although the [[Giant Sapsucker]] is most common on [[Vow]], it can also spawn on [[Assurance]] and [[Adamance]]. It guards a nest with 3 [[Egg]]s, a new scrap item. It's incredibly fast and hard to kill, and any employee who dares to take an egg isn't safe on the surface, not even in the ship.
* The new [[Mansion]] tiles are: bathroom, patio, birthday party, hallway with stairs, Poolrooms, bedroom, garage, square hallway.
* Adamance's exterior got a bit of a makeover, with all the foliage made more vibrant.
* [[Soccer ball]]s and [[Toilet paper]] are no longer conductive, and [[Cookie mold pan]]s now are.
* In addition to the 5 furniture items listed, a "Classic painting" was also added. It's a ''Lethal Company''-themed parody of [[w:American_Gothic|''American Gothic'']].
* On the ship radar screen, the icon for scrap was changed from a green triangle to magenta (so as to not clash with the green background), and keys are now shown with their own yellow icon.
* At random, a Company-sponsored advertisement can appear in the HUD, similar to the warning for [[Meteor shower]]s. It's shown to all players at once, advertising the most-discounted buyable item in the store. If nothing is discounted by at least 30%, a random furniture item will be advertised.
* The [[Echo Scanner]] HUD positioning seems slightly better, but it's hard to tell.
* Steam rich presence integration added (shows the moon you're on or are orbiting).
* Change to drill under main area on [[Gordion|71-Gordion]]. Now can open "Trunk."
* The spawn chance of the [[Zed Dog]] was increased "just a little bit"<ref name="steam" /> for this update.

Hi, I fixed some problems.
* Fixed an issue preventing players from opening the buyable fridge
* Fixed a lamp that was floating off the wall in Dine's exterior
* Fixed weedkiller sounds being global

* Fixed some issues regarding the logic that determines if the radar signal has cut out when monitoring players in the caves, which could prevent the signal from coming back on or off.

* Fixed the bathroom's shower door not being openable by creatures
* Fixed the bathroom's tub being off-limits to creatures
* Fixed? an issue where a cabinet could spawn halfway inside a bookshelf in one of the mansion hallways.

* Slightly decreased chance of mineshaft interior in Rend
* Fixed enemies not being able to navigate up onto the alcove in the narrow hallway in the mansion

<blockquote>
Hi, here is another round of bug fixes for things mostly to do with V70 additions.

######## Version 81
{{version history nav}}
'''Version 81''' was [https://steamcommunity.com/games/1966720/announcements/detail/516365152240535510 released on {{#formatdate:April 5, 2026|mdy}}] after a public beta week.
This update was to be a "creature feature",{{cite Patreon|date=2025-12-06|slug=exciting-work-145201748|title=Exciting work!}}
adding 3 new [[entities]] and [[Kidnapper Fox|1 returning entity]], in addition to gameplay, configuration, and performance improvements.
It also contained changes to [[March]], [[Vow]], and [[Adamance]], both in layout and aesthetic.
<blockquote>
=== Welcome to Version 80! ===

V80 includes a full rework of March, 3
new creatures, and numerous misc.
gameplay improvements and settings, as
well as overhauls to increase
performance.<br/>
The next update will include more
creatures and scrap.

Others must update their game to play
with you on this version.


Have fun!
</blockquote>

== Official Patch Notes ==

<blockquote>
Hello, Version 80 is out of beta!
This update has 3 new creatures for the forest moons (and a returning creature), the utility slot which is a spot dedicated to purchased tools,
a few new rooms for the facility interior, a complete rework to March's exterior + foliage updates for Vow and Adamance,
new graphics and accessibility settings, and numerous bugfixes, performance optimizations, and small improvements.
<br>Version 85 should hopefully come soon and be much more "content-focused",
whereas this update revamped many of the game's systems under the hood and fixed numerous small issues that had been bugging me since the game's release
(or had been introduced in updates since), and a lot of time was spent on that. I am feeling somewhat relieved though after tackling all that stuff.

Patch log:
* Completely reworked March's exterior
* Added three new creatures native to the three forest moons (though two of them can be found elsewhere).
** Backwater Gunkfish
** Feiopars
** Cadaver Bloom
* Added a new Sigurd log: "Work"
* Switched to a version of the game's main shader that renders in a single rendering pass (more performant) and allows the usage of foliage and better terrain.<!--
--> (This could not have been done quite as well without help from members of the modding community, so thank you very much.)
* Readded the Kidnapper Fox
** The fox is now more afraid to leave its territory and more accurately determines the size of its territory.
** The fox cannot spawn at the very beginning of the day.
** Weeds will never begin growing nearby the ship, though they can spread to the ship from the place where they started.
** The Vain Shrouds are more rare than before. However, the weeds will always begin growing on the current moon if you repeatedly "savescum" by disconnecting while not in orbit.
* Added proper foliage to the forest moons.
* Reduced frequent, heavy memory allocations in many areas across the game to reduce lag spikes
* Optimized memory usage regarding all creature AI so that they share the same pool of memory when appropriate
* Added functionality to creature AI and settings for creature AI to prevent land creatures from walking deep underwater when outside.
* Fixed the paycheck UI not scrolling properly through all the sold scrap.
* Fixed the player's hand and fingers not quite matching the lever of the ship when pulling the lever to land.
* Added a proper, satisfying animation and sound for the player pushing the lever to leave the moon.
* Added a visual animation for the main entrance door to the interior of all moons and overhauled the sound effects for it.<!--
--> Animations can be seen from inside and outside when another player is entering or leaving.
* Fixed interactions where creatures could collide with and damage players from outside the mineshaft elevator while it was closed and the player was inside (or vice-versa)
** Also fixed some creatures not moving towards the player even when they could be seen in the closed elevator and were still technically in chase.<!--
--> This may also fix cases where creatures did not move towards players if they were standing on certain ledges.
* Fixed creatures setting their destination unnecessarily, which would cause them to stop and 'jitter' on very large maps (mostly just Titan).
* Optimized creature search algorithms to perform better and more quickly,<!--
--> making creatures slightly less dumb and slow on large maps (specifically Titan) where creatures have to calculate longer paths.
* Turned the head-mounted camera around and increased its draw distance.
** Fixed the head-mounted camera not displaying the sky and instead just a black void outdoors.
* Cameras on the monitors indoors now display at a lower framerate to save costs on performance.
* The interiors now have basic distance culling to save on performance especially in large interiors; only rooms near you are rendered.
* Old Birds can now break bridges when walking on them as well as Forest Keepers.
* Lights indoors now have basic "indirect" lighting. This can be toggled off in the settings.
* Added a setting to decrease the game's pixel resolution, which should save GPU performance significantly if needed. This is also fun.
* Added accessibility options:
** Disable head-bobbing when running and jumping
** Enable toggle-to-sprint.
* Fixed company advertisements displaying an inverted sale percentage for a shop item (that is on a sale) for clients vs host.
* Fixed desync between when the "collected ___" hologram would display for different players;<!--
--> now they only display when players drop their scrap in the ship, not all at once when entering.
* Increased time it takes to drown by about a second.
* Baboon hawks dropping scrap will now properly drop it on the cruiser
* Players dropping their items as a result of death, etc. will now properly drop it on the cruiser and mineshaft elevator (and other moving objects.)
* Old Birds can now be stood on while moving, and scrap can be placed on their heads.
* Added three new rooms/halls to the factory interior type.
* Mineshaft interior now has more pockets of caves along with the main cave network, which should make it easier to find scrap.<!--
--> It also limits the generation to a certain distance from the entrance, making the interior more bendy and interconnected.
* Scrap can now spawn at the end of normal hallways in the factory interior.
* When loading while landing the ship, the game loads the interior asynchronously,<!--
--> meaning that instead of a single lag spike, there is a longer but more pleasing loading sequence in which you can mostly use voice chat like normal.
** The visuals and audio of landing the ship and leaving in the ship have been improved and embellished.
* Fixed Hygrodere not properly morphing to accomodate [sic] the environment
* Fixed Hygrodere not changing size based on variables
* Fixed Hygrodere camping the main entrance when it would follow a player to the main entrance.
* Added the utility slot, which can only be used for (most) non-scrap, shop-purchased items.
** Shovels are excluded.
** While I liked the strategic tradeoff of having to use a scrap slot to hold tools, it meant that most players opted out of using items all-together.
* Running into your fellow employees will shove them aside; if both employees are running at each other, they will both collide.<!--
--> Crouching or carrying heavy scrap makes you harder to get around.
* Fixed cases where spray paint, etc. would not work when facing up while someone is watching you on the map monitor.
* Added a diversity meter to some moons which limits the amount of unique species that can spawn in a single day, to keep from overwhelming new players especially.<!--
--> This is to prepare for adding more creatures.
* Fixed the game's randomness so that creatures will always spawn in the same order on Challenge Moons.
** When creatures die, which would normally open up space for different creatures to spawn early,<!--
--> it now waits until the determined spawn order has been finished to begin spawning extra creatures.
** Also made it so the Old Birds cannot spawn from thin air.
* The game now detects if your client is running a mod loader and uses this to indicate to other players browsing the server list.<!--
--> This does not mean that mods are officially supported or recommended, but I understand the value they add to the game for many players.
* Fixed Tulip Snakes causing lag spikes for the host player when they would walk the interior.
* Indoor creature spawn curves, which are based on the time of day, now round up as well as down when determining the number of creatures to spawn,<!--
--> meaning that the creature spawn curve defined for each moon is represented more accurately.<!--
--> Spawn levels have all been adjusted down slightly by the same amount to compensate. (This might require rebalancing or I may revert it.)
* Slightly lowered night vision range to make the dark more dangerous without a light source
* Increased the distance at which Coilheads will not enable their collision if they stop while ontop of [sic] a player, to prevent Coilheads from pushing players through walls
* Fixed cases where Forest Keepers could be "charged up" by almost seeing one player and then use that charge on another player, causing it to immediately see the other player.
* Crouching or standing still or just walking is now more effective on Forest Keepers when at a distance, and past a certain, far distance they cannot see you at all.
* Starting a new file now sets a random seed initially, instead of always defaulting to zero, which means the furniture on sale will always be different on the first quota.
* Swapped Sigurd's log locations on many moons
* Fog on moons has been updated to fit better visually, and foggy weather is also varied by moon to fit.
* Fixed players not using the proper two-handed hold animation when switching from a two-handed item to an empty item and then to another two-handed item that uses a different animation
* And so many other fixes and changes that I'm not going to be able to get through them all.
</blockquote>

=== Version 80 Beta ===
<blockquote>
Hello, long time no see! Version 80 is out in beta for you to test. You can access it by opting into the public beta branch for Lethal Company on Steam.

V80 brings a complete rework of March's exterior, a wide range of bugfixes, performance improvements, and other improvements, 3 new creatures (and a returning creature), a few new rooms for the factory interior, and the utility slot.

This update isn't quite as content-heavy as it is feature-focused, but it sets up the game with all sorts of under-the-hood fixes and adjustments to fix things I've broken over the past few updates, so I'll be able to think more about just adding new content real soon; this is just the start. Where V70 was mostly just for the costly snow moons, this update focuses on the forest moons, and I also hope it makes the game better for newcomers.

Patch log:
* Completely reworked March's exterior
* Added three new creatures native to the three forest moons (though two of them can be found elsewhere).
** [[Backwater Gunkfish]]
** [[Feiopar]]s
** [[Cadaver Bloom]]
* Added a new [[Sigurd Logs|Sigurd log]]: "Work"
* Switched to a version of the game's main shader that renders in a single rendering pass (more performant) and allows the usage of foliage and better terrain. (This could not have been done quite as well without help from members of the modding community, so thank you very much.)
* Readded the Kidnapper Fox
** The fox is now more afraid to leave its territory and more accurately determines the size of its territory.
** The fox cannot spawn at the very beginning of the day.
** Weeds will never begin growing nearby the ship, though they can spread to the ship from the place where they started.
** The [[Vain Shroud]]s are more rare than before. However, the weeds will always begin growing on the current moon if you repeatedly "savescum" by disconnecting while not in orbit.
* Added proper foliage to the forest moons.
* Reduced frequent, heavy memory allocations in many areas across the game to reduce lag spikes
* Optimized memory usage regarding all creature AI so that they share the same pool of memory when appropriate
* Added functionality to creature AI and settings for creature AI to prevent land creatures from walking deep underwater when outside.
* Fixed the paycheck UI not scrolling properly through all the sold scrap.
* Fixed the player's hand and fingers not quite matching the lever of the ship when pulling the lever to land.
* Added a proper, satisfying animation and sound for the player pushing the lever to leave the moon.
* Added a visual animation for the main entrance door to the interior of all moons and overhauled the sound effects for it. Animations can be seen from inside and outside when another player is entering or leaving.
* Fixed interactions where creatures could collide with and damage players from outside the mineshaft elevator while it was closed and the player was inside (or vice-versa)
** Also fixed some creatures not moving towards the player even when they could be seen in the closed elevator and were still technically in chase. This may also fix cases where creatures did not move towards players if they were standing on certain ledges.
* Fixed creatures setting their destination unnecessarily, which would cause them to stop and 'jitter' on very large maps (mostly just [[Titan]]).
* Optimized creature search algorithms to perform better and more quickly, making creatures slightly less dumb and slow on large maps (specifically Titan) where creatures have to calculate longer paths.
* Turned the head-mounted camera around and increased its draw distance.
** Fixed the head-mounted camera not displaying the sky and instead just a black void outdoors.
* Cameras on the monitors indoors now display at a lower framerate to save costs on performance.

* [[Old Bird]]s can now break bridges when walking on them as well as [[Forest Keeper]]s.

* Added accessibility options:
** Disable head-bobbing when running and jumping
** Enable toggle-to-sprint.
* Fixed company advertisements displaying an inverted sale percentage for a [[shop]] item (that is on a sale) for clients vs host.
* Fixed desync between when the "collected ___" hologram would display for different players; now they only display when players drop their scrap in the ship, not all at once when entering.
* Increased time it takes to drown by about a second.
* [[Baboon hawk]]s dropping scrap will now properly drop it on [[Company Cruiser|the cruiser]]
* Players dropping their items as a result of death, etc. will now properly drop it on the cruiser and mineshaft elevator (and other moving objects.)

* Added three new rooms/halls to the [[factory]] [[interior]] type.
* [[Mineshaft]] interior now has more pockets of caves along with the main cave network, which should make it easier to find scrap. It also limits the generation to a certain distance from the entrance, making the interior more bendy and interconnected.
* Scrap can now spawn at the end of normal hallways in the factory interior.
* When loading while landing the ship, the game loads the interior asynchronously, meaning that instead of a single lag spike, there is a longer but more pleasing loading sequence in which you can mostly use voice chat like normal.
** The visuals and audio of landing the ship and leaving in the ship have been improved and embellished.
* Fixed [[Hygrodere]] not properly morphing to accomodate the environment
* Fixed Hygrodere not changing size based on variables
* Fixed Hygrodere camping the main entrance when it would follow a player to the main entrance.
* Added the utility slot, which can only be used for (most) non-scrap, shop-purchased items.
** [[Shovel]]s are excluded.
** While I liked the strategic tradeoff of having to use a scrap slot to hold tools, it meant that most players opted out of using items all-together.
* Running into your fellow employees will shove them aside; if both employees are running at each other, they will both collide. Crouching or carrying heavy scrap makes you harder to get around.
* Fixed cases where [[spray paint]], etc. would not work when facing up while someone is watching you on the map monitor.
* Added a diversity meter to some moons which limits the amount of unique species that can spawn in a single day, to keep from overwhelming new players especially. This is to prepare for adding more creatures.
* Fixed the game's randomness so that creatures will always spawn in the same order on [[Challenge Moon]]s.
** When creatures die, which would normally open up space for different creatures to spawn early, it now waits until the determined spawn order has been finished to begin spawning extra creatures.
** Also made it so the Old Birds cannot spawn from thin air.
* The game now detects if your client is running a mod loader and uses this to indicate to other players browsing the server list. This does not mean that mods are officially supported or recommended, but I understand the value they add to the game for many players.
* Fixed [[Tulip Snake]]s causing lag spikes for the host player when they would walk the interior.
* Indoor creature spawn curves, which are based on the time of day, now round up as well as down when determining the number of creatures to spawn, meaning that the creature spawn curve defined for each moon is represented more accurately. Spawn levels have all been adjusted down slightly by the same amount to compensate. (This might require rebalancing or I may revert it.)
* Slightly lowered night vision range to make the dark more dangerous without a light source
* Increased the distance at which [[Coilhead]]s will not enable their collision if they stop while ontop of a player, to prevent Coilheads from pushing players through walls
* Fixed cases where Forest Keepers could be "charged up" by almost seeing one player and then use that charge on another player, causing it to immediately see the other player.
* Crouching or standing still or just walking is now more effective on Forest Keepers when at a distance, and past a certain, far distance they cannot see you at all.
* Starting a new file now sets a random seed initially, instead of always defaulting to zero, which means the [[Store#Ship_decoration|furniture]] on sale will always be different on the first quota.
</blockquote>
—Zeekerss<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/516364699048083723 Version 80 Beta!]</ref>
==== Undocumented Changes ====
* Changed the game's desktop icon

=== Version 80 Patch ===
<blockquote>
I've patched V80
* It's less dark indoors now without a flashlight but not exactly as bright as before
* Cadaver Growths cannot infect you if you haven't personally stood in them for more than a few seconds, but being in them for long amounts of time also results in your infection progressing much faster if/when you do become infected.
** For solo players, the HUD status indicates the quality of your air filter, and it takes longer to exhaust the air filter.
** Infected players cannot bloom while the ship is leaving the moon, and if you are the last player alive, the game gives you an extra long warning when you are about to bloom, similar to in solo.
* Fixed spots in March where you could stand deep underwater and not drown
* Fixed teleporters causing players' items to desync their positions when dropped
* Fixed players being able to use the terminal to reroute the ship while it was landing, causing many problems.
* Fixed jetpacks dropping incorrectly visually
* Changed Sigurd log locations on many moons
* And other misc. fixes
</blockquote>
—Zeekerss<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/750645598293590077/750645813771763723/1489503900661710939 V80 patchnotes] via Zeekerss in The Dark Place Travelers discord</ref>
===== Undocumented Changes =====
* Using the terminal command <code>SCAN</code> while in orbit will now show the amount of items on the ship, as well as their total value.
* Added cosmetic changes for April Fools, which are automatically active based off of the system clock:
** The screen is flipped, which can be turned off in game settings
** Player voices are distorted in pitch. The pitch is different per player, and determined by the lobby map seed upon joining
In addition to this, this update had several completely undocumented hotfixes later in the day, all under 1MB each.
* The flipped screen setting is no longer automatically enabled on April 1st
* Player voice pitch now only takes effect when injured, increasing in severity the lower that player's HP gets

* The flipped screen setting is once again automatically enabled on April 1st
* Fixed fog rendering thinner when spectating while dead or toggling screen flip, which allowed players to see through it at certain angles

=== Version 81 Patch 1 ===
<blockquote>
V81 Patch
* If players are looking down at the floor, their items will drop beneath their feet instead of behind their body in certain cases, which would allow players to drop items through walls.
* Fixed players not using the proper two-handed hold animation when switching from a two-handed item to an empty item and then to another two-handed item that uses a different animation
* Fixed weather being desynced between clients and the host player when the host loaded a file that had three days left until the quota.
* Fixed creatures adding to the moon's diversity level every time they spawned, which may have reduced the amount of outdoor creatures that can spawn on a few moons.
* Fixed issue where the host disconnecting from the game while the ship was entering the atmosphere would cause all the scrap on the entire moon to be collected and appear on the ship when the file was loaded again.
* Fixed Old Birds not being able to enter flight mode.
* Fixed Cadaver Blooms standing in place for an extra long time after taking control of a player if they could not see anyone.
* Fixed Cadaver Blooms falling very slowly if they bloomed from a player in the air
* Fixed Cadaver Blooms sometimes "falling" towards a spot that wasn't directly beneath itself when it would take control of a player
* Fixed Cadaver Growths not being able to spawn bloomed players if a cadaver bloom was previously destroyed (such as if it were eaten by the Earth Leviathan).
* Fixed Cadaver Blooms sometimes not spawning a player body when killed
* Battery meter and icon are now always visible but darkened, to make the utility slot feel at home on the HUD with some visual context
* Cadaver Blooms now stay in the elevator when blooming from a player in the moving mineshaft elevator, instead of phasing through it.
* Maneater now stays in the elevator when it grows up while in the mineshaft elevator, instead of phasing through it.
* The Kidnapper Fox now has a behavior to run away to the safety of its nest if it is weakened and is hit while far away from it
* Fixed Vain Shrouds not being able to grow on snow moons, and they now have a snowy appearance
* Creatures should appear less desynced with the elevator when standing in the moving elevator for non-host players. (This was already implemented, but it was effectively random whether it would work or not.)
* Reduced camera pitch and roll motion when crouch-walking to reduce motion sickness
* Bee hives can no longer spawn deep underwater, which may have been one cause for bees becoming roaming killer bees at the start of the day
* Bees will no longer go after a player whose face is underwater
* Made a possible fix for bees settling down at a position that isn't their hive
* Fixed an issue where using weed killer on Vain Shrouds would cause the moon to fail to load on the next day
* Gunkfish slime now does not apply if you are underwater and crouched at the same time, so it's possible to get through the underwater cave.
* Fog on moons has been updated to fit better visually, and foggy weather color is also varied based on the moon
</blockquote>
—Zeekerss<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/750645598293590077/750645813771763723/1489503900661710939 V81 patchnotes] via Zeekerss in The Dark Place Travelers discord</ref>
==== Undocumented Changes ====
* Fixed Vain Shrouds being able to grow on March and Gordion when repeatedly savescumming

Patch:

* Slight changes to March's geometry around the jump to the ship. Also fixed spots where enemies could spawn stuck in the walls on March.
* Slight changes to the snare flea's acceleration to make it easier to jump over, to compensate for the fact that creatures now react better to players jumping

* Fixed/updated Gunkfish behavior; they now take less time to choose different spots and properly choose a position that isn't right ontop of the player, as well as choosing different spots from each other. Now their power level is halved and they are more likely to spawn in groups.

Patch:

Being critically injured and bleeding near a plant increases the chance of infection drastically. Health also affects the speed at which the infection progresses in a similar way.
** Being healed by weed killer removes the residual effect that spending lots of time in the plants has on the infection's progression speed after a player has been infected.

######## Version 9
{{Stub}}{{Unused}}

'''Version 9''' is an early Patreon-exclusive version of the game much like [[Version 4]], but contains less differences to the initial release build, [[Version 35]].

This version of the game can be accessed by getting the beta code from the member-only Discord channel, accessible via supporting [[Zeekerss]] on Patreon.

== Notable Differences ==

* F is the button used for the [[Echo Scanner]] instead of right click.
* The ability to move props around your [[ship]] is missing.
* The clipboard can be found inside the Cupboard.
* The Terminal starts with {{credits|30}}.
* In replacement of [[Weather]], [[Moons]] will start at varying times: Dawn, Noon, Sundown.
* Past 7:25 PM the ship will warn you about dangerous conditions on the moon prior to you landing.
* Upgrades and Suits cannot be found in the Store but under a separate command labelled "[[Ship]]".
* The Deadline is based on how many hours you spend on a moon starting at 3 Days, 15 Hours.
* The starting Profit Quota is {{credits|300}}.
* The [[Offense]] Fire Exit was in a different location.
* The [[Apparatus]] is worth {{credits|130}} and is misspelled as "apparatice".
* You can pick locked doors without a [[Lockpicker]], certain locks have varying times.
* Titan is a hidden moon.

==Branches== <!--T:4-->

<!--T:5-->
Zeekerss makes use of branches on Steam to roll out updates in a gradual, phased manner and enable private access to newer builds before they are released in beta through a password. Each branch tends to include a description of its purpose. The original descriptions are provided here in ''italics''. According to [https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/depots/#branches SteamDB], there are four branches known to exist.

<!--T:6-->
;<code>public</code>
:The default, primary branch.
;<code>beta</code>
:A private branch assumed to be made available only for trusted members of development such as playtesters.
;<code>public_beta</code>
:''For testing new versions''
;<code>previous</code>
:''The previous version''</translate>

==Demo==
During the launch of the game, Zeekerss also published a demo, understood to be v30. At some point later on, this demo was removed from the Steam storefront, but it is possible that players who downloaded it before may still have access. According to [https://steamdb.info/depot/2563241/manifests/ SteamDB], the demo was updated several times, all of which were before the release of v35.

==Branches==

Zeekerss makes use of branches on Steam to roll out updates in a gradual, phased manner and enable private access to newer builds before they are released in beta through a password. Each branch tends to include a description of its purpose. The original descriptions are provided here in ''italics''. According to [https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/depots/#branches SteamDB], there are four branches known to exist.

;<code>public</code>
:The default, primary branch.
;<code>beta</code>
:A private branch assumed to be made available only for trusted members of development such as playtesters.
;<code>public_beta</code>
:''For testing new versions''
;<code>previous</code>
:''The previous version''

==Demo==
During the launch of the game, Zeekerss also published a demo, understood to be v30. At some point later on, this demo was removed from the Steam storefront, but it is possible that players who downloaded it before may still have access. According to [https://steamdb.info/depot/2563241/manifests/ SteamDB], the demo was updated several times, all of which were before the release of v35.

== Betas ==

Zeekerss utiliza betas no Steam para lançar atualizações de uma forma gradual e em fases e permitir acesso privado de novas versões antes de seu lançamento em beta por uma senha. Cada beta tende a indicar uma descrição de seu propósito. As descrições originais estão escritas em ''itálico''. De acordo com o [https://steamdb.info/app/1966720/depots/#branches SteamDB], existem quatro ramos conhecidos.

;<code>public</code>
:O ramo padrão, primário.
;<code>beta</code>
:Um ramo privado onde se assume que é apenas disponibilizado para membros confiáveis para testa-lo.
;<code>public_beta</code>
:''Para testar novas versões''
;<code>previous</code>
:''A versão anterior''

######## Vow/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox|
| moon = Vow
| image = Vow.png
| routecost = 0
}}'''Vow''' is a rather dangerous [[Moons|moon]] and belongs to the category of Easy moons. It has a hazard level of "C" and offers accordingly little loot. Despite that, it is quite dangerous indoors as well as outdoors compared to the amount and value of loot that can be found here.

== Description ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=56-Vow

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

CONDITIONS: Humid.

HISTORY: Vow appears to have been inhabited by several colonies across its continents, but there is now no sign of life, and they have become a mystery.

FAUNA: Diverse, teeming with plant-life}}
== Environment ==

Vow has a lush forest environment full of hills and trees. In front of the Main Entrance are two bridges spanning a deep gully lead to the main entrance. One bridge is a solid dam, with the fire exit at its foot, and the other is a rickety metal bridge that collapses under too much stress.

=== The Fragile Bridge ===

The bridge on the right has a durability of 1. For each second at least one employee is standing on it the durability decreases at a rate of <code>0.02 * (employeeCount * employeeCount)/s</code> where <code>employeeCount</code> is the number of employees currently standing on the bridge.

Additionally, for each employee on the bridge that is carrying more than 11lbs, the durability will further decrease at a rate of <code>0.04 * totalWeight</code> where <code>totalWeight</code> is how much weight the employee is carrying. [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] also cause the bridge durability to decrease at a rate of <code>1/4.25 ≈ 0.2353 durability/s</code>.

If nobody is standing on it, it will slowly regenerate its durability back to 1 at a rate of <code>0.2 durability/s</code>.

Once the durability reaches 0, the bridge collapses and employees on it will fall with it.

Employees and [[Forest Keeper|Forest Keepers]] are the only things that reduce the durability of the bridge, other [[Entities]] and dropped [[Scrap|Scrap]] do not affect the bridge.

== Strategy ==

The fastest path from the ship to the main entrance is to turn right when exiting the ship and to go in a straight line towards the fragile bridge.

The optimal path to get in and out of the interior is to go straight towards the right bridge. It can be difficult to identify which direction the interior is in, since the landing area has few landmarks. The fragile bridge will usually hold one employee without breaking. If crossing with multiple employees or heavy items, it may be better to use the dam.

While it may be necessary to take a detour to avoid outdoor entities, employees are encouraged to keep their trips across Vow's surface as short and direct as possible from evening onwards, as it is easy to get lost in the densely wooded terrain and the presence of at least one [[Forest Keeper]] is virtually guaranteed.

On Vow, daytime entities have an extended spawn timer at the beginning of the day before also gradually decreasing with time. See [[Mechanics]] for interpretation.

######## Vow/ru

}}'''Vow''' - довольно опасная [[Moons/ru|луна]], принадлежащая к категории Лёгких лун. Имеет уровень опасности "C" и предлагает соответствующе немного лута. Вопреки этому, по сравнению с количеством и ценностью лута, находимого здесь, всё же довольно опасна как в здании, так и снаружи.

<span id="Description"></span>
== Описание ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=56-Vow

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

УСЛОВИЯ: Влажные.

ИСТОРИЯ: Vow, кажется, была обитаема множеством колоний, распределённых по её континентам, но следов жизни уже не осталось и они стали тайной.

ФАУНА: Разнообразна, кишит растительностью.}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== Окружение ==

Vow наполнена пышными холмистыми лесами. Перед главным входом имеется пропасть с двумя мостами, по которым её можно пересечь. Левый, бетонный, прекрасно стабилен, а у его подножия располагается пожарный выход. Правый же под достаточным количеством нагрузки обрушится. На левом мосту можно найти запись.

<span id="The_Fragile_Bridge"></span>
=== Хрупкий Мост ===

У правого моста прочность 1. Каждую секунду, когда как минимум один сотрудник стоит на нём, прочность уменьшается со скоростью <code>0.02 * (employeeCount * employeeCount)/с</code>, где <code>employeeCount</code> - количество сотрудников, стоящих на мосту.

Дополнительно, за каждого сотрудника на мосту, который носит более 11 фунтов, прочность будет дополнительно снижаться со скоростью <code>0.04 * totalWeight</code>, где <code>totalWeight</code> - общий вес всего, что носит сотрудник. [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранители Леса]] также снижают прочность моста со скоростью <code>1/4.25 ≈ 0.2353 прочности/с</code>

Если никто не стоит на мосту, он будет медленно восстанавливать прочность обратно до 1 со скоростью <code>0.2 прочности/с</code>.

Как только прочность падает до 0, мост рушится и сотрудники, находившиеся на нём, падают вместе с ним.

Сотрудники и [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранители Леса]] - единственные, кто может снижать прочность моста, другие [[Entities/ru|Сущности]] и сброшенный [[Scrap|Лут]] не влияют на мост.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Самый быстрый путь от корабля к главному входу лежит справа от выхода из корабля по прямой линии через хрупкий мост.

Оптимальный путь лежит прямо через хрупкий мост. Определить направление, в котором находится здание, может быть трудно, так как зона посадки почти не имеет ориентиров. Правый мост обычно может выдержать одного сотрудника, не обрушиваясь. При пересечении несколькими сотрудниками или с тяжёлым грузом будет лучше воспользоваться дамбой левее.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While it may be necessary to take a detour to avoid outdoor entities, employees are encouraged to keep their trips across Vow's surface as short and direct as possible from evening onwards, as it is easy to get lost in the densely wooded terrain and the presence of at least one [[Forest Keeper]] is virtually guaranteed.
</div>

== Сущности ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== Внутри здания ===

[[Bracken/ru|Цветочник]] - самая часто встречающаяся сущность на Vow. Это делает интерьер Vow довольно опасным для исследования, особенно в одиночку, так как Орляк может очень легко подкрасться к сотруднику. Также стоит упомянуть, что можно оказаться во втором типе интерьера, Особняке, но шанс этого очень мал.
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== Ночные ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
[[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранитель Леса]] - самая часто встречающаяся сущность на Vow, с шансом появления более 60%. Это делает внешнюю часть карты Vow одной из самых опасных.
</div> 
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== Дневные ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
[[Circuit Bees/ru|Пчёлы]] встречаются тут чуть более часто, чем на [[Assurance/ru|Assurance]], но огромные размеры карты не делают их нахождение лёгким. Из-за увеличенного шанса появления [[Forest Keeper/ru|Хранителей Леса]] сотрудникам не рекомендуется в поисках пчёл отдаляться от корабля.
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}
<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== Кривые шансов спавна ===

[[File:Vow_spawn_curve.png|thumb]]

Ночные сущности на Vow начинают появляться около 2 дня с довольно большой погрешностью спавна. Подобно [[Assurance/ru|Assurance]], после 9 вечера появления сущностей значительно увеличивается с пиком в полночь. На Vow, дневные сущности имеют продлённый таймер появления в начале дня до того, как снова плавно уменьшиться со временем. Смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]] для интерпретации.

== Чипы данных ==
Чип, содержащий запись "[[Sigurd_Logs/ru#Крики - 13 Сен|Крики]]" можно найти на дамбе.

{{navbox moons}}

[[Category:Moons]]

######## Vow/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoInfobox|infobox|
| moon = Vow
| image = Vow.png
| routecost = 0
}}'''Vow''' 是一颗相当危险的[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]，并且属于简单星球。它的危险等级为 "C"，提供的废料也相应较少。尽管如此，与这里的废料数量和价值相比，它的室内和室外都相当危险。

<span id="Description"></span>
== 描述 ==
{{Template:Terminal|text=56-Vow

<nowiki>----------------------</nowiki>

环境：潮湿。

历史：Vow 的各个大陆似乎都有生物群落的定居痕迹，但现今已没有任何生命迹象。这些痕迹变成了未解之谜。

生态：丰富多样，植被茂密}}
<span id="Environment"></span>
== 环境 ==

Vow 拥有郁郁葱葱的森林环境，到处都是山丘和树木。主要入口前有两座桥，横跨深沟通往主入口。一座桥是坚固的大坝，桥脚是防火出口，另一座桥是摇摇晃晃的金属桥，载重过大就会坍塌。

<span id="The_Fragile_Bridge"></span>
=== 脆弱的桥梁 ===

右边的桥的耐久度为1，当每秒钟至少有一名员工站在桥上是，耐久度的下降速度为 <code>0.02 * (玩家人数 * 玩家人数)/s</code> 其中 <code>玩家人数</code> 是站在桥上的玩家人数。

此外，桥梁上每有一名玩家负重超过 11 磅，耐久度就会进一步降低，降低速度为 <code>0.04 * 总重量</code> ，其中 <code>总重量</code> 是指玩家的体重。 [[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]] 也会导致桥梁耐久度降低，降低速度为 <code>1/4.25 ≈ 0.2353 耐久度/s</code>。

如果没有人站在上面，它的耐久度会慢慢恢复到 1，恢复速度为  <code>0.2 耐久度/s</code>。

一旦耐久度跌落至 0，桥就会倒塌，桥上的玩家也会随之摔下。

只有玩家和[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]会降低桥梁的耐久度，其他[[Entities/zh-cn|实体]]和掉落的[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]不会影响桥梁耐久度。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

从船上到主要入口的最快路径是下船后向右转，然后沿直线走向会坍塌的桥。

进出内部的最佳路径是直奔右边的桥。由于着陆区几乎没有地标，因此很难辨别森林内部的方向。桥通常可承载一名玩家而不会断裂。如果需要多名玩家或重物通过，最好使用左边的水坝。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
While it may be necessary to take a detour to avoid outdoor entities, employees are encouraged to keep their trips across Vow's surface as short and direct as possible from evening onwards, as it is easy to get lost in the densely wooded terrain and the presence of at least one [[Forest Keeper]] is virtually guaranteed.
</div>

== 物品表 ==
{{#invoke:Moons/AutoTables|lootTables|Vow}}

<span id="Entities"></span>
== 实体 ==

<span id="Indoor"></span>
=== 室内 ===

[[Bracken/zh-cn|蕨影]]是 Vow 上最常见的实体。这使得在 Vow 的室内地图中探索相当危险，尤其是独自一人时，因为 [[Bracken/zh-cn|蕨影]] 可以非常容易地偷袭员工。值得一提的是，玩家可以进入第二种室内地图——豪宅，但几率非常低。
{{Template:WikiAutomated/IndoorEntities}}
<span id="Nighttime"></span>
=== 夜间 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]是迄今为止 Vow 中最常见的实体，其生成率超过60%。这使得 Vow 的室外地图成为最危险的区域之一。
</div> 
{{Template:WikiAutomated/NighttimeEntities}}
<span id="Daytime"></span>
=== 日间 ===

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Vow 的[[Circuit Bees/zh-cn|电路蜜蜂]]比在 [[Assurance/zh-cn|Assurance]] 更常见，但地图面积大并不意味着更容易找到它们。由于[[Forest Keeper/zh-cn|森林守护者]]的出现几率增加，我们不鼓励员工离开飞船太远去寻找它们。
</div>
{{Template:WikiAutomated/DaytimeEntities}}
<span id="Spawn_chance_curves"></span>
=== 生成概率曲线 ===

[[File:Vow_spawn_curve.png|thumb]]

Vow 上的夜间实体在下午2点左右开始生成，生成偏差相当大。与 [[Assurance/zh-cn|Assurance]] 类似，晚上9点之后，夜间实体的生成量会急剧增加，并在凌晨12点达到高峰。在 Vow 上，白天的实体在一天开始时的生成时间较长，之后也会随着时间的推移而逐渐减少。曲线绘制方式详见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。

== 数据芯片 ==
在大坝上可以找到一个包含日志“[[Sigurd_Logs/zh-cn#尖叫__Sep_13|尖叫]]”的芯片。

The '''Walkie-Talkie''' is used to communicate with co-workers beyond the proximity chat radius. It can transmit both voice and text (using the in-game chat) when activated.

######## Walkie-talkie/en
{{topicon Fandom|Walkie-Talkie}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item

== Company Description ==
{{Terminal|Useful for keeping in touch! Hear other players when the walkie-talkie is in your inventory. Must be in your hand and pressed down to transmit voice.}}
== Overview ==

The '''Walkie-Talkie''' is used to communicate with co-workers beyond the proximity chat radius. It can transmit both voice and text (using the in-game chat) when activated.

A very useful item, especially if your unit breaks up to cover a larger area. A fully charged walkie-talkie lasts for 820 seconds when turned on.

== Strategy ==

The walkie-talkie allows players to split up while maintaining communication. Another common strategy is for a player to remain in [[Ship|The Ship]] and use the monitor and [[Computer Terminal]] to warn and aid players who are out gathering [[scrap]].

A fully charged walkie-talkie will last longer than an entire day on a moon, the day being 11 minutes and the walkie-talkie's battery being about 13 minutes. Players with a walkie-talkie that is fully charged at the start of a day can use the battery meter to keep track of time while inside the facility, eg. 50% is roughly 5:00 PM.

If someone with a walkie-talkie dies while having it on it will produce static on others walkie-talkies.

== Trivia ==

* When turning on a walkie-talkie and standing against the Company Building wall on [[Gordion]], either directly across from the ship or on the drill's platform, one of the easter egg sounds can be heard. <code>Kola.ogg</code> plays constantly by default. Every 20 seconds, if a player is closer than 5 units to <code>(-38.51, -7.72, -10.56)</code> and rolls a 3/120 chance, <code>FreeRefillsForever.ogg</code> will play. However, this sound will get cut off after 20 seconds due to it being overwritten by <code>Kola.ogg</code>. {{ref code|WalkieTalkie.SetWallAudioVolume}} This easter egg is hinted at in the log "[[Sigurd_Logs#Screams_-_Sep_13|Screams]]".
* The back of the walkie-talkie has a barcode that says "uh why".

######## Walkie-talkie/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom|Walkie-Talkie}}
{{interlangbox}}

<span id="Company_Description"></span>
== 公司描述 ==
{{Terminal|Useful for keeping in touch! Hear other players when the walkie-talkie is in your inventory. Must be in your hand and pressed down to transmit voice.}}
<span id="Overview"></span>
== 概述 ==

'''对讲机'''用于在近距离语音聊天范围之外与同事沟通。启用后，它可以同时传输语音和文字（通过游戏内聊天）。

这是一件非常实用的道具，尤其当你的队伍分散开来、需要覆盖更大区域时。对讲机满电开启后可续航

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

对讲机可以让玩家分头行动，同时保持通讯。另一种常用战术是让一名玩家留在[[The Ship|飞船]]里，通过监控屏幕和[[Computer Terminal|电脑终端]]，为外出搜集[[scrap|废料]]的队友提供预警和协助。

满电的对讲机续航时间会超过卫星上的一整个工作日：游戏内一天时长为11分钟，而对讲机电池大约能使用13分钟。
在工作日开始时持有满电对讲机的玩家，可以在设施内通过电量条来估算时间，例如电量剩余50%时大约是下午5点。

如果携带对讲机的玩家在开机状态下死亡，其他对讲机里会传出电流杂音。

== Trivia ==
</div>

* 在打开对讲机并紧贴**[[Gordion|戈尔迪翁]]** 公司大楼墙壁站立时（无论是正对飞船的位置，还是钻井平台上），可以听到其中一个彩蛋音效。
`Kola.ogg` 默认会持续播放。每过20秒，如果玩家距离坐标 `(-38.51, -7.72, -10.56)` 不足5个单位，且触发 **3/120** 的随机概率，就会播放 `FreeRefillsForever.ogg`。
不过这段音效会在20秒后被 `Kola.ogg` 覆盖而提前中断。{{ref code|WalkieTalkie.SetWallAudioVolume}}
该彩蛋在日志**[[Screams|尖叫]]** 中已有暗示。
* 对讲机的背面有一个条形码，下方印着一行字：“呃，为啥啊”。
