######## Weather
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Verify}}
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
Weather is a mechanic intended to add difficulty on [[moons]]. Players can check the forecast on a moon through the text in brackets beside each moon's name within the ‘moons’ terminal command, provided the day has fully changed. Weather does not affect the amount and value of [[scrap]].

== Weather types == <!--T:8-->

=== Eclipsed === <!--T:40-->
</translate>
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|<translate><!--T:33--> A moon experiencing an eclipse</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:41-->
This weather phenomenon allows for immediate spawns of nighttime entities and significantly increases the spawn rate of entities both indoors and outdoors, making eclipsed moons much more dangerous to explore with no additional benefit.

<!--T:39-->
During an eclipse, the <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>(indoor entities) and <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>(nighttime outdoor entities) are changed according to the table below. See [[Mechanics]] for a detailed explanation of these two variables.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable
!
! <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>
! <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>
|-
| [[Experimentation]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Assurance]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Vow]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Offense]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4
|-
| [[March]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 2
|-
| [[Adamance]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|-
| [[Rend]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|-
| [[Dine]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4
|-
| [[Titan]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|-
| [[Embrion]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4
|-
| [[Artifice]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|}
<translate>
<!--T:5-->
=== Flooded ===
The moon begins to flood, making it impossible to traverse its exterior after a certain point.

<!--T:9-->
Moving on flooded terrain slows employees down considerably and makes them unable to sprint. It also drains stamina, preventing it from regenerating until the employee is out of the water. Being underwater for a prolonged period of time drowns the employee.

<!--T:10-->
Flooding is based on the time of the day and progresses as time goes on, making the moon more dangerous to navigate the longer that employees stay. Some moons, such as Adamance, start at maximum flooding, with the water level lowering over the course of the day. March is always covered with pits of water.

<!--T:11-->
Time until Maximum Flood level: Approx. 5 pm, may vary between moons.

<!--T:46-->
=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}

<!--T:4-->
The entire moon's exterior is covered in thick fog, making it difficult to navigate.

<!--T:44-->
There is a mechanism for reducing [[entities]]' vision in fog:
The maximum line-of-sight distance for spotting employees is capped at 30 units (you can think of this as making everything near-sighted).
All entities are affected by this as it's managed by the base class <code>EnemyAI</code>.<ref group="note">
It does also allow for the clamping step to be skipped with a property <code>canSeeThroughFog</code>, but no entity uses that.
</ref>

<!--T:2-->
=== Rainy ===
Rain leaves dark patches of quicksand on the ground, posing a swift and lethal threat to employees. It is possible to escape the quicksand by reacting quickly and moving out before going too deep. Sinking too deep will result in the employees death which will leave no body and delete all held items. A quicksand patch looks a bit like a large circular puddle of brown dirt on the ground and especially at night, it can be quite hard to spot it.

<!--T:18-->
Adamance has a permanently fixed quicksand patch on the ground, regardless of the weather conditions.

=== Stormy === <!--T:3-->
</translate>
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|<translate><!--T:36--> A sparking item</translate>]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|<translate><!--T:37--> The sound played when an item is sparking</translate>]]
<translate>
<!--T:38-->
During a thunderstorm, conductive items lying on the ground or held by employees can acquire an electric charge that causes them to be struck by lightning after a short delay. When this happens, the item audibly begins to spark. Lighting strikes can be avoided by dropping the item and moving away.

<!--T:47-->
Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.

<!--T:34-->
Random lightning strikes can also occur around the map independently of conductive items and may strike employees without warning.
</translate>
* <translate><!--T:19--> If an employee has a conductive item in their inventory but is not actively holding it, sparks will still appear and they can identify the charged item by rotating through inventory slots.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:20--> Lightning may strike a metal object multiple times, so it is advised to wait for a second or two before picking the items back up.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:21--> If a sparking item is located below a cover such as a roof, the lightning bolt will instead strike on the roof and not hit the item directly. This mainly works on solid roofs or the ship's ceiling. There might be other spots where this works depending on the map, but this is not always a reliable strategy.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:22--> If lightning strikes the ship, the ship's lights and monitor will turn off. They can be turned on again with the light switch or a [[Remote]], and the power button on the side of the monitor, respectively.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:23--> It is possible for employees to avoid lightning to some extent by standing close to a wall when holding a sparking item, or by having a tulip snake on them.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:24--> The "Lightning strike warning" cannot appear when an object in an employee's inventory is sparking.</translate>
* <translate><!--T:35--> Items bought during Stormy weather are not conductive and stay that way until the ship enters orbit again.</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:30-->
For a full list of conductive items, check the [[scrap]] page and also the [[Store#Equipment|equipment list]], or take a look at the [[:Category:Conductive items|conductive items category]].

== Weather choice == <!--T:31-->

<!--T:25-->
Firstly, the game decides how many moons will be affected by weather. This value is evaluated from a curve with a random input value between 0 and 1. If the following criteria are met, the evaluated value is multiplied by a random number between 1.5 and 2.5:

<!--T:26-->
* The crew consists of at least 2 employees (Multiplayer)
* The number of days all employees survived in a row without dying is a multiple of 3 (at least 3 days)
Note: The evaluated value is converted to an integer and clamped between 0 and the number of moons, which means that if the value is above 8, all moons will be affected by weather.

<!--T:27-->
The curve on the left is the default curve for determining how many moons will be affected by weather conditions. The curve on the right is multiplied by 2.5, the maximum possible multiplier, used when the above criteria are met.
</translate>
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
<translate>
<!--T:29-->
For every moon that has been selected, a random index in the list of the moon's possible weather then determines the type of weather the moon will have on that day.

<!--T:43-->

######## Weather/cs
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Verify}}
Počasí je mechanizmus zamýšlený aby přidal obtížnost k [[moons|měsícům]]. Hráči se můžou podívat na předpověď k měsíci napsáno v závorce vedle jméno měsíce v ‘moons’ terminálovém příkazu, pokud celý den uběhl. Počasí nemá vliv na počet a hodnotu [[scrap|šrotu]].

<span id="Weather_types"></span>
== Typy počasí ==

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
=== Zatmění ===
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|Měsíc probíhající zatměním.]]
V tomhle povětrnostním jevu se můžou hned objevit noční entity a o hodně zvyšuje spawn rate entit venku i vevnitř, což dělá zatměné měsíce hodně težší s žadnými dalšími výhodami.

Při zatmění, <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>(vnitřní entity) a <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>(noční venkovní entity) jsou změněny podle tabulky níže. Podívejte se na [[Mechanics|Mechaniky]] pro detailované vysvětlení těhle dvou proměnných.

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Potopa ===
Měsíc se začne zaplavovat, což dělá nemožné přejít venek po určité době.
</div>

Pohybovat se po zatopeném terénu velmi zpomaluje zaměstnance a udělá nemožné běhat. Také plýtvá staminu, zabraňuje její regeneraci dokud nevyjde z vody. Být hodně dlouho pod vodou zaměstnance utopí.

Zatopení je určeno podle času a zvyšuje se jak ubýhá čas, což dělá když je pozdě měsíc hodně nebezpečný se přes něj navigovat.

Čas než Maximální Hladina Potopy: Kolem 5 pm, může se měnit mezi měsících.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Mlha ===
Celý venek měsíce je zahalený v husté mlze, což dělá to těžší se přes něj navigovat.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a mechanism for reducing [[entities]]' vision in fog:
The maximum line-of-sight distance for spotting employees is capped at 30 units (you can think of this as making everything near-sighted).
All entities are affected by this as it's managed by the base class <code>EnemyAI</code>.<ref group="note">
It does also allow for the clamping step to be skipped with a property <code>canSeeThroughFog</code>, but no entity uses that.
</ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Déšť ===
Déšť nechává tmavé skvrny pohyblivého písku, což představuje pro zaměstnance rychlou a smrtelnou hrozbu. Je možné z písku utéct když rychle zareagujete a vyjdete z něj než budete moc hluboko. Skvrna pohyblivého písku vypadá jako velká louže hnědé hlíny na zemi a hlavně v noci, může být obtížné je spatřit.
</div>

March má trvalé skvrny pohyblivého písku na zemi ,i když neprší. (March nemůže mít i tak déšť)

<span id="Stormy"></span>
=== Bouřka ===
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|Jiskřící předmět]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|Zvuk který hraje když předmět jiskří]]
Při bouřce, vodivé předměty na zemi nebo v rukách zaměstnance mohou získat elektrický náboj, což udělá ho po krátké době být trefen bleskem. Když se tohle stane, předmět začne hlasitě jiskřit. Dá se vyhnout blesků když předmět pustíte a odejdete od něj.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.
</div>

Náhodné blesky se také občas mohou objevit na mapě mimo vodivých předmětů a mohou trefit zaměstnance bez varování.
* Jestli zaměstnanec drží vodivý předmět v inventáři ale nedrží ho, jiskry se i tak objeví a předmět který je vydává se může identifikovat když budete procházet míst v inventáři.
* Blesk může trefit železný objekt vícekrát, takže je doporučeno čekat chvilku než předmět si vezmete zpátky.
* Jestli jiskřící předmět je pod krytem, blesk trefí ten kryt a ne předmět. Tohle hlavně funguje na solidních střechách a střechu lodě. Může být i více míst kde tohle funguje, ale není to vždycky spolehlivá strategie.
* Jestli blesk trefí loď, její světla se vypnou. Můžou být zase zapnuta vypínačem světla nebo [[Remote|Ovladačem]] a tlačítko napájení na straně monitoru, respektive.
* Je možné se vyhnout blesku do jisté míry když stojíte blízko zdi když držíte jiskřící předmět nebo když máte na hlavě tulipového hada.
* "Lighting strike warning" se nemůže objevit když objekt v inventáři jiskří.
* Předměty nakoupeny při Bouřce nejsou vodivé a zůstanou tak dokud nepůjde loď do oběžné dráhy znovu.
Pro plný seznam vodivých předmětů, podívejte se na stránku [[scrap|šrotu]] a taky [[Store#Equipment|seznam vybacení]], nebo jenom na [[:Category:Conductive items|seznam vodivých předmětů]].

<span id="Weather_choice"></span>
== Výběr počasí ==

Zaprvé, hra si rozhodne kolik měsíců bude mít počasí. Tahle hodnota je hodnocena z křivky s náhodným vstupní hodnotou mezi 0 a 1. Jestli následující kritéria jsou splněna, zhodnocena hodnota je vynásobena mezi 1.5 a 2.5:

* Posádka má alespoň 2 zaměstnance (Multiplayer)
* Číslo dnů bez umíráni je násobek třemi
Upozornění: Vyhodnocená hodnota je převedena na celé číslo a upnuta mezi 0 a počtu měsíců, což znamená, že když je hodnota nad 8, všechny měsíce budou mít počasí.

Křivka nalevo je běžná křivka pro určování kolik měsíců budou mít počasí. Křivka napravo je vynásobena 2.5, maximálním možným násobitelem, použit když kritéria nad jsou splněna.
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
Pro každý měsíc který byl vybrán, náhodný index v seznamu možných počasí měsíců determinuje typ počasí které bude ten den měsíc mít.

<span id="Weather_choice"></span>
== Auswahl der Wetterphänomene ==

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Zunächst entscheidet das Spiel, wie viele Monde eine besondere Wettersituation haben sollen. Dieser Wert wird einer Kurve mit zufälligem Eingabewert zwischen 0 und 1 entnommen. Wenn die folgenden Kriterien erfüllt sind, wird das Ergebnis mit einer zufälligen Zahl zwischen 1.5 und 2.5 multipliziert.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Mannschaft besteht aus mindesten 2 Mitarbeitern (Mehrspieler). Die Anzahl der Tage, welche alle Mitglieder überlebt haben ist ein Vielfaches von 3 (mindestens 3 Tage). 
Hinweis : Der finale Wert wird auf eine Ganzzahl abgerundet und zwischen 0 und der Anzahl der Monde beschränkt. Somit werden bei einem Wert von mehr als 8 alle Monde von Extremwetter betroffen.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Die Kurve auf der linken Seite ist die Schwierigkeitskurve, welche genutzt wird, um zu bestimmen, wie viele Monde von Wettersituationen betroffen werden. die Kurve auf der rechten Seite ist mit 2.5 multipliziert, dem maximalen Faktor, wenn alle Kriterien erfüllt sind.
</div>
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Für jeden ausgewählten Mond wird ein zufälliger Index aus der Liste der verfügbaren Wettersituationen gewählt, welcher die Art der Wettersituation bestimmt, welche an diesem Tag auftritt.
</div>

######## Weather/en
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Verify}}
Weather is a mechanic intended to add difficulty on [[moons]]. Players can check the forecast on a moon through the text in brackets beside each moon's name within the ‘moons’ terminal command, provided the day has fully changed. Weather does not affect the amount and value of [[scrap]].

== Weather types ==

=== Eclipsed ===
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|A moon experiencing an eclipse]]
This weather phenomenon allows for immediate spawns of nighttime entities and significantly increases the spawn rate of entities both indoors and outdoors, making eclipsed moons much more dangerous to explore with no additional benefit.

During an eclipse, the <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>(indoor entities) and <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>(nighttime outdoor entities) are changed according to the table below. See [[Mechanics]] for a detailed explanation of these two variables.
{| class="wikitable
!
! <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>
! <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>
|-
| [[Experimentation]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Assurance]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Vow]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1

| [[Offense]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4

=== Flooded ===
The moon begins to flood, making it impossible to traverse its exterior after a certain point. Some moons, such as Adamance, start at maximum flooding, with the water level lowering over the course of the day.

Moving on flooded terrain slows employees down considerably and makes them unable to sprint. It also drains stamina, preventing it from regenerating until the employee is out of the water. Being underwater for a prolonged period of time drowns the employee.

Flooding is based on the time of the day and progresses as time goes on, making the moon more dangerous to navigate the longer that employees stay.

Time until Maximum Flood level: Approx. 5 pm, may vary between moons.

=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}

The entire moon's exterior is covered in thick fog, making it difficult to navigate.

There is a mechanism for reducing [[entities]]' vision in fog:
The maximum line-of-sight distance for spotting employees is capped at 30 units (you can think of this as making everything near-sighted).
All entities are affected by this as it's managed by the base class <code>EnemyAI</code>.<ref group="note">
It does also allow for the clamping step to be skipped with a property <code>canSeeThroughFog</code>, but no entity uses that.
</ref>

=== Rainy ===
Rain leaves dark patches of quicksand on the ground, posing a swift and lethal threat to employees. It is possible to escape the quicksand by reacting quickly and moving out before going too deep. Sinking too deep will result in the employees death which will leave no body and delete all held items. A quicksand patch looks a bit like a large circular puddle of brown dirt on the ground and especially at night, it can be quite hard to spot it.

March, which cannot have rainy weather, and Adamance have permanently fixed quicksand patches on the ground regardless of the weather conditions.

=== Stormy ===
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|A sparking item]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|The sound played when an item is sparking]]
During a thunderstorm, conductive items lying on the ground or held by employees can acquire an electric charge that causes them to be struck by lightning after a short delay. When this happens, the item audibly begins to spark. Lighting strikes can be avoided by dropping the item and moving away.

Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.

Random lightning strikes can also occur around the map independently of conductive items and may strike employees without warning.
* If an employee has a conductive item in their inventory but is not actively holding it, sparks will still appear and they can identify the charged item by rotating through inventory slots.
* Lightning may strike a metal object multiple times, so it is advised to wait for a second or two before picking the items back up.
* If a sparking item is located below a cover such as a roof, the lightning bolt will instead strike on the roof and not hit the item directly. This mainly works on solid roofs or the ship's ceiling. There might be other spots where this works depending on the map, but this is not always a reliable strategy.
* If lightning strikes the ship, the ship's lights and monitor will turn off. They can be turned on again with the light switch or a [[Remote]], and the power button on the side of the monitor, respectively.
* It is possible for employees to avoid lightning to some extent by standing close to a wall when holding a sparking item, or by having a tulip snake on them.
* The "Lightning strike warning" cannot appear when an object in an employee's inventory is sparking.
* Items bought during Stormy weather are not conductive and stay that way until the ship enters orbit again.
For a full list of conductive items, check the [[scrap]] page and also the [[Store#Equipment|equipment list]], or take a look at the [[:Category:Conductive items|conductive items category]].

== Weather choice ==

Firstly, the game decides how many moons will be affected by weather. This value is evaluated from a curve with a random input value between 0 and 1. If the following criteria are met, the evaluated value is multiplied by a random number between 1.5 and 2.5:

* The crew consists of at least 2 employees (Multiplayer)
* The number of days all employees survived in a row without dying is a multiple of 3 (at least 3 days)
Note: The evaluated value is converted to an integer and clamped between 0 and the number of moons, which means that if the value is above 8, all moons will be affected by weather.

The curve on the left is the default curve for determining how many moons will be affected by weather conditions. The curve on the right is multiplied by 2.5, the maximum possible multiplier, used when the above criteria are met.
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
For every moon that has been selected, a random index in the list of the moon's possible weather then determines the type of weather the moon will have on that day.

######## Weather/es

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
El clima es una mecánica cuya intencionalidad es presumiblemente prevenir que la tripulación visite la misma luna repetidamente y añadir un grado de dificultad para aquellos jugadores lo suficientemente intrépidos para aventurarse por ellas. Los jugadores pueden ver el clima de las lunas leyendo el texto en corchetes al lado del nombre de cada [[Moons/es|luna]] usando el comando 'moons' en la terminal, siempre que el día haya pasado por completo. El clima no afecta la dificultad del [[Interiors/es|interior]] del edificio.
</div>

= Tormentoso =

El mero hecho de escucharlo es una advertencia para que el jugador suelte todo objeto metálico inmediatamente, y si el jugador no suelta sus objetos, será impactado por un rayo y morirá instantáneamente. Los objetos metálicos en el suelo también serán golpeados, y si el objeto está en la nave, las luces de la misma se apagarán cuando el rayo impacte. 

También es posible usar los rayos para matar a la fauna hostil, como por ejemplo los [[Eyeless Dog/es|perros sin ojos]].

######## Weather/fr
{{topicon Fandom}}

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
La météo est un mécanisme destiné à empêcher les joueurs de visiter la même planète à plusieurs reprises et à ajouter de la difficulté pour ceux qui sont assez courageux pour l'affronter. Les joueurs peuvent vérifier le temps qu'il fait sur les lunes en lisant le texte entre parenthèses à côté du nom de chaque [[Moons/fr|lune]] dans la commande de terminal 'lunes', à condition que le jour ait complètement changé. La météo n'affecte pas la difficulté de l'intérieur du bâtiment.

= Pluie =
Crée des taches de boue/sable mouvant à la surface. Les joueurs peuvent identifier ces taches à distance grâce à leur couleur plus foncée. Si le joueur marche sur de la boue ou des sables mouvants, il sera aspiré par le sol et suffoquera. En se retirant assez rapidement, les joueurs peuvent éviter d'être complètement submergés. Le [[Teleporter/fr|téléporteur]] ne peut pas récupérer les joueurs submergés

<span id="Stormy"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
= Tempête =
Bien qu'il pleuve dans cet événement, la carte ne sera ni inondée ni parsemée de flaques de boue. Au lieu de cela, le joueur doit être attentif aux signaux audio, qui indiquent que la foudre s'apprête à frapper les objets métalliques dans l'inventaire du joueur. La première fois que cela se produit, le joueur est averti qu'il doit immédiatement laisser tomber ses objets métalliques. Si le joueur s'accroche à ses objets, il sera frappé par la foudre et mourra instantanément. Les objets métalliques au sol seront également frappés, et si l'objet se trouve à l'intérieur du vaisseau, les lumières du vaisseau s'éteindront une fois la foudre tombée. Il est également à noter que le joueur peut utiliser la foudre pour tuer les animaux sauvages hostiles, comme les [[Eyeless Dog/fr|chiens aveugles]].
</div>

This mainly works on solid roofs or the ship's ceiling. There might be other spots where this works depending on the map, but this is not always a reliable strategy.</span>

* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">It is possible for employees to avoid lightning to some extent by standing close to a wall when holding a sparking item, or by having a tulip snake on them.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The "Lightning strike warning" cannot appear when an object in an employee's inventory is sparking.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Items bought during Stormy weather are not conductive and stay that way until the ship enters orbit again.</span>
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
For a full list of conductive items, check the [[scrap]] page and also the [[Store#Equipment|equipment list]], or take a look at the [[:Category:Conductive items|conductive items category]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Weather choice ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Firstly, the game decides how many moons will be affected by weather. This value is evaluated from a curve with a random input value between 0 and 1. If the following criteria are met, the evaluated value is multiplied by a random number between 1.5 and 2.5:
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
* The crew consists of at least 2 employees (Multiplayer)
* The number of days all employees survived in a row without dying is a multiple of 3 (at least 3 days)
Note: The evaluated value is converted to an integer and clamped between 0 and the number of moons, which means that if the value is above 8, all moons will be affected by weather.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
The curve on the left is the default curve for determining how many moons will be affected by weather conditions. The curve on the right is multiplied by 2.5, the maximum possible multiplier, used when the above criteria are met.
</div>
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
For every moon that has been selected, a random index in the list of the moon's possible weather then determines the type of weather the moon will have on that day.
</div>

######## Weather/it
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Verify}}
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
Il meteo è una meccanica presumibilmente aggiunta per impedire la visita dello stesso pianeta in continuazione e per aggiungere difficoltà a coloro che hanno il coraggio di affrontarlo. I giocatori possono controllare il meteo sulle lune leggendo il testo nelle parentesi accanto al nome di ogni [[Lune|luna]] nel comando 'lune' del terminale, a patto che la giornata sia completamente passata. Il meteo non influisce sulla difficoltà all'interno dell'edificio.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Weather types ==
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Eclipsed ===
</div>
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A moon experiencing an eclipse</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
This weather phenomenon allows for immediate spawns of nighttime entities and significantly increases the spawn rate of entities both indoors and outdoors, making eclipsed moons much more dangerous to explore with no additional benefit.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
During an eclipse, the <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>(indoor entities) and <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>(nighttime outdoor entities) are changed according to the table below. See [[Mechanics]] for a detailed explanation of these two variables.
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
= Allagato =
Appena atterrati su una [[Lune|luna]], i giocatori noteranno immediatamente pozzanghere d'acqua sul terreno e la pioggia. Durante l'esplorazione nella struttura, la luna gradualmente si allagherà sempre di più. Nel corso del tempo, i giocatori avranno sempre meno punti sicuri su cui camminare. Se un giocatore rimane sommerso nell'acqua per troppo tempo, il giocatore affogherà. Su alcune [[lune]], le uscite antincendio sono inutilizzabili dato che sono completamente sommerse. Questa condizione meteorologica non crea sabbie mobili.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Moving on flooded terrain slows employees down considerably and makes them unable to sprint. It also drains stamina, preventing it from regenerating until the employee is out of the water. Being underwater for a prolonged period of time drowns the employee.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Flooding is based on the time of the day and progresses as time goes on, making the moon more dangerous to navigate the longer that employees stay.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Time until Maximum Flood level: Approx. 5 pm, may vary between moons.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
= Nebbioso =
Riduce la visibilità drasticamente, rendendo la navigazione e la fuga dalla fauna difficile. I [[Guardiano della Foresta|Guardiani della foresta]] riescono ancora a vedere normalmente, nonostante ci sia la nebbia.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a mechanism for reducing [[entities]]' vision in fog:
The maximum line-of-sight distance for spotting employees is capped at 30 units (you can think of this as making everything near-sighted).
All entities are affected by this as it's managed by the base class <code>EnemyAI</code>.<ref group="note">
It does also allow for the clamping step to be skipped with a property <code>canSeeThroughFog</code>, but no entity uses that.
</ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
= Piovoso =
Crea fango/sabbie mobili sulla superficie. I giocatori possono localizzare queste macchie dalla distanza grazie al loro colore scuro. Se il giocatore cammina sul fango/sabbie mobili, sprofonderanno nel terreno e soffocheranno. Fare retromarcia velocemente permetterà ai giocatori di fuggire. Il [[Teletrasporto|teletrasporto]] non può riportare indietro giocatori sommersi.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
March, which cannot have rainy weather, and Adamance have permanently fixed quicksand patches on the ground regardless of the weather conditions.
</div>

<span id="Stormy"></span>
<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
= Tempestoso = 
Nonostante si sia pioggia in questo evento, la mappa non si allagherà e non si riempirà di pozzanghere di fango. Invece, il giocatore dovrà rimanere allerta per suoni che suggeriscono un fulmine che si prepara a colpire gli oggetti metallici nell'inventario del giocatore. La prima volta comparirà un avvertimento dove si consiglia di gettare gli oggetti metallici immediatamente. Se il giocatore non abbandonasse i suoi oggetti, verrà colpito da un fulmine e morirà istantaneamente. Gli oggetti metallici sul terreno verranno fulminati, e se l'oggetto è vicino alla nave, le luci della nave si spegneranno appena il fulmine colpisce. È opportuno dire che il giocatore può utilizzare il fulmine per uccidere la fauna ostile, come i [[Cane Senz'Occhi|cani senz'occhi]].
</div>
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">A sparking item</span>]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|<span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The sound played when an item is sparking</span>]]
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
During a thunderstorm, conductive items lying on the ground or held by employees can acquire an electric charge that causes them to be struck by lightning after a short delay. When this happens, the item audibly begins to spark. Lighting strikes can be avoided by dropping the item and moving away.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Random lightning strikes can also occur around the map independently of conductive items and may strike employees without warning.
</div>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">If an employee has a conductive item in their inventory but is not actively holding it, sparks will still appear and they can identify the charged item by rotating through inventory slots.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Lightning may strike a metal object multiple times, so it is advised to wait for a second or two before picking the items back up.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">If a sparking item is located below a cover such as a roof, the lightning bolt will instead strike on the roof and not hit the item directly. This mainly works on solid roofs or the ship's ceiling. There might be other spots where this works depending on the map, but this is not always a reliable strategy.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">If lightning strikes the ship, the ship's lights and monitor will turn off. They can be turned on again with the light switch or a [[Remote]], and the power button on the side of the monitor, respectively.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">It is possible for employees to avoid lightning to some extent by standing close to a wall when holding a sparking item, or by having a tulip snake on them.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">The "Lightning strike warning" cannot appear when an object in an employee's inventory is sparking.</span>
* <span lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">Items bought during Stormy weather are not conductive and stay that way until the ship enters orbit again.</span>
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
For a full list of conductive items, check the [[scrap]] page and also the [[Store#Equipment|equipment list]], or take a look at the [[:Category:Conductive items|conductive items category]].
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Flooded ===
The moon begins to flood, making it impossible to traverse its exterior after a certain point. Some moons, such as Adamance, start at maximum flooding, with the water level lowering over the course of the day.

=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">

</ref>
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Rainy ===
Rain leaves dark patches of quicksand on the ground, posing a swift and lethal threat to employees. It is possible to escape the quicksand by reacting quickly and moving out before going too deep. Sinking too deep will result in the employees death which will leave no body and delete all held items. A quicksand patch looks a bit like a large circular puddle of brown dirt on the ground and especially at night, it can be quite hard to spot it.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
March, which cannot have rainy weather, and Adamance have permanently fixed quicksand patches on the ground regardless of the weather conditions.
</div>

######## Weather/pt-br
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Verify}}
Clima é uma mecânica que adiciona dificuldade às [[moons/pt-br|luas]]. Jogadores podem verificar a previsão do tempo em uma lua pelo texto em colchetes ao lado do nome de cada lua no comando de terminal ‘moons’, isso se o dia já ter sido completamente mudado. Clima não afeta a quantidade e valor de [[scrap/pt-br|sucata]].

<span id="Weather_types"></span>
== Tipos de Clima ==

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
=== Eclipse ===
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|Uma lua durante um eclipse]]
Esse fenômeno climático permite pela geração infinita de entidades noturnas e significativamente aumenta a taxa de geração de entidades internas e externas, fazendo com que luas em eclipse fiquem muito mais perigosas de explorar, sem nenhum outro benefício.

Durante um eclipse, o <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code> (entidades dos interiores) e o <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code> (entidades ao ar livre noturnas) foram mudadas para a tabela abaixo. Veja [[Mechanics/pt-br|Mecânicas]] para uma explicação detalhada das duas variáveis.
{| class="wikitable
!
! <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>
! <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>
|-
| [[Experimentation]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Assurance]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Vow]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 1
|-
| [[Offense]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4
|-
| [[March]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 2
|-
| [[Adamance]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|-
| [[Rend]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|-
| [[Dine]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4
|-
| [[Titan]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|-
| [[Embrion]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 4
|-
| [[Artifice]] || colspan="2" style="text-align: center;" | 3
|}
=== Inundação ===
A lua começa a inundar, fazendo com que seja impossível atravessar seu exterior após um certo ponto. Algumas luas, como Adamance, começam com inundação máxima, com o nível da água diminuindo com o passar do dia.

Mover em terra inundada deixa ês funcionáries consideravelmente mais lentes e impedinde-es de correr. E ela também suga sua estâmina, impedindo sua regeneração até que ê funcionárie estiver fora da água. Ficar debaixo da água por um longo período de tempo afogará ê funcionárie.

Uma inundação é baseada no horário do dia e piorará ao passar tempo, fazendo com que a lua seja mais perigosa para navegação quanto mais tempo ês funcionáries ficarem.

Tempo até a inundação chegar ao máximo: Aproximadamente até as 5 horas, varia entre as luas.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Neblina ===
Todo o exterior da lua fica difícil de ver devido a neblina exageradamente grande.
</div>

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
There is a mechanism for reducing [[entities]]' vision in fog:
The maximum line-of-sight distance for spotting employees is capped at 30 units (you can think of this as making everything near-sighted).
All entities are affected by this as it's managed by the base class <code>EnemyAI</code>.<ref group="note">
It does also allow for the clamping step to be skipped with a property <code>canSeeThroughFog</code>, but no entity uses that.
</ref>
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Chuvoso ===
A chuva deixa pontos de areia movediça no chão, apresentando uma ameaça rápida e letal para funcionáries. É possível escapar da areia movediça ao reagir rapidamente e sair dela antes de chegar no fundo. Uma poça de areia movediça parece um grande poço de sujeira no chão e, especialmente à noite, fica extremamente difícil de vê-la.
</div>

[[March/pt-br|March]] tem pontos de areia movediça fixos no chão mesmo se não estiver chuvoso (March não pode ter clima chuvoso de qualquer forma).

<span id="Stormy"></span>
=== Tempestade ===
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|Um item faíscando]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|O som que toca quando um item está faíscando]]
Durante uma tempestade, itens condutivos jogados no chão ou segurados por funcionáries podem adquirir uma carga elétrica que causa com que sejam atingidos por um raio após um curto atraso. Quando isso acontece, o item começará a fazer um som característico de faísca. Raios podem ser desviados ao soltar o item e se mover para longe.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.
</div>

Raios aleatórios também podem ocorrer ao redor do mapa, independente se itens condutivos e podem acertar funcionáries sem aviso.
* Se um jogador tiver um item condutivo no inventário mas não o segurando, faíscas ainda vão aparecer e você pode identifica-las rodando pelo inventário.
* Raios cairão em um objeto metálico múltiplas vezes, então está avisado para esperar um ou dois segundos antes de pegar-lo.
* Se um item faíscando é localizado em baixo de algum telhado, o raio vai acertar o telhado e não o item diretamente. Isso funciona principalmente em telhados sólidos ou no teto da nave. Tem outros lugares que isso funciona dependendo do mapa, mas isso nem sempre é uma estratégia confiável.
* Se um raio acerta a nave, as luzes e o monitor da nave vão desligar. Eles podem voltar apertando o interruptor de luz ou um [[Remote/pt-br|controle remoto]] e o botão de energia do lado do monitor, respectivamente.
* É possível que funcionáries previnem um raio, até certo ponto, ficando parado colado em uma parede segurando um item faíscando, ou com uma [[Tulip Snake/pt-br|Cobra Tulipa]] nelu.
* O "Aviso de raio" não aparece quando um objeto no inventário de ume funcionárie está faíscando.
* Itens metálicos comprados durante uma Tempestade não são condutivos e ficaram assim até a nave sair de orbita de novo.
Para uma lista completa de itens condutivos, cheque a página sobre [[scrap/pt-br|sucatas]] e também a [[Store/pt-br#Equipamento|lista de equipamentos]], ou também olhe a [[:Category:Conductive items|categoria de itens condutivos]]

<span id="Weather_choice"></span>
== Escolha do Clima ==

Primeiramente, o jogo decide quantas luas vão ser afetadas pelo clima. Esse valor é avaliado por uma curva com um input aleatório entre 0 e 1. Se o seguinte critério for atendido, o valor avaliado é multiplicado por um número aleatório entre 1.5 e 2.5:

* A tripulação consiste em pelo menos 2 jogadores (Multiplayer)
* O número de dias consecutivos que todos os jogadores sobreviveram em uma partida sem morrer é um múltiplo de 3 (no mínimo de 3 dias)
Nota: O valor avaliado é convertido para um inteiro e é preso entre 0 e o número de luas, que significa que se o valor é acima de 8, todas as luas vão ser afetadas pelo clima.

A curva a esquerda é uma curva padrão para determinar quantas luas vão ser afetadas por condições climáticas. A curva a direita é multiplicada por 2.5, o multiplicador máximo possível, usado quando os critérios acima são atendidos.
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
Para cada lua que foi selecionada, um índice aleatório na lista dos possíveis climas de cada lua então determina o tipo de clima que a lua vai ter no dia.

######## Weather/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}

Погода является механикой, добавляющей сложность на [[moons/ru|луны]]. Сотрудник может узнать прогноз погоды на луне в скобках рядом с названием луны в терминале в разделе ‘moons’. 

Погода не влияет на количество/ценность [[scrap/ru|лома]].

<span id="Weather_types"></span>
== Типы погоды ==

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
=== Затмение ===
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|Луна в затмении]]
Этот погодный феномен вызывает немедленный спавн ночных сущностей и существенно увеличивает частоту спавна сущностей внутри и снаружи здания, делая луны в затмении намного более опасными для исследования, не предлагая никаких бонусов взамен.

Во время затмения, <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>(минимальное количество сущностей внутри здания) и <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>(минимальное количество ночных сущностей) изменяются согласно таблице ниже. Для детального объяснения этих двух переменных смотри [[Mechanics|Механики]].

=== Потоп ===
Луну начинает затоплять, что делает трудным передвижение после определённого момента. Некоторые луны вроде Adamance начинают полностью затопленными, а уровень воды опускается с течением дня.

Движение по воде будет замедленным и уберёт возможность бега, также при движении будет расходоваться и при остановке не будет восстанавливаться выносливость пока сотрудник не выйдет из воды. При слишком долгом нахождении под водой сотрудник задохнётся.

Уровень воды зависит от времени суток постепенно поднимается, делая передвижение по луне более опасным с течением дня.

Время максимального уровня: Примерно 5 PM, время может разниться в зависимости от луны.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Туман ===
Вся поверхность луны окутана густым туманом, что усложняет навигацию по ней.
</div>

Существует механизм ухудшения зрения [[Entities/ru|сущностей]] в тумане: Максимальная дистанция поля зрения для обнаружения сотрудников ограничивается 30 юнитами (считайте, что все сущности становятся близорукими).
Это затрагивает все сущности, так как этот механизм реализован через базовый класс <code>EnemyAI</code>.<ref group="note">
Там же позволяется пропустить применение близорукости с помощью атрибута <code>canSeeThroughFog</code>, но пока ни одна сущность не использует его.</ref>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== Дождь ===
Дождь оставляет тёмные участки зыбучего песка и грязевых луж на поверхности, представляя смертельную ловушку для сотрудников. Можно выбраться из зыбучих песков если достаточно быстро среагировать и вылезти из лужи. Крайне трудно заметить ночью.
</div>

[[March/ru|March]], у которого не может быть дождливой погоды, а также [[Adamance/ru|Adamance]] всегда имеют зыбучие пески на одних и тех же местах вне зависимости от погодных условий.

<span id="Stormy"></span>
=== Шторм ===
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|Искрящийся предмет]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|Звук, издаваемый искрящимся предметом]]
Во время шторма периодически бьют молнии, притягивающиеся к токопроводящим предметам на земле или в руках у сотрудников, вызывая на них удар молнии через короткий промежуток времени. Когда это происходит, предмет начинает издавать звук электричества и визуально искрить. Избежать попадания под молнию можно выбросив предмет и отойдя от него в сторону.

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.
</div>

Случайные удары молний будут также происходить по всей карте вне зависимости от наличия электризуемых предметов под открытым небом и могут при должном (не)везении без предупреждения ударить по сотруднику.
* Если сотрудник имеет при себе токопроводящий предмет в инвентаре, но не держит его, искры всё ещё будут появляться и он сможет определить заряженный предмет переключая слоты инвентаря.
* Молния может ударить по предмету несколько раз, так что следует подождать секунду-две перед тем как брать в руки чтобы убедиться, что по нему не собирается вновь ударить молния.
* Если искрящийся предмет находится под препятствием, например, под крышей, то молния ударит по крыше. Обычно работает если крыша плотная или это крыша корабля. Есть несколько подобных мест на разных лунах, но это не всегда надёжная стратегия.
* Если молния поразит корабль, то погаснет свет и выключится монитор. Можно включить всё заново используя выключатель света или [[Remote|пульт]] (для света) и кнопку питания на мониторе (для основного монитора).
* Можно в некоторой степени избежать попадания молнии, стоя близко к стене и держа в руках искрящийся предмет, либо в полёте на Тюльпановой Змее.
* "Предупреждение об ударе молнии" не может появиться, когда искрящий предмет спрятан в инвентаре сотрудника.
* Предметы, купленные во время Шторма не являются проводящими и останутся таковыми до следующего выхода на орбиту.
Для полного списка токопроводящих предметов смотрите в странице [[scrap/ru|металлолом]] и [[store/ru#Снаряжение|предметы из магазина]], или же взгляните на [[:Category:Conductive items|категорию токопроводящих предметов]].

<span id="Weather_choice"></span>
== Выбор погоды ==

Во-первых, игра решает, сколько лун будут затронуты погодой. Это значение начинает оцениваться по кривой со случайным входным значением между 0 и 1. Если выполняются следующие критерии - оценочное значение затем умножается на случайное число между 1.5 и 2.5:

* Экипаж состоит из как минимум двух сотрудников (Мультиплеер)
* Количество дней, которое все сотрудники выжили подряд без жертв кратно 3 (как минимум 3 дня)
Примечание: Оценочное значение конвертируется в целочисленное и ограничивается между 0 и числом лун, что значит если значение больше 8, то все луны будут затронуты погодой.

Кривая слева - стандартная кривая для определения количества лун, подверженных погодным условиям. Кривая справа умножена на 2.5, что является максимальным возможным множителем, используемым, если условия выше выполняются.
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
Затем для каждой выбранной луны случайный индекс из списка возможных погодных условий для луны определяет тип погоды на луне на этот день.

######## Weather/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{Verify}}
天气是增加[[Moons/zh-cn|星球]]难度的一个机制。玩家可以游戏内一天结束后，在电脑终端中输入指令“moons”来查看每一个星球在降落后的天气状况如何。天气不会影响[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]的数量以及价值。

<span id="Weather_types"></span>
== 天气类型 ==

<span id="Eclipsed"></span>
=== 日食（Eclipsed） ===
[[File:Eclipsedmoon.png|thumb|日食]]
这一天气现象可以使夜间实体立即生成，并且会显著提高室内和室外实体的生成概率。因此，发生日食的星球探索难度极大，且没有任何附加奖励。

日食期间，<code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>（最少生成的室内实体数量）和<code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>（最少生成的夜间实体数量）变量会更改为下表所述值。这两个变量的详细解释可见[[Mechanics|机制]]页。
{| class="wikitable
!
! <code>minEnemiesToSpawn</code>
! <code>minOutsideEnemiesToSpawn</code>

=== 洪水（Flooded） ===
洪水天气下，星球会开始涨水，在特定时间点后会淹没大部分室外区域，使其无法通行。部分星球（如 Adamance）则是在一天开始时达到最大洪水位，此后水位随时间推移逐渐下降。

员工在被水淹没的地带移动时，速度会显著减慢，且无法冲刺；同时还会消耗额外体力，并且体力必须在离开水体后才能恢复。若在水下停留过久，员工将会溺死。

洪水水位会随时间流逝逐渐上涨，员工停留在星球上的时间越长，往返于室外就危险。

一般情况下，洪水会在下午5点涨至最高水位。各个星球的具体时间可能有差异。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
=== Foggy ===
{{about|the outdoor weather type|fog found indoors|Interiors#Indoor fog}}
</div>

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 大雾（Foggy） ===
整颗行星笼罩在浓雾之下，很难在室外区域确认方向。
</div>

游戏中存在一种在雾天降低[[entities|实体]]视野的机制：
实体发现员工的最大视线距离被限制为 30 个单位（可理解为所有单位都变成了近视）。
该机制由基类 <code>EnemyAI</code> 控制，因此所有实体都会受此影响。<ref group="note">
虽然存在一个 <code>canSeeThroughFog</code> 属性可以跳过这一视野限制，但目前没有任何实体使用该属性。

<div class="mw-translate-fuzzy">
=== 阴雨（Rainy） ===
在阴雨天气影响下，降雨会在地面上生成暗色的流沙，对员工构成迅速而致命的威胁。如果反应及时，员工可在刚陷入流沙时迅速后退以脱险。流沙区域看起来像是地面上的一大滩棕色泥土，因此较难以识别，尤其是在夜晚时分。
</div>

March 有不受阴雨天气影响的、固定的流沙生成点位（不过 March 不会有阴雨天气）。

<span id="Stormy"></span>
=== 雷暴雨（Stormy） ===
[[File:LightningSparkEffect.gif|thumb|200px|正冒火花的物品]]
[[File:StormStaticElectricity.ogg|thumb|200px|物品冒火花的同时播放的声音]]
雷暴雨期间，不论是在地上，还是在员工身上的导电物品都有一定概率会被闪电击中。此时，物品将会冒出火花，并伴有电流声。丢下物品并与其保持距离可以躲避雷击。

<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
Lightning deals 50 damage to instant death to the player depending on distance to the strike.
</div>

地图内也可能落下与导电物品无关且没有任何提示的随机闪电。此种闪电也可能击中员工。
* 如果员工的物品槽中有导电物品，尽管没有拿在手上，火花仍有可能出现。他们可以通过快速扫过物品槽来识别带电物品。
* 闪电可能会多次击中金属物体，因此建议等待一两秒钟后再将物品捡回来。
* 若冒火花的物品位于掩体（如屋顶）下方，则闪电会击中掩体，而不会直接击中物品。这主要适用于实心屋顶或飞船的舱顶。在地图中也许能找到其他的安全点位，但总体而言这并非是一个可靠的策略。
* 如果闪电击中飞船，飞船的灯光和监视器将被关闭。可以用船内的开关或[[Remote|遥控器]]重新开灯；按下监视器旁的电源按钮重新打开监视器。
* 员工在手持带电火花的物品时紧贴墙壁站立，或是身上携带郁金香蛇，都能在一定程度上躲避雷击。
* 当引雷的物体正处于某位员工的物品栏中时，类似电火花闪烁的“雷击警告”不会出现。
* 在雷暴天气期间购买的物品不会导电，直到飞船再次进入轨道。
可查看[[Scrap/zh-cn|废料]]页面和[[Store/zh-cn#装备|装备列表]]，或者看看[[:Category:Conductive items|导电物品分类]]以详细了解哪些物品导电。

<span id="Weather_choice"></span>
== 算法 ==

首先，游戏会确定将有天气的星球的数量。这一数量值是从一条曲线生成的，输入值是 0 至 1 的一个随机数。若满足下述条件，该数量值还会再乘上一个 1.5 至 2.5 之间的随机倍数：

* 员工数大于等于 2（多人模式下）
* 所有员工连续存活（无一人死亡）的天数大于 0 且是 3 的倍数
注：最终确定的受天气影响的星球数量会被调整至最小值为 0，最大值为总星球数量的范围内。也就是说，若此数量大于 8，所有的星球都会受天气影响。

左侧的曲线是默认情况下有多少星球受天气影响的曲线。右侧是以上条件满足且随机倍数为最大 2.5 时的曲线。
[[File:Moonweathercurvegraph.png|950px]]
对于每个被选中的的星球，游戏会再从相应星球的可能出现的天气列表中随机抽取一种作为当天星球上的天气。

== Overview == <!--T:1-->

<!--T:2-->
'''Weed killer''' is an item used to kill [[Vain Shroud]]s and [[Cadaver Growth]]s, as well as cure Cadaver Growth infection. It has roughly 30 seconds worth of usage, with each full spray taking about a second. When used to cure infected employees, it will deal 8 damage, but will not damage healthy employees.

<!--T:3-->
Weed Killer can also be used to repair and fuel the [[Company Cruiser]]. Each spray fills a tenth of the Company Cruiser's health, and a fifth of it's fuel, or "turbo" bar.

== Overview ==

'''Weed killer''' is an item used to kill [[Vain Shroud]]s and [[Cadaver Growth]]s, as well as cure Cadaver Growth infection. It has roughly 30 seconds worth of usage, with each full spray taking about a second. When used to cure infected employees, it will deal 8 damage, but will not damage healthy employees.

Weed Killer can also be used to repair and fuel the [[Company Cruiser]]. Each spray fills a tenth of the Company Cruiser's health, and a fifth of it's fuel, or "turbo" bar.

== Overview == <!--T:1-->

<!--T:2-->
The '''weekly challenge''' is a randomly generated moon that uses the same seed for every player and changes every week.

<!--T:3-->
[[File:ChallengeQuotaScreens.png|thumb|The replaced quota and deadline screen during challenge mode]]

<!--T:4-->
Weekly challenge moons have randomly generated names, heavily increased amounts of scrap compared to what would normally be found on any given moon, a random amount of starting credits in the terminal, and other properties. Despite all of these tweaks, however, they are actually just vanilla moons, which means the exteriors are the same as the vanilla moons and never change.

<!--T:5-->
There is no quota that players must meet; the monitors inside of the ship will instead read, "AS MUCH PROFIT AS POSSIBLE." The challenge moons serve as a way to give all players a shared experience.

<!--T:6-->
As the seed is fixed, most random mechanics such as [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|which entities will spawn]], [[scrap]] locations, and [[Gift]] drops will be the same every time.
However, employees can influence the spawn schedule by killing [[entities]] (or not),
and some mechanics like [[Interiors#Steam_leaks|steam leaks]] aren't set upon starting the day and won't be consistent.

<!--T:7-->
After returning to orbit, all collected scrap is automatically tallied and a final score is shown, including an updated leaderboard position.<ref group="note">
Due to a bug, your new score and position will always overwrite your previous, even if it's lower.
</ref>
Retrieved [[Bodies]] count as {{credits|5}} each, like those sold at [[the Company]] during normal play.
At that point the lobby has effectively been reset and the team can choose to land and try again.

<!--T:8-->
If you've completed (or failed) this week's challenge, selecting it again in the main menu will display the leaderboard.
<br>As of 2024-09, there are zero anti-cheat measures, so naturally all the top spots are occupied by people playing with mods and blatant cheaters.

<!--T:9-->
The challenge is replaced with another at midnight UTC at the start of ''Monday''.

######## Weekly challenge/en
{{topicon Fandom|Challenge_Moons}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
{{interlangbox}}
== Overview ==

The '''weekly challenge''' is a randomly generated moon that uses the same seed for every player and changes every week.

[[File:ChallengeQuotaScreens.png|thumb|The replaced quota and deadline screen during challenge mode]]

Weekly challenge moons have randomly generated names, heavily increased amounts of scrap compared to what would normally be found on any given moon, a random amount of starting credits in the terminal, and other properties. Despite all of these tweaks, however, they are actually just vanilla moons, which means the exteriors are the same as the vanilla moons and never change.

There is no quota that players must meet; the monitors inside of the ship will instead read, "AS MUCH PROFIT AS POSSIBLE." The challenge moons serve as a way to give all players a shared experience.

As the seed is fixed, most random mechanics such as [[Mechanics#Entity_spawning|which entities will spawn]], [[scrap]] locations, and [[Gift]] drops will be the same every time.
However, employees can influence the spawn schedule by killing [[entities]] (or not),
and some mechanics like [[Interiors#Steam_leaks|steam leaks]] aren't set upon starting the day and won't be consistent.

After returning to orbit, all collected scrap is automatically tallied and a final score is shown, including an updated leaderboard position.<ref group="note">
Due to a bug, your new score and position will always overwrite your previous, even if it's lower.
</ref>
Retrieved [[Bodies]] count as {{credits|5}} each, like those sold at [[the Company]] during normal play.
At that point the lobby has effectively been reset and the team can choose to land and try again.

If you've completed (or failed) this week's challenge, selecting it again in the main menu will display the leaderboard.
<br>As of 2024-09, there are zero anti-cheat measures, so naturally all the top spots are occupied by people playing with mods and blatant cheaters.

The challenge is replaced with another at midnight UTC at the start of ''Monday''.

== Trivia ==

The [[Bestiary]] and [[Sigurd Logs]] aren't reset upon completing (or failing) the challenge, only when quitting to the main menu.
This means you can't use the bestiary or journal notifications for long-range communication on subsequent attempts.

The default [[Orange Suit]] is replaced with the [[Purple Suit]].
Despite that, it's still possible to buy the purple suit from the store, resulting in 2 purple suits on the rack.

Attempting to route to another moon, including the Company, will result in the message <q>You selected the Challenge Moon save file. You can't route to another moon during the challenge.</q>
(If the moon has a toll you can't afford, it will show the usual out-of-funds message instead.)

Quitting while on the surface will display the <q>The file will NOT save!</q> warning despite saving being disabled for the weekly challenge.

######## Weekly challenge/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom|Challenge_Moons}}
[[Category:Gameplay_mechanics]]
{{interlangbox}}
<span id="Overview"></span>
== 概述 ==

'''每周挑战'''是一个随机生成的卫星，它对所有玩家使用相同的随机种子，并且每周都会更换。

[[File:ChallengeQuotaScreens.png|thumb|挑战模式下被替换后的配额与期限界面]]

每周挑战卫星会生成随机名称，其废品数量相比普通卫星会大幅增加，终端内会随机生成初始信用点，还带有其他特性。不过，尽管做了这些调整，它们本质上仍属于原版卫星，也就是说卫星外部场景与原版一致，且不会发生变化。

玩家没有必须完成的配额要求；飞船内的监视器会显示：“尽可能获取更多收益。”
挑战卫星旨在为所有玩家提供共同一致的游戏体验。

由于种子是固定的，大多数随机机制——例如会生成哪些实体、[[scrap|废料]]的位置以及[[Gift|礼物]]掉落等，每次都会保持一致。

不过，员工可以通过击杀（或不击杀）[[entities|实体]] 来影响生成时序；
而像[[steam leaks|蒸汽泄漏]]这类机制并不会在当天开始时就固定，因此不会保持一致。

返回轨道后，所有收集到的废品会自动统计并显示最终得分，同时更新排行榜排名。

由于一个漏洞，你的新分数和排名总会覆盖之前的记录，即使分数更低也会覆盖。


回收的[[Bodies|尸体]]每具计为5 信用点，与常规游戏中在[[the Company|公司]]出售时的价值一致。

此时大厅会被有效重置，队伍可以选择再次降落进行挑战。

如果你已完成（或失败）本周挑战，在主菜单中再次选择它将会显示排行榜。

截至2024年9月，该模式尚无任何反作弊措施，因此排行榜前列自然全都被使用模组的玩家以及公然作弊者占据。

挑战会在**世界协调时间周一午夜**更新替换为新的内容。
<div style="clear: both;"></div>

<span id="Trivia"></span>
== 趣闻 ==

完成（或失败）挑战后，[[Bestiary|生物图鉴]] 和 [[Sigurd Logs|西格德日志]] 不会被重置，只有返回主菜单时才会重置。这意味着你无法在后续尝试中，通过生物图鉴或日志提示进行远距离沟通。

默认的[[Orange Suit|橙色防护服]]会被替换为[[Purple Suit|紫色防护服]]。
尽管如此，玩家仍然可以在商店购买紫色防护服，这会导致衣架上出现两件紫色防护服。

尝试导航至其他卫星（包括公司所在卫星）时，会弹出提示信息：
你选择了挑战卫星存档。在挑战期间无法前往其他卫星。
（若该卫星需要通行费而你余额不足，则会显示常规的资金不足提示。）

在地表时退出游戏会显示：文件将不会保存！
的警告，尽管每周挑战模式本身已禁用存档功能。

== Overview ==

The '''Welcome mat''' is a ship decor item bought from the [[terminal]] for 40 credits.

It has no functionality other than as a decorative prop. It ''does'' have collision, raising employees slightly off the floor.

######## Whoopie cushion
{{topicon Fandom|Whoopie-Cushion}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item}}
{{Stub}}
<translate>
<!--T:1-->
The Whoopie Cushion, introduced in [[Version 45]] of the game, stands out as a unique (and amusing) item. Functioning like any standard item, players can locate and acquire it during gameplay. Notably, the Whoopie Cushion holds no weight within the inventory, making it easier to transport.

<!--T:2-->
Upon being walked over, the Whoopie Cushion emits a distinctive fart sound. It's '''essential''' to note that players are unable to activate the fart sound voluntarily when the item is held, it must be dropped and walked over. While the Whoopie Cushion may not yield significant value in terms of scrap, its appeal lies in its comedic value.

<!--T:3-->
It is especially important to note that the Whoopie Cushion can be hidden within ship upgrades such as the [[Teleporter]] pad or a strategically placed [[welcome mat]], by first placing the Whoopie cushion on the the floor of the ship then moving the upgrade onto it. This can be used to hide one or more Whoopie Cushions with which to "improve" crew morale.

<!--T:4-->
The Whoopie Cushion can also be laid around the ship and stepped on to attract dogs, which will act as a permanent dog trap, as the dog will dash at the whoopie cushion, step on it and make noise, and then repeat the cycle forever.
</translate>

######## Whoopie cushion/en
{{topicon Fandom|Whoopie-Cushion}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item}}
{{Stub}}
The Whoopie Cushion, introduced in [[Version 45]] of the game, stands out as a unique (and amusing) item. Functioning like any standard item, players can locate and acquire it during gameplay. Notably, the Whoopie Cushion holds no weight within the inventory, making it easier to transport.

Upon being walked over, the Whoopie Cushion emits a distinctive fart sound. It's '''essential''' to note that players are unable to activate the fart sound voluntarily when the item is held, it must be dropped and walked over. While the Whoopie Cushion may not yield significant value in terms of scrap, its appeal lies in its comedic value.

It is especially important to note that the Whoopie Cushion can be hidden within ship upgrades such as the [[Teleporter]] pad or a strategically placed [[welcome mat]], by first placing the Whoopie cushion on the the floor of the ship then moving the upgrade onto it. This can be used to hide one or more Whoopie Cushions with which to "improve" crew morale.

The Whoopie Cushion can also be laid around the ship and stepped on to attract dogs, which will act as a permanent dog trap, as the dog will dash at the whoopie cushion, step on it and make noise, and then repeat the cycle forever.

The most specialized self-protective equipment, capable of sending upwards of 80,000 volts!

== Function == <!--T:12--> 

<!--T:5-->
To perform the stun, the employee must keep the current centered on the target by moving it left or right depending on the pull. Failing this will cause the Zap Gun to overheat, disabling usage for a short period of time. The Zap Gun has a limited amount of charge before having to recharge it at the [[Ship#Recharge station|recharge station]] present in the ship.

<!--T:6-->
* When not cranking, the [[Jester]] will remain stunned for a period even after the Zap Gun animation ends.

== Strategy == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Simply put, this is a reusable and more sustained [[Stun Grenade]] that is best used in combination with a [[Shovel]]-wielding co-worker to damage the threat while the other stuns it. The Zap Gun is also a good way to stall for your co-workers to run and for your stamina to regenerate. The Zap Gun is able to hit your co-workers (which slows their movement speed to a crawl), so it is best to avoid putting them in your line of fire.

######## Zap gun/en

The '''Zap Gun''' is a type of [[scrap]] that can be purchased from the [[store]] for {{credits|400}} [[credits]]. It is a tool for stunning [[entities]] instead of directly damaging them.

== Company description ==
{{terminal|The most specialized self-protective equipment, capable of sending upwards of 80,000 volts!


To keep it targeted as long as possible, pull the gun side-to-side to counter the bend and fight against the pull of the electric beam. It can only stun for as long as you keep the current flowing.
}}
== Function == 

To perform the stun, the employee must keep the current centered on the target by moving it left or right depending on the pull. Failing this will cause the Zap Gun to overheat, disabling usage for a short period of time. The Zap Gun has a limited amount of charge before having to recharge it at the [[Ship#Recharge station|recharge station]] present in the ship.

* When not cranking, the [[Jester]] will remain stunned for a period even after the Zap Gun animation ends.

== Strategy ==

Simply put, this is a reusable and more sustained [[Stun Grenade]] that is best used in combination with a [[Shovel]]-wielding co-worker to damage the threat while the other stuns it. The Zap Gun is also a good way to stall for your co-workers to run and for your stamina to regenerate. The Zap Gun is able to hit your co-workers (which slows their movement speed to a crawl), so it is best to avoid putting them in your line of fire.

The '''Zap Gun''' is a type of [[scrap]] that can be purchased from the [[store]] for {{credits|400}} [[credits]]. It is a tool for stunning [[entities]] instead of directly damaging them.

<span id="Company_description"></span>
== Descrição da Companhia ==
{{terminal|O equipamento de auto proteção mais especializado, capaz de emitir mais de 80.000 volts!


Para deixá-lo no alvo por mais tempo o possível, puxe a arma para os lados para lutar contra o empuxo da corrente elétrica. Ela consegue atordoar enquanto você deixar a corrente fluir.
}}
<div lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr">
== Function ==
</div> 

A '''Arma de choque''' é usada para atordoar [[entities/pt-br|entidades]]. Para performar o atordoamento você deve deixar a corrente centralizada no alvo por mover a arma para esquerda ou direita, dependendo do empuxo. Falhar nisso fará com que a arma sobrecarregue por um tempo. A arma de choque tem uma bateria limitada antes que seja necessário recarregá-la na [[Ship/pt-br#Estação de Recarga|Estação de Recarga]] presente na nave.

* Enquanto não estiver ativado, o [[Jester/pt-br|Palhaço]] ficará atordoado por um tempo até depois da animação da arma de choque acabar.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Estratégia ==

De forma simplificada, essa é uma [[Stun grenade/pt-br|Granada de atordoamento]] reusável e mais longa. É melhor utilizá-la com outre funcionárie que esteja com uma [[Shovel/pt-br|pá]] para [[damage/pt-br|danificar]] a ameaça enquanto ê outre a atordoa. A arma de choque também é um bom jeito de enrolar para que seus colegues fujam e sua estâmina recupere. A arma também pode atingir seus colegues (que deixa seus movimentos muito mais lentos) então tente não usa-lá quando elus estiverem na sua frente.

######## Zap gun/ru
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!-- normal -->
|audible=While shocking target<!-- TODO what about the scan? -->
|battery=Yes<!-- TODO details -->
|primary-use=<q>Scan for threat</q> (hold)

}}
'''Электро-пушка''' - тип [[scrap|лома]], который можно приобрести в [[store/ru|магазине]] за {{credits|400}}. Этот инструмент оглушает [[entities/ru|сущности]] вместо нанесения им прямого урона.

<span id="Company_description"></span>
== Описание компании ==
{{terminal|Самое специализированное приспособление для самообороны, способное выдавать вплоть до 80,000 вольт!


Чтобы удерживать её на цели как можно дольше, тяните пушку из стороны в стороны, чтобы нивелировать изгиб луча и сопротивляйтесь его утягиванию. Электро-пушка оглушает сущности лишь до тех пор, пока вы удерживаете стабильный поток.
}}
<span id="Function"></span>
== Принцип работы == 

Для оглушения сотрудник должен удерживать поток центрированным в сторону цели, утягивая его влево или вправо в зависимости от того, в какую сторону сам луч пытается утянуть вашу пушку. Если с этой задачей не справиться - Электро-пушка перегреется и уйдёт на остывание на непродолжительный промежуток времени. Электро-пушка имеет ограниченный заряд, по иссякании которого её потребуется перезарядить с помощью [[Ship/ru#Катушка|катушки]] на корабле.

* Если [[Jester/ru|Балагур]] ещё не заводится, то после окончания анимации оглушения Электро-пушкой он останется оглушённым ещё на какое-то время.

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== Стратегия ==

Проще говоря - это многоразовая [[Stun Grenade/ru|Светошумовая гранта]] более размеренного, продолжительного действия, которую лучше всего использовать в комбинации с коллегой с [[Shovel/ru|Лопатой]], который будет наносить урон угрозе в то время как сотрудник с Электро-пушкой оглушает её. Электро-пушка также является хорошим способом задержать преследователя и дать коллегам шанс убежать и вашей стамине восстановиться. Электро-пушка также может быть использована на ваших коллегах (существенно замедляя их скорость передвижения), так что лучше убедиться, что в зоне сканирования Электропушки перед выстрелом нет дружественных целей.

== История ==

{{navbox items}}

######## Zap gun/zh-cn
{{topicon Fandom}}
{{interlangbox}}
{{autoinfobox item
|physics=<!-- normal -->
|audible=While shocking target<!-- TODO what about the scan? -->
|battery=Yes<!-- TODO details -->
|primary-use=<q>Scan for threat</q> (hold)
|secondary-use=<!-- none -->
|tertiary-use=<!-- none -->
|inspectable=<!-- no -->
}}
电击枪（Zap Gun）是一种可从商店花费400 信用点购买的废品类道具。它属于牵制型工具，用于击晕实体，而非直接造成伤害。

<span id="Company_description"></span>
== 公司描述 ==
{{terminal|最专业的自卫装备，可释放高达 8 万伏特的电压！


要尽可能长时间锁定目标，需左右摆动枪身来抵消光束弯曲，并对抗电击束的拉扯力。只有持续通电，才能保持眩晕效果。
}}
<span id="Function"></span>
== 功能 == 

要实现眩晕效果，使用者必须根据电击束的拉扯方向左右移动枪口，让电流持续对准目标。一旦操作失误，电击枪就会过热，并在短时间内无法使用。
电击枪的电量有限，需在飞船内的充电装置处进行充电后才能继续使用。

若未持续转动曲柄，即使电击枪的动画效果结束，[[Jester|小丑盒子]] 仍会被眩晕一段时间。

<span id="Strategy"></span>
== 策略 ==

简单来说，这是一款**可重复使用、控场更持久的[[Stun Grenade|震撼弹]]。
最佳用法是：一人持电击枪控场眩晕敌人，另一人手持[[Shovel|铲子]]趁机输出伤害。

电击枪也能有效拖延时间，让队友撤离、自身恢复耐力。
注意：电击枪会误伤队友（会使其移动速度变得极慢），因此尽量不要朝队友方向射击。

* The Zed Dog is 1 of 8 Scrap Items that were added to the game in [[Version 60]].
* It is currently the rarest Scrap Item in the game. Additionally, it has the widest price fork in the game.

This was done in celebration of the Zed Dog Makeship plush,<ref name="makeship"/> which was advertised in the update notes.<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1966720/view/544484746860693720 V70 - The Incubating Update] via Lethal Company's news page on Steam.</ref>
** As a result of this change, the Zed Dog is now most likely to spawn on Rend, whereas its highest spawn chance had previously been on [[Assurance]] and [[Offense]].

== 趣闻 ==
* 泽德犬是游戏[[Version 60]]版本新增的8件废品道具**之一。
* 它目前是游戏中**最稀有的废品道具**。此外，它的**价格浮动区间也是游戏里最大的**。
* 在[[Version 70]]版本中，[[Vow]]与[[Rend]]上泽德犬的生成概率得到了提升。此举是为了庆祝Makeship推出的泽德犬官方毛绒玩偶发售，该玩偶也在本次更新日志中进行了宣传。
** 因此次改动，泽德犬现在最常生成于Rend，而在此之前，它的最高生成概率出现在[[Assurance]]和[[Offense]]。
